The SGP MP asked the Health Minister whether the Covid advisory committee's advice on digital tools was sent to parliament too late, and whether the minister restricted the committee to advice only when requested. The minister denied political motives for timing, confirmed the committee will now advise only on request, and said the mandate and membership are still under discussion.
Political considerations play no role in the timing of sending the advice.
Politieke overwegingen spelen geen rol bij het moment van verzenden van de adviezen.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bisschop over rechtsbescherming na Brexit

MPs Van der Staaij and Bisschop asked how legal protection in cross-border contract disputes with a British party has changed after Brexit, including the enforcement gap left by the Brussels I-bis and Rome I regimes, the 1967 bilateral treaty, and whether the UK should join the Lugano Convention. The minister replied that Dutch courts still apply Rome I, that enforcement now falls back on national rules and the 2019 Hague Judgments Convention (not yet in force for the UK), that the Commission opposes UK accession to Lugano, and that the government will push the Hague Convention and await an advisory report on article 431 Rv.
Finally, the Netherlands is working to reach a decision in the EU as quickly as possible to become a party to the 2019 Hague Conference Judgments Convention.
Ten slotte zet Nederland zich in om in de EU zo snel mogelijk tot een besluit te komen om partij te worden bij het Executieverdrag van de Haagse Conferentie van 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Bikker, Kuzu, Pouw-Verweij en Van der Plas over eiwit-vaccins

MPs asked the health minister about people who want a protein-based COVID-19 vaccine, the cancellation or reduction of Sanofi and Novavax orders, and vaccine efficacy data. The minister said the government has no data on the size of this group, chose Novavax over Sanofi and bought fewer Novavax doses because mRNA vaccines were already sufficient, and gave efficacy figures while noting approval and procurement decisions rest with EMA and the Gezondheidsraad.
I therefore see no need to investigate this in further detail, but will ask the RIVM to keep paying attention to this in its monitoring.
Ik zie daarom geen noodzaak om dit in verder detail uit te zoeken, maar zal het RIVM vragen ook hier in de monitoring aandacht voor te blijven houden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Wilders, Agema, Hijink, Westerveld, Kuiken, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Gündoğan, Van Esch, Simons en Den Haan over de uitspraken van dhr. Gommers dat hij over 10 dagen code zwa

MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the November measures were working, given expert warnings of a 'code black' hospital crisis, and questioned testing, boosters, staffing, supplies, security and a medium-term strategy. The Minister answered that pressure on care is rising, phase 2d was declared with planned care being scaled down, and that no indication yet exists for phase 3, while defending booster timing and deferring some points to earlier letters.
I am in constant contact with field parties in order to maintain a sharp view of the current situation on the shop floor in various care sectors.
Ook ben ik constant in gesprek met veldpartijen, om scherp zicht te houden op de actuele situatie op de werkvloer in verschillende zorgsectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het artikel ‘Onrust in Amersfoort over spirituele rituelen op begraafplaats’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether spiritual rituals at an Amersfoort cemetery without relatives' consent fall under the Dutch crime of grave desecration, and whether the law should be widened. The minister declined to prejudge the public prosecutor's assessment of the reported complaints, said WODC is studying widening the offence of desecration of corpses, and stated that conduct being unpunishable does not mean it is socially acceptable.
It is for the public prosecutor to judge whether it can be concluded without further ado that the conduct described in the news article would not fall under the offence of grave desecration.

Het is aan het OM om te oordelen of zonder meer kan worden geconcludeerd dat de gedragingen die worden beschreven in het nieuwsartikel waarnaar u verwijst, niet onder de strafbaarstelling van grafschennis zouden vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over het coronatoegangsbewijs

MPs Van der Staaij and Stoffer asked about the COVID coronatoegangsbewijs (CTB) being required at a Deventer inloophuis, in lawyers' training, for journalists and officials, and whether the Van der Staaij amendment exempts public buildings. Minister Grapperhaus replied that CTB obligations apply only to specified venues, that buurt- en wijkcentra are largely exempt, that the occupational exemption in article 58ra covers journalists and officials when their work requires presence at a venue, and that no CTB applies at the town hall.
Buurt- and wijkcentra are exempt from the CTB requirement for events that form part of regular operations.
Voor buurt- en wijkcentra geldt een uitzondering op de CTB plicht voor evenementen die tot de reguliere exploitatie behoren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Kathmann, Kuik, Van Nispen, Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij, Ellemeet, Gündoğan, Omtzigt en Van Esch over de daadwerkelijke inwerkingtreding van de Wet kansspelen op afstand en het be

MPs from several parties asked the government about protecting minors and vulnerable groups from online gambling advertising, the 30% youth-audience interpretation in the industry gambling advertising code, enforcement by the Kansspelautoriteit, and the implementation of the Vos motion and amendment on warnings. The minister answered that the ban on targeting youth is absolute, enforcement lies with the Ksa, a time-slot restriction is currently not feasible, and a new warning text is being developed via Trimbos.
The Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) supervises compliance with advertising restriction measures laid down in laws and regulations.
De Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) houdt toezicht op de naleving van reclamebeperkende maatregelen die zijn neergelegd in wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Segers over partijdigheid van de UNHRC-onderzoekscommissie naar eventuele oorlogsmisdaden door Israël en de Palestijnen

MPs Van der Staaij and Segers asked whether the UNHRC commission of inquiry on Israel and the Palestinians is biased, given members' past public criticism of Israel, and whether its open-ended mandate should be changed. The Minister answered that members are appointed by the UNHRC President who must ensure impartiality, that the Netherlands abstained partly over the mandate's breadth, and that the government will scrutinise future reports for one-sided positions.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bisschop over de interpretatie van de grondwettelijke bepalingen inzake het erfelijk koningschap, met name de artikelen 24 en 25

Two SGP MPs asked whether the government's position that a crown heir may marry a same-sex partner without renouncing the throne, and that a consent law is a sufficient route, is consistent with the constitution's closed hereditary succession and with the earlier cabinet's view that marriage implies capacity for children. The minister replied that consent is a matter for the legislature in a concrete case, that the government sees no obstacle to a consent law, and that the earlier view was less firm, without citing new advice.

It is inevitable that there is a fundamental tension with the closed system of succession in the Constitution, which precisely aims to establish on objective and unambiguous grounds who the monarchy passes to.

Het is onvermijdelijk dat er fundamenteel een spanning is met het gesloten systeem van erfopvolging in de Grondwet, dat juist beoogt om op objectieve en eenduidige gronden vast te stellen op wie het koningschap overgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van der Staaij over de opstelling van de staat in zaken rondom afstandsmoeders en verjaring bij adoptie

MPs Van Nispen and Van der Staaij asked why the state is now being sued over non-voluntary domestic adoptions and whether it should waive limitation defences as it did for intercountry adoption. The Minister said the Commission report is still under review with stakeholders, that the state assesses limitation defences case by case, and that the court must now decide.
It is now up to the court to rule on this defence.
Het is nu aan de rechtbank om over dit verweer te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over vaccinatiedrang- en dwang en coronatoegangsbewijzen

An MP (Van der Staaij, SGP) asked the health minister whether companies such as Leaseplan may pressure staff and customers to get vaccinated, whether employees can be asked for their vaccination status, and about the proportionality of extending COVID certificates and the rules on natural immunity and transmission. The minister replied that there is no vaccination obligation, that employers may ask about vaccination status under conditions, that he cannot comment on Leaseplan based on press reports, and that the government is consulting sectors and working on the motions regarding recovery certificates.
These motions are currently being worked out, with the OMT asked for advice.
Deze moties worden op dit moment uitgewerkt, waarbij het OMT om advies is gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Van der Staaij over een luchtbrug voor vluchtelingen uit kwetsbare groepen uit Afghanistan

MPs Ceder and Van der Staaij asked whether the government would help vulnerable Afghan refugees (women in public roles, Afghan contractors, Christians) leave Kabul via a proposed airlift and admit some into the Dutch asylum procedure, and whether Christians' religion recorded in identity documents exposes them to greater risk. The minister replied that the Dutch evacuation ended on 26 August, that the government continues efforts to bring eligible people out and cooperates with regional countries and allies, and that it cannot yet assess the extra danger to Christians.
The cabinet will continue to actively make efforts to bring people who qualify out of Afghanistan or via neighbouring countries to the Netherlands in the coming period.
Het kabinet blijft zich actief inspannen om ook de komende periode mensen die daarvoor in aanmerking komen uit Afghanistan of via de buurlanden naar Nederland over te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over het bericht dat Belarus ongeveer 1 miljard euro ontvangt van het Internationaal Monetair Fonds

MPs Van der Staaij and Stoffer asked whether the IMF's SDR allocation to Belarus, its conditions, monitoring and sanctions impact were acceptable given Dutch sanctions. Ministers Hoekstra and Knapen answered that SDR allocations are unconditional and generic, that the Netherlands will try to limit Belarus's ability to convert SDRs on capital markets, and that no reversal of the allocation is planned.

The Netherlands will seek, in line with existing sanctions policy and in contacts with the EU and other international partners, to limit as far as possible Belarus's options to convert SDRs on the capital market.

Nederland zet erop in om, in lijn met het staande sanctiebeleid, in contacten met de EU en andere internationale partners de mogelijkheden voor Belarus om SDR's te verzilveren op de kapitaalmarkt zo veel mogelijk te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over onteigening in Zuid-Afrika van land of bezit zonder compensatie

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a proposed South African constitutional amendment allowing expropriation without (proportionate) compensation amounts to state theft, its effects on farmers and the economy, and whether the Netherlands would seek international pressure. The minister declined to speculate on foreign law, stressed South Africa's democratic checks and independent courts, said the Netherlands has raised concerns bilaterally and in EU and OECD fora, and promised to keep monitoring the process.
The government will continue to monitor the process of land reform and the respect for property rights in South Africa.
De regering zal het proces van landhervorming en de eerbiediging van eigendomsrechten in Zuid-Afrika blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het artikel ‘De complotdenker bankiert maar elders, zegt de bank’

An MP asked whether banks may close accounts of clients who spread controversial messages without breaking the law, and how freedom of expression is protected against bank blocking. The government answered that banks act under AML rules, prudential integrity requirements and private contract law, that controversial views alone are insufficient grounds, and that banks must be transparent about reasons and clients can complain to Kifid or the courts, without committing to a concrete new step.
The cabinet therefore considers it important, with a view to freedom of expression, that banks are transparent when they take action based on a breach of their intention.
Het kabinet vindt het daarom, met het oog op de vrijheid van meningsuiting, van belang dat banken transparant zijn als zij actie ondernemen op basis van een overtreding van hun voornemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Ceder, Segers en Van der Staaij over de situatie van Afghaanse christenen

Four MPs asked the government about the situation of Afghan Christians and converts under the Taliban, and whether asylum policy should be loosened. The government said the situation of religious minorities was already concerning, that information is limited, and that a moratorium on decisions and departures has been imposed with a new country report and further consultation with parliament promised.
After receiving the country report, the House will be further informed about the conclusions that can be drawn from it for the country-based asylum policy.
Na ontvangst van het ambtsbericht wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd over de conclusies die uit dat ambtsbericht kunnen worden getrokken voor het landgeboden asielbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat het Openbaar Ministerie harde kritiek heeft op de euthanasierichtlijn

An SGP MP asked ministers whether the Public Prosecution Service's criticism of the Regional Euthanasia Review Committees' revised code, and rising euthanasia notifications with few 'careless' rulings, were acceptable. The government answered that it will not publish the prosecutor-general's letter, that the RTE acted without the OM and IGJ, and that a new code, a fourth law evaluation and discussion with the OM are planned, though transparency and independent research were deferred.
It is not fitting for my colleague the Minister of Justice and Security to make public letters from the procurator-general addressed to him.
Het past mijn ambtgenoot van Justitie en Veiligheid niet om brieven van de procureur-generaal die aan hem zijn gericht, openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas, Van der Staaij en Segers over de zoektocht naar Samuël Boujadi

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister why Italian authorities searched inadequately for missing Dutch national Samuël Boujadi, whether the ministry would support further searches or reimburse the family's search costs, and what it would do to help recovery of his body. The minister answered that Italian authorities have jurisdiction and say they searched longer than usual, that the Netherlands cannot intervene without invitation, that specific assistance was offered but not used, and that no reimbursement was promised.
The Netherlands may not and cannot interfere in investigation and legal proceedings in another state without an invitation or permission.
Nederland mag en kan zich niet zonder uitnodiging c.q. toestemming mengen in de opsporing en rechtsgang in een andere staat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Van der Werf, Kuik, Bikker en Van der Staaij over het onderzoek naar de beveiligingssituatie van Peter R. de Vries

MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the investigation into protection of Peter R. de Vries should be broadened to earlier victims and whether the inquiry commission should be fully independent with an additional criminal-law expert. The minister answered that the Safety Board (OVV) will investigate lessons from protection of the brother, lawyer and confidant of the Marengo witness, and that the broader scope fits an OVV inquiry rather than the previously planned commission, while not doubting the commission members' suitability.

I have asked the Dutch Safety Board (OVV) to take on an investigation into the lessons that can be drawn from the security situations of the brother, the then lawyer and the confidant of the crown witness in the Marengo trial.

Ik heb de Onderzoeksraad voor de Veiligheid (OVV) gevraagd om het op zich te nemen in een onderzoek na te gaan welke lessen getrokken kunnen worden uit de beveiligingssituaties van de broer, de toenmalig advocaat en de vertrouwenspersoon van de kroongetuige in het Marengo-proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Van der Staaij over onderdrukking van religieuze minderheden in India naar aanleiding van onderzoek door de London School of Economics

MPs Segers and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister about reported persecution of religious minorities in India, including disinformation and incitement described in an LSE/Open Doors report, and whether the Netherlands would support an international inquiry, act on media platforms, and hold officials accountable. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described existing Dutch projects, human rights dialogues and planned UN review, but did not commit to an international inquiry or to holding Indian officials accountable.
The Netherlands conveys its concerns about these developments to the Indian authorities.
Nederland brengt de zorgen over deze ontwikkelingen over bij de Indiase autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over haatzaaien in (nieuwe) Palestijnse lesmethoden

Two SGP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about incitement and intolerance in new Palestinian school textbooks, including martyr-counting exercises, the omission of Israel from maps, altered wording about Jewish history and people, and whether Dutch or EU funds finance these materials. The minister answered that the EU-commissioned Georg Eckert Institute study finds a mixed picture with some problematic and antisemitic passages but improvements in 2020 editions, that incitement is unacceptable and should be removed, that the Netherlands does not fund textbooks directly, and that UNRWA continuously screens materials.
The cabinet considers it of great importance that such examples are removed by the Palestinian Authority as quickly as possible and that it continues to carry out strict review of this.
Het kabinet acht het van groot belang dat dergelijke voorbeelden door de Palestijnse Autoriteit zo snel mogelijk worden verwijderd en dat het hier een strikte toetsing op blijft uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het overlijden van een 28-jarige vrouw door het dodelijke poeder van de Coöperatie Laatste Wil

MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the health and justice ministers about the death of a 28-year-old woman who took a lethal powder recommended by the Coöperatie Laatste Wil, and about the cooperative's activities, data on deaths, criminal liability and possible prohibition. The minister answered that a criminal investigation is ongoing and cannot be discussed in detail, that the NVIC data are only partially shared on advice, and that existing chemical-sale measures and a 2019 monitoring code remain in place, while noting that providing mere general information is not necessarily punishable.
Regarding this criminal investigation, I cannot make any further statements in the interest of the investigation.
Over dit strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik in het belang van het onderzoek geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over mogelijke blootstelling van Nederlanders in de Dominicaanse Republiek aan de chemische stof Lewisite (L)

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch nationals in the Dominican Republic may have been exposed to the chemical agent Lewisite, whether this constitutes a chemical weapon, and whether the government, the OPCW or the state should investigate and support the victims. The minister answered that lewisite is a Schedule 1 chemical weapon, that no evidence currently shows use of a chemical weapon, that no further investigation or OPCW involvement is warranted now, and that the victims can seek assistance from competent bodies in the Netherlands.
From the currently known facts and circumstances, it cannot be concluded that there would have been use of a chemical weapon.
Uit de thans bekende feiten en omstandigheden kan niet worden geconcludeerd dat er sprake zou zijn geweest van gebruik van een chemisch wapen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Segers, Van der Plas, De Roon, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Lee, Agnes Mulder en Eppink over het bericht dat Indonesië dreigt met 'uitroeiing' separatisten op Papoea

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Indonesia threatened to 'eradicate' Papuan separatists, the killing of an intelligence officer, fears of disproportionate military violence and displacement, Papuans' political rights, and what the Netherlands would do. The minister answered that Indonesia has security duties but concerns about military presence, civilian harm and rights restrictions are shared, and said the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally and in EU dialogue without intervening in foreign court cases.
The Netherlands will continue to press the Indonesian authorities for a meaningful dialogue between all parties involved.
Nederland zal bij de Indonesische autoriteiten blijven aandringen op een betekenisvolle dialoog, tussen alle betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Segers over Nederlandse deelname aan Durban IV-conferentie

MPs Van der Staaij and Segers asked whether the Netherlands will boycott the Durban IV conference, citing antisemitism at earlier Durban conferences and disproportionate focus on Israel. Minister Kaag answered that the Netherlands will not attend, citing the risk of antisemitic abuse and one-sided focus on Israel, while pledging continued anti-racism work at the UN.
The Netherlands does not intend to participate in the Durban IV meeting, given the historical burden of the Durban process.
Nederland is niet voornemens om deel te nemen aan de Durban IV-bijeenkomst, gelet op de historische belasting van het Durban-proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de berichten ‘Kritisch rapport over fouten in jeugdzorg stilgehouden’ en ‘De gescheiden vader, de top van Justitie en het verdwenen rapport’

An SGP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether parents' legal position in child protection should be strengthened, whether the fact-finding improvement plan should be reconsidered, what happens to families harmed by flawed reports, whether a complaints point should be opened, and whether more funds are needed for child judges. The minister replied that civil child-protection law offers adequate protection, the improvement plan continues with evaluation next year, existing complaint routes suffice, and extra funds for judges are not planned for now.
In my response to this research I indicated that further legal protection, for example through stricter evidentiary rules, is not opportune.
In mijn reactie op dit onderzoek heb ik aangegeven dat verdergaande rechtsbescherming, bijvoorbeeld door middel van strengere bewijsregels, niet opportuun is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Bikker en Pouw-Verweij over sterke toename van het aantal gevallen van euthanasie

MPs Van der Staaij, Bikker and Pouw-Verweij asked whether the sharp rise in euthanasia notifications in 2020 is worrying, whether the RTE commissions' ethical review is weak, whether video consultations and the RTE's narrowed 'questions-raising' selection undermine safeguards, and whether isolation in care homes is driving requests. The minister answered that the rise tracks the overall increase in deaths, that COVID-19 played only a minor direct role, that deviation from in-person consultations is allowed under the KNMG/ministry COVID arrangements, that no signals of rising euthanasia wishes in Dutch care homes were found, and that an evaluation will examine physician attitudes.
I see no reason for further investigation into the increase in the absolute number of euthanasia notifications to the RTE in 2020.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor nader onderzoek naar de stijging van het absolute aantal euthanasiemeldingen bij de RTE in 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Piri, Van der Staaij en Jasper van Dijk over de dreigende executie van een Egyptische monnik

MPs from four parties asked the Foreign Minister whether she knew of Amnesty's appeal on the death sentence of Egyptian monk Wael Tawadros, whether torture-based confession and unfair trial could be confirmed, and whether she would press Egypt and the EU to stop the execution. The minister answered that she could not independently verify the allegations, noted rising executions in Egypt, and reported that Tawadros had already been executed on 9 May 2021, with Dutch and EU concern conveyed to Egyptian authorities at senior official level.
I therefore do not have independent information that confirms or refutes these reports, and can therefore give no further judgment on them.
Ik beschik derhalve niet over eigenstandige informatie die deze berichtgeving bevestigt dan wel ontkracht, en kan daar dan ook geen verder oordeel over geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Van der Staaij over bericht 'Fout in nieuwe gokwet zorgt voor ‘meer risico op matchfixing’, sportbonden boos'

MPs Kuik and Van der Staaij asked whether a flaw in the new online gambling law stops sports federations receiving timely matchfixing signals, and how that squares with their advisory right. The minister answered that a fast lane via FIU-Nederland and notification rules will get signals to sports bodies quickly, that no law change is needed, and that the sector's advisory role on black and white lists is maintained.
It has been agreed that a fast lane will be created at FIU-Nederland for matchfixing signals.
Afgesproken is dat voor signalen van matchfixing bij de FIU-Nederland een fast lane zal worden vormgegeven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Van der Staaij, Jasper van Dijk en Agnes Mulder over de veroordeling van een monnik in Turkije voor het geven van brood aan Koerdische bezoekers, in aanvulling op vragen van het li

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about the conviction of a monk in Turkey for giving food to Kurdish visitors, the situation of Christian minorities, and whether EU-Turkey rapprochement and pre-accession aid should continue. The government answered that the Dutch embassy follows the case, that concerns about rule of law and religious freedom in Turkey are raised consistently, and that it has pressed for suspending pre-accession aid, though no Council support exists.
The Netherlands has serious concerns about human rights and the rule of law in Turkey and consistently raises these concerns.
Nederland heeft grote zorgen over de mensenrechten en de rechtsstaat in Turkije en stelt deze zorgen consequent aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Nispen en Groothuizen over het bericht lijkschennis

MPs Van der Staaij, Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked whether necrophilia and desecration of corpses should be made a criminal offence in the Netherlands, given that similar acts are punishable in neighbouring countries. Minister Grapperhaus answered that necrophilia is not directly punishable but can be prosecuted under other provisions, that no societal demand for a separate offence has been found, and that he will ask the WODC to explore the question and report this year.
I will ask the WODC to conduct an exploration of the possibilities for criminalising necrophilia
Ik zal het WODC vragen een verkenning te doen van de mogelijkheden tot strafbaarstelling van necrofilie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het artikel ‘Gemeente Meppel gaat in gesprek met bewoners over uitbreiding prostitutiegebied’

An SGP MP asked the government about Meppel's plans to expand a prostitution zone and the claimed effects on neighbourhood liveability, drug problems, and whether municipalities can exclude prostitution businesses. The State Secretary replied that local matters lie with municipal councils, refused to make general claims about liveability or drugs, said a municipal 'zero option' is not yet legally possible until the Wrs takes effect, and declined further legal frameworks.
On questions about local situations, the central government exercises great restraint.
Bij vragen over lokale situaties past de rijksoverheid grote terughoudendheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Graaf, Van der Staaij en Van Helvert over het rapport 'Same Faith, Different Persecution' van Open Doors

MPs from four Christian parties asked the government about an Open Doors report on gender-specific religious persecution of women and girls, and what came of earlier commitments to raise it with UN envoys. The minister said the Special Envoy's talks with UN officials led to closer cooperation on religion and gender, that the government recognises the problem, and that it will be addressed through existing human rights channels and funding without committing to new concrete measures.
The cabinet recognises that women and girls from religious minorities are subjected to forced marriage and human trafficking.
Het kabinet herkent dat vrouwen en meisjes uit religieuze minderheden onderworpen worden aan gedwongen huwelijken en mensenhandel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Zonder kleding voor de klas in nieuw NPO-Zappprogramma’

An MP asked the ministers whether a children's NPO Zapp programme showing nude adults to primary-school pupils is pedagogically acceptable, whether it conforms to the Kijkwijzer classification and parental consent, and whether the broadcast should be stopped. The minister replied that media content is for the public broadcaster and parents to judge, that the programme was classified 'Alle Leeftijden' by NICAM with Rutgers input and consent obtained, and that the government cannot ask the NPO to refrain from broadcasting because prior review is prohibited.
It is therefore not appropriate for the government to appeal to the NPO or the broadcasters to refrain from broadcasting.
Het past dan ook niet dat de overheid een appél doet op de NPO of de omroepen om van uitzending af te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over UNRWA-studiematerialen

Parliamentarian Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the Foreign Affairs and Development ministers about IMPACT-SE findings that UNRWA home-schooling materials contained incitement to violence and denial of Israel and Jewish history, and whether the government would reconsider its UNRWA funding and raise the issue with UNRWA and the Palestinian Authority. The minister answered that UNRWA removed the material and is conducting an internal review, that the government raised the matter with UNRWA and the PA, and that the government does not intend to revise its UNRWA funding.

In that light, taking into account the corrective measures UNRWA has taken and in the interest of the overall continuity of UNRWA's services, the cabinet does not intend to revise Dutch funding of UNRWA.

In dat licht, rekening houdend met de corrigerende maatregelen die UNRWA heeft genomen en in het belang van de gehele continuïteit van UNRWA’s dienstverlening, is het kabinet niet voornemens de Nederlandse financiering van UNRWA te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Klaver, Ploumen en Van der Staaij over de snelheid van het vaccineren en de uitvoering van de vaccinatiestrategie

Four MPs (Jetten, Klaver, Ploumen, Van der Staaij) asked the health minister why the Netherlands lags the EU average in COVID-19 vaccination, about planning, stock management, the role of Defence and business, and vaccinating nursing-home residents. The minister answered that the first shot was given later than in other member states, that a large safety stock was held, that stock management and planning are being adjusted, and that vaccination groups are being prioritised by risk, while the answers on Defence/business offers and prognoses were largely restated policy or deferred.
It is not easy to estimate when the Netherlands will be at the same vaccination rate as the other EU countries or even above it.
Het is niet goed in te schatten wanneer Nederland op dezelfde vaccinatiegraad zit als de andere EU-landen of zelfs daar boven.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over keuzevrijheid in het vaccin voor een specifieke groep gewetensbezwaarden

Two MPs from ChristenUnie and SGP asked the health minister whether people with conscientious objections to vaccines developed or tested using fetal-derived cell lines (HEK293, PER.C6) should be given freedom of choice among COVID-19 vaccines. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the vaccines are lawful under current rules, but refused individual choice of vaccine type because of limited supply and a need for rapid mass vaccination, while pointing to information and dialogue efforts.
It is not possible for an individual to choose a specific type of vaccine.
Het is niet mogelijk om als individu de keuze te maken voor een specifiek type vaccin.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik, Van den Hul, Sjoerdsma en Karabulut over het ter dood veroordeelde Pakistaanse echtpaar Shafqat Emmanuel en Shagufta Kausar

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the death sentence for blasphemy imposed on the Pakistani couple Shafqat Emmanuel and Shagufta Kausar, the repeated postponements of their appeal, and what the government would do through diplomacy, EU channels and asylum support. The minister condemned the death sentence, said the Netherlands and the EU raised concerns with Pakistani authorities without intervening in the court process, and declined to commit to attending the trial or to pre-judging any asylum request.
The Netherlands and the EU do not intervene in the legal proceedings in other countries.
Nederland en de EU interveniëren niet in de rechtsgang in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Van Helvert over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2021 van Open Doors

Three MPs (Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Van Helvert) asked the foreign minister about the Open Doors 2021 Christian persecution ranking, covering FoRB envoy vacancy, persecution in Nigeria, China, India and Turkey, COVID aid, and export controls. The minister answered at length, mostly restating policy and concerns, while declining to commit to specific new initiatives beyond existing diplomacy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus

An MP asked the health minister about remarks that COVID measures might last longer for unvaccinated people, the legality of sharing vaccination status, enforcement of the 1.5-metre rule, air ionisation, mass testing and hospital capacity. The minister denied a two-tier regime, said no vaccination obligation is planned, referred the ethics question to the Health Council, and gave detailed answers on enforcement, testing strategy and care capacity.
That is why, as I explained in my letters of 20 November and 21 December, I asked the Health Council's Ethics and Law Committee to draw up an ethical framework.
Daarom heb ik, zoals ik in mijn Kamerbrief van 20 november en 21 december heb toegelicht, de Commissie Ethiek en recht van de Gezondheidsraad gevraagd een ethisch afwegingskader op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de campagne van Second Love waarin wordt opgeroepen tot vreemdgaan

An SGP MP asked the Health Minister whether the government would condemn a Second Love advertising campaign urging infidelity, and whether it would press the advertiser or municipalities to stop it, and how municipalities support relationships and prevent divorce harms. The government answered that advertising content is for the Reclame Code Commissie to judge, that relationships are a private matter, and that municipalities provide relationship and divorce support under the Jeugdwet, with the SzS programme supporting them.
It is not for the government to become substantively involved in advertising campaigns or to pass judgment on them.
Het is niet aan de overheid om inhoudelijke bemoeienis te hebben met reclamecampagnes of hier over een oordeel te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen het bezoek van predikanten beperken

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked whether hospitals restricting visits by chaplains conflicts with agreements and legal rights, and whether patients may receive pastoral visits outside visiting hours. The minister replied that hospitals may limit visits for infection control, that no distinction is made between visitor types, that he disagrees with the claim of non-compliance, and that he will only alert hospital associations to a guidance document; he declined to answer question 8 and could not answer in time.
It is up to the care institution to weigh this, in which the safety of all patients and staff counts alongside the interest of the individual patient.
Het is aan de zorginstelling om een afweging te maken, waarbij naast het belang van de individuele patiënt de veiligheid van alle patiënten en personeel meetelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat de crisisopvang jeugdpsychiatrie overbelast is

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that youth psychiatric crisis care is overloaded, rising crisis referrals, and measures to keep care accessible during lockdown. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, pointed to coordination between municipalities and providers, a pending survey of capacity, and a 58.5 million euro youth package, while stating there is no national picture of cancelled treatments.
There is no national picture of the number of treatments that did not go ahead.
Er is geen landelijk beeld op het aantal behandelingen dat niet is doorgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Raan, Van Ojik, Van Helvert en Van der Staaij over de mensenrechtensituatie in West-Papua

MPs from seven parties asked the Foreign Minister about arms exports to Indonesia, the Community Policing Programme, human rights in West Papua, journalist access, the murder of Yeremia Zanambani, and environmental damage by companies. The minister answered that arms licences are assessed case by case including the Papua situation, the Dutch programme ended in 2019 with local continuation, and human rights concerns are raised bilaterally, though no full overview of documented violations or environmental damage is held.
However, I do not have a complete overview of all documented damage to the environment, living environment and climate in Papua.
Ik beschik echter niet over een totaaloverzicht van alle gedocumenteerde schade aan milieu, leefomgeving en klimaat in Papua.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij en Karabulut over Nagorno-Karabach

MPs from ChristenUnie, CDA, SGP and SP asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's alleged deployment of Syrian fighters in the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict, Azerbaijan's ceasefire violations, possible sanctions, arms embargoes, war crimes allegations and recognition of Karabakh's independence. The minister answered that the government now knows of Turkish involvement, condemned the use of Syrian fighters, said no sanctions are currently under consideration, reaffirmed the OSCE arms embargo with no Dutch exports, and rejected recognition of independence.
Sanctions are not on the agenda at this moment.
Sancties zijn op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Geurts en Van der Staaij over de situatie in Zuid-Afrika

MPs Van Helvert, Geurts and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister about attacks on white farmers, land expropriation without compensation in South Africa's Expropriation Bill, and Brexit implications for trade. The minister said the government has raised land reform concerns bilaterally and in the EU and OECD, that the bill sets limited no-compensation scenarios subject to court or arbitrator review, and that Dutch influence is limited to continued dialogue.
The new bill, the Expropriation Bill, provides for this.
Het nieuwe wetsvoorstel, de «Expropriation Bill», voorziet daarin.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over Turkse paspoorten voor Hamas-terroristen

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey issues passports to Hamas members, whether this threatens Israel, Europe and NATO, and whether visa liberalisation for Turks is still conceivable. The minister could not confirm the press reports, said the Netherlands has no information on Turkish support for listed organisations, and said the Dutch concerns would be raised in bilateral contacts with Turkey.
The Dutch concerns and questions about this reporting will be raised in bilateral contacts with Turkey.
De Nederlandse zorgen en vragen over deze berichtgeving zullen in bilaterale contacten met Turkije worden opgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van der Staaij over de verjaringstermijn bij adoptie en het bewaren van adoptiedossiers

MPs Van Nispen and Van der Staaij asked whether the limitation period in intercountry adoption cases should start only when the adoptee comes of age, and how adoption files will be kept after Stichting Kind en Toekomst stops mediating. The minister defended absolute limitation periods for legal certainty, pointed to the COIA inquiry, said the files stay with the foundation and the Ca takes over if it is dissolved, and said a bill extending the retention period to 100 years will go to consultation by end 2020.
I can imagine that the court's ruling on limitation is disappointing, not only for the person seeking justice but possibly also for other adoptees.
Ik kan mij kan voorstellen dat de betreffende uitspraak van de rechter inzake de verjaring teleurstellend is, niet alleen voor de rechtszoekende, maar mogelijk ook voor andere geadopteerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Raan over de beveiliging van Nobelprijswinnaar dr. Denis Mukwege

MPs asked whether MONUSCO protection of Nobel laureate Denis Mukwege and the Panzi hospital is sufficient, whether Nederland will play a role in his security, and whether he should be protected. The minister answered that Nederland pressed the UN for adequate protection, MONUSCO assigned Nepalese troops to the compound and committed to continued protection, and Nederland is exploring a new contribution to security without a formal request from Mukwege.
For this reason, the Netherlands has in recent weeks pressed the UN for adequate protection for Dr. Mukwege.
Nederland heeft daarom de afgelopen weken bij de VN aangedrongen op adequate bescherming voor dr. Mukwege.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de dreiging van een boete voor het Israël Producten Centrum

MPs from the ChristenUnie and SGP asked the minister why the NVWA is enforcing the 2015 EU interpretive notice on labelling of settlement goods against the Israel Producten Centrum, and why this is not applied equally to other occupied territories, and about consistency with UN and BDS positions. The government answered that EU origin-labelling rules apply uniformly, that the NVWA acted after a complaint, inspection and re-inspection under its intervention policy, and that the 2019 CJEU ruling confirms settlement products must be labelled as such.
There is no exception for Israel or the Israeli-occupied territories or any other country or territory.
Er is geen uitzondering voor Israël of de door Israël bezette gebieden of een ander land of gebied.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Weverling, Van der Staaij en De Roon over het bericht dat twee terreurverdachten indirect salaris hebben ontvangen met behulp van Nederlandse financiële steun aan de Palestijns

Four MPs asked why the government kept funding the Palestinian NGO UAWC after learning that two suspected terror-linked employees received salary via Dutch-funded overhead, and whether this shows inadequate vetting and BDS-related risks. The minister admitted the earlier conclusion was wrong, suspended payments, commissioned an external investigation, but largely defended the vetting process, rejected reconsidering funding for BDS-adjacent organisations, and answered each question.
Because careful action on this point is extremely important, I have decided to commission an external investigation into possible links between PFLP and UAWC.
Omdat zorgvuldig handelen op dit punt uiterst belangrijk is heb ik besloten om een extern onderzoek te laten verrichten naar eventuele banden tussen PFLP en UAWC
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Helvert en Voordewind over foltering en honger in vrouwenkampen in Noord-Korea na gedwongen terugkeer vanuit China

Three MPs asked the foreign minister about torture, starvation and sexual violence against North Korean women repatriated from China, and the UN's 2020 report on this, asking whether it amounts to crimes against humanity and what Netherlands is doing about it, including whether military intervention could be justified without a Security Council mandate. The minister confirmed awareness of the UN report and agreed that crimes against humanity are occurring, noted diplomatic and UN-level efforts, and stated that human rights violations alone do not provide a legal basis for military intervention without Security Council authorisation.

Human rights violations, even if they may be qualified as crimes against humanity, do not under existing international law constitute a legal basis for military intervention without authorisation from the UN Security Council.

Het plegen van mensenrechtenschendingen, ook wanneer deze kunnen worden gekwalificeerd als misdrijven tegen de menselijkheid, vormen onder het bestaande internationaal recht geen rechtsgrond voor militaire interventie zonder autorisatie van de VN-Veiligheidsraad.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over het bericht dat de Nederlandse regering waarschuwingen zou negeren over het financieren van een NGO met banden met terrorisme

MPs Van der Staaij, De Roon and Voordewind asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether Dutch funding to the Union of Agricultural Work Committees (UAWC) was linked to a terror group, after reports that the government ignored warnings. The minister answered that no evidence of links to listed terror organisations was found, but that after two former UAWC staff were arrested over a bombing, payments were suspended and an external investigation was commissioned.
Because careful action on this point is so important, I have decided to commission external research into possible links between the PFLP and UAWC.
Omdat zorgvuldig handelen op dit punt dermate belangrijk is heb ik besloten om extern onderzoek te laten verrichten naar eventuele banden tussen PFLP en UAWC
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over het advies van de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie om de abortuspil na 24 weken te gebruiken

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked the minister about WHO guidance permitting medical abortion pills after 12 and even 24 weeks, questioning its compatibility with Dutch practice and whether development aid funds such procedures. The minister replied that Dutch clinics limit the pill to 9 weeks while hospitals follow NVOG guidance up to 24 weeks, saw no reason to contact the WHO, and said aid supports safe abortion care within recipient countries' legal frameworks.
I see no reason to contact the WHO about the 2014 Clinical practice handbook for safe abortion.
Ik heb geen aanleiding om in contact te treden met de WHO over het in 2014 uitgebrachte «Clinical practice handbook for safe abortion».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, De Roon, Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Van Helvert en Van Ojik over de bombardementen van Turkije in de Iraakse regio Sinjar

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish bombings in the Sinjar region of Iraq, including alleged strikes on a refugee camp, a hospital and Yezidi areas, and whether the Netherlands would seek clarification or condemn them. The minister confirmed awareness, said the camp and hospital were reportedly not directly hit according to local sources, cited PKK presence as the reason for Turkish strikes, and said the Netherlands raised the bombings with EU partners and urges restraint and respect for international humanitarian law.
I have also recently raised the Turkish bombings with my European colleagues at the Foreign Affairs Council on 13 July.
Ook heb ik de Turkse bombardementen recentelijk opgebracht bij mijn Europese collega's tijdens de Raad Buitenlandse zaken op 13 juli jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat er in Oekraïne honderden draagmoederbaby’s wachten tot ze opgehaald worden door hun wensouders

Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the Justice and Foreign Trade ministers about reports of hundreds of surrogacy babies in Ukraine waiting to be collected by intended parents, asking about child welfare, coercion, trafficking, Dutch involvement, nationality and whether Dutch rules can be tightened. Minister Dekker answered that Ukraine is responsible for the facts and prosecution, that Dutch surrogacy legislation is in preparation with safeguards and a ban on child-buying, and that Dutch involvement in the Hague Conference expert group continues.
It is not for me or the Netherlands but for the Ukrainian authorities to establish the actual circumstances and, where relevant, investigate and prosecute criminal offences.
Het is niet aan mij of Nederland maar aan de Oekraïense autoriteiten om de feitelijke omstandigheden vast te stellen en waar relevant strafbare feiten te onderzoeken en te vervolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over beperkingen begrafenissen en kerkdiensten in het licht van de Grondwettelijke vrijheden

An SGP MP asked the ministers whether COVID-19 caps on attendance at church services and funerals (30 persons) fit the constitutional freedom of religion, and whether emergency decrees are a suitable instrument for such restrictions. The minister answered that worship exemptions, streaming and a 'reasonable interpretation' of article 6 justify the temporary limits, that church bodies set their own protocols, and that a bill on fundamental-rights restrictions is in preparation.

A reasonable interpretation of freedom of religion means that this right does not extend so far that, under current circumstances, it covers an unlimited number of participants in religious gatherings.

Een redelijke uitleg van de vrijheid van godsdienst brengt dan met zich dat dit recht niet zó ver reikt dat het onder de huidige omstandigheden een onbeperkt aantal deelnemers aan religieuze bijeenkomsten omvat
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over ontwikkelingen op het gebied van seksuele gezondheid

An SGP MP asked the minister about sexual health education: the review of lesson methods, the budget and its distribution for schools, the level playing field for providers, state-aid consequences for Rutgers, continuity of counselling contracts, and abortion counselling and aftercare. The minister answered that the Kwink study and a letter would follow, detailed a 7.1 million euro annual budget, said no further measures were needed on abortion clinic cooperation, and gave a substantive but partly general account.
This study will be submitted by Kwink Groep in June, and the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport will then inform you about it.
Dit onderzoek wordt in juni aangeboden door Kwink Groep en de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zal u vervolgens daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Van der Staaij over de financiering van ziekenhuizen en over het bericht ‘NVZ: ‘VWS laat ziekenhuizen en verzekeraars vrij worstelen over geld’

MPs Ellemeet and Van der Staaij asked about a 47% fall in hospital care revenue during COVID-19, whether hospitals should be fully compensated, whether all hospitals are protected from bankruptcy, and whether the financing system should change. Minister Van Rijn answered that insurers' continuity payments and cost reimbursement are in place, the NZa supervises insurers, a Contourennota on the system is postponed to autumn, and the regime for larger providers is still being worked out.
With the continuity contribution and extra-cost scheme there is compensation, so hospitals need not get into financial difficulties because of the coronavirus crisis.
Met de continuïteitsbijdrage en meerkostenregeling is er sprake van compensatie, waardoor ziekenhuizen niet vanwege de coronacrisis in financiële problemen hoeven te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht 'Onbegrijpelijke concurrentie rond abortus'

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Health about abortion clinics remaining open to foreign women during the COVID-19 crisis, the clinics' infection-control measures and consultation practices, and whether the abortion pill would be made freely available. The Minister answered that clinics remain open and accessible, that the reflection period and in-person safeguards continue under a temporary telephone-consult arrangement, and that the sexual education and counselling programme has been delayed by the pandemic.
Also during the coronavirus crisis, Dutch statutory and regulatory framework applies.
Ook tijdens de coronacrisis geldt de Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en van Helvert over de mensenrechtensituatie in Eritrea n.a.v. de excommunicatie van patriarch Antonios van de Eritrees-Orthodoxe Tewahedo-Kerk en de gedwongen s

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about human rights in Eritrea, including the detention of Patriarch Antonios and other religious figures, the forced closure of Catholic clinics, and interference by Eritrean authorities in religious life among the diaspora in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally and in the UN Human Rights Council, has taken diplomatic steps against interference, but that Eritrea shows little sensitivity to pressure and the available instruments are limited.

The Netherlands consistently speaks out about the worrying human rights situation in Eritrea and calls on the country to respect human rights and cooperate with the Special Rapporteur on the human rights situation in Eritrea.

Nederland spreekt zich voortdurend uit over de zorgwekkende mensenrechtensituatie in Eritrea en roept het land op om de mensenrechten te respecteren en om samen te werken met de Speciaal Rapporteur voor de mensenrechtensituatie in Eritrea.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over richtlijnen voor begrafenissen en kerkdiensten

MP Van der Staaij asks why large department stores may admit hundreds of visitors while religious services and funerals are capped at 30 people, and on what basis the restrictions are justified. The minister answers that stores are not closed by government and may operate under 1.5-metre rules, that the 30-person cap for services and funerals will be reviewed for 100 persons from 1 July on OMT advice, and that the measures will be placed on temporary legislation rather than emergency ordinances.
In a state governed by the rule of law, emergency ordinances cannot last too long, partly in view of the ongoing consequences for everyone's freedoms and fundamental rights.
In een rechtstaat kunnen noodverordeningen niet te lang duren, mede met het oog op de voortdurende gevolgen voor de vrijheden en grondrechten van eenieder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de gevolgen van de coronamaatregelen voor relatie- en opvoedingsondersteuning

An MP asked the Health Minister whether COVID-19 measures have increased demand for relationship and parenting support, whether providers such as the Eigen Kracht Centrale face financial trouble, and whether intake barriers should be lowered. The minister answered that he lacks data on the scale of demand, pointed to existing helplines, municipal support and the escalation route to the Jeugdautoriteit, and said relationship therapy is not covered by the Zvw so no deductible or GP referral applies.
I have no insight into the precise extent of the problem or whether there has been an increase in requests for such help and support.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de precieze omvang van de problematiek en of er sprake is van een stijging in het aantal aanvragen voor dergelijke hulp en ondersteuning.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Karabulut en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlanders in Marokko in het licht van de pandemie

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how many Dutch citizens remain stranded in Morocco, why Morocco is refusing repatriation, what pressure the government applies, and what the EU and other member states are doing. The minister answered that over 1000 are registered, four special repatriation flights and some ambulance flights have taken place, Morocco cooperates on urgent cases, and the government continues to press for repatriation within EU coordination.
The aim of the Netherlands is to organise all necessary repatriation flights in the short term.
Inzet van Nederland is om op korte termijn alle benodigde repatriëringsvluchten te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Helvert en Voordewind over de vernieling van graven van christenen in Turkije

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the desecration of Christian graves in Turkey, whether this reflects a rising trend of pressure on Christians, who spreads hate speech, whether Turkish school books label missionary activity a national threat, and whether Turkey effectively prosecutes grave desecration. The minister answered that Turkish authorities prosecute such acts, that the cemetery is being restored and guarded, that reports show no clear increase in pressure on Christians, and that the Dutch government raises minority concerns with its Turkish counterpart.
I also do that in my conversations with my Turkish counterpart.
Ook ik doe dat in mijn gesprekken met mijn Turkse ambtsgenoot.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, De Roon, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Raan, Krol, Van der Staaij, Kuzu, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlander

MPs asked how many Dutch nationals remain stranded abroad, why repatriation costs are charged, and whether a 300-euro rate should extend to more countries and hardship cases. The minister replied that about 8,000 registered Dutch nationals still wished assistance, that the registration closed on 8 April, that costs are charged after the fact, that Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories will be considered favourably, and that a coulance regime is not appropriate given personal responsibility and budget impact.
I am willing to look favourably at the request to add Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories to the list for which the 300-euro rate applies.
Ik ben bereid welwillend te kijken naar het verzoek om Jordanië, Israël, Libanon en de Palestijnse Gebieden toe te voegen aan de lijst waarvoor het tarief van 300 euro geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het artikel ‘Een schriftelijke wilsverklaring is nog geen euthanasieverzoek’

Parliamentarian Van der Staaij asked the health and justice ministers about an article arguing that a written advance euthanasia declaration is not a concrete request, and about verification, the role of the Regional Review Committees, and transparency of closed case files. Minister De Jonge answered that a written request can replace an oral one only if it is explicit and concrete, that other due-diligence rules still apply, that the Supreme Court case on dementia verification precludes substantive comment for now, and that the fourth evaluation will examine transparency.
I therefore consider it appropriate to exercise restraint in responding substantively until the Supreme Court's judgment is known.
Mij past daarom terughoudendheid om hier inhoudelijk op te reageren tot het oordeel van de Hoge Raad bekend is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Wijngaarden, Ploumen, Van Ojik, van der Graaf, Van der Staaij, van Nispen over het onderzoek van Levada Centrum onder de Russische bevolking naar de publieke opinie over Ned

MPs asked the government about a Levada Centre survey of Russian public opinion on the Netherlands and MH17, including willingness to pay compensation, access to facts, and whether Russians could follow the trial in Russian. The government said it was aware of the survey, that trial information is available online in English and via the Dutch embassy, and that the judiciary chose to livestream the trial in English; a Russian-language livestream of the first session was made by Current Time and the government is looking into Russian summaries.

Within the limits of the law, the judiciary, partly because of the broad and diverse international involvement, decided to set up a livestream so the MH17 trial can be followed worldwide and in English as well as Dutch.

Binnen de mogelijkheden van de wet heeft de Rechtspraak, mede vanwege de brede en diverse internationale betrokkenheid, besloten om een livestream in te richten waardoor het MH17-proces wereldwijd en naast het Nederlands, ook in het Engels te volgen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen, Wilders, Krol, Van der Staaij en Baudet over COVID-19 patiënten aan boord van vluchten uit coronabrandhaard New York

Five MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Health about the lack of temperature checks and symptom screening for passengers on flights from COVID-19-affected New York, and whether the government should ban such flights. The answer is a referral: the questions are answered in a separate letter on tourism during Easter and the May holiday and measures for New York flights, with the answers to questions 15-19 due on 8 April 2020.
have been answered by means of the letter 'Countering tourism during Easter and the May holiday; measures for flights from New York'
zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Tegengaan toerisme tijdens Pasen en de meivakantie; maatregelen voor vluchten uit New York»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Van Helvert en Kuik over seksueel geweld tegen christelijke vrouwen

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and CDA asked the ministers about reported sexual violence against Christian women and the Open Doors gender-specific persecution report, including what Dutch foreign and development policy can do about it. The ministers condemn such persecution, describe existing programmes on women's legal equality, child marriage, religious freedom and a EUR 750,000 contribution to psychological care for persecuted believers, but do not change any institutional check.
Persecution on account of a belief or conviction deviating from the majority is considered unacceptable by the cabinet.
Vervolging wegens een (van de meerderheid afwijkende) geloofs- of levensovertuiging vindt het kabinet onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Koopmans, Karabulut, Voordwind en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘In Saudi Arabia, contacting the EU is a crime,

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government reacts to reports that contacting an EU or Dutch embassy is treated as a crime in Saudi Arabia, and whether EU diplomats may attend trials of women's rights activists. The minister answered that the government regards such contacts as legitimate, has raised the matter repeatedly with Saudi authorities, and that EU diplomats have so far been refused access to hearings despite continued efforts.
It is correct that EU diplomats, including Dutch diplomats, have not been granted access to court hearings since autumn 2018.
Het klopt dat EU-diplomaten, waaronder Nederlandse diplomaten, sinds het najaar van 2018 geen toegang hebben gekregen tot hoorzittingen van rechtszaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Westerveld, Agema, Hijink en Van der Staaij over de mogelijke doorstart van de Hoenderloo Groep

MPs Kuiken, Westerveld, Agema, Hijink and Van der Staaij asked the Minister of Health about the Hoenderloo Groep closure, his contacts with parents, steps toward a possible restart and its consistency with the Chamber's motion. The Minister replied that he visited the site, held talks with Pluryn, gemeenten and the IGJ, asked KPMG to test restart plans, and that Pluryn has offered placements for all youths while the IGJ oversees the transfer process.
I informed your House on 20 February 2020 about this, in line with my commitment in the committee debate on financial problems at youth care institutions and the Hijink et al. motion.
Ik heb uw Kamer, conform mijn toezegging in het AO «financiële problemen bij diverse jeugdzorginstellingen» en motie Hijink cs, hierover op 20 februari 2020 geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over het bericht dat de VN een zwarte lijst gepubliceerd heeft van bedrijven die zakendoen in Israëlische nederzettingen

Three MPs asked the foreign minister whether the UN Human Rights Council's published list of businesses active in Israeli settlements is justified, whether it amounts to political condemnation fuelling BDS, and whether the Netherlands will oppose it. The ministers answered that the list follows a 2016 Council mandate, carries no legal judgment or call for boycott, that the Netherlands discourages economic ties with settlements, and that they will raise concerns with EU partners while pushing to remove the agenda item.
The cabinet consults with European partners on the joint approach to the Middle East peace process and the joint approach in the UN Human Rights Council.
Het kabinet overlegt met de Europese partners over de gezamenlijke inzet in het Midden-Oosten Vredesproces en de gezamenlijke inzet in de VN Mensenrechtenraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Koopmans, Sjoerdsma en Krol over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2020 van Open Doors

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2020 ranking on Christian persecution, including rising violence in Africa, China's church closures and the role of faith-based actors. The minister acknowledged serious concern, described existing programmes and diplomatic efforts, and committed to continued engagement without introducing new measures.

The cabinet shares your great concern about the trend identified by Open Doors of an increasing number of persecutions of Christians on the basis of their religion and the increasing number of attacks on churches and Christian buildings.

Het kabinet deelt uw grote zorg over de door Open Doors gesignaleerde trend van een toenemend aantal vervolgingen van christenen op basis van hun religie en het toenemend aantal aanvallen op kerken en christelijke gebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over De veroordeling van de Chinese voorganger Wang Yi

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the criminal convictions of Chinese church leaders Wang Yi and Qin Defu, the implications of China's 2018 religion law, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister confirmed Dutch concern, described an embassy statement and EU-level advocacy, and promised to raise Qin Defu's case through regular dialogues and to pass on concerns about the religion law.
The cabinet is also willing to raise the case of Qin Defu with the Chinese government through the regular dialogues with the Chinese authorities.
Het kabinet is tevens bereid om de zaak van Qin Defu aan te kaarten bij de Chinese overheid via de reguliere dialogen met de Chinese autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de sluiting van de Hoenderloo Groep

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Health about the causes, staffing, funding and continuity of care after the closure of De Hoenderloo Group, which houses about 200 children. The minister answered that Pluryn is responsible for orderly transfer of care, municipalities for adequate youth care, and the IGJ will supervise the closure plan, while describing a liquidity support scheme and a staff-retention intention agreement.
I am closely monitoring the situation to ensure that Pluryn and the municipalities take their responsibility.
Ik volg de situatie nauwgezet om te zorgen dat Pluryn en gemeenten hun verantwoordelijkheid nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van der Staaij over de gebeurtenissen op 1 december in West Papoea

MPs Ploumen and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister about the harsh Indonesian response to 1 December demonstrations in West Papua, including police entering a church and detaining people. The minister said over a hundred people were arrested, most released, that Papua human rights are a standing agenda item in bilateral and EU dialogue, and that the issue will be raised during the March state visit.
The situation in Papua will therefore also be raised during the state visit in March.
De situatie in Papua zal daarom ook tijdens het Staatsbezoek van maart a.s. aan de orde worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij inzake het bericht dat coffeeshops sportverenigingen sponsoren

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers whether coffeeshop sponsorship of sports clubs is unacceptable, whether it is already banned under the Opium Act and AHOJG criteria, and what measures will end financial ties. The minister replied that sponsorship is undesirable and can be prosecuted or enforced case by case, that no overview of sponsorship exists, and that an investigation into criminal influence in sports clubs will be carried out.
We do not have an overview of coffeeshop sponsorship of sports clubs.
Wij beschikken niet over een overzicht van de sponsoring van coffeeshops aan sportclubs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Lesmethodes seksuele voorlichting onder de loep’

Parliamentary questions from MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked whether the supply of recognised sexual health lesson interventions is broad enough, how subsidies to Rutgers and others are kept to sexual health, and whether Rutgers' role in recognising lesson methods creates a conflict of interest. State Secretary Blokhuis answered that about 36 recognised interventions exist, that subsidies continue with partial phase-out for state-aid reasons, that grant accountability will shift to measuring reach, and that a Gezonde School coordinator is a mandatory component, while defending Rutgers' expert role as not creating conflict of interest.
However, I cannot yet make announcements about the exact outcomes, because the organisations concerned must first be informed.
Ik kan echter nog geen mededelingen doen over de exacte uitkomsten ervan, omdat eerst de betreffende organisaties op de hoogte gebracht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het rapport ‘Briefing on the Situation of Religious Persecution of Christians and Muslims in India’ van Jubilee Campaign

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a Jubilee Campaign report on religious persecution of Christians and Muslims in India, including discriminatory laws, arbitrary detentions, and violence, and whether the government would press India on the report's nine recommendations and support religious freedom initiatives. The minister said the government shares concerns, raises them diplomatically and in EU and multilateral settings, supports Mensenrechtenfonds projects, and that the special envoy for religion will travel to India, but did not commit to specific demands on India's implementation of the recommendations.
In conversations with India, the government emphasises the importance of respect for human rights for everyone.
Het kabinet benadrukt in gesprekken met India het belang van respect voor mensenrechten voor iedereen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Nederlandse hulp aan gevangenen in buitenland berust op willekeur’

Six MPs from CDA, SP, GroenLinks, D66, SGP and ChristenUnie asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Dutch assistance to Dutch prisoners abroad (the Singh case), including the five-year binding criterion, a WOTS transfer request and the handling of the case. The government answered that it cannot comment on individual cases, that existing criteria apply, that no official US transfer request was ever made, and that it promises no concrete new step.
I cannot make statements about ongoing cases and individual cases.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over lopende zaken en individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Helvert en Van Ojik over bloedvergieten op Papoea

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about deadly violence in Wamena, Papua, on 23 September 2019, the Indonesian demonstration ban, the end of the Dutch contribution to the Community Policing Programme, and Dutch diplomatic efforts. The minister answered that the causes and casualty breakdown remain unclear, described the programme's results, and said Dutch diplomacy on Papua continues at ministerial and senior official level.
The cabinet closely follows developments in Papua and gives priority to raising these developments as a standing item with the Indonesian authorities.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen in Papua nauwgezet, en geeft er prioriteit aan deze ontwikkelingen als vast onderdeel bij de Indonesische autoriteiten aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut, Voordewind, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij en Van Ojik over het bezoek van premier Rutte aan Indonesië

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about the topics of Rutte's visit to Indonesia, including the military crackdown in Papua, and whether the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights would be invited to Papua. The government answered that human rights and Papua were discussed, that the Netherlands urged a prompt UN visit, and that the visit is now up to the UN and Indonesian authorities to arrange.
The aim of this conversation was to stress that dialogue and restraint are important to reach a lasting solution.
De inzet van dit gesprek was te benadrukken dat dialoog en terughoudendheid belangrijk zijn om tot een duurzame oplossing te komen

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Den Haag inzake de specialist ouderengeneeskunde die verdacht werd van onzorgvuldige euthanasie op een demente patiënte

Parliamentary questions from MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the ministers about a district court ruling acquitting a geriatric specialist accused of careless euthanasia on a dementia patient, and its effects on review bodies and the Euthanasia Act. The government answered that the Public Prosecution Service will not appeal but the Procurator-General will seek a cassation ruling in the interest of the law, that review practice should follow the Supreme Court decision once issued, and that current law already covers taking the current situation into account, while declining to comment further on a possible amendment.
However, the Public Prosecution Service has asked the Procurator-General at the Supreme Court to file a cassation appeal in the interest of the law in the above case.
Wel heeft het OM de Procureur-Generaal bij de Hoge Raad verzocht om cassatie in het belang der wet in te stellen in bovengenoemde zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het onderwerp godsdienstvrijheid in het Algemeen Ambtsbericht over Afghanistan

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister how the Afghan state protects religious minorities and non-believers, how it treats converts, and whether the General Asylum Report (Algemeen Ambtsbericht) on freedom of religion is accurate and should be amended. The minister acknowledged limited legal space and intimidation of minorities but rejected the claim that the report downplays risks, declined to amend the report, and said the Mensenrechtenambassadeur and Special Envoy would engage on religious freedom.
I see no reason to amend the report.
Ik zie geen reden het ambtsbericht aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over etikettering van producten afkomstig uit de Palestijnse gebieden

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked how the Netherlands enforces labelling of Israeli-occupied-territory products, whether the Ten Broeke motion and the Commission interpretive notice are being followed, and whether the 'Palestine' origin label implies recognition of a Palestinian state. The government answered that the NVWA follows the Commission notice, applies a warning policy, awaits a CJEU ruling, and that the footnote means the label does not imply recognition, which is unchanged.
The cabinet honours European agreements and the NVWA acts in line with the guidance in the Commission interpretive document mentioned above.
Het kabinet komt Europese afspraken na en de NVWA handelt conform de aanwijzingen uit het bovengenoemd interpretatiedocument van de Europese Commissie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik, Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, en Van Raan over een aanval op de democratie in Turkije

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's removal of elected HDP and CHP mayors and appointment of state supervisors, and whether the Netherlands and EU would condemn it and what consequences would follow. The minister answered that the government shares EU and Council of Europe concerns, supports the EU's public statements, raises the issue bilaterally, and backed halting accession talks, though that proposal lacked support and talks have stalled.
The government does not have precise figures.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over precieze aantallen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Helvert over het rapport 'We’re Indians too' van organisatie Open Doors inzake geweld, uitsluiting en geloofsvervolging van christelijke en moslimminderhe
