MPs asked the Foreign Minister about an Open Doors report on violence and exclusion of Christian and Muslim minorities in India, including whether the government would raise anti-conversion laws, Dalit classification, and religious freedom with India at bilateral, EU and UN level. The minister answered that the government shares the concerns, raises religious freedom in human rights dialogues and UN forums, and plans to ask the new Special Envoy for freedom of religion to visit India, while declining to speculate on post-election developments.

I also intend to ask the recently appointed Special Envoy for freedom of religion and belief to travel to India to speak with the government and civil society organisations about freedom of religion and belief.

Ook ben ik voornemens om de onlangs aangestelde Speciaal Gezant religie en levensovertuiging te vragen naar India te gaan om daar met overheid en maatschappelijke organisaties te spreken over vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ploumen, Karabulut, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik en Van der  Staaij over het Nederlandse kind Duncan en de Spaanse kinderbescherming

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the case of a Dutch child with Down syndrome held under Spanish child protection and whether he should be reunited with his mother quickly. The minister said the matter falls to the competent Spanish authority, that the ministry is following the case and has mediated contact, and withheld case details citing data protection.
For reasons of personal data protection, I cannot give your House any details about the individual case.
Omwille van persoonsgegevensbescherming kan ik uw Kamer geen details geven over de individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over de oprichting van een tribunaal om IS-strijders te vervolgen

MPs asked whether the government had discussed an international tribunal for IS fighters with Sweden, whether it will pursue genocide prosecutions and join a Swedish-invited conference, and whether a prosecutor is assigned. The government confirmed talks with Sweden and UN partners, said it is seeking expert advice on an international tribunal due 8 July 2019, and said the Public Prosecution Service will report on a dedicated prosecutor before the recess.
The Public Prosecution Service is expected to inform the cabinet before the recess whether a special prosecutor specifically for prosecuting ISIS fighters for genocide would add value.

Het OM zal het kabinet naar verwachting voor het reces nog informeren of daarnaast een speciale officier van justitie specifiek voor de vervolging van ISIS-strijders voor genocide van toegevoegde waarde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der  Staaij, Koopmans, Voordewind, De Roon en Van Helvert over aanvallen door radicale moslims op christenen in Nigeria

Five MPs asked the foreign minister about the May 2019 killing of Nigerian Christians after a church visit near Jos and whether radical Muslims were responsible. The government confirmed the killings, framed the Middle Belt conflict as mainly driven by resource pressure rather than religion, and promised to raise the issue bilaterally, in the EU and UN, and through the special envoy for freedom of religion.
The conflict is on the agenda during bilateral talks and will also be discussed during Minister Kaag's visit to Nigeria in July.
Het conflict staat op de agenda tijdens bilaterale gesprekken en zal ook tijdens het bezoek van Minister Kaag aan Nigeria in juli worden besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de behandeling van het onderwerp godsdienstvrijheid in het Algemeen Ambtsbericht over Afghanistan

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister whether the General Asylum Report on Afghanistan wrongly portrayed religious freedom and the position of Christians, converts and apostates, including omitting parts of the US State Department findings and a Open Doors claim about trials framed as other crimes. The Minister denied intending such a picture, defended the report's treatment of non-Muslims and converts, and declined to amend the text.
I therefore see no reason to amend the said paragraph.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om genoemde paragraaf aan te passen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over een Brits rapport inzake geloofsvervolging waarin grote zorgen worden geuit over de wereldwijde christenvervolging

MPs from CDA, ChristenUnie and SGP asked the Foreign Minister about a British interim report on Christian persecution that said persecution in some regions approaches the UN definition of genocide, and asked what Dutch action would follow. The minister responded that the Netherlands shares concern, cites its existing human rights commitments, the planned Special Envoy and an international conference in November 2019, and that sanctions and genocide-prevention obligations are available instruments without committing to new specific measures.
The cabinet is committed, and will remain committed, to upholding the Universal Declaration, including article 18.
Nederland zet zich in, en zal zich blijven inzetten, voor naleving van de Universele Verklaring, met inbegrip van artikel 18.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de samenwerking met Armenië

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister and Prime Minister about cooperation with Armenia, including whether an embassy in Yerevan would be opened and when the EU-Armenia partnership agreement bill would reach parliament. The minister answered that opening an embassy is not currently on the agenda due to limited postal network funds, that the bill's explanatory memorandum will go to the Council of State in the first half of the year, and that Armenia is covered by the Georgia embassy.
The explanatory memorandum will be submitted to the Council of State in the first half of this year.
De MvT zal in de eerste helft van dit jaar aan de Raad van State worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het verband tussen wietgebruik en psychoses

An MP asked the government about a Lancet Psychiatry study linking strong cannabis use to psychosis, and whether this should end the closed coffeeshop cannabis experiment, cap THC levels, and cost implications. The minister answered that causality is scientifically uncertain, that further research is needed, that the experiment will continue, and that cost estimates cannot be given.
I do not share that view.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de bombardementen van Turkije op christenen in Irak

MPs Van Helvert, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the foreign minister about reported Turkish airstrikes forcing Christian villagers in northern Iraq to flee, and about civilian casualties and compliance with international humanitarian law. The minister said the reports could not be verified, attributed the strikes to Turkey's campaign against the PKK, denied any targeting of religious minorities, and called on Turkey to exercise restraint and proportionality.
The cabinet has no precise information about the exact times and precise locations of these bombings.
Het kabinet heeft geen precieze informatie over de exacte tijd en precieze locaties van deze bombardementen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over erkenning van de Golanhoogten als deel van Israël

Three MPs asked whether the Netherlands recognises the Golan Heights as Israeli territory, on what resolutions its position rests, when it would recognise Israeli sovereignty, and whether residents are safer under Israel. The minister answered that the Golan remains Syrian territory under Israeli occupation, based on international law and UN Security Council resolutions 242 and 497, and that the Netherlands will only recognise border changes agreed by both parties.
The Netherlands will only recognise changes to the 1967 border if both parties, in this case Israel and Syria, agree to them.
Nederland zal alleen wijzigingen van de grens van 1967 erkennen als de beide partijen, in dit geval Israël en Syrië, daarover afspraken maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Buitenweg en Van der Staaij over de gesloten jeugdzorg

MPs Westerveld, Buitenweg and Van der Staaij asked the ministers about youths being placed in closed youth care because no alternatives exist, the acceptability of deprivation of liberty, waiting lists, and compliance with children's rights. Minister De Jonge answered that closed care should be minimised, pointed to a best-fit care plan and expert teams, acknowledged the lack of alternatives and the need for a new legal framework, and said several points are under study.
That young people have experienced stays in a closed institution as a prison, I consider an important signal.
Dat jongeren het verblijf in een gesloten instelling als een gevangenis hebben ervaren, vind ik een belangrijk signaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het besluit van het Openbaar Ministerie om abortusklinieken CASA en medisch diagnostisch centrum STAR niet strafrechtelijk te vervolgen

Parliamentary questions from MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the Minister about the Public Prosecution Service's decision not to prosecute abortion clinics CASA and STAR, and whether commercial incentives and unclear rules were at play. The Minister said he would tell clinics how to handle repeated consultations, commissioned an audit and revision of the subsidy scheme, and that the NZa will decide on further measures after receiving OM findings, while declining further action on the fraud investigation itself.
Regarding the OM's investigation into declaration fraud, the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) will have the OM further inform it about the nature, scope and content of the findings.

Ten aanzien van het onderzoek van het OM naar de declaratiefraude zal de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) zich door het OM verder laten informeren over de aard, omvang en inhoud van de gedane bevindingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat christenvervolging in China verviervoudigd is

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that persecution of Christians in China had quadrupled, the closure of churches, state restrictions on religious freedom including of Uyghurs, and Dutch efforts at the UN and EU. The minister confirmed the rise in arrests linked to new religious regulations, said official church closure figures are unknown, described qualifications in China's constitution, reported Dutch support for a UN religious freedom resolution, and described continued EU, UN and bilateral advocacy on China's human rights.
Human rights, including the right to freedom of religion and belief, is one of the priorities of the Netherlands' foreign policy and will therefore also be part of the China strategy.

Mensenrechten, waaronder het recht op vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging, is een van de prioriteiten van het buitenlands beleid van Nederland en zal daarmee dus ook onderdeel zijn van de China-strategie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, De Roon en Van der Staaij over het bericht op de website van de Jerusalem Post waarin staat dat Nederland een kritisch onderzoek naar het Israëlische hooggerechtshof heeft gefi

MPs Voordewind, De Roon and Van der Staaij asked why the Dutch government funded B'Tselem, a critical report on the Israeli Supreme Court, and whether the government shaped its aims or findings. The minister answered that the €176,000 grant was based on B'Tselem's own strategic plan, that the Dutch government did not steer its research goals or conclusions, and that funding critical civil society work fits Dutch support for human rights and the two-state solution.
The Netherlands in no way steered the research objectives or conclusions in advance or during the implementation of the research.
Nederland heeft op geen enkele manier op voorhand, of tijdens de uitvoering van het onderzoek sturing gegeven aan onderzoeksdoelen of conclusies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over banden tussen BDS en terroristen

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the government about alleged links between BDS organisations and Palestinian terrorists, whether Dutch subsidies could indirectly fund such organisations, and about an Amnesty campaign urging tourism platforms to boycott Israeli settlement businesses. The government rejected the general claims, said subsidy procedures and sanctions are adequate, maintained its opposition to BDS and its policy of not funding BDS-promoting activities, and referred to the company's own responsibility under international CSR norms.
Funds from both the Netherlands and the EU are only provided once careful selection procedures have been completed.
Fondsen van zowel Nederland als de EU worden pas verstrekt zodra zorgvuldige selectieprocedures zijn doorlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Van der Staaij over antwoorden op Kamervragen over foutieve registratie in de Basisregistratie Personen

MPs Bisschop and Van der Staaij asked about the Council of State ruling on a disputed birthplace entry in the BRP, the legal basis for including non-recognised territories in the country table, and whether adding 'Gazastrook en Westelijke Jordaanoever' implies de facto recognition of Palestine. The State Secretary answered that the ruling was correctly applied, that exceptions for non-recognised areas are allowed in the country table, and that the change does not alter Dutch policy on Palestinian statehood.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Helvert over de veiligheid van de advocaat van de Asia Bibi, de heer Saif ul-Malook, nu hij teruggekeerd is naar Pakistan om haar zaak te verdedigen

MPs asked whether the Minister would nominate lawyer Saif ul-Malook for the Human Rights Tulip, offer him protection when threats recur, confirm the validity of his Schengen visa, and say how the Netherlands could help his safety in Pakistan. The Minister said the Tulip nomination process is independent, declined to pre-empt any new protection request, would not confirm visa validity, and noted Pakistani authorities are responsible for his safety.
The cabinet cannot make statements about the validity of individuals' Schengen visas, partly because it is not authorised to share this personal data.
Het kabinet kan geen uitspraken doen over de geldigheid van het Schengenvisum van individuen, mede omdat het kabinet niet gemachtigd is deze persoonsgegevens te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Koopmans, De Roon, Karabulut, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de uitzetting van Nederlandse journalist Boersma

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether Turkey expelled Dutch journalist Ans Boersma on the basis of information Dutch authorities shared, and what Dutch government steps followed. The ministers confirm the expulsion, say an information request was made in a Dutch criminal investigation via operational channels without foreign ministry involvement, and decline to give further details citing the ongoing investigation.
Regarding the content of that information request, no further statements can be made because the criminal investigation is still ongoing.
Over de inhoud van dat informatieverzoek kunnen, vanwege het nog lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek, geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over verstrekking van Nederlandse visa in landen waar geen Nederlands consulaat gevestigd is

An MP asked how the Dutch-Belgian visa representation arrangement in Cameroon works, why individual visa refusal appeals are handled only by the representing state, and how the government ensures effective remedies. The minister answered that appeals lie against the representing state under the Visa Code, that CJEU case El Hassani guarantees effective remedies, and that complaints about Belgian representation in Cameroon have been minimal.
I do not wish to anticipate the outcome of that procedure.
Ik wil niet op de uitkomsten van die procedure vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Helvert over de ranglijst christenvervolging 2019 uitgebracht door 'Open Doors'

MPs from the ChristenUnie, SGP and CDA asked the Foreign Minister about the 2019 Open Doors ranking of Christian persecution, its trend, and Dutch responses in Iraq, China, India and Algeria, plus the Asia Bibi case and the planned special envoy for freedom of religion. The minister acknowledged the concern about rising persecution, described ongoing bilateral and EU diplomacy, and said the special envoy would start work as soon as possible.
The Netherlands continues to work for freedom of religion and belief bilaterally and through various multilateral fora and will intensify this effort in the coming years.
Nederland blijft zich zowel bilateraal als via de diverse multilaterale fora inzetten voor de vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging en zal deze inzet in de komende jaren intensiveren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Helvert, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over arrestaties tijdens mensenrechtendemonstraties in West-Papoea

Eight MPs asked the Foreign Minister about mass arrests of protesters at Human Rights Day demonstrations in West Papua, the fairness of their trials, progress on human rights in Indonesia, the Dutch Community Policing Programme, and whether the Netherlands will keep pressing Indonesia on press freedom and violence against Papuans. The minister answered that roughly 132-137 people were detained and released without charge in a context of tension, that all were freed and will not be prosecuted, that human rights concerns remain despite socio-economic progress, and that the Netherlands raises these points bilaterally and within the EU.
All persons arrested have since been released. They will not be prosecuted.
Alle opgepakte personen zijn inmiddels weer vrijgelaten. Zij zullen niet vervolgd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de bedreiging, onderdrukking en roof van christenen in Irak

MPs from CDA, ChristenUnie and SGP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of militia intimidation of Christians in Iraq, illegal seizure of their homes, the Shia militias' status, and whether Dutch pressure and UN investigation were planned. The minister said the Bartella incident was a wedding celebration rather than religious restriction, acknowledged property seizures, and said the government raises minority rights with Iraqi authorities but sees no reason for a separate UN inquiry.
The cabinet sees no reason to additionally start a UN investigation into the alleged oppression, threats and persecution of vulnerable minorities in Iraq.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om hiernaast nog een VN onderzoek te starten naar de vermeende onderdrukking, bedreiging en vervolging van kwetsbare minderheden in Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de verstrekking van Nederlandse visa in landen waar geen Nederlands consulaat gevestigd is

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how Dutch visas are issued in countries without a Dutch consulate, including the Cameroon arrangement with Belgium, the criteria for financial means and return, and whether decisions can be reviewed. The minister explained the EU Visa Code framework, bilateral representation arrangements (including Belgium deciding independently in Cameroon), the evidence criteria, and that the decision on individual applications cannot be revised through Dutch channels.
The Netherlands has transferred the authority to make final decisions on visa applications in Cameroon to Belgium.
Nederland heeft de bevoegdheid om definitief te beslissen op visumaanvragen in Kameroen overgedragen aan België.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het stelselmatig martelen van critici door de Palestijnse autoriteiten

An MP asked the government about HRW's findings that Palestinian security services systematically torture critics, and what Dutch and EU responses would be. The minister acknowledged the serious concerns, described diplomatic pressure, support for a national anti-torture mechanism, and continued but conditional donor support.
The Netherlands will closely follow this investigation, jointly with the EU and other donors.
Nederland zal dit onderzoek nauwgezet volgen, gezamenlijk met de EU en andere donoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het artikel 'Beroepsgroep gynaecologen: IVF-draagmoederschap ook mogelijk voor homostellen'

MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked nine questions about the NVOG's 2016 position allowing IVF surrogacy with donor gametes, including its medical, legal and privacy implications and costs. The Minister answered that the position was grounded in a careful assessment, that surrogacy is already possible, that costs for non-medical cases are not covered by basic insurance, and that the government is not responsible for clinic decisions, offering limited commitments.
Offering IVF surrogacy is separate from a decision on a legal framework and from the research on this in the context of the Staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap advice.
Het aanbieden van ivf-draagmoederschap staat los van een besluit tot een juridische regeling en de onderzoeken daarnaar in het kader van het advies van de Staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de toename van synthetische drugscriminaliteit

The MP Van der Staaij asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the rise in synthetic drug crime, its effects, whether police and prosecutors have enough powers and capacity, information sharing, and protection of officials. The Minister says the picture is mixed, that drug crime has fallen overall, but lab takedowns and dumps are rising, and that the government is investing extra money and capacity and will inform parliament further on funding and information sharing.
I am currently consulting with my colleague of Finance on an agreement regarding the spending plans.
Ik ben nu in afstemming over een akkoord van mijn collega van Financiën over de bestedingsplannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Van Helvert en Koopmans over de situatie van Asia Bibi nu zij is vrijgesproken van godslastering door het Pakistaanse Hof

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the situation of Asia Bibi after her acquittal by Pakistan's Supreme Court, including efforts to secure her release, safe exit for her and her family, and protection for Christians in Pakistan. The minister answered that a review petition is pending under Pakistani procedure, that the Netherlands is pursuing quiet diplomacy with allies, offered the lawyer and family a place in the Shelter City programme, and will raise minority protection at the Foreign Affairs Council.
To the lawyer of Asia Bibi, as well as his wife and child, the cabinet has offered a place in the Shelter City programme.
Aan de advocaat van Asia Bibi, alsmede zijn echtgenote en kind, heeft het kabinet een plek in het Shelter City-programma aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Baudet, De Roon en Voordewind over de Nederlandse instemming met een Palestijns voorzitterschap van de G77

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands voted for a UN resolution granting the Palestinian delegation rights to chair the G77, given the resolution's reference to a "Palestinian State" and the Netherlands not recognising such a state. The minister answered that the rights are temporary and limited to the 2019 chairmanship, that the Netherlands reaffirmed its non-recognition in a vote explanation, and that the Kingdom will keep clarifying its position where needed.
At the same time, the Kingdom reaffirmed its long-standing consistent position on the non-recognition of the "State of Palestine" in a vote explanation.
Tegelijkertijd heeft het Koninkrijk zijn jarenlange consistente positie ten aanzien van de niet-erkenning van de «Staat Palestina» in een stemverklaring herbevestigd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Helvert, Koopmans, Voordewind en Kuzu over kerksluitingen in China

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the closure of the Sion church in Beijing, China's repression of religious minorities, and the legal basis of new restrictions on religious groups. The minister confirmed the closure as part of a broader pattern of restrictions, described the legal measures and Article 36 of the Chinese constitution, said past Dutch interventions cannot be shown to have had direct effect, and committed to keep raising the issue within the EU and at the UN General Assembly.
Raising human rights violations remains necessary according to this cabinet, if only to discourage China from continuing those violations.
Het aan de orde stellen van mensenrechtenschendingen blijft volgens dit kabinet noodzakelijk, al is het enkel om China te ontmoedigen met die schendingen door te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Reddend kankermiddel niet vergoed, patiënten in paniek’

An SGP MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about the background of the NVMO's negative advice on the cancer drug nivolumab, the reaction to specialists who call it effective, and whether the advice rests mainly on the technical requirement of five years versus two years of experience. The Minister answers by referring to answers already given to earlier parliamentary questions from other MPs, without substantive answers in this document.
For the answer to these questions I refer you to the answers to questions 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 from MP Van Gerven (SP).
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik u naar de antwoorden op de vragen 1, 2, 3, 4 en 6 van het lid van Gerven (SP)
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van Rooijen, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Kuzu over de uitvoering van de motie inzake Magnitsky-sancties

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he had formally proposed an EU human rights sanctions regime, how other member states reacted, and why he doubts a national Magnitsky-style regime would be effective, as well as whether he will implement the Omtzigt motion. The minister answered that he proposed an EU global human rights sanctions regime at the Gymnich meeting, that some states were positive and none openly negative, that a formal proposal is deferred until support exists, that a national regime would be ineffective given Schengen, and that he will pursue the EU route and report after a November meeting.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is organising a senior-official meeting in November for EU member states and like-minded countries to further develop the concept of a human rights sanctions regime.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken organiseert in november een hoogambtelijke bijeenkomst voor EU-lidstaten en enkele gelijkgezinde landen om het concept van een mensenrechtensanctieregime verder te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat de Nigeriaanse overheid verdrijving van christenen toestaat

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Nigerian government permits the expulsion of Christians in the Middle Belt and whether impunity for violence against them is actively sustained by federal authorities. The minister denied that the federal government expels Christians or encourages violence, acknowledged police and army failure to curb attacks, and listed diplomatic pressure and two new NGO-run programmes as steps taken.
It has not been shown that the federal government would expel Christians from their country or encourage violence.
Het is niet gebleken dat de federale overheid christenen van hun land zou verdrijven of geweld zou aanmoedigen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Ojik, Agnes Mulder, Sjoerdsma en Van der Staaij over de berichten dat tegen vijf Soedische mensenrechtenactivistes de doodstraf is geëist

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that prosecutors sought the death penalty against five Saudi human rights activists, including one woman, and whether the trial is fair and what pressure the Netherlands can exert. The minister answered that the government is deeply concerned, opposes the death penalty, raises concerns with Saudi authorities and through EU channels including a joint demarche, and will raise the issue at the November UPR, but gave limited information on the trial itself.
The cabinet is following developments, including the trial of the female activist mentioned in the reports, closely.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen, waaronder het proces van de in de berichtgeving genoemde vrouwelijke activist, op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij de stijging van het aantal zelfmoorden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the sharp rise in youth suicides, possible causes, suicide powders, school prevention, and the Netflix series 13 Reasons Why. The government said it has no explanation yet, is convening stakeholders, will receive a CBS microdata analysis in September, and is exploring regulation of substances used for suicide.
Based on the currently available information, I have no explanation for this increase.
Ik heb op basis van de huidige informatie die beschikbaar is, geen verklaring voor deze toename.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert, De Roon en Van der Staaij over een rapport over schoolboeken, uitgegeven door de Palestijnse Autoriteit

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government assesses a report finding that Palestinian Authority textbooks delegitimise Israel, glorify violence and lack peace education, and whether the government will press for change and join a British-led review. The ministers agree problematic elements remain, say Dutch and EU pressure on both sides against incitement has had limited results as relations deteriorate, and decline to contribute to the British review because the Netherlands is not a donor in education and lacks specific expertise.
However, the Netherlands is not a donor in the education sector and has no specific expertise on Palestinian education.
Nederland is echter geen donor in de onderwijssector en heeft geen specifieke expertise op het Palestijnse onderwijs.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke en Van der Staaij over de brief van de Hoge Vertegenwoordiger van de EU Federica Mogherini aan de Israëlische minister van Strategische Zaken Gilad Erdan

MPs asked the government about an EU High Representative letter to Israeli minister Erdan and reports that a Palestinian NGO, Ma'an Development Center, employed a man allegedly linked to the PFLP, and whether Dutch funds reached it and whether NGO funding policy should change. The government answered that the man worked on a project basis and not in permanent employment, that it has no independent evidence of the alleged affiliation, that its selection criteria are adequate and it would act if subsidy conditions were breached, and that no policy revision is currently needed.
Revision of the Dutch policy towards NGOs is currently not on the agenda.
Herziening van het Nederlandse beleid ten aanzien van NGO's is op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Van der Staaij, Ellemeet en Dik-Faber over de situatie dat het openbaar vervoer in dorpen niet altijd toegankelijk is voor rolstoelgebruikers

MPs from SGP, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked why the disability equality law and public transport rules exclude small buurtbussen from wheelchair accessibility requirements, and whether the government would act. The State Secretary answered that accessibility rules were written for larger scheduled buses, that provinces and municipalities are responsible for buurtbus requirements, and that accessibility of buurtbussen is an item on an action programme with stakeholders, without committing to a legal change.
The responsibility for this lies with the provinces and municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid hiervoor ligt bij provincies en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Voordewind, Diks, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma en Agnes Mulder over de arrestatie van opnieuw twee vrouwenrechtenactivisten in Saoedi-Arabië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of two more Saudi women's rights activists, whether it constitutes an attack on the movement, what joint EU steps were taken, and how the government supports civil society. The minister said the government is concerned, an EU demarche was delivered on 8 August urging clarification of charges and fair treatment, but Saudi space for civil society is limited.

On 8 August the Chargé d'Affaires of the European diplomatic mission, together with the European countries present in Riyadh including the Netherlands, delivered a demarche to the Saudi Foreign Minister.

Op 8 augustus jl. voerde de Tijdelijk Zaakgelastigde van de Europese diplomatieke missie samen met de in Riyad aanwezige Europese landen, waaronder Nederland, een demarche uit bij de Saoedische Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Segers over de berichten ‘Ander huis gezocht voor bedreigde christelijke Syriër’ en ‘Syrische christen uit Overijssel krijgt dreigbrief, van IS’

Two MPs asked how citizens threatened for their faith or views, such as a Syrian Christian receiving a threat letter, can obtain adequate protection quickly, and how such cases are registered and countered. The government answered that local authorities are responsible for protection and risk assessment, that threats should be reported to police and are registered as discrimination or threats, and that a local multidisciplinary approach to radicalisation exists.
The local authority generally bears responsibility for the safety and well-being of its citizens.
Het lokale gezag draagt in het algemeen zorg voor de veiligheid en het welzijn van haar burgers.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en De Roon over het bericht dat het Israëlisch parlement een wet heeft aangenomen om salarisbetalingen aan veroordeelde Palestijnse terroristen te stoppen

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands should support the Israeli, US and Australian measures against salary payments to convicted Palestinian prisoners, and freeze funds to the Palestinian Authority. The minister responded that the government shares concern about payments tied to detention length, opposes unilateral Israeli withholding of PA tax revenues, and continues to press the PA to reform the system without endorsing a funding freeze.
The Netherlands consistently presses for adjustment of the system.
Nederland dringt consequent aan op aanpassing van het systeem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over het vertrek van de Verenigde Staten uit de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

MPs Van der Staaij, De Roon and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about the US withdrawal from the UN Human Rights Council over alleged bias against Israel, and whether Dutch membership legitimises unreliable human rights policy. The minister rejects that view, acknowledges shortcomings such as agenda item 7, describes reform efforts and says the Netherlands will keep working in the Council rather than follow the US out.
The cabinet does not want to sideline itself, but rather wants to stay in dialogue within the Human Rights Council, including with the difficult countries.
Het kabinet wil zichzelf niet buiten spel zetten, maar wil juist in gesprek blijven in de Mensenrechtenraad, ook met de moeilijke landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het toepassen van palliatieve sedatie bij mensen met dementie buiten de palliatieve fase

MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the health and justice ministers about deep palliative sedation of people with dementia outside the terminal phase, including whether it is used as a means to control severe behavioural problems, its relation to euthanasia oversight and the Wet zorg en dwang, and whether guidelines are being revised. Minister De Jonge answered that the core condition of a life expectancy under two weeks still applies in principle, that professional bodies are revising guidelines and a ZonMw study on the rise in sedation is under way, and that the Wzd framework permits such care only after a strict necessity and subsidiarity assessment.
No figures are known on the number of continuous deep palliative sedations in patients with dementia or non-psychogeriatric conditions with a life expectancy longer than two weeks.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over het aantal continue en diepe palliatieve sedaties bij patiënten met dementie of niet-psychogeriatrische aandoeningen en een langere levensverwachting dan twee weken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het testen van erfelijke ziekten via de huisarts

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked the health minister about GP-offered carrier screening for hereditary diseases for couples planning a child, including licensing, ethical counselling, coverage and transparency of the UMCG study. The minister answered that GP offers operate under university genetic centre licences, that counselling is adequate, that the test is not reimbursed without medical indication, and that quality guidelines are being drafted.
I will consult with the relevant professional associations so that these guidelines come as quickly as possible.
Ik zal in overleg treden met de betreffende beroepsverenigingen opdat deze richtlijnen er zo snel mogelijk komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de stijgende christenvervolging in China onder Xi Jinping

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the detention of Catholic bishop Guo Xijin, new Chinese restrictions on unregistered religious activity, and what the government will do about religious freedom in China. The minister said the Netherlands is seriously concerned, raised religious freedom in bilateral and multilateral talks, and will use the UN Universal Periodic Review, but made no commitment on the bishop's appointment, which he called a matter between China and the Vatican.
The cabinet makes no statement on the official appointment and approval of bishops; this is a matter between China and the Vatican.
Over de officiële benoeming en goedkeuring van bisschoppen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken – dit is een kwestie die speelt tussen China en het Vaticaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Baudet, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Becker, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over de sluiting van kerken door de Algerijnse overheid

Eight MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Algeria is closing Protestant churches under its law on non-Islamic religions and whether this breaches religious freedom. The minister confirmed that some churches cannot hold services without the required permits, said freedom of religion is not generally violated, and said he raised the issue with the Algerian foreign minister, who replied that churches have nothing to fear.
Needless to say, I will continue to closely monitor developments in this regard and, if necessary, voice my concerns bilaterally and within the EU.
Het spreekt voor zich dat ik de ontwikkelingen hieromtrent nauwgezet blijf volgen en indien nodig hierover, bilateraal en in EU-verband, mijn zorgen zal uiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke, van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over aanvallen op de Kerem Shalom-grensovergang in Israël

MPs asked whether Gazan demonstrators tried to damage the Kerem Shalom crossing, whether the Dutch-funded scanners and cargo flows were affected, how much freight crossed this year, and whether the government accepts Israel's view that the border protests amount to a state of war. The minister answered that damage occurred on the Palestinian side with minimal effect on trade, gave UN cargo figures for January to April, and rejected the war qualification, stating that Gaza is occupied territory under the law of occupation.
On Friday 4 May Gazan demonstrators caused damage on the Palestinian side of the Kerem Shalom / Karm Abusalem crossing.
Op vrijdag 4 mei hebben Gazaanse demonstranten aan Palestijnse zijde van de Kerem Shalom / Karm Abusalem grensovergang beschadigingen aangebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert en De Roon over het bericht dat EU-subsidies terecht komen bij organisaties die oproepen tot boycot van Israël

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU funds organisations calling for a boycott of Israel (BDS), and whether funds reached Palestinian groups linked to terrorism. The government answered that the EU opposes a boycott, that BDS advocacy is protected speech and not a funding bar, that only one NGO was named in the report (training for youth including Hamas and PFLP members, funded by Norway), and that it sees no reason to ask the Commission to act.
The fact that organisations support the BDS movement is not a criterion for rejecting funding for the cabinet.
Het feit dat organisaties de BDS-beweging ondersteunen, is voor het kabinet geen afwijzingscriterium voor financiering

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Voordewind, Becker, Diks, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij, Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Prominente Saudische vrouwenrechtenactivisten opgepakt’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the arrests of Saudi women's rights activists were only for campaigning for women's right to drive, and whether the government would raise the matter bilaterally and in the EU and call for their release. The minister said the detainees are suspected of conspiracy with foreign powers and financing hostile actors, that Nederland raised concerns with the Saudi foreign minister and is consulting partners including in the EU, and that it remains concerned about repression of dissent.
The Netherlands will continue to ask for attention to the detention of the activists and press for proper treatment.
Nederland zal aandacht blijven vragen voor de aanhoudingen van de activisten en aandringen op goede behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de antisemitische uitspraken van president Abbas

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister whether President Abbas's antisemitic remarks were unacceptable, whether the EU would take follow-up action, and what consequences should follow. The minister answered that the government shares the EU's view that parts of the speech are unacceptable, has protested bilaterally and in the UN Security Council, and sees no reason to suspend Dutch support to the Palestinian territories.
The cabinet sees no reason to suspend or end (partly) Dutch support to the Palestinian territories.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om de Nederlandse steun aan de Palestijnse gebieden (gedeeltelijk) op te schorten of te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de verspilling van medicijnen

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about wasted medicines, GP re-dispensing of leftover drugs, and whether re-dispensing should be allowed, including a thermometer-sealed bag and chip technology. The Minister rejects loosening the rules, citing quality and safety risks, and states that re-dispensing is only cost-effective for expensive drugs, while promoting measures to reduce waste.
I do not have exact figures on the extent of the waste.
Ik heb geen exacte cijfers over de omvang van de verspilling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over toenemende inperking van de godsdienstvrijheid in China

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the worsening of religious freedom in China, including tighter rules on unregistered religious groups, the detention of Dr. Wang Bingzhang without trial, and the treatment of Taiwanese activist Li Ming Che. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described Dutch raising of the issue bilaterally and in EU forums, and said the government will keep raising individual cases with China.
The Cabinet raises individual cases both within the EU and bilaterally and will continue to do so.
Het Kabinet kaart zowel in EU-verband als in bilateraal verband individuele gevallen aan en zal dat blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat Iran stiekem delen van het atoomprogramma zou hebben voortgezet

MPs Becker, Ten Broeke, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked whether Israeli claims that Iran secretly continued parts of its nuclear weapons programme after the JCPOA were new, whether the IAEA and the Dutch government had received the material, and how the Dutch government would keep the JCPOA in place after the US withdrew support. The minister answered that the information offers no new insight, that the IAEA reports Iran is complying, that Nederland urges Israel to share the material with the IAEA, and that Nederland is working with EU partners to preserve the agreement and consider measures on ballistic missiles.
The information presented by Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu does not lead to new insights into the Iranian nuclear programme.
De informatie die de Israëlische minister-president Netanyahu presenteerde leidt niet tot nieuwe inzichten over het Iraanse nucleaire programma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de komst van een zelfmoordmachine naar de uitvaartbeurs in Amsterdam

Three MPs asked whether it is acceptable that a suicide machine (euthanasia demonstration) was shown at an open funeral fair in Amsterdam, and what the government would do about it and about suicide prevention investment. The Staatssecretaris called such a demonstration highly undesirable, said the government has no legal power to ban it, and promised to inform the House this spring on suicide prevention funding.
I have no legal powers to prohibit such demonstrations, the aim of which is to stimulate discussion.
Ik heb geen wettelijke mogelijkheden om te verbieden dat dergelijke demonstraties plaatsvinden, waarvan het doel is de discussie aan te jagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de verkoop van euthanasieproducten via een website

MP Van der Staaij asked whether a website selling euthanasia products amounts to criminal assistance in suicide, whether the public prosecution service will investigate, who runs the site, and what powers exist to shut it down. The Minister of Justice replied that the public prosecution service decides independently on investigation and prosecution, declined to comment on this individual case, said the identity of the operators is unknown to him, and described the notice-and-take-down procedure and the prosecutor's power under article 54a Sr. to order internet providers to block access.
It is for the public prosecution service to decide independently, on the basis of the facts and circumstances, whether to open an investigation and possibly take a prosecution decision.
Het is aan het OM om op basis van de feiten en omstandigheden eigenstandig te beslissen of een opsporingsonderzoek wordt ingesteld en eventueel een vervolgingsbeslissing te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Diks, Van den Hul en Kuik over buitenlandse investeringen in Ethiopië

MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about foreign investment in Ethiopia after a documentary on large-scale land grabs, and how Dutch investment, World Bank programmes and civil society support could prevent harm to people and the environment. The minister acknowledged the problems in large-scale projects, said Dutch investments are generally much smaller and that the embassy requires due diligence and IMVO compliance, and committed to pressing the World Bank on FPIC and civil society space.
Alleged violations of the OECD Guidelines can be reported to the National Contact Point for the OECD Guidelines (NCP).
Vermeende schendingen van de OESO-richtlijnen kunnen worden gemeld bij het Nationaal Contact Punt voor de OESO-richtlijnen (NCP).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Van Helvert en Voordewind over het benoemen van een defensieattaché in Iran

MPs from the SGP, PVV, CDA and ChristenUnie asked why the Netherlands plans to station a defence attaché in Tehran, how this relates to Iran's regional ambitions and missile programme, and to possible EU sanctions. The government answers that the posting improves monitoring of military developments and contacts with Iranian authorities, and that a parallel dialogue with Iran does not exclude concern about the missile programme.
Because of the Dutch interests in the region and Iran's role in it, it was chosen to station the new defence attaché in Tehran itself.
Vanwege de Nederlandse belangen in de regio en de rol van Iran daarin is ervoor gekozen de nieuwe defat in Teheran zelf te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Kuik over sugardating

MPs Van der Staaij and Kuik asked whether sugardating platforms that connect young women with wealthy men for sex amount to illegal prostitution or trafficking, whether they should be regulated or investigated, and whether municipalities can act against their advertising. The state secretary answered that no specific permit is needed, existing criminal law (art. 273f) suffices against exploitation, consultations with site operators are constructive, no indications of exploitation are known to the prosecution service, and no further investigation or new municipal powers are planned.
I currently see no reason to conduct further research into this.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om hier verder onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Becker en Van Helvert over verhoging van het budget voor betalingen aan veroordeelde Palestijnen

MPs Van der Staaij, Becker and Van Helvert asked the government about reports that the Palestinian Authority's 2018 budget raises payments to prisoners and their families by $56 million, and what the Netherlands is doing to change the system. The ministers answered that the increase is about $900,000 compared with 2017, that the Netherlands opposes linking payments to length of detention, and that it keeps raising this bilaterally, multilaterally and within the EU.
The cabinet continues to press on this, including in multilateral settings.
Het kabinet blijft hierop aandringen, ook in multilateraal verband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht 'Videodiensten moeten kinderen beschermen tegen gewelddadige porno'

An MP asks the minister whether the Commissariaat voor de Media's view that 16-year-olds' moral development is insufficient means minors are adequately protected from online pornography, and whether the UK Digital Economy Act could serve as an example for mandatory age verification. The minister acknowledges that current Mediawet rules do not yet require protection of minors from harmful content in on-demand services, supports extending Kijkwijzer classification online, and promises to implement the revised AVMD Directive in the Mediawet once adopted.
I therefore support extending the level of protection that NICAM has achieved over recent years with Kijkwijzer for linear services to online media offerings.

Ik ben er dan ook voorstander van dat het beschermingsniveau dat het NICAM de afgelopen jaren met de Kijkwijzer heeft bereikt voor de lineaire diensten doorgetrokken wordt naar het online media-aanbod.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de emotionele oproep van ouders na de dood van hun dochter om het zelfmoordpoeder te verbieden en het strafrechtelijk vervolgen, dan wel verbieden van de Coöperatie Laat

An SGP MP asked the Health and Justice ministers, after parents' emotional appeal following their daughter's suicide, whether they would ban the self-death powder sold by the CLW, pursue prosecution, and dissolve the cooperative under civil law, and whether a meeting with the CLW had taken place. The ministers answered that they will explore regulation options, that the Public Prosecution Service has started a criminal investigation and asked the CLW to cease its activities, that civil dissolution is being considered by the OM, and that a meeting with the CLW is not appropriate during the investigation.
Since the Cooperative Last Will is the subject of a criminal investigation, a conversation by me with this cooperative is not opportune and the commitment cannot be fulfilled.
Aangezien de Coöperatie Laatste Wil onderwerp is van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek, is een gesprek van mij met deze coöperatie niet opportuun en kan de toezegging niet gestand worden gedaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de ontwikkeling en het gebruik van ‘killer robots’

An SGP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about the development and use of 'killer robots' and the legal and ethical frameworks governing them. The government answered that meaningful human control must always be retained, that fully autonomous weapons are rejected in principle, and that existing international humanitarian law and weapons reviews under Article 36 provide the safeguards, while committing to revisit the advisory report in 2020.
According to the cabinet, people must always remain responsible and accountable for the use of weapon systems.
Volgens het kabinet moeten mensen altijd verantwoordelijk en aansprakelijk blijven voor de inzet van wapensystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Ten Broeke, Karabulut en De Roon over de onderdrukking van Papoea’s in Indonesië

MPs asked the minister about the expulsion of a BBC journalist from Papua, press freedom, deteriorating human rights, and Dutch police training in Indonesia. The minister confirmed the expulsion, said foreign journalists need permits, described Dutch support for press freedom and the Community Policing Programme, and said human rights including Papua are raised in bilateral and EU/UN dialogue.
Enquiries showed that the BBC journalist indeed had to leave the province.
Bij navraag is gebleken dat de BBC-journaliste inderdaad de provincie moest verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Van Helvert over een nieuwe serie moorden onder christenen in Nigeria

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reported killings of Christians in Nigeria and whether Fulani herdsmen are responsible, why the Nigerian state fails to protect civilians, whether religion plays a role, Boko Haram's current strength, and how the Netherlands can help. The minister said the government cannot independently confirm the figures, attributed the violence mainly to economic and land-related causes rather than a religious agenda, and committed to pressing Nigerian authorities to document crimes and prosecute perpetrators.
The Netherlands will, preferably together with other partners or within the EU, press the Nigerian authorities that the perpetrators of the killings must not go unpunished
Nederland zal er, bij voorkeur ook samen met andere partners, dan wel in EU-verband, bij de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten op aandringen dat de daders van de moordpartijen niet vrijuit gaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Van der Staaij en Karabulut over het personeelstekort bij de militaire luchtverkeersleiding

MPs asked the state secretary of Defence about staff shortages at military air traffic control, including suspended services, limited flight information, and whether flight safety is at risk. The government acknowledges chronic shortages and service suspensions, says safety is preserved by suspending services, and outlines training, retention and cooperation measures with LVNL, while rejecting a pay rise.
Air Operations Control Station (AOCS) has struggled with staff shortages for years. Currently 17 of the 73 established posts are vacant.
Air Operations Control Station (AOCS) kampt al jaren met een personeelstekort. Momenteel zijn 17 van de 73 organieke functies vacant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ellemeet, Dik-Faber en Von Martels over de situatie dat het openbaar vervoer in de dorpen niet altijd toegankelijk is voor rolstoelgebruikers

MPs asked whether wheelchair users can be refused when transferring from a regular bus to a community bus, and whether the Wet personenvervoer 2000 should be amended to close a gap. The government answers there is no legal omission: the Wgbh/cz applies, community buses are deliberately outside its scope as small vehicles, the province chose not to impose further demands on volunteer-run services, and gemeenten must provide small-scale wheelchair transport instead.
There is no omission in the Wet personenvervoer 2000 that would need to be repaired.
Er is geen sprake van een omissie in de Wet personenvervoer 2000 die gerepareerd zou moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het artikel ‘Het gewone sterven blijft onderbelicht’

An SGP MP asked the health minister whether public debate overly focuses on euthanasia at the expense of natural dying and palliative care, and how the 8 million euro per year for palliative care would be spent. The minister agreed that palliative care deserves more attention, outlined planned awareness activities from after summer 2018, and said the spending plan and timeline would follow in an April 2018 letter.
In my forthcoming letter on palliative care (April 2018) I will go into more detail on the plans and the further timeline.
In mijn komende brief over palliatieve zorg (april 2018) zal ik in meer detail ingaan op de plannen en het verdere tijdpad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Van Helvert over de Open Doors ranglijst christenvervolging 2018

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and CDA asked the Foreign Minister about the 2018 Open Doors persecution ranking, including religious freedom in Pakistan, North Korea, India and other countries, and whether religious freedom should be a priority in asylum policy. The minister answered that the government shares concern, describes bilateral, EU and Human Rights Fund activities, and sees no reason to make Christian asylum seekers a separate priority in asylum policy.
The government cannot independently confirm the exact number of North Korean Christians in prison camps.
Het kabinet kan het exacte aantal Noord-Koreaanse christenen in strafkampen niet eigenstandig bevestigen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de vergunningsaanvraag voor het openen van een nieuwe abortuskliniek in ‘s Hertogenbosch

An MP asked whether a new abortion clinic in 's-Hertogenbosch was being licensed, whether capacity or spread can be considered, and whether investor returns create incentives. The minister replied that no application has been received yet, that licensing law contains no capacity or spread conditions, that he is reviewing whether regulation needs changing, and that the clinic may not pursue profit.
As reported to the House of Representatives on 27 September 2017, I am looking at the current regulations in this area to see whether adjustment is needed.
Zoals aan de Tweede Kamer gemeld op 27 september 2017 4 kijk ik naar de huidige regelgeving op dit gebied om te bezien of aanpassing nodig is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Arissen, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het bericht dat moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers in Europa in voorbere

MPs from ten parties asked the government whether it knew of reports that assassinations of Turkish citizens in Europe were being planned, how it assessed these claims, and whether it would investigate and take extra security measures. The minister said the government is alert and monitors tensions and safety in the Turkish-Dutch community, cannot confirm the existence of such plans, and urged anyone threatened to report it.
I cannot confirm the existence of plans for assassinations of Turkish citizens.
Het bestaan van plannen voor moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers kan ik niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over een zelfmoordaanslag op een kerk in Pakistan

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a suicide attack on a church in Pakistan, its victim numbers, the attackers' background, the state of radical Islamist groups and Dutch efforts on religious freedom, including the cases of death-sentenced Christians. The minister answered with casualty figures, attributed the attack to ISIS-Khorasan, described the Pakistani government's counter-terrorism plan and reported Dutch and EU engagement on religious freedom.
It cannot be determined from the figures whether the victims were of terrorist, sectarian or separatist violence.
Het is niet uit de cijfers op te maken of het hierbij gaat om slachtoffers van terroristisch, sektarisch of separatistisch geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het Nederlandse stemgedrag inzake VN-resoluties aangaande Israël

Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands voted for a UN General Assembly resolution on Jerusalem that appears to deny Jewish ties to the holy sites, and how this squares with his motion against disproportionate UN agendas on Israel. The minister answered that the resolution follows UNSC resolution 478 and the EU position on the 1967 borders, that the EU added a statement stressing the holy sites, and listed Dutch votes on other 2017 UN resolutions concerning Israel.
The cabinet also refers to the answer to parliamentary questions of 27 July 2017 on the UNESCO decision on the Old City of Hebron.
Het kabinet verwijst tevens naar de beantwoording van Kamervragen van 27 juli 2017 over het besluit van Unesco over de Oude Stad van Hebron.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de steun aan het Human Rights and International Humanitarian Law Secretariat en de samenwerking met de Women’s Affairs Technical Committee

MPs asked why the Dutch government ended funding for the Women's Affairs Technical Committee after it refused to distance itself from a youth centre named after a convicted terrorist, and why the Human Rights and International Humanitarian Law Secretariat still lists WATC and touts its advocacy against Israel. The ministers answered that donors ended the partnership after WATC refused to distance itself from glorifying violence, that the last payment was in May 2017, that the website figures were adjusted, and that support for Israeli and Palestinian human rights organisations will continue under review.
The cabinet considers glorifying violence simply unacceptable and expects all its partners to keep well away from it.
Het kabinet acht het verheerlijken van geweld simpelweg onacceptabel en verwacht van al zijn partners dat zij zich hier verre van houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ten Broeke, De Roon en Van der Staaij over de omstandigheden in Noord-Koreaanse politieke gevangenissen

MPs from CDA, VVD, PVV and SGP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that North Korean political prisons resemble Nazi camps, including detention numbers, alleged crimes against humanity, UN and ICC action, and protection for Christians. The minister answered that the UN commission reports are authoritative, that Netherlands raises the issue at the UN and supports referral to the ICC though this requires Security Council agreement, and that it supports documentation projects and religious freedom.
The Netherlands, together with the EU, regularly raises the human rights situation in North Korea, including abuses in (political) prisons.
Nederland stelt de mensenrechtensituatie in Noord-Korea, inclusief misstanden in (politieke) gevangenissen, mede in EU-verband regelmatig aan de orde
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Diks, Van den Hul en Van der Staaij over de waarschuwing van Unicef over de zorgwekkende situatie van 8,5 miljoen kinderen in Syrië en omliggende landen

Four MPs asked the ministers about UNICEF's warning on 8.5 million children in Syria and neighbouring countries, including emergency aid, action on Eastern Ghouta, the position of children in peace talks, and renewal of UN Security Council resolution 2165. The ministers answered that the Netherlands has contributed substantial humanitarian funds, pushes for humanitarian access and medical evacuations in the ISSG, and will prioritise child protection and cross-border aid during its 2018 Security Council seat.
The Netherlands raises the worrying situation weekly in the International Syria Support Group and will also work in the UN Security Council in 2018 to improve the situation.
Nederland zet zich wekelijks in de ISSG (International Syria Support Group) in om de zorgwekkende situatie aan de kaak te stellen en zal zich in 2018 ook in de VN Veiligheidsraad ervoor inzetten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Helvert en Ten Broeke over de implementatie van het vredesakkoord in Colombia

MPs Van der Staaij, Van Helvert and Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about the slow and uneven implementation of the Colombia peace agreement, including rising violence and rights abuses, and what the Netherlands is doing and will do about it. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described mixed progress, listed Dutch funding and diplomatic initiatives, and said the government will press Colombia on faster implementation.
The cabinet will therefore seize every opportunity to press for the most effective and swift possible implementation of the peace agreement.
Het kabinet zal dan ook elke gelegenheid aangrijpen om aan te dringen op een zo effectief en spoedig mogelijke uitvoering van het vredesakkoord
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de CASA-klinieken

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked the Minister about signals that care quality at CASA clinics was not guaranteed, including workload, use of temporary nurses, and the protection of counselling and information rights for women seeking abortion. The Minister answered that the inspectorate placed CASA Klinieken under intensified supervision, that responsibility for care quality lies with the board, and that a licence procedure will apply to any takeover.
After completion of the intensified supervision process, the inspectorate will prepare a report and publish it as usual.
Na afronding van het traject van verscherpt toezicht zal de inspectie een rapportage opstellen en zoals gebruikelijk openbaarmaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over mogelijk nog grotere fraude bij CASA klinieken

An MP asked the minister whether CASA clinics might have billed abortions that never took place, given the gap with other clinics' expected September 2017 volumes, and asked for inspection checks and no permit before answers were given. The minister said clinics report quarterly by law, the inspectorate will compare figures, and a permit for a successor will not be decided before the answers are received.
I will ask the IGJ i.o. to compare the data for this period with the same period in 2016.
Ik zal de IGJ i.o. vragen de gegevens over deze periode te vergelijken met dezelfde periode in 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over euthanasie in de Levenseindekliniek bij psychiatrisch patiënten

Two MPs asked the Health Minister whether euthanasia by the Levenseindekliniek for psychiatric patients who were not fully treated, or not in unbearable hopeless suffering, was in line with the Chabot ruling and why the RTE judged such cases careful. The Minister declined to judge individual cases, explained the distinction between hopeless suffering and absence of a reasonable alternative, said he would discuss concerns with the profession in the evaluation of the euthanasia law, but saw no reason to doubt current practice.
It is not for me as Minister to judge individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om te oordelen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Schotland voert minimumprijs voor alcohol in’

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether the Netherlands will follow Scotland in introducing a national minimum unit price for alcohol, and whether EU law blocks such a measure. The State Secretary confirmed EU law does not prevent minimum prices if proven more effective than tax increases, but declined to commit to a bill until the Scottish effects are observed.
I therefore want to first see what the possible effects of this measure in Scotland may be and will closely follow this step.
Ik wil daarom eerst zien wat de mogelijke effecten van deze maatregel in Schotland kunnen zijn en zal deze stap dan ook nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het niet herkennen van signalen van mensenhandel door artsen

An SGP MP asked the State Secretaries whether doctors fail to recognise human trafficking signals, whether trafficking should be added to the meldcode for domestic violence and child abuse, how doctors can be trained, and what role municipalities should play. The minister answered that the existing meldcode can support professionals on trafficking, medical bodies can extend it, and the Lenferink recommendations are being pushed at municipalities, with an integrated action plan promised.

In the talks I am having on the meldcode for domestic violence and child abuse, I will emphasise with the KNMG doctors' federation this possibility and the important role of medical professional groups in it.

In de gesprekken die ik voer over de meldcode huiselijk geweld en kindermishandeling zal ik met de artsenfederatie KNMG deze mogelijkheid en de belangrijke rol hierin van de medische beroepsgroepen benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat Nederland een centrale rol in een wereldwijd netwerk speelt dat mensen helpt bij het kopen van euthanatica

An SGP MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about reports that the Netherlands plays a central role in a global network helping people buy euthanasia drugs, and about enforcement against facilitators, customs controls and testing labs. Minister Grapperhaus replied that no central Dutch role appears in the article, that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, that there is no tolerance policy and the law is enforced, and that customs conducts risk-based checks while the Inspectorate and prosecutors were unaware of the testing lab.
I repeat that the Public Prosecution Service can never make statements about ongoing cases, but there is confidence in the Public Prosecution Service that it will do what it must do: enforce the law.
Ik herhaal hier dat het Openbaar Ministerie nooit mededelingen kan doen over lopende zaken maar dat er vertrouwen is in het Openbaar Ministerie dat het doet wat het moet doen: de wet handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over bedreiging van christenen in Rotterdam

Two MPs (Van der Staaij and Voordewind) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that a converted Christian couple in Rotterdam was threatened by Muslims for evangelising, asking how police and prosecutors respond and whether other cases exist. The minister confirmed that threats are criminal, that the couple has regular contact with police, and that cases can be investigated, but declined to discuss individual casework.
Beyond that, it is not appropriate for me to address individual casework in parliamentary questions.
Voor het overige past het mij niet om in Kamervragen in te gaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over een fatwa tegen Somalische christenen in Europa

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether a fatwa calling for action against Somali Christians in Europe poses a real threat, and what protection is needed. The minister answered that the threat cannot be confirmed, the video had only 135 views, no signals of unrest were received, and that threats reported to authorities would be investigated with measures taken if needed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Karabulut, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Thieme over het referendum over onafhankelijkheid voor Iraaks Koerdistan

Six MPs asked whether the independent international law adviser should assess whether Iraqi Kurdistan meets the Montevideo criteria for statehood in light of its independence referendum, and how the government interprets such advice. The answer states that the questions were answered in a separate letter ('Situatie Koerdische regio') to parliament, so no substantive reply is given in this document.

The written questions from MPs Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Karabulut, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij and Thieme, question number 2017Z12850, have been answered by means of the letter 'Situation in the Kurdish region'.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma (D66), Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Karabulut (SP), Van Ojik (GroenLinks), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD), vraagnummer 2017Z12850 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Situatie Koerdische regio» (Kamerstuk 32 623, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke en De Roon over het stopzetten van de financiering aan de Women’s Affairs Technical Committee (WATC)

MPs Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke and De Roon asked whether Dutch funding to the Women's Affairs Technical Committee (WATC) was stopped after WATC backed a youth centre named after a terrorist, and whether other subsidised organisations glorify terrorism. The ministers confirm the funding was halted with other donors, citing glorification of violence, and state that existing subsidy conditions are sufficient to prevent support to such organisations.
For this reason, the Netherlands, together with the other donors of the Human Rights and International Humanitarian Law Secretariat, has decided to immediately end cooperation with WATC.
Om deze reden heeft Nederland – samen met de andere donoren van het Human Rights and International Humanitairan Law Secretariat – besloten de samenwerking met WATC per direct stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over het advies van de Coöperatie Laatste Wil omtrent een zelfdodingsmiddel

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij ask whether a lethal substance advised by the Coöperatie Laatste Wil for suicide is legal, traceable, safe, and whether the cooperative's advice constitutes criminal assistance in suicide, and whether it should be banned. The ministers answer that they do not know the substance, that criminal liability is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, that a ban under article 2:20 BW faces high legal thresholds, and that the government opposes spreading such information and will rely on suicide prevention policy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over door de Europese Unie georganiseerde reizen voor journalisten naar de Westoever

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about EU-funded press trips for European journalists to the West Bank, their aims, and why Israel is not included, arguing the programme may be one-sided. The minister explained the trip aims to inform journalists about EU-Palestinian Authority relations and aid, rejected the call for a different programme, and noted a planned visit to Israel's COGAT was being considered.
The cabinet does not share this view.
Het kabinet deelt deze mening niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Te weinig verpleging voor mensen die thuis willen sterven: 'Dieptepunt in zorg'’

MPs Bergkamp and Van der Staaij asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that terminally ill patients cannot get home palliative nursing care and are kept in or cannot leave hospitals or hospices. The State Secretary acknowledged 17 reported cases, attributed them mainly to staff shortages and budget ceilings, pointed to NZa oversight and planned roundtables, and promised further monitoring of palliative care while stating he sees no evidence of underfunding by insurers.
I am willing to conduct further research into the bottlenecks in palliative care along three tracks.
Ik ben bereid om langs drie sporen verder onderzoek te doen naar de knelpunten in de palliatieve zorg
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de uitzending van EenVandaag over euthanasie bij demente mensen

Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the Health Minister how to treat earlier written euthanasia declarations when dementia changes a person's wishes, and whether a doctor's call for relatives to press a demented parent into euthanasia crosses a line. Minister Schippers answered that the patient's current, competent wish is central, that written declarations can be honoured if the patient was competent when writing them, and that such conversations are important while the statutory due-care requirements still apply.

The starting point remains that the person's wish is honoured at any stage of the illness, provided the wish is expressed while competent or, if the person is no longer competent, was recorded in writing beforehand while competent.

Uitgangspunt blijft dat de wens van de persoon gehonoreerd wordt, in welk stadium van de ziekte dan ook, mits die wens wilsbekwaam wordt geuit of, indien iemand niet meer wilsbekwaam is, diens wens daarvóór wilsbekwaam schriftelijk is vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke en Voordewind over het besluit van Unesco over de Oude Stad van Hebron

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether UNESCO's decision to place the Old City of Hebron on the World Heritage List, which they said neglects Jewish history, distorts history, and whether the Netherlands will protest. The minister answered that the decision was taken by the World Heritage Committee members, that ICOMOS could not verify the emergency procedure criteria because Israel denied a site visit, that the cabinet follows ICOMOS advice, and that the Netherlands will not protest but will urge coexistence.
The cabinet's position is that it follows the advice of ICOMOS.
Het kabinet hanteert als standpunt dat het de adviezen van ICOMOS volgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Karabulut, Van Raan, De Roon en Van der Staaij over de confiscaties door Turkse overheid van Aramese kerken en kerkbezittingen

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey's transfer of over 50 Aramaic churches and monasteries to the Diyanet amounts to confiscation, and whether the Netherlands would seek clarification and urge EU partners to respond. The minister said the transfers stem from administrative reorganisation under Turkish law, that Diyanet denied receiving property and Mardin confirmed this, but that the Aramaic community has lost property it used for over a thousand years; the embassy will raise minority rights and a field visit with EU partners is planned.
The Netherlands will continue to raise the rights of religious minorities in Turkey with the authorities.
