Nederland zal de rechten van religieuze minderheden in Turkije bij de autoriteiten blijven aankaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke en De Roon over de berichten dat Turkije Koerdische doelen in Noord-Syrië en Noord-Irak heeft aangevallen

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reported Turkish strikes on Kurdish targets in northern Syria and Iraq, including whether evidence supports Turkey's claim the targets were PKK smugglers and what is known of casualties among Syrian Christians and Yazidis. The minister answered that Turkey has a right to self-defence but should show restraint and act proportionately, that the government has no evidence to confirm or refute Turkey's claim, and that it has no independent information on casualties, only open-source reports of protests.
The Netherlands does not have independent intelligence on the basis of which these reports can be confirmed or refuted.
Nederland beschikt niet over eigenstandige inlichtingen op basis waarvan deze berichten bevestigd of ontkracht kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het meewerken aan illegaal commercieel draagmoederschap uit Cambodja door de Nederlandse ambassade

An SGP MP asked ministers whether the Dutch embassy in Cambodia assisted in bringing a baby from an allegedly illegal commercial surrogacy arrangement to the Netherlands, and raised questions about surrogacy policy, nationality recognition, and possible extradition. The minister answered that the embassy only accepts passport applications under Dutch law, defers the broader policy question on surrogacy to a future cabinet, and says it is for foreign authorities to act on illegal conduct abroad.
A decision on following up the Staatscommissie's recommendations, including those on surrogacy, I gladly leave, in light of this, to a next cabinet.
Een beslissing over de opvolging van de aanbevelingen van de Staatscommissie, waaronder die over draagmoederschap, laat ik mede in dat licht graag aan een volgend kabinet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Helvert, De Roon, Karabulut, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Diks, Van den Hul en Sjoerdsma over de veroordeling van de gouverneur Tjahaja Purnama van Jakarta

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the two-year prison sentence of Jakarta governor Purnama for blasphemy, whether it will press Indonesia for his release and raise the case in the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue. The minister answered that the government is concerned, that the human rights ambassador raised it with Indonesian officials, that the EU issued a statement, and that the case will be followed closely, without committing to demand release.
The Dutch government will continue to closely monitor the case and the situation regarding freedom of expression and of religion or belief, together with other EU partners.
De Nederlandse regering zal de zaak en de situatie rondom de vrijheid van meningsuiting en van godsdienst en levensovertuiging, samen met andere EU-partners, nauw blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Segers, Knops, Ten Broeke, Martin Bosma en Van der Staaij over de verboden stille tocht van Christenen voor Israël in Rotterdam

Six MPs asked why Rotterdam's mayor banned a silent march by Christians for Israel, questioning the security rationale given the comparable treatment of a Palestinian Return Centre congress and the impact on Jewish residents. The minister replied that maintaining public order is the mayor's responsibility and accountable to the municipal council, that the organisation itself chose to cancel the march, and that police capacity decisions in similar future cases rest with the mayor.
Maintaining public order in Rotterdam is the responsibility of the mayor of Rotterdam.
De handhaving van de openbare orde in Rotterdam is de verantwoordelijkheid van de burgemeester van Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bisschop over de overseksualisering van kinderen

MPs Van der Staaij and Bisschop asked about the Council of Europe's concern over the sexualisation of children, the role of media and advertising regulation, and whether sanctions via the Advertising Code Committee are adequate. The state secretary answered that existing youth-protection rules, education on sexuality, and self-regulation (RCC, NICAM) are sufficient for now, that a Dutch monitoring study is pending, and that OCW will raise modernisation of youth-protection rules with RCC and NICAM.
In contacts with the Advertising Code Committee (RCC) and the Netherlands Institute for the Classification of Audiovisual Media (NICAM), the Ministry of OCW will raise this matter.
In de contacten met de Reclame Code Commissie (RCC) en het Nederlands Instituut voor de Classificatie van Audiovisuele Media (NICAM) zal het Ministerie van OCW dit ter sprake brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de kosten voor koosjere maaltijden in zorgcentra

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked whether kosher meal provision at care centres such as Etrog in Amersfoort is under financial pressure because costs are not covered in the tariffs, and whether the government will ensure such religious meal provision remains possible. The State Secretary replied that meals are part of the integrated Wlz tariff for accommodation, that there are no specific funding rules for religious meals, and that providers have freedom to allocate funds, while agreeing that food can be part of a care centre's identity.
There are no specific funding rules for the reimbursement of meal provision according to religious practices.
Er zijn geen specifieke bekostigingsregels voor de vergoeding van maaltijdverstrekking volgens religieuze gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het essay ‘De apotheek is geen euthanasie-automaat’

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked the minister about pharmacists' concerns over supplying euthanasia drugs, including unclear professional norms, conscientious objection, time pressure from doctors, and the absence of this issue from the third evaluation of the Euthanasia Act. The state secretary replied that the 2012 KNMP/KNMG guideline is the applicable norm, that pharmacists may refuse on principled grounds, and that doctors bear final responsibility, but declined further research on the pharmacist's role.
It is therefore sensible for the professional associations to keep their members continuously informed about the existence and content of the guideline, including during pharmacist training.
Het is daarom zinvol als de beroepsverenigingen hun achterban blijvend informeren over het bestaan en de inhoud van de richtlijn, ook gedurende de opleiding tot apotheker.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Baudet, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Knops over haatzaaien in Palestijnse schoolboeken

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether Palestinian schoolbooks incite hatred against Israel, glorify martyrdom and fuel terrorism, and whether the Netherlands funds such curricula. The minister answered that UNRWA screens textbooks and found problematic passages in some, that the government has no comparative data showing a trend toward more incitement, and that the Netherlands is not a donor to the Palestinian education sector.
The Netherlands is not a donor to the Palestinian education sector and therefore does not contribute to the curriculum.
Nederland is geen donor voor de Palestijnse onderwijssector en draagt derhalve ook niet bij aan het curriculum.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Ten Broeke over het bericht dat UNESCO een resolutie in stemming wil brengen waarin de soevereiniteit van Israël over West-Jeruzalem ontkend

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, PVV and VVD asked whether the government would use its influence in UNESCO to block a draft resolution denying Israeli sovereignty over West Jerusalem, and why UNESCO engages with such politicised texts. The minister said the Netherlands criticised the draft, voted against the adopted version together with Germany, Greece and Lithuania, and that UNESCO's focus on the Old City reflects its World Heritage listings, but did not commit to further action.
The Netherlands therefore voted against the decision, as explained in a joint statement of vote with Germany, Greece and Lithuania.
Nederland heeft daarom tegen het besluit gestemd, zoals toegelicht in een gezamenlijke stemverklaring met Duitsland, Griekenland en Litouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Thieme, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Knops, Karabulut en Van Rooijen over repressieve maatregelen tegen de oppositie door de regering van Wit-Rusland

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister about repressive measures against the opposition in Belarus, including arrests of demonstrators and Christian Democrat leaders around the 25 March protest. The minister said the Belarusian authorities' measures were disproportionate, that Nederland raised concerns via EU statements and with the Belarusian ambassador, and that the issue was discussed in the OSCE Permanent Council.
In the cabinet's view, the measures of the Belarusian authorities are not proportionate.
De maatregelen van de Wit-Russische autoriteiten zijn in de ogen van het kabinet niet proportioneel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over de risico’s van een curettage na een miskraam of tijdens een abortus provocatus

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked about risks of curettage after miscarriage or abortion, including a possible shift toward expectant management and whether all women are fully informed of risks beforehand. The Secretary of State replied that curettage is considered safe, that alternatives exist and are used when medically indicated, that professional guidelines are updated with new evidence, and that the WGBO already requires risk information, with a planned WGBO amendment pending at the Raad van State.
Furthermore, together with the Minister of Security and Justice, I am preparing an amendment to the WGBO.
Verder bereid ik samen met de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie een wijziging voor van de WGBO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de behandeling van Pakistaanse asielzoekers en vluchtelingen in Thailand

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about the treatment of Pakistani asylum seekers and refugees in Thailand, including whether Thailand treats them as an immigration matter, arbitrary detention risks, Dutch dialogue results and NGO support. The minister answered that Thailand still treats refugee matters as immigration, that Pakistanis are not singled out, that Dutch and EU raise the issue regularly, and that resettlement destinations are a matter for the State Secretary of Justice and Security.
Thailand still regards the fate of refugees and asylum seekers within its borders as an immigration matter.
Thailand beschouwt het lot van vluchtelingen en asielzoekers binnen de landsgrenzen nog altijd als een immigratiezaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer, Omtzigt, Van Bommel, De Roon, Van der Staaij, Van Klaveren en Voordewind over de vluchtelingendeal met Turkije

MPs from several parties asked whether PM Rutte and Chancellor Merkel made a gentlemen's agreement with Turkey to resettle 150,000-250,000 Syrian refugees a year, and whether the government asked Turkey to postpone a visit by Minister Cavusoglu. The government denied any side agreement, pointed to the EU-Turkey statement of 18 March 2016 and ongoing EU resettlement talks, denied any request to postpone the visit, and declined to answer the questions one by one before the requested deadline.
No. Agreements have only been made at European level on resettling Syrian refugees from Turkey.
Antwoord 4 Er zijn enkel in Europees verband afspraken gemaakt over het hervestigen van Syrische vluchtelingen vanuit Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de schrikbarende stijging van het aantal ‘plaasmoorde’ in Zuid-Afrika

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister about a reported sharp rise in farm murders in South Africa, including the claim that over 30 white farmers and family members were killed in the first two months of 2017, and what the government is doing about it. The minister could not confirm the figures, noted that official statistics do not separate victims by race or occupation, described the causes and South African police measures, and said prosecution is South Africa's own responsibility while Netherlands cooperates only ad hoc.
The cabinet therefore cannot confirm with certainty the numbers stated in your question.
Het kabinet kan daarom de gestelde aantallen in uw vraag niet met zekerheid bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van der Staaij en De Roon over aanslagen op christenen in de Sinaï, Egypte

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about ISIS killings of Christians in North Sinai, whether Egypt can protect them, whether the government will raise concerns with Egypt and President Sisi, and whether Dutch radar deliveries to the Egyptian navy improve Sinai surveillance. The minister answered that the government is concerned, cannot judge the army's protection capacity given limited access and information, will raise concerns bilaterally and via the EU, and that the radars are not yet operational and are not clearly linked to Sinai surveillance.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over niet heimelijk euthanasie plegen

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked the Minister of Health whether euthanasia in advanced dementia, based on written declarations and without the patient's current consent, is legally and ethically sound after specialists criticised such cases. The Minister defended the Wtl framework, said one of three reviewed cases was judged not careful by the Rte and referred to IGZ and OM, and declined to tighten the rules or the handreiking.
In view of this, I refrain from giving a judgment.
Gelet hierop onthoud ik mij van een oordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, De Roon, Knops en Van Bommel over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2017 van Open Doors

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2017 ranking of Christian persecution, including whether the rise in persecution, the role of religious nationalism and Saudi-linked financing in Sub-Saharan Africa, Dutch policy and the fight against ISIS are being addressed. The minister confirmed the increase in persecution, said the causes are hard to pin down, described Dutch efforts through the Human Rights Fund and diplomacy, and said the fight against ISIS also serves Christians.
To gain more clarity on this, the Netherlands is supporting research in the region into both the sources and the effects of these financing flows in the Horn of Africa.
Om hier meer duidelijkheid over te krijgen steunt Nederland onderzoek in de regio naar zowel bronnen als effecten van deze financieringsstromen in de Hoorn van Afrika.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht “Forse kritiek op uitspraak Raad van State inzake Iraanse bekeerling”

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about criticism of a Council of State ruling on an Iranian convert, including the claim that the Rambo model was wrongly treated as the sole basis for assessing conversion and whether experts are sufficiently consulted. The State Secretary replied that the IND uses a broader set of insights than the Rambo model, consults experts where needed, and is not obliged under the Procedures Directive to consult experts routinely.
The IND has previously been in contact with Ms Van Saane and will continue to do so in the future.
De IND heeft eerder contact gehad met mevrouw Van Saane en zal dat in de toekomst ook blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Van Klaveren en Knops over de wapenopbouw van Hezbollah

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Hezbollah's arms build-up in southern Lebanon, Iranian supply, civilian shielding, and possible Dutch support for Israel and tougher action against Iran. The minister answered that the government cannot verify the reports, condemns any use of civilians as shields, urges Iran to play a constructive role, and says new sanctions against Iran are not currently on the table.
The government has taken note with concern of the media reports but cannot comment on the accuracy of this information.
Het kabinet heeft met zorg kennisgenomen van de berichtgeving in de media maar kan geen uitspraken doen over de juistheid van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Recourt, Van Oosten, Kooiman en Van der Staaij over de documentaire ‘Grenzeloos misbruikt’

Five MPs asked the ministers of Justice, Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about the documentary on child sex tourism and webcam abuse, including police capacity, investigative powers, Philippine cooperation, liaison staffing and funding. The government answered in detail, describing existing measures, the Plan van Aanpak, the Manila liaison extension and the Down to Zero programme, while declining to commit additional funds or expertise for Philippine police training due to scarce specialised capacity.

Because these efforts require scarce specialised operational police capacity, which would then not be available for investigation in the Netherlands, I am unfortunately forced to be restrained in this regard.

Omdat deze inspanningen de inzet vereisen van schaarse gespecialiseerde operationele capaciteit van de politie, die daardoor niet voor de opsporing in Nederland beschikbaar is, ben ik helaas gedwongen hiermee terughoudend om te gaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de eindejaarswensen van de Nederlandse ambassade in Berlijn

MPs Knops, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked why the Dutch embassy in Berlin sent only New Year wishes and no Christmas wishes, and whether other Dutch embassies do the same. The minister replied that embassies are not obliged to send season's greetings, that the choice is left to each post, and that the Berlin embassy did send a digital card wishing a merry Christmas and a happy 2017, so no reference was avoided.
So there is no question of messages being avoided.
Er is dus geen sprake van dat boodschappen worden gemeden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse staat New York Nederlandse bedrijven op een zwarte lijst heeft gezet omdat zij Israël zouden boycotten en het bericht over

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked whether the government would act after New York State blacklisted four Dutch firms for allegedly boycotting Israel, and what it thought of a German CDU position calling the BDS campaign antisemitic. The minister said the ambassador raised due-process concerns with New York, the firms denied any boycott, the government opposes boycotts of Israel, and it rejected the view that BDS is antisemitic.
The cabinet considers that before publishing such a list, careful hearing and rebuttal should take place.
Het kabinet vindt dat voor publicatie van een dergelijke lijst zorgvuldige hoor en wederhoor zou moeten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Recourt, Gesthuizen, Sjoerdsma, Voortman, Van der Staaij en Thieme over uitlevering van verdachten aan Rwanda

MPs asked the Minister of Justice whether the extradition of two Rwandan-national suspects should be reconsidered in light of testimony from Witteveen about Rwandan courts, fair-trial risks and the Bandora case, and whether a broader extradition inquiry should be conducted. The minister refused to revisit the decision, stating Witteveen's findings were already weighed, the Court of Appeal found no real fair-trial risk, and the two men were extradited on 12 November 2016.
I see no reason to revisit the decision regarding the extradition.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de beslissing ten aanzien van de uitlevering te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Ten Broeke, Jasper van Dijk, Knops, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Grashoff en Van der Staaij over het gebruik van chemische wapens in Darfur

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty's report of possible chemical weapons use in Darfur, lack of humanitarian and UNAMID access to Jebel Marra, and whether Sudan should be asked to explain under the Chemical Weapons Convention and face inspection. The minister said the OPCW is examining the report, has requested more information from Sudan, and that Netherlands will press for accountability and raise the issue with EU and UN partners if use is confirmed.
The Netherlands asked the OPCW to act proactively and to actively inform the States Parties about the findings.
Nederland heeft de OPCW verzocht om proactief optreden en de Staten Partijen actief over de bevindingen te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over verwijzingen naar abortusklinieken in AZC’s

MPs asked how pregnant asylum seekers in reception centres are cared for, whether COA policy on unplanned pregnancies includes independent counselling on alternatives to abortion, and whether they are being referred to abortion clinics with standard referral letters, with calls for independent investigation. The government answered that asylum seekers have the same maternity care rights as Dutch citizens, that GC A follows NHG standards with referral to clinics or counselling bodies possible, that it finds such steering unacceptable, has received no such signals, and sees no reason for an investigation at present.
At this moment there is no reason for me to conduct an investigation.
Op dit moment is er voor mij geen aanleiding voor een onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Van Bommel, Bontes, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops en Sjoerdsma over het uitoefenen van internationale druk op Noord-Korea

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how North Korea's missile launches and nuclear tests affect regional stability, what diplomatic and sanctions pressure can be applied via China and the UN/EU, and how the Netherlands prepares for regime destabilisation. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns the launches, supports UN sanctions enforcement and IAEA action, will press for a human rights resolution at the UN General Assembly, and sees no concrete signs of regime collapse.
The Netherlands will – as in recent years – continue to raise human rights violations both bilaterally and in relevant international forums.
Nederland zal – net als in afgelopen jaren – zowel bilateraal als in relevante internationale fora aandacht blijven vragen voor mensenrechtenschendingen.
Antwoord op de vragen leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, De Roon en Knops over het wereldwijd toegenomen geweld tegen Joden

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about a reported global rise in violence against Jews, including the Pew Research figures, its causes, the countries affected, Dutch funding of BDS-linked organisations, monitoring, and follow-up on a motion on antisemitism. The minister answered that the findings are concerning, that causes are complex and context-specific, that BDS activities are protected by free speech, and listed Dutch and EU initiatives against discrimination and antisemitism.
These findings from Pew Research are very concerning.
Deze bevindingen van Pew Research zijn zeer zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over de verspreiding van abortuspillen door Women on Waves naar Noord-Ierland

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked whether the Women on Waves abortion-pill action toward Northern Ireland was lawful, whether the Dutch permit was affected, and whether there was contact with Ireland. The Minister answered that Northern Ireland's authorities are responsible for enforcement, no temporary permit was required since the action took place abroad, and there was no contact with Ireland or Northern Ireland.
Since Women on Waves' conduct did not take place on Dutch territory, no permit is required under Article 296(5) of the Criminal Code.
Aangezien het handelen van Women on Waves niet op Nederlands grondgebied plaatsvond, is er geen vergunning vereist
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over problemen bij uitbetaling van verleende palliatieve zorg

The SGP MP Van der Staaij asks the minister about billing problems for palliative care, including the rule that blocks parallel palliative and active clinical billing, and why the NZa postponed a fix until 2018. Minister Schippers replies that parallel billing is already possible via another specialty, that the NZa is running a broader inventory with quick wins planned, and that the intercollegial consult rule will not be abolished.
I do not intend to abolish this rule.
Ik ben niet voornemens deze regel af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over de beperking van godsdienstvrijheid in islamitische landen

MPs Van der Staaij, De Roon and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about restrictions on religious freedom in Islamic countries, the US State Department findings, Dutch action, and Boko Haram's calls for violence against Christians. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described Dutch human rights support and multilateral efforts, and outlined counter-Boko Haram measures without providing precise casualty figures.
It is not possible to provide precise figures on the number of Christians and churches affected by violence in Islamic countries in the recent period.
Het is niet mogelijk om precieze cijfers te verstrekken van het aantal christenen en kerken dat in de afgelopen periode getroffen is door geweld in islamitische landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind c.s. over de bijdrage van Nederland aan politietrainingen op Papua

Dutch MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch support for police training on Papua, including monitoring of Indonesian security forces, possible human rights abuses by trained officers, and the Community Policing Programme's design and evaluation. The minister answered that a mid-term evaluation shows gradual progress, that no guarantee can be given that trained officers did not commit abuses, and that embassy staff monitor the situation through dialogue with local actors.
No guarantee can be given that trained officers did not take part in violating human rights.
Er kan geen garantie worden gegeven dat getrainde agenten niet hebben deelgenomen aan het schenden van mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Van Klaveren over de verstoring van een Israëlkraam in een Jumbo supermarkt

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and Van Klaveren asked the ministers whether an online protest campaign against an Israeli product display in a Jumbo supermarket in Krimpen aan den IJssel was undesirable, and what the government would do to protect supermarkets and staff from intimidation. The minister answered that such actions fall under freedom of expression, that criminal law applies to threats or intimidation, that no signals of disruption of public order were received, and that no extra measures against protest campaigns are needed.
I therefore see no reason to take additional measures against protest campaigns.
Ik zie derhalve geen reden om extra maatregelen te nemen tegen protestcampagnes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over jong ouderschap naar aanleiding van het congres Jong en Ouder

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked the state secretary about support, housing, funding fragmentation and care for young parents, including teen pregnancies in closed youth care. The state secretary largely pointed to municipal responsibility, existing initiatives and the taskforce, promising follow-up letters on national procurement and a study on the demand side.
Municipalities precisely have the opportunity to look, using funds from different sources, at how integrated tailored support can best be delivered.
Gemeenten hebben juist de mogelijkheid om met middelen die uit verschillende bronnen komen te kijken op welke wijze integraal het beste maatwerk kan worden geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over meer vraag naar euthanasie als er onvoldoende palliatieve zorg geboden wordt

MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked whether inadequate palliative care drives demand for euthanasia, citing SCEN doctors who feel powerless when palliative care falls short and an extrapolated estimate of 160 to 800 cases a year. The State Secretary acknowledged the SCEN doctors' frustration, said he has no hard data on palliative care quality, and promised a progress letter and improvement measures such as the National Palliative Care Programme.
I do not have hard figures on the quality of the palliative care provided.
Ik heb geen harde cijfers over de kwaliteit van de ingezette palliatieve zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Keijzer en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Azc's krijgen vertrouwenspersonen voor homoseksuele asielzoekers’

MPs Van der Staaij, Keijzer and Voordewind asked whether asylum reception centres have dedicated confidants for vulnerable groups such as gay asylum seekers and Christians, about prosecution of crimes against vulnerable groups, and about cameras protecting them. The State Secretary answered that a coordinating confidant function and staff confidants serve all residents without targeting specific groups, that training is being shaped with NGOs, that a new report will show incident-to-prosecution figures without group breakdown, and that cameras are used under an internal framework.
The registration does not break down cases by specific target groups.
In de registratie wordt geen uitsplitsing gemaakt naar specifieke doelgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de handreiking schriftelijk euthanasieverzoek

Two MPs from the ChristenUnie and SGP ask the health and justice ministers whether the government's answer on the written euthanasia request guidance was adequate and whether its wording on dementia patients, which they say confuses doctors and the public, should be changed. The minister replies that the sentence should be read in the context of dementia cases, that it is clear, and that the working group decided not to amend it.
In consultation, the members of the working group on the written euthanasia declaration have therefore decided not to amend the passage.
In overleg hebben de leden van de werkgroep «Schriftelijke wilsverklaring euthanasie» dan ook besloten de passage niet aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Ten Broeke, Thieme en Van der Staaij over de arrestatie van een mensenrechtenactivist in Bahrein

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of human rights activist Nabeel Rajab in Bahrain, its charge, and whether the government would raise it with Bahrain. The minister confirmed the arrest on the charge of spreading false news, said the government finds the repression very concerning, and said the EU will make a demarche in Manama seeking clarification.
The European Union will shortly make a demarche in Manama to the Bahraini authorities to raise the recent pressure on human rights defenders and the opposition.
De Europese Unie zal op korte termijn in Manama een demarche uitvoeren bij de Bahreinse autoriteiten om de recente druk op mensenrechtenverdedigers en de oppositie aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het hoge aantal abortussen

Two MPs from ChristenUnie and SGP asked the health minister about the rising global abortion count, the apparently high rate among some immigrant groups, and whether abortion may encourage risky sexual behaviour. The minister answered that the Netherlands has one of the lowest abortion rates internationally, that origin is not registered so no evidence of higher rates among specific immigrant groups exists, and that no additional research or targeted policy is planned.

I do not intend to commission additional research into the effect of abortion legislation on sexual risk-taking, since the Netherlands is internationally among the countries with the lowest abortion rate.

Ik ben niet voornemens om extra onderzoek te laten doen naar het gevolg van de abortuswetgeving op seksueel risicogedrag, aangezien Nederland internationaal tot de landen behoort met het laagste abortuscijfer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het artikel ‘Minister aanklagen vanwege miskramen’ en het uitsluiten van belangenverstrengeling

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the NIPT consortium and Gendia have conflicts of interest with the Health Council's advice on the NIPT test, after a Gendia director accused her of medical malpractice. The Minister rejected the accusations, said Gendia is not involved in the Health Council advice, described the consortium's links and its conflict-of-interest rules, and explained the Council's procedures for excluding conflicted experts.
Gendia is not involved in any way in the Health Council's advice on the NIPT.
Gendia wordt op geen enkele manier betrokken bij het advies van de Gezondheidsraad over de NIPT.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma en Grashoff over de arrestatie van een Nederlandse vrouw in Qatar

MPs from eight parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of a Dutch woman in Qatar after she reported rape, and what the government had done to free her. The minister confirmed the arrest and sentencing, described consular assistance provided by the Doha embassy, and said the woman was to be deported within days.
For privacy reasons and to prevent misunderstandings, the ministry does not provide information to other persons, including (close) family members, without the consent of the person concerned.
Om privacyredenen en om misverstanden tegen te gaan, verstrekt het ministerie zonder toestemming van betrokkene geen informatie aan andere personen, inclusief (naaste) familieleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat artsen dronken patiënten zat zijn en strengere regels eisen

An SGP MP asked the state secretary for Health about reports that emergency doctors are fed up with drunk patients and demand stricter rules, including enforcement of alcohol-serving bans, prosecution of aggressive patients, mandatory aftercare, and alcohol sales and advertising limits. The state secretary replied that the issue will be taken into account in the ongoing evaluation of the Drank- en Horecawet, that hospitals can join criminal proceedings or claim damages, that a direct liability route for offenders is being prepared with Justice, and that the ZonMw study on alcohol measures will inform the policy response.
During the meeting they indicated, among other things, that VWS takes the NVSHA's signal very seriously and is including it in the ongoing evaluation of the Drink and Catering Act (DHW).
Zij hebben tijdens het gesprek onder andere aangegeven dat VWS het signaal van de NVSHA heel serieus neemt en meeneemt in de evaluatie van de Drank- en Horecawet (DHW) die momenteel plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke en Van der Staaij over de indirecte Nederlandse steun aan de Boycot, Desinvesteringen en Sancties (BDS)-beweging

Three MPs asked whether Dutch-funded NGOs fund other NGOs promoting the BDS campaign against Israel, whether this fits subsidy criteria, and to list supported NGOs. The minister answered that the government does not finance BDS activities against Israel, that support for BDS is not a disqualifying criterion because of freedom of expression, and that it does not keep an overview of such organisations.
The cabinet ensures that it does not finance BDS activities against Israel.
Het kabinet stelt zeker dat het geen BDS-activiteiten tegen Israël financiert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, De Roon, Voordewind en Knops over geweld tegen christenen door extremistische hindoes in India

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about attacks on Christians by extremist Hindus in India, including whether police intervened and what the government would do internationally. The minister acknowledged rising religiously motivated violence, said six suspects were arrested, and described diplomatic efforts on religious freedom without committing to new concrete steps.
The cabinet uses various opportunities to raise human rights, including freedom of religion and belief, with India.
Het kabinet maakt van verschillende mogelijkheden gebruik om mensenrechten – en daarbinnen vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging – in India aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de handreiking schriftelijk euthanasieverzoek

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked about the handreiking on written euthanasia requests, including how the brochure was drafted, uptake among doctors, and wording on dementia suffering. The ministers answered that the handreiking was developed by a working group with consultation of stakeholders to clarify the Wtl, that uptake is unknown, and that doctors must still assess unbearable suffering case by case.
We have no insight into the extent to which doctors use the handreiking.
Antwoord 3 We hebben geen inzicht in de schaal waarop artsen gebruikmaken van de handreiking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Keijzer en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Gave: ook christenen in Nederlandse azc’s bedreigd’

MPs from SGP, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that Christians in asylum centres are threatened, including comparisons with Germany and reporting and information measures. The State Secretary declined to make quantitative comparisons with other countries, said each incident requires a firm approach, and pointed to earlier letter measures on reporting encouragement, safety across locations and information for asylum seekers.
I do not have information on the basis of which I can make such quantitative comparisons with Germany or another country.
Ik beschik niet over informatie op basis waarvan ik dergelijke kwantitatieve vergelijkingen kan maken met Duitsland of een ander land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Knops, De Roon, Van der Staaij en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Abbas confirms PA still paying terrorists’ salaries’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the shift of prisoner salary payments from the Palestinian Authority to the PLO is merely cosmetic, given EU and Dutch funding, and whether the Netherlands will object as Norway did. The minister replied that the Netherlands has no objection in principle to support for prisoners if transparent and proportionate, that the Dutch Pegase contribution does not fund prisoner payments and has robust verification, and that the government will keep raising the issue bilaterally.
The government has no insight into the total income or expenditure of the PLO.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzage in de totale inkomsten of uitgaven van de PLO.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over een eventueel gratieverzoek voor een in Egypte veroordeelde Nederlandse journaliste

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands has not pursued or joined pardon requests for Dutch journalist Rena Netjes, convicted in absentia in Egypt, despite other countries supporting such requests. The minister answered that a pardon request can only be filed by Netjes herself, that the Netherlands will support it if she files, and that Netjes has so far declined to file.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Servaes, Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Knops en Van Bommel over de situatie in West-Papoea

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports of 'slow genocide' against Papuans, the failure of quiet diplomacy, the Netherlands' historical responsibility, and whether he would raise the issue with Indonesia. The minister answered that the report was not yet public, outlined ongoing concerns and recent gestures by Jakarta, described bilateral and EU/UN channels, and committed to studying the report and raising the issue during his Indonesia visit.

As explained in the letter to Parliament of 22 November 2005, Professor Drooglever's academic research is a further contribution to describing Papua's own history and the course of events surrounding the 'Act of Free Choice'.

Zoals in Kamerbrief van 22 november 2005, stuk 30 300V is toegelicht vormt het academische onderzoek van professor Drooglever een nadere bijdrage aan de beschrijving van de eigen geschiedenis van Papoea en het verloop van de gebeurtenissen rond de «Act of Free Choice» .
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over Nederlandse subsidies aan de Israëlische NGO Breaking the Silence

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and PVV asked whether Dutch subsidies to the Israeli NGO Breaking the Silence should be reconsidered after reports it collected classified IDF information, and how the government ensures subsidies are lawfully spent. The minister replied that no charges have been filed, that the government is concerned about NGO space in Israel, and that the Human Rights Secretariat has strict selection and monitoring procedures with no finding of breach so far.
However, no such finding has been made in the case of the Israeli NGO Breaking the Silence.
Van een dergelijke constatering is in het geval van de Israëlische NGO Breaking the Silence evenwel geen sprake.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Knops over de aanslag op Eerste Paasdag in Lahore, Pakistan, waarbij 72 mensen om het leven zijn gekomen en in het bijzonder christenen doelwit waren

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the Easter Day bombing in Lahore that killed 72 people, including whether Christians are targeted, whether Pakistani state protection for religious minorities is adequate, and how Pakistan's fight against Taliban-linked groups can be supported. The minister acknowledged the attack, described the claimed motives, said the Netherlands raises minority protection bilaterally and multilaterally, and pointed to planned NGO programmes and EU and GCTF cooperation on counterterrorism.
The Netherlands therefore intends to support NGO programmes in Pakistan from this autumn via the Addressing Root Causes fund.
Nederland is daarom voornemens om vanaf dit najaar via het Addressing Root Causes fonds ngo-programma's in Pakistan te steunen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp, Voordewind, Leijten en Van der Staaij over het supermarktkartel tegen leeftijdsverificatiesystemen voor de verkoop van alcohol en tabak

MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about a court ruling against the CBL's campaign and code on age verification for alcohol and tobacco sales, and whether the sector is living up to its duty to keep sales from minors. The State Secretary declined to comment on the ruling pending appeal, said the government expects the law to be followed, and will report to parliament on the tobacco display-ban convenant by 1 July 2016 if no agreement is reached.
Since this is a court ruling against which the parties will appeal, I cannot go into the content of this ruling or the conduct of any of the parties in this lawsuit.
Aangezien het een uitspraak van een rechtbank betreft waartegen partijen in hoger beroep zullen gaan, kan ik niet ingaan op de inhoud van deze uitspraak
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Knops en Voordewind over het onderzoeksrapport over christenvervolging door Boko Haram in Nigeria

MPs from SGP, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about an Open Doors report on Christian persecution by Boko Haram and related violence in Nigeria, and how Dutch efforts compare and what concrete action is possible. The minister answered that the violence is serious but driven largely by economic and ethnic-religious conflicts, described existing Dutch and EU support for dialogue, deradicalisation and a regional task force, and acknowledged the particular vulnerability of Christian communities.
The Netherlands actively works worldwide for freedom of religion and belief for everyone.
Nederland zet zich wereldwijd actief in voor vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging voor iedereen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de forse toename van het aantal comazuipers

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the sharp rise in hospital admissions of underage youths for alcohol intoxication and what measures would reverse the trend. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, said youth drinking is declining but binge drinking among heavier-drinking older teens remains high, promised action after the summer Peilstation study, and said enforcement of the age limit will be addressed in the DHW evaluation.
I assume you mean better enforcement of the age limit by municipalities.
Ik ga er van uit dat u hierbij doelt op betere handhaving van de leeftijdsgrens door gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman, Bruins Slot, Bergkamp, Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over een verzekeraar die wijkverpleegkundigen passeert met nieuw pgb-beleid

MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about insurer CZ's new policy limiting which home-care nurses may assess persoonsgebonden budget (PGB) eligibility, designating preferred organisations per region, and whether this restricts budget-holders' choice. The State Secretary answered that CZ's approach is within the agreed rules, budget-holders remain free to choose other providers with reduced reimbursement, the insurer has at least two providers per region, and an AMvB will be sent to parliament with a letter on the motion.
Control lies in all cases with the PGB holder.
De regie ligt in alle gevallen bij de pgb-houder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de website ‘woman on web’

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked whether Women on Web, a Dutch-hosted online abortion-information and medication service, offering free abortions to women with Zika may be unlawful and harmful, and when more will be known about Zika's link to microcephaly and Guillain-Barré. The minister answered that Dutch law only permits abortion in licensed facilities and bars internet prescribing without a doctor-patient relationship, that the IGZ has asked follow-up questions, and that scientific conclusions on Zika will take weeks to months.
The IGZ has asked Women on Web additional questions about the working method of this online community following the reports.
De IGZ heeft naar aanleiding van de berichtgevingen Women on Web aanvullende vragen gesteld over de werkwijze van deze online gemeenschap
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke en Voordewind over financiering van veroordeelde terroristen door de Palestijnse Autoriteiten

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether reports that the Palestinian Authority funds convicted terrorists with foreign aid should change Dutch donor policy and how the government implements earlier motions calling for pressure on the PLO to stop such payments. The minister replied that the Israeli deputy minister's claims are her own, that the World Bank made no such finding, and that the government keeps raising the PLO's payment policy bilaterally and in the EU, where only one member state shares the concern.
The cabinet continues to raise the PLO's policy in bilateral talks with the PA and the PLO.
Het kabinet blijft het beleid van de PLO aankaarten in bilaterale gesprekken met de PA en de PLO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de uitzending over de Levenseindekliniek

An MP from the SGP asks the Minister of Health about a documentary on a euthanasia clinic, criticism of its conduct, the assessment of a psychiatric case and whether the regional review committees (RTE's) can be trusted and supervised. The Minister defends the RTE's and the euthanasia framework, says a documentary is unsuitable as assessment material, notes that review outcomes are published and periodically evaluated, and promises a policy response on the Voltooid leven report before summer.
In addition, the RTEs account to me and the Minister of Security and Justice through the annual report, which is also submitted to the House of Representatives.
Daarnaast leggen de RTE's verantwoording af aan mij en de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie door middel van het jaarverslag dat ook aan de Kamer wordt aangeboden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de benoeming van een voormalig voorzitter van de Nederlandse Vereniging voor een Vrijwillig Levenseinde (NVVE) tot voorzitter van de Regionale Toetsingscommissies Euthan

An SGP MP asked whether the appointment of a former NVVE chair and co-initiator of a euthanasia bill as coordinating chair of the Regional Review Committees on Euthanasia was procedurally sound, impartial, and compatible with independent oversight. The ministers answered that an open procedure was followed, that the appointee was chosen as the best candidate, that his past NVVE role is different from the committees' legal task, and that existing accountability mechanisms and evaluations are sufficient.
We did not choose Mr Kohnstamm for a politically or socially profiled appointment, but for the best candidate proposed by the RTEs after an open application procedure.

Wij hebben met de heer Kohnstamm niet gekozen voor een politiek of maatschappelijk geprofileerde benoeming, maar voor de beste kandidaat die na een open sollicitatieprocedure door de RTE’s is voorgedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het onderzoek naar tienerzwangerschappen

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked the ministers about a Rutgers study on teenage pregnancies, including whether abortion is rejected by many pregnant teenagers, whether support for young mothers is adequate, and whether prevention and counselling should stress abortion's negative consequences. The State Secretary answered that girls' choices are respected, that doctors judge whether decisions are free and informed, that existing funding for support organisations is sufficient, and that counselling covers all options and consequences of abortion.
It is up to the doctor to determine whether a woman who comes to him for an abortus has made this choice freely and well informed.
Het is aan de arts om te bepalen of een vrouw die bij hem komt voor een abortus deze keuze in vrijheid en goed geïnformeerd heeft gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht "Zilveren kruis smeert verstandelijk beperkten wurgcontract aan"

MPs from nine parties asked the State Secretary about a Zilveren Kruis settlement agreement offered to persoonsgebonden budget holders, and whether it should be withdrawn and whether the motion to halt recovery was being implemented. The State Secretary answered that the zorgkantoren act on agreements made with them, that the settlement need no longer be signed pending a good-faith assessment, that recovery of alleged improperly paid budgets is suspended until good faith is assessed by 1 May 2016, and that other zorgkantoren operate under the same agreements.
By 1 May 2016 or as soon as possible, zorgkantoren will have assessed in all currently open individual cases whether the budget holder acted in good faith.
Uiterlijk 1 mei 2016 of zoveel eerder als mogelijk, hebben zorgkantoren in alle op dit moment openstaande individuele casuïstiek beoordeeld of de budgethouder te goeder trouw heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Voortman en Van der Staaij over voorlichting aan asielzoekers in Nederland

MPs Voordewind, Voortman and Van der Staaij asked whether information for asylum seekers in reception centres is limited to LHBT groups, whether incidents involving asylum seekers are registered, whether incidents are more frequent in emergency reception locations, and whether an independent confidential person should be appointed. The minister answered that COA is consulting on broader information covering Christians, atheists and other minorities, that incidents are not registered by asylum status or sexual orientation, that the data do not show more incidents in larger locations, and that the government sees no added value in a separate confidential person.
The sexual orientation of a resident is not registered in COA's systems.
De seksuele gerichtheid van een bewoner wordt in de systemen van het COA niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Knops en De Roon over de ranglijst christenvervolging van Open Doors

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, CDA and PVV asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2016 ranking on Christian persecution, including rising killings, Dutch policy response, a proposed UN inquiry and ISIS treatment of minorities. The minister said the government shares serious concern, cites funding for religious freedom projects and EU/UN engagement, but opposes a UN inquiry focused on one group in favour of an inclusive approach.
The cabinet is however not in favour of a UN inquiry focused on one specific group.
Het kabinet is echter geen voorstander van een VN-onderzoek gericht op één specifieke groep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over commerciële handel in weefsel van geaborteerde kinderen

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Health whether Planned Parenthood clinics engaged in commercial trade in foetal tissue and altered abortion methods, and what diplomatic or subsidy measures the government would take regarding IPPF funding. The minister answered that no commercial trade occurs under US law, that Dutch law forbids compensation for foetal tissue, that IPPF receives about 2.5 million euro annually for youth sexual and reproductive health, and that withdrawing subsidies is neither warranted nor desired.
There is no question of commercial trade or of a profit motive.
Er is geen sprake van commerciële handel of van een winstoogmerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bergkamp over de continuïteit van hospicezorg

MPs Bergkamp and Van der Staaij asked the government about waiting lists and funding gaps at Hospice Dignitas, insurers' expenditure caps for 2016, and whether insurers meet their care duty when contracting little with regional hospices. The State Secretary answered that waiting times are undesirable, that insurers are expected to contract sufficiently and reorganise contracting, that local shortages occur but are not structural, and that the NZa transparency rule and a dispute body are being developed.
Health insurers have a duty of care; they must provide insured persons with good-quality care that is within their reach and delivered in a timely manner.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben zorgplicht, zij moeten verzekerden voorzien van kwalitatief goede zorg die binnen hun bereik is af te nemen en tijdig wordt geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het bericht 'Minder ziekenhuisopnames door casemanager palliatieve zorg'

MPs asked the state secretary for Health about a study finding that palliative case managers reduce hospital admissions, and about funding, reach beyond cancer patients and follow-up on a motion. The state secretary said the model adds value, that the Health Insurance Act allows such roles to be funded through nursing care, and that palliative care is being broadened beyond cancer, though no new obligation is created.
I am currently examining how I can implement the adopted motion submitted by member Bruins Slot et al.
Ik ben momenteel aan het onderzoeken hoe ik uitvoering kan geven aan de aangenomen motie van het lid Bruins Slot c.s.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon, Voordewind, Grashoff, Van der Staaij, Thieme, Bontes, Kuzu, Van Vliet, Krol, Klein en Houwers over de levensbedreigende situatie

MPs asked the ministers about the humanitarian siege of Madaya in Syria, where about 40,000 people face starvation, and whether the Netherlands would press for a ceasefire, humanitarian access and airdrops. The ministers confirmed the severity of the situation, described Dutch funding and diplomatic efforts through the UN and ICRC, and explained why airdrops are not considered feasible.
The Netherlands has for some time been pressing within the UN for a ceasefire so that humanitarian aid can be provided to the population.
Nederland dringt in VN-verband al geruime tijd aan op een staakt-het-vuren zodat humanitaire hulp geboden kan worden aan de bevolking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de rellen rond een raadsvergadering over de komst van een asielzoekerscentrum in Geldermalsen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the riots around a council meeting on an asylum centre in Geldermalsen could have happened, whether police and riot units were adequately prepared, and what measures are planned to protect politicians and officials. The minister answered that the mayor and police had assessed risks as low beforehand, that the riot unit arrived in time, that a criminal investigation into a threat against a councillor is ongoing, and that guidance tools exist and the council will evaluate the events.
As usual, I cannot say whether threat and risk have given (or given cause) to take security measures in relation to the councillor and his family.
Zoals gebruikelijk kan ik geen mededelingen doen over de vraag of dreiging en risico aanleiding zijn (geweest) tot het nemen van beveiligingsmaatregelen in relatie tot het raadslid en zijn gezin.
Antwoord op vragen van het Van der Staaij over de overgang van een verzilverd ZZP naar terminale zorg thuis

An MP asked whether the Wilhelmina Hospital Assen had repeatedly been unable to arrange home or hospice deaths for patients already receiving Wlz care, and whether the Zvw/Wlz divide should be changed. The state secretary confirmed the cases, said the CIZ issued an indicatie the same day and the guidance was clarified, but refused to convert existing Wlz indications into Zvw home-care indications.
I have incorporated the clarification into the existing information card on Palliative Terminal Care (PTZ).
Ik heb de verduidelijking verwerkt in de bestaande informatiekaart Palliatief Terminale Zorg (PTZ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en De Roon over resoluties bij de Algemene Vergadering van de Verenigde Naties

MPs asked the Foreign Minister why 19 or 20 of the UN General Assembly resolutions in the 70th session target Israel, how the Netherlands voted, whether the Golan resolution language is fair, and how the UN could better address states that violate international law. The minister replied that the Netherlands pushed for balance and proportionate wording, supported 15 of 19 resolutions in EU coordination, saw many actors responsible for the Golan conflict, and pointed to resolutions on other states and the UN Human Rights Council review.
The Netherlands works in several ways to ensure that countries violating international law are called to account by the UN General Assembly.
Nederland zet zich er op verschillende manieren voor in dat landen die het internationaal recht schenden daarop worden aangesproken door de AVVN.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het besluit van de Duitse Bondsdag om nieuwe richtsnoeren over etikettering van producten uit de Westelijke Jordaanoever, Oost-Jeruzalem en de

MPs Ten Broeke, Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about the German Bundestag's reported rejection of EU labelling guidance for products from the West Bank, East Jerusalem and the Golan Heights, and whether Griechenland and Hungary also refuse to implement it. The minister says the cabinet has no knowledge of a German decision, that the Netherlands stands by its signature on the earlier letter, and that member states are expected to implement the interpretive communication, with the implementation question left to the businesses and to the member states' own deliberation.
The cabinet sees no reason to revise its position, which is based on established policy.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om zijn standpunt, dat gebaseerd is op staand beleid, te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ' Nog geen deal tussen verzekeraars en ziekenhuizen'

Mr Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the health minister why major insurers and hospitals had not concluded 2016 contracts by the 19 November deadline, what this means for insured patients and whether the NZa will enforce transparency rules. Minister Schippers answers that patients must be informed of contracted care, that the NZa supervises this, that contracting is disappointingly slow, and that she will ask the parties to take measures and discuss it at the December Bestuurlijk Overleg.
I find the pace of contracting disappointing and will ask the parties to take measures on this.
Ik vind het tempo van contracteren teleurstellend en zal partijen vragen om hierop maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het aandacht vragen voor gendercide tijdens het staatsbezoek aan China

An SGP MP asked whether the government would raise gendercide (sex-selective killing of girls and abortion) during the state visit to China, and how. The minister replied that the issue was raised in human rights consultations, with the health state secretary and in the embassy, and that China says sex disclosure is legally banned and campaigns against gendercide.
Combating violence against girls and women, including unborn girls, is one of the Netherlands' policy priorities.
Het tegengaan van geweld tegen meisjes en vrouwen, met inbegrip van ongeboren meisjes, is één van de beleidsprioriteiten van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Bruins Slot en Dik-Faber over de financiering van geestelijke begeleiding bij palliatieve zorg in de thuissituatie

MPs Van der Staaij, Bruins-Slot and Dik-Faber asked why spiritual care for terminally ill patients at home is not reimbursed under the Zvw and whether insurers are meeting their duty of care. The Secretary of State answered that spiritual guidance on religion and spirituality is not insured care, that palliative care by nurses and GPs is covered, and that Agora will be asked to inventory improvements with stakeholders.

I am not aware of any signals that health insurers are not purchasing and reimbursing the support for coping with illness and treatment, as described by the professional groups themselves within the limits of care that GPs and nurses normally provide, and are therefore failing their duty of care.

Mij zijn geen signalen bekend dat zorgverzekeraars de begeleiding bij de verwerking en het omgaan met ziekte en behandeling, zoals door de beroepsgroepen zelf beschreven binnen de grenzen van zorg zoals huisartsen en verpleegkundigen die plegen te bieden, niet inkopen en vergoeden en dus hun zorgplicht niet nakomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de handreiking ‘Zorg voor mensen die bewust afzien van eten en drinken om het levenseinde te bespoedigen’

An MP from the SGP asks the Minister of Health whether the KNMG/V&VN guidance on care for people who stop eating and drinking to hasten death wrongly treats this as a natural death rather than suicide, and whether it protects vulnerable patients, lacks legal or ethical review, and should be monitored. The Minister replies that the legal terms are undefined, that the guidance is a professional-body document not subject to government review, that current certification practice suffices, and that the 2010 mortality study estimated about 600 deaths, with a new study due in 2017.
I see no role for the government in having a guidance document drawn up by the professional group reviewed on legal or ethical grounds.
Ik zie geen taak voor de overheid om een handreiking opgesteld door de beroepsgroep te toetsen op juridische of ethische gronden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen, Oskam, Swinkels en Van Der Staaij over de geruchten dat er extra geld vrijkomt om de gaten in de begroting van Veiligheid en Justitie te dichten en de door de bezuin

MPs from SP, CDA, D66 and SGP asked whether extra money is available for the Justice and Security budget for 2016, how it would be allocated across police, prosecution, judiciary, forensics, probation and prisons, and whether it should be decoupled from the Eerste Kamer risk on fee and legal aid measures. The answer refers the MPs to the government's budget letter for the 2016 Justice and Security budget (Kamerstuk 34 300 VI, nr. 23) rather than answering each question directly.

Further answer: the written questions from MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen (both SP), Oskam (CDA), Swinkels (D66) and Van Der Staaij (SGP) have been answered by way of the letter 'Draft budget 2016 Security and Justice'.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen (beiden SP), Oskam (CDA), Swinkels (D66) en Van Der Staaij (SGP) Van Oosten (VVD) vraagnummer 2015Z21968 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Ontwerpbegroting 2016 Veiligheid en Justitie»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke en Klaveren over het bericht dat de Palestijnse Autoriteit veroordeelde Hamas terroristen heeft betaald

MPs asked whether the Palestinian Authority pays convicted Hamas terrorists, the total amounts paid, and what the government will do to press the EU to stop the policy. The minister declined to confirm the reported amounts, referred to earlier answers, said Pegase payments do not fund prisoners, and said the Netherlands will keep raising the issue bilaterally with the PA and PLO.
The cabinet cannot confirm the amounts mentioned in the news report.
Het kabinet kan de in het nieuwsbericht genoemde bedragen niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de vernietiging van kerken op Atjeh door de Indonesische politie onder druk van moslims

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the destruction of churches in Aceh under pressure from Muslim groups and the wider threat to religious freedom in Indonesia. The minister confirmed the incidents, said the Indonesian authorities condemned the violence and arrested suspects, and committed to raising the issue with his Indonesian counterpart.
This subject will be raised in my next meeting with the Indonesian Minister of Foreign Affairs.
Dit onderwerp zal in mijn eerstvolgend onderhoud met de Indonesische Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken aan de orde worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Tellegen, Van der Staaij en Oskam over een hooggeplaatst lid van ISIS

Six MPs asked ministers whether a report that a senior ISIS member was en route to the Netherlands or Germany was credible and how intelligence services had examined it. The government answered that the report closely resembles earlier media reports, that services remain vigilant, and that it cannot publicly discuss the nature of its investigations.
The cabinet cannot make public statements about the nature of the services' investigations.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over de aard van onderzoek door de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Servaes, Ten Broeke, Van Klaveren, Knops en Voordewind over “De oplaaiende terreur in Nigeria”

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about escalating attacks on civilians, many of them Christians, in Central Nigeria, the government's protection efforts, Boko Haram's trajectory, regional cooperation, humanitarian funding and gender-specific attention. The minister answered that the Middle Belt violence is largely driven by economic and land/water conflicts between herders and farmers, that Nigerian authorities have been ineffective at protecting civilians, and that Nigeria bears primary responsibility for countering Boko Haram, with Dutch support channelled through EU and humanitarian programmes.
The violence against the population makes clear that the Nigerian authorities have not been effective in protecting civilians.
De gewelddadigheden tegen de bevolking maken duidelijk dat de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten niet effectief zijn geweest in de bescherming van burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Euthanasie is geen consumptieartikel’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health about an article arguing that euthanasia requests often mask fear and loss of control, and that physicians cannot judge whether a life is meaningful, so the 'unbearable and hopeless suffering' criterion should be narrowed. The Minister answered that existential suffering can already qualify, that palliative care awareness is being raised, that physicians assess unbearable suffering from the patient's perspective rather than meaningfulness of life, and that the current definition will be kept.
I therefore see no reason to depart from the current definition.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om af te stappen de huidige definitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de aanrijtijden van ambulances in de gemeente Epe

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Health why ambulances missed the 15-minute response norm in 12.8% of cases in Epe, whether the reference framework is reliable, what the government will do about the 93% performance target for Noord- en Oost-Gelderland, and whether an ambulance post in Emst should be opened. The Minister answered that the RAV and insurers are working toward the 93% target, that the framework is not a blueprint, that the NZa is investigating insurers' duty of care, and that she cannot judge the Emst post herself.
The Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) is currently investigating how insurers fulfil their duty of care in relation to response times.
De Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) doet momenteel onderzoek naar de invulling van de zorgplicht door verzekeraars in relatie tot de aanrijdtijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over het oplaaiend geweld van Palestijnen

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the surge of Palestinian violence, President Abbas's role and silence on attacks, and Palestinian media incitement before Abbas's visit. The minister condemned attacks on Israelis, attributed the violence to lack of political perspective and largely youth-driven, social-media-organised attacks beyond Abbas's control, and said de-escalation and the issue would be raised during the visit.
During the visit, the current violence and the need for de-escalation will be discussed extensively, and it will naturally be urged that a call to renounce violence be made.
Bij het bezoek zal uitgebreid worden stilgestaan bij het huidige geweld, en de noodzaak tot de-escalatie, waarbij vanzelfsprekend ook zal worden aangedrongen op een oproep tot afzien van geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de rigide manier waarop CZ haar inkoopeisen hanteert

An MP asked the state secretary about insurer CZ refusing contracts to care providers whose statutes deviate even slightly from the Zorgbrede Governance Code, and whether this fits with court rulings, procedural fairness and deregulation. The secretary broadly supports using the code in contracting, says CZ's policy has been adjusted after talks with sector bodies, and will consult the Wlz insurers on standardising application of the code, while declining to judge what counts as minor errors.
I will therefore consult with the Wlz executing bodies/care offices to arrive at a standardised application of the ZGC within purchasing policy.
Ik zal daarom met de Wlz-uitvoerders/zorgkantoren in overleg treden om te komen tot een gestandaardiseerde toepassing van de ZGC binnen het inkoopbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘aantal vechtscheidingen groeit explosief’

An MP asked whether the government will act on reports that high-conflict divorces are rising sharply, including calls for mandatory mediation, appointment of special guardians (bijzondere curatoren), municipal responsibility under the Jeugdwet, and family group plans. The government answered that it monitors the trend but finds mandatory mediation ineffective in all cases, promised ongoing work on special guardians, municipal pilots and mediation legislation, and said the Jeugdwet choices are for municipalities.
I therefore do not consider it effective to make mediation mandatory.
Ik acht het daarom niet effectief om mediation verplicht te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat Nederlands hulpgeld wordt gebruikt om boetes van Palestijnse boeren te betalen

An SGP MP asked whether Dutch aid money was used to pay fines imposed on Palestinian farmers by Israeli authorities, how often this occurred, and under what criteria. The minister confirmed EUR 11,382 in fines paid since 2013 in three cases to release seized equipment, and said the government will continue aid in Area C despite the risk, without ending the practice.
No. Question 4: Has the Netherlands also paid fines imposed after Palestinian violence? Answer 4: No.
Vraag 4 Heeft Nederland ook boetes betaald die waren opgelegd nadat er sprake was van geweldpleging door Palestijnen?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de Beroepsorganisatie kindbehartiger

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary about the Beroepsorganisatie kindbehartiger, the profile of bijzondere curators, and whether expertise requirements and registration criteria exist. The State Secretary answered that anyone can act as bijzondere curator, that the judge decides case by case, and that the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand is developing expertise requirements expected in the first half of 2016.
The judge appoints in individual cases a bijzondere curator whom he or she considers suitable for this role.
De rechter benoemt in individuele zaken een bijzondere curator die hij of zij hiertoe geschikt acht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over het onderzoek naar de 20 wekenecho door Siriz en de NPV

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health about a survey finding that a quarter of women were not fully satisfied with information after an abnormality was detected at the 20-week scan, and about related questions on information quality, the rising share choosing the scan, and new prenatal screening. The Minister said information will be reviewed for neutrality and that the Health Council will advise on the wider screening chain by 2016, but declined further study of the information itself.
I will review the information in light of this so that it is as neutral and complete as possible.
Ik zal naar aanleiding daarvan de informatie tegen het licht houden opdat de informatie neutraal en zo volledig mogelijk is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Van der Staaij over gebruik van onderzoek naar drugsresten in rioolwater als aanvullend instrument naast andere drugsmonitoringmethoden

MPs Segers and Van der Staaij asked whether wastewater analysis for drug residues is a useful supplement to other drug monitoring methods and whether it should be deployed structurally and nationally, including for designer drugs. The state secretary replied that the method has limited added value compared with national surveys and other monitoring sources, saw no need for further research, and declined to step up its use.
I therefore see no added value in further research.
Ik zie derhalve geen toegevoegde waarde in nader onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de veiligheid van christelijke asielzoekers op Asielzoekerscentra’s (AZC’s)

Two MPs (Voordewind and Van der Staaij) asked the State Secretary about safety and intimidation of Christian asylum seekers in reception centres, including a claimed shared room and COA's implementation of Deloitte's 2011 recommendations. The State Secretary answered that COA found no hard evidence of intimidation in the individual case, that room use is regulated by COA, and that most recommendations were implemented while some (clustering groups) were not, with a follow-up plan for training and reporting.
After talks with those involved in this individual case, COA found no hard evidence of intimidation, discrimination or threats.
Het COA heeft na gesprekken met betrokkenen in dit individuele geval geen harde aanwijzingen gevonden van intimidatie, discriminatie of bedreiging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Van Oosten, Rebel, Oskam, Van Tongeren en Van der Staaij over de inzet van de Koninklijke Marechaussee bij de bestrijding van mensenhandel

MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the Royal Marechaussee's role in combating human trafficking, its legal basis in the Police Act, and more sniffer dogs for searching lorries. The minister confirmed the KMar's frequent involvement and stated that its trafficking-combating task is covered by existing police tasks, with a review of possible legal changes ongoing and some capacity measures taken.
Consultations are currently taking place between my department, the Public Prosecution Service, the police and the KMar to further improve cooperation in combating human trafficking.

Momenteel vindt er overleg plaats tussen mijn departement, het Openbaar Ministerie, de politie en de KMar om de samenwerking op het gebied van de bestrijding van mensenhandel nog verder te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de veiligheid van christelijke asielzoekers op Asielzoekerscentra's (AZC’s)

Two MPs (ChristenUnie and SGP) asked the State Secretary about the safety of Christian asylum seekers in asylum centres, following a report of intimidation by Muslim residents, and asked whether staff enforced house rules, how many religion-related incidents occurred, whether complaint reporting is effectively encouraged, and whether additional measures or research are needed. The State Secretary answered that the picture is not accurate as presented, that COA staff spoke with those involved and no sanction was imposed for lack of evidence, that complaint channels and staff training have been strengthened, and that further research is not considered necessary while COA maintains ongoing consultation with partner organisations.
COA did not impose a sanctioning measure because no indications of intimidation, discrimination or threats were found at the individual level.
Het COA heeft geen sanctionerende maatregel opgelegd omdat tot op het individuele niveau geen aanwijzingen zijn gevonden van intimidatie, discriminatie of bedreiging.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Hachchi, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de gezette stappen een jaar na de moord op de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis

MPs asked whether the government will keep pressing Libyan authorities for a thorough investigation into the murders of activists Salwa Bugaighis and Fariha Al-Barqawi, and what has been done on protecting female human rights defenders.
