The minister answers that investigations never got off the ground because Libya lacked effective central authority, that the embassy supported women's organisations and raised protection in EU, UN and bilateral settings, and that the government will raise these cases at the UN Security Council in October 2015.
The cabinet maintains that the murderers of Libyan human rights activist Salwa Bugaighis must not go unpunished and has pressed for a thorough investigation within the EU framework.
Het kabinet blijft van mening dat de moordenaars van de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis niet ongestraft mogen blijven en heeft in EU-kader aangedrongen op een gedegen onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over levensbeëindiging bij pasgeborenen

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked whether the minister sees too little attention to oversight of end-of-life decisions for newborns, the reporting of such cases to the expert committee, and the legal (fundamental-rights) dimensions. Minister Schippers answered that reporting is important but incomplete, that the regulation is being revised, that legal safeguards are clear, and that the revised regulation is expected in autumn 2015.
That is why I also announced that I would amend the Regulation.
Daarom heb ik ook aangekondigd de Regeling te zullen aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het korten van pensioenen van personen op de West bank

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked why the government will cut AOW pensions to the single-rate (50% minimum wage) for new recipients living in Israeli-occupied West Bank territory from 1 January 2016, whether Israel can lawfully bind itself to treaty obligations there, and how this squares with the 1967 borders and the Oslo framework. The government answered that Israel as occupying power cannot conclude treaties applying to the occupied territory, that existing recipients keep the 70% rate, and that the Netherlands does not recognise the territories as Israeli.

This decision will be announced and communicated as soon as possible, so that it should be clear enough what the consequences of living in Israeli-occupied territory are for the AOW benefit of single AOW recipients.

Dit besluit zal zo spoedig mogelijk worden bekendgemaakt en gecommuniceerd, waardoor het voldoende helder moet zijn welke gevolgen wonen in door Israël bezet gebied heeft voor de AOW-uitkering van alleenstaande AOW-gerechtigden.
Antwoord op vragen van het Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Zorgwekkende vragen naar gedrag kinderen’

Van der Staaij (SGP) asked whether the GGD's use of the SDQ questionnaire for parents is national policy, whether non-response has consequences, and what follow-up occurs and whether answers enter children's files. Staatssecretaris Van Rijn answered that questionnaires are advisory tools under professional guidelines, filling them in is voluntary with no consequences, and only findings prompting follow-up enter the electronic child file.
Not filling in the questionnaire has no consequences.
Het niet invullen van de vragenlijst heeft geen gevolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over het bericht dat godsdienstige minderheden in India steeds meer in de knel komen

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and De Roon asked whether attacks on religious minorities in India are rising, particularly against Christians, and what Indian authorities and the Dutch government are doing about it. The minister answered that USCIRF reports rising religious violence while official Indian figures show a drop in communal incidents, that Indian leaders have condemned such violence and arrests were made, and that the Netherlands raises religious freedom through EU and UN channels and funds local dialogue projects.
Freedom of religion and belief is a priority of the Dutch human rights policy.
Vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging is een prioriteit van het Nederlandse mensenrechtenbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat een omstreden sjeik naar Eindhoven komt

Parliamentarian Van der Staaij asked why a controversial sheikh was able to enter the Netherlands for a conference in Eindhoven despite being refused by France, and about the powers to revoke Schengen visas and residence permits on public order grounds. The government answered that Italy had withdrawn the visa, the organiser cancelled the event, and explained the legal framework for public order refusals of EU and non-EU nationals.

Because Italy, as the issuing country, withdrew the visa, the speaker mentioned in the article no longer meets the requirements for stay within the Schengen area and may no longer travel to the Netherlands.

Omdat Italië als afgevend land het visum heeft ingetrokken, voldoet de in het artikel genoemde spreker niet langer aan de vereisten voor verblijf binnen het Schengengebied en mag hij niet meer naar Nederland reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Omtzigt over de positie van christenen in Syrië

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the kidnapping of a Syrian-Christian cleric near Homs, the decline of Christian populations in Syria and Iraq under ISIS, Dutch contacts with the anti-ISIS coalition on Christian protection, and whether the international community will act. The minister confirmed the kidnapping, gave rough population estimates, said the Netherlands raises the issue through all channels and within the coalition, and described pluralism-oriented political work without committing to a new concrete step.
Precise figures for the current number of Christians in Syria and Iraq are not available.
Precieze cijfers van het huidige aantal christenen in Syrië en Irak zijn niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over mogelijke wapenleveranties aan Boko Haram via Turkish Airlines

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister how to assess alleged arms transports to Nigeria via Turkish Airlines, a leaked call, and UNODC findings on arms trafficking, and whether the government would verify the call or seek independent investigation. The minister answered that the government cannot verify the recording, will not speculate on unconfirmed reports, declined to raise it with Turkey, and will only generally urge research into how Boko Haram obtains weapons.
There is too little confirmed information to justify a Dutch diplomatic intervention, in a matter that primarily concerns the relationship between Turkey and Nigeria.
Er is te weinig bevestigde informatie om een Nederlandse diplomatieke interventie te rechtvaardigen, in een zaak die primair de relatie tussen Turkije en Nigeria betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het afdwingen van euthanasie bij patiënten die volgens de behandelend arts wilsonbekwaam zijn

Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the health minister how a physician who barely knows a patient can override the treating doctors' judgement on the patient's competence in a request for euthanasia, and whether such cases occur. Minister Schippers answered that no specific cases are known, that competence is assessed per decision, that courts found the patient competent in a specific case, and that the regional review committees are bound by secrecy so the specific assessment cannot be disclosed.
Article 14 of the Termination of Life on Request and Assisted Suicide Act states that the regional review committees are bound to secrecy.
Artikel 14 van de Wtl stelt dat de Rte tot geheimhouding zijn verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke en Voordewind over het bericht dat alleen Israël door de World Health Organization is veroordeeld voor het schenden van gezondheidsrechten

Three MPs (Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Voordewind) asked why the WHO assembly adopted a resolution singling out Israel's health conditions in occupied territories and whether the Netherlands backed it. The minister answered that the decision was a compromise, all EU states voted for it, the US, Canada and Australia opposed it, and that the Netherlands favours non-politicised WHO texts and supports phasing out country-specific resolutions.
Where possible, the Netherlands therefore works within the EU framework for balanced, non-politicised texts and advocates within the EU for phasing out these resolutions and decisions.
Nederland zet zich waar mogelijk in EU-kader dan ook in voor gebalanceerde, niet-politiserende teksten en pleit in EU-kader voor uitfasering van deze resoluties en besluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dijkgraaf over verminderde douanecontrole, beveiliging en patrouilles op de Waddenzee en op de Westerschelde

Two SGP MPs asked whether reduced customs, marechaussee and police patrols on the Wadden Sea and Western Scheldt weaken interdiction of drugs and smuggling, and whether RHIB boats and port checks are adequate. The government replied that patrols are not being halted but shifted to intelligence-led, faster-response boats, that port controls continue 24/7, and that it sees no need for continuous patrols; it did not register controls or tips in a way that allows measuring their results.
This is not correct. Checks continue unchanged in the Zeeland ports of Terneuzen and Vlissingen.
Dit is niet juist. In de Zeeuwse havens Terneuzen en Vlissingen vinden onverminderd controles plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het korten van het pensioen van een holocaustoverlevende, omdat zij woont op de West Bank

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked why a Dutch Holocaust survivor's AOW pension was cut after she moved to the West Bank, and whether it would be reversed and prevented in future. The government answered that the cut was based on the Wet BEU and Israel's lack of treaty competence in occupied territory, that the SVB has reversed the decision, and that people living in occupied areas will keep 70% AOW from now on, while from 1 January 2016 new single residents there will get the 50% rate.
The cabinet regrets how matters unfolded. For the person concerned, the situation has now been corrected and she has been informed of this.
Het kabinet betreurt de gang van zaken. Voor betrokkene is de situatie nu aangepast en zij is daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het lot van Pakistaanse vluchtelingen in Thailand

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked about arbitrary detention of Pakistani asylum seekers and refugees in Thailand, including children, and Thailand's treatment of them under the Child Rights Convention. Minister Koenders answered that Thailand treats all refugees alike under immigration law, that the Netherlands raises rights violations with Thai authorities and accepted 38 Pakistani refugees for resettlement, and that UNHCR is aware of long waiting times.
The Netherlands, including within the EU, regularly raises the deteriorating human rights situation in contacts with the Thai authorities.
NL brengt, o.a. in EU-verband, de verslechterende mensenrechtensituatie met regelmaat op in contacten met Thaise autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over labeling van producten uit Israëlische steden op de Westelijke Jordaanoever

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked whether 16 EU member states want products from Israeli settlements on the West Bank labelled, what their request to Mogherini means, why the Netherlands supported it, and whether labelling harms trade and the peace process. The minister answered that the request concerns correct labelling of settlement products as consumer information rather than a boycott or import ban, that the Netherlands opposes boycotts, and that the Netherlands continues to promote a two-state solution through negotiations.
The Netherlands' co-signing of this reminder letter fits existing cabinet policy.
Mede-ondertekening door Nederland van deze herhalingsbrief past in het staande kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de komst van radicale sjeiks naar Utrecht

An SGP MP asked whether radical preachers were given a platform in Utrecht, whether one was convicted for inhuman treatment and another linked to the Hofstad investigation, whether visas, permits and Schengen travel restrictions apply, and how they are monitored. The government answered that the local tripartite found no criminal or administrative ground to act, that one speaker was not present, that a visa was issued only to one visa-required speaker, that the event needed no permit, and that visa withdrawal and criminal prosecution remain available, so no change to Schengen rules is planned.

The local tripartite in Utrecht, based on police investigation and consultation with the National Coordinator for Counterterrorism and Security (NCTV), concluded there was no criminal or administrative ground to act.

De lokale driehoek in Utrecht heeft op basis van politieonderzoek en na overleg met de Nationaal Coördinator Terrorismebestrijding en Veiligheid (NCTV) de conclusie getrokken dat er geen strafrechtelijke of bestuurlijke grond was om op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het dwingen van vrouwen om een abortus te doen plegen

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Health whether pressuring women into abortion is permitted, what criminal law applies, how the Public Prosecution Service handles such cases, and whether the government will take measures to prevent coerced abortions. The Minister answered that coercion is undesirable and that the abortion law requires voluntary, informed decisions, but that the criminal code has no specific provision and she sees no need for additional measures.
The Public Prosecution Service will have to determine, on the basis of a report, whether a criminal offence has taken place.
Het Openbaar Ministerie zal aan de hand van een aangifte moeten bepalen of er sprake is geweest van een strafbaar feit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de NIP-test (ingezonden 10 april 2015)

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked the health minister about the societal effects of NIPT prenatal screening, its proportionality, counselling safeguards and abortion rates after Down syndrome diagnoses. The minister answered that an implementation study runs until April 2016, a Health Council advice on prenatal screening is expected in 2016, counselling and voluntary choice safeguards exist, and that the 2013 abortion data does not record diagnoses.
Furthermore, I have asked the Health Council for advice on the entire prenatal screening chain and the role and place of new developments therein.
Verder heb ik de Gezondheidsraad om advies gevraagd over de gehele prenatale screeningsketen en de rol en plaats van nieuwe ontwikkelingen daarin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Sjoerdsma en Van der Staaij over de uitgifte van Turkse paspoorten aan jihadgangers. Deze vragen werden ingezonden op 15 april 2015

MPs asked whether reports that over 100,000 Turkish passports were given to ISIS fighters, and that around 50,000 Uyghurs joined ISIS through a loophole in Turkish law, are true, and what Turkey does with detained jihadists and to prevent departures. The minister said the government has no independent information to verify the claims, that Dutch jihadists are removed from Turkey after procedures with Dutch authorities informed, and that Turkey cooperates with origin countries and in the anti-ISIS coalition working group.
The cabinet does not have independent information to verify the claims in this article.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie om de beweringen in dit artikel te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Laar over moderne slavernij en kinderarbeid in de kledingindustrie in India

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and Van Laar asked the government about modern slavery and child labour in the South Indian textile industry, including reported deaths and abuse of girls under the Sumangali scheme, and what Dutch action is planned. The minister answered that the embassy and industry are engaged in multi-stakeholder initiatives, the MVO conference will explore EU-level supply chain measures, and the ILO and OECD frameworks are used to press India on forced and child labour standards.
Once the initiative takes firm shape, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs will consider how this initiative can be supported.
Zodra het initiatief vaste vormen aanneemt, zal het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken bezien op welke manier dit initiatief ondersteund kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Van Haersma Buma, Slob, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Roemer over het bed, bad, brood compromis

MPs from several parties asked the government to explain its reliance on the Council of Europe's Committee of Ministers resolution rejecting the ECSR findings on basic provision for irregular migrants, the conditional 'bed, bath, bread' shelter scheme tied to return cooperation, the funding and sanction mechanism for municipalities, and the buitenschuld permit system. The government answered that the ECSR findings have no basis in the treaty, that Article 3 ECHR sets the floor, that shelter in pre-VBL locations will be time-limited and tied to return efforts, and that details will be settled with the VNG.
It is not for the ECSR to pronounce on the rights of persons residing illegally in our country.
Het is dan ook niet aan het ECSR om zich uit te spreken over de rechten van illegaal in ons land verblijvende personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de actuele situatie in Nigeria in het licht van de gehouden verkiezingen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the outcome of Nigeria's 2015 elections, the outlook for Boko Haram, humanitarian aid and EU support. The minister answered that the elections were broadly credible, that policy effects cannot yet be assessed before Buhari's inauguration, and that Nigeria bears primary responsibility, with the EU and Netherlands pressing via dialogue and development programmes.
It is difficult at this moment to make a careful assessment of the policy consequences of the outcome.
Het is moeilijk om op dit moment een zorgvuldige inschatting te maken van de beleidsinhoudelijke gevolgen van de uitslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Servaes, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma en De Roon over het nucleair akkoord met Iran

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the framework nuclear deal with Iran, covering its assessment, the timing of sanctions relief, regional effects, human rights, EU and Dutch contributions, and prospects before the 30 June deadline. The minister welcomed the framework, said sanctions relief will be tied to Iranian steps and reinstated if Iran breaches the deal, and answered several questions only in general terms while leaving the concrete sequencing and any full assessment for later.
The cabinet will send a written response on the various aspects of the comprehensive agreement to the House once it is definitively concluded.
Het kabinet zal een schriftelijke reactie op de verschillende deelaspecten van het alomvattend akkoord naar de Kamer sturen als dit definitief is gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Aantal abortussen in Duitsland weer gedaald’

An SGP MP asked the health minister why German abortions fell 25% over ten years while Dutch numbers did not, and whether Dutch policy should change to reduce abortions, including counselling and waiting-period issues. The minister said the causes of the German decline are unknown, saw no need for extra measures, pointed to existing counselling guidance, and declined to bring forward the abortion-motives study due in 2016.
I do not intend to take additional measures.
Ik ben niet voornemens om extra maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Rebel en Van der Staaij over de rokende gokker

MPs asked why Holland Casino expanded and made attractive smoking rooms with gambling machines, whether this is lawful and consistent with anti-smoking policy, and whether the government will change it. The government answered that such rooms are lawful under the Tabakswet provided the NVWA's criteria are met, that the offer should not be more attractive than outside the room, and agreed to talk with Holland Casino about a prevention pledge.
Smoking rooms, however, are exempt from the smoking ban, and the way Holland Casino has set up its smoking rooms does not conflict with the rules on this.
Rookruimten zijn echter uitgezonderd van het rookverbod en de manier waarop Holland Casino haar rookruimten heeft ingericht is niet strijdig met de regels daaromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het oordeel ‘onzorgvuldig’ door de toetsingscommissies euthanasie

An MP asks why the regional euthanasia review committees again judged a Levenseindekliniek euthanasia case 'onzorgvuldig' and whether the committees overstep by nuancing that judgment, and asks the government to act against the clinic and order an independent investigation. The minister replies that the committees only assess compliance with the statutory due-care criteria, that the case has been referred to the IGZ and the Public Prosecution Service which must decide independently, and that she sees no grounds for measures or an independent investigation at this stage.
In view of this, I refrain from giving a judgment.
Gelet hierop onthoud ik mij van een oordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de handhaving van het verbod op illegale gokzuilen

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about enforcing the ban on illegal gambling machines in cafes, including municipal powers, enforcement by the Gaming Authority and the Public Prosecution Service, and the Gaming Authority's capacity. The State Secretary answered that municipalities enforce primarily under administrative law, that cooperation with the Gaming Authority and prosecutors is ongoing, and that the Gaming Authority has sufficient capacity, while stating prosecutors keep no figures on their interventions.
The Public Prosecution Service does not have figures on the number of cases in which the OM intervenes.
Het OM beschikt niet over cijfers met betrekking tot het aantal gevallen waarin het OM optreedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slob, Van der Staaij en Wilders over de herdenking van de Armeense genocide

MPs Slob, Van der Staaij and Wilders asked whether the cabinet still backs the Rouvoet motion urging Turkey's recognition of the Armenian genocide, given the minister's view that history is not for the cabinet to interpret, and whether a minister would attend the 100-year commemoration in Armenia or in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the cabinet maintains the motion's supportive interpretation and that the Dutch ambassador to Georgia, also accredited to Armenia, will attend the Armenia commemoration, with attendance at other events decided case by case.
The cabinet maintains the interpretation that previous cabinets have given to the motion.
Het kabinet handhaaft de interpretatie die voorgaande kabinetten aan de motie hebben gegeven

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over grootschalig onderzoek van Unesco (Organisatie van de Verenigde Naties voor Onderwijs, Wetenschap en Cultuur) waaruit blijkt dat de Holocaust wereldwijd in schoolboeken

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government views a UNESCO study finding that the Holocaust is widely ignored in school textbooks, what follow-up UNESCO plans, whether the Netherlands will push for action, and whether it will address the Palestinian territories. The minister answered that the Netherlands values Holocaust education, will raise the report in the IHRA and with UNESCO's Director-General, and that the government raises the issue in bilateral contacts with the Palestinian authorities.

The Dutch Permanent Representative to UNESCO will, following publication of this report, urge the UNESCO Director-General to pursue follow-up research and sustained efforts to promote Holocaust education.

De Nederlandse Permanente Vertegenwoordiger bij Unesco zal naar aanleiding van het verschijnen van dit rapport bij de Directeur-Generaal van Unesco aandringen op vervolgonderzoek en blijvende inspanning om Holocaust-educatie te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Servaes en Sjoerdsma over De ontvoering van tenminste 150 Syrische christenen

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, PvdA and D66 asked the Foreign Minister about the reported abduction of at least 150 Syrian Christians by ISIS, about Dutch military and material support to Kurdish forces in Iraq, how minority protection is built into the anti-ISIS strategy, and how the international community could secure the hostages' release. The minister answered that Dutch support (helmets, vests, instructor teams, humanitarian aid) is aimed at training Peshmerga who protect all civilians, that inclusiveness and minority protection are addressed in training and EU policy, and that no ground options exist for freeing the hostages, while about twenty had been released.
Yes. Question 2: What material and military support has the Netherlands by now given to the Kurds in Iraq?
Ja. Vraag 2 Welke materiële en militaire steun heeft Nederland inmiddels gegeven aan de Koerden in Irak?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Imams hebben visum voor benefiet in Rijswijk al binnen’

An SGP MP asked whether imams invited to a Rijswijk event had already received visas, whether visas could be refused or withdrawn for radical preachers, and whether criteria should be tightened and EU-level action taken. The government confirmed three visas were withdrawn on public order grounds, said current Schengen criteria suffice, and saw no reason to tighten them or raise the issue in the EU.
I see no reason to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Van der Staaij over de fouten die zijn gemaakt in de zaak Van U.

MPs Recourt and Van der Staaij asked the Minister of Justice and Security about errors in the Van U case, including whether civil-law measures and broader psychiatric-detention options were considered, and whether dangerous suspects are being released pending appeal. The minister replied that an independent commission has been set up by the College of Procurators-General to investigate the DNA sampling, enforcement of pre-trial detention and BOPZ detention, and that it will answer these questions in its outcome, expected before the summer recess.
The College of Procurators-General asked the commission to establish the facts and circumstances surrounding the DNA sampling of the suspect after his conviction(s) in 2012.
Het College van Procureurs-generaal heeft de commissie gevraagd de feiten en omstandigheden te achterhalen rond de afname van het DNA van verdachte na zijn veroordeling(en) in 2012
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de sluiting van een theologische hogeschool in Jakarta

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister about the closure of a theological college in Jakarta, whether the embassy had mediated, and what the implications are for religious freedom in Indonesia and bilateral relations. The minister answered that the dispute appears non-religious, concerning a missing permit and a municipal relocation order, that the Netherlands raises religious minority issues regularly with Indonesia, and that there are no consequences for bilateral relations.
Based on the above information, this case appears to be a non-religiously motivated dispute between the school and the local authorities.
Op basis van bovengenoemde informatie lijkt in dit geval sprake te zijn van een niet-religieus gemotiveerd geschil tussen de school en de lokale autoriteiten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Roemer, Van Haersma Buma, Wilders, Pechtold, Slob, Van Ojik en Van der Staaij naar aanleiding van zijn uitspraken tijdens het debat op 14 januari jl. over de aanslagen in Parijs

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister whether his remark that the AIVD, with current staffing and funding, can do its job was meant regarding jihadism, how many staff track returnees, whether budget cuts reduced coverage and staff quality, and how police, mayors and national government coordinate. The government replied that all eleven questions were already answered in an earlier letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 288), without giving substance in this document.
The written questions ... have been answered by letter 'extra measures counterterrorism and following the debate of 14 January 2015 on the Paris attacks' (Kamerstuk 29 754, no. 288).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «extra maatregelen terrorismebestrijding en n.a.v. debat op 14 januari 2015 over de aanslagen in Parijs» (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 288 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over rapportages waaruit blijkt dat de EU honderden woningen laat verrijzen voor Palestijnen in de zogenaamde C-gebieden op de West Bank

Two MPs asked whether EU-funded housing structures for Palestinians in Area C of the West Bank are lawful and whether the EU is creating facts on the ground, and whether it will stop cooperating. The minister said the EU supports humanitarian needs of Palestinian and Bedouin communities facing demolitions, that no new facts are created since the people already lived there, and rejected calling on the EU to stop.
Do you see reason to raise these alleged illegal structures in European context and to promote that the EU immediately stops its cooperation in creating facts on the ground, if proven?

Ziet u aanleiding om genoemde illegale bouwwerken in Europees verband aan te kaarten en te bevorderen dat de EU onmiddellijk haar medewerking, indien bewezen, aan het creëren van feiten op de grond stopt?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over doodstraf op importeren bijbel in Saoedi-Arabië

An MP from the SGP asked the Foreign Minister whether Saudi Arabia had adopted a law imposing the death penalty for importing the Bible, what the consequences would be for Christians, and whether the government would press Saudi authorities on freedom of religion. The minister replied that the report appears to be a misunderstanding, that the cited law is over 30 years old, and that no new legislation exists, so no separate démarche is planned beyond raising religious freedom generally.
Since there does not appear to be any new legislation, I see no reason to raise this with Saudi Arabia.
Aangezien er geen sprake lijkt te zijn van nieuwe wetgeving zie ik geen aanleiding om Saoedi-Arabië hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Bruins Slot en Van der Staaij over de toekomst van het landelijk centrum De Riethorst voor geestelijke gezondheidszorg voor doven en slechthorenden

MPs asked the minister when she would talk with De Riethorst, why doven-ggz is funded differently from general institutions, whether max-max tariffs suffice, and whether an emergency fix like GGMD's can keep the unit open. The minister replied that insurers bear responsibility for access, that she will talk with insurers and commission an NZa study on funding, and that she sees no reason for extra transition measures.
It is not for me to intervene in that.
Het is niet aan mij om daarin te interveniëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over een onderzoek onder artsen over de morele belasting van de uitvoering van euthanasie

An MP asked the minister about a survey showing doctors feel moral strain and pressure from patients and relatives when performing euthanasia, and whether the public wrongly sees euthanasia as an enforceable right. The minister acknowledged the emotional burden and pressure, said there is no right to euthanasia, pointed to existing information and a national palliative care programme, and promised further awareness initiatives with stakeholders.
The law states that doctors are not obliged to grant a request and that the doctor must be convinced the request meets the legal due-care criteria.
De wet stelt dat artsen niet verplicht zijn om een verzoek in te willigen en dat de arts overtuigd moet zijn dat het verzoek voldoet aan de wettelijke zorgvuldigheidscriteria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de Open Doors ranglijst christenvervolging 2015

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the Open Doors 2015 ranking of Christian persecution, whether religious freedom should get more weight in foreign policy, whether a thematic country report on Nigeria, Kenya and China would be prepared, and whether more countries would be added to the religious freedom pilot. The minister answered that religious freedom is a priority and that the pilot countries, with an evaluation to follow in the 2014 human rights report, may be adjusted depending on the outcome, while declining a thematic report for Kenya and China, citing low asylum inflow.
Depending on the outcome of the evaluation, it will be examined whether countries are added to or removed from the pilot.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomst van de evaluatie zal bekeken worden of landen aan de pilot worden toegevoegd of verwijderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat Hamas mogelijk van de Europese terreurlijst verdwijnt

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Hamas might be removed from the EU terrorist list after a General Court ruling, and whether the designation was based on media reports. The minister answered that the court annulled the listing on procedural grounds but kept its effects for three months, so Hamas remains listed for now, that the Council may appeal or re-list, and that the government will work with other member states to address the defects.
The General Court decided to annul the listing on procedural grounds.
Het Gerecht heeft besloten de plaatsing op de lijst nietig te verklaren, wegens procedurele gebreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de vernieling van diverse kerken in Khartoum door het regime in Sudan

Three MPs asked the foreign minister about the demolition of churches in Khartoum, arrests of church members, a claimed ban on new church construction, and whether the government would protest and seek further sanctions. The minister confirmed awareness, explained the seizures as stemming from a land dispute and missing permits, said the ban was announced in 2012 and is unclear in writing, and stated the Netherlands raises religious freedom bilaterally and in EU and UN fora but sees no current plans for new sanctions.
Freedom of religion and belief is one of the priorities of Dutch human rights policy; the cabinet therefore rejects any obstacle a government places on people in practising their faith.

Vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging is een van de speerpunten van het Nederlandse mensenrechtenbeleid, elke belemmering die een overheid aan mensen oplegt in de uitvoering van hun geloof keurt het kabinet daarom af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Servaes, Ten Broeke over doodschieten van Papoea's door de Indonesische politie

Seven MPs asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about reports that Indonesian police or soldiers shot dead five Papuans during a protest, and what the Netherlands would do. The Minister said the government deeply regrets the deaths, that Indonesia has launched an inquiry, that he will raise it with his counterpart, and that the Netherlands supports community policing and human rights training in Papua.
The Indonesian authorities immediately launched an investigation into the circumstances.
De Indonesische autoriteiten hebben direct een onderzoek naar de toedracht ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Van Bommel en Ten Broeke over de positie van Pakistaanse minderheden

Five MPs asked the government about the position of religious minorities in Pakistan, including reported lynchings of Christians, a judge's apparent embrace of a blasphemy-case killer, and whether Pakistani Christians should be treated as an asylum risk group. The minister acknowledges rising violence against minorities, notes Dutch and EU pressure on Pakistan over blasphemy laws and minority protection, and says the State Secretary will review the new country report for possible changes to asylum policy.
The State Secretary for Security and Justice will examine whether the information in the thematic country report gives cause for changes to the current asylum policy for Pakistani Christians.
De Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie zal bezien of de informatie in het thematisch ambtsbericht aanleiding geeft tot aanpassingen in het huidige asielbeleid voor Pakistaanse christenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Van Bommel over de demonstratie tegen de plaatsing van het Armeens herdenkingsmonument

MPs asked the government about a demonstration against an Armenian genocide memorial in Almelo, alleged Turkish state involvement, verification of claims, and whether the government will take a clearer stance on the commemoration. The government answered that there was no direct Turkish state involvement in the demonstration, that it has raised the matter with Turkish authorities, that it does not keep lists of all contacts, and that it sees no need for special research, while declining to say when the prosecutor will decide on the complaints.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed the Ministry of Security and Justice that it cannot currently give certainty about when the assessment of the complaint will be completed.
Het openbaar ministerie heeft het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie meegedeeld dat het nu geen uitsluitsel kan geven over het moment waarop de beoordeling van de aangifte zal zijn afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de vuurwerkopslag in Heerde

Three MPs (Oskam, Dik-Faber, Van der Staaij) asked whether a fireworks storage facility in Heerde close to a care centre and supermarket is safe, and whether other veiligheidsregio's should inventory similar risks. The state secretary replied that the Vuurwerkbesluit's construction requirements, sprinklers and fire resistance keep the effects of any calamity within the storage facility, declined to order a nationwide inventory, and described the uniform incident-response approach.
As I indicated in the answer to question 1, the consequences of any calamity are limited to the storage facility itself.
Zoals ik in het antwoord op vraag 1 heb aangegeven, beperken de gevolgen van een eventuele calamiteit zich tot de bewaarplaats zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Van der Staaij over illegaal draagmoederschap

MPs Arib and Van der Staaij asked about illegal surrogacy, including enforcement by the prosecution service, whether the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming can track children born through surrogacy, a reporting structure, and screening of surrogates and intended parents. The government answered that it sees no reason to tighten enforcement, a reporting structure or screening now, deferring these questions to the Staatscommissie Herijking Ouderschap due mid-2016.
On this basis I see no reason to ask the Public Prosecution Service to tighten the current enforcement policy on surrogacy or to give it more priority with the police.

Ik zie op basis hiervan geen aanleiding het Openbaar Ministerie te verzoeken het huidige handhavingsbeleid ten aanzien van draagmoederschap aan te scherpen of het meer prioriteit te geven bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, De Roon, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Thieme en Van Klaveren over Beschuldiging van Turkse wapenleveranties aan terroristische organisaties

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about allegations that Turkey supplied arms to jihadist groups including IS, and about reports of recruitment centres and a prisoner swap. The minister said the government could not confirm the allegations, relied on Turkey's denials and its IS listing, and declined to seek clarification from Turkey or back an independent international inquiry.
The cabinet is aware of these reports, as is the House, but, as indicated in earlier answers to parliamentary questions, cannot confirm them.
Het kabinet is net als de Kamer op de hoogte van deze berichten, maar kan, zoals ook in eerdere antwoorden op Kamervragen aangegeven, deze niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Voordewind, De Roon, Servaes, Ten Broeke en Van Bommel over het doodvonnis van Asia Bibi

Six MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the Pakistani appeal court's upholding of Asia Bibi's death sentence, what remaining appeal options exist, and what Dutch and international steps can prevent execution. The minister said the government deeply regrets the ruling, outlined the appeal path to the Pakistani Supreme Court, and listed bilateral and EU advocacy, embassy actions and planned follow-up without committing to a specific new step.

The Netherlands will continue to raise the case of Ms Asia Bibi, the blasphemy legislation and the death penalty with the Pakistani authorities at every opportunity, both bilaterally and within the EU.

Nederland zal bij iedere voorkomende gelegenheid bij de Pakistaanse autoriteiten aandacht blijven vragen voor mevrouw Asia Bibi, de blasfemiewetgeving en de doodstraf, zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke en Omtzigt over ‘Gaza met onmiddellijke ingang onder controle van Hamas en Fatah’

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Hamas and Fatah would jointly govern Gaza, and about whether Dutch or EU funds could reach Hamas through Palestinian Authority salaries and prisoner payments. The minister answered that there is no joint budget, that Qatari one-off payments are not salaries, that EU-funded civil servant lists are unchanged, and that the prisoner payment rules remain duration-based, with the Netherlands continuing to press for reform.
The money concerns Qatar, not the EU or the Netherlands.
Het betreft geld van Qatar, niet van de EU of NL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Bruins Slot en Van der Staaij over afspraken tussen supermarkten over het weren van effectieve controlesystemen handhaving alcoholleeftijd

MPs asked the state secretary whether supermarkets agreed to exclude effective age-verification systems for alcohol sales, whether this is unacceptable, what the government knew and what it has done about alcohol-age enforcement compliance (around 50%). The state secretary answered that it is up to supermarkets to choose their approach, that the ACM has not closed its investigation into possible prohibited agreements, that the government is monitoring compliance and is reluctant to impose systems, and that a pilot did not improve compliance.
The ministry is not aware of unlawful agreements between supermarkets.
Het ministerie is niet bekend met ongeoorloofde afspraken tussen supermarkten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het grote aantal abortussen waarbij sprake is van financiële redenen

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked the health minister about the large share of abortions with financial motives and whether the government would act on it. The minister answered that no extra measures are planned, that the woman decides on the emergency, and that a ZonMW study on abortion motives is expected in mid-2016.
It is not mandatory for the treating physician to register and report the nature of the emergency situation.
Het is niet verplicht voor de behandelend arts om de aard van de noodsituatie te registreren en te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de tweede berisping in korte tijd voor de Levenseindekliniek

An SGP MP asked the health minister about a second reprimand in a short period for the Levenseindekliniek, including whether the physician properly established unbearable suffering and what measures could be taken. The minister declined to judge pending IGZ and OM proceedings, noted a guidance document on written declarations is being prepared, and said no additional measures were warranted for now, while outlining IGZ's enforcement powers.
Both bodies, within their own competences, have the task of further investigating the matter and taking a decision on that basis.
Beide instanties hebben binnen hun eigen bevoegdheid de taak om de zaak verder te onderzoeken en naar aanleiding daarvan een beslissing te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht Christenen in Irak vluchten voor ISIS

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked whether ISIS targets Christians in Mosul and whether the Netherlands would follow France in admitting them as refugees, possibly via the UNHCR quota. Minister Teeven confirmed the persecution, said the Netherlands does not operate asylum-on-the-post policy, deferred any Iraq-specific asylum decision until a new country report, and said the resettlement quota for 2015 will follow UNHCR priorities while humanitarian aid is increased.
In the short term the Minister of Foreign Affairs will issue a general country report on Iraq.
Op korte termijn wordt door de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken een algemeen ambtsbericht Irak uitgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Van Bommel over de demonstratie op 1 juni tegen het Armeens herdenkingsmonument in Almelo

MPs from several parties asked the government about a June 2014 demonstration in Almelo against an Armenian genocide memorial, including alleged Turkish state involvement, slogans, and whether the Turkish consul or Diyanet mosques were involved. The government answered that the claims could not be verified in several cases, that demonstration rights were respected, that a criminal complaint was under assessment by the Public Prosecution Service, and that the issue would be considered in a separate parallel-communities study.
The cabinet is aware of these reports, but they could not be verified.
Deze berichtgeving is het kabinet bekend, maar deze was niet te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Omtzigt over zware aanklacht tegen Iraanse voorganger

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest and possible death-penalty charge against Iranian pastor Matthias Haghnejad, and about the persecution of Iranian Christians and EU action on religious freedom. The minister replied that the facts of the charge are not yet known, that the government shares concern and monitors the case, and that Nederland and the EU raise religious freedom with Iran bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN Universal Periodic Review, while acknowledging that individual cases are better addressed at EU level.
Nothing has been made public about the background of the charge.
Over de achtergrond van de aanklacht is niets bekend gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over een richtlijn over het bespreken van alternatieven voor abortus door huisartsen

Parliamentary member Van der Staaij asked whether GPs should have a guideline and legal duty to inform women with unwanted pregnancies about alternatives to abortion, given that six in ten are referred to abortion clinics by GPs. Minister Schippers replied that the legal duty to inform on alternatives applies to clinics and hospitals rather than GPs, but that GPs play an important role, pointed to existing tools (a Fiom/NHG quickscan and an NGvA guideline) and said a handling protocol for GPs and specialists is being developed.
For the GP, such obligations are not included in the regulations.
Voor de huisarts zijn dergelijke verplichtingen niet opgenomen in de regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Van der Staaij en Omtzigt over de Gaza-demonstratie van 24 juli 2014 in Den Haag

Three MPs asked the ministers about the Gaza demonstration in The Hague on 24 July 2014, including whether it was properly notified, whether police and prosecutors acted on antisemitic chants, threats to journalists, and display of ISIS flags. The government answered that the demonstration was notified as required with 50 expected participants, referred to answers given to related questions, and stated the prosecution's position that displaying IS and Hamas flags is punishable under the Penal Code.

The position is that IS (formerly ISIS/ISIL) and Hamas, banned as terrorist organisations by the EU and UN aiming at violence against certain population groups, public display of their flags constitutes a criminal offence in the prosecution's view under Articles 137d and 137c of the Penal Code.

Het standpunt houdt in dat nu IS (voorheen ISIS/ISIL) en Hamas (door de EU en de VN) verboden, terroristische organisaties zijn die tot doel hebben geweld te plegen tegen bepaalde bevolkingsgroepen, het in het openbaar tonen van deze vlaggen van deze organisaties naar het oordeel van het Openbaar Ministerie strafbaarheid oplevert
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en De Roon over de uitspraken van de Turkse premier Erdogan inzake het handelen van Israël in Gaza

Three MPs (Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon) asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemned Turkish PM Erdogan's comparisons of Israel's conduct in Gaza to Hitler, whether he would summon the Turkish ambassador, seek EU support against Turkey, suspend EU accession talks, or reconsider the Patriot mission. The minister answered that the remarks were regrettable, that summoning the ambassador was unnecessary, that accession talks remain the best lever, and that the Patriot mission fulfils NATO solidarity.
The cabinet does not consider it necessary to summon the Turkish ambassador specifically for this.
Het kabinet vindt het niet nodig specifiek hiervoor de Turkse ambassadeur te ontbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Van der Staaij over het verbieden van festivals waar niet krachtig tegen drugsgebruik wordt opgetreden

MPs Bisschop and Van der Staaij asked whether festivals with drug problems should keep receiving permits and what legal grounds exist to refuse or revoke them. The government answered that no national rules set permit conditions, that municipalities may refuse permits only where drug use would likely cause public order or health problems, and that some municipalities already attach anti-drug conditions.
The suspicion of drug use in itself is not a ground for refusal.
Het vermoeden van drugsgebruik op zich is geen weigeringsgrond.
Antwoord op vragen van de de leden Omtzigt, Van Haersma Buma, Voordewind, Slob en Van der Staaij over IS(IS) en de situatie in Irak

Members of parliament from the CDA, ChristenUnie and SGP asked the government about the humanitarian emergency facing Yazidis and Christians fleeing IS in Iraq, US airstrikes and genocide claims, and whether Dutch and EU action is adequate. The minister answered that the government supports US aid to Iraq, has given an extra 400,000 euro via the Red Cross, is examining airlift support through defence, and is pressing for a unity government in Baghdad.

In response to the current humanitarian crisis, the cabinet has decided to immediately provide an extra 400,000 euro via the Netherlands Red Cross to the International Red Cross for emergency aid in Iraq.

Naar aanleiding van de huidige humanitaire crisis heeft het kabinet besloten onverwijld een extra bijdrage van 400 000 Euro via het Nederlandse Rode Kruis te geven aan het Internationale Rode Kruis ten behoeve van noodhulp in Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Omtzigt over de dramatisch zorgelijke situatie van christenen in Mosul

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about threats by ISIS against Christians in Mosul, how such groups can be protected, and whether a safe haven could be created and the issue raised at the UN General Assembly. The minister answered that minorities' rights are a priority, cited UN Security Council and UNAMI calls for accountability, ISIS UN sanctions, EU aid, and said a political solution in Iraq is needed, without committing to a specific new step.
Both the protection of minority rights and freedom of religion or belief are priority subjects of Dutch foreign policy.
Zowel bescherming van de rechten van minderheden als vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging zijn prioritaire onderwerpen van het Nederlands buitenlands beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Gesthuizen, Maij en Schouw over de opvang van Syrische vluchtelingen

MPs from five parties asked the State Secretary about the timing of resettling Syrian refugees from Amman and Beirut, whether pending refugees face unexplained delays, and whether a Article 1F exclusion risk affects some cases. The government answered that the arrivals fall under the regular quota, that the standard six-month preparation period applies, that more than 250 Syrians have been accepted, and that UNHCR nominations are assessed case by case for Article 1F risk.
It is the standard procedure in resettlement that refugees arrive in the Netherlands no later than 6 months after acceptance.
Het is de standaard procedure bij hervestiging dat vluchtelingen uiterlijk 6 maanden na acceptatie naar Nederland komen

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Van Klaveren over het uiten van extreme geweldsdreigementen en het plegen van daadwerkelijk terroristisch geweld tegen (de Joodse inwoners van) Israël door te

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and Van Klaveren asked whether Fatah officials and affiliated groups calling for violence and firing rockets at Israel should be treated as terrorism, whether the Palestinian Authority is responsible, and whether EU and Dutch funding and cooperation should be halted. Minister Timmermans answered that these are not formal Fatah statements, that Fatah is a political movement that renounced violence, and that suspending cooperation is not on the table, while pledging to raise the issue at the EU Foreign Affairs Council.
No. Fatah is a political movement that has renounced violence.
Nee. Fatah is een politieke beweging die geweld heeft afgezworen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het mogelijk tot 'persona non grata' verklaren van de Nederlandse diplomaat Serry wegens poging tot steun aan Hamas

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch diplomat Robert Serry, UN coordinator for the Middle East peace process, attempted to arrange payment of millions of dollars to Hamas and whether Israel might declare him persona non grata. The minister answered that Serry, now a UN official, acted in a matter for the UN, that Dutch relations with Israel face no consequences, and that the government will take no further steps.
The conduct of Mr Serry is a matter for the UN.
De handelswijze van de heer Serry is een zaak voor de VN.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma en Hachchi, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis is vermoord

MPs from several parties asked whether the Minister had raised the murder of Libyan activist Salwa Bugaighis with Libyan authorities, requested a thorough investigation, and asked what the Netherlands could do to protect threatened women's rights activists in Libya. The Minister answered that the Libyan authorities bear primary responsibility, that the issue will be raised bilaterally and in EU channels, and that the Netherlands supports civil society programmes and is exploring support for a hotline.
This point will be raised both in bilateral contacts and within the EU with the authorities in Tripoli as well as with the Libyan embassy in The Hague.
Dit punt zal zowel in bilaterale contacten als in EU-verband met de autoriteiten in Tripoli alsook met de Libische ambassade in Den Haag worden opgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de Global Partnership for Education Replenishment Meeting

MPs Smaling, Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked why the Netherlands was absent from the Global Partnership for Education replenishment meeting, whether it supports investment in education and urges other donors including the EU to contribute, and whether it will push for the Lucens Guidelines protecting schools from military use. The minister answered that the Netherlands was not represented because its basic education support is being phased out, that it has urged other donors to keep funding education, and that it could not raise the Lucens Guidelines at the meeting.
Given the phase-out of basic education policy and therefore also the phase-out of Dutch support to the GPE, the Netherlands is not represented at this meeting.
Gegeven de afbouw van het beleid voor basisonderwijs en hiermee ook de afbouw van de Nederlandse steun aan het GPE is Nederland niet vertegenwoordigd op deze bijeenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, de Roon en van Bommel over de vrijlating en arrestatie van een zwangere vrouw in Sudan

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Merriam Ibrahim was re-arrested after a court acquitted her of a death sentence, on what grounds, and whether the Sudanese ambassador would be summoned. The minister confirmed she was held at the airport on suspicion of using false documents, released on 26 June and is now at the US embassy, and said international pressure is being raised through quiet diplomacy.
Ms Ibrahim was held on suspicion of using false documents, but she was not formally arrested.
Mevrouw Ibrahim werd vastgehouden op verdenking van het gebruik van valse documenten, maar zij is niet officieel gearresteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Keijzer over de berichten waaruit blijkt dat een consulent van Stichting De Einder adviezen over zelfdoding geeft

MPs Van der Staaij and Keijzer asked whether a counsellor of Stichting De Einder giving concrete suicide advice and a supplier address to a young woman was acceptable, and whether it was criminal, asking the government to act against the foundation and the Chinese supplier. The minister confirmed the reports, said the Openbaar Ministerie has opened an investigation and declined to comment on it, noted that article 294 Sr is not met since no suicide followed, and pointed to existing medicines-law and economic-offence powers against the supplier.
The Public Prosecution Service (OM) is launching an investigation following the reports mentioned.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) stelt een onderzoek in naar aanleiding van voornoemde berichtgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat gemeenten in de biblebelt fors minder geld per jongere krijgen dan andere gemeenten

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked whether Bible Belt municipalities receive much less youth care funding per young person, and whether the allocation model's use of historical spending is fair, citing the low figure for Bunschoten. The state secretaries answered that the 2015 budget follows historical youth care use, that many municipalities outside the Bible Belt also receive less, and that municipalities must bear high-cost risks themselves.
All municipalities now receive budget for what they use, and therefore the amount of money they need in 2015.
Alle gemeenten krijgen nu budget voor wat ze gebruiken, en dus de hoeveelheid geld die ze in 2015 nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het gebrek aan kennis over de onderliggende oorzaken van suïcidaal gedrag

MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the health minister about the claim that knowledge of the underlying causes of suicidal behaviour is lacking, the rise in suicides, and whether more research investment and prevention were planned. The minister said research is the responsibility of the professional groups, pointed to the existing national suicide prevention agenda 2014-2017 with EUR 1.1 million allocated, and gave no new commitments beyond periodic information to parliament.
It is the responsibility of the professional group(s) themselves to set up and carry out scientific research where gaps in knowledge exist regarding causes and/or treatment.

Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de beroepsgroep(en) zelf om daar waar leemtes in kennis zitten op het terrein van oorzaken en/of behandeling, wetenschappelijk onderzoek op te zetten en uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Sjoerdsma over seksueel geweld tegen (Dalit) vrouwen in India

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he would raise caste discrimination and impunity for sexual violence against Dalit women in India and Bangladesh at UN forums, co-sponsor a side event, and raise the issue bilaterally. The minister confirmed awareness and past discussions, noted India's announced zero-tolerance policy and Dutch UN resolution work, but declined to co-sponsor the side event and could not answer before the deadline.
To increase the effectiveness of this event it is important that not only European countries co-sponsor it, but especially countries from other parts of the world.
Om de effectiviteit van dit evenement te vergroten is het van belang dat niet alleen Europese landen dit evenement co-sponsoren», maar juist ook landen uit andere delen van de wereld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Omtzigt, Van Bommel over de vernietiging van 64 kerken in de Chinese provincie Zhejiang

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that 64 churches in China's Zhejiang province were demolished or stripped of Christian elements under a demolition campaign, and whether central authorities back it. The minister confirmed the reports, said the campaign targets illegal buildings and anti-corruption, and said Dutch concerns on religious freedom are raised bilaterally and via the EU.
The Netherlands will continue to raise this worrying development both bilaterally and through the EU.
Nederland zal zowel bilateraal als via de EU aandacht blijven vragen voor deze zorgelijke ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Van der Staaij over de aanslag op bezoekers van het Joodse Museum in Brussel

MPs Segers and Van der Staaij asked the Justice Minister about the Brussels Jewish Museum attack: its effect on threat levels, whether the state should bear extra security costs for Jewish institutions, and renewed consultation with local authorities on funding. The minister said no acute threat was identified for Jewish institutions in the Netherlands, that security costs are primarily the responsibility of citizens and organisations with state support where needed, and that consultations with local authorities including Amsterdam have taken place.
Security measures are taken equally for every citizen, cultural, religious or educational institution, based on threat and risk.
Voor iedere burger, culturele, religieuze of onderwijsinstelling worden op gelijke wijze beveiligingsmaatregelen genomen op basis van dreiging en risico.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de doodstraf voor een zwangere vrouw in Sudan

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the government about the death sentence imposed on a pregnant Christian woman in Sudan for refusing to return to Islam, including protests, possible sanctions and Sudan's debt relief. The minister answered that the Sudanese ambassador was summoned, the verdict was condemned, an appeal is pending, the EU was engaged, no documented overview of recent anti-Christian incidents exists, and debt relief is conditional on proven progress.
The cabinet had the Sudanese ambassador summoned to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Het kabinet heeft de Sudanese ambassadeur laten ontbieden op het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het gebruiken van foetussen als energiebron

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked the Minister whether Dutch rules allow using foetuses from miscarriages and abortions as an energy source, and how compliance and parental information are ensured. The Minister answered that the Wlb and Wfw do not permit energy use, that the IGZ found no compliance problems, and that hospitals and clinics follow NVOG guidance, with individual wishes considered.
For the avoidance of doubt, I note that using a foetus explicitly for generating energy cannot be considered one of the permitted purposes.
Voor alle duidelijkheid merk ik op dat gebruik van een foetus dat expliciet is gericht op het opwekken van energie, dan niet geacht kan worden onder die toegestane doeleinden te vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de verplaatsing van cocaïneroutes naar Rotterdam

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that a large share of cocaine entering Western and Central Europe passes through Rotterdam, and about seizure figures and inter-agency cooperation. The Minister answered that the flow via Rotterdam is long-known and not shown to be increasing, that higher 2013 seizures reflect better cooperation and detection, and that the total volume is unknown, giving seizure figures and describing the Integere Haven and HARC-team cooperation.
No good estimate can be made of this, since nothing is known about the total volume of cocaine smuggling to Rotterdam and no indicators for it exist.
Hiervan is geen goede schatting te maken, aangezien over de totale omvang van de cocaïnesmokkel naar Rotterdam niets bekend is en daar ook geen indicatoren voor te geven zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over de ter dood veroordeling van een Pakistaanse christen

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the death sentence imposed in Pakistan on a Christian for alleged blasphemy, the causes of the case, the situation of Christian minorities and the government's response. The minister answered that blasphemy laws are prone to misuse, that the case is under appeal, and that the Netherlands raises the issue through quiet diplomacy in bilateral and multilateral channels.
The Netherlands will, both within the EU and UN framework and bilaterally, continue to raise the position of religious minorities with the Pakistani authorities.
Nederland zal, zowel in EU- en VN-verband als bilateraal, bij de Pakistaanse autoriteiten aandacht voor de positie van religieuze minderheden blijven vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Keijzer over het ouderschapsplan

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and Keijzer asked the government about reports that children in high-conflict divorces are in a difficult position, the effectiveness of the parenting plan, and whether relationship counselling is covered by basic insurance. The government answered that it has sent an implementation plan to parliament, that a WODC evaluation is preliminary, that basic insurance does not cover relationship problems without a psychiatric diagnosis, and that municipalities may buy such help from 2015.
To this end, we sent an implementation plan to your House by letter of 31 March 2014.
Daartoe hebben wij bij brief van 31 maart 2014 een uitvoeringsplan naar uw Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over diefstallen uit stallen, schuren en weilanden

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about rising thefts of machinery and goods from farm barns, stables and fields, the role of Eastern European mobile criminal gangs, and cross-border cooperation. The minister said police do not register these thefts separately so no national trend can be confirmed, described regional measures and a 2013 project in Limburg, and referred to earlier letters and debates for the rest.
Thefts at agricultural businesses are not separately recorded in the police registration systems.
Diefstallen bij agrarische bedrijven worden niet apart geregistreerd in de registratiesystemen van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de beoordeling van euthanasie door de Regionale Toetsingscommissies Euthanasie

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked whether euthanasia review committees should follow professional guidelines, whether there should be an independent dispute body for KNMG's complaints, and whether a meeting with KNMG had taken place. Minister Schippers answered that committees are not bound by guidelines but use them as a reference, that transparency will be improved via the website, that a separate dispute body is not desirable, and that a meeting with KNMG has been arranged.
We do not consider it desirable that in other situations objection to an Rte judgement be possible.
Wij achten het niet wenselijk dat in andere situaties bezwaar tegen een Rte-oordeel openstaat.
Antwoord op vragen het van lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat de VN-Organisatie voor Onderwijs, Wetenschap en Cultuur (UNESCO) een internationale expositie over Israël heeft geschrapt

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether UNESCO's cancellation of an exhibition on Jewish history and the Holy Land was justified, whether the government would protest, and what it would do if UNESCO persisted. The minister replied that the exhibition was postponed to June rather than cancelled, cited UNESCO's concerns about Arab states and unfinished content agreement with the Wiesenthal Center, welcomed the postponement, and expected the exhibition to proceed.
The exhibition "The People, the Book, the Land – 3,500 years of ties between the Jewish People and the Holy Land" has not been cancelled but postponed until June of this year.
1 Antwoord De tentoonstelling «The People, the Book, the Land – 3,500 years of ties between the Jewish People and the Holy Land» is niet geschrapt, maar uitgesteld tot juni van dit jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind, Van der Steur en Van der Staaij over het gebruik van xtc onder jongeren

MPs asked the government about the high ecstasy use among young party-goers, rising XTC-related hospital and first-aid incidents, how easily XTC is obtained, controls at events, and the role of parents and municipalities in prevention. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to the new Trimbos VGHE prevention programme, noted increased incidents and drug strength, and said event organisers bear primary responsibility for security while enforcement focuses on production and trade.
For this reason I have instructed the Trimbos Institute to start the Safe and Healthy Hospitality and Events (VGHE) programme in 2014, as announced in the National Prevention Programme (NPP).

Mede om die reden heb ik het Trimbos-instituut opdracht gegeven om, zoals ook is aangekondigd in het Nationaal Programma Preventie (NPP), in 2014 te starten met het programma Veilige en Gezonde Horeca en Evenementen (VGHE).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het mogelijk schrappen van de visumplicht voor Turken

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether reports that Turks could enter the EU without a visa within a few years were accurate, and what had been agreed with Turkey. The minister confirmed a 2012 EU-Turkey JBZ cooperation package, with visa liberalisation conditional on a readmission agreement and strict criteria rather than a timetable, and said national rules for long-stay visas and work permits would not be affected.
Regarding visa liberalisation, the Netherlands holds that the process is tied to strict conditions, with the criteria leading and not the timetable.
Ten aanzien van visumliberalisatie staat Nederland voor dat het proces is verbonden aan strikte voorwaarden, waarbij de criteria leidend zijn en niet het tijdpad.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, De Roon, Voordewind over het gegeven dat waterbedrijf Vitens zijn samenwerkingsverband met het Israëlische waterbedrijf Mekorot heeft beëindigd 'om neutraal' te

Four MPs asked the foreign minister whether the government was involved in Vitens ending its cooperation with Israel's Mekorot, whether this harms innovation and the peace process, and whether it fits the water top-sector policy. The minister answered that the government does not interfere in individual companies' decisions, that the ministry only explained Dutch non-encouragement policy when consulted, and that companies decide their own economic relations.
The government does not intervene in the decisions of individual companies.
De regering treedt niet in de besluiten van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat in Azerbeidzjan en Armenië duizenden meisjes worden geaborteerd vanwege hun geslacht

An SGP MP asked the government about reports that thousands of girls are aborted for their sex in Azerbaijan and Armenia, and whether those governments act and whether the international community raises it. The minister called the reports worrying, described limited government attention in both countries, noted Council of Europe and UNFPA engagement, and committed to supporting efforts to reduce sex-selective abortion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Keijzer, Dik-Faber en Krol over de publicatie ‘Over(-)behandelen. Ethiek van de zorg voor kwetsbare ouderen’

Members of parliament asked the health minister about a publication on over-treatment of frail elderly patients, including whether over-treatment should be curbed, adopting decision-making methods and ethical frameworks, and cost limits. The minister answered that shared decision-making, professional standards set by stakeholders, and a new 'intensive consultation at end of life' activity code are the preferred routes, with no binding new rules or cost ceilings.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik-Faber, Van der Staaij en Bruins Slot over de effectiviteit van de Bob-campagne

MPs from the ChristenUnie, SGP and CDA asked the ministers whether independent research shows the Bob campaign works, especially for young drivers, and whether a new, harder campaign concept is needed. The minister answered that annual effect measurements show a decline in drink-driving offenders, particularly among 18–24 year old men, and rejected a new youth concept and harder confrontational messaging as unsupported by evidence.
I do not agree with that finding.
Ik ben het niet eens met die constatering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over de verwoesting van het Syrische christelijke dorp Sadad

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about reports of mass killings and destruction in the Christian Syrian village of Sadad, the background, international responses, and possible action. The minister said SOHR reported 45 civilian deaths but no destruction of the village, that no further information was available, and that the Netherlands would press for respect for minorities and referral of Syria to the International Criminal Court.
No information is available about the background of these killings.
Over de achtergronden van deze moorden is geen informatie beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de toenemende vervolging van christenen op Sri Lanka

MPs Omtzigt, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister about reported rising persecution of Christians in Sri Lanka, including church closures, an attack on a church in Hanwella, police inaction, and removal of Sri Lanka from the human rights fund country list. The minister acknowledged rising religious tensions, said no independent information was available on several specifics, explained the 2011 reduction of the fund's country list, and noted EU and UN expressions of concern without committing to new national measures.
There is no independent information available to make a statement about this.
Er is geen onafhankelijke informatie beschikbaar om hier een uitspraak over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma, Thieme, Van Ojik en Omtzigt over het autorijverbod voor vrouwen in Saoedi-Arabië

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about arrests and fines of women defying Saudi Arabia's driving ban and the detention of a journalist supporting women's right to drive, and whether the government would press Saudi counterparts. The minister confirmed short detentions that could not be independently verified, said the journalist was briefly held and has been released, described the situation as concerning while noting some reforms, and stated the issue is raised in EU and UPR dialogue.
However, it is not possible to independently confirm the number of women detained, nor whether they were fined.
Het is echter niet mogelijk om het aantal vrouwen dat is vastgezet onafhankelijk bevestigd te krijgen, noch of zij zijn beboet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Van Bommel over het ongekende geweld tegen christenen in Egypte, zoals gedocumenteerd door Amnesty International

MPs from seven parties asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty's documentation of large-scale violence against Coptic Christians in Egypt, including trends, casualty figures, the interim government's protection efforts and possible international initiatives. The minister said the reports are troubling, that the government urges independent investigation bilaterally and in EU and UN fora, that no reliable casualty figures exist, and that Dutch initiatives include judicial training and interfaith contacts.
The cabinet advocates the need for such an impartial investigation with the Egyptian authorities, both bilaterally and within the EU and UN.
Het kabinet bepleit de noodzaak van een dergelijk onpartijdig onderzoek bij de Egyptische autoriteiten, zowel bilateraal als in EU- en in VN-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Segers, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over mogelijke financiering van Al-Shabaab via het consulaat van Eritrea

MPs from several parties asked whether money from the Eritrean consulate's diaspora tax in the Netherlands may fund Al-Shabaab, whether the OM investigated, and whether the consul should be expelled or the consulate closed. The government answered that the OM has received no complaints and started no investigation, that the tax is not per se contrary to Vienna Conventions or sanctions, that there are no concrete indications the funds financed terrorism, and that no measures are warranted.
The Public Prosecution Service has not started an investigation into the so-called diaspora tax because it had received no reports on this matter.
Door het Openbaar Ministerie is geen onderzoek begonnen naar de zgn. diaspora taks omdat het Openbaar Ministerie dienaangaande geen aangiften had ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de oververtegenwoordiging van Nederland bij de hosting van pornosites
