An SGP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the Netherlands hosts a disproportionate share of the world's pornographic websites and what measures will be taken, including stricter age verification. The minister answered that hosting of legal adult content is a consequence of the country's digital infrastructure, that the government will act only on criminal content such as child pornography, and that age verification cannot be mandated for legal content.
I also do not believe that the Netherlands contributes to keeping inhumane conditions alive.
Ik ben ook niet van mening dat Nederland meewerkt aan het in leven houden van mensonwaardige omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het belang van de ondersteunende rol die NGO’s kunnen hebben voor het aannemelijk maken van het asielrelaas door asielzoekers

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked whether NGO support can help asylum seekers substantiate their claims, whether documents from the NGO CLAAS should be treated as reliable given Dutch funding, and why IND document research cannot always give a verdict on authenticity. The state secretary acknowledged the role of NGOs, said CLAAS funding concerns a different activity and does not determine evidentiary status, and stated that the IND assesses each document individually and considers its content acceptable.
I consider this approach careful and adequate.
Ik acht deze werkwijze zorgvuldig en toereikend.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht van een negatief Nederlands bouwadvies

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister whether the government advised Royal HaskoningDHV to stop building a sewage treatment plant in East Jerusalem, and what legal basis and consequences such advice has. The minister replied that the government only informed the company about the occupation and its obligations, that settlement investment is discouraged as policy, but that companies are not forbidden and bear responsibility themselves.

The Cabinet considers Israeli settlements unlawful and an obstacle to peace and therefore discourages Dutch companies from making investments or undertaking other activities in or for the benefit of Israeli settlements.

Het Kabinet acht Israëlische nederzettingen onrechtmatig en een obstakel voor de vrede en ontmoedigt daarom Nederlandse bedrijven investeringen te doen of andere activiteiten te ontplooien in of ten behoeve van Israëlische nederzettingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de tegemoetkoming in de kosten van adoptie

An SGP MP asked why the Agentschap SZW changed the wording of the adoption-cost allowance criteria, which led to rejections of some applications, and whether the old criteria would be applied. The minister says the change was a clarification, that 35 wrongly rejected cases were reassessed and the website amended, and that the earlier criteria will be applied to the affected applications.
It was then decided to reassess these 35 cases and to amend the website, so that the lack of clarity has been removed.
Daarop is besloten deze 35 gevallen opnieuw te beoordelen en de website aan te passen, zodat de onduidelijkheid is weggenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Inpakken en wegwezen na overlijden in verpleeghuis’

Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the state secretary about a Consumentenbond survey finding that nursing homes often clear a deceased resident's room before the seven-day period in the general conditions, and that about 40% give incorrect or no information on this. The state secretary said such practice is hurtful, that the seven-day rule was agreed with consumer and patient organisations, and that he will raise non-compliance with the sector organisation Actiz in regular meetings.
In the regular consultation my ministry has with the branch organisations, I will raise why such clear agreements are still not always complied with.
In het overleg dat mijn ministerie regulier met de branche-organisaties heeft, zal ik aan de orde stellen waarom dergelijke heldere afspraken toch niet altijd worden nageleefd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de moord op Mostafa Talaie

An MP asked about the murder of Mostafa Talaie, a convert from Islam to Christianity, and about threats against converts in and outside asylum centres. The state secretary confirmed awareness of the broadcast, said COA has taken measures for Christian asylum seekers and that reporting and complaint rates should be raised, and reported 18 recorded incidents in 2012 across thirteen centres.
The number of reports of violence and threats against Christian asylum seekers amounted to eighteen in 2012, spread over thirteen different asylum centres.
Het aantal meldingen van geweld en bedreiging tegen christelijke asielzoekers bedroeg in het jaar 2012 achttien, verspreid over dertien verschillende azc's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Drinken tijdens zwangerschap kan gewoon’

MPs Bruins Slot, Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked whether a UK study suggesting moderate drinking in pregnancy is harmless changes government advice, and how professional guidance and a warning logo will be addressed. The State Secretary answered that the advice to avoid alcohol in pregnancy stands, will be raised with professional groups, and that talks with the drinks sector on a voluntary pregnancy logo continue, with a report to follow after summer.
The government's position remains that it is best to avoid drinking alcohol when you want to become pregnant, are pregnant or are breastfeeding.
Het standpunt van de overheid is nog altijd dat het het beste is het drinken van alcohol te vermijden wanneer je zwanger wilt worden, zwanger bent of borstvoeding geeft.

Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de toename van mobiele teams voor euthanasie en het promoten van hulp bij zelfdoding door

An SGP MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about the growth of mobile euthanasia teams linked to the Levenseindekliniek, whether the statutory care requirements are checked, and whether the public prosecutor enforces the ban on assisted suicide by family members. The ministers answered that all reviewed clinic notifications were judged careful, that cases judged careless go to the Inspectorate and prosecutor, that prosecution is hard mainly due to proof problems, and that merely informing about or depicting such acts is not punishable.

When a notification from the physician is assessed as careless by the review committees, that notification will be forwarded to the Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) and the Public Prosecution Service (OM).

Wanneer een melding van de arts door de toetsingscommissies als onzorgvuldig wordt beoordeeld, zal deze melding doorgestuurd worden naar de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord op vragen van de ledenr Omtzigt, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de EU-richtsnoeren over vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging

MPs Omtzigt, Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked why the minister did not inform parliament in advance about the EU guidelines on freedom of religion or belief adopted in June 2013, and whether the Netherlands would discuss a ranking of persecuted religious minorities in EU fora. The minister answered that the guidelines were prepared in the Council working group, were not discussed substantively at the Foreign Affairs Council, will be communicated to parliament by letter, and that the freedom of religion topic will be raised in EU consultations after parliament debates the human rights note.
As promised to your House during the committee meeting on freedom of religion of 15 May, your House will be informed by letter about the adoption of these guidelines.
Zoals tijdens het AO godsdienstvrijheid van 15 mei jl. aan uw Kamer toegezegd, wordt uw Kamer per brief over de aanname van deze richtsnoeren geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon, Van Ojik, Omtzigt en Van Bommel over de nieuwe NGO-wet in Egypte

Six MPs asked the foreign minister whether Egypt's draft NGO law, despite amendments, still violates freedoms of expression and assembly, threatens human rights work and civil society, and whether the Netherlands has raised objections. The minister agreed the draft appears to conflict with Egypt's international obligations, said the Netherlands and the EU have raised concerns bilaterally and in multilateral fora, and noted the law is not yet adopted, with the EU to raise it if adopted.
Should a restrictive proposal nonetheless become law, I will raise it as soon as possible within the EU framework.
Mocht een restrictief voorstel toch wet worden dan zal ik dat zo spoedig mogelijk in EU-verband aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat online alcoholhoudende drank kopen kinderspel is

MPs Van der Staaij and Bruins Slot asked whether municipalities lack effective enforcement powers over online alcohol sales to minors, and whether the Drank- en Horecawet should change. The state secretary acknowledged weak enforcement of online sales, outlined interministerial work on eID-based age verification with no firm timeline, and argued that parents bear primary responsibility.
In practice it has proved difficult to exercise adequate supervision here, because delivery takes place at the front door at unpredictable moments.
In de praktijk is het lastig gebleken hier adequaat toezicht op te houden, omdat het gaat om levering aan de voordeur op niet te voorspellen momenten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het terugsturen van negen gevluchte Noord-Koreanen naar hun eigen land

An SGP MP asked the foreign minister about the forced return of nine Korean refugees from Laos via China, the risks they face, China's and Laos's non-refoulement practice, and steps to press China, Laos and North Korea. The minister answered that the cabinet is concerned, that UNHCR lacks access and China does not treat North Koreans as refugees, and that the Netherlands and EU will raise non-refoulement with China and Laos and voice concerns to North Korea.
The Netherlands and the EU will raise the principle of non-refoulement with Laos through an EU-level demarche and during the EU-Laos human rights dialogue.
Nederland en de EU zullen Laos aanspreken op het principe van non-refoulement door het uitvoeren van een demarche op EU niveau en tijdens de EU-Laos mensenrechtendialoog.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het initiatief Second love

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked whether the government finds it undesirable that the Second love initiative, which advertises in media, undermines relationships, including via public broadcasting, and what it will do to promote relationship support. The State Secretary answered that relationships are a private matter that cannot be imposed by government, that municipalities and Centra voor Jeugd en Gezin are responsible for relationship support (with a handreiking), and that government does not judge advertisements, which are assessed by the Reclame Code Commissie.
The government has no substantive involvement in, nor any judgement on, advertising.
De overheid heeft geen inhoudelijke bemoeienis met en ook geen oordeel over reclame-uitingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis en Ten Broeke over de detentie van Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi-Arabië

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister whether the four-month detention of human rights activist Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi Arabia was justified, whether the government agrees with Amnesty International that he is a prisoner of conscience, and whether it will urge Saudi Arabia to release him. The minister answered that the EU is investigating the background of the arrest with Saudi bodies, that EU action will depend on the outcome, and that the Netherlands generally raises human rights defender issues with Saudi authorities.
Depending on the outcome of the investigation, the EU will consider whether, and if so what, action is effective and desirable.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek zal in EU-verband worden bezien of, en zo ja welke, actie effectief en wenselijk is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, De Roon en Van Bommel over de benoeming van Iran tot voorzitter van de VN-Ontwapeningsconferentie

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister whether Iran's rotating chairmanship of the UN Conference on Disarmament, and the US boycott of it, undermines disarmament progress and whether the Netherlands should follow a boycott. The minister replied that the chair rotates alphabetically rather than being elected, that the Netherlands will attend but leave if the Durban criteria are violated, and that a policy letter is forthcoming.
The Netherlands is a strong supporter of (nuclear) disarmament and non-proliferation, with the ultimate goal of a world without nuclear weapons.
Nederland is een groot voorstander van (nucleaire) ontwapening en non-proliferatie, waarbij het uiteindelijke doel is een wereld zonder kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het gedogen van qat-gebruik

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether police and prosecutors will stop prosecuting small amounts of qat for personal use after it was listed under Opium Act list II, and how enforcement is ensured. The minister answered that there is no tolerance of qat offences, that possession and trade remain criminal with lower penalties for small amounts, and that local nuisance can be tackled via municipal bylaws.
There is and will be no question of tolerating criminal acts with regard to qat.
Er is en zal geen sprake zijn van het gedogen van strafbare handelingen ten aanzien van qat.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij, Omtzigt en Voordewind over Islamitisch-extremistisch geweld tegen christenen in Nigeria

MPs Van der Staaij, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked the foreign minister about Islamist violence against Christians in northern Nigeria, including whether the Nigerian state is failing to protect its citizens and what the Netherlands and the EU will do. The minister acknowledged the violence, said Nigeria bears national responsibility and that the Netherlands will raise it bilaterally and in EU and UN fora, but gave no concrete commitments beyond ongoing dialogue and EU follow-up.
The Netherlands will, through the usual multilateral channels and mainly in the bilateral relationship with Nigeria, point to Nigeria's national responsibility for protecting its citizens.

Nederland zal via de gebruikelijke multilaterale kanalen en vooral in de bilaterale relatie met Nigeria wijzen op de nationale verantwoordelijkheid van Nigeria ten aanzien van de bescherming van haar burgers.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Bonis, Omtzigt, Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij en Van Ojik over de ontvoering van twee Syrische bisschoppen

MPs from eight parties asked the foreign minister whether the government knew of the abduction of two Syrian bishops, whether their driver was killed, and whether the Netherlands would seek mediation with the parties to the conflict. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to give details on the circumstances or the bishops' status, and said the Netherlands is working with EU partners and the Syrian opposition to secure their release and promised to inform the House.

Regarding the precise circumstances of the abduction of Bishop Boulos Yazigi and Bishop Yohanna Ibrahim and the specific question of whether their driver was killed, it is not possible to provide further information.

Over de precieze omstandigheden van de ontvoering van bisschop Boulos Yazigi en bisschop Yohanna Ibrahim en de concrete vraag of hun chauffeur hierbij is gedood is het niet mogelijk nadere inlichtingen te verschaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat supermarktketens weigeren effectieve naleving van leeftijdgrenzen bij alcoholverkoop toe te passen

Two MPs asked the government about reports that supermarket chains resist effective age checks for alcohol sales, including remote age-verification systems. The state secretary answered that compliance is the supermarkets' own responsibility, that the burgomaster supervises compliance and can impose sanctions, and that the government has contacted the VNG and will evaluate the law after three years.
However, it is up to the supermarkets themselves to determine how the age limits for the sale of alcoholic beverages are complied with and which systems they use for this.
Het is echter aan de supermarkten zelf om te bepalen op welke wijze de leeftijdsgrenzen bij de verkoop van alcoholhoudende dranken worden nageleefd en welke systemen zij daarvoor hanteren.
Antwoord vragen Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over het bericht “ziekenhuizen mogen abortus niet weigeren”

Two MPs asked the health and education ministers about a minister's radio remarks on abortion and a hospital board's decision to offer abortion, including whether conscientious objectors are protected under the Termination of Pregnancy Act. The government answered that the law protects non-participation, that hospital decision-making and ethics committee involvement are internal matters, and that it expects conscientious objectors' position to be sufficiently secured.
I regard this as an internal matter.
Ik zie dit als een interne aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het onderzoek ‘Do time restrictions on alcohol advertising reduce youth exposure’

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and Kooiman asked whether a study showing the 6:00–21:00 time slot for alcohol advertising has counterproductive effects for high-risk youth should lead to extending the slot or other measures, and about compliance with the advertising code. The state secretary replied that the time slot is effective for young children, that he will discuss further protection of 12–18 year olds with the education ministry and report back, that code compliance is good, and that no further evaluation is needed beyond the existing one.

As indicated earlier during the debate on the private member's bill raising the alcohol age, I will soon discuss with the education ministry how young people aged 12–18 can be further protected from the influence of alcohol advertising.

Ik zal, zoals eerder aangegeven tijdens het debat over het initiatiefwetsvoorstel verhoging leeftijd alcohol, binnenkort met het ministerie van OCW bespreken op welke manier jongeren tussen de 12–18 jaar verder kunnen worden beschermd tegen de invloed van alcoholreclame.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haersma Buma, Pechtold, Slob, Van Ojik en Van der Staaij over de gevolgen van het akkoord voor de ontwikkeling van het (structurele) EMU-saldo en de staatsschuld in de periode 2014-201

MPs from CDA, D66, ChristenUnie, GroenLinks and SGP asked the government how the social accord affects the structural EMU balance, debt, the 3% deficit target, and the WW premium changes. The minister replied that the accord causes a shortfall of 119 million structurally and up to 543 million in 2017, that the government abandons the 4.3 billion supplementary package but will take further measures if the CPB forecast requires it, and that a CPB analysis of structural effects will come with the June forecast.
The cabinet will take additional measures if the CPB's MEV forecast, given the 2014 balance target, gives reason to do so.
Het kabinet zal aanvullende maatregelen nemen indien de MEV-raming van het CPB gegeven het saldodoel 2014 daartoe aanleiding geeft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat palliatieve zorg vaak te laat wordt ingezet bij chronische aandoeningen

An SGP MP asked the state secretary whether palliative care is started too late for chronic conditions, and how the government is broadening palliative care beyond cancer as the motion requested. The government answered that broadening is built into policy through a generic palliative care module, ZonMw programmes and training, without giving concrete results yet.
In the interim I will inform you about the results of this programme, which also leaves room to test the palliative care module.
Tussentijds zal ik u informeren over de resultaten van dit programma, waarin ook ruimte is voor het toetsen van de module voor palliatieve zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind  en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘IJsland wil porno blokkeren’

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked about Iceland's plan to block internet pornography and about what is known of its effects on Dutch children, including exposure, help-seeking and research. The government answered that Iceland's plans are only under study, that the evidence on harm is mostly correlational, and that no further research is considered necessary beyond the ongoing NHL study.
The state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport and I do not consider initiating additional research necessary.
Het entameren van aanvullend onderzoek achten de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en ik niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon en Ten Broeke over de aanval op een christelijke wijk in de Pakistaanse stad Lahore

Four MPs (Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Ten Broeke) asked the foreign minister about a mob attack on a Christian neighbourhood in Lahore over alleged blasphemy, Pakistan's government response, the misuse of blasphemy law and what the Netherlands will do to press Pakistan. The minister answered that Punjab ordered a judicial inquiry and compensation was paid, that the blasphemy law is open to abuse, and that the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally, multilaterally and in GSP+ assessment, but gave no concrete new commitments beyond existing channels.
I do not have confirmed figures on the number of people imprisoned on charges under this law.
Ik beschik niet over geconfirmeerde cijfers over het aantal personen dat gevangen zit vanwege een beschuldiging op grond van deze wet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Gesthuizen en Schouw over het bericht dat circa 100 huizen van Pakistaanse christenen zijn verbrand vanwege vermeende belediging van Mohammed

Four MPs asked the state secretary whether the Pakistani government adequately protects Christian minorities after about 100 homes were burned over an alleged blasphemy case, and why Christians are not classed as a risk group for asylum purposes. The state secretary answered that Pakistani authorities often fail to protect and prosecute perpetrators, that no reliable data on 2012 incidents exists, and that after considering the Lahore incident he still does not consider Pakistani Christians a risk group.
No, there is no reliable information available on this.
Nee, er is hierover geen betrouwbare informatie beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over uitlatingen premier Erdogan over het zionisme

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the foreign minister how he judged Turkish Prime Minister Erdogan's remark describing Zionism as a crime against humanity, whether the Netherlands had protested, and why the UN Secretary-General had not condemned it. The minister distanced the government from the remark, said it was raised with Turkey politically and at official level, and noted the UN Secretary-General had distanced himself from it.
I explicitly distance myself from this.
Ik neem hier uitdrukkelijk afstand van.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik en Krol over dodelijke aanvallen op Hazara’s in Pakistan

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister about deadly attacks on Hazara Shia communities in Pakistan, including whether perpetrators have been prosecuted and whether Pakistan should investigate independently. The minister confirmed the attacks, attributed most to Lashkar-e-Jhangvi, said Pakistan pledges to pursue perpetrators while noting recent arrests, and said the Netherlands and EU raise the issue of minorities bilaterally and multilaterally.
The Netherlands regularly raises the issue of the position of (religious) minorities in Pakistan in bilateral and multilateral contacts.
Nederland stelt de kwestie rondom de positie van (religieuze) minderheden in Pakistan geregeld in bilaterale en multilaterale contacten aan de orde.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Bonis, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Agnes Mulder over seksueel geweld tegen vrouwen in India en beperkingen voor mensenrechtenorganisaties

Seven MPs asked the foreign minister about sexual violence against women and Dalit women in India and Indian restrictions on NGOs, including a Dutch human rights prize winner's trial and blacklisting of NGOs and donors. The minister said the Netherlands supports the European Parliament resolution, funds Indian women's NGOs, respects the Indian legal process while staying in contact with the prize winner, and that the Indian NGO rules are being monitored through EU channels.
I will keep you informed of relevant developments.
Ik zal u op de hoogte houden van relevante ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over diefstal uit schuren in Oost-Nederland

Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the Justice Minister about the relatively high rate of theft from sheds in eastern Netherlands, the pursuit of perpetrators, whether stolen goods end up in Eastern Europe, and whether police presence at night and weekends is sufficient. Minister Opstelten answered that such burglaries are a police priority, that a 25% rise in clearance rates is targeted by 2014, that cross-border cooperation exists, and that capacity allocation is for local mayors and the chief public prosecutor to decide.
The number of reports or incidents specifically involving a burglary or theft from a shed is not registered by the police.
Het aantal aangiften of incidenten waarbij het een inbraak of diefstal uit specifiek een schuur betreft wordt niet door de politie geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over de opvang van tienermoeders

Two MPs asked the state secretary about the risk that Siriz's shelter for teenage mothers loses funding after 2014, and what happens to this group after decentralisation to municipalities. The state secretary answers that shelter for teenage mothers should remain available, that advice from VNG and Federatie Opvang is expected before summer 2013, and that the group will move to municipal shelter funding from 2015 without explicit mention in the Wmo.
I consider it important that support and, where necessary, shelter for teenage mothers with (serious) problems remain available.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat ondersteuning en zo nodig opvang voor tienermoeders met (ernstige) problemen beschikbaar blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Maij en Van Bommel over de marginalisatie van de Papua's in sociaal en economisch opzicht

Dutch MPs asked the foreign minister whether Papuans are marginalised in the exploitation of natural resources, whether large development programmes bring in immigrants, who benefits, how their land is legally protected, and how the Netherlands can help. The minister acknowledged the reports, said development is aimed at the whole population, admitted the Special Autonomy Law's consultation duty and local regulation are not consistently implemented or completed, and committed to pressing Indonesia for transparency and NGO access.
This consultation obligation is not always complied with in practice.
Deze consultatieplicht wordt in de praktijk niet altijd nageleefd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het rapport van Human Rights Watch waaruit blijkt dat Syrische oppositiegroepen kerken plunderen

Members Omtzigt, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the foreign minister about a Human Rights Watch report on Syrian opposition groups looting churches, including who was responsible, whether sectarian violence is increasing, and whether attacks on religious buildings are war crimes for the ICC. The minister answered that responsibility cannot be established, acknowledged the sectarian trend and the crime, but said the ICC cannot act without a Security Council referral, which the Netherlands supports, and that the letter to the Council did not specifically mention church attacks.
No. Is it possible to establish which groups were responsible for these lootings?
Vraag 2 Is vast te stellen welke groepen verantwoordelijk zijn geweest voor deze plunderingen?

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pechtold, Van Bommel, Madlener, Van der Staaij, Ouwehand en Segers over het rapport “Seventeenth Bi-annual Report: Developments in European Union Procedures  en Practices Relevant

MPs asked the foreign minister about the COSAC report on parliamentary scrutiny of EU documents, including why the Dutch parliament lacks access to Council documents marked EU Restricted and Limité that Austrian MPs can see. The minister answered that both chambers will receive direct access to all Limité documents, that Limité is a distribution code rather than a classification, and that the Dutch parliament is already as well informed as the Austrian and European Parliaments.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over VN-pleidooi voor internationaal onderzoek naar mensenrechtenschendingen in Noord-Korea

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the UN High Commissioner's call for an international inquiry into human rights abuses in North Korea, and whether it will support it and include religious freedom. The minister answered that the Netherlands will keep raising the issue in international fora, support such an inquiry in the UN General Assembly and Human Rights Council, and examine how religious freedom can be addressed within limited possibilities.

To obtain more information on the human rights situation in North Korea, the Netherlands will also support the call for an international inquiry into human rights violations in North Korea in the relevant international bodies.

Om meer informatie te krijgen over de mensenrechtensituatie in Noord-Korea zal Nederland tevens het pleidooi voor een internationaal onderzoek naar mensenrechtenschendingen in Noord-Korea in de relevante internationale gremia steunen

Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de effecten van de vermogensinkomensbijtelling voor het bepalen van de eigen bijdrage voor de Algemene Wet Bijzondere Ziektekosten (AWBZ) en de Wet maatschappelijke onderst

An SGP MP asked the state secretary for Health about the actual revenue, average increase, and distribution of the box III wealth income add-on (vermogensinkomensbijtelling) on care contributions under the AWBZ and Wmo, including impacts on people with illiquid assets. The state secretary said early intramural revenue is in the expected range, extramural and Wmo figures are not yet known, provided tables of box III wealth bands and age groups, and will examine the measure's effects before discussing consequences with the Chamber.
It is now too early to state with certainty what the revenue will be.
Het is nu te vroeg om met zekerheid aan te geven wat de opbrengst zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw c.s. over de zaak Van Rey - Weekers

Opposition and coalition MPs ask the State Secretary for Finance about the Van Rey–Weekers affair: a billboard donation, the sale of a tax office and a tax request involving real estate. They press on the nature and financing of the donation, contacts about closing tax offices, and handling of a personal tax request. The item is a bundle of written questions; the answers are not included in the text provided.
Have you verified that the donation was indeed made only by Mr Van Rey and, as agreed, processed via the regional campaign fund? Can you make the accounts public?

Heeft u zich ervan vergewist dat de donatie inderdaad alleen door de heer Van Rey is gedaan en, zoals afgesproken, via de regionale campagnekas is afgehandeld? Kunt u de rekeningen hiervan openbaar maken?
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over Turkije en Iran-sancties

An MP asked the foreign minister whether Turkey circumvents international sanctions against Iran, and whether the EU and Netherlands will act. The minister answered that the transactions do not breach UN sanctions, the only ones binding on Turkey, and that the Netherlands will keep urging Turkey to adopt EU sanctions.
The transactions mentioned in the article do not violate the UN Security Council sanctions against Iran.
De in het artikel genoemde transacties zijn niet in strijd met de sancties van de VN-Veiligheidsraad tegen Iran.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de verslechterde positie van moslims in Birma

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the foreign minister whether the Burmese government can contain sectarian violence against Muslims in Rakhine, whether reforms are undermined, and whether the Netherlands will push for UN-level protection. The minister answered that the government has increased military presence and that reforms continue, and that the Netherlands supports UN resolutions and humanitarian aid through CERF.
The Netherlands also campaigns for this, multilaterally for example by supporting the UN human rights resolution
Ook Nederland maakt zich hiervoor sterk, in multilateraal verband bijv. door ondersteuning van de mensenrechtenresolutie van de AVVN
Antwoord vragen Dik-Faber, Segers en Van der Staaij over berichten dat er binnen Europa een lijst in omloop is waarop ‘anti-choice personalities’ met naam worden genoemd

MPs asked whether a list naming 'anti-choice personalities' circulated by the European Parliamentary Forum for Population and Development (EPF), partly funded by the European Commission, is acceptable, and whether the Dutch government would raise the matter with the EPF or the Commission or question the funding. The minister answered that the EPF is a private initiative operating within EU law, that organisations choose their own strategies, and that she sees no reason to act or to question the funding.
An organisation is itself responsible for a chosen strategy to make its position clear.
Een organisatie is zelf verantwoordelijk voor een gekozen strategie om haar standpunt duidelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de grote toename van het aantal Hongaarse prostituees die gedwongen worden te werken voor pooiers

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the rise in Hungarian women forced into prostitution by pimps in the Netherlands, including whether legal prostitution attracts traffickers and whether sentencing and cooperation with Hungary are adequate. The minister said prostitution's legality is not the cause, that cooperation with Hungarian police and prosecutors is being intensified, that maximum sentences for trafficking will be raised via a bill, and that further research into sentencing is unnecessary.
I cannot make statements about the practice of the Amsterdam court without case-file research.
Over de praktijk van de Amsterdamse rechtbank kan ik geen uitspraken doen zonder dossieronderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en De Roon over de bloedige onderdrukking van Papoea’s in Indonesië

Four MPs asked the foreign minister about reports of lethal force against Papuan demonstrators in Indonesia, whether the government would condemn it, summon the ambassador, support a free press there, and send independent observers. The minister said the 23 October clashes in Manokwari are still under investigation, denied that repression is structural, noted limits on foreign journalists' access, and said the Netherlands will keep raising human rights through bilateral contacts and the EU dialogue, but rejected observers and sanctions-style steps.
The Netherlands will continue to raise the human rights situation in Papua and West Papua in bilateral contacts and through the EU human rights dialogue.
Nederland zal in bilaterale contacten en via de EU-mensenrechten dialoog aandacht blijven vragen voor de mensenrechtensituatie in Papua en West-Papua.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over het convenant inzake de landelijk werkende instellingen

Two MPs asked whether the state secretary still supports the agreement giving national working institutions a transition period in the youth care reform, and how continuity of identity-based care is protected as some provinces plan to end funding from 1 January 2013. The state secretary reaffirms the agreement, notes provinces may phase out subsidies while statutory client choice and identity-based care rules are met, and says provinces assured careful handling.
Provinces are free to phase out subsidies to institutions, as long as they continue to meet the statutory obligations mentioned above.
Het staat provincies vrij subsidies aan instellingen af te bouwen, zolang zij aan wettelijke verplichtingen zoals hierboven genoemd blijven voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de abortusboot

MPs from ChristenUnie and SGP asked whether the Women on Waves abortion boat's planned visit to Morocco, where abortion is illegal, risks prosecution, whether the government had contact with Morocco, what permits the foundation holds, its past activities and whether it receives subsidy. The minister answered that the trip is a private initiative, that Morocco regards it as an NGO matter, that the Dutch Waz permit requires a temporary permit and IGZ review for the mobile clinic which the foundation has not requested, and that it receives no ministry subsidy.
However, WoW has not applied for the temporary permit.
WoW heeft de tijdelijke vergunning echter niet aangevraagd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Leijten, Van der Staaij en Bruins Slot over het toegenomen aantal zelfdodingen

MPs asked the Minister of Health about the rising number of suicides, the effect of prevention policy, the new suicide treatment guideline, weekend psychiatric care and bank staff training. The minister acknowledged the increase, said the effect of policy is hard to measure, will seek advice from the VU on a target figure, and said weekend crisis care is sufficient while training bank staff is the financial sector's own responsibility.
Given that the absolute number of suicides rose again over the past year, I consulted relevant stakeholders on whether a target figure is possible and desirable.
Mede gezien de omstandigheid dat het absolute aantal suïcides over het afgelopen jaar wederom is gestegen, heb ik overleg gevoerd met betrokken veldpartijen
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink, Van Toorenburg en Van der Staaij over de schadelijke gevolgen door blowen

MPs asked the government about harms of heavy cannabis use among young people, including effects on brain development and psychosis risk, and whether schools should act more strictly and the minimum age for softdrugs be raised to 21. The minister replied that existing drug policy already reflects these risks, that schools are tightening enforcement and drug use is declining, that the research shows no case for raising the age to 21 on current evidence, and that the 350-metre coffeeshop distance rule takes effect in 2014 after a transition period.
This report does not give cause for this at present.
Daartoe geeft dit bericht vooralsnog geen aanleiding.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de arrestatie van een 11-jarig meisje met Down Syndroom vanwege schending van de blasfemiewet in Pakistan

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about the arrest of an 11-year-old girl with Down syndrome under Pakistan's blasphemy law, and whether the Netherlands would seek her release, press Pakistan to repeal or reform the law, and continue funding a legal aid NGO. The minister answered that the girl was released on bail, Pakistan's government ordered an inquiry and an imam was arrested, the Netherlands raised concern discreetly with the EU and via quiet diplomacy, and the embassy already funds a legal aid project for 2011–2013.
For security reasons, the Netherlands, like the EU and the Pakistani government, acts very discreetly in such cases.
Vanwege veiligheidsoverwegingen handelt Nederland evenals de EU, en ook de Pakistaanse overheid, zeer discreet in dergelijke zaken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het systematisch onbestraft blijven van VN'ers na verkrachtingen

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that UN peacekeepers in Congo, among others, are almost never prosecuted after raping minors, and what the UN and the Netherlands have done about it. The minister answered that the UN has a zero-tolerance policy with internal reporting and investigation mechanisms, that the trend in reported cases is declining, that the Netherlands has pushed for conduct rules and a training course, and that the UN reports publicly each year.
The UN pursues a zero-tolerance policy towards personnel who commit serious misconduct.
De VN voert een beleid van zero tolerance jegens personeel dat zich schuldig maakt aan ernstige misdragingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink en Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de relatietherapie

MPs from the ChristenUnie and SGP asked whether the government would follow the CVZ advice to remove relationship therapy from the basic insurance package, and about the costs and child effects of divorce. The state secretary said the government follows the CVZ view that relationship problems fall outside the basic GGZ package because relationships belong to citizens' private sphere, declined a national study of divorce costs, and pointed to municipal support and a forthcoming guidance document for Centra voor Jeugd en Gezin.
We follow the CVZ's judgement, because this contributes to the sustainability of the geneeskundige GGZ package.
Wij volgen het oordeel van het CVZ, omdat hiermee wordt bijgedragen aan de houdbaarheid van het pakket voor geneeskundige GGZ
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Timmermans, De Roon, Ormel, Voordewind en El Fassed over het zwijgen van het Westen over de strafkampen in Noord-Korea

Six MPs asked the foreign minister why the West is silent about North Korea's prison camps, citing the HRNK report and asking about international action and China's refoulement of refugees. The minister acknowledged the report, described UN and bilateral efforts (UN resolutions, UPR, raising the issue at the UNGA, funding a Korean NGO) and said North Korea denies the camps, making dialogue difficult.
The Netherlands will again call on North Korea at the 2012 UN General Assembly to improve the human rights situation in the country, referring to the HRNK report.
Dit zal Nederland niet weerhouden tijdens de AVVN 2012 Noord-Korea opnieuw op te roepen de mensenrechtensituatie in het land te verbeteren met verwijzing naar het rapport van HNRK.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink, De Roon, Van der Staaij en Ormel over het belang van het herdenken van aanslagen

MPs from several parties asked whether the minister would use her influence to persuade the NOC*NSF and the IOC to hold a minute's silence at the London Olympic opening ceremony for the 1972 Munich attack. The minister acknowledged the tragedy but declined to intervene, saying the IOC is autonomous and it is not the government's responsibility to influence its protocols.
No. I do not consider it my responsibility to point this out to the IOC.
Neen. Ik acht het niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid het IOC hierop te wijzen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat C1000 begint met een EK-oorlog

An SGP MP asked the health minister about a supermarket's alcohol discount promotion during the European Championship, asking whether such price wars should be restricted, whether the industry code is adequate, and whether a national ban on below-cost sales should be considered. The minister answered that local municipalities, including new mayoral powers under the amended Drank- en Horecawet, should handle such promotions, that the industry self-regulation code is sufficient, and that no further national legislation is planned.
I consider such measures a matter where local considerations are necessary.
Ik vind dergelijke maatregelen een zaak waar lokale afwegingen noodzakelijk zijn.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ferrier, Van der Staaij, El Fassed, De Lange, Ouwehand, Hachchi en Irrgang over het bericht dat ruim 18 miljoen mensen in de Sahel worden bedreigd door een humanitaire ramp

MPs asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about the Sahel food crisis affecting 18 million people, its urgency, past prevention efforts, Dutch funding levels, disaster risk reduction, and support for smallholders. The State Secretary answered that the situation is very serious, outlined past Dutch development projects, reported modest extra Dutch emergency contributions and planned bilateral and multilateral efforts, but gave no specific DRR funding breakdown and declined to pledge larger increases.
At present so-called aid tracking of DRR activities, labelling the DRR dimension of development cooperation activities, is not yet possible.
Op dit moment is het zogenoemde «aid tracking» van DRR activiteiten, het labellen van de DRR-dimensie van OS activiteiten, nog niet mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over rondreizende radicale moslims

An MP from the SGP asked the ministers whether they share concern about itinerant radical Muslims who reject the democratic rule of law and are ambiguous about violence, and whether the AIVD monitors these youths and their foreign imam contacts. The government shares concern about rejection of democracy and ambiguity toward violence, notes religious outreach is protected by freedom of expression and religion, describes its counterterrorism strategy, and declines to comment publicly on current AIVD investigations while pointing to the AIVD annual report.
We cannot make public statements about current AIVD investigations.
Wij kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over actueel onderzoek van de AIVD.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de evaluatie van het NICAM over de naleving van artikel 240a van het Wetboek van Strafrecht

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Education about the NICAM evaluation of compliance with article 240a of the Criminal Code on age limits for films and games. The state secretary reports that compliance rose from 14% to 49% since 2008, that the government will continue the convenant approach without declaring the Kijkwijzer code generally binding, and that further proposals on internet sales will be sent to parliament by June 2012.
As promised during the committee debate on alcohol policy of 9 February 2012, your House will be informed by letter by June 2012 at the latest.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het AO alcoholbeleid van 9 februari 2012 zal uw Kamer uiterlijk juni 2012 hierover bij brief geïnformeerd worden.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij, Peters, Kortenoeven over de veroordeling van de winnares van de Mensenrechtentulp

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the conviction to two years' imprisonment of human rights lawyer Ni Yulan and her husband was an unfair trial, whether China was pressed for their release, and how China's restrictions on lawyers and new criminal procedure law fit with this. The minister answered that the Netherlands is concerned about the lack of transparency, has conveyed disappointment to Chinese authorities, will raise the case in EU-China human rights consultations, and that the appeal is still pending.
As far as the Netherlands is concerned, this case should also be a topic of discussion during the upcoming EU-China human rights consultations.
Deze zaak zal wat Nederland betreft ook onderwerp van gesprek moeten zijn tijdens de komende EU-China mensenrechtenconsultaties.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon, Van Bommel, Ormel, Ten Broeke en El Fassed over vrouwenrechten in Egypte

MPs from several parties asked the minister of Foreign Affairs about reports of abductions and forced conversions of Coptic girls in Egypt, the link to Salafism, and whether the government would raise women's rights with Egyptian and EU counterparts. The minister said reliable crime statistics are lacking, pointed to Egypt's wider human rights concerns, noted that Dutch government cooperation under Matra-Zuid was suspended, and listed women's rights projects being funded.
The Netherlands stresses, both in bilateral contacts with Egyptian authorities and within the EU, the importance of applying and implementing the rule of law and of countering impunity.

Nederland onderstreept zowel in bilaterale contacten met Egyptische autoriteiten, als in EU-verband, het belang van de toepassing en uitvoering van rechtsstatelijkheid en het belang om straffeloosheid tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Çörüz, Van der Staaij en Ouwehand over vrouwenrechten in Marokko

Five MPs asked the foreign minister about Morocco's Article 475, which lets a rapist avoid prosecution by marrying the victim, following the suicide of Amina Filali, and whether the Netherlands would condemn it, press for repeal via the EU, and what Dutch Matra programme work addresses women's legal inequality. The minister confirmed the article conflicts with Morocco's international obligations, said the matter is for Morocco to reform through its own national debate, and noted the EU human rights dialogue and Dutch-funded women's rights projects in Rabat.
It is not known how often such cases occur.
Het is niet bekend hoe vaak dergelijke zaken voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Kortenoeven over de positie van Assyrische christenen in Irak

Three MPs (Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Kortenoeven) asked the Foreign Minister about the position of Assyrian Christians in Iraq, including a human rights report on their exodus, Dutch support for UNDP projects in Nineveh, police deployment there, and the status of the Zakho attacks investigation. The minister described the UNDP projects and said he would raise concerns about church attacks and police in Nineveh with Iraqi authorities, while noting that some arrests were made and the criminal investigation is ongoing.
I will discuss this shortly with the Iraqi authorities and specifically ask for attention to the deployment of police in Nineveh.
Ik bespreek dit op korte termijn met de Iraakse autoriteiten en vraag daarbij specifiek aandacht voor de inzet van de politie in Nineveh.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Dibi, Samsom en Gesthuizen over de gevolgen van verschillende gerechtelijke uitspraken voor lopende procedures van Iraanse bekeerlingen

MPs from several parties asked the minister how pending CJEU prejudicial questions and an ECtHR interim measure on Iranian converts affect asylum cases, and whether processing and removals should be suspended. The minister replied that the questions do not specifically target Iranian converts, that the interim measure is unreasoned and has no general effect, and that Dutch policy on religious persecution remains unchanged, so no suspension is planned.
The interim measure taken by the European Court of Human Rights is not reasoned.
De door het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens getroffen voorlopige maatregel (interim measure) is niet gemotiveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Van der Staaij inzake de grote verschillen in leges die gemeenten berekenen voor grafrechten

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about large differences between municipalities in cemetery grave fees and whether a cost model has produced transparent cost structures. The Minister acknowledges the differences, says the VNG cost model supports transparency, that fees are set by municipal councils within cost-recovery limits, and that individuals can appeal to the courts.
Applying the cost-justification model leads to a clear justification of the costs the municipality recovers.
Het hanteren van het model van kostenonderbouwing leidt tot een duidelijke onderbouwing van de kosten die de gemeente verhaalt.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij en Voordewind over een oproep van de grootmoefti van Saudi-Arabië om alle kerken op het Arabisch schiereiland te vernietigen.

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the foreign minister about a reported call by Saudi Arabia's grand mufti to destroy all churches in the region, including the influence of the cleric, Saudi authorities' reaction and what the government would do. The minister deplored such statements, said the mufti has no formal political role, raised concerns through the EU with the GCC, and noted that human rights are discussed regularly with Saudi authorities, without committing to new steps beyond that.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Timmermans, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij en Dibi over het bericht dat speciale milities in Irak jacht maken op homoseksuele, biseksuele, lesbische en transgender Irakezen

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Affairs and Immigration ministers whether reports of militias hunting LGBT Iraqis are confirmed, whether Iraq's interior ministry should be challenged, and whether LGBT asylum seekers should be returned to Iraq. Minister Rosenthal confirmed the reports, said the Dutch embassy warned Iraqi officials, stated Nederland currently funds no related projects, and pointed to a more lenient policy for this group.
Antwoord vragen De Roon, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

MPs De Roon, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the minister of Foreign Affairs whether the UN Human Rights Council's adoption of several resolutions critical of Israel, and a fact-finding mission, was disproportionate compared with its one resolution on Syria, and what the government would do about it. The minister agreed the number and character of the Israel resolutions were disproportionate, said the Netherlands argues for proportionality and has raised the concern within the EU and the UN, and answered all questions.
I consider the number of Israel resolutions and their character to be disproportionate.
Ik acht het aantal Israël-resoluties en het karakter ervan disproportioneel.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Kortenoeven over het bericht dat een kerk in Koeweit mogelijk voor Goede Vrijdag gesloten wordt

Three MPs asked the foreign minister whether a Kuwaiti evangelical church would close before Good Friday following a Saudi fatwa, and whether the government would protest or summon Kuwait's ambassador. The minister answered that the church is not closing and services will proceed, saw no reason to summon the ambassador, and noted no change in Kuwaiti policy toward churches.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ormel en Voordewind over 'de sluiting van een christelijke kerk door de Palestijnse Autoriteit'

Four MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Palestinian Authority intends to force the First Baptist Church in Bethlehem to close, and what the background is. The minister answered that the PA says it has no plan to close the church, that the church issued marriage and birth certificates without authorisation and was asked to stop or meet legal requirements, and that Christians enjoy religious freedom in the Palestinian territories.
As previously indicated, there is no intention to close the Baptist congregation in Bethlehem.
Zoals al eerder aangegeven is er geen voornemen de Baptistengemeente in Bethlehem te sluiten.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van Klaveren, Van der Staaij en Sterk over de komst van een extremistische imam naar Nederland

MPs asked whether statements by an extremist imam, Al Haddad, that the minister called reprehensible, possibly including calls to violence, justified refusing his entry into the Netherlands, and how entry decisions are made. The minister answered that the statements may not be criminal in isolation, that without concrete indications of serious threat entry could not lawfully be refused, and that entry decisions for EU and non-EU nationals follow Schengen rules and case-by-case checks.
The law does not give me the room to refuse someone entry to the Netherlands solely on the basis of his statements, without concrete indications of imminent serious criminal offences.
De wet biedt mij niet de ruimte om zonder concrete aanwijzingen voor dreigende ernstige strafbare feiten iemand de toegang tot Nederland te ontzeggen louter op basis van zijn uitspraken.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij, Kortenoeven, Timmermans, Pechtold, Ormel en Voordewind over Chinese deportaties van Noord-Koreaanse vluchtelingen naar hun vaderland

Six MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that China continues to deport North Korean refugees and what the government is doing about it, including pressing China, supporting South Korea at the UN Human Rights Council, and pursuing arbitration with UNHCR. The minister answered that the government is concerned and has raised non-refoulement with China, but China rejects the refugee label and treats the matter as bilateral, so no concrete change is expected.
Both the Netherlands and the EU have previously raised with China the principle of non-refoulement and advocated UNHCR access.
Zowel Nederland als de EU heeft China eerder aangesproken op het principe van non-refoulement en toegang van UNHCR bepleit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over Palestijnse ophitsing ten aanzien van de Joden

An SGP MP asked the foreign minister how the government judges a Palestinian mufti's public call to kill Jews and whether it will sanction the Palestinian Authority or limit its funding. The minister condemned the statements, said they violate the Roadmap and the ICCPR, and declined sanctions for now, instead urging the PA to act and reviving trilateral talks.
Punishing the PA will not contribute to restarting the peace talks at this time.
Bestraffing van de PA zal op dit moment niet bijdragen aan de herstart van de vredesbesprekingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en De Roon over de bevindingen van het boek Deception

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the book 'Deception' documenting Palestinian Authority incitement and glorification of terrorism, and whether Dutch aid should be conditioned on tackling it. The minister acknowledged the statements as unacceptable but argued the PA cannot be held responsible for every media statement, referred the matter to revived trilateral talks and EU channels, and rejected monthly conditional aid payments as counterproductive to peace talks.
In all its contacts with the PA, the government points to the need to counter incitement and glorification of violence.
Het kabinet wijst in al zijn contacten met de PA op de noodzaak haatzaaien en geweldverheerlijking tegen te gaan.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij over het ontbreken van richtlijnen voor huisartsen over een gesprek over ongewenste zwangerschap

MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked whether GPs have adequate guidance and training to discuss alternatives with women facing unwanted pregnancy, citing research showing alternatives are rarely discussed. Minister Schippers replied that the GP plays an important role, but that the content of GP training and professional development is for the profession itself, and she sees no need for new measures.
I see no need for any intentions on my part in this area.
Ik zie geen noodzaak tot enige voornemens van mijn zijde op dit vlak.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Staphorst censureert abortusinformatie CJG’

An SGP MP asked the state secretary whether the Staphorst municipality's censorship of abortion information on the CJG website is compatible with municipal freedom and whether the state will mediate for a model website. The state secretary answered that municipalities decide themselves what information to provide, that VWS's role is facilitating, and that the foundation Opvoeden.nl is examining possible improvements while the board includes municipal representatives.
Municipalities themselves decide on the information they wish to provide to their residents.
Gemeenten beslissen zelf over de informatie die zij willen verstrekken aan hun inwoners.
Antwoord vragen Van der Veen en Van der Staaij over de beslissingsmacht van zorgverzekeraars over een ambulancepost op Walcheren

MPs Van der Veen and Van der Staaij asked whether the minister remains responsible for keeping the Walcheren ambulance post open, given that the NZa and insurers could let it close, and how this fits the 45-minute norm and her responsibility for vital care. The minister answered that the NZa independently assessed the request, approved retroactive extra budget for the ambulance service, and that responsibility for acute care is clearly divided between insurers, the NZa and the RAV.
I will ask the NZa to add these funds to the budget of the RAVZ.
Ik zal de NZa verzoeken deze middelen aan het budget van de RAVZ toe te voegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Klaveren, Van der Staaij, Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga en Ormel over de komst van een extremistische imam naar Nederland

MPs asked whether a British cleric known for antisemitic and misogynistic statements, invited to a VU symposium, should be barred from entering the Netherlands. The government answered that it had examined an entry ban but found the statements insufficient grounds under EU free-movement rules, which require a current, genuine and serious threat to public order.
The objectionable statements, however, are insufficient indication that such a danger exists.
De verwerpelijke uitspraken zijn echter onvoldoende aanwijzing dat een dergelijk gevaar aan de orde is.

Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het ontbreken van een warme overdracht door het stoppen van de subsidie voor Het Scharlaken Koord in Deventer per 1 januari 2012 (in

The SGP MP asks the Justice Minister about the Deventer municipality ending subsidy for the Scharlaken Koord prostitution exit programme without a warm handover, despite positive evaluation results. The minister says the municipality will continue the programme and is seeking to secure it, that existing trajectories can be completed, and sees no reason for further consultation.
The municipality of Deventer has indicated it will continue the exit programme and is currently looking for ways to secure it.
De gemeente Deventer heeft aangegeven te zullen doorgaan met het uitstapprogramma en is momenteel op zoek naar mogelijkheden om dat te borgen.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), De Roon (PVV), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Ormel (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over de arrestatie van twee leiders van de op te richten christendemocratische part

Four MPs asked the foreign minister about the arrest of two leaders of an intended Christian Democratic party in Belarus, whether it was linked to the party's founding, and what the government would do. The minister answered that the two were detained to prevent them attending a party congress, condemned the ongoing repression, and said Netherlands and the EU would continue to raise the matter bilaterally, in the OSCE and at the UN, and through expanded EU sanctions criteria.
I strongly condemn the ongoing repression.
Ik veroordeel de voortdurende repressie scherp.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Dijkhoff (VVD), Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Kortenoeven (PVV) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie van tientallen Turkse journalisten, acad

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister how the government judges the Turkish police arrest of dozens of journalists, writers and publishers, whether the charges link to publications on the Armenian genocide, and what Dutch steps and EU accession consequences follow. The minister answered that detainees are held pending a formal indictment under anti-terror law, that press freedom is under growing pressure, and that the Netherlands raises this bilaterally and in the EU, with Turkey unable to join until it meets the accession conditions.
The Netherlands raises with the Turkish government, both bilaterally and through the EU, the importance of press freedom and freedom of expression for Turkey's democratic reform process.
Nederland spreekt zowel bilateraal als via de EU de Turkse regering aan op het belang van persvrijheid en vrijheid van meningsuiting voor het democratisch hervormingsproces in Turkije.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Van der Veen (Pvda), Van Gerven (SP) en Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het uitblijven van een structurele financiering van de to

Four MPs asked the health minister why structural funding for an extra ambulance post on Walcheren remains unsecured despite earlier commitments and a parliamentary motion. The minister said she asked the NZa in spring 2011 to expand the regional ambulance budget retroactively, but the NZa still lacks correct data from the regional service and insurers, and promised a decision within weeks.
The assessment of this request is for the NZa.
De beoordeling van dit verzoek is aan de NZa.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouten (ChristenUnie), Ferrier (CDA), Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Dijkhoff (VVD), Van der Staaij (SGP), Dikkers (PvdA), Gesthuizen (SP) en Hachchi (D66)

Ten MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about child labour in Turkish hazelnut harvesting one year after it was first reported, including whether enforcement is adequate, whether companies are meeting their responsibilities, and the status of various studies and working groups. The government answered that the problem lies mainly with Turkey, that the embassy raised it with Turkish authorities and funds a study, that industry bodies have adopted guidelines and a Turkish action plan exists, but that it could not confirm concrete results of the Turkish working group and could not answer in time for the scheduled debate.
The cabinet will continue to raise this issue within the EU framework, including in the Council conclusions.
Het kabinet zal hier in EU-kader aandacht voor blijven vragen, ook in de Raadsconclusies.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Dijsselbloem (PvdA), Kooiman (SP), Koşer Kaya (D66), Voortman (GroenLinks) en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn e

Six MPs asked the state secretary of Health why the Stichting Adoptievoorzieningen faces an extra structural cut to its aftercare subsidy on top of an earlier 1.5% efficiency cut, and whether this is disproportionate given a further cut from Justice. The state secretary answered that the cuts are justified by falling adoption numbers, that adoption-specific aftercare will largely remain, and that alternatives exist, and left the decision on a pending SGP amendment to the Chamber.
The budget cut obligation has forced me to make choices.
De bezuinigingstaakstelling heeft mij genoodzaakt keuzes te maken.

Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de verkrijgbaarheid van levensgevaarlijke abortuspillen via internet (ingezonden 29 septem

An SGP MP asked the health and justice ministers whether abortion pills sold online are dangerous, which countries host the sites, and what the IGZ can do against foreign sellers. The minister answered that the IGZ's jurisdiction is limited to Dutch entities, that Dutch law prohibits online prescribing without a prior doctor-patient contact but lacks a sanction yet, and that a warning was posted on a government website.
The IGZ can, where needed, contact counterpart organisations in other countries with a request to take action there.
De IGZ kan in voorkomende gevallen contact opnemen met collega-organisaties met het verzoek om in het betreffende land actie te ondernemen.

Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Omtzigt (beiden CDA), Timmermans (PvdA), De Roon (PVV), Van Bommel (SP), Schouw (D66), Voordewind (CU), Thieme (PvdD) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het a

MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that the UK had secretly banned Russian officials linked to the death of lawyer Magnitsky from entering, whether Russian investigations could still be trusted, and whether the Netherlands would ban the same officials. The minister replied that no visa ban was introduced by the UK or US, that Russia has continued prosecuting doctors, and that the Netherlands would raise the matter as it has before, without committing to a new measure.
The government has repeatedly expressed its concern about the death of Mr Magnitsky and the circumstances under which he died.
De regering heeft herhaaldelijk haar zorg uitgesproken over de dood van de heer Magnitsky en over de omstandigheden waaronder hij is overleden

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het verheerlijken van terrorisme door de Palestijnse Autoriteit (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and De Roon asked the foreign minister whether the Palestinian Authority glorifies terrorism through statements by Abbas's adviser, street naming, and prisoner and family payments, and how this squares with earlier answers and the adopted motion to cut aid. The minister answered that the statements cannot be confirmed in context, the government rejects glorification of terror, the issue is raised in EU human rights dialogue, prisoner aid is a standard welfare practice, and there is no structural PA policy of glorifying terrorism, so no aid cut is warranted.
In light of the above answers, I currently see no reason to end bilateral or EU development cooperation with the PA.
In het licht van bovenstaande antwoorden zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding om de bilaterale of de EU-ontwikkelingssamenwerking met de PA te beëindigen.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), De Roon en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de verheerlijking van gew

Opposition MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP and PVV asked the Foreign Minister why the Palestinian Authority glorifies terrorism and pays salaries and prisoner allowances to terrorists, despite Dutch funding, and whether Dutch aid should be cut. The minister acknowledged sympathy for terrorism among part of the population, said PA leaders distance themselves from terrorism, rejected that the aid funded terrorist payments, and saw no reason to halt the payments or the Dutch contribution.
I see no reason to call on the PA to revise this arrangement.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de PA op te roepen deze regeling te herzien.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Kortenoeven (PVV), Ormel (CDA) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het oppakken door de Oezbeekse politie van vier christenen (ingezonden 29

MPs from SGP, PVV, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the foreign minister about the arrest of four Christians by Uzbek police, the number of Christians jailed for their faith, the worsening pressure on religious groups, and EU and Dutch action. The minister replied that the four were released without interrogation after one day, that the exact number of jailed Christians is unknown, and that the EU raises religious freedom and individual cases in its human rights dialogue.
The group of four was released after one day in detention.
Het viertal is na een dag hechtenis vrijgelaten.

Vragen namens de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie van de Chinese huiskerkleider Shi Enhao (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011).

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the foreign minister whether China's treatment of Christians has structurally worsened, whether the ambassador will be summoned over the administrative detention of house-church leader Shi Enhao, and whether China will be urged to ratify the ICCPR. The minister answered that Christians in unregistered house churches are tolerated but lack legal protection, that Dutch concerns will be raised via EU channels and bilateral human rights consultations, and that China has no timetable for ratification.
The Netherlands, partly within the EU, strongly advocates better legal protection for Chinese people subject to this kind of administrative measures and detention.
Nederland maakt zich mede in EU-verband sterk voor betere rechtsbescherming van Chinezen aan wie dit soort administratieve maatregelen en detenties worden opgelegd.

Vragen namens de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en De Roon (PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het terugdraaien van het besluit om de tegoeden van IHH-N

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP and PVV asked whether the government would appeal a court ruling that suspended the freezing of IHH-Nederland's assets over alleged Hamas links, and how it could guarantee funds do not reach Hamas, including via IHH-Germany. The minister answered that the government argued in court for keeping the freeze, that the ruling is only a provisional measure with no appeal possible, that the objection has now been rejected so IHH-Nederland can take the matter to the administrative court, and that German authorities supervise IHH-Germany's finances so no separate information request is planned.
However, no appeal is possible against the ruling of the provisional relief judge.
Tegen de uitspraak van de voorlopige voorzieningenrechter is echter geen beroep mogelijk.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), De Roon (PVV) en Ormel (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de verwijzing naar de islamitische wetgeving in de «routekaart» van de Transit

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, PVV and CDA asked the foreign minister about the TNC Libya roadmap's reference to Islam as state religion and sharia as main legislative source, and whether this affects recognition of the TNC. The minister answered that the draft charter guarantees religious freedom and non-discrimination, that the NTC does not aim for a strict Islamic regime, and that Libya itself decides on a state religion while being bound by the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.
It is up to (the 'new') Libya to determine whether it wants a state religion, and if so which one.
Het is aan (het «nieuwe») Libië om te bepalen of het een staatsgodsdienst wil, en zo ja welke.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), Spekman (PvdA) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de eventuele uitzetting van een Iraanse vrouw en haar twee kinderen (in

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, PvdA and SP asked the immigration minister about the possible expulsion of an Iranian woman and her two children, and about a pending new country report on Iran. The minister replied that expulsion is not currently imminent because a follow-up asylum application was filed, that the report and new country report were sent to parliament, and that the family may await the decision in the Netherlands.
There is currently no question of an imminent expulsion of the woman and her children.
Van een dreigende uitzetting van de vrouw en haar kinderen is thans geen sprake.
Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse zaken over consequenties van het korten op OS-budget ten behoeve van onderwijs (ingezonden 6 september 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about the consequences of donor withdrawal from education aid in developing countries, citing a Fast Track Initiative report warning of risks to students. The State Secretary acknowledges the report, says the Dutch exit is phased over 2-3 years with partner consultation and a EUR 120 million FTI contribution, and states that EU coordination is ongoing though not yet agreed.
In line with my commitment during the General Consultation on the Focus letter in June, I will inform you further on this before the budget debate.
Conform mijn toezegging, tijdens het Algemeen Overleg over de Focusbrief in juni, zal ik u hierover voor de Begrotingsbehandeling nader informeren.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP) en Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de maatregelen tegen gewetensbezwaarde ambtenaren in Groningen (ingezonden 5 augustus 201

MPs Van der Staaij and Slob asked the minister about Groningen not renewing the contracts of three civil-registry officials with conscientious objections to same-sex marriage, and whether such measures are justified. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for personnel policy within legal bounds, that practical solutions are for the municipality to assess, and that he will not take measures against municipalities requiring officials to perform all marriages given local autonomy.
Given municipal autonomy, I do not intend to take measures against municipalities that impose as a job requirement that an official must conduct all marriages.
Gelet op de gemeentelijke autonomie ben ik niet voornemens maatregelen te treffen tegen gemeenten die als functie-eis stellen dat een ambtenaar alle huwelijken moet sluiten.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), De Roon (PVV) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over steun van de gemeente Vlaardingen aan ini

MPs asked the ministers whether the municipality of Vlaardingen and its mayor, through subsidies and participation in a Palestinian event, supported the Gaza flotilla and anti-Israel activity, and whether this fits the law and the government's Middle East policy. The minister answered that the mayor attended in a civic capacity, that the municipality had no subsidy relationship with the organisations named, and that the government would intervene if a local authority supported antisemitic or terrorist organisations.
The government therefore does not consider the conduct of the municipality of Vlaardingen and of the mayor in this matter to be targeted support for the Gaza flotilla.
Het optreden van de gemeente Vlaardingen en van de burgemeester in onderliggende kwestie beschouwt de regering derhalve niet als gerichte ondersteuning van de Gaza-vloot.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Immigratie en Asiel over de dreigende doodstraf voor de Iraanse predikant Yoesef Nadarkhani (ingezonden
