Asks the government to immediately reverse the excise increases on LPG and diesel because border petrol stations are in trouble.
border petrol station operators have run into serious problems as a result of the excise increases this cabinet has implemented
de pomphouders aan de grens in grote problemen zijn gekomen als gevolg van de accijnsverhogingen die dit kabinet heeft doorgevoerd
Motie van het lid Nijboer c.s. over een systeem waarbij de risico's op staatsobligaties in de kapitaalseisen worden meegewogen
Motion asks the government to push in Europe for bank capital rules that weigh the risk of sovereign bonds instead of giving them zero weight.
requests the government to advocate for this in European context
verzoekt de regering, zich hiervoor sterk te maken in Europees verband
Motie van het lid Merkies over meer openbaarheid in de discussie over belastingafdracht van multinationals
Asks the government to explore greater public openness in the debate on multinationals' tax payments, given confidentiality of the European Commission's state aid inquiry.
requests the government to explore possibilities for more openness in the debate on tax payments by multinationals
verzoekt de regering, mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om in de discussie over belastingafdracht van multinationals meer openbaarheid te betrachten
Motie van het lid Merkies over uitvoeren van een impact assessment
Asks the government to carry out an impact assessment before concluding new tax treaties with developing countries.
requests the government, when concluding new tax treaties with developing countries, to carry out an impact assessment
verzoekt de regering, bij het aangaan van nieuwe belastingverdragen met ontwikkelingslanden een impact assessment uit te voeren
Amendement van de leden Bashir en Merkies over het regelen van een voorhangprocedure zodat de Staten-Generaal mee kan praten (indien nodig) over voor welke lichamen informatieverplichtingen gelden en

Adds a pre-consultation procedure so the States General receive a draft general administrative order at least four weeks before it is adopted, covering which bodies face information duties and the substantive requirements.
The draft general administrative order referred to in the fifth paragraph is sent to the States General at least four weeks before the regulation is adopted.
Het ontwerp van een algemene maatregel van bestuur als bedoeld in het vijfde lid wordt ten minste vier weken voordat de regeling wordt vastgesteld, toegezonden aan de Staten-Generaal.
Motie van het lid Merkies over een evaluatie van de effecten van de resolutieheffing op de kredietverlening
Asks the government to have an independent party evaluate the effects of the resolution levy on lending.
requests the government to have the effects of the resolution levy on lending evaluated by an independent party
verzoekt de regering, de effecten van de resolutieheffing op de kredietverlening door een onafhankelijke partij te laten evalueren
Motie van de leden Van Bommel en Merkies over het opheffen van de Benelux Unie
Asks the government to negotiate with Belgium and Luxembourg to dissolve the Benelux Union.
requests the government to consult with Belgium and Luxembourg to dissolve the Benelux Union
verzoekt de regering, in overleg te treden met België en Luxemburg om te komen tot het opheffen van de Benelux Unie
Motie van de leden Van Hijum en Merkies over een onderzoek naar de uitvoerbaarheid van decentralisaties
Asks the government to have an independent body such as the Rekenkamer or CPB examine the feasibility of the decentralisations with VNG and take the results into account in the legislative process.
requests the government, together with the VNG, to have the feasibility of the individual decentralisations examined by an independent party, such as the Rekenkamer or the CPB
verzoekt de regering om, samen met de VNG de uitvoerbaarheid van de afzonderlijke decentralisaties nader te laten onderzoeken door een onafhankelijke partij, zoals de Rekenkamer of het CPB
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Hijum c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 9 over investeren in energiebesparende maatregelen
Shifts 50 million euro within the Wonen en Rijksdienst budget to a revolving fund for energy-saving measures in the built environment.
In article 2 Living environment and construction, the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by 50,000 (x 1000 euros).
In artikel 2 Woonomgeving en bouw worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 50.000 (x € 1000).
Amendement van het lid Van Hijum c.s. dat beoogt een budget van 50 miljoen euro vrij te maken voor het investeren in energiebesparingsmaatregelen in de gebouwde omgeving
Moves 50 million euro within the housing budget to fund energy-saving investments in the built environment, with offsetting cuts elsewhere.
This amendment aims to free up a budget of 50 million euro for investing in energy-saving measures in the built environment.
Dit amendement beoogt een budget van 50 miljoen euro vrij te maken voor het investeren in energiebesparingsmaatregelen in de gebouwde omgeving
Amendement van het lid Van Hijum c.s. over een taakstelling op de ambtelijke organisatie
Cuts 45 thousand euro from the central civil-service apparatus as a spending target within a package of budget amendments.
This amendment arranges a spending target on the civil-service organisation.
Dit amendement regelt een taakstelling op de ambtelijke organisatie.
Amendement van het lid Van Hijum c.s. over investeren in energiebesparende maatregelen
Increases the housing and construction budget by 50 million euro to fund energy-saving investments in buildings.
The departmental budget statement is amended as follows: in article 4 Housing environment and construction, the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by 50,000 (x 1,000 euro).
De departementale begrotingsstaat wordt als volgt gewijzigd: In artikel 4 Woonomgeving en bouw worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 50 000 (x € 1 000).

Amendement van het lid Van Hijum c.s. over het vrijmaken van een budget van 10 miljoen euro voor het bieden van de mogelijkheid een pilot te starten om te bekijken op welke manier saldering van de ene
Earmarks 10 million euro in the energy budget for a pilot to explore netting energy bills beyond one's own roof.
This amendment aims to free up a budget of 10 million euros for offering the possibility of starting a pilot
Dit amendement beoogt een budget van 10 miljoen euro vrij te maken voor het bieden van de mogelijkheid een pilot te starten
Amendement van het lid Van Hijum c.s. over het vrijmaken van een budget van 20 miljoen voor milieuvriendelijke investeringen ten behoeve van de verduurzaming van de agrosector
Amendment earmarks 20 million euros for environmentally friendly investments in sustainable agriculture, funded by a package of budget shifts.
this amendment aims to free a budget of 20 million euros for environmentally friendly investments for sustainable agriculture
dit amendement beoogt een budget van 20 miljoen euro vrij te maken voor milieuvriendelijke investeringen ten behoeve van de verduurzaming van de agrosector
Amendement van het lid Van Hijum c.s. over het verhogen van de kartelboetes
Raises the revenue estimate for cartel fines by 75 million euros in the budget as part of a package of offsetting measures.
This amendment provides that cartel fines are increased.
Dit amendement regelt dat de kartelboetes worden verhoogd.
Amendement van het lid Van Hijum c.s. over het terugdraaien van de afbouw van de werkgeversvoet
Adds 90 million euro to childcare to largely reverse the cut to the fixed employer share in the first-child tariff table.
This amendment provides that the phase-out of the fixed employer share of 33% in the first-child allowance table is largely reversed.
Dit amendement regelt dat de afbouw van de vaste werkgeversvoet van 33% in de toeslagtabel van het eerste kind grotendeels wordt teruggedraaid.
Amendement van het lid Van Hijum c.s. over het invoeren van een verplicht quotum van arbeidsgehandicapte werknemers bij de overheid
Amendment reducing the labour market budget by 10 million euro to introduce a mandatory quota for employing disabled workers in the government as an example function.
This amendment provides for the introduction of a mandatory quota for government employers to hire disabled workers, to serve as an example.
Dit amendement regelt de invoering van een verplicht quotum voor de overheid voor het in dienst nemen van arbeidsgehandicapten, teneinde als voorbeeldfunctie te fungeren.
Amendement van het lid Van Hijum c.s. over de verlaging van topinkomens in de zorg
Cuts 40 million euro from the nominal and unforeseen budget item to lower top salaries of healthcare executives.
This amendment aims to lower top incomes of healthcare executives by 40 million euros.
Dit amendement strekt tot verlaging van de topinkomens van bestuurders in de zorg met € 40 miljoen

Amendement van het lid Van Hijum c.s. over het in 2013 onder het verlaagde btw-tarief brengen van renovatie- en herstelwerkzaamheden, met uitzondering van materialen die een deel vertegenwoordigen van
Amends tax rules: VAT rate on renovation work, the flat-rate allowance of the work-cost scheme, a 3000 km limit for classic cars, and reintroduction of a waste tax.
A component is added to article III: in article 31a the percentages in the second and fifth paragraphs are lowered by 0.1 percentage point.

Aan artikel III wordt een onderdeel toegevoegd, luidende: E In artikel 31a worden het in het tweede lid, aanhef, laatstgenoemde percentage en de in het vijfde lid genoemde percentages verlaagd met 0,1%-punt.
Amendement van het lid Van Hijum c.s. nr. 11 over verhoging van het agenderingsrecht naar 3%
Requires shareholders who request an agenda item to disclose their long and short economic positions in shares and instruments.
This amendment aims to tighten the proposed increase of the agenda right to 3% with a scheme for disclosure.
Dit amendement strekt ertoe de voorgestelde verhoging van het agenderingsrecht naar 3% aan te scherpen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat de Zwitserse kiezer belastingherziening blokkeert

Merkies (SP) asked whether the government shares the European Commission's disappointment that Swiss voters rejected a corporate tax reform, whether Switzerland still fails international standards, and what steps Switzerland must take to avoid the EU blacklist. Wiebes answered that Switzerland remains committed to BEPS minimum standards, that a new proposal is expected, and that it is too early to say what is needed to stay off the blacklist.
I have good hope that the Swiss government will soon come with a new proposal that meets the international obligations.
Ik heb goede hoop dat de Zwitserse regering in de nabije toekomst met een nieuw voorstel zal komen dat aan de internationale verplichtingen voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Smaling over een mogelijk tekort aan accountants die gemeentelijke jaarrekeningen controleren

MPs Merkies and Smaling asked whether a shortage of accountants auditing municipal annual accounts threatens timely audit opinions, and whether decentralisations and the Omgevingswet strain municipal staff. The government acknowledges some tender failures and capacity pressure, relies on market forces and new entrants, and says municipalities bear responsibility for their own staffing.
The equipping of the civil service is, within the administrative relations, the responsibility of municipalities as independent tier of government.
Het toegerust zijn van het ambtenarenapparaat is binnen de bestuurlijke verhoudingen de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten als zelfstandige bestuurslaag.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Merkies over het bericht 'Nederlandse banken vanaf nu vaag over kapitaaleis'

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether the ECB had asked banks to stop disclosing the overall capital requirement (guidance) and what risks non-disclosure poses to financial stability. The minister denied any ECB request, said only the MDA-relevant requirements must be published, that DNB will inform banks they may disclose guidance voluntarily, and that transparency generally helps; he gave no list of past panic cases.
I do not have all these occurring cases available.
Ik heb al deze voorkomende gevallen niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Merkies en Smaling over de mate waarin Nederlandse verzekeraars zich inzetten voor toegang van mensen in arme landen tot medicijnen

SP MPs asked why Dutch insurers score poorly on health and access to medicines in responsible investment rankings, and what the government will do about it. The minister said several insurers have not signed the Access to Medicine Index investor statement, but that the sector is being engaged through a planned IMVO covenant and that DNB oversees insurers' prudential risk management without setting investment policy.
The investment policy of insurers is primarily the responsibility of those insurers themselves.
Het investeringsbeleid van verzekeraars is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van die verzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat president Trump van de Verenigde Staten nieuwe bankenregels terugdraait

MP Merkies (SP) asked the Finance Minister how Trump's executive order reviewing Dodd-Frank bank rules would affect Dutch consumers, derivatives regulation, Basel IV and EU banking supervision. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the order only tasks the FSOC with a review, that no concrete changes exist yet, and that Dutch and EU rules are not directly affected, while DNB has sufficient tools to respond.
The decree itself contains no concrete measures and is for now mainly a signal about the principles the new American government values.
Het decreet zelf bevat geen concrete maatregelen en is vooralsnog vooral een signaal ten aanzien van de uitgangspunten waaraan de nieuwe Amerikaanse regering waarde hecht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over de gevolgen van het handelsverdrag tussen de EU en Canada (CETA) en het handelsverdrag voor de handel in diensten (Trade in Services Agreement, TiSA)

Two SP MPs asked the Ministers of Foreign Trade and Finance about financial-sector risks, regulatory room, investor rights, TiSA services liberalisation and ILO standards under CETA and TiSA. The minister answered at length, largely defending the agreements, while committing to continued attention to ILO standards, a Broad Trade Consultation, and quarterly overviews of trade negotiations.
To increase transparency, the cabinet sends the House of Representatives a quarterly overview of all ongoing EU trade agreement negotiations with third countries.
Om de transparantie te vergroten stuurt het kabinet de Tweede Kamer elk kwartaal een overzicht van alle lopende onderhandelingen over handelsakkoorden van de EU met derde landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Merkies over betrokkenheid van ABN Amro bij de aanleg van de Dakota Access-oliepijpleiding en het neerslaan van protesten daartegen

MPs Gesthuizen and Merkies asked the Finance Minister about ABN AMRO's involvement in the Dakota Access pipeline, whether the state (via NLFI) is liable, whether it will investigate alleged human rights abuses against protesters, and how the banking CSR covenant applies. The minister answered that ABN AMRO is not in the financing consortium, that NLFI is not responsible for its investments, that the US legal system is the proper forum, and that complaints can go to the OECD National Contact Point.
It is not for the Dutch government to investigate this.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse overheid om hier onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over wurgkredieten

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister about 'wurgkredieten' (revolving credit where high interest leaves consumers unable to repay), whether the AFM enforced sufficiently, and whether intermediaries and debt advisers need licences and whether the commission regime is adequate. The minister confirms such cases persist, describes AFM-driven remediation plans due by end 2017, and defends the licensing and commission rules while deferring any change until the 2017 evaluation of the commission ban.
The AFM closely monitors the progress of market parties and will, where necessary, proceed to formal enforcement.
De AFM houdt de voortgang van marktpartijen scherp in de gaten en zal indien nodig overgaan tot formele handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht “Nederland notoire dwarsligger in aanpak van belastingontwijking”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about Dutch resistance to EU anti-tax-avoidance measures, including a 10% minimum tax on royalties and interest, rulings exchange, the participation exemption and hybrid mismatches with the US. The State Secretary answered that the 10% compromise was dropped for lack of unanimity, that Dutch positions were defended on efficiency grounds, and that the government would send its position on the hybrid mismatch proposal later.
The government's position on this proposal will, as usual, be sent to your House in the form of a BNC fiche.
Het kabinetsstandpunt over dit voorstel zal zoals gebruikelijk in de vorm van een BNC-fiche naar uw Kamer worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over 'gratis geld voor bedrijven' als gevolg van het ECB-beleid

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about ECB bond-buying (CSPP) giving large firms cheap credit, its fairness to SMEs, which firms' bonds were bought, and whether the program amounts to subsidy and conflicts with the ECB mandate. The minister answered that the ECB policy is not sector-specific, that the bond list and purchase volumes per security are not published as market-sensitive, and that the Treaty mandate is for the ECB to assess, not the cabinet.
No list of corporate bonds bought under the CSPP is published, because this is market-sensitive information.
Er wordt geen lijst van onder het CSPP opgekochte bedrijfsobligaties gepubliceerd, omdat dit marktgevoelige informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Smaling over het bericht “Nederland faciliteert omstreden bouwproject”

Two SP MPs asked whether Dutch-based shell companies facilitate HKND's Nicaragua canal project that allegedly violates human rights and harms the environment, and what the government did about warnings. The government answered that tax authorities cannot assess human rights, that trust offices must screen integrity risks and DNB supervises them but cannot share its findings, that concerns were shared with Nicaragua and Dutch firms, and that Dutch firms should apply due diligence.
Whether TMF Group adequately performed its gatekeeper function in this case is supervisory-confidential information and therefore cannot be shared by DNB.
Of TMF Group in dit geval zijn poortwachterfunctie adequaat heeft uitgevoerd, is toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie en kan derhalve niet door DNB worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het UNCTAD-rapport 'Trade Misinvoicing in Primary Commodities in Developing Countries'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about a UNCTAD report alleging systematic export overinvoicing of primary commodities to the Netherlands, implying missing import data and possible capital flight or tax avoidance. The State Secretary answered that the figures may reflect plausible explanations such as buyer nationality, resale during transport, and changed destinations, denied that data is missing, saw no evidence of capital flight or tax avoidance, and declined to adopt the recommended country and company level research.
I have no indications that the differences were caused by efforts toward capital flight or tax avoidance.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de verschillen zijn veroorzaakt door het streven naar kapitaalvlucht of belastingontwijking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over de aanpak van de Griekse schuldencrisis door het IMF naar aanleiding van het evaluatierapport van het IEO (Independent Evaluation Office)

An MP asked the Finance Minister how to respond to the IEO evaluation criticising the IMF's handling of the Greek and eurozone crises, including alleged political pressure from the European Commission, the debt restructuring decision, and whether an independent review of the Dutch role is needed. The minister rejects the claim of political interference, defends the IMF's independence and debt analysis, welcomes the IEO recommendations, and declines a separate independent inquiry, pointing to existing audits and evaluations.
I welcome the IEO report on the eurocrisis and the recommendations the evaluation office has formulated.
Ik verwelkom het IEO- rapport van de eurocrisis en de aanbevelingen die de evaluatiedienst geformuleerd heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper Van Dijk en Merkies over defensiebedrijven die via Nederland belasting ontwijken

MPs Van Dijk and Merkies asked whether large defence companies use Dutch holdings to avoid tax, how much corruption and holding data is tracked, and whether research into the sector's use of the Dutch tax climate is needed. The State Secretary answered that such data is not kept, corruption is addressed through EU and national anti-money-laundering and criminal rules, and that no specific sector-focused research is planned.
This data is not kept as such.
Deze gegevens worden niet als zodanig bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over de belangenverstrengeling van belastinghoogleraren

MPs Van Dijk and Merkies asked about the affiliations of tax professors with accountancy and law firms, conflicts of interest, lobbying influence on tax policy, and a register of side jobs. The government answered that such side jobs are acceptable under the Dutch research code, that transparency is required through university websites, that consultation and advice paragraphs are used, and that it sees no need for a national register.
It is the responsibility of civil servants, the cabinet and MPs to reach balanced judgments based on available information and by listening to the views of parties involved.

Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van ambtenaren, het kabinet en Kamerleden om op basis van beschikbare informatie en door te luisteren naar geluiden van betrokken partijen tot afgewogen oordelen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Jasper van Dijk over de productie van euromunten

MPs Merkies and Jasper van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Royal Dutch Mint's use of Poongsan roundels, a supplier also linked to cluster munitions, and about ministry oversight of state-owned enterprises. The State Secretary answered that the Mint raised the issue with the MDWG, that the ministry approves roundel orders and will block Poongsan purchases while it makes cluster munitions, and that the state will use the case as a general warning to other state holdings.

As promised in the General Consultation of 2 June on the KNM, the ministry will also in future ensure through the coin contract that no Poonsang roundels are purchased for producing Dutch euro coins as long as this company also makes cluster munitions.

Zoals toegezegd in Algemeen Overleg van 2 juni j.l. over KNM zal het ministerie ook in de toekomst via het muntcontract borgen dat er geen rondellen van Poonsang worden afgenomen voor de productie van Nederlandse euromunten zolang dit bedrijf ook clustermunitie maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Jasper van Dijk over de productie van euromunten door een Zuid-Koreaans bedrijf dat ook betrokken is bij de productie van clustermunitie

MPs Merkies and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the state-owned Royal Dutch Mint (KNM) bought euro coin blanks from Poongsan, a Korean firm also linked to cluster munitions, and what the state as shareholder did about it. The Staatssecretaris answered that KNM ordered blanks in 2013 and 2015, that the state now asks KNM to stop ordering from Poongsan and will check this, and that the state will use the case as a general warning to other state holdings.
The state as shareholder will use this specific case as a general warning to the other state holdings that it is important to assess client and supplier relationships also on CSR aspects.

De staat als aandeelhouder zal deze specifieke casus gebruiken als algemene waarschuwing richting de andere staatsdeelnemingen dat het van belang is om klant- en leveranciersrelaties ook op MVO-aspecten te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Merkies over de onthulling in de Panama Papers dat een Rotterdams notariskantoor mee heeft gewerkt aan dubieuze financiële constructies

MPs Van Nispen and Merkies asked whether a Rotterdam notary firm helping set up dubious financial structures, revealed by the Panama Papers, breached notarial duties and whether investigation is warranted. The Minister said he awaits the outcome of an investigation by the Bureau Financieel Toezicht, which the firm itself reported, and sees no reason yet for broader inquiry into Dutch notaries and lawyers, while stating that helping move money out of the tax authorities' view is not a notary's task and is criminal.
Pending the outcome of that, I refrain from judging the situation and for now see no reason to launch broader investigation into Dutch lawyers and notaries.

In afwachting van de resultaten hiervan onthoud ik mij van een oordeel over de situatie en zie ik vooralsnog geen aanleiding om een breder onderzoek naar Nederlandse advocaten en notarissen in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Merkies over het bericht 'Wiebes boos om Braziliaanse belastingactie tegen Nederland'

MPs Klaver and Merkies asked the State Secretary of Finance about Brazil placing the Netherlands on its grey list over preferential holding company tax treatment, its effect on Dutch firms, treaty renegotiation, anti-abuse clauses, disclosure of Dutch-Brazilian exchanges, and parallels with Mongolia and Malawi terminating tax treaties. The State Secretary answered that the listing is unjustified, Brazil has not clarified its criterion, treaty talks stalled since 2008 but are being revived with anti-abuse measures, diplomatic correspondence cannot be shared, and the Mongolia and Malawi cases are unrelated.
Given the confidentiality of diplomatic exchanges, I cannot go into detail on this in the answers to these parliamentary questions.
Met het oog op de vertrouwelijkheid van het diplomatieke verkeer, kan ik daar in de antwoorden op deze Kamervragen niet in detail op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Merkies over de belastingvoordelen voor Shell, Total en ENI in Nigeria

SP MPs asked the government to react to an ActionAid report on tax holidays worth 3.3 billion dollars for Shell, Total and ENI in Nigeria, and whether such incentives help poor countries, and asked about Dutch involvement and aid to Nigeria. The minister answered that tax incentives should be used narrowly, that Nigeria is responsible for its own incentive design, that the Netherlands did not actively help Shell obtain its incentive, that tax holidays show weak effects and the OECD and IMF advise restraint, and gave Nigeria aid figures.
The Dutch government does not support individual Dutch companies in obtaining favourable tax treatment in developing countries.
De Nederlandse overheid geeft geen ondersteuning aan individuele Nederlandse bedrijven om een gunstige fiscale behandeling in ontwikkelingslanden te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Merkies over het bericht ‘€ 5 miljard van Nederland in Oekraïne geïnvesteerd? Bijna de helft is van deze oligarch’

Two SP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a report that nearly half of a reported 5 billion euros in Dutch investment in Ukraine belongs to one oligarch, and whether Ukrainian oligarchs avoid tax via Dutch shell companies. The government answered that DNB data show 9.8 billion euros invested in 2014, that tax confidentiality prevents breakdown by individual taxpayers, that anti-abuse measures are being pursued internationally and in a treaty negotiation, and that the trade benefits Dutch firms though job effects cannot be precisely quantified.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act prevents further breakdown based on Tax Authority data on individual taxpayers.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen verhindert verdere uitsplitsing op basis van gegevens van de Belastingdienst over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over duurzame investeringen in de bankensector naar aanleiding van het rapport ‘Undermining our future’

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about Dutch banks' greater investment in fossil fuels than in renewables, a coal-reduction recommendation, transparency, and ING's selection as state house bank. The minister acknowledged the report, pointed to a bank climate statement and planned transparency talks, and said commitments on coal were a matter for the energy phase-out and sector, giving only partial substantive answers.
Perhaps the researchers themselves can explain this.
Wellicht kunnen de onderzoekers zelf hier duiding aan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over de over de rol van belastingparadijzen in het vergroten van de wereldwijde ongelijkheid

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about Oxfam's report on global inequality, billionaire wealth, and the role of tax havens, including whether tax avoidance worsens inequality and how BEPS measures stop profit shifting. The State Secretary answered that inequality stems from many factors, that BEPS targets companies rather than wealthy individuals, that transparency measures such as the Common Reporting Standard address individual evasion, and that the report did not clearly show money flows from the Netherlands to the named tax havens.
The BEPS project of the OECD and G20 and the recently proposed EU Anti-Tax Avoidance Package target internationally operating companies, not (wealthy) individuals.

Het BEPS project van de OESO en de G20 en het recent door de Europese Commissie voorgestelde «Anti tax Avoidance Package» richten zich op internationaal opererende bedrijven, niet op (rijke) individuen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Merkies en Grashoff over de belastingontwijking door wapenproducenten

MPs Bruins, Merkies and Grashoff asked whether seven of the ten largest arms producers use Dutch tax structures, whether they have rulings, and whether their substance is adequate. The State Secretary declined to give information on individual taxpayers under confidentiality rules, explained the substance test and risk-based supervision, and said public country-by-country reporting awaits an EU impact assessment.
Based on the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR), I cannot provide information about individual taxpayers.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsverplichting van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik geen informatie verstrekken over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat een betaalopdracht voor een reis richting Cuba wordt geweigerd door ING

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether ING's refusal of a payment for a Cuba holiday trip was reasonable and whether banks may refuse payments to countries without an embargo. The government answered that US sanctions and the bank's own risk assessment determine such decisions, that banks are responsible for their own choices, and that it does not intervene in them.
It is up to the banks themselves to weigh, within this context of various legal frameworks, how a particular transaction relates to these rules.
Het is aan de desbetreffende banken zelf om in deze context van verschillende wettelijke kaders een afweging te maken hoe een bepaalde transactie zich verhoudt tot deze regels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht ‘Nederland blokkeerde belastingherzieningen’

Senator-level MP Merkies (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Netherlands systematically blocked EU tax reforms on business tax benefits such as the innovation box, and why. The State Secretary denied chairing or steering the Code of Conduct group, explained the modified nexus approach compromise and the Dutch aim of keeping the box open to SMEs, and said the 2010 tax-ruling exchange was only a temporary study reservation later withdrawn.
The Code of Conduct group discussed patent and innovation boxes within the EU on several occasions.
Er is in de Gedragscodegroep een aantal keren gesproken over patent- en innovatieboxen binnen de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie de Nederlandse tax ruling als illegale staatssteun bestempelt

The SP MP Merkies asked the State Secretary of Finance how the Dutch tax ruling for Starbucks could be reconciled with the European Commission's finding of illegal state aid, including the TNMM method, royalty payments, and effective tax burden. The State Secretary defended the TNMM method and the arm's length principle, said the Commission's case concerns an individual ruling, and argued that the price of imported beans and royalties were not decisive for the Dutch taxable profit.
The European Commission's decision concerns an individual case.
Het besluit van de Europese Commissie betreft een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies naar aanleiding van het bericht “Bank had geen zicht op klant met ‘verhoogd risicoprofiel’”

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that ABN AMRO Dubai lacked insight into client wealth, allegedly systematic failures, PEP clients, and whether the DNB fine decision would be published. The minister acknowledged rule breaches and blank signed forms for three clients but found no concrete signs of systematic misconduct, and said DNB cannot publish the fine decision due to confidentiality, with publication to be addressed through the EU fourth anti-money-laundering directive by June 2017.
Due to a confidentiality obligation regarding supervisory information, DNB cannot make the fine decision known to anyone other than, in this case, ABN AMRO.
Vanwege een geheimhoudingsplicht ten aanzien van toezichthoudersinformatie kan DNB het boetebesluit niet kenbaar maken aan anderen dan, in dit geval, ABN AMRO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Merkies naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Vivat verzekeringen krijgt mogelijk junkstatus’

MPs Ronnes and Merkies asked the Finance Minister about credit rating agency S&P suspending Vivat's rating after its takeover by Anbang, including effects on solvency, DNB's access to information, the Dutch management's influence, and continuity. The minister answered that the rating suspension does not directly affect solvency, that DNB granted the takeover approval with full information, that governance is a matter for the company and shareholder, and that the EUR 1.35 billion capital injection secures stability.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes c.s. over de inhoud van de prospectus voor beursgang ABN AMRO

MPs from several parties asked the Finance Minister whether the ABN AMRO prospectus for its stock market listing shows share-linked bonuses that conflict with earlier assurances and the Merkies/Nijboer amendment, and about conflicts of interest of two board members. The minister answered that identified staff may receive variable pay in non-cash form, that the top 7 board members and 25 senior managers are barred from variable pay while the state holds a stake, that the amendment is complied with, and that the bonus decisions rest with ABN AMRO itself.
ABN AMRO as a company itself bears responsibility for drawing up a variable pay scheme within the legal framework.
ABN AMRO heeft als vennootschap zelf de verantwoordelijkheid om binnen het wettelijke kader een variabele beloningsregeling op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Merkies over de besteding van een IMF-lening aan Oekraïne

MPs Van Bommel and Merkies asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers whether IMF loan money to Ukraine was diverted to offshore accounts linked to oligarch Kolomoisky, and sought investigation of beneficial owners and auditor selection. The ministers answered that Dutch funds are pooled and untraceable, that the IMF found no irregularities in the central bank's use of funds, and that since the IMF already supervises its funds no further investigation is needed.
Since it is standard policy that the IMF monitors the use of its public funds and this has recently occurred in the case of Ukraine, we see no need to advocate further investigation.

Aangezien het standaard beleid is dat het IMF de besteding van haar publieke middelen controleert en dit recent is gebeurd in het geval van Oekraïne, zien wij geen noodzaak om voor nader onderzoek te pleiten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Staat de in Nederland geheven dividendbelasting moet terugbetalen aan particuliere beleggers die elders in de Europese Unie wonen

Merkies (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance how the CJEU ruling requiring the Netherlands to refund dividend tax to non-resident portfolio shareholders would affect revenue, timing, box 3 rules and other EU states, and what measures would cover any shortfall. Wiebes answered that the ruling mainly affects non-resident individuals with portfolio holdings (estimated shortfall EUR 39m one-off and EUR 13m structural, subject to the Hoge Raad ruling), that a three-year refund period applies, that legislation or a policy decision will follow, and that implications for other member states cannot be generalised.
The ruling means that non-resident individual shareholders may in certain cases be entitled to a refund of dividend tax.
Het arrest leidt ertoe dat buitenlandse particuliere aandeelhouders in voorkomende gevallen mogelijk recht krijgen op een teruggave van dividendbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Merkies over de toename van de kloof tussen arm en rijk in Amsterdam

MPs Karabulut and Merkies asked the ministers about a report showing rising rich-poor segregation in Amsterdam, the role of the state, housing liberalisation and possible action with the municipality. Minister Asscher answered that Amsterdam ranks relatively low on segregation among the 13 cities studied, that government focuses on equal opportunities in education and the labour market, and that the municipality shares responsibility for affordable housing.

Moreover, a further study into the spatial distribution and mixing of different groups in the Netherlands is currently being carried out on behalf of the Minister for Housing and Central Government Reform.
Overigens wordt momenteel, in opdracht van de Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst, een nader onderzoek uitgevoerd naar de ruimtelijke spreiding en menging van verschillende groepen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over uitzondering WNT bij salaris AFM-bestuurslid de Vries

An MP asked why the minister used the WNT individual exception to set a higher salary for the new AFM board member Femke de Vries, and how the decision was made and communicated. The minister answered that the unique combination of knowledge, experience and labour-market conditions justified the exception, that the decision was published in the Staatscourant, and that the salary would be reduced to a non-excessive level, while declining to disclose the content of candidate negotiations.
The content of the discussions with a candidate is not public.
De inhoud van de gesprekken met een kandidaat zijn niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Merkies, Smaling en Van Bommel over het bericht “Afspraken VN-top stellen arme landen teleur”

MPs from the SP asked why no international tax body was created to combat tax avoidance, how much developing countries lose to profit shifting, and what the UN Addis Ababa conference means for aid and Dutch policy. The minister answered that BEPS and a compromise on the UN tax committee are the main routes, that loss estimates are unreliable, and that the outcome supports the SDGs without new pledges.
Owing to the lack of unambiguous data, it is currently impracticable to give a ratio between total development aid and the taxes developing countries lose through tax avoidance by multinationals.

Bij gebrek aan eenduidige gegevens is het thans ondoenlijk om een verhouding aan te geven tussen de totale ontwikkelingshulp en de belastingen die ontwikkelingslanden mislopen als gevolg van belastingontwijking door multinationals.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over mogelijke belastingontwijking door Walmart

The SP MP Merkies asks the State Secretary of Finance about a report alleging that Walmart uses Dutch and Luxembourg holding companies to dodge taxes, and about whether the Netherlands facilitates such avoidance. The State Secretary rejects the tax-haven label, points to Dutch transparency measures and OECD/EU work on country-by-country reporting, and declines to explain Walmart's subsidiaries or their motives citing confidentiality under article 67 AWR.
Because of the confidentiality obligation in article 67 AWR, I cannot address your question why Walmart has five subsidiaries in the Netherlands and what activities they carry out.

Voorts kan ik vanwege de geheimhoudingsverplichting van artikel 67 AWR niet ingaan op uw vraag waarom Walmart in Nederland over vijf dochterondernemingen beschikt en welke activiteiten zij ontplooien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over de aanklacht tegen Leyla en Arif Yunus in Azerbeidzjan

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the prosecution sentencing requests of 11 and 9 years against Leyla and Arif Yunus in Azerbaijan, their medical treatment, international trial monitoring, and implementation of a motion on prisoners of conscience. The minister confirmed the sentences of 8.5 and 7 years, described EU-coordinated medical access and monitoring rotations, and cited Dutch statements calling for their release.
At the urging of the EU, a German doctor has been able to visit Leyla and Arif Yunus several times since December 2014.
Op aandringen van de EU heeft een Duitse arts Leyla en Arif Yunus sinds december 2014 een aantal keren kunnen bezoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Merkies over de mogelijke verkoop van QBuzz door de Nederlandse Spoorwegen

MPs Smaling and Merkies asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about the NS plan to sell bus company Qbuzz, its reasons, effects on staff and the HTM joint venture, and whether a Dutch bus firm should go to a foreign state company. Minister Dijsselbloem replied that NS's strategic reorientation must finish first, so no comment on the sale is possible yet, while information is exchanged and the government will send an analysis this autumn.
I consider it important that this reorientation is first completed before decisions are taken.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat deze heroriëntatie eerst wordt afgerond alvorens er besluiten worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het rapport 'Dutch Banks: Commitments and Progress' van de Eerlijke Bankwijzer

An MP asked the Finance Minister how the government responds to a report on Dutch banks' sustainability commitments, transparency gaps, and compliance with OECD guidelines. The minister answered that banks are largely meeting commitments, that transparency is being addressed through industry dialogue and IMVO covenants, and that the government mainly encourages rather than enforces.
Insofar as possible and necessary, I catalyse and facilitate these initiatives.
Voor zover mogelijk en nodig katalyseer en faciliteer ik deze initiatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over beleggingen van verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen in de wapenhandel

MPs asked whether insurers and pension funds should stop investing in arms makers supplying controversial states, and about reported billions in such holdings, including APG's. The government answered that only cluster munitions are legally barred, that it promotes IMVO covenants, and that the banking and insurance sectors are pursuing sector-specific covenants.
For investments in cluster munitions there is a statutory ban; beyond that, there are no other binding legal restrictions on insurers and pension funds investing in companies.

Voor investeringen in clustermunitie geldt er een wettelijk verbod, verder zijn er geen andere dwingende wettelijke belemmeringen voor het investeren in bedrijven door verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het kaalplukken van een afvalverwerker voor private equity

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister how the government views private equity firm Waterland extracting EUR 183 million in dividends from waste processor Attero, partly intended for landfill remediation, and what it will do to prevent asset stripping. The minister replied that the company's finances are not unhealthy, that dividend rules and the AIFM directive's anti-asset-stripping measures already apply, and that interest deduction limits were judged unwarranted for now.
I am aware of the reporting surrounding the takeover of Attero by Waterland.
Ik ken de berichtgeving rond de overname van Attero door Waterland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over de uitzending ‘Belastingparadijs Nederland’ van Rambam

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a Rambam broadcast on Dutch tax rulings and tax avoidance, including shell companies, substance requirements, NFIA promotion and whether ruling requests involve negotiation. The State Secretary defended the ruling practice within legal limits, said substance requirements were tightened in 2013 with spot checks and information exchange, and denied that tax rates are negotiated.
There is no negotiation with the Tax Authority, not even when advance certainty is requested.
Er wordt niet onderhandeld met de Belastingdienst, ook niet wanneer wordt verzocht om zekerheid vooraf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over coco's (contingent convertibles)

An MP asks the Finance Minister about contingent convertibles (coco bonds): their rapid growth, whether they increase interdependence among banks, whether limits or stricter rules are needed, the risks of triggering, suitability for retail investors, and tax deductibility. The minister answers that existing CRR/CRD-IV rules already limit bank exposures, that stricter rules could be considered later (e.g., higher trigger level, leverage-ratio limits) pending EBA and Commission work, that tax deductibility was needed for competitiveness and leverage ratio reasons, and that the AFM considers cocos suitable only for professional investors.
Nevertheless, some prudential requirements regarding cocos could be further tightened in the future.
Niettemin zouden enkele prudentiele eisen rondom coco's in de toekomst verder kunnen worden aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Karabulut over het bericht dat de vermogensongelijkheid in Nederland recordhoogtes bereikt

MPs Merkies and Karabulut asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Finance about reports that wealth inequality in the Netherlands had reached record levels, and whether the government would act to reduce it. The minister replied that the CBS figures show rising wealth concentration mainly due to falling house prices, that the government sees no need for action since social security cushions risks, and that it will keep monitoring wealth distribution.
The cabinet therefore attaches no consequences to the current development in wealth distribution, but will continue to follow wealth distribution in the coming years.
Het kabinet verbindt daarom geen consequenties aan de huidige ontwikkeling in de vermogensverdeling, maar blijft de vermogensverdeling de komende jaren wel volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Merkies over bewindvoerders die door een lidmaatschapseis geen bankrekening kunnen openen

MPs Van Nispen and Merkies asked whether banks such as ABN AMRO may require court-appointed trustees (bewindvoerders) to belong to a trade association before opening a bank account, and what the earlier talks with associations and banks produced. The minister replied that the Wwft does not require membership, that banks may choose additional measures case by case, that the Wft and payment-account convention give access to basic accounts, and that talks with associations were constructive but did not resolve the problem.
The Wwft does not require banks to demand that trustees be members of a trade association.
De Wwft schrijft niet voor dat banken van bewindvoerders eisen dat zij lid zijn van een branchevereniging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Merkies over “de megabonus voor de topman van Schiphol”

MPs Bashir and Merkies asked why the Schiphol CEO receives a bonus nearly equal to his base salary, whether this is consistent with the 20% cap, and whether the government has acted to get him to waive it. The minister explains the 2008 contract followed then-applicable policy, states that the new 2014 policy caps variable pay at 20%, says the shareholder sets directors' pay policy, and notes he has told Schiphol the CEO's variable pay should be brought into line with current policy.
In addition, I have informed Schiphol that I am of the view that the variable pay of Schiphol's CEO should be brought into line with the current remuneration policy.
Daarnaast heb ik aan Schiphol laten weten dat ik van mening ben dat de variabele beloning van de CEO van Schiphol in lijn moet worden gebracht met het vigerende beloningsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over de kwaliteit van het hersteladvies door verzekeraar voor houders van woekerpolissen

Opposition MP Merkies asked the Finance Minister about the poor quality of repair advice given by insurers to holders of 'woekerpolissen' (investment-linked insurance policies), and about the share of clients who keep unchanged policies, whether advice is independent, and how the AFM supervises. The minister acknowledged concerns, said the AFM can enforce against deficient advice, announced further AFM research into clients who choose not to change, and said advice rules apply in full to insurer advice.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over fraude bij ABN Dubai

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about alleged fraud at ABN Amro's Dubai operation, including its nature, duration, supervisory role, DNB's knowledge, and the implications for the planned IPO. The government answered by referring to a separate letter to parliament on the same matter, without answering the questions directly.
The written questions from MP Merkies (SP), question number 2015Z04403, have been answered by means of the letter
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Merkies (SP), vraagnummer 2015Z04403 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het AFM-rapport Productonderzoek Contracts for Difference

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the AFM's product study of Contracts for Difference (CfDs), including investor protection against residual debt, aggressive marketing, and why foreign-passported providers escape AFM supervision. The minister answered that providers should offer stop-loss protection and that MiFID II will allow tighter product rules, but that home-country supervision applies to EU providers and that ESMA cooperation has not yet produced concrete steps.

The AFM has raised this within ESMA and will continue to work towards further harmonising supervision of the European rules so that differences in supervisory practice between national supervisors are reduced.

De AFM heeft dit in ESMA verband aangekaart en zal zich verder inzetten voor het verder harmoniseren van het toezicht op de Europese regels zodat verschillen in de toezichtpraktijk tussen de nationale toezichthouders worden verkleind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over renteopslagen rentederivaten

MP Merkies asks the Finance Minister whether banks may unilaterally raise risk and liquidity surcharges on business loans, whether MSMEs are adequately informed, and whether Kifid complaint routes are wide enough. The minister replies that banks say derivative valuations do not affect risk surcharges, that the AFM has found insufficient transparency and will review arbitrariness, that no public-law limits exist beyond contract and reasonableness, and that Kifid's derivatives desk is designed for narrow cases.

As I promised in response to questions from MP Nijboer (PvdA) at the General Consultation on lending of 5 February, I will consult with the AFM to see whether it recognises the picture of arbitrariness in banks' application or increase of interest surcharges.

Zoals ik heb toegezegd op vragen van het lid Nijboer (PvdA) in het Algemeen Overleg over kredietverlening van 5 februari jl. zal ik met de AFM in overleg treden om te kijken of zij het beeld dat sprake is van willekeur bij het toepassen of verhogen van renteopslagen door banken herkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Gesthuizen over de opkomst van Apple en Google in het betalingsverkeer

MPs Merkies and Gesthuizen (SP) asked whether the uneven playing field between banks and tech firms like Apple and Google in payments, data-use rules and payment data protection should be closed. The government answered that all parties must comply with the same privacy law, that the voluntary banking code is only a further interpretation of it, and that the new EU directives and privacy regulation will add registration and risk-based duties.
All the parties mentioned, both financial institutions and other companies, must comply with the same privacy legislation.
Alle genoemde partijen, dus zowel financiële instellingen als andere bedrijven, moeten voldoen aan dezelfde privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over de ‘behoedzame’ beleggingsportefeuille van Alex Vermogensbank

MP Merkies asked the Finance Minister whether an automated investment model at Alex Vermogensbank that swaps shares for bonds on market declines reduces losses, whether a 100% equity portfolio can be called cautious, how the AFM checks risk profiles, and whether banks may freely name risk profiles and owe a duty of care. The minister answered that firms choose their own models and profile names, that the AFM supervises whether processes are correctly set up and whether names are misleading, and that the duty of care under the Wft requires client information gathering.
What the AFM supervises is whether the legally required investment processes are set up correctly and carefully by the investment firm.
Waar de AFM toezicht op houdt is of de wettelijk vereiste processen voor het beleggen correct en zorgvuldig door de beleggingsonderneming zijn ingericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Gesthuizen over de veronderstellingen van het Centraal Planbureau (CPB)

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the CPB's assumptions, its quality checks, and whether wage moderation drove Dutch productivity, investment and export share. The minister replied that the CPB has multiple internal and external quality controls, that Dutch productivity and export share remained stable or high, and that wage moderation is a second-best tool against unemployment.
Many checks and balances have been built into the CPB's working method to prevent one-sided views that are not based on scientific consensus and facts.
Er zijn in de werkwijze van het CPB veel checks and balances aangebracht om het ontstaan te voorkomen van een eenzijdige, niet op wetenschappelijke consensus en op feiten gebaseerde visie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over de werkwijze van online broker DeGiro

MP Merkies asks the Finance Minister about DeGiro's practices: holding client cash in money market funds, deposit and investor compensation schemes, and securities lending. The minister answers that DeGiro lacks a banking licence, that client assets are legally segregated, and that lending requires explicit client consent with collateral and supervisory rules.
Investment firms such as DeGiro are not permitted to attract repayable funds from consumers outside a closed circle, unless De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) has granted an exemption.

Het is aan beleggingsondernemingen zoals DeGiro niet toegestaan opvorderbare gelden van consumenten buiten besloten kring aan te trekken, tenzij De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) hiervoor een ontheffing heeft verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Merkies over de berichtgeving “Nederland verzette zich tegen OESO-aanpak belastingontwijking”

MPs Klaver and Merkies asked whether the Dutch innovation box, which can benefit firms whose R&D is done abroad, undermines its purpose and whether the Netherlands opposed the OECD's tighter approach to patent boxes. The State Secretary answered that the box requires sufficient substance in the Netherlands, that the Netherlands backed a transfer-pricing approach instead of the nexus approach, and that the box will not be amended via the Fiscale verzamelwet 2015.
The cabinet does not have the picture that the Dutch innovation box enables abuse of internal transfer prices by international concerns.
Het kabinet heeft niet het beeld dat de Nederlandse innovatiebox misbruik van de interne verrekenprijzen van internationale concerns mogelijk maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over belastingontwijking door multinationals

An SP MP asked the state secretary of Finance about multinational tax avoidance via Luxembourg, Dutch advance rulings and transfer pricing, public country-by-country reporting, and whether the Netherlands is a conduit country. The state secretary answered that Luxembourg's tax application cannot be judged, that advance rulings are only given within Dutch law, that Dutch support for public CbC reporting is limited to an impact study by 2018, and that tax avoidance requires international cooperation.
I cannot give a judgement on how Luxembourg's tax law or the tax treaties it has concluded should be applied in these cases.
Een oordeel over de wijze waarop het Luxemburgse belastingrecht of de door Luxemburg gesloten belastingverdragen op deze gevallen toegepast moet worden kan ik niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Merkies, Smaling over Toegang tot Medicijnen

SP MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether she would hold Dutch insurers and pharmaceutical firms accountable for poor medicine access in poor countries, and whether insurers should use their investments to push for better access. The minister said investment policy is primarily the companies' own responsibility, pointed to voluntary initiatives and OECD/IMVO standards, and said she would invite the insurers' association to discuss the Access to Medicine Index.
Investment policy is primarily the responsibility of the companies themselves.
Het investeringsbeleid is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de bedrijven zelf.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over de gevolgen van het Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership (TTIP) en Trade in Services Agreement (TISA) voor financiële regulering

SP MPs Van Dijk and Merkies asked about a leaked EU proposal on regulatory cooperation in financial services under TTIP and about the effects of TISA on financial regulation. Minister Ploumen answered that the EU aims only at institutional cooperation and consultation, not at weakening financial rules, and that TISA's financial provisions largely reaffirm existing GATS and standstill commitments.
Once enough parties have joined the TISA negotiations, I will also work to bring TISA under the WTO framework to safeguard the continuity of the global trading system.

Wanneer zich voldoende partijen bij de TISA-onderhandelingen hebben aangesloten, zal ik mij bovendien inzetten om TISA onder het raamwerk van de WTO te brengen om zo de continuïteit van het mondiale handelssysteem te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat ING overweegt delen van haar hoofdkantoor te verhuizen naar Londen of Frankfurt

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether ING was considering moving parts of its head office abroad and whether DNB knew of such plans, and whether a state-aided bank should be leaving the Netherlands. The minister denied that ING was considering any relocation, stating the bank had said so directly.
No, I cannot confirm that. Following the press report in the FD, I was in contact with ING and the bank informed me that it is by no means considering moving its head office or parts thereof abroad.

Nee, dat kan ik niet bevestigen. Ik heb naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving in het FD contact gehad met ING en de bank heeft mij laten weten geenszins te overwegen het hoofdkantoor of delen daarvan naar het buitenland te verplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat meer dan 3.000 huiseigenaren van zonnepanelen een forse naheffingsaanslag hebben gekregen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that over 3,000 solar panel owners received large back-tax assessments for failing to file quarterly VAT returns. The State Secretary defended the fines as proportionate, pointed to existing coulance and exemption options, and rejected a yearly VAT filing exception for this group.
I therefore do not consider the fine for failing to file on time and the minimum fine for failing to pay the tax due on time to be disproportionate.
Ik acht de boete wegens het niet tijdig doen van aangifte en de minimumboete wegens het niet tijdig betalen van de verschuldigde belasting dan ook niet disproportioneel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over het Oxfam-rapport Business Among Friends

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Merkies asked the State Secretary about the Oxfam report on corporate tax avoidance, the arm's length principle, transfer pricing improvements, and the role of developing countries in OECD standard-setting. The State Secretary answered that the arm's length principle works imperfectly but is not itself the cause of avoidance, that BEPS work targets profit shifting, and that developing countries are involved through dialogue and capacity building.
The Netherlands attaches importance to these action points and actively contributes to seeking improvements.
Nederland hecht belang aan deze actiepunten en draagt actief bij aan het zoeken naar verbeteringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Klaver over het nieuws dat de fiscale structuur van Philip Morris wel in Nederland blijft

Opposition MPs Merkies and Klaver asked whether Philip Morris's Dutch tax holding structure remains only for tax reasons, whether tax rulings must be re-tested after mass layoffs, and about support and secret agreements. The State Secretary refused to give information on individual taxpayers under tax secrecy, said the company keeps a significant presence (about 140 jobs), and denied any secret agreements outside legal frameworks.
Based on the secrecy obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot provide information about individual taxpayers.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsverplichting van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik geen informatie geven over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat BinckBank Amerikanen uitsluit van een beleggingsrekening

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether BinckBank excluding US persons from investment accounts is justified under FATCA and the IGA, and whether this constitutes nationality discrimination. The minister answered that FATCA and the IGA do not justify excluding Americans on nationality alone, that the exclusion is based on tax liability, that the CRM opinion is non-binding, and that other banks are expected to comply without terminating services.
The College does not, however, issue a binding ruling but gives an opinion on whether the equal treatment act has been violated.
Het College doet overigens geen bindende uitspraak maar geeft een oordeel of de wet gelijke behandeling is overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat de werkdruk bij de Belastingdienst nog altijd te hoog is

The SP MP Merkies asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that workload at the Tax Administration remains too high despite planned cuts of about 1,000 FTE, and whether staffing and workload are being monitored. The State Secretary Wiebes acknowledged temporary workload from reorganisation and reassignment, cited staffing figures (28,107 FTE end 2012, 28,857 end 2013), said workload is monitored through staff surveys and consultation with works councils, and confirmed taxpayers should be able to get answers on their filings.
I am kept informed about this by the service management.
Ik word hierover door de dienstleiding op de hoogte gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat Rusland af wil van het huidige belastingverdrag met Nederland

Senator Merkies (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that Russia wants to replace the current tax treaty with the Netherlands, including Russia's reasons, timing and the Dutch response. The State Secretary answered that Russia proposed a partial revision to align the 1996 treaty with the current OECD model, that the Netherlands agreed to official-level negotiations, and that the revision was listed in the periodic overview of treaties under negotiation.
In response to Russia's request, I therefore proposed that official-level negotiations be started on a possible revision of the tax treaty between the two countries.
In reactie op het verzoek uit Rusland heb ik dan ook voorgesteld dat op ambtelijk niveau besprekingen worden aangegaan over een mogelijke aanpassing van het belastingverdrag tussen de beide landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat verzekeraars het provisieverbod schenden

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister how to respond to reports that insurers still pay commissions in breach of the commission ban, such as welcome bonuses, and whether the AFM is acting. The minister agrees such constructions are undesirable, notes the AFM has informed the market and engaged insurers who then stopped or will stop, and says the AFM cannot give an overview of individual institutions due to supervisory confidentiality.
The AFM cannot give an overview of individual institutions because it concerns supervisory-confidential information.
De AFM kan geen overzicht geven van individuele instellingen omdat het om toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over de berichten dat multinationals massaal belasting ontwijken in ontwikkelingslanden

MPs Van Dijk and Merkies (SP) asked whether OECD tax reforms go far enough against profit shifting harming developing countries, and about transfer pricing losses in Africa and the Dutch role. Secretary Wiebes answered that the OECD rules already prevent profit shifting, that technical assistance to developing countries is supported, and that the Tax Authority's transfer pricing capacity has been expanded.
That all countries aim to be able to tax as large a share as reasonably possible of multinationals' profits is obvious.
Dat alle landen ernaar streven binnen het redelijke een zo groot mogelijk deel van de winst van multinationals te mogen belasten ligt voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het bericht dat de Raad van Commissarissen van de Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) zich zorgen maakt over het toekomstige salaris van de directie van DNB

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that DNB's supervisory board is worried that the WNT pay cap will make it hard to attract and keep directors, and whether the board's concern is justified given the shift of supervision to the ECB. The minister rejects the concern, says the WNT leaves room for a sound pay structure with a case-by-case exemption, will not cut current directors' pay during their terms, and says the board will submit any new appointment pay decision to him for assessment.
At a new appointment or reappointment of a director, that will be the case. I will then assess that.
Bij een nieuwe benoeming of bij een herbenoeming van een directielid zal daarvan sprake zijn. Dat zal ik vervolgens beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat ING adverteerders inzicht wil bieden in klantgedrag

SP MPs Merkies and Gesthuizen asked the Finance Minister how he reacts to ING's plan to give advertisers insight into customer behaviour, and whether the pilot breaches privacy law, the sector code, consent rules and customer data ownership. The minister says he and the AFM and DNB are critical, that consent under the Wbp would be required for commercial use, that the Cbp is responsible for enforcement and may investigate, and that no further legal change seems necessary for now.
It is not for me nor for the State Secretary of Security and Justice to pronounce on compatibility with the Code of Conduct or the Wbp.
Het is niet aan mij noch aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie om een uitspraak te doen over de verenigbaarheid met de Gedragscode of de Wbp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over de kwaliteit van dienstverlening door banken en beleggingsondernemingen

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the AFM study finding that investment services for wealthy clients often failed to match portfolios to client profiles, and about enforcement, remediation and whether clients can rely on advice. The minister said the AFM recommendations are enforceable under the Wft, that some firms have started remediation, that AFM will monitor compliance, and that it cannot name the firms due to confidentiality.
The AFM will closely monitor the extent to which banks and investment firms actually implement the promised remedial measures.
De AFM zal nauwkeurig monitoren in hoeverre banken en beleggingsondernemingen de toegezegde verbetermaatregelen ook daadwerkelijk implementeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over een mogelijk nieuw steunpakket voor Griekenland

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether a new Greek support package was discussed at the Eurogroup and Ecofin, whether the Troika found a 15 billion euro financing gap, and whether a 10-20 billion package is being prepared, and why debt restructuring is excluded. The minister answered that no new package was discussed on 27 January, the Troika has not concluded on a financing gap, a possible new package can only be assessed later in 2014, and no third package has been discussed yet.
No, that is not correct. At the Eurogroup of 27 January we discussed progress in implementing the current Greek loan programme.
Nee dat klopt niet. Tijdens de Eurogroep van 27 januari jl. hebben we gesproken over de voortgang van de implementatie van het huidige Griekse leningenprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Wit, Gesthuizen en Merkies over een schikking van het Openbaar Ministerie met KPMG

MPs De Wit, Gesthuizen and Merkies (SP) asked why the Minister approved a Public Prosecution Service settlement with KPMG over its role in the Ballast Nedam fraud, and whether it should be reversed. The Minister answered that he approved it after weighing all interests, that the settlement with its fine and publicity serves punishment goals, and that reversal is not possible.
With this settlement the investigation into the responsible natural persons has not ended; that investigation continues.
Met deze transactie is het onderzoek naar verantwoordelijke natuurlijke personen niet beëindigd; dat onderzoek wordt voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Wit, Gesthuizen, en Merkies over de door het openbaar ministerie getroffen schikking met KPMG in een fraudezaak van Ballast Nedam

MPs De Wit, Gesthuizen and Merkies asked whether KPMG's top has known about the Ballast Nedam bribery affair for ten years, whether this was kept from the prosecution, whether the OM is investigating KPMG leadership, and whether the minister will reconsider the settlement with KPMG. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports, declined to answer the specific questions because the investigation into three accountants is ongoing, and stood by the settlement.
To avoid harming this ongoing investigation, I cannot answer the specific questions you ask at this time.
Om dit nog lopende onderzoek niet te schaden kan ik de specifieke vragen die u stelt nu niet beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het verwijderen van geldautomaten en het sluiten van bankkantoren, met name in de kleinere gemeenten

MP Merkies asked the Finance Minister about the disappearance of over 1,000 bank branches and ATMs and the accessibility of cash services, especially in small municipalities, and whether minimum banking provision should be agreed. The minister answered that nearly all Dutch residents remain within five kilometres of a bank facility, that digital banking and retail cash options have grown, and that no agreement on minimum provision is currently warranted, though the situation will be monitored via the MOB.
I do not have an overview of the decline in the number of ATMs at municipal level.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van de afname van het aantal geldautomaten op gemeenteniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het gebrekkige monitoren van transacties door trustkantoren

The SP MP Merkies asked the Finance Minister about weak transaction monitoring and unreported unusual transactions by trust offices, citing DNB findings and a possible money-laundering probe. The minister acknowledged DNB's findings that monitoring does not always fit client risk profiles, listed formal measures and FIU report counts, and said an ongoing investigation could not be discussed.
No statements can be made about possibly ongoing criminal investigations.
Over mogelijk lopende opsporingsonderzoeken kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Merkies over country-by-country reporting voor internationaal opererende ondernemingen

MPs Klaver and Merkies asked whether the government supports country-by-country tax reporting for multinationals, as proposed by the European Parliament development committee, and whether it will push for mandatory per-country tax disclosure in annual reports. The government replied that it supports transparency initiatives on tax payments but stresses coordination with existing rules, the economic risks of public disclosure, and the need for clear EU proposals with assessed effects.
The Netherlands has consistently indicated that alignment with existing transparency obligations, such as the obligation already included in the capital requirements directive, is important.
Nederland heeft steeds aangegeven dat afstemming met bestaande transparantieverplichtingen, zoals de verplichting die reeds is opgenomen in de richtlijn voor kapitaalvereisten, van belang is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over berichten inzake de vijandige overname van KPN door América Móvil

Merkies (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how he would respond to a hostile takeover bid for KPN by América Móvil and whether public-interest telecom services, including emergency-services networks, would be protected against foreign takeover. Minister Kamp answered that takeovers are for companies and shareholders to decide, that existing law and contracts would bind any acquirer, and that the government is examining whether stronger safeguards for national security are needed, reporting back in early 2014.

More structurally, the cabinet wants to examine whether existing measures can be applied more effectively to safeguard public interests, in particular national security, and whether additional provisions are needed in the event of a takeover.

Meer structureel gezien wil het kabinet bezien of in het kader van de effectieve borging van publieke belangen, in het bijzonder de nationale veiligheid, bestaande maatregelen effectiever kunnen worden toegepast en of aanvullende voorzieningen nodig zijn bij een overname.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over het feit dat Blackrock vastgoed gaat keuren waar het zelf belang in heeft

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether DNB's hiring of BlackRock Solutions to audit Dutch bank real-estate portfolios, while BlackRock holds stakes in ING, creates conflict of interest. The minister replied that BlackRock's advisory arm is walled off from its investment arm, the contract contains strict safeguards, and DNB sets the valuation methodology, so no conflict is found.

Because of the sensitive nature of the examination BlackRock Solutions will carry out, the contract between DNB and BlackRock Solutions contains strict conditions to prevent misuse of information and to contain any risks of conflicts of interest.

Vanwege de gevoelige aard van het onderzoek dat BlackRock Solutions zal uitvoeren, zijn in het contract tussen DNB en BlackRock Solutions zware condities opgenomen om misbruik van informatie te voorkomen en eventuele risico's van belangenverstrengeling in te dammen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Merkies over het Nederlands verzet tegen country-by-country reporting voor internationaal opererende ondernemingen

MPs Klaver and Merkies asked whether the Dutch government is opposing an EU-wide country-by-country reporting obligation for multinationals and whether its position remains consistent with earlier commitments. The government answered that it supports transparency initiatives through tax reporting in general, while stressing possible negative economic effects of public disclosure, the need for coordination with existing rules, and clear, well-assessed EU proposals.
The Netherlands will also in future take a position along the lines outlined above.
Nederland zal ook in de toekomst een positie langs de hiervoor geschetste lijnen innemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Merkies over de vergoedingen die de Trojka in rekening brengt bij steunprogramma’s

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether the troika had received 224 million euro in fees from Ireland's support programme and asked about the fee structure, its basis, refunds and the interest rates. The minister denied that the troika itself receives the fees, explained the EFSF, EFSM and IMF fee components and total fees paid by programme countries, and set out the interest rate calculation.
No. The Troika consists of representatives of the European Commission, the ECB and the IMF.
Nee. De Trojka bestaat uit vertegenwoordigers van de Europese Commissie, de ECB en het IMF.
Vragen van het lid Merkies (SP) aan de minister van Financiën over het bericht dat er hogere handdrukken worden uitgereikt dankzij sluiproutes (Ingezonden 7 juni 2013).

The SP MP Merkies asked the Finance Minister whether severance packages at listed companies circumvent the Dutch Corporate Governance Code's one-year salary cap and whether the excessive severance tax applies. The minister answered that the Code is largely complied with, that the monitoring commission found no clear evidence of circumvention, promised to ask the commission to focus on transparency, and provided tax revenue figures.
