I therefore ask the Commission to, in addition to attention to compliance with provision II.2.8, pay specific attention to transparency in the annual report on the departure of directors.
Ik vraag de Commissie daarom om, naast aandacht voor de naleving van bepaling II.2.8, specifiek aandacht te besteden aan transparantie in het jaarverslag bij vertrek van bestuurders.
Antwoord vragen Merkies over beloningen in de financiële sector

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about reported large salary increases in 2012 at state-supported financial firms such as Achmea and Leaseplan, and whether these are excessive and what concrete steps will be taken to lower pay. The minister confirmed the increases, explained they used a one-off permitted 20% fixed-pay compensation under the bonus ban, said moderation of pay is reasonable, and committed to asking bank boards to address pay and to sending the EBA pay report to parliament.
I have also reported this to the chair of the ING board. The House will be informed about the progress of the CAO agreements.
Ik heb dit tevens gemeld aan de bestuursvoorzitter van ING. De Kamer zal over de voortgang van de CAO-afspraken worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over de uitzending van Tegenlicht ‘De Tax Free Tour’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a Tegenlicht documentary on offshore tax avoidance, including the size of the offshore industry, bronbelasting, tax rulings, economic zones and tax holidays. The State Secretary declined to confirm the offshore figures, rejected withholding tax on interest and royalties, acknowledged that corporate tax avoidance shifts burdens to others, and defended tax rulings as legitimate advance certainty.
I have said on several occasions that this is an international problem that must be tackled internationally and that I am committed to that international approach.
Ik heb bij verschillende gelegenheden gezegd dat dit een internationaal probleem is dat internationaal aangepakt moet worden en dat ik mij voor die internationale aanpak inzet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klaver en Merkies over het bericht van de Franse regering om er binnen de EU voor te ijveren dat country-by-country reporting verplicht wordt gesteld voor alle bedrijven

MPs Klaver and Merkies asked whether the government supports France's EU push for country-by-country tax reporting for all multinationals, and what it will do about it. The government supports international efforts against aggressive tax planning, would back France if it raises the proposal in the EU, but favours such reporting only if introduced at EU level.
The cabinet will therefore support the French government if it wishes to consult at EU level on an obligation for such reporting.
Het kabinet zal dan ook de Franse regering steunen als zij in EU-verband wenst te overleggen over een verplichting tot een dergelijke rapportage.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Merkies over belastingontwijking in Zambia

MPs Van Dijk and Merkies asked the ministers whether a Dutch treaty with Zambia enables tax avoidance by a British sugar company, whether Zambia loses more to avoidance than it gains in aid, and whether the treaty should be renegotiated. The government said it lacks data on specific amounts, acknowledged the 5% dividend withholding rate under the 1977 treaty, and promised a review of treaties with developing countries with results expected in summer 2013.
We have no information on the amount of tax that may have been avoided in Zambia.
Over de omvang van de eventueel in Zambia ontweken belasting hebben wij geen informatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Merkies over “belastingparadijzerij”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how the adopted Van Vliet motion rejecting the label 'tax haven' for the Netherlands would be implemented, and pressed on whether the Netherlands facilitates tax avoidance by multinationals, the OECD criteria for tax havens, preferential regimes, and the meaning of 'tax-haven practices'. The State Secretary answered that the motion means a parliamentary majority does not consider the Netherlands a tax haven, that only the OECD criteria are meaningful, that the Netherlands takes anti-avoidance measures and an enforcement intensification, and that the term was used loosely in debate without a defined meaning.
I do not agree, and as the adopted motion shows, a majority in the House of Representatives does not agree either.
Ik ben het er niet mee eens en, zo blijkt uit de aangenomen motie, een meerderheid in de Tweede Kamer ook niet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Merkies en Van Hijum over een mogelijke gang naar de Ondernemingskamer in het kader van mogelijk mismanagement bij SNS

MPs Merkies and Van Hijum asked why the government would not initiate an enquiry by the Enterprise Chamber into alleged mismanagement at SNS REAAL, and whether this creates uncertainty. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that an enquiry would add no value beyond the nationalisation, the evaluation commission and the supervisory board's investigation, and would burden the company, while the Council of State ruling confirmed the nationalisation was lawful.
I am of the view that an enquiry procedure regarding SNS REAAL adds no value compared with the measures already initiated and moreover has disadvantages.
Ik ben van oordeel dat een enquêteprocedure ten aanzien van SNS REAAL geen meerwaarde heeft ten opzichte van de reeds in gang gezette maatregelen en bovendien nadelen kent.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Merkies over het bericht dat Nederland laks is in de bestrijding van corruptie

Two SP MPs asked the government how it can tolerate that 14 of 22 signalled foreign bribery cases were never investigated and none led to conviction, and what it will do about it. The minister replied that the OECD evaluation is part of three pending reviews, that an integrated policy response is due in autumn 2013, that a new prosecution guideline was adopted, 150 extra FIOD investigators are being recruited, and several legislative and prosecution measures are underway, but gave no firm timetable for the OECD-recommended legislative changes.

The cabinet letter presenting the OECD report stated that the cabinet aims to present an integrated policy response on Dutch anti-corruption efforts to the House after the three evaluations are complete.

In de Kamerbrief ter aanbieding van het OESO-rapport 2 is aangegeven dat het kabinet ernaar streeft om na afloop van de drie evaluaties een integrale beleidsreactie over de Nederlandse corruptiebestrijding aan uw Kamer aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Bashir over het bericht dat Nederlandse banken tientallen vennootschappen hebben in belastingparadijzen

SP MPs Merkies and Bashir asked whether Dutch banks, especially state-supported ones, should avoid tax via tax-haven subsidiaries, whether such structures are tax avoidance, and whether banks should disclose and justify foreign subsidiaries, plus the status of a proposed reporting duty for tax advisers. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that he has no reason to doubt banks' stated reasons, that tax avoidance is legal but sometimes undesirable, that foreign subsidiaries are already partly disclosed and tax authorities have sufficient powers, and that a reporting point for tax advisers is unnecessary given existing covenants.
Moreover, Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act does not allow me to go into individual cases.
Overigens staat artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelasting mij niet toe in te gaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Merkies over de introductie van een overlijdensrisicoverzekering op basis van postcode

Member Merkies (SP) asked the Finance Minister whether it is acceptable that a life insurance premium be based on the policyholder's postcode, and whether this amounts to discrimination. The minister said such differentiation is not legally prohibited, that he finds it undesirable, and asked the Human Rights College to investigate the discrimination question.
I have asked the Human Rights College to conduct an investigation into the composition of the affected groups and the objective justification for any indirect distinction.
Ik heb het College voor de Rechten van de Mens verzocht een onderzoek in te stellen naar de samenstelling van de geraakte groepen en de objectieve rechtvaardiging voor eventueel indirect onderscheid.
Antwoord vragen Merkies over het rapport: «Het Financiële Overgewicht van Nederland»

MP Merkies (SP) asked the Finance Minister whether he agrees with the SOMO report's conclusions that the Dutch banking sector is out of balance with the real economy, has among the highest leverage, and enjoys implicit state support worth EUR 4 to 12 billion. The minister answered that large banks carry risks but that research on finance size and growth is inconclusive, that Dutch leverage stems mainly from traditional mortgage activity, and that implicit guarantee estimates vary widely and are small for the Netherlands relative to peers.
A large banking sector is however not without risks, as the crisis has shown.
Een grote bancaire sector is echter niet zonder risico's zoals tijdens de crisis is gebleken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Merkies over het ontwijken van belasting door Google

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about Google's tax avoidance through Dutch and Bermudan structures, the low effective tax rate, the 'substance' requirements for letterbox companies, the EU's push against aggressive tax planning and reform of the Code of Conduct group and anti-abuse rules. The State Secretary declined to judge the individual company's tax position (citing Article 67 AWR), said no law was broken, defended the status quo, and only supported international initiatives without committing to concrete national steps.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act does not allow me to give an opinion on the tax position of an individual company.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen staat mij niet toe een oordeel geven over de belastingpositie van een individueel bedrijf.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Merkies over de overname van NYSE Euronext

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about the consequences of the ICE takeover of NYSE Euronext for the Amsterdam exchange, whether relocation would be undesirable, and the role of DNB and AFM. The minister said the continental plans are not yet concrete, that Dutch exchanges should stay, that he has not yet received a no-objection application and will consult the AFM, with a 13-week decision period once complete.
For this takeover I must issue a declaration of no objection.
Voor deze overname dien ik een verklaring van geen bezwaar af te geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Merkies over de Nederlandse goudvoorraad toekomen

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about the Dutch gold reserve: whether it is physically checked, whether gold should be repatriated, DNB's sales plans, and the purpose of holding gold. The minister answered that DNB receives annual custody statements and internal audit verification, sees no need for physical checks or repatriation, cannot comment on sales plans for independence reasons, and explained the reserve's role as a last-resort asset.
Due to DNB's independence in its role as monetary authority, I cannot comment on any possible plans to sell gold by DNB.
Vanwege de onafhankelijkheid van DNB in haar rol als monetaire autoriteit, kan ik geen mededeling doen over eventuele verkoopplannen van goud door DNB.

m: Motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over voorkomen van herdimensionering van de kustwacht
Motion asking the government to prevent downsizing (herdimensionering) of the Caribbean coast guard and report to the House by 3 October.
requests the government to do everything to prevent downsizing of the coast guard and to report to the House on this as soon as possible, and no later than 3 October

verzoekt de regering, alles in het werk te stellen om herdimensionering van de kustwacht te voorkomen en daarover op de kortst mogelijke termijn, doch uiterlijk 3 oktober aanstaande aan de Kamer te rapporteren
Motie van het lid Knops c.s. over met meer urgentie en tempo de huidige knelpunten bij de reservisten oplossen
Asks the government to resolve current bottlenecks in the reserve forces policy faster and to present by 1 January 2017 a plan for implementing the Canadian Total Force Concept.
requests the government to resolve the current bottlenecks regarding reservists with more urgency and pace
verzoekt de regering, met meer urgentie en tempo de huidige knelpunten bij de reservisten op te lossen
Motie van het lid Bosman c.s. over voorwaarden voor de beëindiging van de plannen van aanpak
Asks the government to make proposals with binding agreements before ending the action plans for police and prisons on Sint Maarten, and to submit them to both chambers.
to make proposals to improve the functioning of police and prisons on Sint Maarten, with binding agreements and clear goals, and to submit them to both chambers by mid-May 2016

voorstellen te doen ter verbetering van het functioneren van de politie en het gevangeniswezen op Sint-Maarten, met daarin bindende afspraken en heldere doelen, en deze voorstellen uiterlijk medio mei 2016 aan beide Kamers aan te bieden
Motie van het lid Eijsink c.s. over oriëntatie op de voordelen van meerjarige defensieplannen
States that the House will explore whether multi-year defence plans could offer benefits in the Dutch context.
states that the House will explore whether multi-year defence plans could have benefits in the Dutch context
spreekt uit dat de Kamer zich gaat oriënteren of meerjarige defensieplannen ook in de Nederlandse context mogelijke voordelen kunnen hebben
Motie van de leden Teeven en Vuijk over het verbreden van de mandaten van VN-missies
Asks the government to push for broader UN mission mandates covering migrant smuggling and to strengthen Dutch military capacity for border surveillance.
requests the government to make efforts to broaden the mandates of UN missions
verzoekt de regering, zich in te spannen voor het verbreden van de mandaten van VN-missies
Motie van de leden Günal-Gezer en Vuijk over een jaarlijks overzicht van de prijsbijstellingen militair materieel
Asks the government to report annually in the defence budget on price adjustments for military equipment, their allocation across projects and operating costs, and whether they are adequate.
requests the government to provide annually in the Defence budget an overview of the price adjustment granted
verzoekt de regering om, jaarlijks in de Defensiebegroting een overzicht te geven van de toegekende prijsbijstelling
Amendement van de leden Vuijk en Günal-Gezer over het eenmalig vergroten van het fonds CODEMO
Amendment shifts 5 million euro within the defence investment article to temporarily increase the CODEMO fund, a budget reallocation.
This amendment aims to increase the CODEMO fund once by 5 million euros.
Dit amendement beoogt het fonds CODEMO eenmalig te verhogen met €5 miljoen.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Vuijk en Bosman over het bericht “Venezuela beschuldigt Nederland en VS opnieuw van agressie”

MPs Ten Broeke, Vuijk and Bosman asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of Venezuela's accusations against the Netherlands and the US of airspace violation and aggression, and whether the government would respond. The minister answered that Venezuela did not accuse the Netherlands of airspace violation, that the government has no information on any airspace breach, and that he voiced concern to the Venezuelan foreign minister and urged that such statements be avoided.
In a conversation with the Venezuelan Minister of Foreign Affairs, I expressed my surprise and concern about these unjustified and public accusations directed at Venezuela.
In een gesprek met de Venezolaanse Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken heb ik mijn verbazing en zorg over deze onterechte en publieke beschuldigingen uitgesproken richting Venezuela.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over het bericht “Nederlands-Duits defensiebedrijf gehackt door Chinezen”

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether Rheinmetall Defence secret data was stolen by Chinese hackers since 2012, and how responsibility for protecting defence-sector ICT is divided between Defence and private firms. The minister declined to confirm or refute the media report, said neither Rheinmetall nor Fox-IT confirmed theft, and stated that protecting the private sector is not Defence's task, pointing to contractual security rules (ABDO) and MIVD audits.
It is not for the Ministry of Defence to refute or confirm such reporting.
Het is niet aan het Ministerie van Defensie om dergelijke berichtgeving te ontkrachten of te bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vuijk en Teeven inzake het bericht over gestolen data van Zwitserse speciale eenheden door Russische hackers

MPs Vuijk and Teeven asked the Defence Minister about reports that Russian hackers stole data on Swiss special forces, the risks of such cyberattacks to the Dutch armed forces, and whether Dutch units' identities are adequately protected. The Minister replied that Switzerland is investigating the incident, that Defence faces a considerable and growing cyber espionage threat but has not lost sensitive information so far, and that the Swiss case does not require additional measures.
Defence repels attacks daily and there are so far no known cyberattacks in which sensitive information has been seized.
Defensie slaat dagelijks aanvallen af en er zijn vooralsnog geen cyberaanvallen bekend waarbij gevoelige informatie is buitgemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over het uit de vaart nemen van de Zr.Ms. Karel Doorman

A VVD MP asked the Defence Minister about the damage to the Karel Doorman's electric propulsion motor, the lengthy eight-month repair, the lack of replacement supply capacity, and whether budget cuts contributed. The minister acknowledged an unexpected, rare defect, explained the repair must be done in a factory, and said the delay is unrelated to past budget cuts or spare-parts shortages, with a repair estimate expected after research concludes in mid-June 2016.
The investigation is expected to be completed by mid-June 2016.
Naar verwachting zal dit onderzoek medio juni 2016 voltooid zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over een voorzorgslanding door een Apache gevechtshelikopter

An MP asked the Defence Minister about a precautionary landing by an Apache helicopter after an uncommanded flight manoeuvre, why it was transported by truck, what caused the fault warning, and whether it relates to a 2015 Mali crash. The Minister explained the standard procedures, said the investigation with Boeing is not finished and cause and follow-up measures are undetermined, and said the effects on the fleet's deployment are limited.
Defence is investigating the cause with manufacturer Boeing and collecting flight and system data from the helicopter. The investigation is not yet complete.
Defensie onderzoekt met fabrikant Boeing de oorzaak en verzamelt daartoe vlucht- en systeemdata van de helikopter. Het onderzoek is nog niet voltooid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over weer een voorzorgslanding door een Apache gevechtshelikopter

An MP asked the Defence Minister about a second precautionary landing of an Apache helicopter on 25 March 2016, whether it was linked to an earlier incident and to a 2015 Mali crash, and whether budget cuts were to blame. The minister said an investigation with Boeing is ongoing, the two incidents appear to have different causes, and the landings are not a consequence of budget cuts.
Depending on the outcome of the investigation, Defence will determine whether this complaint leads to measures and, if so, which ones.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek bepaalt Defensie of deze klacht tot maatregelen leidt en, zo ja, welke.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vuijk en Teeven over het bericht "Openbaarmaking personeelsblad MIVD brengt werknemers in gevaar"

MPs Vuijk and Teeven asked why the MIVD staff magazine Ingelicht was published online with unredacted staff names and photos, and what is being done about security risks. The Minister says the names should have been anonymised, that the MIVD advised honouring the access request, that no threats have been recorded, and that efforts to have the personal data removed have not yet succeeded.
In hindsight, however, it can be concluded that when the access request was granted, the names in the magazines should have been anonymised.
Achteraf kan echter geconcludeerd worden dat bij het honoreren van het inzageverzoek de namen in de bladen geanonimiseerd hadden moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vuijk en Teeven over het schrappen van banen bij Thales Nederland

Two MPs asked the defence and economic affairs ministers whether Thales Nederland's 200 job cuts relate to postponed naval investments, what this means for the domestic defence industry and armed forces' access to radar technology, and how investment planning accounts for industry knowledge. The minister replied that the cuts are a company reorganisation, that investment decisions are weighed against the budget, that access to SMART-L radar technology is secured through signed contracts, and that knowledge is maintained via the Gouden Driehoek cooperation and maintenance contracts.
The measure announced by Thales Nederland is of a business-economic nature and concerns an internal reorganisation.
De maatregel die Thales Nederland heeft bekendgemaakt is van bedrijfseconomische aard en betreft een interne reorganisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teeven en Vuijk over het onderzoek naar de export van omstreden goederen door RH Marine Group

MPs Teeven and Vuijk asked about a customs investigation into possibly illegal exports of dual-use goods by RH Marine Group (former Imtech Marine), including licensing, the countries involved, and consequences for defence projects. The minister confirmed that customs is investigating after the ministry was alerted and that the remaining questions will be answered once the investigation, expected in about two months, is complete.
Questions 3 through 7 will be answered after the customs investigation has been completed.
De vragen 3 tot en met 7 worden beantwoord na afronding van het onderzoek van de Douane.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vuijk en Teeven over het schrappen van banen bij Fokker

MPs Vuijk and Teeven asked whether Fokker's job cuts of 270 positions affect Dutch defence industry, the armed forces, F-35 technology access, and whether Thales cuts signal a wider trend. Minister Kamp answered that the cuts stem from the civil aircraft market, do not weaken Fokker's strategic partnership with Defence, are unrelated to Thales, and that future trends cannot be predicted.
Through the measures now announced, the strategic partnership in the form of industry cooperation with Defence is not affected.
Door de nu aangekondigde maatregelen wordt het strategische partnerschap in de vorm van samenwerking van de industrie met Defensie niet aangetast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teeven en Vuijk over een tekort aan bommen boven Irak voor Nederlandse F-16’s

MPs Teeven and Vuijk asked the Defence Minister about a reported shortage of bombs for Dutch F-16s fighting ISIS over Iraq, including consequences, causes, reorders and allied supply. The minister replied there is no current shortage, but certain precision munitions may run out over time due to higher consumption and long delivery times, and that the government is pursuing deliveries, loans and prioritisation with allies and producers.
There is currently no shortage of bombs for the Dutch F-16s deployed in the fight against ISIS.
Er is op dit moment geen tekort aan bommen voor de Nederlandse F-16’s die worden ingezet in de strijd tegen ISIS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over het patiëntenvervoer vanaf de Waddeneilanden

An MP asked the Defence Minister why the tender for air ambulance helicopter transport from the Wadden islands failed, and about the cost, training and landing consequences of Defence continuing to fly patient transport with the NH90. The minister answered that the RAV Fryslân tender was abandoned after a court ruling, that Defence's patient transport was handed to Coast Guard helicopters from 24 August, and that the NH90 cannot land on the UMCG roof when fully loaded.
Taking into account the court's ruling, the RAV concluded that no remaining bids met the requirements and conditions of this tender, and it therefore abandoned the tender.
Met inachtneming van de uitspraak van de rechter heeft de RAV geconcludeerd dat er geen inschrijvingen meer over zijn die aan de opdracht, eisen en randvoorwaarden van deze aanbesteding voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vuijk, Teeven en De Roon over het project Data Communicatie Mobiel Optreden Long Range Communications (DCMO-LRC)

MPs Vuijk, Teeven and De Roon asked the Defence Minister about the DCMO-LRC communications project, its status, purpose, reliability in worst-case scenarios and lessons learned. The minister answered that the project is in its realisation phase due for completion in 2015, that LRC extends communication beyond VHF radio range, and that Defence uses a mix of transmission means, with the business partner FoxIT developing the basic module.
LRC is in the realisation phase.
LRC bevindt zich in de realisatiefase.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teeven en Vuijk over het artikel “Experts kritisch op wapenexportplan”

MPs Teeven and Vuijk asked the ministers about a press report criticising the arms export plan, including CDIU consultation, the timing and validity of export licences, and EU-level distortion of competition through state-owned shipyards. Minister Ploumen answered that licences are issued before delivery with a prior sounding procedure available, that licences usually run one year, and that the EU has long worked to reduce competition distortion in defence procurement.
A licence is issued prior to the actual delivery of the goods.
Een vergunning wordt verstrekt voorafgaand aan de daadwerkelijke levering van de goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over het bericht ‘geheime informatie over JSF in handen van China’

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether reports that secret F-35 information was in Chinese hands were true and what the consequences would be, and whether this squared with hosting Chinese naval ships. The minister replied that the reporting concerns old leaked US documents and a years-old incident without classified data being taken, that operational security is not at stake, and that the Chinese ship visit follows from a bilateral partnership.
Furthermore, the JPO states that for security reasons no further details are provided.
Verder stelt het JPO dat om veiligheidsredenen geen nadere details worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over het persbericht ‘Veiligheidstekorten opgelost, wel aandachtspunten bij 336 Squadron Koninklijke luchtmacht’ van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the Safety Board's press release finding that safety shortcomings at 336 Squadron were resolved but the safety culture needs more attention, and about the Air Force's non-compliance with MAR OPS-1. The minister acknowledged the MAR OPS-1 implementation was ongoing with completion expected by year end and audit by the MLA, and answered the remaining questions largely by restating existing safety measures.
The implementation is expected to be completed by the end of this year. An evaluation and an audit by the Military Aviation Authority (MLA) will then follow.
Naar verwachting is de invoering eind van dit jaar voltooid. Vervolgens vindt een evaluatie plaats en een audit door de Militaire Luchtvaart Autoriteit (MLA).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over het bericht ‘Man gaat joyriden met pantservoertuig’

An MP asked the Minister of Defence how a man could take an armoured YPR vehicle from a barracks unseen, what measures will prevent such theft, and whether recovery costs will be recovered from the perpetrator. The minister answered that the criminal investigation is ongoing, gave a general account of how the vehicle was accessed and driven out, noted that guard staff did not follow procedures, announced stricter security enforcement, and declined to say whether costs will be recovered pending the investigation.
The criminal investigation carried out under the direction of the Public Prosecution Service by the Royal Military Police has not yet been completed.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek dat onder leiding van het Openbaar Ministerie door de Koninklijke Marechaussee wordt uitgevoerd, is nog niet voltooid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over het bericht «Shabaab claimt aanslag Nederlanders Somalië»

MP Vuijk asked the Defence Minister about al-Shabaab's claim of an attack targeting Dutch soldiers in Somalia/Djibouti, the threat to deployed personnel, and effects on anti-piracy operations and port calls. The minister replied that the attack was likely not aimed specifically at Dutch troops, the threat assessment is unchanged in substance, and precautionary measures were adopted by EU Atalanta without affecting Dutch operations.
The MIVD has no indications that there are intentions to specifically target Dutch military personnel in the region with terrorist attacks.
De MIVD beschikt niet over aanwijzingen dat er intenties zijn om terroristische aanslagen specifiek te richten op Nederlandse militairen in de regio.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Vuijk over het zelden vooraf bekend maken van dronevluchten

Two VVD MPs asked why only 9 percent of drone flights were announced in advance in 2013 compared with 87 percent in 2011, and why flights were announced afterwards rather than beforehand, including how this relates to privacy rules. The minister explained the drop by a 2012 decision removing the separate airspace application for training flights, said civil authorities decide on pre- or post-flight publication, and stated the camera footage does not show identifiable persons.
With a view to the confidentiality and effectiveness of criminal investigations, it is generally not desirable to announce flights in advance.
Met het oog op de vertrouwelijkheid en effectiviteit van strafrechtelijke onderzoeken is het doorgaans niet wenselijk om vluchten van te voren aan te kondigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vuijk over het bericht ‘Mali-missie in matig pak’

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether union claims that combat uniforms for the Mali mission are of inferior quality are true, whether NATO allies use TenCate's Defender M fabric, and whether Defence leaked TenCate fabric samples to China and Indonesia. The minister answered that the uniforms meet procurement requirements, that only the United States currently uses Defender M-based uniforms, and that the allegation about leaked samples is incorrect.

Motie van het lid Diederik van Dijk c.s. over het verruimen van de mogelijkheden tot afwijzing van aanvragen van asielzoekers als de aanvrager niet meewerkt aan de procedure
Asks the government to push in the EU for wider grounds to reject asylum applications when applicants do not cooperate with the procedure.
requests the government to work in the European context for broader possibilities to reject asylum seekers' applications

requests the government to draft a proposal for a withdrawal limit

to make appeal in first and only instance possible before the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State
beroep in eerste en enige aanleg mogelijk te maken bij de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State
Amendement van het lid Van Zanten over een maximale gevangenisstraf van 1 jaar in verband met een ongewenstverklaring

In article 197 of the Criminal Code, 'six months' is replaced by 'one year'.

requests the government to start a study into measures and instruments to support Dutch producers of generic and innovative medicines.

Asks the government to make maximum efforts to realise a materials research institute in Almere if the business case is positive, and to report progress to the House.
requests the government, if the business case is positive, to make maximum efforts to realise IAMM in Almere and periodically inform the House of progress

Asks the government not to allow the NPO to cover its planned budget cut with higher revenue from the Ster advertising levy.
requests the government not to allow the Dutch Public Broadcaster (NPO) to absorb the planned cut

requests the government to anchor a governance code in the Media Act, which will serve as a criterion in assessing admission or renewal of licences of broadcasting associations

verzoekt de regering een governancecode te verankeren in de Mediawet, die daarmee als criterium zal fungeren bij de beoordeling rondom de toetreding of de verlenging van de vergunningen van omroepverenigingen
Motie van het lid Van Zanten over het intrekken van de eenmalige investering van 3,6 miljoen voor sociale veiligheid bij de NPO
Asks the government to withdraw a one-off €3.6 million investment in social safety at the public broadcaster NPO.
requests the government to withdraw the one-off investment of 3.6 million euros.
verzoekt de regering de eenmalige investering van 3,6 miljoen euro in te trekken
Motie van het lid Van Zanten over wettelijke verankering van de zelfstandigheid van de redacties van kleine levensbeschouwingen binnen het publieke bestel
Asks the government to legally anchor the editorial independence of small philosophical broadcasters within the public broadcasting system.
requests the government to legally anchor the independence of the editorial teams of small philosophical currents within the public system

Asks the government to get the NPO and commercial broadcasters to cooperate to improve findability and visibility of Dutch content against big tech and streamers.
requests the government to start consultations with the NPO and commercial broadcasters at short notice
verzoekt de regering om met de NPO en de commerciële omroepen op korte termijn het overleg aan te gaan
Motie van de leden Van Zanten en Stoffer over ervoor zorgen dat alle aanbieders van door het RIVM erkende lesmethoden gelijke kansen krijgen om als kenniscentrum te fungeren
Asks the government to ensure all providers of RIVM-approved teaching methods get equal chances to act as a knowledge centre, not only Rutgers.
requests the government to ensure all providers of RIVM-recognised teaching methods get equal chances
verzoekt de regering ervoor te zorgen dat alle aanbieders van door het RIVM erkende lesmethoden gelijke kansen krijgen

Reallocates 500,000 euro within the education budget for 2025 to subsidise organisations giving guest lessons to teachers on antisemitism and discrimination.
to make 500,000 euro available for 2025 for subsidies to organisations supporting teachers with guest lessons

Asks the government to make the subsidy for relationship and sexuality education available to schools using recognised programmes without the Gezonde School obligations.

requests the government to also make the subsidy for relationship and sexuality education available if schools want to use the recognised programmes without the obligations of the Gezonde School programme

Amendement van de leden Ceder en Van Zanten ter vervanging van nr. 75 over middelen voor voorlopers van de techniekhavo
Moves 500,000 euro structurally to the secondary education budget for pre-stages of techniekhavo, funded by a planned btw compensation that may no longer be needed.
Funding is found in the resources available from 2026 as compensation for the VAT increase on learning materials.
Dekking wordt gevonden in de middelen die vanaf 2026 beschikbaar zijn ter compensatie voor de verhoging van de btw op de leermiddelen.
Motie van het lid Van Zanten over bureaucratische belemmeringen wegnemen voor het inzetten van onbenutte reserves van samenwerkingsverbanden voor autismeprogramma's in het onderwijs
Asks the government to investigate how bureaucratic barriers can be removed so that school partnerships can use unused reserves for autism programmes in education.
requests the government to investigate how bureaucratic barriers can be removed

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas, Vermeer, Pierik, Van Zanten, Rikkers-Oosterkamp, Wijen-Nass, Oostenbrink en Joseph over optredens van de haatprediker Bob Vylan in Nederland

MPs from BBB asked whether a Bob Vylan concert in Paradiso calling for violence against Zionists and whether such performances should be allowed, and asked about criminal liability, entry bans and municipal responsibility. The minister said prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, declined to comment on individual cases, and noted that municipal mayors decide on events and that entry refusal is possible under Schengen rules but depends on available information.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to investigate exactly what was said. The police investigation into this is still ongoing.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te onderzoeken wat er precies is gezegd. Het politieonderzoek hiernaar loopt nog.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over de artikelen 'Kantoor CIDI in Den Haag beklad: ’De waanzin dendert door’, 'Gebouw CIDI beklad met ketchup en bloem, gebeurde tijdens Gazadebat' en 'Zijn deze kunstenaars al

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the defacing of the CIDI office in The Hague and a CIDI board member's home, including whether suspects have been arrested and what protection measures exist for staff. The minister declined to comment on the individual investigation, said responsibility for security lies mainly with employers and local authorities, and rejected new laws or a dedicated prosecution policy, while pointing to existing funds, taskforce work and recent criminal-law changes.
I understand that this is a serious situation, but as usual I cannot comment on individual cases.
Ik begrijp dat dit een ingrijpende situatie is, maar zoals gebruikelijk kan ik niet ingaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten  over het artikel 'Zuyderland 21,5 miljoen euro in de plus'

An MP asks the health minister about Zuyderland's 21.5 million euro profit and whether it is compatible with staff shortages and downgrading of care in Heerlen, and whether the profit use should be independently investigated. The minister says hospitals may retain profits but not distribute them, the accounts are public, rejects an independent investigation and says the decisions on care location are the hospital's and insurer's responsibility, promising a handreiking on regional dialogue and information on the NZa reports in September.
I am not willing to do that.
Hier ben ik niet toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het bericht French court rules Gaza residents can get refugee status

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about a French court ruling granting refugee status to Gazans, its free-movement and Schengen consequences, and whether the Netherlands should challenge France or restrict social benefits. The minister said Dutch policy on Gaza already yields similar outcomes, so consequences are limited, and declined to raise objections with France, suspend Schengen, or block benefits.
Furthermore, the general picture is that it is practically impossible to leave Gaza without permission from the relevant authorities.
Verder is het algemene beeld dat het vrijwel onmogelijk is om Gaza te verlaten zonder toestemming van de relevante autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oostenbrink en Van Zanten over het artikel Visumvrij reizen 85 miljoen Turken stap dichterbij

BBB MPs asked whether the European Commission is seriously considering visa-free travel for all Turkish citizens despite Turkey's non-fulfilment of benchmarks, and what this means for migration control and sovereignty. The minister replied that visa liberalisation is not on the table because six of 72 criteria remain open, that the Schengen cascade model change only extends visa validity for frequent travellers, and that the government firmly maintains full fulfilment of the benchmarks.
See the answer to question 2. There is no question of visa-free travel.
Zie het antwoord op vraag 2. Er is geen sprake van visumvrij reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over de Z-route inburgering

An MP asks the state secretary about the share of integration trainees placed in the Z-route (around 29 percent in 2024, against an expected maximum of 15 percent), whether eligibility is loosened, how eligibility is checked, and whether the route allows avoidance of language requirements. The state secretary confirms the figures, denies loosening of criteria, describes the intake and feasibility test, and commits to further monitoring and to examining municipal application in the upcoming evaluation.
I therefore closely monitor this development.
Ik houd daarom deze ontwikkeling nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het bericht 'COA worstelt met hoge kamerprijzen voor opvang in hotels'

An MP asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reports that COA pays up to €290 per night for hotel asylum rooms, why prices are not market-level, how expiring contracts will be priced, how the motion to end commercial emergency reception will be implemented, whether residents must cook for themselves, and when emergency reception can end. The minister acknowledges high prices, explains COA's price steering and contract shortening, describes phasing out emergency locations as capacity allows, and gives a partial answer with a list annexed, while declining to forecast a closing date.
COA also aims to transfer expensive and temporary reception contracts as much as possible to cheaper, long-term ones within the financial framework.
Het COA zet er bovendien op in om dure en tijdelijke opvangovereenkomsten zoveel mogelijk over te zetten naar goedkopere en langjarige binnen de financiële kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het bericht ‘Onrust in Fries dorpje om jonge AZC’ers die meisjes belagen: Nog een vinger naar mijn dochter en ik ga los’

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration how to stop unaccompanied minor asylum seekers at a Frisian reception centre from harassing girls, whether supervision or area bans could be imposed, and why COA told a victim not to go to the police. The Minister said coordination with police, COA and the municipality will continue, that intensive supervision and transfer to specialised care exist, that area bans are for the mayor, and that reporting crimes remains policy.
As you know, individual cases cannot be addressed.
Zoals u bekend, kan niet worden ingegaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Piri, Rajkowski, Van Nispen, Boomsma en Van Zanten over het preventiefonds en schaderegelingen voor ondernemers in Ter Apel

MPs asked whether the 800,000 euro preventive fund for Ter Apel is nearly exhausted, how remaining costs will be financed, whether damage settlement will be broadened by this summer, and whether a single counter for damage claims and preventive funds can be set up. The minister said the funds were paid to Westerwolde municipality, that the damage scheme will be widened case by case, and that a single counter is being explored with a decentralised grant to be decided by the municipality.
As promised to the House and stated in the letter of 11 March 2025, the damage scheme will be broadened.
Zoals aan de Kamer toegezegd en benoemd in de Kamerbrief op 11 maart 2025, zal de schaderegeling verruimd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wijnen-Nas en Zanten over de column ‘Afgeslacht om die achterlijke reden: Eer’

MPs Van Zanten and Wijnen-Nas asked the government about a Telegraaf column on honour killings and what it would do about the attitudes behind them and whether citizenship could be revoked for honour-motivated crimes. The state secretary condemned the worldview, described prevention and repression measures, and said revoking Dutch nationality is only possible within European Convention limits, with the government studying whether other serious crimes could be added.
Revoking Dutch nationality is only possible for persons who hold another nationality besides Dutch.
Intrekking van de Nederlandse nationaliteit is alleen mogelijk bij personen die naast de Nederlandse nog een andere nationaliteit hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Zanten en Stoffer over het bericht van De Nieuwe Ster ’Hakenkruizen en antisemitisme op UWC’

MPs Van Zanten and Stoffer asked about reports of swastikas, antisemitic remarks by a guest speaker, and a student email at UWC Maastricht, and whether the school and the Inspectorate are protecting pupils. The State Secretary answered that the school has registered incidents, tightened its guest-speaker and email protocols and safety policy, and that the Inspectorate sees no reason for further steps while staying alert, offering support via a school-safety foundation.
The inspectorate is of the view that the board and the school are taking the situation very seriously.
De inspectie is van oordeel dat het bestuur en de school de situatie zeer serieus oppakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeer en Van Zanten over het bericht 'Vernietiging Armeens erfgoed in Nagorno-Karabach: 'Doelbewust uitwissen geschiedenis''

Two BBB MPs asked whether the government would summon the Azerbaijani ambassador, urge Azerbaijan to stop destroying Armenian heritage in Nagorno-Karabakh, prosecute perpetrators, protect remaining Armenians and compensate displaced people, and add the conflict to Dutch education. The government answered that it is concerned, urged compliance with Hague conventions and peace talks, but did not commit to summoning the ambassador and deferred prosecution and compensation to the two states.
It is up to Armenia and Azerbaijan to ensure investigation and prosecution of crimes within this framework.
Het is aan Armenië en Azerbeidzjan om binnen dit kader zorg te dragen voor opsporing en vervolging van misdrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Zanten over Samidoun

An MP asked whether the government would ban a Samidoun teach-in at the University of Amsterdam, after Samidoun's Europe coordinator had earlier been barred, and what the status is of a motion to list Samidoun on the Dutch terrorist sanctions list. The minister replied that universities decide on events under academic freedom, that the UvA says the event was not officially registered and Samidoun is not welcome, and that no sufficient grounds currently exist for a court ban or sanctions listing, with a broader EU inventory and possible further measures to be reported in spring.

The conversation that has since taken place confirmed that the Public Prosecution Service currently has no information that could contribute to a request for a court ban or listing on the sanctions list.

Het gesprek dat inmiddels heeft plaatsgevonden heeft bevestigd dat het Openbaar Ministerie op dit moment geen informatie heeft die kan bijdragen aan een verzoek om verbodenverklaring bij de rechter of plaatsing op de sanctielijst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Ceder, Van Zanten, Eerdmans en Ellian over het weigeren van een Israëlische comedian door theaters in Amsterdam

MPs from five parties asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how she views Amsterdam theatres declining to host Israeli comedian Yohay Sponder after threats and reactions, whether local police and municipal bodies were consulted, and what follow-up is planned. The minister condemns the intimidation, says cultural institutions must be free to programme, notes Boom Chicago did not follow the sector protocol, and reports ongoing talks with the alderman and Kunsten '92 to find an alternative venue.
It is intolerable that a cultural institution receives such reactions or is threatened to such an extent that a performance is cancelled.
Het is onverteerbaar dat een culturele instelling zodanige reacties krijgt of zodanig wordt bedreigd dat een voorstelling wordt geannuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het bericht 'Tieners veroordeeld voor groepsverkrachting dakloze vrouw in Helmond

MP Van Zanten asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether a group rape by teenagers of a homeless woman in Helmond should lead to withdrawal of asylum permits, how the motion on refusing or revoking permits after prison sentences will be implemented, which sentence length applies, and on what timeline. The minister answers that serious offences should in principle lead to refusal or revocation, that the minimum sentence threshold is dropped in favour of case-by-case assessment (while the sliding scale of Article 3.86 remains for non-extension or revocation), and that the policy circular was amended and published on 30 January 2025.
I am of the view that if there is a (particularly) serious offence, this should in principle lead to rejection of the asylum application or revocation of the permit.
Ik ben van mening dat als er sprake is van een (bijzonder) ernstig misdrijf, dit in beginsel zou moeten leiden tot afwijzing van de asielaanvraag of intrekking van de vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het bericht 'Harde klap voor gastlessen'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education why the stichting Na de Oorlog lost a tender for teacher support on antisemitism lessons, and whether the tender criteria, process and winner (Fawaka) were appropriate. The State Secretary answered that the 2023 subsidy and the 2024 tender stem from separate amendments, that the tender was run correctly with relevant expertise as a criterion, and announced new subsidy schemes and tenders for 2025.
The tender process was carefully conducted in accordance with the applicable guidelines of the General Government Terms and Conditions for Services (ARVODI).
Het aanbestedingsproces is zorgvuldig verlopen volgens de daarvoor geldende richtlijnen van de Algemene Rijksinkoopvoorwaarden voor diensten (ARVODI).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Van Zanten en Hertzberger over het bericht ‘Niet-rendabele talenstudies verdwijnen, want studenten doen liever een brede bachelor’

MPs Stoffer, Van Zanten and Hertzberger asked the Minister of Education about reports that small language programmes such as French and German are being closed at Leiden and Utrecht, and what the government will do to keep a national offering. The minister acknowledges the concern, points to the sector plan Talen & Culturen, says institutions decide on closures under an existing advisory procedure, and commits to talks with the sector and a DLG action plan, while declining to set minimum norms or a numerus fixus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elian en Van Zanten over het bericht ‘Te koop in Nederland: 7 Oktober, de game’ worden beantwoord zoals aangegeven

MPs Van Zanten and Ellian asked whether the game 'Fursan al-Aqsa' depicting the 7 October attack, sold on Steam in the Netherlands, violates criminal law and should be banned. The minister said criminal prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, that the game was removed from Steam for EU member states after a French removal order, and that the national authority ATKM is monitoring the situation.
I have specifically brought this game to the attention of the Dutch ATKM to see whether it can be removed.
Ik heb deze game specifiek onder de aandacht gebracht van de Nederlandse ATKM om te bezien of deze verwijderd kan worden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over journalistieke integriteit en onpartijdigheid van door de overheid gefinancierde media n.a.v. de berichten 'BBC ‘breached guidelines 1,500 times’ over Israel- Hamas war', 'V

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how complaints about biased public broadcaster coverage of Israel and the Middle East are handled, whether the regulator will investigate, and how the government will protect journalistic integrity and combat biased information. The minister answered that complaints go first to the broadcaster and the Ombudsman, that the Media Regulator handles signals on a risk-based basis, and that direct government oversight of media content would amount to censorship, so the government declines to ask the regulator for investigations.
I am not willing to ask the regulator to conduct such an investigation.
Ik ben niet bereid het commissariaat te vragen een dergelijk onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het bericht ‘’Olifant in kamer’ blijft ongenoemd in debat over dalende homoacceptatie'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about declining acceptance of same-sex relationships among young people, including in Amsterdam, and the role of religious, cultural and social media factors. The State Secretary acknowledged the decline as troubling, pointed to mixed research evidence, and committed to commissioning a study on the causes with results expected by summer 2025, while declining to request a separate national study from the SCP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over de problematiek rond het innen van de eigen bijdragen van Oekraïense ontheemden met een baan en eigen inkomsten

An MP asks the government about municipalities struggling to collect own contributions from working Ukrainian displaced persons, retroactive charges, the tax exemption for motor vehicle tax and BPM, housing, and security in Ukraine. The minister answers that the government supports municipalities with a guide and reimbursed costs, allows retroactive charges not before 1 July 2024 but advises restraint, and says the vehicle exemption expires on 4 March 2025 without committing to further changes.
We have advised municipalities to exercise restraint, so as not to confront displaced persons at a later time with an accumulated arrears.
Wij hebben gemeenten geadviseerd terughoudendheid te betrachten, om ontheemden niet op een later moment met een opgebouwde achterstand te confronteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het bericht 'Opnieuw irritatie in carnavalswereld Limburg over datum voorjaarsvakantie'

An MP asked why the 2025 spring holiday for the southern region does not coincide with the carnival week, and what weight is given to carnival as cultural heritage. The Staatssecretaris answered that the spring holiday is only an advisory date, schools may deviate, the 7-8 weeks school rhythm drives planning, and a 2024 evaluation of the holiday regulation will consider carnival's role.
First and foremost, all schools that wish to can simply hold their spring holiday during the carnival week.
Voorop staat dat alle scholen die dat willen, gewoon hun voorjaarsvakantie tijdens de carnavalsweek kunnen houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het bericht ‘Vruchteloze strijd met ON! kost NPO tonnen aan externe advocaten’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the NPO spending nearly EUR 800,000 on external lawyers in its dispute with broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland, rather than using in-house legal staff, and about the rules, transparency and selection of counsel. The Minister answered that the NPO makes its own judgments on needed expertise, that legal costs are reported in its annual report, that the Minister cannot intervene in individual disputes and the NPO is independent in executing its statutory tasks, and that the Aanbestedingswet does not apply.
The NPO makes its own assessments of the expertise required in carrying out its tasks.
De NPO maakt haar eigen afwegingen over de benodigde expertise bij de uitvoering van haar taken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten ver de artikelen 'Pro-Palestinian protesters are backed by a surprising source: Biden’s biggest donors' en 'Qatar is oversaturating US Universities with funds, directly affecting

MP Van Zanten asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether foreign funding, including from Qatar, reaches Dutch universities and fuels antisemitism, and what measures exist compared with the US. The minister answered that no such cases are known, that transparency on external funding is being pursued through a forthcoming guideline and the Wtmo bill, and that universities are responsible for their own safeguards.
We do not know whether money from these or other foreign organisations has reached Dutch educational institutions.
We weten niet of er ook geld van deze of andere buitenlandse organisaties terecht is gekomen bij Nederlandse onderwijsinstellingen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het nieuwsbericht 'Kunstacademie stopt samenwerking met Israël: Eisen van studenten worden ingewilligd' en het bijbehorende Instagrambericht op het profiel van Kabkstudentun

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the Royal Academy of Art (KABK) suspending its cooperation with an Israeli institution after student demands, and about a related Instagram post with the phrase 'Global intifada'. The Minister answered that institutions decide on international cooperation autonomously within the law, that KABK is developing an ethical framework, that no sanctions or funding cuts are planned, and that the government does not monitor such decisions.
Because institutions have the right and freedom to decide on their international cooperation, there is no question of sanctioning measures or stopping funding.
Omdat instellingen het recht en de vrijheid hebben om te beslissen over hun internationale samenwerkingen is er geen sprake van sanctionerende maatregelen of het stopzetten van bekostiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het bericht 'Onrust op basisscholen over uitkomsten nieuwe doorstroomtoets: ‘Dit klopt gewoon niet’'

An MP asked the minister about school leaders doubting the reliability of the new end-of-primary (doorstroom) test, its effect on equal opportunity, the weighting of test results against teacher judgement, the multiple commercial providers, the absence of a pilot, and the CvTE review. The minister defended the new norming and the rule requiring schools to revise advice when a higher test result is obtained, promised a full analysis after summer 2024, and declined to provide complaint figures per provider, referring the MP to the providers.
I do not have this data. For this I refer you to the providers of the end-of-primary tests.
Ik beschik niet over deze gegevens. Hiervoor verwijs ik u naar de aanbieders van de doorstroomtoetsen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over de reactie op de motie van het lid Van Zanten c.s. over geen subsidiebeleid voor inclusie en diversiteit met een dwingend karakter en een evenredigere verdeling van cultuurs

MP Van Zanten asks how the government reconciles its February 2024 letter keeping the Code Diversiteit en Inclusie in future culture subsidy frameworks with the adopted motion that diversity and inclusion should not be binding conditions, and how applications will now be weighed. The state secretary answers that the 2025–2028 rules were fixed before the application window opened, the diversity code is non-binding with no set norms, the Raad voor Cultuur assessment is still ongoing with advice expected in July, and geographic distribution effects cannot yet be measured.
Since the Diversity and Inclusion Code does not prescribe how institutions must give substance to the code, the motion of your House is already being followed.
Aangezien de Code Diversiteit en Inclusie niet voorschrijft hoe instellingen inhoudelijk invulling aan de code moeten geven, wordt er reeds conform de motie van uw Kamer gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over het artikel ‘Leesvaardigheid Nederlandse 15-jarigen verder achteruitgegaan'

An MP asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education about declining reading skills among 15-year-olds in PISA results, the effect of the loss of the old school types, digital media use, parental involvement and international lessons. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to the Masterplan basisvaardigheden, new core curriculum goals, library-in-school programmes and phone restrictions in classrooms, and said the EUR 15.7 million underspend will be spent in 2024 rather than left unused.
Our intention is to spend the EUR 15.7 million in the second part of the school year (2024).
Ons voornemen is om de € 15,7 miljoen in het tweede deel van het schooljaar (2024) uit te geven.
