qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het bericht 'Pensioenfonds PME doet honderden bedrijven in de ban'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that pension fund PME excludes hundreds of companies on ideological grounds, and whether this breaches the motion-Aartsen principle of risk and return over political considerations. The minister rejected concerns about ideological investing, said existing law and DNB supervision suffice and no tightening is needed, and declined to comment on a fund director's remarks about the US.
I therefore saw no reason to tighten the supervisory framework.
Ik heb dan ook geen aanleiding gezien om het toezichtskader aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het bericht dat de FIOD een nieuwe "Bulgarenfraude" heeft ontdekt

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance (Tax Benefits and Customs) about reports of renewed Bulgarian-linked benefit fraud, when the government first knew of signals, why it did not intervene earlier, how much money was lost, and whether more fraud signals exist. The State Secretary answered that signals were reported to parliament in April 2024, that regular checks continued while intensive review had been paused, that the amount lost and recovery steps cannot be disclosed due to an ongoing FIOD investigation, and that further address and DigiD signals are being processed.
I therefore cannot go into questions 4 and 5 in more detail.
Op de vragen 4 en 5 kan ik dan ook niet nader ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het in de problemen komen van de teelt van frietaardappelen door nieuwe Haagse regels

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about farmers being penalised with reduced nitrogen allowances for sowing cover crops after 1 October, which hurts potato growers after a cold, wet spring, and whether the rules were consulted with the sector. The Minister defends the rule as needed for water quality, notes flexibility and the possibility of a later sowing with a penalty, and does not commit to changes.
I do not intend to make changes to the measure promoting cover crop cultivation that follows from the 7th Nitrates Directive Action Programme.
Ik ben niet voornemens wijzigingen aan te brengen in de maatregel ter stimulering van de teelt van vanggewassen die volgt uit het 7e Actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over verslechtering van de Nederlandse waterkwaliteit in EU-rapportages terwijl de waterkwaliteit in Nederland verbetert

An MP asked the minister whether Dutch water quality is declining in EU reports while improving domestically, and why measurement methods may explain the discrepancy. The minister answered that Dutch water quality has improved under the Water Framework Directive, that nitrate leaching rose again since 2018 partly due to drought, and that the EU report differences stem from unit errors in 2008–2011 data and depth-category differences, while refusing to reduce monitoring points.
I am currently in discussion with the European Commission to see how this discrepancy can be prevented in the future.
Ik ben momenteel in gesprek met de Europese Commissie om te kijken hoe deze discrepantie in de toekomst voorkomen kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over een artikel waarin wordt gesteld dat het mestbeleid een opeenstapeling is van verkeerd beleid sinds de jaren negentig

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether mandatory manure injection harms soil life and leaches more nutrients, whether research was dropped, and which EU countries mandate injection. The minister denied the core claims, pointed to PBL and expert-committee reports, and said the former minister's research assignment could not be identified.
It is not known which research assignment is being referred to.
Niet bekend is aan welke onderzoeksopdracht gerefereerd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het bericht dat mogelijk 90 procent van de Urker vissersvloot de kerst niet haalt zonder compensatie voor de gestegen brandstofprijzen

An MP asked the minister about reports that most of Urk's fishing fleet may not survive to Christmas without compensation for fuel price rises, and about the lack of support compared with other EU countries. The minister acknowledged the hardship, pointed to the decommissioning scheme, bridging and liquidity schemes and innovation subsidies, and committed to further schemes and an impact analysis.
I will support them by, alongside the decommissioning scheme, further developing the bridging scheme, about which I informed the House on 15 November, and opening it early next year.
Ik ga hen ondersteunen door naast de saneringsregeling de overbruggingsregeling, waar ik de Kamer op 15 november jl. over heb geïnformeerd, verder uit te werken en begin volgend jaar open te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over de brandbrief 'saneringsregeling visserij'

An MP asks whether the fishing decommissioning scheme's condition that quotas lapse without compensation was never discussed beforehand, calls it unjust, and asks why the Dutch government supports fishers less than France or Belgium. The minister confirms the condition was not discussed to avoid insider trading in quotas, defends the scheme as necessary after Brexit, offers temporary free quota management for remaining fishers, and promises a letter on a bridging scheme.
This was chosen because a preliminary consultation on this component could lead to trading quotas with inside knowledge, which is undesirable.
Hiervoor is gekozen omdat een vooroverleg over dit onderdeel kon leiden tot handel in contingenten met voorkennis, wat ongewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Edgar Mulder over een artikel in het Algemeen Dagblad (22 juli jl.) 'Pal naast Natura 2000-gebied in Barchem wil Natuurmonumenten grote huizen bouwen’

MPs Kops and Edgar Mulder asked why Natuurmonumenten may build four homes next to a Natura 2000 area in Barchem while farmers may not, and whether this serves nature. The minister answered that the homes fit the zoning plan and the Rood voor Rood scheme, that emissions and nature gains result, and that no action against Natuurmonumenten is warranted.
Organisations and companies in the Netherlands are free to pursue initiatives within the law.
Het staat organisaties en bedrijven in Nederland vrij om initiatieven te ontplooien binnen de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Graus over het artikel 'Luxemburgers kijken naar Delfzijl voor industriële houtzagerij: investering van meer dan 1 miljoen'

PVV MPs Graus and Mulder asked whether Staatsbosbeheer's planned supply of roundwood to a new large Delfzijl sawmill (linked to Wood Trading & Technologies/IBV) would distort competition and squeeze smaller Dutch sawmills, contrary to a motion they had passed. The minister replied that Staatsbosbeheer operates within the Market and Government Act, that only a limited volume is reserved and smaller mills keep access, and that she will talk with Staatsbosbeheer about additional measures but sees no reason for a large-scale investigation.
I am therefore of the view that the current regulations provide sufficient frameworks.
Ik ben derhalve van mening dat met de huidige regelgeving voldoende kaders zijn meegegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het bericht 'Kritische depositiewaarden niet geschikt voor beschermen natuur'

An MP asks the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about claims that critical nitrogen deposition values (KDW) rest on glasshouse experiments and lack scientific scrutiny, and asks for a cost-benefit analysis of Natura 2000 areas. The minister rejects the claims, citing field research, peer review and a meta-analysis, and points to a forthcoming socio-economic analysis expected in autumn 2022.
The above answers show there is no reason to claim that nitrogen policy is flawed.
Uit bovenstaande antwoorden blijkt dat er geen reden is om te stellen dat het stikstofbeleid rammelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het artikel 'Stikstofnormen boerensloten veel strenger in Nederland'

MP Edgar Mulder asked the minister whether nutrient standards for farm ditches in the Netherlands are stricter than in Germany and Belgium, whether cross-border river inflows drive exceedances, and whether an impact analysis would be sent to parliament. The minister answered that standards are set per water type and are mid-range internationally, that cross-border influence varies by region and is addressed in river commissions, and saw no need for an additional impact analysis.
I therefore see no need for an additional impact analysis.
Ik zie dan ook geen noodzaak tot een extra impactanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het artikel 'Zelfs betrokkenen ‘Bulgarenfraude’ krijgen tienduizenden euro’s compensatie'

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a report that people involved in the 'Bulgarian fraud' received compensation of tens of thousands of euros, and whether the same IP addresses were used, why the Chamber was not informed earlier, how much was wrongly paid out, and whether money would be recovered. The State Secretary answered that 14 people received the flat-rate EUR 30,000 after a first check, that a full later assessment is pending, that the error rate of the first check is estimated at 2-5%, that recovery will only occur in cases of evident misuse, and that an internal presentation was shared on request while internal signals will be summarised in a later letter.

I do not have those reports. Signals within the organisation about possible improper and indiscriminate use of the recovery schemes directed at my predecessor or senior management are of a personal nature and are often traceable to individual employees.

Over die meldingen beschik ik niet. Signalen in de organisatie over mogelijk oneigenlijk en ongericht gebruik van de herstelregelingen bij mijn ambtsvoorganger of het hogere management zijn van persoonlijke aard en zijn vaak herleidbaar tot individuele medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het de leden Kops en Mulder over de rampzalige gevolgen van de EU-klimaatplannen voor de landbouw

PVV MPs Kops and Mulder asked whether EU climate plans (Fit-for-55, Farm to Fork) would cause large food price rises, deforestation and worsening nature, citing a German study. The minister responded that the study uses unrealistic hypothetical assumptions and covers only part of the strategy, that the government shares the goal of affordable food but supports the EU climate plans, and that these plans protect nature and cut emissions.
These assumptions are not realistic because they are not part of the climate plans of the European Commission.
Deze aannames zijn niet realistisch omdat ze geen onderdeel uitmaken van de klimaatplannen van de Europese Commissie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het artikel 'Stikstofrapporten drama voor boer en natuur'

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, through several questions, whether a nitrogen report would increase biodiversity, whether a claimed peatland area and its buyout costs exist, whether nature targets are feasible, and whether ammonia levels on the Veluwe are lower than elsewhere, and asked about funding and accountability for a report. The minister answered that the report is too high-level to quantify effects yet, that the peat area exists and was re-surveyed, that targets were assessed for feasibility, that ammonia figures are lower on the Veluwe, and that the funding conditions were met with no reason to reclaim money.
The report was prepared in a sound manner and deserves to be taken seriously in the further elaboration of nitrogen policy.
Het rapport is op een gedegen wijze tot stand gekomen en verdient het om serieus te worden genomen bij de nadere invulling van het stikstofbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het artikel ‘Gebiedsgerichte aanpak één grote leugen?’

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about an article claiming nitrogen policy and area-based approach are a lie, covering ammonia deposition distance, buyouts of polluting farms, and measurement data. The minister responds that ammonia and nitrogen oxides deposit near the source, that buyout schemes address peak polluters, that monitoring data are publicly available, and that the policy is well founded.
The articles referred to in the questions give me no reason to doubt the justification of the nitrogen policy.
De artikelen waarin in de vragen wordt gerefereerd geven mij geen reden om te twijfelen aan de onderbouwing van het stikstofbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het onderzoek naar stikstofdepositie en kritische depositiewaarden

The MP asks the minister whether soil nitrogen stored in nature areas, and nitrogen released by felling forest or converting nature, is being kept out of view in nitrogen policy, and questions the scientific basis of the nitrogen measures and their cost. The minister answers that only external deposition is relevant to the ecosystem balance, that soil-derived uptake is far smaller than claimed, and that the scientific basis is not doubted, so no further study is needed.
The release of nitrogen is in itself not a problem, as long as it remains part of the cycle.
Het beschikbaar komen van stikstof is op zich geen probleem, zolang het maar onderdeel is van de kringloop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het bericht 'Stikstofdepositie geen bedreiging voor natuur in uiterwaarden'

Mulder (PVV) asks whether nitrogen deposition really poses no threat to nature in floodplains, whether critical deposition values there should be dropped, and whether the basis of nitrogen policy is too weak. The minister rejects the generalized conclusion, explains that critical deposition values for supplementary habitat types were set provisionally and are being corrected via mapping rounds, and says she does not share the view that the policy basis is seriously deficient.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het bericht 'EU-commissie ergert food- en agribusiness'

An MP from the PVV asks the agriculture minister whether the European Commission's Farm to Fork strategy is being adopted without a proper impact assessment, and whether the Netherlands will withdraw support until one is published. The minister replies that a technical study is still ongoing, that each legislative element will get its own impact assessment and be submitted to parliament via the usual channel, and that the Dutch government will not withdraw its support since the strategy broadly aligns with cabinet policy.

Each legislative element of the Farm to Fork strategy will be accompanied by an impact assessment, and I will inform your House through the usual channel about the intended cabinet position on each element.

De uitwerking van elk wetgevingsonderdeel van de Van boer tot bord-strategie wordt voorzien van een effectbeoordeling en ik zal uw Kamer via de gebruikelijke weg over de voorgenomen kabinetspositie per onderdeel informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Peters, Lodders, Edgar Mulder, Van Weyenberg, Snels, Nijboer, Bruins, Van Raan, Azarkan, Van Haga, Van Otterloo, Leijten, Stoffer en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat de Bel

MPs from many parties asked whether the Tax Authority fails to apply the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) when offsetting benefit overpayments against current allowances, and whether this breaches the law. The State Secretary admits that offsets under the standard payment arrangement were made without applying the protected minimum, that this is a mistaken assumption, and promises a repayment operation and a solution, but declines to meet the requested three-week deadline.
I conclude that this approach, given the purpose and intent of the Wet vBVV, offers citizens insufficient protection.
Ik concludeer dat deze werkwijze, gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vBVV, onvoldoende bescherming aan burgers biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Edgar Mulder over de brandstofprijzen in Nederland

PVV MPs Madlener and Mulder asked the ministers why Dutch fuel prices are among the highest in the world, whether this harms purchasing power and border-region businesses, whether it creates dangerous cross-border jerrycan transport, and whether fuel taxes will be cut. The government answered that Dutch prices are high mainly due to world oil market supply and demand, acknowledged possible purchasing-power effects, found no evidence of rule-breaking on jerrycan limits, and said it has no plans to lower fuel taxes.
The cabinet does not intend to lower taxes on fuels.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens de belastingen op brandstoffen te verlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het bericht 'Minister Schouten komt met hilarisch antwoord op Kamervragen over kritische depositiewaarden'

An MP asks the minister to reconsider claims about critical nitrogen deposition values and the Korenburgerveen nature area, and to stop what he calls the harassment of farmers and waste of billions on a fabricated nitrogen problem. The minister maintains that the critical deposition values rest on studies predating the cited article, that the cited ecologist's note does not contain the quoted statements and itself reports species losses, and that the nitrogen problem is real and the spending necessary.
I have a warm regard for farmers; there was and is no question of belittling farmers.
Ik draag de boeren een warm hart toe; van het wegtreiteren van boeren was en is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het data-lek bij het ziekenhuis OLVG waardoor onbevoegde studenten medische dossiers hebben ingezien

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a data leak at hospital OLVG that let unauthorised student workers view patient records, whether patients were informed, whether access was closed, and whether a plan exists to address such leaks and to limit sharing to a basic patient-controlled dataset. The minister said the hospital reported the breach to the data protection authority, tightened access and privacy training, and is investigating; sector-wide, he cited existing rules, Z-CERT, a planned obligation to join it and a broader action plan, while rejecting a single basic dataset as impractical.
The OLVG is investigating the records that were unlawfully viewed by unauthorised student workers.
Het OLVG doet onderzoek naar de dossiers die onrechtmatig zijn ingezien door onbevoegde werkstudenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het bericht dat de BelastingTelefoon voor het zesde jaar op rij onder de maat presteert

Rep. Edgar Mulder (PVV) asked the State Secretary of Finance why the Tax Helpline was rated insufficient for the sixth year running, asking about answer accuracy, staffing, training and remedial action. State Secretary Snel answered that about 90% of calls are process and status questions meeting the 90% norm, that complex regulatory questions (about 3%) fall short, and that specialisation by theme and a stronger second line are being prepared.
Measures to improve the answering of questions on laws and regulations, such as specialisation on these questions and strengthening the second line, are being prepared.

Rep. Edgar Mulder (PVV) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the consequences of the CJEU's 22 February 2018 ruling on the Dutch fiscal unity regime, including the number of firms affected, budgetary effects, the regime's value for tax authorities and the investment climate, and whether a cross-border fiscal unity is feasible. The State Secretary answered that emergency repair measures are needed to protect the tax base, that budgetary effects are still being studied with a bill expected in Q2 2018, and that a cross-border fiscal unity is not a realistic option.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het bericht 'Dit gebeurt er met die 30 miljoen ‘vergeten’ euro's op oude ov-chipkaarten'

An MP asked the state secretary about press reports on about 30 million euros of unclaimed balances on old public transport chip cards, including whether Translink funds ICT and a charity and whether consumer organisations approve spending. Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over de te strikte toepassing van wetgeving, naar aanleiding van het artikel “ProRail: treinvertraging en economische schade door te strikt naleven van de wet; Roep om meer flexibili

An MP asked the State Secretary whether overly strict enforcement of rail and environmental law delays trains and causes economic harm, and whether the rules can be simplified. The State Secretary answered that safety and nature rules serve legitimate purposes, that existing consultations with ProRail and agencies continue, and that the government will examine legal instruments, without conceding that the rules are too strict.
My ministry is continuously in consultation with the parties involved to see where clarification is needed.
Mijn ministerie is continu in overleg met de betrokken partijen om te zien waar verduidelijking nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Minhas over het bericht 'Intercity Eindhoven-Aken loopt mogelijk vertraging op 2025 zeer ambitieus'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary whether a direct Intercity Eindhoven-Aken is feasible by 2025 or December 2024 in the off-peak hours, why the €125 million budget falls short, and what the economic and accessibility consequences of delay are. The State Secretary answers that the December 2024 off-peak introduction is still the target but is very ambitious, outlines the remaining steps, names an extra ~€920 million need for Eindhoven station works, and says he will inform parliament in early 2024 on the structural variant.
This is why I indicated in my letter to the House of Representatives of 5 October that the aim of introduction by December 2024 is very ambitious.
Dit maakt dat ik in de brief aan de Tweede Kamer op 5 oktober jl. heb aangegeven dat het streven naar introductie per december 2024 zeer ambitieus is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rajkowski en Minhas  over het bericht ‘Ernstig lek bij Kadaster: miljoenen woonadressen door iedereen op te zoeken’

MPs Rajkowski and Minhas asked the minister about a leak at the Kadaster that let anyone look up residential addresses by name, and about the measures taken, the planned law change, data-breach notification and access logging. The minister answered that the leak has been closed, that verification of existing business accounts is nearly complete, that a Kadasterbesluit amendment restricting name search is being prepared, and that affected persons are being informed.
The leak in the registration procedure has now been fully closed.
Het lek in de aanmeldprocedure is inmiddels volledig gedicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Bevers over het bericht ‘Weer problemen met leerlingenvervoer in Schiedam: bussen komen soms wel twee uur te laat’

MPs Minhas and Bevers asked about late school transport buses for vulnerable pupils in Schiedam and what the government would do. The minister says responsibility lies with municipalities, that she has written to the VNG asking it to hold municipalities to account, and that she urges Schiedam to act quickly.
Responsibility for implementing pupil transport, however, lies with municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van het leerlingenvervoer ligt echter bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Zaltbommel zet alle nieuwe bouwplannen een jaar lang in de ijskast'

MPs Minhas and Peter de Groot (VVD) asked the Minister for Housing about reports that the municipality of Zaltbommel would freeze new building plans for a year because of the Environment and Planning Act, given the housing shortage. The minister replied that Zaltbommel still processes permit applications, only pausing new zoning plans, that a temporary stop of permit applications is legally impossible, and that he is working with the VNG and regional implementation supporters to prevent further delays.
For municipal councils there is room to temporarily refrain from adopting new zoning plans.
Voor gemeenteraden bestaat er wel ruimte om tijdelijk af te zien van het vaststellen van nieuwe bestemmingsplannen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Heerema over het bericht “Reizigersvereniging boos over plannen NS. Intercity Alkmaar-Haarlem komt niet terug en op vrijdag minder treinen tussen Alkmaar en Amsterdam”

MPs Minhas and Heerema asked the state secretary about NS plans to cut some Intercity and Sprinter services between Alkmaar, Haarlem and Amsterdam in the 2024 timetable, the expected ridership, use of the transition compensation, and how regions and the concession will safeguard service levels. The state secretary answered that NS decides the timetable within concession rules, that about 1800 extra trains per week are added overall, that the transition plan is submitted to the ministry, and that the new concession will include tariff differentiation requirements.
It is currently not possible to make the contribution from the 2023 public transport transition compensation scheme transparent, because it depends on actual passenger numbers.
Het is op dit moment niet mogelijk om de bijdrage uit de regeling transitievergoeding OV (TVOV) 2023 inzichtelijk te maken omdat deze afhangen van de werkelijke reizigersaantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van  lid Minhas over berichtgeving in de Telegraaf over de economische schade van knelpunten in de weg-, vaarweg- en spoorweginfrastructuur

MP Minhas asked the minister, citing a Telegraaf report and a Panteia study commissioned by the Logistieke Alliantie, about record economic damage from freight congestion on road, waterway and rail, and how the government will address bottlenecks and fund infrastructure. The minister acknowledges the damage and the bottlenecks, points to rail measures and ProRail repairs, but states that 17 MIRT infrastructure projects are paused due to lack of financial, personnel and nitrogen room, with no funds currently for corridor bottlenecks.
As a consequence, 17 MIRT projects will be temporarily paused; other projects will continue.
Dit heeft als consequentie dat 17 MIRT-projecten voorlopig gepauzeerd worden; andere projecten blijven doorgang vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Van Campen over het adviesrapport 'Goed water goed geregeld' van de Raad voor de leefomgeving en infrastructuur (Rli)

Two VVD MPs (Minhas and Van Campen) asked the minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the government responds to the Rli advice on the Water Framework Directive, whether the 2027 targets are achievable, what the main obstacles are, and whether projects could stall. The minister answers that urgency is high, the KRW impulse programme has started, exemptions are possible only under strict conditions, and that project stalling is not expected generically though specific projects may be affected, referring largely to the separate cabinet response for further measures.
As indicated in the Water Committee debate of 7 June, achieving the goals of the Water Framework Directive is a top priority.
Zoals aangegeven in het Commissiedebat Water van 7 juni is het behalen van de doelen van de Kaderrichtlijn Water een topprioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Van den Hil over het treinvervangend busvervoer in Zeeland

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about replacement bus service in Zeeland that failed stranded travellers, asking how NS oversees it, why app information was wrong, and how it will be improved. The State Secretary acknowledged the failures, said NS is responsible under the concession and will be held to account, and committed to lessons learned and a check before Roze Zaterdag, which went well.
In such cases I expect NS to learn from the situation and apply these lessons to improve replacement rail transport in the future.
In dergelijke gevallen verwacht ik van NS dat zij lering trekt uit de situatie en deze lessen meeneemt om het treinvervangend vervoer in de toekomst te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Rajkowski over een mogelijk datalek van klantgegevens van NS-reizigers

Two MPs asked the state secretaries whether NS was aware of a reported data leak of NS customer data via a market research subcontractor and its software supplier, and how it was handled, including legal basis, DPIA, subprocessor oversight and rules for protecting client data. The state secretary answered that NS had a processor agreement and DPIA, that the leak source and whether NS data was included remained unclear, and that existing GDPR rules and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens budget were adequate.
However, it is not yet certain which data exactly was leaked and whether NS data was also part of the data breach.
Het is echter nog niet zeker welke data precies zijn gelekt en of ook NS-data onderdeel waren van het datalek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Krul over het bericht 'Gratis reizen met ov heel eenvoudig: betaling met OVpay te omzeilen'

MPs Minhas and Krul asked the state secretary about a report that OVpay contactless payment on public transport can be circumvented by fraudulently using disposable digital cards. The state secretary acknowledged the fraud scenario was known, described monitoring and bank sanctions, and stated no significant increase had been detected, with no new structural measures planned.
Following the RTL publication, no worrying increase in this type of fraud cases has been observed.
Er is, naar aanleiding van de RTL-publicatie, geen zorgwekkende toename geconstateerd van dit soort fraudegevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het bericht 'Agressie tegen NS-personeel neemt toe, topman wil meer ruimte voor aanpak'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about rising aggression against NS staff, the possibility of giving NS enforcement officers with boa powers access to the driving licence register to identify offenders quickly, camera rollout, reporting of crimes and bodycams. The State Secretary answered that the sector is working on additional measures, that access to the licence register is targeted for autumn 2023 and that camera and bodycam deployment is ongoing, with no further commitment on the substance of the scrutiny question.

The Ministry of I&W, together with the Ministry of J&S, is working to give boa's access to the RDW driving licence register so that the identity of a nuisance offender can be established more quickly.

Het Ministerie van IenW is samen met het Ministerie van JenV bezig om boa's toegang te geven tot het rijbewijzenregister van de RDW om de identiteit van een overlastpleger sneller vast te kunnen stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het bericht ‘De zakenreiziger staat te popelen om de trein te nemen, maar stuit op gebrek aan stoelen en ticketchaos’

An MP asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that business travellers cannot get enough train seats, especially to London, and about barriers to international rail travel. The state secretary answered that capacity is limited and that operators, not the government, should adjust supply, while listing planned capacity increases, EU pilots and ministry coordination.
It is up to the operators to align the supply as well as possible with the market.
Het is aan de vervoerders om het aanbod zo goed mogelijk aan te laten sluiten bij de markt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Minhas over het bericht ‘ProRail dumpt Chinese bewakingscamera’s, de NS laat ze hangen’ van Follow The Money

MPs Rajkowski and Minhas asked whether Chinese-made cameras in rail rolling stock, where the rail infrastructure is a designated vital process, are compatible with national security given China's offensive cyber strategy, and whether NS's mitigation measures and NCSC advice are adequate. The government replied that Chinese equipment in vital sectors is not per se undesirable, that vital providers like NS are responsible for risk assessment and mitigation under supervision by the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport, that NS has taken measures such as network separation and no direct internet connection, and that the NCSC does not advise on individual products.
That a particular product or service, in this case cameras, within a vital sector originates from a Chinese provider is not necessarily undesirable.
Dat een bepaald product of dienst, in dit geval camera's, binnen een vitale sector afkomstig is van een Chinese aanbieder is niet per definitie onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het bericht “Te veel giftreinen denderen door onze steden, doe daar iets aan staatssecretaris”

An MP asks the state secretary to act on reports that too many freight trains carrying dangerous goods pass through towns, raising safety risks for residents and questioning how municipalities can control this. The state secretary rejects the premise of increasing risk, describes existing safety chains, the Basisnet risk ceilings, information channels to municipalities, and future measures such as a Delta Corridor pipeline project, while stating that residual risk cannot be eliminated and that the government cannot guarantee fewer dangerous goods on rail.
I do not recognise myself in this.
Ik herken mij hier niet in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Minhas over de motie Koerhuis en Minhas om te onderzoeken hoe het probleem op de spoorwegen van de Maasvlakte voor goederenvervoer kan worden opgelost

MPs Koerhuis and Minhas asked about their motion to study how rail freight bottlenecks on the Maasvlakte can be solved, including costs and possible state funding. The State Secretary says a bottleneck will emerge, that the state lacks the funds for the proposed €400 million infrastructure and is still negotiating reuse of remaining MIRT money, and that funding the remaining €195 million depends on future Mobility Fund space.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Minhas over het bericht 'Zonder ingrijpen valt nieuwbouw terug naar 45.000 woningen per jaar' in de Cobouw van 31 oktober 2022

Two VVD MPs asked the housing minister about a report that housebuilding could fall to 45,000 homes per year, and about delays in approved projects, subsidies, binnenstedelijk building, VINEX-style regional planning and the spatial planning instrument. The minister acknowledged the risks, pointed to the Programma Woningbouw, planned a plan of action on speeding up building, promised to revisit the Woningbouwimpuls subsidy rules in spring, and gave partial, policy-restating answers on figures and planning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het programma ‘Sven op 1’

An MP asks the state secretary whether he discussed with the European Commissioner the direct award of the main rail network to NS, whether the Commission still demands a market analysis, and why the media were informed before parliament. The state secretary confirms the talks, says the Commission's position is unchanged, and explains he chose not to carry out the market analysis in line with a parliamentary motion while acknowledging legal and financial risks, and promises a 'plan B'.
In view of the motion not to carry out a market analysis, which was broadly supported and adopted, I have chosen not to carry out this market analysis now.
Mede gelet op de motie om geen marktanalyse uit te voeren, die breed is gesteund en aangenomen, heb ik ervoor gekozen om deze marktanalyse nu niet uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bevers en Minhas over het bericht “Terschelling en Vlieland vragen Rijk om compensatie voor Doeksen. ‘Onze levensader kan niet alleen voor rijken zijn weggelegd’”

MPs Bevers and Minhas asked the State Secretary about Doeksen's request to raise Wadden ferry fares by 11.1% and whether residents could be shielded or compensated. The State Secretary answered that a temporary fuel surcharge was agreed at 4.5% for island residents and 16.5% for other passengers, that compensation would be discussed only if the Rijk makes funds available, and that greening the ferries is being studied.
I agree with you that the residents of the Wadden Islands depend on the ferry connection for transport to the mainland.
Ik ben het met u eens dat de bewoners van de Waddeneilanden voor het vervoer naar het vasteland afhankelijk zijn van de veerverbinding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over de berichtgeving rondom de nieuwe dienstregeling van de Nederlandse Spoorwegen

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about critical reporting on NS's 2023 timetable, which cuts trains by about 13% (more on weekends), the claimed decline in service, staffing shortages and the lack of prior detection. The State Secretary answered that the cuts are an NS decision with no ministerial consent power, that NS is pursuing an integrated staffing approach the ministry monitors closely with Finance, and that NS will study the consumer advice but not that a plan is binding.
I have no power of consent for this.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Minhas over het bericht ‘ProRail dumpt Chinese bewakingscamera’s, de NS laat ze hangen’

MPs Rajkowski and Minhas asked the ministers about reports that NS was buying Chinese-made surveillance cameras for trains and stations and whether the government would restrict such procurement. The government answered that NS uses isolated networks and follows government advice, that concrete procurement criteria are not set in the concession, and that a government guideline and scan of vital infrastructure are being prepared.
As requested in the adopted motion 4 Rajkowski et al., the House will be informed before the Christmas recess about the requested guideline for the central government and its suppliers.
Zoals verzocht in de overgenomen motie 4 Rajkowski c.s. zal de Kamer nog voor het kerstreces geïnformeerd worden over de verzochte richtlijn voor de rijksoverheid en haar leveranciers

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot het voorstel van de leden Bromet en Tjeerd de Groot tot wijziging van de Waterschapswet, de Kieswet en de Algemene wet bestuursrecht in ver

An MP asked the minister about the status of the Bromet/De Groot bill to democratise water board elections and whether delays in its Eerste Kamer treatment would leave the 2023 water board elections without clarity or changes. The minister confirmed the 8 November plenary date, said clarity cannot yet be given, and noted that the law would need to be published by 1 December to apply to the 2023 registration deadlines, with current law applying otherwise.
By 4 November 2022 at the latest, the questions of the Eerste Kamer will be answered.
Uiterlijk 4 november 2022 zal op de vragen van de Eerste Kamer worden gereageerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken, Minhas, Bouchallikh en De Hoop over het bericht 'Inspectie: NS heeft onvoldoende zicht op gevaarlijke situaties'

MPs asked the State Secretary about a NRC report that the Inspectorate found NS had insufficient oversight of dangerous situations in trains, following a whistleblower complaint, including questions on maintenance, a possible concealed technical defect, and sanctions. The State Secretary answered that the ILT found no acute risk or violation, is monitoring NS's improvement measures, will share the ILT letters, and found no concealment, though many answers defer to NS's own information.
Such letters are currently not actively made public, but an exception is possible in consultation with those involved.
Dergelijke brieven worden op dit moment niet actief openbaar gemaakt, maar in overleg met betrokkenen is een uitzondering mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Van den Hil over het bericht 'Kwart Zeeuwse waterkeringen voldoet niet aan veiligheidsnorm'

MPs Minhas and Van den Hil asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that a quarter of Zeeland's flood defences fail the safety standard, the expected 1.5 billion euro reinforcement cost, cost sharing between the state and water boards, and how completion by 2050 and sea-level rise will be ensured. The minister confirmed the assessments are still ongoing, with results due end 2023, cost estimates are not yet firm, cost sharing follows the Water Act, and the programme and Water Act evaluation will address funding adequacy.
The House will, in line with the law and earlier commitments, be informed at the end of 2023 about the national results of these assessments.
De Kamer wordt, conform de wet en eerdere toezeggingen, eind 2023 over de landelijke uitkomsten van deze beoordelingen geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het bericht ‘Reizigers klagen massaal over bomvolle treinen tussen Zwolle en Randstad: NS moet meer doen’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about overcrowded and short trains on several routes after NS reduced its timetable due to staff shortages, including the Zwolle-Randstad corridor. The State Secretary answered that NS is lengthening trains and raising frequencies, that complaint counts rose but causes are unclear, and that NS will be assessed at year-end under the concession.
I will assess NS at the end of the year on its performance, as laid down in the Hoofdrailnet transport concession.
Ik zal NS aan het eind van het jaar beoordelen op haar prestaties, zoals opgenomen in de vervoerconcessie van het Hoofdrailnet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Bevers over het bericht 'Bereikbaarheid Ameland op het spel: boot te vaak te laat'

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary and minister about reports that the Ameland ferry is often late, threatening reliability and accessibility before the storm season. The ministers answered that Rijkswaterstaat is studying long-term solutions for the period after 2030, with a decision expected in 2023, while acknowledging ferry delays caused largely by silting of the shipping channel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over de brief over de evaluatie van de IT-storing bij NS van 3 april

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the division of responsibilities between NS, ProRail and the state after the 3 April 2022 IT outage, and about simplifying the timetable and regional coordination. The State Secretary answers that NS is responsible for the timetable and operations under the concession, that the government steers via output indicators, that a simplification proposal is being examined with NS, and declines to commission further ProRail work or extend formal consumer consultation.
I have therefore asked NS to critically examine which simplification options, friendly to travellers, it can still implement that could also contribute to a faster restart after disruptions.
Ik heb NS daarom gevraagd kritisch te bezien welke (reizigersvriendelijke) vereenvoudigingsmogelijkheden zij wél kan doorvoeren die ook kunnen bijdragen aan een snellere opstart na verstoringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het artikel 'Nederlands datacenter Microsoft verbruikte vier keer meer water dan gedacht'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that a Microsoft data centre used four times more drinking water for cooling than previously stated, and what this means for water scarcity and environmental discharge. The minister called drinking-water use for cooling undesirable, said the drinking-water utility decides on supply, and pointed to existing policy on 'the right water for the right use' and strict regulation of hyperscale data centres.
The drinking-water company (PWN) does not provide information on the drinking-water use of individual companies.
Over het drinkwatergebruik van individuele bedrijven wordt door het betrokken drinkwaterbedrijf (PWN) geen informatie verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over de Kamerbrief ‘Afschalen dienstregeling vanwege personeelstekorten NS’ en ‘NS’ers willen meer geld, ja. Maar ze willen vooral waardering’

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management and the Minister of Finance about NS's planned timetable cuts of 10 to 15 percent due to staff shortages, including consultation, accountability, concession incentives and sanctions. The government answers that it finds the cuts undesirable, is monitoring NS and seeking to limit the impact, but says the shortages cannot be fully prevented and that it sees no direct link to shareholder decisions.
As concession grantor for the main rail network, I expect the concession holder to do everything it can to run trains as agreed.
Als concessieverlener voor het hoofdrailnet verwacht ik van de concessiehouder dat NS alles in het werk stelt om conform afspraak treinen te laten rijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het bericht Chaos na opnieuw ‘computerblunder’ bij ProRail, ‘Het back-upsysteem moet werken’

An MP asked the State Secretary about repeated IT failures at ProRail, the lack of a working backup system, the absence of replacement transport for passengers, and compensation communication. The State Secretary acknowledged the failures, said they had different causes, admitted the backup did not switch over, and promised further evaluation and the new concession programme.
I am already in discussion with ProRail and NS to examine to what extent we can prevent disruptions in digital systems in general and
Ik ben al in gesprek met ProRail en NS om te bezien in hoeverre we storingen in digitale systemen in het algemeen kunnen voorkomen en
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het bericht ‘Invalide reiziger uit ongenoegen over defecte lift’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about a disabled traveller who left a station after a broken lift, asking about lift maintenance responsibilities, breakdown numbers, repair times and alternatives. The government answered all ten questions in substance, acknowledging repair backlogs due to parts shortages and staff gaps, and pointed to ProRail measures such as monitoring systems and parts recovery.
It is correct that ProRail is responsible for lift maintenance at stations.
Het klopt dat ProRail verantwoordelijk is voor het liftonderhoud op stations.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het dreigende capaciteitstekort voor spoorgoederenvervoer door werkzaamheden aan het derde spoor

An MP asked the state secretary about the capacity shortfall for rail freight caused by 20 weeks of double-track closure at Emmerich during third-track works, including diversions via Venlo and Oldenzaal, hazardous goods, noise, trade competitiveness, bus alternatives and passenger delays. The state secretary confirmed the planned closure, said a ProRail action plan and advice from the steering group are awaited, and deferred most substantive answers until then.
Earlier, my predecessor asked ProRail, in consultation with the Third Track Germany Steering Group, to draw up an action plan for the long-term works in 2024, 2025 and 2026.
Eerder heeft mijn voorganger ProRail gevraagd om in samenspraak met de Stuurgroep Derde spoor Duitsland een Plan van Aanpak op te stellen voor de langdurige werkzaamheden in 2024, 2025 en 2026.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas, Heinen en Brekelmans over het bericht "Sanctie-experts: Nederland niet doeltreffend met opsporen Russisch vastgoed"

VVD MPs asked the government why sanctions enforcement on Russian-linked real estate in the Netherlands was unclear, whether other countries were more effective, and when concrete results would be reported. The minister answered that roles are divided among ministries, the Kadaster checks found no sanctioned persons as registered owners so far, and the government will continue reporting on progress.
From time to time the cabinet will continue to do this.
Op gezette tijden zal het kabinet dit blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Vewin: drinkwater voor 900.000 nieuwe woningen niet zeker’

MPs Minhas and Peter de Groot asked the ministers about reports that drinking water supply for 900,000 new homes to 2030 is uncertain, and about the state of water sources, coordination with the housing sector, and planned measures. The minister answers that supply is secured for at least 10 years through supply plans supervised by the ILT, and points to ongoing studies, strategic reserves, a 800 million euro Deltaplan and a planned water-saving exploration, but gives no concrete figures on new sources.
RIVM is working on a supplementary report on the availability of sources, to be completed by mid-2022.
RIVM werkt aan een aanvullend rapport over de beschikbaarheid van bronnen, dat medio 2022 zal worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Minhas over het bericht ‘Alarm om agressie op spoor en station’

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Minhas asked about rising aggression against rail and public transport staff, including the role of conductors as boa's, their equipment and police response times. The Minister answered that incidents rose (NS 660 to 744, regional transport 787 to 977), outlined the NS request for database access to verify identities, and promised talks with NS and police but gave limited concrete commitments.
To improve the information position of boa's when establishing identity, it is important to give them better access to information so they can carry out their tasks independently.
Om de informatiepositie van boa's te verbeteren bij het vaststellen van de identiteit is het belangrijk hen betere toegang te geven tot informatie voor een zelfstandige taakuitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Van Campen over het bericht 'Schoon water is in Nederland nog ver weg'

MPs Minhas and Van Campen (VVD) asked the ministers about a news report that clean water is far off in the Netherlands, including the EU Water Framework Directive risks for 2027. Minister Harbers answered that the water quality picture is complex, that most chemical norms are met but biological and nutrient norms lag, and that further measures and possible use of exemptions are planned.
I do not share the view that water quality is not good in all respects.
Het beeld dat de waterkwaliteit op alle onderdelen niet goed is, deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het bericht ‘Bouw brandblusinstallatie Waalhaven Zuid op losse schroeven’

An MP asked why the fire-suppression works at Waalhaven Zuid rail yard cost four times the estimate, how a 63 million euro shortfall arose at ProRail, why it was disclosed late, and what logistics and closure risks follow for the 1 January 2023 deadline. The State Secretary answered that the cost rise reflects project complexity, that ProRail is still validating the estimate and shortfall, that the ministry was alerted in December 2021, and that all parties are working to meet the deadline.
Once a stable picture is available, I can proceed to decision-making on the shortfall.
Zodra er een stabiel beeld is kan ik overgaan tot besluitvorming over het tekort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het artikel 'Welkom op het slechtste station van Nederland: 'Ik heb maar een auto gekocht''

An MP asked the state secretary about a news report calling Rotterdam-Zuid the worst station in the Netherlands, covering ratings, ridership, crime, camera surveillance, complaints and safety measures. The state secretary acknowledged the low rating, described joint police, municipal and NS/ProRail safety measures, and gave ridership and crime figures without addressing executive oversight.
That is unpleasant for the travellers who use this station and that must improve.
Dat is vervelend voor de reizigers die gebruik maken van dit station en dat moet beter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Peter de Groot en Minhas over woningbouw binnen bestaand stedelijk gebied en de gevolgen voor sportvoorzieningen

MPs from the VVD asked the housing and health ministers whether housing construction in dense cities is squeezing sports facilities, and how municipalities plan space for sport. The minister answered that data on squeezed sports space is unavailable, that no standard norms exist, that he will not mandate a sports paragraph in spatial plans, and that the government will compile examples of multifunctional sports facilities.
A specific obligation regarding including a sports paragraph does not seem desirable given municipalities' own responsibility in this, and in my view is also not necessary.
Een specifieke verplichting m.b.t. het opnemen van een sportparagraaf lijkt niet wenselijk gezien de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten in deze, en is m.i. ook niet nodig.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Michon-Derkzen over de berichten ‘Verkeerde waterstanden en gebrek aan regie: veel ging mis bij aanpak watersnood Limburg’ en ‘Waterschap was niet voorbereid op watersnood Limbur

MPs Minhas and Michon-Derkzen asked the ministers about press reports that the Limburg flood response suffered from wrong water-level forecasts and poor coordination, and about the water board's preparedness and the COT evaluation. The minister answered that the water board will implement the COT recommendations, that a flood emergency plan for the Heuvelland is being prepared, and that broader crisis-system reforms and risk mapping are underway, without giving a firm timeline for every point.
The Limburg Water Board is responsible for implementing the recommendations of the COT.
Het Waterschap Limburg is verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de aanbevelingen van het COT.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Koerhuis over het artikel dat de woningbouw naar nul gaat door nieuwe wet

MPs Minhas and Koerhuis (VVD) asked the minister about a newspaper report that a new noise law would bring housing construction near zero, and about the status of the Koerhuis motion on policy-neutral transfer of noise rules. The minister rejects the report's conclusions, says the impact analysis shows up to 60,000-80,000 planned homes may face cumulation assessments, and says a joint working process with the region and an implementation guide for municipalities are underway.
The ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and I are willing to draft, together with the region, a framework or guidance for municipalities that face this issue.
De bewindslieden van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en ik zijn bereid om samen met de regio een handelingskader of handreiking op te stellen voor gemeenten die daarmee te maken krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en De Kort over het bericht 'Slecht ter been? Zorg dan maar dat je niet op dit station terecht komt'

MPs Minhas and De Kort asked the state secretary about the prolonged closure of all lifts at Rotterdam Lombardijen station near Maasstad Hospital, including temporary lifts, taxi alternatives, and station accessibility nationwide. The secretary answered that the works are delayed but managed by ProRail and NS, that temporary lifts are technically impossible, that taxis are offered as an alternative, and referred to a national accessibility report.
ProRail states that it closely steers the planning with the contractors involved and eliminates possible risks of overrun as far as possible.
ProRail geeft aan samen met de betrokken aannemers strak te sturen op de planning en mogelijke risico's op uitloop zoveel mogelijk te elimineren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Rudmer Heerema over de extra reistijd op het traject Alkmaar-Den Haag van NS

MPs Minhas and Rudmer Heerema asked the State Secretary about longer rail travel times between Alkmaar and Den Haag under NS's 2022 timetable, and whether this conflicts with the goal of more frequent trains. The State Secretary replied that NS manages the timetable, that the net benefit for most travellers outweighs the losses for a few tens of passengers, and that he sees no reason to intervene.
I see no reason at this time to intervene as concession grantor in this process.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om als concessieverlener in dit proces te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Minhas over het bericht 'Meer incidenten met asielzoekers in trein Emmen-Zwolle, personeel ziek thuis'

MPs Valstar and Minhas asked about rising incidents involving asylum seekers on the Emmen-Zwolle train line, sick leave among staff, and measures taken, including bodycams, travel bans, guards and funding for a shuttle bus. The State Secretary confirmed the increase, described measures such as limited enforcement powers for supervisors and the HTL placement option, but said incident data do not record residence status and that individual cases cannot be discussed.
The police and transport operators do not register the residence status of persons involved in incidents.
De politie en vervoerders registreren niet op verblijfsstatus van personen die betrokken zijn bij incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het bericht 'Treinen vallen uit door personeelstekort bij ProRail'

An MP asked the state secretary about train cancellations caused by staff shortages at ProRail, the timing of solutions, whether such cancellations count as force majeure in concessions, and why replacement buses were not deployed on 2 November 2021. The state secretary acknowledged the shortages, outlined recruitment and training measures expected to last until 2023, said cancellations count in performance evaluations, and explained NS's operational limits on replacement buses while promising ongoing talks with NS.
Train cancellations count, regardless of cause, in various performance indicators, such as passenger punctuality and number of high-impact disruptions.
Treinuitval telt, ongeacht de oorzaak, mee in diverse prestatie-indicatoren, zoals reizigerspunctualiteit en aantal impactvolle verstoringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Minhas over het bericht ‘Chauffeurs balen van uitblijven oplossing voor onveilige bussen: Gemeenten en provincies blijven maar naar elkaar verwijzen’

MPs Wiersma and Minhas asked about reports that public transport between Emmen and Ter Apel remains unsafe due to nuisance by asylum seekers and that municipalities and provinces refer responsibility to each other. The government answers that incidents, mostly fare-payment problems, have fallen sharply since 2019 thanks to measures such as steward deployment, a pilot for a regional travel ban, and a 1 million euro municipal budget, while it does not register residence status of those involved.
The police and transport operators do not record the residence status of persons involved in incidents.
De politie en vervoerders registreren niet op verblijfsstatus van personen die betrokken zijn bij incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Koerhuis over het NRC-bericht ‘Nieuwe bouwcrisis dreigt door ‘onwerkbare’ megawet’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the Environmental and Planning Act (Omgevingswet) could delay building projects if introduced on 1 January 2022, and whether the digital system is ready. The Minister answered that the start date moves to 1 July 2022, admitted the digital system is not yet fully in order with ongoing delays, and described temporary alternative measures and transitional law.
With a view to meeting the minimum criteria for entry into force, together with the other governments it has been decided to move the entry-into-force date from 1 January 2022 to 1 July 2022.

Antwoord 2 Met het oog op het voldoen aan de minimumcriteria voor inwerkingtreding is samen met de andere overheden besloten de inwerkingtredingsdatum van 1 januari 2022 naar 1 juli 2022 te verplaatsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Minhas over het bericht 'Vertraging woningbouw dreigt na uitspraak Raad van State'

MPs Koerhuis and Minhas (VVD) asked the Minister of the Interior about a Council of State ruling that may lengthen housing project delays by letting non-objectors appeal, and about the risk of further delays and of people selling off objections. The minister answers that the ruling is not a crisis but may lengthen procedures, that a bill to amend the General Administrative Law Act is being prepared, and that a draft will go to internet consultation this summer.
The intention is to put a draft bill out for (internet) consultation this summer.
Het voornemen is om deze zomer een conceptwetsvoorstel in (internet)consultatie te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en De Neef over de Zembla-uitzending dat spoorwerkers al ruim 10 jaar worden blootgesteld aan gevaarlijk kwartsstof

Two VVD MPs asked ministers about a Zembla broadcast reporting that rail workers have been exposed to carcinogenic quartz dust for over ten years, asking about legal duties, inspection history, ProRail reports and station safety. The ministers answered in detail on the legal framework and past inspections, acknowledging ProRail's reports and ongoing investigations, but largely pointed to employer responsibility and did not commit to new measures beyond referring to existing inspection work.
ProRail had not shared these studies with the Inspectorate SZW until recently, but did so following the Zembla broadcast.
ProRail had deze onderzoeken tot voor kort niet met de Inspectie SZW gedeeld, maar heeft dit naar aanleiding van de uitzending van Zembla wel gedaan.

m: Motie van het lid Hirsch c.s. over pas vanaf het ingaan van het nieuwe subsidiekader meten voor het drempelcriterium
Asks the government to measure the new 50% non-government-income threshold for civil society organisations only from the start of the new subsidy framework, not on past three-year finances.
requests the government to measure the new threshold criterion only from the start of the new subsidy framework
verzoekt de regering om pas vanaf het ingaan van het nieuwe subsidiekader te meten voor het nieuwe drempelcriterium
Motie van de leden Kamminga en Van der Plas over met voorstellen op het gebied van handel en export komen om de regel- en verantwoordingsdruk te verminderen
Asks the government to map existing export support measures and propose ways to reduce regulatory and accountability burdens on businesses, especially SMEs.
come up with proposals to reduce the regulatory and accountability burden
met voorstellen te komen om de regel- en verantwoordingsdruk te verminderen
Motie van het lid Kamminga over maatwerk toepassen voor organisaties die vanuit kennis en expertise hun meerwaarde kunnen leveren maar niet voldoen aan de 50%-norm
Asks the government to apply tailored treatment to knowledge-based civil society organisations that fail the 50% private-funding norm, so they can still claim subsidy funds.
requests the government, for organisations that add value through knowledge and expertise but do not meet the 50% norm, to apply tailored treatment
verzoekt de regering om bij organisaties die vanuit kennis en expertise hun meerwaarde kunnen leveren maar niet voldoen aan de 50%-norm, maatwerk toe te passen
Motie van het lid Kamminga over bij de CSDDD-implementatie geen aanvullende nationale regels en restricties inbouwen
Motion asks the government not to add extra national rules or restrictions when implementing the CSDDD, keeping a level playing field and limiting burdens on business.
requests the government not to build additional national rules and restrictions into the implementation of the CSDDD
verzoekt de regering om bij de implementatie van de CSDDD geen aanvullende nationale regels en restricties in te bouwen
Motie van het lid Kamminga over onderzoeken hoe Nederland meer gebruik kan maken van delegated cooperation
Asks the government to map and examine how the Netherlands can use delegated cooperation more for EU development funds, raising the amount to at least one billion euros.
requests the government to map what percentage of their contributions countries like France and Germany use via delegated cooperation
verzoekt de regering in kaart te brengen welk percentage van hun bijdrage landen als Frankrijk en Duitsland inzetten via delegated cooperation
Motie van het lid Ram c.s. over een pas op de plaats maken bij langjarige financiële verplichtingen voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking
Asks the demissionary government to pause entering new long-term financial commitments for development cooperation, or implementing them.
requests the government to pause, during the caretaker period, the entering into new long-term financial commitments for development cooperation

verzoekt de regering om in de demissionaire periode een pas op de plaats te maken waar het gaat om het aangaan van nieuwe langjarige financiële verplichtingen op het gebied van ontwikkelingssamenwerking
Motie van het lid Kamminga c.s. over onderzoek naar de effecten van invoering van het Mercosur-verdrag op de Nederlandse landbouwsector
Asks the cabinet to obtain an update of the Wageningen Economic Research report and examine the effects of the EU-Mercosur agreement on Dutch agriculture before any decision.
requests the cabinet, before decision-making on the EU-Mercosur agreement, to receive an update of the Wageningen Economic Research report
verzoekt het kabinet voorafgaand aan besluitvorming over het EU-Mercosur-verdrag een update te ontvangen van het rapport van Wageningen Economic Research
Motie van het lid Boswijk c.s. over de mogelijkheden onderzoeken voor het met Oekraïne delen van kennis en licenties ten aanzien van door Nederland geleverde middelen
Asks the government to explore with industry sharing knowledge and licences so Ukraine can produce munitions and other items Netherlands supplies.
requests the government to explore together with industry the possibilities to share knowledge and licences
verzoekt de regering om samen met het bedrijfsleven de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om kennis en licenties
Motie van de leden Ram en Kamminga over het opbouwen van een gelijkwaardige handelsrelatie tussen Nederland en India
Asks the government to work with India to build a reciprocal, equal trade relationship aimed at strengthening both economies and expanding bilateral trade.
Requests the government to explore with India how an equal trade relationship can be built with the Netherlands.
verzoekt de regering om samen met India te onderzoeken hoe met Nederland een gelijkwaardige handelsrelatie kan worden opgebouwd
Motie van het lid Van den Berg c.s. over een voorstel over het versterken van de coördinerende rol van BZK
Asks the government to send Parliament a proposal by the 2023 annual report on strengthening the coordinating role of the Ministry of Interior over state spending, following an Audit Office finding.
requests the government to send the Chamber a proposal for the 2023 annual report on how the coordinating role of BZK will be strengthened
verzoekt de regering voor het jaarverslag 2023 een voorstel naar de Kamer te zenden over hoe de coördinerende rol/regierol van BZK wordt versterkt
Motie van de leden Kamminga en Van den Berg over liquiditeitsleningen aan Aruba alleen langjarig tegen gunstige voorwaarden herfinancieren bij financieel toezicht op basis van een rijkswet
Asks the government to refinance Aruba's liquidity loans on long-term favourable terms only once financial supervision is anchored in a Rijkswet, otherwise at market rates.
requests the government to refinance the liquidity loans long-term on favourable terms only if financial supervision exists based on a Rijkswet
verzoekt de regering de liquiditeitsleningen alleen langjarig op basis van gunstige voorwaarden te herfinancieren als er sprake is van financieel toezicht op basis van een rijkswet
Motie van de leden Van den Berg en Kamminga over meerjarige financiële en begrotingseffecten van de hervormingen meewegen bij het bepalen van de aflossingscapaciteit van de CAS-landen
Asks the government to consider multi-year financial and budgetary effects of reforms when setting repayment capacity of CAS countries on loans.
take into account multi-year financial and budgetary effects of the reforms
meerjarige financiële en begrotingseffecten van de hervormingen mee te wegen
Motie van de leden Van den Berg en Kamminga over inventariseren of er behoefte is aan traineeplaatsen voor ambtenaren van Curaçao, Aruba en Sint-Maarten
Asks the government to investigate whether there is demand for trainee places for civil servants from Curaçao, Aruba and Sint Maarten.
to investigate whether there is also a need for trainee places for civil servants from Curaçao, Aruba and Sint Maarten
te inventariseren of er ook behoefte is aan traineeplaatsen voor ambtenaren van Curaçao, Aruba en Sint-Maarten
Motie van het lid Van den Berg c.s. over onderzoeken hoe opleidingsmogelijkheden op de BES-eilanden voor de lokale beroepsbevolking versterkt kunnen worden
Asks the government to study how training opportunities on the BES islands can be strengthened for the local workforce and report before Budget Day 2023.
asks the government to examine how training opportunities, both practical and theoretical, on the islands can be strengthened for the local workforce
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken op welke wijze opleidingsmogelijkheden, zowel praktisch als theoretisch, op de eilanden voor de lokale beroepsbevolking versterkt kunnen worden
Motie van het lid Wuite c.s. over verkennen welke experimentele (hybride) samenwerkingsverbanden haalbaar zijn op het gebied van vervolgonderwijs
Asks the government to explore experimental hybrid higher-education partnerships for the Caribbean Netherlands and report to the Chamber in Q4.
requests the government to explore which experimental (hybrid) partnerships are feasible in the field of further education
verzoekt de regering te verkennen welke experimentele (hybride) samenwerkingsverbanden haalbaar zijn op het gebied van vervolgonderwijs
Motie van de leden Van den Berg en Kamminga over aanbevelingen doen voor het land- en tuinbouwbeleid op de BES-eilanden
Asks the government, with the BES islands, to have WUR study agricultural policy and report recommendations to the Chamber by April 2023.
requests the government, in consultation with the BES islands, to have Wageningen University & Research examine agricultural policy and make recommendations
verzoekt de regering, in overleg met de BES-eilanden, Wageningen University & Research het land- en tuinbouwbeleid te laten onderzoeken en aanbevelingen te doen
Motie van het lid Den Haan c.s. over Caribisch Nederland meenemen in de opdracht aan de Staatscommissie Demografische ontwikkelingen 2050
Asks the government to include the Caribbean Netherlands in the mandate of the State Commission on Demographic Developments 2050.
requests the government to include the Caribbean Netherlands in the assignment to the State Commission on Demographic Developments 2050
verzoekt de regering Caribisch Nederland mee te nemen in de opdracht aan de Staatscommissie Demografische ontwikkelingen 2050
Motie van het lid Koekkoek c.s. over uitbreiding van het aantal fte voor EU-adviseurs en de Permanente Vertegenwoordiging van de Tweede Kamer in Brussel
Asks the government to finish its needs study quickly and propose more EU advisers and staff for the Tweede Kamer and its Permanent Representation in Brussels.
requests that the needs study be completed as quickly as possible with a proposal to expand the number of FTE EU advisers
verzoekt het behoefteonderzoek zo snel mogelijk af te ronden en met een voorstel voor uitbreiding van het aantal fte voor EU-adviseurs
Motie van de leden Kamminga en Wuite over de bijdrage van verduurzaming aan lagere kosten voor nutsvoorzieningen en aan werkgelegenheid
Asks the government to ensure energy sustainability lowers utility costs for Caribbean Netherlands residents and to study job creation effects.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over het bericht 'Aantal Nederlandse handelsmissies afgenomen, ook fors minder opbrengst'

An MP asked the trade minister about a news report that the number of Dutch trade missions has fallen and yields have dropped, and how missions will be planned, targeted and involve business. The minister answered that business organisations and sector bodies are consulted twice yearly, that evaluations show satisfied participants, and that about twelve missions per year fits business needs, with upcoming missions to Italy, Indonesia and Japan.
Roughly twelve missions per year appears to fit well with the needs and capacities of business.
Ongeveer twaalf missies per jaar lijkt goed aan te sluiten bij de behoeften en mogelijkheden van het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over het bericht ‘Rabo: heffingen VS kunnen Nederland €12 mrd gaan kosten’

An MP asked the trade minister about possible US tariffs of 25% on EU goods, their effects on Dutch food, beverage and other firms, possible relocation to the US, and EU-US trade relations. The minister said tariffs are only announced, with no executive order yet, that the effects depend on timing, height and scope, and that the government is in dialogue with both the US and the EU while preparing countermeasures.
No executive order has been published since the announcement that gives further substance to it.
Er is sinds de aankondiging geen uitvoeringsbesluit (executive order) gepubliceerd dat hier nadere invulling aan geeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over het bericht “EU zal terugslaan na Trumps heffingen op import van staal en aluminium.”

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade about US tariffs on EU steel and aluminium, the scope and timing of EU countermeasures, and the impact on Dutch firms such as Tata Steel. The minister answered that the US measures reactivate 2018 tariffs with a wider product scope and that the EU will decide on countermeasures in coming weeks, while giving no firm commitments on specifics.
At European level it will be decided in the coming weeks whether and how the countermeasures will be reactivated, after studying the American implementing decisions.
In Europees verband zal in de komende weken worden besloten of en hoe de tegenmaatregelen worden gereactiveerd, na bestudering van de Amerikaanse uitvoeringsbesluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Martens-America over de artikelen `Energieminister Qatar dreigt gaslevering EU te stoppen` en `Topman Boskalis `verketterd` om kritiek op vestigingsklimaat

MPs Kamminga and Martens-America (VVD) asked the ministers about newspaper reports on Qatar threatening EU gas supply and on criticism of the investment climate, and about the impact of the CSDDD on competitiveness, compliance costs and implementation. The minister answered at length, largely defending the CSDDD and its Dutch implementation, promising ongoing dialogue and business support, and arguing that the Dutch law adds no extra requirements.
The cabinet endorses the goal of reducing regulatory burden, as also included in the coalition programme.
Het kabinet onderschrijft het doel van regeldrukvermindering, zoals ook opgenomen in het regeerprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Martens-America over het rapport 'Effect van Amerikaanse invoertarieven op de Nederlandse en Europese economie’ van het Centraal Planbureau

MPs Kamminga and Martens-America asked the ministers about the CPB report on the effects of US import tariffs on the Dutch and European economy, covering sectoral impacts, EU countermeasures, trade diversion, investment relocation, financing, ports and employment. The government answered that the report shows limited but real effects, pointed to existing EU trade instruments and business-support tools, and said it is too early to commit to specific measures on financing or employment.
It is too early to take measures on business financing.
Het is te vroeg om maatregelen te nemen rondom bedrijfsfinanciering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Kamminga over het bericht 'Kabinet wil uitgeprocedeerde Afrikaanse asielzoekers naar Oeganda sturen'

MPs Rajkowski and Kamminga asked the government about reports that the cabinet wants to send rejected African asylum seekers to Uganda, and about migration deals with third countries, Uganda's anti-LGBTI law, and plans for return hubs. The minister confirmed that partnerships with third countries are a key element, said talks with Uganda are at an early exploratory stage, and declined to give figures, costs, timelines or a timeframe for answering.
The talks with Uganda are at an initial stage.
De gesprekken met Oeganda bevinden zich in een beginstadium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Zeedijk over het bericht «Hulpverlening aan Gaza dreigt verder in knel te komen: Israël verbiedt UNRWA»

MPs Kamminga and Zeedijk asked the minister about Israel's legislation banning UNRWA and its effects on humanitarian aid in Gaza and on Dutch funding. The minister answered that the laws threaten UNRWA's operations and aid in Gaza, that no other organisation can easily replace it, and that the Dutch annual contribution of EUR 19 million remains unchanged for 2022–2025.
The cabinet's position on the annual contribution remains unchanged.
Het kabinetsstandpunt met betrekking tot de jaarlijkse bijdrage blijft onveranderd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Van Campen over het bericht «Europese miljarden voor bestrijding migratie in Afrika komen nauwelijks goed terecht: «school zonder elektriciteit kreeg blender cadeau»»

MPs Kamminga and Van Campen asked the ministers whether the EUR 4.5 billion EU Trust Fund for Africa spent on curbing migration had real impact, following a European Court of Auditors report on poor spending. The minister answered that the government does not share the report's conclusion of negligible impact, accepts the auditors' recommendations, will press the Commission to implement them, and says there is no ready-made formula for migration control.
The Netherlands will firmly urge the European Commission to implement this and will ask the Commission to inform the member states about it.
Nederland zal er bij de Europese Commissie stevig op aandringen dat dit ook gebeurt en zal de Europese Commissie vragen de lidstaten hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Kamminga over het bericht ‘Russen maken microchips met oude ASML-machines voor wapens’

MPs Van der Burg and Kamminga asked the ministers whether Russia is obtaining ASML spare parts and machines despite sanctions and what can be done about intermediaries. The government said it cannot confirm the reported shipment numbers or the number of machines in Russia, cites confidentiality, and says it works with the EU sanctions envoy and other partners to counter circumvention, while acknowledging that listing intermediaries takes time.
The cabinet cannot provide insight into the number and type of ASML machines in Russia.
Het kabinet kan geen inzicht geven in het aantal en het soort ASML-machines in Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Kamminga over vrouwenrechten in Afghanistan

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about Taliban restrictions on women's rights in Afghanistan, EU and UN engagement, sanctions and visas for Taliban members, and whether aid can be misused.
