The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns the restrictions, co-holds Afghanistan liable under CEDAW, keeps conditional aid and monitoring, and sees no case for a full aid stop.

The Netherlands, bilaterally and within the EU, strongly condemned this law and called on the Taliban to respect human rights and especially women's and girls' rights in line with international treaty obligations.

Nederland heeft bilateraal en in EU verband deze wet ten sterkste veroordeeld en de Taliban opgeroepen mensenrechten en vrouwen- en meisjesrechten in het bijzonder in lijn met internationale verdragsverplichtingen te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over de toespraak van Eurocommissaris Wopke Hoekstra op de TU Eindhoven op 2 september 2024

An MP asked the minister about Commissioner Hoekstra's speech on EU-China relations, unfair Chinese competition, cheap non-compliant imports such as TEMU, EV tariffs, and reducing dependence on China. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described existing EU trade defence instruments and ongoing investigations, and referred to government policy on strategic dependencies and raw materials without committing to new specific measures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over het bericht “Ook PVV-Minister Klever geeft geld aan UNRWA in Gaza maar wel minder”

An MP from the VVD asked the foreign trade and development minister why 3 million euro earmarked for UNRWA was redirected to UNICEF, and what safeguards exist for UNRWA's neutrality and against Hamas links. The minister cited concerns about UNRWA neutrality, the Colonna review and its implementation, diversification of aid channels, and the handling of staff allegedly linked to the 7 October attacks.

The cabinet closely follows the implementation together with other donors, because it is important that the organisation takes all possible steps to minimise the chance of breaches of the neutrality principles.

Nederland volgt de implementatie nauwgezet met andere donoren, omdat het van belang is dat de organisatie alle mogelijke stappen zet om de kans op schendingen van de neutraliteitsprincipes te minimaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Martens-America over het bericht ‘Nederland wil export ASML naar China verder beperken’

MPs Kamminga and Martens-America asked whether the government plans to further restrict ASML's exports of chip-making machines to China, which tools and risks are involved, and how businesses are consulted. The minister denies a plan to restrict exports, describes a country-neutral export-control measure that requires licences rather than banning exports, and gives largely general answers, declining to give licence numbers and deferring to ASML on its own impact.
The cabinet does not make statements about individual licences to specific destinations.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over individuele vergunningen naar specifieke bestemmingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Kamminga over de berichtgeving omtrent mpox-vaccins, o.a. op NU.nl ‘Geen Nederlandse mpox-vaccins naar Afrika vanwege ‘nationale paraatheid’’

MPs Tielen and Kamminga asked the Ministers of Health and of Foreign Trade and Development about reports that the Netherlands would not donate its mpox vaccine stock to Africa for national preparedness reasons, and about the stock size, donations, replenishment and expected use. Minister Agema answered that the stock of about 99,700 vaccines is a safety reserve, that donation is not ruled out but is currently declined, that replenishment depends on manufacturer delivery expected in early 2025, and that the Netherlands contributes EUR 3 million to the WHO response plan.
As I indicated earlier, I have decided not to donate mpox vaccines now because the 100,000 vaccines I have are our safety stock and delivery of new vaccines will only take place in 2025.

Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven, heb ik besloten nu geen mpox-vaccins doneren omdat de 100.000 vaccins die ik heb onze veiligheidsvoorraad zijn en levering van nieuwe vaccins pas in 2025 plaats zal vinden.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Kamminga en Van der Burg over het bericht 'Burkina Faso volgende Afrikaanse land dat homoseksualiteit strafbaar wil maken'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that Burkina Faso plans to criminalise homosexuality and what the Netherlands is doing in response, including aid, contacts with the regime and Sahel policy. The ministers answered at length, saying the legal consequences are still unclear, that the embassy raised the issue and supports civil society indirectly, and that public statements are currently judged counterproductive, while committing to raise the issue at EU-AU level.
The cabinet will work to achieve this.
Het kabinet zal zich daarvoor inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Becker over het bericht ‘In Gambia dreigt genitale verminking weer legaal te worden’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the government would act against a Gambian bill that would legalise female genital mutilation, including aid, diplomatic contacts and prevention in the Netherlands. The government answered that it opposes FGM, has raised the issue with the Gambian government and works through EU projects and campaigns, but has no direct Dutch programmes on FGM in Gambia.
Our ambassador in Dakar has repeatedly discussed the Dutch position on the bill to legalise female genital mutilation with representatives of the Gambian government.

Onze ambassadeur in Dakar heeft de Nederlandse positie met betrekking tot het wetsvoorstel betreffende legalisering van vrouwelijke genitale verminking meermaals met vertegenwoordigers van de Gambiaanse regering besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over het bericht ‘Noodkreet gemeenten in Toeslagenaffaire’

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that municipalities are overwhelmed by non-victims of the childcare benefits scandal claiming broad municipal support, and about how to speed up individual assessments and set limits on support. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, explained that non-victims should be referred to regular help, and pointed to ongoing assessment acceleration, data-sharing improvements and a forthcoming administrative consultation with the VNG, promising a progress report.
A administrative consultation with the VNG and the Ministry of SZW will soon take place to discuss these problems.
Binnenkort vindt er een bestuurlijk overleg plaats met de VNG en het Ministerie van SZW om deze problemen te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Becker over het bericht ‘Oeganda handhaaft een van de strengste antihomowetten ter wereld

MPs Kamminga and Becker asked whether the government will reduce development aid to Uganda after its Constitutional Court let the Anti-Homosexuality Act stand, and about related steps and international coordination. The minister answers that the government has already stopped direct budget support to the central Ugandan state (JLOS programme, Orange Knowledge scholarships), rejects further aid cuts to civil society and multilateral programmes, and describes diplomatic and multilateral efforts without committing to new concrete action.
Yes, the cabinet is of the view that this is a very worrying development.
Ja, het kabinet is van mening dat dit een zeer zorgelijke ontwikkeling is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Becker over het bericht ‘Parlement Ghana akkoord met wet die lhbti’s celstraf oplevert’

MPs Kamminga and Becker asked the government how it responds to Ghana's parliament passing a law criminalising LGBTI identification and funding, and what action it will take on human rights and aid. The ministers say they are concerned, have raised the issue bilaterally and in EU and Equal Rights Coalition settings, but avoid public statements and will review aid only after the president signs the law.
The cabinet finds it worrying that the so-called Human Sexual Rights and Family Values law has been adopted by Ghana's parliament.
Het kabinet vindt het zorgelijk dat de zogenaamde Human Sexual Rights and Family Values wet is aangenomen door het parlement van Ghana.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over het bericht ‘OM ‘gesprek aangegaan met Silvania’

A Dutch MP asks the state secretary whether Curaçao's decision to stop actively collecting older tax debts (pre-2018) is compatible with Dutch-funded reform support, whether reform conditions should be attached, and how the Curaçao Cft advice relates. The state secretary answers that the change is not a waiver of debts, is an autonomous Curaçao matter, reform progress is under discussion in the upcoming implementation agenda, and the Cft advice predates the change.
I will discuss this with Curaçao in the run-up to the next implementation agenda, which will be adopted at the end of June.
Ik ga hierover in gesprek met Curaçao in de aanloop op de volgende uitvoeringsagenda die eind juni zal worden vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Zelensky wil actie tegen Russische gokbedrijven op Curaçao’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports that Ukraine sanctioned Curaçao-based online gambling firms, and about oversight of those firms. The minister answered that Curaçao is autonomous in licensing and supervision, that Nederland has no direct role, and that a new independent gaming regulator is planned under the Landspakket with a target of end-2023.
Curaçao is an autonomous country within the Kingdom and has its own gambling legislation and regulations.
Curaçao is een autonoom land binnen het Koninkrijk en heeft eigen kansspelwet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil en Kamminga over het bericht 'Kwaliteit kinderopvang Caribisch Nederland moet omhoog, zegt Onderwijsinspectie'

MPs Van den Hil and Kamminga asked the minister about the Education Inspectorate's finding that childcare quality in the Caribbean Netherlands must improve, the sanctions imposed, how the findings feed into the pending childcare bill, and whether expanding capacity risks quality. The minister fully endorses the inspectorate's findings, explains the historical causes and the ongoing improvement programme, states that enforcement lies with the island authorities and no sanctions were needed so far, and says the bill will not be changed but will consult island authorities on a 'strict at the gate' approach.
If it is clear in advance that a childcare organisation cannot meet these requirements, it is undesirable to admit the organisation to the childcare system.
Als op voorhand duidelijk is dat een kinderopvangorganisatie niet in staat is om aan deze eisen te voldoen dan is het onwenselijk om de organisatie toe te laten tot het kinderopvangstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over het bericht ‘Regering Curaçao is het oneens met Hof en wil niet dat het huwelijk wordt opengesteld’

An MP asked whether the Curaçao government's plan to appeal a court ruling opening marriage to same-sex couples is acceptable, and what the Dutch government has done on this in relations with the autonomous countries. The state secretary agrees same-sex couples should be able to marry, says the obligation lies with Curaçao but a registered partnership alternative must be legally anchored, and notes the court's finding of a breach that she is concerned about and will follow closely.
I also consider it of great importance that throughout the Kingdom care is taken to realise fundamental human rights.
Ik vind het ook van groot belang dat overal binnen het Koninkrijk zorg wordt gedragen voor de verwezenlijking van de fundamentele mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klink en Kamminga over het bericht dat de Britten een wetsvoorstel hebben ingediend om Brexit-afspraken Noord-Ierland eenzijdig te wijzigen

Two MPs from the VVD asked the government about a UK bill that would allow unilateral changes to Brexit Northern Ireland Protocol arrangements, including its impact on trade, Ireland, Dutch-UK relations and the role of the EU Court of Justice. The Minister answered that the government shares EU concerns, supports Commission dialogue and pressure measures, and urges the UK to honour its international obligations, while the bill's final content and implications remain uncertain.
The cabinet has, in the EU and in contacts with the UK, expressed its concerns about any form of unilateral action.
Het kabinet heeft de afgelopen periode in de EU en in de contacten met het VK zijn zorgen uitgesproken over iedere vorm van unilaterale actie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Aruba heeft geen boodschap aan RMR en Cft: Geld vliegt de deur uit’

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about press reports that Aruba is ignoring advice from the RMR and the Cft on its public finances, asking about the consequences of rising debt and whether the government will hold the Aruban cabinet to account. The State Secretary agreed the situation is very worrying, explained the possible financial risks, but declined to judge Aruba's budget policy while a formal Article 11 procedure is ongoing, promising to inform the House once the RMR decision on the Cft advice is taken.
The budget policy pursued by Aruba is currently subject to an Article 11 procedure, with a hearing and rebuttal process, under the adopted 2022 budget.
Over het door Aruba gevoerde begrotingsbeleid loopt in kader van de Vastgestelde Begroting 2022 momenteel een artikel 11-procedure met een hoor- en wederhoor traject.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Kamminga over de berichten ‘Er vallen doden door slechte gezondheidszorg Sint Eustatius’ en ‘Het ene Nederland is het andere niet’

MPs Van den Hil and Kamminga asked the State Secretaries about reports of deaths from poor healthcare on Sint Eustatius, including the hospitainer's equipment, staffing, appointment of a hospital director and stakeholder involvement. The government denied the hospitainer was inadequate or unstaffed, said no new director was appointed but a temporary CMO was added, and committed to a study of healthcare in Caribbean Netherlands and to a letter for the budget debate.
I will send your House a letter before the 2022 budget debate in response to question 9.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor de begrotingsbehandeling 2022 als antwoord op vraag 9 een brief sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Superjachten van rijke Russen in beslag genomen door Frankrijk en Duitsland’

MPs Kamminga and Brekelmans asked whether Russian oligarchs' superyachts in Sint Maarten waters should be seized as France and Germany had done, and why the Kingdom had not acted. The Minister replied that the Kingdom must implement EU sanctions, that action would follow if listed owners' vessels were found there, that no such case currently exists, and that the government is in contact with Sint Maarten and monitors the situation.
If vessels owned by persons on the EU individual sanctions list are located in Sint Maarten waters (or other parts of the Kingdom), action will be taken.

Indien schepen van eigenaren, die voorkomen op de EU-sanctielijst voor individuen, zich bevinden in de wateren van Sint Maarten (of andere delen van het Koninkrijk) zal hiertoe actie worden ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klink, Kamminga en Van Campen over de nadelige gevolgen van het sluiten van de grenzen in Groot-Brittannië met betrekking tot de invoer van aardappelpootgoed uit de EU

MPs asked whether Brexit trade barriers harming the Dutch seed potato sector, including SMEs, would be eased by a derogation or by Brexit Adjustment Reserve support. The minister acknowledged the sector's difficulties, rejected a special derogation for seed potatoes, said export options to the UK are being explored but are complex, and pointed to an internationalisation programme and individual support.
However, this is extremely complex and time-consuming.
Dit is echter uiterst complex en tijdrovend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over het Politico interview van Eurocommissaris Reynders

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Commissioner Reynders' Politico interview on the timing of the EU rule-of-law conditionality regulation against Hungary, and whether payments could be suspended earlier. The minister answered in detail that the procedure takes at least three months, that no delay before the Hungarian elections is intended, and that the government keeps pressing the Commission to use the instrument fully.
The cabinet continues to urge the Commission to fully use the MFK rule-of-law regulation, by adopting guidelines as soon as possible and starting the procedure to suspend or stop payment of EU funds.

Antwoord 7 Het kabinet blijft er bij de Commissie op aandringen om de MFK-rechtsstaat verordening volledig te benutten, door nu zo snel mogelijk richtsnoeren vast te stellen, en de procedure om tot de opschorting of stopzetting van uitkering van EU-middelen te komen, te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kamminga over het verslag van de Europese Rekenkamer ‘EU-steun voor de rechtsstaat in de Westelijke Balkan’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the European Court of Auditors report finding that EU support for rule-of-law reform in the Western Balkans has had little effect, and what the government would do about it. The minister agreed the findings are serious, committed to pressing for the auditors' recommendations (conditionality, civil society and media support, better monitoring) and to raising them in EU and bilateral channels.
The cabinet takes the ERK's conclusions and recommendations very seriously and will actively use them in current and future efforts on rule-of-law reforms in the Western Balkans.
Het kabinet neemt de conclusies en aanbevelingen van de ERK zeer serieus en zal hier actief gebruik van maken bij de huidige en toekomstige inzet op rechtsstaatshervormingen in de Westelijke Balkan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude, Kamminga en Becker over het bericht 'French government protests EU Commissioner meeting with 'Islamist' NGO'

MPs Van der Woude, Kamminga and Becker asked ministers about an EU Commissioner's meeting with the FEMYSO network, reported as Islamist, and about whether Dutch student associations linked to FEMYSO received university funding. The government declined to endorse the French criticism, said it supports broad civil-society consultation, reported limited funding details from universities, and said the Taskforce on problematic behaviour and undesirable foreign financing would act only if concrete problematic conduct arose.
The cabinet has confidence that our higher education institutions are well able to critically assess applications for financial support for student organisations
Het kabinet heeft er vertrouwen in dat onze instellingen voor hoger onderwijs uitstekend in staat zijn om aanvragen voor financiële ondersteuning voor studentenorganisaties kritisch te beoordelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Agnes Mulder over het bericht 'Hof Polen: Pools recht weegt zwaarder dan Europees Recht'

MPs Kamminga and Agnes Mulder asked the government how it assesses the Polish Constitutional Tribunal's ruling that Polish law prevails over EU law, its consequences for the rule of law, EU instruments (infringement, Article 7, RRF, budget conditionality) and Dutch citizens and firms. The minister answered that the ruling threatens the primacy of EU law, that the Commission has the tools and is to act, that Netherlands supports strong steps and conditioning Polish RRF approval on judicial independence, and that the Prime Minister will raise it at the European Council.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Amhaouch over ontwikkelingen omtrent de Brexit met specifiek het Noord-Ierland protocol

MPs Kamminga and Amhaouch asked the Foreign Minister about Brexit and the Northern Ireland Protocol, including the Commission's proposed simplifications, risks of fraud, and the possible use of Article 16. The minister answered that the Protocol is still being negotiated with the UK, that full implementation remains the goal, and that the consequences of Article 16 cannot yet be assessed.

m: Motie van het lid Kortenoeven over het bevriezen van de contributies aan UNESCO
Motion asking the government to freeze Dutch contributions to UNESCO after it admitted the Palestinian liberation movement/Authority as a full member.
requests the government to freeze the Dutch contributions to UNESCO.
verzoekt de regering, de Nederlandse contributies aan UNESCO te bevriezen
Motie van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders over het staken van de contributies aan UNRWA
Asks the government to stop Dutch contributions to UNRWA and work toward dissolving the organisation.
requests the government to stop Dutch contributions to UNRWA and to promote the dissolution of the organisation
verzoekt de regering, de Nederlandse contributies aan de UNRWA te staken en te bevorderen dat de organisatie wordt opgeheven
Motie Kortenoeven over handhaving van de orde op zee
Motion asking the government to bring maritime public order enforcement to the IMO to seek sanctions against environmental groups disrupting demonstrations at sea.
requests the government to bring the enforcement of order at sea before the International Maritime Organization (IMO)
verzoekt de regering, om de handhaving van de orde op zee aanhangig te maken bij de Internationale Maritieme Organisatie (IMO)
Motie Kortenoeven en Van der Staaij over de mensenrechten van Molukkers, Papoea's en christenen
Asks the government to raise the human rights situation of Moluccans, Papuans and Christians in Indonesia systematically in bilateral and international fora and to report annually to the House.
requests the government to systematically raise the human rights position of Moluccans, Papuans and Christians in Indonesia in bilateral contacts and international fora

verzoekt de regering de mensenrechtenpositie van de Molukkers, de Papoea's en de christenen in Indonesië systematisch in bilaterale contacten met Indonesië en in de relevante internationale fora aan de orde te stellen
Asks the government to bring the human rights suspension mechanism of the EU-Indonesia framework agreement into effect immediately after ratification, citing rights of Moluccans and Papuans.
requests the government, after possible approval of the framework agreement, to bring the suspension mechanism for human rights into effect immediately
verzoekt de regering na een eventuele goedkeuring van de kaderovereenkomst, het opschortingsmechanisme met het oog op de mensenrechten met onmiddellijke ingang in werking te laten treden
Motie-Kortenoeven c.s. over boycotten van de Iraanse centrale bank
Asks the government to seek international support for boycotting the Iranian central bank as a sanction against Iran's nuclear programme.
requests the government to seek international support for boycotting the Iranian central bank
verzoekt de regering om internationaal steun te verwerven voor het boycotten van de lraanse centrale bank
Motie-Kortenoeven en Voordewind over intrekking van de landingsrechten van Iran Air
Asks the government to revoke Iran Air's landing rights in the Netherlands as a sanction against Iran's nuclear programme.
requests the government to revoke the landing rights of Iran Air and Iran Air Cargo
verzoekt de regering, de landingsrechten van Iran Air en van Iran Air Cargo in te trekken
Motie Kortenoeven over terugroepen van de Nederlandse ambassadeur
Asks the minister of Foreign Affairs to recall the Dutch ambassador in Tehran for consultation.
Requests the minister of Foreign Affairs to recall the Dutch ambassador in Tehran to the Netherlands for consultation.
verzoekt de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken, de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Teheran voor consultatie naar Nederland terug te roepen
Motie Kortenoeven over vertrek van de Iraanse ambassadeur
Asks the foreign minister to declare the Iranian ambassador persona non grata and expel him from the Netherlands immediately.
requests the foreign minister to declare the Iranian ambassador in The Hague persona non grata immediately and expel him from the Netherlands
verzoekt de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken, de Iraanse ambassadeur in Den Haag per direct tot persona non grata te verklaren en hem uit Nederland te verwijderen
Motie Voordewind c.s. over uitbreiding van de zwarte lijst
Asks the government to bar Iranian officials and members of the judiciary from entering the Netherlands and freeze assets, and to press for wider EU sanctions covering human rights.
requests the government to immediately deny entry to the Netherlands to the seven officials not yet on the blacklist as well as members of the judiciary
verzoekt de regering om de zeven functionarissen welke nog niet zijn toegevoegd aan de zwarte lijst alsook de leden van de rechterlijke macht, per direct de toegang tot Nederland te ontzeggen
Motie-Kortenoeven/Wilders over de ambassade naar Jeruzalem
Asks the government to move the Dutch embassy back from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem.
requests the government to move the Dutch embassy back to the capital of Israel, Jerusalem
verzoekt de regering de ambassade van Nederland terug te verplaatsen naar de hoofdstad van Israël: Jeruzalem
Asks the government to urge China to end its occupation of Tibet.
requests the government to press the People's Republic of China to end the occupation of Tibet
verzoekt de regering er bij de Volksrepubliek China op aan te dringen de bezetting van Tibet te beëindigen
Motie-Van der Staaij c.s. over de situatie in Papoea
Asks the government to seek open dialogue with Indonesia in international fora to stop human rights violations in Papua and report back.
requests the government to take initiatives in international fora leading to open and constructive dialogue with Indonesia on the situation in Papua
verzoekt de regering in internationaal verband initiatieven te ondernemen die moeten leiden tot een open en constructief overleg met Indonesië over de situatie in Papoea
Motie-Kortenoeven over president Iran voor Internationaal Strafhof
Motion asks the government to get the UN Security Council to have Iranian president Ahmadinejad brought before the International Criminal Court.
requests the government to promote that the UN Security Council brings about that Mahmoud Ahmadinejad is summoned before the International Criminal Court
verzoekt de regering te bevorderen dat de VN-Veiligheidsraad bewerkstelligt dat Mahmoud Ahmadinejad voor het Internationaal Strafhof in Den Haag wordt gedaagd
Motie van het lid Nicolaï c.s. over beveiliging diplomatiek verkeer
Asks the government to review the technical security and classification of Dutch diplomatic communications and inform the House before summer 2011.
requests the government to consider the technical security and classification of Dutch diplomatic communications and to inform the House about it before summer 2011
verzoekt de regering zich te beraden op de technische beveiliging en classificatie van het Nederlandse diplomatieke verkeer en daarover de Kamer voor de zomer van 2011 te informeren
Asks the government to press Turkey to end its occupation of northern Cyprus.
requests the government to urge the Turkish government to end the occupation of northern Cyprus
verzoekt de regering er bij de Turkse regering op aan te dringen de bezetting van Noord-Cyprus te beëindigen
qa: Antwoord vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Hernandez over de militaire presentie in Zuid-Libanon van de terroristische organisatie Hezobollah

MPs Kortenoeven and Hernandez asked the foreign minister whether Hezbollah's military buildup in South Lebanon, its role in the Lebanese government, and the limits of UNIFIL under resolution 1701 breach the EU association agreement and Lebanon's responsibilities. The minister answered that Hezbollah is dominant but not sole ruler in the south, that the Lebanese army has deployed there since 2006, that the Netherlands backs EU listing of Hezbollah, and that the government is responsible for weapons control, answering questions 3 and 4 jointly.
The Netherlands, as is well known, advocates listing Hezbollah on the EU list of terrorist organisations and explicitly avoids contacts with Hezbollah-affiliated politicians.
Nederland pleit zoals bekend voor opname van Hezbollah op de EU-lijst van terroristische organisatie en gaat contacten met Hezbollah-gelieerde politici nadrukkelijk uit de weg.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kortenoeven over de verplaatsing naar Caïro van het hoofdkantoor van de terreurorganisatie Hamas

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Hamas's headquarters had moved from Damascus to Cairo, and whether Egypt hosting Hamas breaches the EU-Egypt association agreement, and asked for EU pressure to reverse it. The minister replied that according to Egyptian authorities the headquarters had not moved, that Hamas was only considering opening a representation in an Arab capital, and referred back to that answer for the remaining questions.
I refer to the answer to question 1.
Ik verwijs naar het antwoord op vraag 1.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kortenoeven over de betrekkingen met de Islamitische Republiek Iran

An MP asked the foreign minister how she assessed Canada's severing of diplomatic relations with Iran, whether this related to Iran's support for the Syrian regime and incitement against Israel, and whether the Netherlands would revise its own relations with Iran. The minister said the government noted Canada's decision and understood it as a response to Iranian threats, but that keeping a diplomatic channel open with Iran was important, so the Netherlands would not revise relations.
No. The government considers it important to keep a communication channel open with the Iranian government.
Nee. De regering acht het belangrijk om een communicatiekanaal met de Iraanse regering open te houden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Hernandez over het bewapeningsprogramma van Turkije

Two MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about press reports on Turkey's ballistic missile programme and whether it conflicts with NATO's collective approach, and whether the government will raise it at the next NATO defence ministerial. The minister answered that Turkey has announced intentions for a missile interceptor and satellite capability, no formal decisions have been taken, such capabilities are also of NATO interest, and there is no reason to see it as a signal of drifting from transatlantic cooperation, so he sees no reason to raise the issue at NATO.
No formal decisions have yet been taken on this.
Hierover zijn nog geen formele besluiten genomen.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Kortenoeven over de nieuwe oproep van de president van de Islamitische Republiek Iran tot vernietiging van de Joodse staat Israël alsmede over mogelijk subversieve activiteiten van Iraanse amb

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Ahmadinejad's renewed call for Israel's destruction, whether it constitutes incitement to genocide, and possible subversive activity by Iranian embassies. The minister condemned the remarks as unacceptable, said prosecution at the ICC is not possible since Iran has not ratified the Statute, and said the Netherlands and EU have repeatedly rejected such statements and will not attend such speeches.
The recent statements attributed to President Ahmadinejad are reprehensible and completely unacceptable.
De recente, aan president Ahmadinejad toegeschreven uitlatingen zijn verwerpelijk en volstrekt onacceptabel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kortenoeven over de opdracht van opperste leider Khamenei om aanslagen te plegen op Westerse doelen

The MP asks whether reports that Supreme Leader Khamenei ordered terror attacks on Western targets should be treated as a declaration of war, how the government responded, and whether Iranian embassy staff in The Hague should be cut to a minimum with others expelled. The minister answers that no such order has been established, that the government will raise the matter in EU context if the reports are confirmed, and that the Vienna Convention leaves staff composition largely to the sending state.
It has not been established that such an order was actually given by Ayatollah Khamenei.
Er is niet vastgesteld dat een dergelijke opdracht daadwerkelijk door Ayatollah Khamenei is gegeven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kortenoeven over het gevaar van de islamitische Libanese terreurorganisatie Hezbollah voor de veiligheid in Europa

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Interior whether the US assessment that Hezbollah may strike in Europe is endorsed, and why Hezbollah is not fully listed on the EU terrorist list. The minister answered that Hezbollah is a terrorist organisation, that Dutch services see no current heightened threat, and that the Netherlands has long favoured full EU listing and will raise the matter again in the EU.
The Netherlands advocates full listing of Hezbollah on the EU terrorism list.
Nederland pleit voor integrale plaatsing van Hezbollah op de EU-terrorismelijst.
Antwoord vragen Kortenoeven en Hernandez over de weigering van de EU om Hezbollah te plaatsen op de lijst van terroristische organisaties

MPs Kortenoeven and Hernandez asked the Foreign Minister why the EU refuses to list Hezbollah as a terrorist organisation, whether the Netherlands still considers it one, and whether the EU Association Agreement with Lebanon should be suspended while Hezbollah is in government. The minister answered that the Netherlands regards Hezbollah as a terrorist organisation and will keep raising this in the EU, but opposes suspending the Association Agreement, and described efforts on UNSC resolution 1701 and Syrian chemical weapons.
The Netherlands considers Hezbollah a terrorist organisation.
Nederland beschouwt Hezbollah als een terroristische organisatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders over nieuwe anti-christelijke maatregelen in Indonesië

MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister how she assesses news reports of church closures and attacks on Christians in Indonesia, including Aceh's sharia, and what concrete steps the government has taken to protect them. The minister expressed concern, denied that a jihad targets Christians, said Aceh remains subject to national law, and listed diplomatic raising of the issue, the human rights ambassador's visit and support for interfaith programmes.
The Netherlands regularly raises attention to the position of religious minorities in Indonesia.
Nederland vraagt regelmatig aandacht voor de positie van religieuze minderheden in Indonesië.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders over het strafproces tegen de Turkse musicus Fazil Say

PVV MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister about the prosecution of Turkish musician Fazil Say for allegedly insulting Islam on Twitter, and whether this signals an attack on free expression in Turkey, including whether the ambassador should be summoned and whether an observer should attend the trial. The minister answered that Say is charged under Article 216.3 of the Turkish penal code, that Dutch concerns about free expression and press freedom in Turkey are raised with the Turkish government, and that the Netherlands is following the case and will consider observer attendance in consultation with EU partners.
Dutch concerns about this are discussed in contacts with the Turkish government.
Nederlandse zorgen hierover worden in contacten met de Turkse regering besproken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bemmel en Kortenoeven over vrij internet bij de ambassades in landen waar internetcensuur geldt

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether Dutch embassies in censored countries are themselves subject to internet censorship and whether opening embassy Wi-Fi to the public could help. The minister replied that embassies use the ministry's secure internal network, that opening Wi-Fi is not possible for security reasons, and that the government will explore EU cooperation to give human rights defenders uncensored access.
I will raise in the EU context whether cooperation is possible in countries with internet censorship so that human rights defenders can use uncensored internet connections.
Ik zal in EU-verband aan de orde stellen of in landen met internetcensuur kan worden samengewerkt om mensenrechtenverdedigers gebruik te laten maken van ongecensureerde internetverbindingen.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij, Peters, Kortenoeven over de veroordeling van de winnares van de Mensenrechtentulp

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the conviction to two years' imprisonment of human rights lawyer Ni Yulan and her husband was an unfair trial, whether China was pressed for their release, and how China's restrictions on lawyers and new criminal procedure law fit with this. The minister answered that the Netherlands is concerned about the lack of transparency, has conveyed disappointment to Chinese authorities, will raise the case in EU-China human rights consultations, and that the appeal is still pending.
As far as the Netherlands is concerned, this case should also be a topic of discussion during the upcoming EU-China human rights consultations.
Deze zaak zal wat Nederland betreft ook onderwerp van gesprek moeten zijn tijdens de komende EU-China mensenrechtenconsultaties.
Antwoord vragen Kortenoeven, Bosma en Wilders over de Turkse reactie op het in het Rijksmuseum exposeren van een ‘anti-Turkse spotprent’

PVV MPs asked the government about Turkish media criticism of a 1683 anti-Turkish caricature exhibited at the Rijksmuseum, whether Turkish authorities had contacted the Dutch government, and whether the museum's explanatory text was a form of capitulation. The minister answered that the Turkish embassy raised concern via the foreign ministry, that the museum is responsible for its own captions, and that the government does not share the characterization of the museum's conduct.
As for any Turkish contacts with the Rijksmuseum, I refer you to the director of the Rijksmuseum.
Voor wat betreft eventuele Turkse contacten met het Rijksmuseum, verwijs ik u naar de directeur van het Rijksmuseum.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Kortenoeven over de positie van Assyrische christenen in Irak

Three MPs (Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Kortenoeven) asked the Foreign Minister about the position of Assyrian Christians in Iraq, including a human rights report on their exodus, Dutch support for UNDP projects in Nineveh, police deployment there, and the status of the Zakho attacks investigation. The minister described the UNDP projects and said he would raise concerns about church attacks and police in Nineveh with Iraqi authorities, while noting that some arrests were made and the criminal investigation is ongoing.
I will discuss this shortly with the Iraqi authorities and specifically ask for attention to the deployment of police in Nineveh.
Ik bespreek dit op korte termijn met de Iraakse autoriteiten en vraag daarbij specifiek aandacht voor de inzet van de politie in Nineveh.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Kortenoeven over het bericht dat een kerk in Koeweit mogelijk voor Goede Vrijdag gesloten wordt

Three MPs asked the foreign minister whether a Kuwaiti evangelical church would close before Good Friday following a Saudi fatwa, and whether the government would protest or summon Kuwait's ambassador. The minister answered that the church is not closing and services will proceed, saw no reason to summon the ambassador, and noted no change in Kuwaiti policy toward churches.
Antwoord vragen Hernandez en Kortenoeven over de benoeming van een burgermedewerkster tot generaal

MPs Hernandez and Kortenoeven asked the Defence Minister why a civilian employee was appointed to the rank of major general as deputy commander of the Royal Marechaussee, and questioned her lack of military training and whether this undermines military staff. The minister answered that leadership experience is relevant, declined to discuss individual appointment procedures, and denied any link to unrest among military personnel.
I make no statement about the appointment procedure of individual personnel members.
Ik doe geen mededeling over de benoemingsprocedure van individuele personeelsleden.

Antwoord vragen Hernandez en Kortenoeven over het bericht dat parlementsleden van de Britse Defensiecommissie zich grote zorgen maken over de dreiging van een EMP-aanval (Electromagnetic Pulse) voor de nationale veilighe

Two PVV MPs asked the Defence Minister whether he would revise his view that the threat of an electromagnetic pulse (EMP) attack is low, in light of UK parliamentary warnings, and whether he would commission an interdepartmental study of EMP risks to Dutch critical infrastructure. The minister maintained that the threat is low, said intelligence services rate a nuclear EMP attack as unlikely, described improvised EMP devices as causing limited damage, judged protection costs too high to estimate, and declined to form an interdepartmental working group.
I do not consider there to be a need for this.
De noodzaak hiervoor acht ik niet aanwezig.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij, Kortenoeven, Timmermans, Pechtold, Ormel en Voordewind over Chinese deportaties van Noord-Koreaanse vluchtelingen naar hun vaderland

Six MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that China continues to deport North Korean refugees and what the government is doing about it, including pressing China, supporting South Korea at the UN Human Rights Council, and pursuing arbitration with UNHCR. The minister answered that the government is concerned and has raised non-refoulement with China, but China rejects the refugee label and treats the matter as bilateral, so no concrete change is expected.
Both the Netherlands and the EU have previously raised with China the principle of non-refoulement and advocated UNHCR access.
Zowel Nederland als de EU heeft China eerder aangesproken op het principe van non-refoulement en toegang van UNHCR bepleit.
Antwoord vragen Kortenoeven over Chinese overheidsmaatregelen tegen mensenrechtenverdedigers

An MP asks the Foreign Minister how the government responded to Chinese police preventing Tsering Woeser from receiving the Prins Claus Prize and to her house arrest, whether she can be invited to the Netherlands, how these measures are assessed, and whether Dutch diplomats visited or attended the trial of Ni Yulan. The minister says the government deplored the events and asked Chinese authorities for an explanation, that Woeser cannot travel as she has no passport, that the Tibetan issue is raised in EU-China dialogue, and that Ni Yulan's trial was monitored but the embassy was denied access to the courtroom.
I regret the course of events and have asked the Chinese authorities for a text and explanation.
Ik betreur de gang van zaken en heb de Chinese autoriteiten om tekst en uitleg gevraagd.
Antwoord vragen De Roon, Kortenoeven en Bontes over kandidaturen van Pakistan en Venezuela voor de VN Mensenrechtenraad

Three PVV MPs asked whether Pakistan and Venezuela are the only candidates for vacant UN Human Rights Council seats, whether their poor human rights records should bar them, and what the government will do to block them. The minister replied that other candidates exist under clean-slate arrangements, that human rights records weigh heavily but Netherlands does not state voting preferences, and that election of these two countries is unlikely to be prevented.
However, the Netherlands does not make statements about voting preferences in elections for UN bodies.
Nederland doet echter geen uitspraken over stemvoorkeuren bij verkiezingen voor VN-organen.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het in Saoedi-Arabische schoolboeken zaaien van haat en aanzetten tot geweld tegen Joden, christenen, «ongelovigen» en g

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister how the government views reports that Saudi textbooks incite hatred and violence against Jews, Christians, unbelievers and apostates, and what the Netherlands has done bilaterally and in international bodies to press Saudi Arabia to change the curriculum. The minister answered that Saudi revision of textbooks is ongoing but unfinished, and that the Netherlands has raised freedom of religion and expression with Saudi Arabia through bilateral, EU and UN channels, with a human rights ambassador visit planned.
A visit by the Human Rights Ambassador to Saudi Arabia is also planned for February 2012 with the aim of continuing the human rights dialogue.
Ook is een bezoek van de Mensenrechtenambassadeur aan Saoedi-Arabië gepland voor februari 2012 met als doel het voortzetten van de dialoog op het gebied van mensenrechten.
Antwoord vragen Hernandez en Kortenoeven over het Turkse raketprogramma

Two PVV MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether Turkey is developing long-range ballistic missiles, whether this breaches NATO philosophy or the non-proliferation treaty, and whether the minister will raise it at NATO. The minister replied that nothing is known to him about a Turkish missile programme, declined to engage with the NATO and non-proliferation questions on that basis, and answered the timing question affirmatively.
I have no knowledge of this and have also been unable to obtain any confirmation of it.
Mij is daarover niets bekend en evenmin heb ik daar enige vorm van bevestiging van kunnen krijgen.

Vragen van de leden Wilders, Kortenoeven en Hernandez (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over het door Turkije opschorten van de militaire samenwerking met Frankrijk (ingezonden 23 decemb

PVV MPs asked the foreign and defence ministers whether Turkey's unilateral suspension of military cooperation with France over an 'honour dispute' shows Turkey is unreliable, warranting reconsideration of its NATO membership and missile shield role, and whether Turkey should be barred from EU accession. The ministers replied that Turkey remains an important NATO ally, that the Netherlands regrets the France-Turkey rift and hopes for repair, and that the government keeps its accession policy unchanged while rejecting the characterisations of Turkey and Erdogan.
Turkey is and remains an important NATO ally, including in the collective defence of NATO territory through the missile defence system.
Turkije is en blijft een belangrijke NAVO-bondgenoot, onder andere bij de gemeenschappelijke verdediging van het NAVO-grondgebied via het raketverdedigingssysteem.

Vragen van het lid Kortenoeven en Hernandez (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over het tegen de eigen burgerbevolking inzetten van gevechtsvliegtuigen door NAVO-lidstaat Turkije (ingezo

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence how they assess reports that a Turkish airstrike killed 31 Kurdish villagers, whether this breaches the NATO treaty spirit, and whether they will raise it in the NATO Council. The government replied that Turkey called it a tragic mistake, expressed regret and promised compensation and an inquiry, and that no NATO Council discussion is needed.
No. Given the answer to questions 1 and 2, it is not necessary to raise this in the NATO Council.
Nee. Gezien het antwoord op vraag 1 en 2 is het niet nodig om dit in de NAVO-Raad aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord vragen De Roon en Kortenoeven over de boycot van Iraanse olie

MPs De Roon and Kortenoeven asked the Foreign Minister about Greek objections to an EU boycott of Iranian oil, possible compensation arrangements, costs, Turkey's exemption request and the Halkbank position. The minister replied that EU talks on compensating supply and modalities are ongoing, that a ban is not expected to cause direct extra costs but may briefly raise oil prices, that Turkey is not covered by an EU ban, and that EU sanctions apply to Halkbank's European branches.
At this moment, discussions are taking place at EU level about a ban on the import of Iranian oil into the EU.
Op dit moment wordt in EU-verband gesproken over een verbod op de import van Iraanse olie in de EU.
Antwoord vragen Kortenoeven over de vriendschappelijke betrekkingen tussen het islamistische regime Erdogan en de islamitische terreurorganisatie Hamas

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's engagement with Hamas and whether the government would condemn it and reconsider celebrating 400 years of Dutch-Turkish relations. The minister replied that Turkey's contacts are monitored and raised with Ankara, that EU conditions for contact with Hamas apply, and that the bilateral relationship is important and will be celebrated.

The government follows the contacts between Turkey and Hamas and raises with Turkey that, through contacts with a terrorist organisation, it crosses the red lines of the EU's common foreign and security policy.

De regering volgt de contacten tussen Turkije en Hamas en spreekt Turkije aan dat het door contacten met een terroristische organisatie de rode lijnen van het gemeenschappelijk buitenlands en veiligheidsbeleid van de EU overschrijdt.

Vragen van de leden Wilders en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over rabiate islamitische Jodenhaat op de staatstelevisie van het als «gematigd» bekend staande emiraat Koeweit (ingezonden 1

PVV MPs Wilders and Kortenoeven asked the Foreign Minister about a Kuwaiti state TV preacher's antisemitic remarks, and whether the government would condemn them and inform parliament of Kuwait's response. The minister said the remarks are the preacher's own responsibility, that Kuwait's government had no link to them according to the embassy, and that no formal protest would be lodged.
It is not for the Dutch government to distance itself from the statements of a Kuwaiti sheikh.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse regering om afstand te nemen van uitlatingen van een Koeweiti sheikh.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het systematisch muilkorven, oppakken en detineren van journalisten in herislamiserend Turkije (ingezonden 22 december 2

MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister about the arrests and detention of journalists in Turkey, whether the government would condemn them, what it did for jailed journalist Nedim Sener, and the cost of celebrating 400 years of diplomatic relations. The minister answered that Turkey falls short on press freedom under the Copenhagen criteria, that the government raises it bilaterally and via the EU, that it does not comment on individual charges but monitors the case, and that 2.07 million euro is budgeted for the anniversary.
The cabinet does not go into individual charges.
Het kabinet gaat niet in op individuele tenlasteleggingen.
Antwoord vragen Kortenoeven en Wilders over Nederlands-Iraanse relaties

PVV MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked why the Dutch ambassador to Iran was recalled and then sent back, and whether Iran's conduct justified a different stance. Minister Rosenthal answered that the recall was a joint protest against the storming of the British embassy, that dialogue requires a diplomatic presence, and that the government condemns Iran's threats and keeps tightening EU sanctions.
In the view of the countries involved, it is important to keep the channel of dialogue with the Iranian authorities open.
Het is naar het oordeel van de betrokken landen van belang om het gesprekskanaal met de Iraanse autoriteiten open te houden.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Dijkhoff (VVD), Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Kortenoeven (PVV) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie van tientallen Turkse journalisten, acad

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister how the government judges the Turkish police arrest of dozens of journalists, writers and publishers, whether the charges link to publications on the Armenian genocide, and what Dutch steps and EU accession consequences follow. The minister answered that detainees are held pending a formal indictment under anti-terror law, that press freedom is under growing pressure, and that the Netherlands raises this bilaterally and in the EU, with Turkey unable to join until it meets the accession conditions.
The Netherlands raises with the Turkish government, both bilaterally and through the EU, the importance of press freedom and freedom of expression for Turkey's democratic reform process.
Nederland spreekt zowel bilateraal als via de EU de Turkse regering aan op het belang van persvrijheid en vrijheid van meningsuiting voor het democratisch hervormingsproces in Turkije.

Vragen van het lid Kortenoeven (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het escalerende en brute geweld van het Indonesische leger tegen de autochtone bevolking van West-Papoea (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

An MP asks the Foreign Minister how the government assesses reports of Indonesian army violence against West Papuans in Paniai and what concrete steps it took, and how it implements a parliamentary motion. The minister disputes the scale of the reports, describes diplomatic contacts and existing human rights dialogue, but declines to implement the motion's protection mechanism.
implementing point 3 of the Kortenoeven motion – establishing protection mechanisms for the Papuans – I consider not effective in this light.
uitvoering van punt 3 van de motie van het lid Kortenoeven – instelling van beschermingsmechanismen voor de Papoea's – acht ik in dit licht niet effectief.
Vragen van het lid Kortenoeven (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de uitbreiding van EU-sancties tegen de Islamitische Republiek Iran (ingezonden 5 december 2011).

An MP asks the foreign minister how EU Iran sanctions developments (Council conclusions of 1 December 2011, UK and French bank measures, Iran Air landing rights, travel advice) relate to his motion calling for swift sanctions, and whether the Netherlands is leading. The minister replies that the Netherlands has taken a lead role, that 180 Iranian persons/entities were added to the EU list, that the EU is united, and that no travel-advice change is needed, while listing the Iran Air aircraft covered by the EU regulation.
It is prohibited to grant Iranian cargo flights access to EU airports, unless they are mixed flights (partly passengers, partly cargo).
Het is verboden Iraanse vrachtvluchten toegang tot luchthavens in de EU te verlenen, tenzij het gemengde vluchten (deels passagiers, deels vracht) betreft.
Vragen van het lid Kortenoeven (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het geweld tegen christenen in Birma (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister about reported military violence against Christians in Burma, the effectiveness of Dutch Human Rights Fund support, internet freedom, measures to protect Burmese Christians, and sanctions options. The minister condemned the violence, described Dutch support for independent media and NGOs, noted Karen refugee funding, and said human rights concerns are raised in international fora and through existing EU, US and Western sanctions regimes.
The government therefore strongly condemns these acts.
De regering veroordeelt deze dan ook scherp.

Vragen van het lid Kortenoeven (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de gewelddadige Indonesische reactie op het vreedzame onafhankelijkheidsstreven van de Papoea’s (ingezonden 20 oktober 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the violent Indonesian response to the peaceful independence movement in Papua, whether Indonesia has been pressed to stop the repression and release detained leaders, and what the Dutch position is given earlier promises to Papuans. The minister answered that the Netherlands has raised concern and asked Indonesia for information, will act if developments warrant, recognises Indonesian sovereignty, and supports full implementation of the special autonomy law.
This concern has been conveyed to the Indonesian authorities.
Deze zorg is kenbaar gemaakt aan de Indonesische autoriteiten.
Vragen van het lid Kortenoeven (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over aanvallen van Hindoe-extremisten op christenen in India (ingezonden 6 oktober 2011).

MP Kortenoeven asks the foreign minister about Hindu extremist attacks on Christians in India, whether the minister raised Christians' legal protection with his Indian counterpart, and whether the EU-India free trade talks address Christians' position. The minister acknowledges weak local protection and says the position of religious minorities is raised through EU human rights dialogue, but commits to no specific new action.
In addition, the position of religious minorities, including Christians, is raised.
Daarbij komt ook de positie van religieuze minderheden, waaronder christenen, aan de orde.
Vragen van de leden Hernandez en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Defensie over het bericht «Turken heersen bij taptoe» (ingezonden 4 oktober 2011).

PVV MPs Hernandez and Kortenoeven asked the Defence Minister about a Telegraaf report on Ottoman-era content and the Turkish Mehter band at the 2011 National Tattoo, and about Defence's financial, personnel and material contribution. Minister Hillen answered that the Ottoman period was not part of the Tattoo, the Mehter band was invited as a NATO partner's military band with a size comparable to the other eight bands, and Defence's support was set out in a convenant with the independent foundation.
The "glorious era of the Ottoman Empire" was not part of the National Tattoo.
De «glorietijd van het Ottomaanse rijk» maakte geen deel uit van de Nationale Taptoe.

Vragen van de leden Wilders , Kortenoeven en Beertema (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over apartheidsreizen naar Saoedi-Arabië (ingezonden 30 augustus 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Education and Foreign Affairs ministers about Hajj/Umrah trips to Saudi Arabia, which bar non-Muslims from Mecca and Medina, and whether schools organise such trips during school time. The government said religious access restrictions are a religious matter it does not normally comment on, that no Islamic schools are known to organise such trips, that absence is not recorded by religion, and that municipalities enforce compulsory schooling.
The government therefore cannot tell you whether, and if so how many, Islamic compulsory-education pupils were absent without leave during the past Hajj season.
De regering kan u dan ook niet melden of, en zo ja hoeveel islamitische leerplichtigen ongeoorloofd afwezig waren tijdens het afgelopen hadj-seizoen.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Hernandez (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over de betrokkenheid van het regime van de Islamitische Republiek Pakistan bij de recente terreuraanval o

MPs Kortenoeven and Hernandez asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether the Pakistani regime was involved in the attack on the US embassy in Kabul and what it means for Dutch interests and security. The minister said he lacked the precise basis for the US accusations, that Pakistan remains an important counter-terrorism partner, and declined to give details on embassy security measures and NATO operations for security reasons.
For security reasons, no statements are made about specific measures.
Om veiligheidsredenen worden geen uitspraken gedaan over specifieke maatregelen.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de vervolging van de Turkse cartoonist Bahadir Baruter wegens het afwijzen van Allah (ingezonden 6 oktober 2011).

PVV MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister about the prosecution of Turkish cartoonist Bahadir Baruter for insulting religious values under Turkish criminal law, and whether this signals Turkish restrictions on free speech and religious freedom. The minister declined to prejudge the Turkish court case, said the provision is not per se incompatible with the rule of law, and stated the Netherlands has raised concerns about free expression and religious freedom in Turkey.
It is not for the Cabinet to anticipate this trial.
Het is niet aan het Kabinet om op dit proces vooruit te lopen.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), De Roon en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de verheerlijking van gew

Opposition MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP and PVV asked the Foreign Minister why the Palestinian Authority glorifies terrorism and pays salaries and prisoner allowances to terrorists, despite Dutch funding, and whether Dutch aid should be cut. The minister acknowledged sympathy for terrorism among part of the population, said PA leaders distance themselves from terrorism, rejected that the aid funded terrorist payments, and saw no reason to halt the payments or the Dutch contribution.
I see no reason to call on the PA to revise this arrangement.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de PA op te roepen deze regeling te herzien.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Kortenoeven (PVV), Ormel (CDA) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het oppakken door de Oezbeekse politie van vier christenen (ingezonden 29

MPs from SGP, PVV, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the foreign minister about the arrest of four Christians by Uzbek police, the number of Christians jailed for their faith, the worsening pressure on religious groups, and EU and Dutch action. The minister replied that the four were released without interrogation after one day, that the exact number of jailed Christians is unknown, and that the EU raises religious freedom and individual cases in its human rights dialogue.
The group of four was released after one day in detention.
Het viertal is na een dag hechtenis vrijgelaten.
Vragen van de leden Wilders en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de verijdelde Iraanse terreuraanslagen in de Verenigde Staten (ingezonden 12 oktober 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister how he assessed reports of foiled Iranian terror plots in the United States and whether he would immediately sever diplomatic relations with Iran if the regime was behind them. The minister said he was appalled, that the cabinet was consulting the US and allies on a joint response, that he would inform parliament when consultations concluded, and that the Netherlands supported raising the matter in the UN Security Council.
I will inform your House when that consultation has concluded.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren wanneer dat overleg is afgerond.
Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de relaties tussen Nederland en de Islamitische Republiek Iran (ingezonden 28 september 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about an IRNA report of his meeting with Iran's foreign minister, alleged 'provocative acts' in Europe, growing bilateral trade, and Iranian human rights, terrorism and nuclear conduct. The minister replied that the Iranian minister did not use the phrase 'provocative acts', that the government distinguishes its views from the PVV's, that the conversation was mainly about the consular dialogue on detained dual nationals, and that the government remains seriously concerned about Iran's nuclear programme and human rights.
Minister Salehi did not use the term 'provocative actions' in his conversation with me.
Minister Salehi heeft in zijn gesprek met mij het woord «provocatieve acties» niet gebruikt.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een nieuwe pogrom van Indonesische moslims tegen Indonesische christenen (ingezonden 14 september 2011).

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reports of unrest on Ambon and about the government's efforts on religious freedom in Indonesia, including the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue and advocacy with Indonesian officials. The minister answered that the Ambon violence was not sectarian in origin, described diplomatic raising of religious tolerance in bilateral and multilateral fora, and promised to answer before the EU-Indonesia framework agreement vote.
I raised the subject with the Indonesian Minister of Foreign Affairs on the margins of the ASEM Foreign Ministers' Meeting on 6 and 7 June 2011.
Ik heb het onderwerp onder de aandacht gebracht van de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken van Indonesië en marge van de ASEM Foreign Ministers' Meeting op 6 en 7 juni 2011.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het doodvonnis en de beestachtige detentie van een Pakistaanse christelijke vrouw die islamstichter Mohammed zou hebben

PVV MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister about the death sentence and harsh detention of Aasia Bibi and about Pakistan's blasphemy laws, and whether Pakistan can hold a meaningful role in international human rights bodies. The minister replied that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised the case through bilateral and EU channels, favours quiet diplomacy over public pressure on blasphemy laws, rejects claims of systematic discrimination in flood aid, and asked for understanding for the delayed answer.
The Netherlands regularly raises the blasphemy laws issue in bilateral and multilateral contacts, where quiet diplomacy is considered the most effective approach.
Nederland stelt de kwestie rond de blasfemiewetten in Pakistan geregeld in bilaterale en multilaterale contacten aan de orde, waarbij de weg van stille diplomatie het meest effectief is.
Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de rechtspositie en veiligheid van christenen in Indonesië (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

PVV MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether reports that the Bogor mayor is blocking churches are true, how the Indonesian government is acting, and whether the Netherlands will press Indonesia for religious freedom. The minister answered that the concerns are serious, that the high court and ombudsman ruled the church has valid permits, that Nederland raises religious freedom regularly with Indonesian authorities and the EU does so in human rights dialogue, and did not commit to new specific action.
This reporting is cause for concern.
Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en De Roon (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over de Iraanse rol bij het geweld tegen burgers in Syrië (ingezonden 18 augustus 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether reported Iranian snipers in Syria are true, how Iranian involvement should be classified, what consequences apply to officials, and whether the Netherlands will lead on prosecuting external accomplices of the Syrian regime. The minister said he cannot verify the report, condemned Iranian involvement, noted EU sanctions on Revolutionary Guard commanders and the Al-Quds unit, and reported no indications of other external parties.
I cannot assess whether this specific report is true.
Ik kan niet beoordelen of dit specifieke bericht op waarheid berust.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Hernandez en Kortenoeven (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie, van Buitenlandse Zaken, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Defensie over een blunder bij Di

PVV MPs asked several ministers about the DigiNotar certificate authority breach, its effects on DigiD and government e-services, and whether Iran was involved. The government confirmed the hack, took over operational management of DigiNotar's certificate systems, announced a ministry investigation of the PKI-Overheid system and oversight, and said the Iran question was still under investigation.
As part of this, the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations is conducting an investigation into the entire PKI-Overheid system and process, including the supervision of it.
Als onderdeel daarvan voert het ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties een onderzoek uit naar het gehele stelsel en proces rondom PKI-Overheid, inclusief het toezicht daarop.
Vragen van het lid Kortenoeven (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de censuurpolitiek van het regime van de Communistische Volksrepubliek China (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about Chinese censorship of Western music and the sentencing of a Tibetan editor, and whether the Beijing book fair can be used to promote free expression. The minister answers that the government opposes such restrictions, raised free expression with Chinese authorities, and points to Dutch participation in the fair and publication of a human rights note on the embassy website.
Promoting a free and uncensored internet is a priority for the Netherlands in promoting human rights.
Het bevorderen van een vrij en ongecensureerd internet is voor Nederland een prioriteit bij de bevordering van mensenrechten
Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Saoediërs blokkeren sites» (ingezonden 16 augustus 2011).

MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether he would summon the Saudi ambassador and publicly criticise Saudi internet censorship after reports that Saudi Arabia briefly blocked Dutch broadcaster Wereldomroep websites. The minister answered that the responsible party could not be established, that the sites were accessible again, and that Netherlands raises internet freedom in EU, UN and Council of Europe fora.
On this matter, an inquiry will be made with the Saudi Arabian embassy in The Hague.
Over deze kwestie zal ter navraag met de ambassade van Saudi-Arabië in Den Haag contact opgenomen worden.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Kortenoeven (PVV), Van Bommel (SP) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over de eigenstandige positie van Taiwan (ingezonden 22 juni 2011).

Four MPs asked the foreign minister how the EU, US and China stance on Taiwan's international standing is changing and what Dutch support for Taiwan's participation in international bodies would look like. The minister answered that the policies of the US, EU and member states have not changed, that Dutch policy follows the one-China principle, and that Taiwan's membership of international organisations is supported only where all parties agree.
The Netherlands and the other EU member states recognise the government in Beijing as the lawful government of China (one China policy).
Nederland en de andere lidstaten van de EU erkennen de regering in Peking als wettige regering van China (één China beleid).

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Kortenoeven (PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de toenemende christenvervolging in Ch

Three MPs asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers about the rising persecution of Christians in China, including arrests of churchgoers, and whether the government would condemn it and raise it with Beijing during a trade mission. The minister answered that concerns about religious freedom are raised bilaterally and via the EU, and that human rights were discussed during the trade mission, but gave no new concrete commitments.
The Netherlands has repeatedly expressed concern to Chinese authorities about the lack of religious freedom in China and will continue to do so.
Nederland heeft herhaaldelijk tegenover Chinese autoriteiten zorg uitgesproken over de gebrekkige vrijheid van religie in China en zal dat blijven doen.
Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven, Bontes en Hernandez (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over de bouw van Iraanse raketbases in Venezuela (ingezonden 20 mei 2011).

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reports that Iran was building missile bases in Venezuela, and about the strategic ties between Tehran and Caracas. The government said it could not confirm the reports, noted that a closer Iran-Venezuela relationship could undermine UN sanctions and that compliance would be monitored, and described the bilateral cooperation agreements while saying it would follow developments closely.

Although the Dutch government cannot confirm that these reports are true and therefore cannot establish whether international prohibitions and treaties are being violated, a more intensive relationship between Venezuela and Iran may bring serious and undesirable developments.

Hoewel de Nederlandse regering niet kan bevestigen dat deze berichten op waarheid berusten en het daardoor niet mogelijk is vast te stellen of internationale verbodsbepalingen en verdragen worden geschonden, kan een intensievere relatie tussen Venezuela en Iran ernstige en onwenselijke ontwikkelingen met zich meebrengen.

Vragen van het lid Kortenoeven (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over nieuwe antichristelijke maatregelen van het communistische regime van de Volksrepubliek China (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about reports that Chinese authorities blocked an Easter service in Beijing and about the legal position of Christians in China. The minister describes China's religious regulation, states that the Netherlands raises freedom of religion with China and the EU, and says the incident adds to attention on these rights in contacts with China.
Both the ministry in The Hague and the embassy in Beijing promote freedom of religion and belief in China by regularly raising freedom of religion and belief in contacts with China.

Zowel het ministerie in Den Haag als de ambassade in Peking bevordert de vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging in China door in contacten met China de vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging regelmatig aan de orde te stellen.
Vragen van de leden Helder en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Nederland doet werk voor Turks OM» (ingezonden 23 mei 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the Netherlands should cooperate with a Turkish legal assistance request to hear a Turkish judge in an asylum procedure over insulting Turkish nationhood, and on what grounds such a request can be refused. The minister said the requests are still under review, cited ERV grounds for refusal including a reservation on persecution for belief or nationality, and committed to a case-by-case assessment.
After receipt of all the implementing documents, I will make an assessment of which information can be provided to the Turkish authorities and which cannot.
Na ontvangst van alle uitvoeringsstukken zal door mij een afweging worden gemaakt welke informatie verstrekt kan worden aan de Turkse autoriteiten en welke niet.

Vragen van de leden Wilders en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de existentiële bedreiging van Nederland, Israel en de rest van het Vrije Westen door het islamofascistische regime in T

Wilders and Kortenoeven (PVV) asked the foreign minister whether the Iranian regime poses an existential threat to the Free West, citing the documentary Iranium. Minister Rosenthal confirmed awareness of the film, declined to endorse the characterisation, but stated serious concern over Iran's nuclear programme and human rights, pointing to UN, US and EU sanctions.
The Netherlands nevertheless has great concerns about developments in Iran, including its nuclear programme and the human rights situation.
Nederland heeft evenwel grote zorgen over de ontwikkelingen in Iran, onder meer over het het Iraanse nucleaire programma en de mensenrechtensituatie.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de aanzwellende onderdrukking van de vrijheid van meningsuiting en van de persvrijheid in Turkije (ingezonden 8 maart 20

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister about arrests and sentences of journalists and writers in Turkey, including the Ergenekon investigation and sentences of seven years and eleven months for two journalists, and whether Turkey's EU membership should be ruled out. The minister said the government monitors these cases, raised press freedom with Turkey, expressed concern over increasing prosecutions under other penal articles, and stated Turkey cannot join the EU until accession criteria are met.
The Cabinet does not go into individual charges.
Het Kabinet gaat niet in op individuele tenlasteleggingen.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Kortenoeven (PVV) en Ormel (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over arrestaties van christenen in Iran (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister about reports that around 70 Christians were arrested in Iran at Christmas, possibly held in Evin prison and pressed to renounce their faith, and about rising persecution of Christians in Muslim-majority countries. The minister confirmed a December 2010 arrest of several dozen house-church visitors, said he had no information on those detained, and described Dutch and EU pressure on Iran and other states over religious freedom.
I have no information about the people arrested.
Ik heb geen informatie over de gearresteerde personen.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), Kortenoeven (PVV) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Iran: Christians imprisoned without charge» (ingezonden 1

Four MPs asked the foreign minister whether four Christians held in Iran without charge, including a Dutch-Iranian dual national, could be helped through consular and legal assistance and whether the government would inform parliament. The minister answered that the embassy had not obtained formal confirmation from Iranian authorities, that Iran refuses consular access to dual nationals, and that Nederland has raised the issue bilaterally and in the EU while promising to keep parliament informed.
I will keep the House regularly informed of developments.
Ik zal de Kamer met regelmaat op de hoogte houden van ontwikkelingen.
Vragen van de leden De Roon, Kortenoeven, Bontes en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een rapport van «EU-diplomaten» over Jeruzalem (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

Four PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether he would distance the Netherlands from an EU diplomats' report suggesting East Jerusalem be treated as a Palestinian capital, and whether Dutch diplomats contributed to it and whether the report should be discarded. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports a two-state solution with Jerusalem's final status left to negotiation, that the report was largely factual with options the Netherlands endorsed only where they maintained existing policy, and that Dutch contributions followed government policy and distanced the Netherlands from calls contrary to it.
Options that anticipate the outcomes of the final status negotiations have not been supported by the Netherlands.
Opties die vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van de finalestatusonderhandelingen zijn niet door Nederland ondersteund.
