Vragen van de leden lid Hernandez en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat de Nederlandse luchtmacht twee Russische bommenwerpers heeft onderschept die het

PVV MPs Hernandez and Kortenoeven asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether Russian Tu-95 bombers that entered the Dutch responsibility area were a violation of Dutch airspace, whether Russia notified the flights, whether contact with pilots was made, how often Russian aircraft were intercepted since the Cold War, and what motives lie behind the flights. Minister Hillen answered that the flights were unannounced but not an international violation or provocation, that Russia should have reported at entry into air traffic control areas but usually does not, that NATO escorts without contacting pilots, and that the flights resumed structurally after 2007 for training and possibly demonstration purposes.
Exact data on numbers, positions and the actions taken by NATO are classified.
Exacte gegevens over aantallen, posities en de acties die door de Navo zijn genomen, zijn gerubriceerd.

Vragen van de leden Bontes, Kortenoeven en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het door moslims op Kerstavond aangerichte bloedbad tegen christenen in Nigeria (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Christmas Eve killings of Christians in Nigeria were part of a global Islamic war, whether they could be called genocide, and what action was being taken. The minister rejected the global-war framing, said the attacks were claimed by Boko Haram and are under investigation, stated the genocide definition is not met, and listed EU and Dutch measures such as calls for prosecutions and support for a conflict-management centre.
Regarding the qualification 'genocide', I refer to the definition of genocide in the 1948 Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide.
Ten aanzien van de kwalificatie «volkerenmoord» verwijs ik graag naar de definitie van genocide zoals opgenomen in het Verdrag inzake de Voorkoming en de Bestraffing van Genocide uit 1948.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het financieren van Turkse anti-PVV propaganda door de Nederlandse regering (ingezonden 24 december 2010).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether the government funded a Turkish documentary and journalist visit critical of the PVV and Geert Wilders, and whether such funding would stop. The minister confirmed about 11,998 euro was spent on travel and stay via embassy and consulate facilitation, said the programme must not facilitate propaganda, and gave no commitment to stop.
The programme may not lead to conducting or facilitating propaganda.
Het programma mag niet leiden tot het bedrijven of faciliteren van propaganda.
Vragen van de leden De Roon, Kortenoeven en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een bomaanslag op Egyptische christenen (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about a New Year's bombing of a Coptic church in Alexandria, including whether Egyptian security withdrew shortly before the attack and whether the ambassador should be summoned to demand better protection of Christians. The minister said the reports of security presence conflict, the prosecutor is investigating, extra security had been ordered after warnings, and he had asked Egypt in a condolence letter to protect religious minorities.
The investigation into the bombing in Alexandria is led by the public prosecutor-general.
Het onderzoek naar de bomaanslag in Alexandrië wordt geleid door de openbaar hoofdaanklager.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Helder en Kortenoeven (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Nederlandse hoofdrol o

PVV MPs asked ministers whether an investigation exists into the people behind radical extremist websites, whether citizenship could be revoked and they could be expelled, and whether such extremists increasingly operate from the Netherlands. The minister declined to give operational details citing the interests of investigation, said nationality revocation is only possible under narrow conditions and lacks sufficient data for a judgement, and referred to earlier answers for the remaining questions.
In the interest of the investigation I cannot give information about any ongoing criminal investigations or about the number of persons involved.
Ik kan in het belang van de opsporing geen mededelingen doen over eventueel lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken of over het aantal betrokkenen.
Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de aanzwellende islamitische jihad tegen christenen in Irak (ingezonden 5 januari 2011).

MPs Kortenoeven and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether attacks on Iraqi Christians form part of a wider Islamic jihad against Christians, linked to recent attacks in Egypt and Nigeria, and what is being done to prevent destruction of the community. The minister said there is no concrete evidence linking the incidents, attributed them to local causes, and described Dutch and EU engagement with Iraqi authorities and the planned EU Foreign Affairs Council discussion.
On the basis of their primary responsibility, I first approached the Iraqi authorities to promote an improvement in the security situation in Iraq.
Ik heb mij, op grond van hun primaire verantwoordelijkheid, allereerst tot de Iraakse autoriteiten gewend om te bevorderen dat de veiligheidssituatie in Irak zal verbeteren.
Vragen van het lid Kortenoeven (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het lot van de Nederlands-Iraanse Zahra Bahrami (ingezonden 7 januari 2011).

MP Kortenoeven asked the Foreign Minister whether the government had contacted Iran over the death sentence against Dutch-Iranian Zahra Bahrami, and how it would respond to the Iran Comité's call for consequences for bilateral relations and what sanctions options exist. The minister replied that the government has repeatedly raised her position with the Iranian ambassador and the Dutch embassy in Tehran, but that Iran does not recognise her Dutch nationality, and that maintaining diplomatic ties is preferred to enable raising concerns; a broad economic sanctions package already applies.
I have repeatedly and explicitly asked both the Iranian ambassador in The Hague and, via the Dutch ambassador in Tehran, for clarity on Ms Bahrami's position.
Ik heb zowel bij de Iraanse ambassadeur in Den Haag als via de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Teheran nadrukkelijk en bij herhaling uitsluitsel gevraagd omtrent de positie van mevrouw Bahrami.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Fritsma, Kortenoeven en Bontes (allen PVV) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Veiligheid en Justitie, Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de

PVV MPs asked whether members of terrorist organisations should be denied or stripped of refugee status, citing a 2010 EU Court ruling and asking for screening and a revised EU directive. The government answered that the AIVD and IND can refuse or revoke status for national-security risks or serious non-political crimes after individual assessment, that mere membership is not enough, and that the current Qualification Directive already allows denying residence to those actually involved in terrorism.
The EU Court of Justice holds that a person who belonged to an organisation using terrorist methods can only be excluded from refugee status after an individual examination.

Het Hof van Justitie van de EU overweegt dat een persoon die heeft behoord tot een organisatie die terroristische methoden toepast, slechts van de vluchtelingenstatus kan worden uitgesloten na een individueel onderzoek.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven, Hernandez en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over het bericht dat de Islamitische Republiek Iran zou beschikken over geavanceerde Noord-Koreaan

MPs Kortenoeven, Hernandez and Wilders asked whether NATO discussed reports that Iran already had North Korean BM25 missiles capable of reaching Western Europe with nuclear weapons, why this was not public, and whether sanctions should be tightened. The government answered that the threat was discussed in connection with missile defence, that the Strategic Concept already covers it, and that existing UN and EU sanctions already target Iran's ballistic missile programme.
The current sanctions policy towards Iran, UN Security Council Resolution 1929 and the European Regulation on sanctions against Iran, already targets countering Iran's ballistic missile programme.

Antwoord 5 Het huidige sanctiebeleid jegens Iran, VN Veiligheidsraadresolutie 1929 3 en de Europese Verordening inzake sancties tegen Iran, richt zich reeds op het tegengaan van het ballistische rakettenprogramma van Iran.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Kortenoeven (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over de arrestatie van vier ex-moslims in Azerbeidzjan (ingezonden 8 november 2010).

Three MPs (SGP, ChristenUnie, PVV) asked the foreign minister about the arrest and brief detention of four Christian ex-Muslims in Azerbaijan during a thanksgiving service, and what the government had done on religious freedom. The minister said the men were released after five days, the grounds were unknown, and the government raises human rights bilaterally and in international fora, with the case added to an EU subcommittee agenda.
The Netherlands has added the arrest of these four persons to this agenda item.
Nederland heeft de arrestatie van deze vier personen aan dit agendapunt toegevoegd.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Justitie, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de islamitische terreurdreiging tegen infrastructurele d

PVV MPs asked ministers about media reports of Taliban and jihadist threats against Dutch and European targets, including Schiphol, and whether Dutch passport holders in terror training camps would be arrested on return and whether Wali ur Rehman's extradition would be sought. The government kept the national threat level at 'limited', said returnees would be investigated under existing criminal law, declined to give numbers of Dutch nationals joining militant groups (shared with the parliamentary intelligence committee instead), and said Pakistan is primarily responsible for Rehman and that no extradition treaty exists.
More specific information on the nature and scope of this phenomenon will be shared with the parliamentary Committee for the Intelligence and Security Services of your House.
Meer specifieke informatie over de aard en omvang van dit fenomeen wordt met de Commissie voor de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten van uw Kamer gedeeld.

Vragen van de leden Elissen, Helder, Kortenoeven en Fritsma (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de vrijlating van Wesam al D., die in Amerika voor 25 jaar gevangenisstra

PVV MPs asked why Wesam al D., sentenced in the US to 25 years for plotting attacks on American soldiers, was released early after a Dutch court substantially reduced his sentence due to detention conditions, and whether they would prevent such reductions and revoke his Dutch nationality. The ministers answered that the court weighed additional information, that the case is exceptional and warrants no new measures, and that nationality revocation is not possible here because the relevant provision does not apply to offences committed before its entry into force.
As a rule, there is no reason for a judge converting a foreign sentence to moderate that foreign sentence on account of detention conditions.
In de regel is er voor de rechter bij de omzetting van een buitenlandse straf geen aanleiding voor matiging van de buitenlandse straf wegens detentieomstandigheden.
Vragen van het lid Kortenoeven (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de voortdurende gevangenschap van de Chinese Nobelprijswinnaar Liu Xiaobo (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the foreign minister about China's detention of Nobel laureate Liu Xiaobo, the Chinese government's denunciation of the prize, whether human rights had been downgraded in dialogue with China, and whether the Netherlands would request his release. The minister confirmed the press reports, said Beijing's term was 'blasphemy' and that the Netherlands and EU reject China's characterisation, denied that human rights were downgraded, and affirmed that the Netherlands and EU have repeatedly called for his release.
The Netherlands and the EU have repeatedly called for the release of Liu Xiaobo since December 2008 and have drawn attention to the situation of his wife Liu Xia, and will continue to do so.
Nederland en de EU hebben sinds december 2008 bij herhaling aangedrongen op de vrijlating van Liu Xiaobo en aandacht gevraagd voor de situatie van zijn vrouw Liu Xia, en blijven dat doen.
Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de aanzwellende islamitische jihad in Indonesië tegen christenen (ingezonden 11 oktober 2010).

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about rising Islamist violence against Christians in Indonesia and whether the Indonesian government tolerates religious intolerance, and whether the Netherlands would raise the issue at the UN Human Rights Council. The minister acknowledged concern, said Indonesia's constitution guarantees religious freedom, blamed small radical groups and weak local capacity or will, and pledged continued raising of the issue bilaterally, in the EU dialogue and at the March 2011 Council session, without committing to specific cases.
The Netherlands will certainly pay attention to freedom of religion, the position of religious minorities and, where necessary, places where this freedom is under pressure.
Nederland zal hier zeker aandacht besteden aan godsdienstvrijheid, de positie van religieuze minderheden en indien nodig plaatsen waar deze vrijheid onder druk staat.

Vragen van de leden Wilders en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de behandeling van christenen in het islamitische koninkrijk Saoedi-Arabië (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

PVV MPs Wilders and Kortenoeven asked the Foreign Minister about reports of Saudi religious police arresting Catholics at a Mass, the legal position of Christians in Saudi Arabia, embassy guidance for Christian Dutch nationals, and whether Saudi Arabia's treatment of Christians should be raised internationally. The minister acknowledged concern over discrimination against religious minorities, said Christians in practice must convert to obtain citizenship, stated that travellers bear responsibility for informing themselves, and said the human rights ambassador and bilateral and EU channels have raised freedom of religion.
The Netherlands regularly expresses its concern about this, both in bilateral and EU contacts and within various organs of the UN system.
Nederland spreekt regelmatig haar zorg daarover uit, zowel in bilaterale en EU-contacten als binnen diverse organen van het VN-systeem.

Vragen van de leden De Roon en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het door de Palestijnse Autoriteit bekrachtigen van de doodstraf voor de verkoop van grond aan Joden (ingezonden 22 sept

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about a report that the Palestinian Authority upheld the death penalty for selling land to Jews, and whether Jordan and the Palestinian territories have restrictive laws on land sales to Jews, Israelis and Christians. The minister answered that no death sentences in the period had involved land sales, that the cited laws do not make such sales a capital offence, that Nederland opposes the death penalty in all cases, and that Jordan repealed its ban on land sales to Israelis in 1995.
The Netherlands opposes the death penalty regardless of the offence and advocates a universal moratorium.
Nederland is tegen de doodstraf, ongeacht het delict, en pleit voor het instellen van een universeel moratorium.

Vragen van de leden Wilders en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de schandelijke uitlatingen van de Indonesische ambassadeur over PVV-leider Geert Wilders en de Nederlandse kiezers die

PVV MPs Wilders and Kortenoeven asked the foreign minister whether he would summon the Indonesian ambassador over remarks calling Wilders incompetent and his voters psychologically afflicted, and whether the ambassador spoke for his government. The minister said the ambassador spoke freely but had been told the remarks about PVV voters were unwise, that he retracted them, and that he would not summon him.
However, I did not think it wise of the ambassador to express himself in the terms he used about PVV voters.
Ik vond het evenwel niet verstandig van de ambassadeur zich in de termen zoals hij die heeft gebruikt uit te laten over de kiezers van de PVV.
Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de her-islamisering van de Turkse publieke sector (ingezonden 17 september 2010).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Turkish constitutional referendum of September 2010 and the Erdogan government's plans signal Islamisation of the Turkish state and whether Turkey should ever join the EU. The minister welcomed the reforms as bringing Turkey closer to EU standards, said the Netherlands will monitor implementation, and restated the government's position that accession depends on Turkey meeting all conditions.
The Netherlands will therefore closely monitor how the Turkish government implements the constitutional amendments.
Nederland zal daarom nauwlettend volgen op welke wijze de Turkse regering uitvoering geeft aan de grondwetswijzigingen.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de aangekondigde executie door steniging of ophanging van mevrouw Sakineh Mohammadi Ashtiani onder de verantwoordelijkhe

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister how the government judges the legal process and stoning sentence of Sakineh Mohammadi Ashtiani in Iran, and what it will do to prevent her execution. The minister answered that she appears to have had no fair trial, that the EU and the Netherlands have protested and called for a moratorium, but that Dutch diplomats cannot visit prisoners and the government does not investigate individual cases.
Information about and access to Iranian detainees is only provided to immediate family, so visiting Ms Ashtiani is not possible for foreign diplomats.
Informatie over en toegang tot Iraanse gedetineerden wordt alleen verstrekt aan directe familie en het bezoeken van mevrouw Ashtiani is derhalve niet mogelijk voor buitenlandse diplomaten.

Vragen van de leden Driessen, Kortenoeven en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat christelijke slachtoffers van de overstromingen in Pakistan met betrekking tot de hulpverlening

Three PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether Christian flood victims in Pakistan are denied water, food and aid in favour of Muslims. The minister answered that no signals of partiality had been received, that humanitarian principles require aid regardless of religion, and that he trusts these principles are applied in practice.
No signals have been received from humanitarian aid organisations, the Dutch embassy or other parties indicating partiality in humanitarian aid.
Er zijn geen signalen ontvangen van humanitaire hulporganisaties, van de Nederlandse ambassade of andere betrokkenen die duiden op partijdigheid bij de humanitaire hulpverlening.

Vragen van de leden De Roon, Kortenoeven en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de militaire opbouw in Zuid-Libanon, van de met Iran samenspannende islamitische terreur- en jihadbeweging Hezbo

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about Hezbollah's military buildup in southern Lebanon, alleged arms stockpiles, and whether the arms embargo and UNIFIL had failed under Resolution 1701. The minister answered that concern exists, that UNIFIL has no mandate to verify Hezbollah's capacity, that the embargo did not fail, and that disarmament must be pursued through the Lebanese political process.
The UN has no mandate to verify the exact capacity itself.
De VN heeft geen mandaat om de exacte capaciteit zelf te kunnen verifiëren.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven, Wilders en Driessen (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de islamitische jihad tegen christenen in de Islamitische Republiek Pakistan (ingezonden 22 juli 2010).

MPs Kortenoeven, Wilders and Driessen asked the foreign minister about killings of Christians in Pakistan, whether the violence is systematic, Pakistan's blasphemy laws, whether Pakistan should sit on the UN Human Rights Council, and whether aid should be halted. The minister denied systematic persecution, described the government's diplomatic efforts and the blasphemy laws, and refused to end development aid.

The Netherlands, in consultation with other EU countries, expressed its concern to the Pakistani government about violence against Christians and other religious minorities after previous incidents and called for the perpetrators to be prosecuted.

Nederland heeft, in samenspraak met andere landen van de EU, na voorgaande incidenten de Pakistaanse overheid zijn zorgen over het geweld tegen christenen en andere religieuze minderheden kenbaar gemaakt en opgeroepen de daders te vervolgen.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en Van Vliet (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over het Iraanse Revolutionaire Garde Korps (IRGC) (ingezonden 30 juni 2010).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers about the role of Iran's Revolutionary Guard (IRGC) in Iran's nuclear programme, whether it should be listed as terrorist, and whether Dutch firms' ties to it should be investigated. The minister said Nederland is concerned about the IRGC, that IRGC elements were included in UN and EU sanctions, and that export transactions to Iran already get extra scrutiny via licensing, without committing to a separate investigation of Dutch business ties.
Where necessary, under the applicable sanctions policy towards Iran, export transactions are already subjected to further examination.
Waar nodig worden, in het kader van het geldende sanctiebeleid jegens Iran, uitvoertransacties reeds onderworpen aan nader onderzoek.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven, Wilders, Bontes en De Roon (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de positie van oliemaatschappij Koninklijke Nederlandse Shell onder het (aan te scherpen) sanctieregime

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that Shell had halted or resumed gasoline sales to Iran, and whether Shell would receive an exemption under tightened EU sanctions. The government said Shell reported no gasoline sales since October 2009 and that a later report was based on an erroneous port inspection, and it declined to discuss individual companies in the EU Foreign Affairs Council.
The Council will not speak about individual companies.
De Raad zal niet over individuele bedrijven spreken.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven, Wilders, De Roon en Van Vliet (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over de positie van oliemaatschappij Koninklijke Nederlandse Shell onder het (aa

PVV MPs asked whether the government knows of a July 2010 letter from 22 US Congress members urging Shell to end its Iran activities and disclose them to US authorities, and whether it will urge Shell to disclose its Iran activities in the Netherlands too. The ministers answered that they know the letter, that it fits efforts for strict Iran sanctions, that Shell must answer it itself, and that Shell must account transparently to its shareholders while the government supervises compliance with EU and UN sanctions.
Shell is bound by the regulations arising from the relevant UN and European sanctions measures against Iran; it is the government's task to monitor compliance with them.
Shell is gebonden aan de regelgeving die voortvloeit uit de relevante VNVR- en Europese sanctiemaatregelen jegens Iran; het is de taak van de overheid toe te zien op naleving daarvan.
Vragen van de leden Ormel en Eski (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over veelvuldige treinstoringen op de lijn Winterswijk–Arnhem (ingezonden 18 mei 2010).

MPs Ormel and Eski (CDA) asked the transport minister about repeated train disruptions on the Arnhem–Winterswijk line, including causes, frequency, information for passengers and replacement transport. The minister answered that the faults stemmed from a new axle-counter system interacting with magnetic brakes, that a replacement part is being installed, and that ProRail acknowledged its errors and will draw lessons learned.
ProRail has publicly acknowledged its mistakes and provided me with the data needed to answer the preceding questions.
ProRail heeft haar fouten publiekelijk erkend en mij de gegevens verstrekt voor de beantwoording van de voorgaande vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Aartsen over het bericht 'Coronavirus bereikt onze winkels: producten worden duurder'

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports of higher retail prices during the early coronavirus pandemic, including whether price regulation was applied, the causes of price rises, and shortages affecting medicines and medical supplies. The state secretary answered that no overviews of price-regulating firms are known, that no concrete signs of serious consumer harm have emerged, and pointed to general economic support packages and letters on medicine supply and stockpiling.
No overviews are known to me of businesses and shops that may have applied price regulation at the start of the coronavirus pandemic.
Mijn zijn geen overzichten bekend van bedrijven en winkels die mogelijkerwijs prijsregulering hebben toegepast aan het begin van de coronapandemie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Geen zorgtoeslag door mogelijke fraude met de Basisregistratie Personen’

An SP MP asked the government about a tenant denied childcare allowance because the landlord and her child remained registered at the address in the Personal Records Database, despite a rental contract showing they did not live there. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case, citing confidentiality, explained that the tax authority may depart from the registry only when there is reasonable doubt and that a registry check is the municipality's responsibility, and promised a discussion with the policy ministries.

However, if the Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances has reasonable doubt about the accuracy of the registration (for example following an objection), it must notify the municipality so that the municipality investigates the accuracy of the registration.

Indien de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen echter gerede twijfel heeft over de juistheid van de inschrijving (bijvoorbeeld naar aanleiding van een bezwaar), dient deze hiervan melding te doen aan de gemeente, zodat de gemeente onderzoek doet naar de juistheid van de inschrijving.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over het nijpende huisartsentekort

MPs Ploumen and Kerstens asked the ministers about the worsening general practitioner shortage, including whether the duty of care can still be met, the impact on quality of care, administrative burdens, training capacity and additional funding. The minister answered that insurers have a leading role under the duty of care, that the ministry and the LHV will support regions, and that additional funds and measures such as task-shifting and digital care are being pursued, without committing to new legislation.

The Ministry of VWS and the Dutch GP association LHV will, with the help of a bureau, go into the regions to provide support and help regions increase access to GP care in both the short and long term.

Het Ministerie van VWS en de Landelijke Huisartsen Vereniging (LHV) gaan met medewerking van een bureau regio's in om ondersteuning te bieden en regio's te helpen met de toegankelijkheid van huisartsenzorg te verhogen voor zowel de korte als lange termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het datalek van het Donorregister

MP Pia Dijkstra asked the Health Minister 19 questions about the missing external hard drives holding Donorregister data, covering timing, security, notification and remedies. The minister answered that the CIBG discovered the loss in February-March 2020, notified the Data Protection Authority, is informing affected citizens, and that the Audit Dienst Rijk and the Data Protection Authority are investigating, with the findings to be shared with parliament.
I will therefore inform the House of the outcomes of the investigations by the ADR and the AP, and ask the CIBG to report any follow-up steps to me and make them public.
Ik zal de Kamer daarom informeren over de uitkomsten van de onderzoeken door de ADR en AP en het CIBG vragen om eventueel te nemen vervolgstappen aan mij te rapporteren en deze openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Gent over het bericht ‘KNLTB in beroep tegen uitspraak AP’ en ‘Boete voor tennisbond vanwege verkoop van persoonsgegevens’

MPs Heerema and Van Gent asked the ministers about the Dutch data protection authority's fine on the KNLTB tennis federation for selling personal data and its interpretation of 'legitimate interest' under the GDPR, including whether the fine was proportionate and why no alternative intervention was used. The minister answered that the GDPR is binding EU law, that the AP acts independently and cannot be instructed, that the KNLTB's appeal is pending so details cannot be given, and that the sports sector will draft new guidelines by mid-2020.
It is for the AP to impose a proportionate sanction; it makes its own independent assessment in this.
Het is aan de AP om een proportionele sanctie op te leggen, zij maakt hierin onafhankelijk haar eigen afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de dringende oproep van Per Saldo over de onzekerheden bij pgb-houders aangaande het coronavirus

An MP asked the minister how the government responds to Per Saldo's urgent call on uncertainties for personal budget (pgb) holders during the coronavirus crisis, covering protective equipment, continued payment of pgb care, the 40-hour norm, lost collective day care, natura care alternatives, and reassessment procedures for families. The minister answers that temporary measures were published, that pgb care providers will be paid until 1 June, that the 40-hour norm is being explored for temporary relaxation, and that agreed indication extensions and guidance apply, but gives no new legislative or structural change.
These agreements apply to care and support purchased with a pgb under the Youth Act, Wmo 2015, Zvw or Wlz.
Deze afspraken zijn van toepassing op zorg en ondersteuning die met een pgb uit de Jeugdwet, Wmo 2015, Zvw of Wlz wordt ingekocht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Kuik over de berichten ‘Prestatiedruk in het hoger onderwijs leidt tot misbruik ADHD-medicatie’ en ‘Braindrug modafinil is populair onder studenten, maar ‘je

CDA MPs asked the ministers of Education and Medical Care about reports of ADHD medication and modafinil misuse by students under performance pressure, and about illegal trade, monitoring, prevention and campaigns. The ministers answered that the Amsterdam study is qualitative and not representative, that a RIVM and Trimbos monitor on student mental health and substance use is underway with results expected in 2020 and 2021, that prevention measures will be considered depending on those results, and that the Health Inspectorate (IGJ) is working against illegal online trade within the limits of cross-border enforcement.
The exact scale and extent of trade in ADHD medication and modafinil is insufficiently known.
De exacte schaal en omvang van de handel in ADHD-medicatie en modafinil is onvoldoende bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Karabulut over toeristen in Nederland die vanwege het Coronavirus niet terug kunnen keren

Two SP MPs asked whether the government would act on reports that tourists in the Netherlands with expiring visas cannot return home due to coronavirus, and how many are affected. The minister said visa extensions can be requested by phone from the IND, which judges each case individually, but could not give exact numbers and does not track these cases.
In addition, the IND does not register the number of people who cannot return due to the coronavirus and who for that reason submit a request to extend a visa.
Daarnaast registreert de IND niet het aantal mensen dat niet kan terugkeren vanwege het Coronavirus en om die reden een verzoek om verlenging van een visum indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over antisemitische uitingen tijdens Ajax-PSV

MPs Kerstens, Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked the Justice and Health ministers about antisemitic chants at the Ajax-PSV match, whether they are punishable, why the match was not stopped, whether stadium bans will follow, and the status of the anti-racism action plan. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the chants were condemned, PSV stewards intervened, one person was handed to police and the public prosecutor is reviewing the file, and that the KNVB and partners are implementing the action plan including a persoonsgerichte aanpak and a smart-technology challenge.
No report is known to the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Er is geen aangifte bekend bij het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over een plantaardige voedingsaanbod in ziekenhuizen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked whether plant-based meals are available in Dutch hospitals and whether the 2025 target of the National Prevention Agreement for healthy hospital food is ambitious enough. The State Secretary answered that healthy food should be available in hospitals, that availability is likely but not verified nationwide, and that the target has been set at 2030 with the Alliance Food in Care working toward it.
The goal is healthy food offerings in all hospitals by 2030.
Het doel is gezond voedingsaanbod in alle ziekenhuizen in 2030.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over het coronavirus en onderwijs

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about school closures and childcare during the coronavirus outbreak, including whether schools should serve as childcare, whether parents may keep children home under the Compulsory Education Act, and the Inspectorate's stance. The minister confirmed that in-person teaching and childcare are suspended until 28 April with online teaching where possible, and set out exam, internship, study-advice and funding adjustments.
Until and including Monday 28 April, no on-site teaching will take place in primary, secondary, vocational and higher education, and regular childcare will be suspended.

Tot en met maandag 28 april wordt er geen les gegeven op locatie in het primair onderwijs, voortgezet onderwijs, middelbaar beroepsonderwijs en hoger onderwijs, en de reguliere kinderopvang wordt gestaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over “menstruatie-armoede in Nederland”

MPs Ploumen and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the government will tackle period poverty, including by providing free menstrual products as Scotland does. The state secretary answered that the government favours an integrated poverty approach with municipalities responsible, mentioned school sexuality education and a few municipalities exploring stadspas access, and declined to commit to free provision.
Zie hiervoor het antwoord op vraag 3.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Sneller over de lokale noodverordeningen in verband met de bestrijding van het coronavirus

Two MPs (D66) asked the ministers about the legal basis, decision-making, democratic oversight and publication of local COVID-19 emergency ordinances, and about Latvia's suspension of ECHR rights. The minister acknowledged the omitted legal basis, described the regional chairs' emergency ordinances and the accountability route via municipal councils, and said current measures fit within ECHR limitation clauses.
Omitting the legal basis was an oversight.
Het niet vermelden van de wettelijke grondslag was een omissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Schaf de zorgtoeslag af, zonder inkomenseffecten’

D66 MPs asked the government about a proposal to abolish the healthcare allowance (zorgtoeslag) and lower the nominal premium, covering income effects, costs, state-aid risk and premium competition. The minister answered at length, noting that roughly 3 million households would lose out without compensation, that the proposal is unclear on compensation and feasibility for the tax authority, and that a lower premium would require EU state-aid notification, while promising alternatives will be explored in the response to the IBO-toeslagen.
Regarding cost-awareness and the level of the nominal premium, two aspects play a role.
Met betrekking tot kostenbewustzijn en de hoogte van de nominale premie spelen twee aspecten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over homeopathische behandelingen van Covid-19 en het coronavirus

An MP asked the minister about claims that homeopathic prophylaxis protects against the coronavirus, asking what powers exist to act against such claims and the role of the IGJ. The minister agreed such claims are unacceptable, said unfounded medical claims are not permitted, noted the IGJ can investigate providers who are reported, and brought the matter to the IGJ's attention.
I have brought the matter to the attention of the IGJ.
Ik heb een en ander onder de aandacht van de IGJ gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Rog over de berichtgeving rondom het coronavirus COVID-19 via de sociale mediakanalen van de Rijksoverheid

MPs Van den Berg and Rog asked why ministry and inspectorate websites lacked school-specific COVID-19 guidance, whether schools were directly informed, and about contingency planning and school trip cancellations. The minister replied that information is centralised on rijksoverheid.nl with a school FAQ linked from the OCW and inspectorate sites, that a central contact point and daily dialogue with education sector bodies exist, and that schools closed until 6 April with contingency planning in place, while declining to provide figures on cancelled trips and referring travel refunds to schools and carriers.
No, I do not have those figures.
Nee, die cijfers heb ik niet.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'KNVB is nog niet toe aan een kopverbod'

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether football heading by children should be restricted in light of studies on head impacts and the English FA's plans, and whether the government would engage the KNVB. The minister said the research is inconclusive, that the KNVB is studying heading with AMC/VU with results expected in early 2021, and that he will await those conclusions.
I am awaiting the conclusions of the KNVB's research.
Ik wacht de conclusies van het onderzoek van de KNVB af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Foute huisarts die nooit meer spreekuur mag houden, toch weer aan het werk’

An MP asked whether the Health Inspectorate (IGJ) supervises struck-off healthcare professionals who return to practice, and whether it can search past cases and check databases. The minister answered that the IGJ investigates reports, that employers must screen applicants via the public BIG register and other registers, and that retrospective investigation is not considered useful.
The IGJ will always investigate when it receives a report that a suspended healthcare professional is performing reserved acts or wrongly uses a professional title.
De IGJ zal altijd onderzoek doen als zij een melding ontvangt dat een geschorste zorgverlener voorbehouden handelingen uitvoert of ten onrechte een beroepstitel voert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het niet vergoeden van explantatie van borstimplantaten ondanks het bestaan van een medische noodzaak

An SP MP asked why health insurers refuse to reimburse removal of breast implants for a patient despite three medical specialists confirming medical necessity, and whether the patient is entitled to reimbursement. The minister replied that assessing individual reimbursement is the insurer's task under the Health Insurance Act, that the patient can complain to the SKGZ, and that the patient apparently had the removal at a non-contracted private clinic, so full reimbursement was not provided.
It is primarily the task of health insurers to determine which care may be counted as insured care.
Het is primair de taak van zorgverzekeraars om te bepalen welke zorg tot verzekerde zorg gerekend mag worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars de revalidatiezorg het mes op de keel zetten

An MP asked the minister whether insurers' cost-cutting is squeezing rehabilitation providers, waiting lists and quality, and whether NZa tariffs are adequate. The minister responded that the NZa and insurers have been asked to act on access and tariffs will be revised for 2021, while leaving contracting largely to providers and insurers and noting existing NZa and IGJ enforcement powers.
That is why I have asked the Netherlands Competition Authority (NZa) to take the lead in ensuring that care other than COVID-19 care proceeds as well and efficiently as possible.
Daarom heb ik de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) gevraagd om regie te nemen op het zo goed en efficiënt mogelijk doorgang te laten vinden van andere zorg dan COVID-19 zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de immorele marketing door een medicijnfabrikant die is veroordeeld door de rechter

Van Gerven (SP) asked the minister about a court ruling that drug maker Boehringer Ingelheim's reimbursement-scheme letters to doctors were misleading marketing, whether doctors relied on industry-influenced studies, whether guideline committees are industry-influenced, and whether oversight of marketing is adequate. The minister answered that the ruling concerned a specific case, that the IGJ is examining the scheme and has sufficient powers, and that guideline oversight is the IGJ's task.
I have brought this to the attention of the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ).
Ik heb dit onder de aandacht gebracht van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Veel transgenders gaan zelf aan de slag met hormonen, met alle risico’s van dien’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Medical Care about press reports that many transgender people self-medicate with hormones due to long waiting lists, and about waiting times, prevention of risks, and support initiatives. The minister condemned self-medication, described ongoing efforts to shorten waiting times and expand endocrine care, and committed to follow-up research and measures against illegal online medicine sales.
I have no more recent figures on the extent to which transgender people in the Netherlands self-medicate.
Ik heb geen recentere cijfers over de mate waarin transgender personen in Nederland aan zelfmedicatie doen.
Antwoord de vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Özütok over veel transgenders gaan zelf aan de slag met hormonen, met alle risico's van dien

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about transgender people self-administering hormones because of long waiting lists, including advice, support, waiting-list reduction and data on complications. The Minister advised against self-medication, pointed to GP and support organisations, reported new endocrine care capacity and a planned 2021 follow-up study, and said GPs can take on part of the hormone follow-up.
I do not have figures on the number of medical complications among transgender persons as a result of self-medication.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over het aantal medische complicaties bij transgender personen ten gevolge van zelfmedicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over de nazorg aan slachtoffers van misbruik in de sport

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about aftercare for victims of abuse in sport, including rising reports, support measures and a possible role for NOC*NSF. The minister said reports are rising, that existing aftercare through the Centrum Veilige Sport and referral partners is sufficient, and that he is discussing further investment with NOC*NSF and the sports tribunal, while rejecting a direct role for NOC*NSF.
I am in discussion with NOC*NSF, the Centrum Veilige Sport and the Instituut voor Sportrechtspraak about the investments needed to handle the growth in the number of reports, including in the future.

Ik ben met NOC*NSF voor het Centrum Veilige Sport en het Instituut voor Sportrechtspraak in overleg over de benodigde investeringen om de groei in het aantal meldingen, ook in de toekomst, aan te kunnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over fysiotherapeuten die in actie komen tegen bemoeienis van de zorgverzekeraar

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about physiotherapists protesting against insurer interference, contracting refusals, care avoidance due to costs, the behandelindex, NZa cost research and reinstating the first twenty physiotherapy treatments in the basic package. The Minister replies that contracts are preferred but a provider's choice, that avoidance has halved to 8% and compensation measures exist, that the behandelindex stays for now, that no new NZa cost study will be commissioned, and that reinstating the twenty treatments would cost roughly 100 million euros per year as a rough estimate.

During the General Consultation of 12 September on co-payments in healthcare, I committed to commissioning research into the (effectiveness of) measures municipalities and health insurers take to counter undesired care avoidance for financial reasons among vulnerable groups.

Tijdens het Algemeen Overleg van 12 september jl. over Eigen Bijdragen in de zorg heb ik toegezegd een onderzoek uit te zetten naar de (effectiviteit van) maatregelen die gemeenten en zorgverzekeraars nemen om ongewenste zorgmijding vanwege financiële redenen onder kwetsbare groepen tegen te gaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink, Van Gerven en Marijnissen over het opkopen van een Duits bedrijf dat aan een coronavaccin werkt door de Amerikaanse president Trump om een vaccin uitsluitend voor Amerikanen te ver

MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care how she would respond to reports that President Trump sought to buy a German COVID-19 vaccine developer for exclusive US access, and how to ensure affordable, universal access to any Dutch-funded vaccine or therapy, including whether to block private sale, suspend patents and set price limits. The minister replied that CureVac denied any such offer, that the medical need should guide access, that the existing patent law and compulsory licensing options are sufficient for now, and that she supports international price negotiations and will oppose excessive prices.
It is also not my intention in this crisis to develop a vaccine publicly and, if successful, to have distribution to the world population handled by a public organisation.

Het is ook in deze crisis niet mijn voornemen om publiekelijk een vaccin te ontwikkelen en bij een eventueel succes de distributie vanuit een publieke organisatie naar de wereldbevolking te verzorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van Gerven over het bericht dat onbevoegd personeel van hulpmiddelenfabrikanten in de operatiekamers van ziekenhuizen meehelpen bij operaties

MPs Ploumen and Van Gerven asked whether manufacturer product specialists assisting in operating theatres without a patient being informed is undesirable, and whether all hospitals should be asked to map such presence. The Minister replied that product specialists may give technical support under the operating surgeon's responsibility, that informing patients is advisable but not always legally required, that the IGJ has received no such signals, and that no further survey or additional measures are planned.
I see no reason to take additional measures.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om aanvullende maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Vertrouwen tot nulpunt gedaald: ‘We zijn enorm geschrokken, SKB moet zich nu echt afscheiden’’

Two MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about the collapse of trust over a planned hospital merger in the Achterhoek (SKB Winterswijk and Doetinchem), including loss of separate works and client councils, IGJ findings, possible conflicts with NMa conditions, and whether the minister would commission an independent investigation and request sharing of withheld information. The minister answered that the hospital board is responsible for its strategy, the IGJ sees no threat to care quality, a regional picture is due in May 2020, and the board decides what information is commercially sensitive, declining an independent investigation.
No. The Board of Directors of Santiz is responsible for the business operations and strategic direction of its hospital.
Nee. De Raad van Bestuur van Santiz is verantwoordelijk voor de bedrijfsvoering en strategische koers van haar ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de naleving van coronamaatregelen door privéklinieken

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care whether private clinics (ZBCs) can manage non-urgent care during the COVID-19 crisis, whether dual-employed staff are protected, whether ZBCs are expected to add beds like in Italy, and whether they follow RIVM guidelines and how this is supervised. The minister answered that clinics postpone non-urgent procedures, share staff and equipment via ROAZ, must follow RIVM/IGJ guidelines, and that the IGJ supervises quality of care as usual.
I assume that everyone adheres to the RIVM guidelines, including the ZBCs.
Ik ga ervan uit dat iedereen zich houdt aan de richtlijnen van het RIVM, ook de ZBC’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over het artikel ‘Overleg over mogelijk tekort aan medicijnen’

SP MPs asked the minister whether the planned Wet geneesmiddelenprijzen was being postponed after pharma firms warned that low drug prices risk shortages during the coronavirus crisis, and about shortage prevention measures. The minister said options including room under the price law are being examined, that no corona-related shortages have yet been signalled, and that a further letter will follow next week.
I expect to be able to provide more insight on this next week, and I will inform you separately by letter.
Ik verwacht hier volgende week meer inzicht in te kunnen geven, ik zal u daarover separaat per brief informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge en Renkema over maatregelen tegen het Coronavirus in mbo-instellingen

MPs Van den Berge and Renkema asked why mbo vocational schools were not advised to move all non-essential activities online or cancel them, given student work in care settings and the approach taken for higher education. The minister replied that from 15 March until 6 April no on-site teaching occurs in mbo and other schools, that online teaching is used where possible, and that schools were asked to prioritise final-year students and the Cabinet is assessing consequences for individual students.
Currently the cabinet is inventorying the further consequences of COVID-19, including the consequences for individual students.
Momenteel inventariseert het kabinet de verdere gevolgen van COVID-19, waaronder de gevolgen voor individuele studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van den Berg over onbegrijpelijke ziekenhuisrekeningen

An MP asked the minister why hospital bills based on average DBC tariffs seem unrelated to treatment length and why a 9-hour and a 60-hour rehabilitation treatment can carry the same tariff band, and how insurers check tariffs. The minister defended average DBC pricing as an efficiency incentive, explained the tariff bands and insurers' audit tools, and pointed to ongoing NZa work on price transparency.
I will inform the House of the outcomes of this.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Veldman over het bericht 'Maximumsnelheid ook voor hulpdiensten omlaag: ‘Dit kan mensenlevens kosten’'

Two VVD MPs asked whether the lower daytime speed limit on motorways (100 km/h) would also apply to emergency services and, if so, how this affects response times and the OGS 2009 rules. The minister replied that emergency vehicles may still exceed the limit by up to 40 km/h, that effects on response times are expected to be negligible, that no amendment is planned, and that the effects will be monitored with the ambulance sector and the knowledge centre, with a promise to inform parliament if problems arise.
The exact effects of the speed reduction between 06:00 and 19:00 on the response times of emergency services are currently not known.
De exacte effecten van de snelheidsverlaging tussen 06.00 en 19.00 uur op de aanrijtijden van de hulpdiensten zijn op dit moment niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jansen en Van Aalst over het bericht dat hulpdiensten in de knel komen door de verlaging van de maximumsnelheid

Two MPs from the PVV asked the minister whether lowering the daytime speed limit to 100 km/h would lengthen emergency response times and endanger people in need, and whether the government would protect emergency services. The minister answered that the effects are expected to be small to negligible, that emergency services may still exceed the limit by up to 40 km/h, and that the effects will be monitored with the Kenniscentrum Voorrangsvoertuigen and adjusted if bottlenecks emerge.
The exact effects of the speed reduction between 06:00 and 19:00 on emergency service response times are currently not known.
De exacte effecten van de snelheidsverlaging tussen 06.00 en 19.00 uur op de aanrijtijden van de hulpdiensten zijn op dit moment niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema, Smeulders, Westerveld en Özütok over het coronavirus (COVID-19)

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about its whole-of-government approach to COVID-19, equipment and ICU capacity, school decisions, Caribbean Netherlands coordination, economic measures like part-time unemployment benefit, accessibility of public communication, and intensified publicity. The minister answered that broad measures are in place, outlined capacity expansions and procurement steps, and committed to letters on decision-making and a school decision framework.
During the debate of Thursday 5 March I committed to inform you about this by letter.
Ik heb tijdens het debat van donderdag 5 maart toegezegd u hierover per brief te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over een farmaceut die honderd medicijnen verloot onder baby’s met een dodelijke spierziekte

An MP asked the health minister about Novartis's lottery giving 100 free doses of the costly SMA drug Zolgensma to infants, and whether the minister would take EU-wide or sanctioning steps and demand price transparency. The minister condemned the lottery as lacking medical selection criteria, issued a joint Benelux statement and urged Novartis to revise its program, but declined further steps for now and only called on the company to disclose its pricing.
At this moment I am not considering further steps.
Op dit moment overweeg ik geen nadere stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over een door de industrie gesponsord onderzoek naar implantaten

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether industry-withheld study results on heart stents undermine informed choice, why cardiac surgeons and cardiologists diverge on the guideline, and how conflicts of interest in guideline-writing are prevented. The minister said manufacturers should not withhold unfavourable results, pointed to the EU MDR registration duties, noted the professional societies are in dialogue while patient care is safeguarded through heart-team meetings, rejected a precautionary principle citing no IGJ signals, and pointed to the voluntary Gedragscode Medische Hulpmiddelen on conflicts of interest.
I therefore do not consider it desirable that manufacturers withhold research results, whether unfavourable or not.
Ik vind het dan ook niet wenselijk dat fabrikanten onderzoeksresultaten, onwelgevallig of niet, achterhouden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Ploumen over het bericht in het programma Argos dat onbevoegd personeel van hulpmiddelenfabrikanten in de operatiekamers van ziekenhuizen meehelpen bij operaties

MPs Van Gerven and Ploumen asked the Minister for Medical Care about a Argos report that unqualified staff of medical device manufacturers assist in operating theatres. The minister answered that no specific rules apply, that existing general frameworks govern this, that the IGJ has received no reports of unauthorised involvement, and that no new specific guidelines are needed, though the IGJ will raise the issue with hospitals and a self-regulatory body will review practice.

The inspectorate has no reports of unauthorised involvement of staff of medical device manufacturers in operations, and no indications that this presence in practice prevents surgeons and other care providers from fulfilling their responsibility for good and safe care.

De inspectie heeft geen meldingen van ongeoorloofde betrokkenheid van personeel van hulpmiddelenfabrikanten bij operaties en ook geen aanwijzingen dat deze aanwezigheid er in de praktijk toe leidt dat operateurs en andere zorgverleners hun verantwoordelijkheid voor goede en veilige zorg niet kunnen invullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Acuut tekort aan medische hulpmiddelen dreigt, waarschuwt Zwolse klinisch fysicus’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports of looming shortages of medical devices, including neonatal breathing masks, and about EU device regulation delays. The minister said no specific shortage signals were received, pointed to transition periods and stakeholder dialogue, and promised to use the voluntary Eudamed modules.
I have not received any signals about these specific devices no longer being available.
Ik heb geen signalen ontvangen over het niet langer beschikbaar zijn van deze specifieke hulpmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over honden afscheid laten nemen van baasje

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Medical Care whether hospitals should have standardised conditions for allowing pets to visit dying patients, after UMCG let a dog say goodbye to its deceased owner. The minister answered that such decisions are case-by-case for hospitals and care providers, that standardisation is not desirable given the unique hospitals and person-centred care, and that rouwcentra are private organisations.
It is up to the individual care providers to consider whether they can and want to admit pets and how they fill in the preconditions for this.
Het is aan de individuele zorgaanbieders om te bezien of zij huisdieren kunnen en willen toelaten en hoe ze invulling geven aan de randvoorwaarden daarvoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over gendersensitieve zorg en het College Beoordeling Geneesmiddelen (CBG)

Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Minister of Medical Care about gender-sensitive drug research, whether the trial populations match target patients, and whether the CBG requires gender differences in medicine labels and the SmPC. The Minister answered that representative inclusion is checked during authorisation, sex differences are analysed in subgroups, and gender differences are already reflected in product information, while declining to provide counts of labels or dossiers with gender differences and citing workload.

Answering these questions would require manually reviewing very large numbers of dossiers and package leaflets; with many thousands of medicines on the Dutch market this would place a disproportionate burden on the CBG's limited capacity.

De beantwoording van deze vragen zou het handmatig doornemen van zeer grote hoeveelheden dossiers en bijsluiters vereisen; bij de vele duizenden medicijnen op de Nederlandse markt zou dit een onevenredig beslag leggen op de beperkt beschikbare capaciteit van het CBG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van Helvert, Van den Berg en Omtzigt over het coronavirus (COVID-19), dat nu in Gangelt is vastgesteld, direct grenzend aan Limburg

MPs of the CDA asked the ministers about COVID-19 cases in Gangelt near the Dutch border, cross-border coordination, quarantine and airport controls, hospital bed capacity, and travel advice. The minister answered that the GGD Zuid-Limburg coordinates with Germany, that airport controls are not considered appropriate, that at least 250 isolation ICU beds exist, and that travel advice follows RIVM risk assessments.
I will answer these questions as soon as possible.
Ik beantwoord deze vragen zo spoedig mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat ‘Frankrijk beslag laat leggen op de voorraden en productie van mondkapjes’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether he would respond to France seizing face-mask stocks and production, whether the Netherlands could take a similar measure, and whether he would answer before the debate. The minister said he lacks the legal power for such a seizure, that GGD-GHOR will coordinate distribution, and that he will raise the issue at the EU health council.
I do not have that legal authority.
Die wettelijke bevoegdheid heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de communicatie rondom de melding van de eerste coronabesmetting in Nederland

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why the first coronavirus infection was announced live during an NOS broadcast, whether the minister knew beforehand, and whether the hospital was surprised. The minister answered that the test still required confirmation and notification of the patient and family, that the announcement was coordinated with the RIVM, GGD and the hospital, and that the standard procedure was followed.
During the broadcast I was told that everyone had been informed, and I chose to make this news public.
Tijdens de uitzending kreeg ik te horen dat iedereen geïnformeerd was en heb ik ervoor gekozen dit bericht bekend te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over complicaties door onprofessionele behandelingen

MP Van Gerven asked the minister about complications from cosmetic treatments by unqualified practitioners, the role of the cosmetic doctors' meldpunt and NVPC, IGJ oversight, and measures against unqualified practice. The minister said reports should go to the IGJ, that IGJ oversight of cosmetic clinics has been intensified, and that a quality framework and competence requirements are being developed.
For that, it is crucial that cases be reported to the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ), so that the IGJ can take targeted action.
Daarvoor is het cruciaal dat voorkomende gevallen gemeld worden bij de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ), zodat de IGJ gericht actie kan ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Regelwoede pakt funest uit voor medisch onderzoek 'en is slecht voor de patiënt’’

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister for Medical Care whether strict rules for experimental medical research also apply to studies comparing existing treatments, whether these rules are in balance, why independent research has become much more expensive, and whether a clearer interpretation of privacy law (AVG) is needed. The Minister answered that the WMO applies only when extra risks or burdens are imposed, that much of the added burden stems from field standards and local interpretation rather than the law itself, that a study on lighter review for low-risk research is underway, and that a revised code of conduct for health research is being prepared by 2021 with the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Hard figures on the extent of the cost increase are, however, not known to me.
Harde cijfers over om welke toename van de kosten het gaat zijn mij echter niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Stel dat mijn kind ziek wordt, en de stamcellen zijn kwijt...’

An MP asks the minister about commercial stem cell bank Cryo-Save: how patients encounter such banks, how the inspectorate supervises them, the transfer of stored material to a Polish company, and how lost material can be traced. The minister says the inspectorate supervises under the Wvkl, that Cryo-Save's recognition lapsed in 2019, that donors were notified of the transfer, and that he has no control over material stored abroad.
I have no control over stem cell materials stored abroad.
Ik heb geen zeggenschap over stamcelmaterialen die in het buitenland zijn opgeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de aangifte tegen bekkenbodemmatjesfabrikant Johnson & Johnson

An MP asks the Minister for Medical Care whether the Public Prosecution Service should be asked to investigate Johnson & Johnson's Ethicon over pelvic floor mesh, following a Californian ruling, and what the Californian case and Australian expert testimony mean for Dutch use of such implants. The minister declines to involve the prosecutor, notes that vaginal implants are now allowed only in strictly regulated research settings, shares the view that the mesh rollout was over-rushed, and explains how patients can claim liability through general civil law.
The Public Prosecution Service itself decides whether a criminal complaint should lead to a criminal investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie bepaalt zelf of een aangifte tot een strafrechtelijk onderzoek moet leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over nieuw onderzoek naar fysiotherapie voor COPD-patiënten

The MP asks the minister for a reaction to a new study finding worse symptoms, more medication use and hospital admissions when COPD patients receive fewer physiotherapy sessions, and whether the session cap should be dropped. The minister says the study is only available as an abstract, calls on the researchers to submit the full report to the Zorginstituut, and states that any revision of the benefit is for the Zorginstituut to decide.
I therefore call on the researchers to send the full research results to the Zorginstituut for assessment.
Ik roep de onderzoekers daarom op de volledige onderzoekresultaten ter beoordeling aan het Zorginstituut te sturen.
Antwoord op van de leden Kuik, Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de uitbraak van het coronavirus.

Three CDA MPs asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about the coronavirus outbreak, including its infectiousness during incubation, passenger tracing from the Westerdam, EU coordination, travel restrictions and travel advice. The minister answered that transmission during incubation plays a very limited role per RIVM, that EU coordination runs through ECDC and the HSC, and that WHO and ECDC advise against trade or travel restrictions.
Based on the scientific knowledge of the RIVM, we assume that the new coronavirus is transmitted through coughing and sneezing.
Op basis van de wetenschappelijke kennis van het RIVM nemen wij aan dat het nieuwe coronavirus wordt overgedragen door hoesten en niezen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Paternotte over ontwikkelingen coronavirus naar aanleiding van het bericht 'Two Beijing hospitals quarantined amid fears coronavirus infections will spike in the capital'

Two D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Health and of Infrastructure and Water Management about rising COVID-19 cases in Beijing, Chinese airlines still flying to Amsterdam, and KLM selling tickets on those routes, and whether they would restrict or withdraw air transport permits. The government answered that the case numbers do not compare to Wuhan, that airline restrictions are not currently at issue on WHO advice, that airlines are responsible for their schedules, and that it will reconsider only if WHO advice changes.
I have not currently taken any decisions that lead to restrictions on aviation.
Ik heb op dit moment geen besluiten genomen die leiden tot restricties voor de luchtvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over de berichten Italië neemt drastische stappen na grote uitbraak coronavirus en Uitbraak coronavirus in Noord-Italië geen extra maatregelen in Nederland

The MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about reports of a coronavirus outbreak in northern Italy, including the epidemiological link, preventive testing, incubation period, hospital preparedness, supplies of masks and intensive care beds, medicine shortages, vaccine progress and international support. The Minister answers each question in turn, stating that current capacity and supplies are adequate, that the situation is monitored, and that certain steps such as a European procurement procedure are being explored.
I am also exploring whether the Netherlands can order a limited stock of additional protective equipment through a European tender procedure.
Ik verken daarnaast of Nederland via een Europese offerteprocedure een beperkte voorraad extra beschermingsmiddelen kan bestellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over zorgen om verantwoord wisselen medicijnen

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about concerns over safe medicine switching and whether the talks on responsible switching collapsed alongside the GVS reform, and how patients without the means to pay a co-payment could switch safely. The minister answered that parties could not agree on all points, the talks were not 'stopped' by parties walking out, that the two developments are unrelated, that a co-payment-free option will exist in each cluster, and that he will make the list of risky switches more binding and seek to avoid co-payments for strictly medical reasons.
I want to give this list a more binding character.
Ik wil deze lijst een meer bindend karakter geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het Coronavirus op de MS Westerdam

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care whether passengers of the MS Westerdam left their cabins in Cambodia against instructions, how the government learned of this, and whether those passengers are known to the GGD. The minister replied that quarantine was the responsibility of Cambodian authorities, all Dutch passengers tested negative and are being monitored by the GGD, and that quarantine in the Netherlands is not deemed necessary.
The quarantine measures in Cambodia were imposed by, and are under the responsibility of, the Cambodian government.
De quarantainemaatregelen in Cambodja zijn opgelegd door, en onder verantwoordelijkheid van de Cambodjaanse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over de ontwikkelingen rondom het Coronavirus

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Medical Care about the spread, transmission, incubation period, mortality, origin and treatment of COVID-19, and about Chinese measures in Wuhan. The minister answered that the RIVM's current evidence is provisional, gave the RIVM estimates (2% mortality, 7-day incubation), and described Dutch containment measures without addressing the underlying policy choices in depth.
I am keeping a close eye on the situation.
Ik houd de situatie nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de loting voor SMA-patiënten voor een behandeling met Spinraza

An SP MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about the lottery used by UMC Utrecht to set the order in which older SMA patients start Spinraza treatment, and why this was not disclosed earlier. The minister explains the lottery was chosen because no medical or scientific criteria could rank patients, that the order is set under notary supervision, and that the centre is working to speed up intake but cannot give a date for the last patient.
At the time of answering earlier written parliamentary questions on the conditional admission of Spinraza, nothing was yet known about how the order of patient intake would be determined.

Antwoord 3 Ten tijde van de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke Kamervragen 4 over de voorwaardelijke toelating van Spinraza was er nog niets bekend over de wijze waarop de volgorde van instroom van patiënten zou worden bepaald.
Antwoord op de eerste drie vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg, Kuik en Van Helvert over het coronavirus (COVID-19), dat nu in Noordrijn-Westfalen is vastgesteld, vlakbij Limburg

CDA MPs asked ministers for an update on new COVID-19 infections near the Dutch border, whether German schools had closed, and what advice applies to Dutch schools, firms and travellers. The Minister of Medical Care answered that contact tracing is ongoing in Germany with no need for extra Dutch measures, that German schools closing is noted, and that Dutch schools and workplaces can stay open.
The situation is being closely monitored and measures will follow if necessary.
De situatie wordt op de voet gevolgd en indien nodig volgen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over tekortkomingen van Kustwachtwachthelikopters

MPs Van den Berg and Amhaouch asked about a safety report on the Dutch coast guard SAR helicopters, crew safety, the 2016 OVV findings, crew language skills, the contracting of the Belgian operator, airworthiness oversight and callout figures. The minister referred to the attached research report and response for most substantive points, said the contractor had been awarded the contract on lowest price, placed airworthiness oversight with the Belgian aviation authority, and gave callout numbers for 2017-2019.
I refer you to the research report that I have sent you today.
Ik verwijs u naar het onderzoeksrapport dat ik u heden heb toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Hackpoging ziekenhuis Leeuwarden, NCSC vreest aanvallers in meer systemen'

An MP asked the ministers about a hacking attempt at Medisch Centrum Leeuwarden, whether the hospital should have acted on NCSC warnings about Citrix servers, and how the new data-exchange law and other hospitals are affected. The minister answered that hospitals are primarily responsible for their own ICT, supported by Z-CERT, that the MCL did not timely implement mitigating measures and is investigating, and that the law will allow information-security requirements, while declining to say how many hospitals use vulnerable servers.
Healthcare institutions are themselves responsible for their own ICT and which systems and/or servers they use.
Zorginstellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun eigen ICT en welke systemen en/of servers zij gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Huisartsenposten ’s nachts dicht in Voorhout en Alphen’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about plans to close the night-time GP posts in Voorhout and Alphen aan den Rijn and move the Leiden post to Leiderdorp, asking about consultation, travel times and access. The minister replied that GPs and insurers are primarily responsible for the organisation, that the decision is not yet final, that consultation with residents and municipalities will follow and that IGJ and NZa are monitoring, while declining to commit to keeping the posts open.
The decision to close the GP posts in Alphen aan den Rijn and Voorhout at night is therefore not for me, but for them.
Het besluit om de huisartsenposten in Alphen aan den Rijn en Voorhout in de nacht te sluiten is dus niet aan mij, maar aan hen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de passagiers op het schip Westerdam

MPs Kuik, Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked about passengers stranded on the cruise ship Westerdam in Cambodia, their information, repatriation, passenger lists, and the RIVM's earlier claim that people are only contagious once symptomatic. The minister answered that most questions were addressed in an earlier letter, that about 30 Dutch nationals have returned, that returnees are monitored by the GGD, and that current RIVM knowledge supports the incubation and transmission figures, while acknowledging the contagiousness statement as based on current evidence.
Answer 2, 3, 4, 5 and 7 These questions I have already answered in the letter to the House of 17 February.
Antwoord 2, 3, 4, 5 en 7 Deze vragen heb ik reeds beantwoord in de Kamerbrief van 17 februari jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het toenemen van de wachttijden voor levensreddende middelen

The SP MP Van Gerven asked the Minister of Medical Care about rising waiting times for life-saving drugs in the Dutch 'sluis' (gate) procedure, including Yescarta, and whether dwanglicenties or the German model should be used. The minister disputes the 410-day average, citing 340 days for completed procedures and 280 days for ongoing ones, explains the sluis criteria and the difficulty of compelling early submission, and says a commission is reviewing compulsory licensing with a reply to follow.
I cannot force a company to submit a reimbursement request in the Netherlands directly after registration.
Ik kan een bedrijf niet dwingen om direct na registratie ook in Nederland een vergoedingsvraag in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht 'Wachttijd nieuwe levensreddende medicijnen loopt op tot meer dan een jaar'

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a report that waiting times for expensive life-saving drugs in the Dutch drug-pricing 'sluis' (gate) had risen to over a year, and why the manufacturer of Yescarta has not made it available. The minister disputes the 410-day average, says the sluis is not the main cause, and offers only general monitoring and European co-negotiation options without concrete new commitments.
I have no insight into the considerations other countries make in their individual reimbursement decisions.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de afwegingen die andere landen maken bij hun individuele vergoedingsbesluiten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht 'Acuut gevaar voor zorg door tekort aan medische hulpmiddelen’

An MP asked the minister whether the EU medical device regulation risks shortages of notified bodies and devices, and what steps were taken to prevent harm to patient care. The minister answered that capacity is sufficient for now, transition periods apply, and an exemption and prioritisation tools exist, while rejecting a reporting obligation for manufacturers.
At present I foresee no major risks in the number of designated notified bodies, but I am closely monitoring the situation to prevent the availability of devices for patients from being jeopardised.
