Op dit moment voorzie ik geen grote risico’s in het aantal aangewezen notified bodies, maar ik volg de situatie nauwlettend om te voorkomen dat de beschikbaarheid van hulpmiddelen voor de patiënt in het gedrang komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Brandweer ingezet voor reanimatie’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that firefighters were deployed for a cardiac arrest in Ter Apel, asking how often ambulances are unavailable and whether closing the Stadskanaal emergency department affects ambulance availability. The minister replied that the response followed protocol, that firefighters were used because a station was nearby, that no substitute services are routinely deployed, and that extra ambulance capacity is being added as part of a regional care plan.
There is therefore no question of services being deployed as replacements; the civilian responders of HartslagNu are a valuable addition to acute care.
Er is dus geen sprake van diensten die ter vervanging worden ingezet, de burgerhulpverleners van HartslagNu zijn een waardevolle aanvulling op de acute zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over recente ontwikkelingen met betrekking tot het gebruik van rubbergranulaat bij kunstgrasvelden

An MP asked the ministers about a Rotterdam court ruling convicting a sports club for spreading rubber granules from its artificial pitch, and about how clubs can meet the duty of care, including cheaper alternatives and support for volunteer-run clubs. The government said it takes note of the ruling, that duty-of-care measures are described in sector guidelines, that clubs can get 30% subsidy for spread-prevention measures, and that research on more environmentally friendly pitches is funded with results expected in early 2021.
It is up to the competent authority to assess whether the duty of care has been properly implemented.
Het is aan het bevoegd gezag om te beoordelen of sprake is van een juiste invulling van de zorgplicht.
Antwoord op het vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Stilleggen van het dataverkeer door het Medisch Centrum Leeuwarden naar aanleiding van een hackpoging’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care how a hacking attempt on the Medisch Centrum Leeuwarden went undetected or unaddressed despite earlier Citrix warnings, and what role Z-CERT and the NCSC played. The minister answered that hospitals bear primary responsibility for their ICT security under supervision of the IGJ, that the MCL reports no data reached internal systems, that the MCL failed to apply a December workaround in time and is investigating, and that the government is exploring making Z-CERT membership mandatory with results due before summer 2020.

I consider it of the utmost importance that patient and healthcare institution data are safe, and therefore I attach importance to healthcare institutions being supported by Z-CERT when taking measures.

Ik vind het van het grootste belang dat de gegevens van patiënten en zorginstellingen veilig zijn en daarom hecht ik eraan dat de zorginstellingen bij het treffen van maatregelen worden ondersteund door Z-CERT
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht ‘MCL legt dataverkeer stil na cyberaanval’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the Leeuwarden hospital's shutdown of external data traffic after a cyberattack, its Citrix server vulnerability, and whether all hospitals have adequate protection and are connected to Z-CERT. The minister answered that patient safety was not endangered, the hospital reported it failed to apply a workaround in time, other hospitals' measures are unknown to him, and mandatory Z-CERT membership is being investigated with a progress report after the summer recess.
Healthcare institutions are themselves responsible for their own ICT and which systems and/or servers they use.
Zorginstellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun eigen ICT en welke systemen en/of servers zij gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Dik –Faber over het standpunt van het Zorginstituut Nederland over de hooggebergtebehandeling voor patiënten met ernstig astma

MPs Van Gerven and Dik-Faber asked the Minister for Medical Care about the Zorginstituut's decision to drop reimbursement of high-altitude treatment for severe asthma, including its handling of the REFRAST study, insurer authorisation delays, and whether a follow-up study and stakeholder talks will be held. The Minister defers to the Zorginstituut procedure, says it will evaluate how suited its methods are to small patient groups, notes insurers have contracted the Davos clinic for 2020, and will inform the House after talks with stakeholders.
I stand behind this procedure as I also indicated during the committee debate.
Ik sta achter deze procedure zoals ik dat ook tijdens het AO heb aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de mogelijke institutionele vooringenomenheid bij het niet vergoeden van afbouwmedicatie

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether the refusal to reimburse tapering medication shows institutional bias, citing a Wob-obtained document and comparing it to the childcare benefits scandal. The minister denies any institutional bias, states that the Zorginstituut has taken no official position, that reimbursement decisions rest with insurers subject to independent appeal, and that insurers will reimburse tapering medication case by case under the multidisciplinary guideline.
I am of the opinion that there is no institutional bias regarding the reimbursement of compounded tapering medication.
Ik ben van mening dat er geen sprake is van institutionele vooringenomenheid rond de vergoeding van magistraal bereide afbouwmedicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over de dierlijke oorsprong van het nieuwe coronavirus en de falende aanpak van de handel in bedreigde diersoorten

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked whether the new coronavirus originated from wildlife sold at a Wuhan market and whether the government will tighten import checks, ban trade in protected species and push China and the EU for stronger wildlife trade rules. The minister acknowledged possible wildlife reservoirs and the zoonotic risk but declined new import controls, a CITES evaluation, a total trade ban or a call to China, arguing there was no evidence the spread stems from animal trade.
There is no reason now to tighten supervision and enforcement of imports of animal products and animals from China.
Er is geen reden om nu tot een aanscherping van toezicht en handhaving op de import van dierlijke producten en dieren uit China over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de vergoeding van fysiotherapie bij chronische COPD

An MP asks why physiotherapy reimbursement for chronic COPD patients depends on whether they needed antibiotics or prednisone in the previous year, and whether this creates perverse incentives and access problems. The Minister answers that treatment is adjusted to current health status via GOLD severity categories, that physiotherapy is in the basic package since 2019, and that the MP's concerns about antibiotic prescribing and insurance refusals are not shared, while noting the competitive supplementary insurance market offers ample coverage.
For patients with COPD it is important that they receive appropriate care.
Voor patiënten met COPD is het van belang dat zij passende zorg krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van den Berg, Amhaouch en Omtzigt over het feit dat Italië alle vluchten tussen Italië en China heeft opgeschort

Four CDA MPs asked ministers about Italy suspending China flights, Chinese tourists with coronavirus in Italy, KLM suspending China flights, travel advice, EU coordination, quarantine of returnees, and international support for vulnerable countries. The government answered that Dutch procedures match Italy's, that EU health measures remain with member states, that it follows WHO advice against disproportionate restrictions, and that no additional Dutch funding seems necessary now.
Measures regarding health are reserved to the member states.
Maatregelen ten aanzien van de gezondheid zijn voorbehouden aan de lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de manier waarop het zorgstelsel klantvriendelijker kan worden

Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Minister of Medical Care how the health insurance system could become more customer-friendly, including mid-year switching during patient stops and transparency on insurer contracts with providers. Minister Bruins rejected mid-year switching as impractical and weakening insurers' bargaining power, and pointed to existing rules, planned research and outcome-information initiatives.
I do not agree with the proposal to make mid-year switching possible, so that someone could always go to the provider of their choice.
Ik ben het niet eens met het voorstel om tussentijds overstappen mogelijk te maken, zodat iemand altijd bij de aanbieder van zijn voorkeur terecht zou kunnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hermans en Veldman over het artikel ‘Nieuwe Wuhan-virus overdraagbaar van mens op mens’

MPs Hermans and Veldman asked the Minister of Health about a news report that the new Wuhan coronavirus spreads person to person, covering monitoring, travel advice, airport measures and preparedness. The minister answered that the RIVM monitors the situation, that airport screening is not advised, that travel to neighbouring countries need not be discouraged, and that public information and hospital isolation protocols are in place.
I have kept your House informed about the outbreak of the new coronavirus in Wuhan and elsewhere through several letters to parliament.
Ik heb uw Kamer over de uitbraak van het nieuwe coronavirus in Wuhan en elders op de hoogte gehouden middels verschillende Kamerbrieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Kuik over het Coronavirus

MPs Van den Berg and Kuik asked the government about the new coronavirus, including its mortality compared with Ebola, WHO coordination, Dutch preparedness, travel advice and European measures. The minister answered that mortality is about 2%, that the WHO declared a PHEIC, that Dutch hospitals are prepared with at least 250 isolation ICU beds, and that travel advice and monitoring are being adjusted in line with WHO and ECDC advice.
The Netherlands is well prepared and follows the advice of the WHO and the ECDC.
Nederland is goed voorbereid en volgt hierbij de adviezen van de WHO en het ECDC.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over de besnijdenis van Nederlandse meisjes in het buitenland

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the government about the cutting of Dutch girls abroad and what measures it takes to prevent and detect it. The minister answers that FGM is strictly prohibited and that prevention, reporting via Veilig Thuis, and an action agenda are being pursued, while noting that outcomes are not known and that Kenya has been raised with its authorities.
I will continue to invest in tackling FGM over the coming years together with my colleague for Legal Protection.
Ik blijf de komende jaren samen met mijn collega voor Rechtsbescherming investeren in de aanpak van VGV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het sluiten van de afdelingen van het Streekziekenhuis Koningin Beatrix

MPs Ellemeet asked whether the government accepts that the Winterswijk hospital (Santiz, formerly Streekziekenhuis Koningin Beatrix) plans to close departments despite merger promises, and how paediatrics, acute obstetrics, eating-disorder care and inter-tier cooperation will be protected. The minister answered that the merger was approved in 2016 and that the hospital board must give clarity on its implementation; acute obstetrics cannot close as the hospital is classed as sensitive, a regional working group has been set up, and the board has paused its decision on concentrating paediatrics and obstetrics.
I consider it important that the parties involved in the Achterhoek jointly go through a careful process and take the time for it.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de betrokken partijen in de Achterhoek gezamenlijk een zorgvuldig proces doorlopen en hier de tijd voor nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het artikel ‘Nabestaanden houden steeds vaker orgaandonatie tegen’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that relatives increasingly block organ donation even when the deceased registered consent, and about the planned active donor registration law. The minister acknowledged the 2019 decline in transplants, defended the role of relatives as a considered decision, and said the quality standard and training will protect the donor's wishes.
The starting point is the wish of the deceased, and this should be carried out as far as possible.
Uitgangspunt is de wens van de overledene en deze dient zoveel mogelijk uitgevoerd te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘VGZ zet succesproject huisartsen op pauze’

An SP MP asks the health minister whether he accepts insurer VGZ pausing a successful GP pilot ('Positieve Gezondheid') because it reduces hospital referrals and revenue, and how this fits national care policy. The minister says the pilot continues for 2020, further expansion will be discussed regionally, and the decision is for regional parties to agree, without the government directly overriding the insurer.
Agreements on continuing and expanding the project must be made between the care providers and health insurers involved and must fit the broader regional picture.
Afspraken over de voortzetting en uitbreiding van het project moeten tussen de betrokken zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars worden gemaakt en moet passen in het bredere plaatje in de regio.

Antwoord op vragen het lid Agema over het bericht dat het succesvolle project waarin huisartsen door meer tijd te nemen voor patiënten minder hoeven door te verwijzen, niet mag uitbreiden van de zorgverzekeraar omdat dit

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Medical Care why the VGZ insurer paused a successful GP project of more time per patient, which reduced referrals, allegedly because it costs hospitals revenue. The minister answered that the pilot continues into 2020 and possible expansion will be discussed later, and that regional coordination of Juiste Zorg op de Juiste Plek must weigh all parties' interests.
VGZ has informed me that it is not stopping the Positive Health pilot; they are waiting with the rollout.
VGZ heeft mij laten weten niet te stoppen met de pilot «Positieve Gezondheid», zij wachten met de uitrol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van den Berg over het zorginnovatieproject ‘Meer tijd voor de patiënt’ in Afferden

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care why insurer VGZ is not expanding the successful 'More time for the patient' pilot in Afferden, its cost savings, and whether the NZa monitors shifting care to Maasziekenhuis Pantein in Boxmeer. The Minister says VGZ will continue the pilot in four practices in 2020 with possible expansion later, that savings are not yet realised, and that regional data and NZa monitoring results are not yet available.
I do not yet have insight into the outcomes of the NZa monitor.
Ik heb nog geen zicht op de uitkomsten van de monitor van de NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over onvoldoende aandacht voor man-vrouwverschillen in de zorg

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether doctors and boards pay too little attention to sex-specific symptoms in women and whether gender-specific care should be evaluated under the Zorgevaluatie en Gepast Gebruik programme. The Minister said the scientific associations must update guidelines, that gender differences will be addressed in existing ZonMw research, and that insurers' role is limited because decisions are made in shared decision-making.
I see no reason to start another programme focused on gender aspects.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om nog een programma te starten wat op genderaspecten gericht is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over haperend ziekenvervoer in Overijssel

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about disrupted patient transport to hospitals in Overijssel after insurers Zilveren Kruis and Eno switched ambulance-transport provider, and whether insurers meet their duty of care and should open a dedicated phone line. The Minister said the insurers have taken measures such as extra phone lines and alternative booking options, that the supervisor NZa must judge compliance with the duty of care, and that the Minister has been in regular contact with the insurers and will not open a special line but notes an existing Vervoerslijn number.
It is up to the supervisor of health insurers, the Netherlands Authority for Consumers and Markets' healthcare arm NZa, to assess whether Zilveren Kruis and Eno have met their statutory duty of care.
Het is aan de toezichthouder op zorgverzekeraars, de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit, om te beoordelen of Zilveren Kruis en Eno aan hun wettelijke zorgplicht hebben voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Becker over de collectieve zorgverzekering van Zilveren Kruis met Milli Görüs

MPs Veldman and Becker (VVD) asked whether the Zilveren Kruis collective health insurance with Milli Görüs, which they link to Erdogan's AK party and Turkish diaspora politics, is appropriate and what care-related benefit it offers. The minister answers that the government has no evidence of unwanted foreign interference, that insurers may make collective agreements, and that the collective is under review for genuine care-related added value.
The cabinet has no information showing that the choice of this collective insurance discount involves any form of unwanted foreign interference.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie die aantoont dat er via de keuze voor deze collectiviteitskorting van de zorgverzekering sprake is van een vorm van ongewenste buitenlandse inmenging.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het op medische noodzaak ontvangen van vaccins die niet zijn opgenomen in het Geneesmiddelenvergoedingssysteem omdat de fabrikant geen vergoedingsdossier heeft ingediend

An SP MP asked why people with no functioning spleen must pay themselves for medically necessary vaccines not covered by the reimbursement system because the manufacturer never filed a reimbursement dossier. The Minister finds this undesirable, will ask the manufacturer to file a dossier, is consulting the Zorginstituut and RIVM on a broader solution, and expects to inform parliament in the second half of 2020.
I find it undesirable that people whose spleen has been removed and who depend on such a vaccination do not receive reimbursement for it.
Ik vind het onwenselijk dat bij mensen waarvan de milt is verwijderd en die aangewezen zijn op een dergelijke vaccinatie, deze niet vergoed krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over meerdere keren het eigen risico aanspreken

An MP asked the health minister whether repeated application of the eigen risico for one DBC is unjust, whether the government supports the NZa call to abolish the DBC system, and whether a proposal to charge only the first DBC's eigen risico will be implemented. The minister answered that patients should pay only once per DBC but that vervolg-DBCs cause confusion, that the government is working toward outcome-based contracting, and that the NZa will advise by summer 2020 before any change is decided.
I can well understand that this situation causes confusion among patients and I understand that they experience this as unjust.
Ik kan mij heel goed voorstellen dat deze situatie voor verwarring zorgt bij patiënten en ik begrijp dat zij dit als onrechtvaardig ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over het bericht ‘Ziekenhuis Winterswijk verliest intensive care, kinderafdeling en verlosafdeling’

MPs Van Gerven and Hijink (SP) asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that the Winterswijk hospital would lose intensive care, paediatrics and obstetrics, and whether closures were planned without proper consultation. The Minister said the hospital board must follow the consultation steps of the draft AMvB on acute care before deciding, that acute obstetrics cannot close under the 45-minute accessibility norm, and that the board has paused the decision and set up a regional group.
I have informed the Board of Directors that closing acute obstetrics in Winterswijk is ruled out for as long as these conditions are not met.
Ik heb de Raad van Bestuur ervan op de hoogte gesteld dat het uitgesloten is dat de acute verloskunde in Winterswijk kan sluiten, zolang er niet aan deze voorwaarden voldaan is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over genderspecifieke gezondheidszorg

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Medical Care about sex differences in drug trials, dosing, side effects, and hormonal contraception, and about the knowledge programme on gender and health. The minister replied that drug registration reviews show trial populations are not always representative, that subgroup analyses and SmPC information cover sex differences where clinically relevant, and that the CBG will share its review and encourage better data dissemination, without committing to a new EMA dosing requirement.
I will ask the CBG to draw attention to the importance of better disclosing the available data on drug effects in women in the EPAR and in the SmPC, where clinically relevant.
Ik zal het CBG vragen het belang onder de aandacht te brengen om in de EPAR en in de SmPC – waar klinisch relevant – de beschikbare data over geneesmiddeleffecten bij vrouwen beter te ontsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘LangeLand Ziekenhuis krijgt steun van DSW’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that insurer DSW supports LangeLand Hospital and that Menzis would not, and whether insurers should keep a hospital open and how that fits with regional care. The minister answered that Menzis still has a contract with the hospital for 2020 and denies the reports, that regional care planning is for providers and insurers, and that government involvement with financially troubled providers is limited to exceptional cases.
Health insurers have a duty of care and the Dutch Healthcare Authority supervises this.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben een zorgplicht en de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit ziet hierop toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het niet toelaten van een geneesmiddel dat vooral effectief is voor vrouwen met hartklachten

MP Ploumen asks why ranolazine, said to benefit women with angina, is not reimbursed in the Netherlands, and whether the 2010 Zorginstituut assessment still holds given sex differences in effect and new evidence. Minister Bruins answers that the Zorginstituut advised against reimbursement in 2010, that no new evidence has been submitted, that the manufacturer may request a reassessment, and that the drug is not on the Dutch market.
It is not for me to assess the effectiveness of a medicine. In this case that is for the Zorginstituut.
Het is niet aan mij om de effectiviteit van een geneesmiddel te beoordelen. Dat is in dit geval aan het Zorginstituut.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het gebrek aan volledige dekking fysiotherapie in verzekeringen

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked the Minister why no insurer offers unlimited physiotherapy cover in 2020, whether medical selection effectively excludes full cover, and how ME/CVS and rheumatism patients needing physiotherapy can be helped. The Minister rejected the premise that the situation is undesirable, pointed to a range of supplementary policies with physiotherapy cover and the Zorginstituut's ongoing advisory work, and said the answer was delayed by the need for external information.
I do not share that view. We have an extensive and solidarity-based basic package in the Netherlands.
Ik deel die mening niet. We hebben in Nederland een uitgebreid en solidair basispakket.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over straffen die collectief worden opgelegd aan groepen voetbalsupporters na het gebruik van vuurwerk door één of enkelen

An SP MP asked the Justice and Security Minister whether collective closures of football stands after fireworks by a few supporters are fair and effective, and whether he will move to individual punishment. The minister answered that such sanctions are a matter for the KNVB and clubs, that stand closures are a last resort, that effectiveness cannot be established, that he does not share the fairness objection, and that he is implementing a person-focused approach with clubs and municipalities.
Imposing penalties for such incidents is a matter between the Royal Netherlands Football Association (KNVB) and the clubs.
Het opleggen van straffen bij dergelijke incidenten is een aangelegenheid tussen de Koninklijke Nederlandse Voetbalbond (hierna: KNVB) en de clubs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘DSW wil fusie Reinier de Graaf en Haga terugdraaien’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care to respond to reports that insurer DSW wants to reverse the merger of Reinier de Graaf and Haga hospitals, and about the consequences of a further legal merger. The minister said insurers may voice views but cannot formally block a merger, that the Reinier Haga Group stopped its study into a legal merger after the medical staff withdrew trust, and that no legal merger will proceed.
The research into the precise medical, financial and organisational consequences has not been completed.
Het onderzoek naar de precieze gevolgen op medisch, financieel en organisatorisch is niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Renkema over berichten dat kwetsbare ouderen en mensen met een beperking verstoken zijn van huisartsenzorg

MPs Slootweg and Renkema asked about reports that frail elderly people and people with disabilities lack GP care, including the role of specialist elderly care physicians and physicians for people with intellectual disabilities and the cost-sharing rules. The minister answered that consultation with parties is ongoing toward a convenant, that the NZa is conducting a quickscan of contracting problems, and that GP care is not subject to the insurance deductible by design, while committing to further follow-up.
I have now asked the NZa to map, with a quickscan, the experiences with contracting SOs and AVGs in primary care.
Ik heb inmiddels de NZa gevraagd om met een quickscan de ervaringen met de contractering van de SO en de AVG in de eerste lijn in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot transgenderzorg

MPs Ellemeet and Özütok asked the Minister of Medical Care about long waiting times in transgender care, the limits of the quartermaster's approach, cross-border lessons, insurer information, a new patient survey, and underuse of the breast augmentation subsidy. The Minister acknowledged long waits, said he cannot give a date for meeting the Treek norms, and listed steps such as extending the quartermaster's mandate, asking insurers to report, and planning a new patient survey in 2021.
I share your concern that waiting times in transgender care are still very long.
Ik deel uw zorgen over het feit dat de wachttijden in de transgenderzorg nog steeds erg lang zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij inzake het bericht dat coffeeshops sportverenigingen sponsoren

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers whether coffeeshop sponsorship of sports clubs is unacceptable, whether it is already banned under the Opium Act and AHOJG criteria, and what measures will end financial ties. The minister replied that sponsorship is undesirable and can be prosecuted or enforced case by case, that no overview of sponsorship exists, and that an investigation into criminal influence in sports clubs will be carried out.
We do not have an overview of coffeeshop sponsorship of sports clubs.
Wij beschikken niet over een overzicht van de sponsoring van coffeeshops aan sportclubs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de veiligheid van en toezicht op indoor kartbanen

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about safety regulation and oversight of indoor go-kart tracks, including hospital admissions, applicable rules, liability and whether a regime is needed. The minister answered that indoor tracks outside amusement parks fall outside the WAS and no rijksoverheid supervision applies beyond the kart machines, and committed to bringing indoor tracks under the WAS and consulting the KNAF, municipalities and inspection bodies.
I want to bring indoor go-kart tracks under the WAS.
Ik wil indoor kartbanen onder het WAS brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Diertens en Paternotte over het racisme tijdens de voetbalwedstrijd FC Den Bosch – Excelsior

MPs Diertens and Paternotte asked the ministers about racist abuse of Excelsior player Ahmad Mendes Moreira at the FC Den Bosch match, the club's initial reaction, the extent of racism in sport, existing policy, sanction powers of the KNVB and clubs, and related matters. Minister Bruins answered that the abuse was unacceptable, described the monitoring figures and existing programmes, and promised to report on a joint action plan after 31 January.
At the end of January I will come together with my colleagues of J&V and SZW and the KNVB with an action plan to better combat racism and discrimination in sport.
Eind januari kom ik samen met mijn ambtsgenoten van J&V en SZW en de KNVB met een aanvalsplan om racisme en discriminatie in de sport nog beter te bestrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat forensische zorginstellingen onvoldoende gefinancierd worden

MP Van Nispen asked whether forensic care institutions are underfunded, whether three tbs clinics went to court over tariffs, and whether the ministry's tariffs fall below NZa maximums. Minister Dekker replied that DJI follows NZa maximum tariffs with some discounts, that no price negotiations took place, that the financing increase is adequate, and that a blanket 10% increase is rejected.
The tariffs applied nationally by DJI are based on the maximum tariffs set by the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa).
De tarieven die landelijk worden gehanteerd door DJI zijn gebaseerd op de maximale tarieven zoals vastgesteld door de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (Nza).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Marketingspersoneel zorgverzekeraar VGZ kon bij medische gegevens’

An MP asked the minister about reports that marketing staff at health insurers VGZ and Menzis had access to patients' medical data, and whether Menzis had taken sufficient action. The minister confirmed the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens imposed penalties on both insurers, that Menzis paid a 50,000 euro penalty payment after incomplete compliance, that the insurers have since changed their working methods, and that no evidence of actual marketing use was found.
At both health insurers, marketing staff had improperly had access to personal health data.
Bij beide zorgverzekeraars hadden marketingmedewerkers ten onrechte toegang tot persoonsgegevens betreffende de gezondheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Oorzaak gezocht bij capaciteitsproblematiek ziekenhuizen: Stijging sterfte rond geboorte baby’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether capacity problems in hospitals are behind a recent stagnation in perinatal mortality and whether acute maternity care is under pressure. The minister rejected a demonstrable link to capacity, pointed to low birth weight and preterm birth as the main risks, and committed to further action and a RIVM study reported in autumn 2020.
As I indicated in my letter to parliament of 25 November, the figures and Perined's interpretation show that the risks lie mainly with low birth weight and/or preterm babies.

Zoals ik in mijn Kamerbrief van 25 november jl. heb aangegeven, blijkt uit de cijfers en de duiding van Perined dat de risico's vooral zitten bij een laag geboortegewicht en/of te vroeggeboren baby's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het weigeren van een lesbisch stel voor KID door het Franciscus Gasthuis in Rotterdam

An MP asked whether Franciscus Gasthuis in Rotterdam refuses KID (donor insemination) to lesbian and single women, and whether this breaches equal treatment law, and what patients and government can do. The minister replied that the hospital does not offer KID and refers all women seeking it elsewhere, so no differential treatment occurs, that complaints can go to the hospital complaints officer or the College voor de Rechten van de Mens, and that he sees no reason to intervene.
Because there is no unequal treatment in this case, I see no reason to enter into consultation with Franciscus Gasthuis.
Omdat er in deze casus geen sprake is van ongelijke behandeling, zie ik geen aanleiding om met het Franciscus Gasthuis in overleg te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Parkeerkosten bij ziekenhuis rijzen de pan uit’

An SP MP asked the minister whether hospital parking fees of up to 30 euros per day are acceptable, whether the government will ensure patients know about discounts, and whether parking should be capped or profit-free. The minister answered that parking tariffs are the responsibility of hospitals and municipalities, that VWS has asked the sector to inform patients better, and that he is not planning to cap tariffs or agree profit limits.
Parking policy and tariffs are the responsibility of hospitals and municipalities.
Het parkeerbeleid en de tarieven zijn een verantwoordelijkheid van ziekenhuizen en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Slootweg over subsidie voor een nazorgsysteem

MPs Van den Berg and Slootweg asked the Minister for Medical Care why the ministry subsidised a rival aftercare system (HartslagNu) instead of scaling up Hart4all, a proven aftercare system for volunteer first responders. The minister replied that the €1 million subsidy stemmed from the De Lange amendment, required a single alerting network (now achieved) and allowed aftercare innovation, that talks with Hart4all did not yield a joint solution, and that organisations may choose their own aftercare system.
Organisations are free to choose for themselves which aftercare system they use.
Het staat organisaties vrij om zelf te kiezen van welk nazorgsysteem zij gebruik maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Özütok over het rapport 'FC Twente, Feyenoord en de Europese regels voor staatssteun'

MPs Westerveld and Özütok asked the ministers about a report claiming state aid to professional football clubs (FC Twente, Feyenoord) is unlawful and that municipalities are pressured into paying, and whether the EU Commission and national rules adequately police this. The Minister rejects the claims of coercion and unfair advantage, says anyone can complain to the Commission and that the Commission can act ex officio, and explains that municipalities are primarily responsible for state-aid compliance, with the Rijk supporting this through a knowledge centre, but commits to no new action.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over de sluiting van een afdeling in het OLVG Oost door personeelstekort

MPs Ploumen and Kerstens asked the minister why the OLVG Oost hospital closed its haematology and oncology ward due to staff shortages, what the consequences for patients and quality of care are, whether the ministry was informed beforehand, and whether it will address housing and pay conditions for care staff. The minister confirmed the closure, said care remains available nearby at OLVG West within 10 km, said the ministry was not informed beforehand since insurers hold the duty of care, and pointed to housing priority schemes, existing pay funds and the Werken in de Zorg programme without committing to new funds.
The health insurer has a duty of care and is therefore responsible for providing accessible, good-quality care.
De zorgverzekeraar heeft zorgplicht en is daarmee verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van toegankelijk en kwalitatief goede zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Gerven over de prijsverhoging van glycopyrroniumbromide (Sialanar®)

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the sharp price increase of Sialanar, a registered glycopyrronium bromide drink, whether pharmacies may still supply compounded versions, and whether the manufacturer should be held accountable. The Minister answered that collegial supply of compounded drinks is allowed only where patients medically cannot use Sialanar, that the price difference reflects registration costs, and that he will monitor pricing but will not restrict registration of compounded products.
I think it is a good thing when a preparation is registered; a registered product is preferred.
Ik vind het een goede zaak als een bereiding geregistreerd wordt, een geregistreerd product heeft de voorkeur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een leerling-zweminstructeur die wordt verdacht van ontucht met minderjarigen

An MP asked the ministers whether a swim instructor suspected of sexual misconduct with minors should have had a VOG, whether mandatory VOGs should apply to swim instructors, and whether clubs should be checked and inform parents. The minister condemned the conduct, declined to discuss the individual case during the criminal investigation and for privacy, and rejected a statutory VOG obligation for the sector while promoting voluntary VOG use within integrity policy.
Due to the privacy of the person concerned, I cannot answer these questions. Moreover, the criminal investigation is still ongoing.
In verband met de privacy van de betrokkene kan ik deze vragen niet beantwoorden. Bovendien loopt het strafrechtelijk onderzoek nog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Laboratoriumtest: Mogelijk kankerverwekkende minerale olieresten in babymelk van Neolac, Hero Baby en Nutrilon’

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the ministers whether test results showing possibly carcinogenic mineral oil residues in baby formula from Neolac, Hero Baby and Nutrilon warranted recall, NVWA removal from shelves, company proof of safety and statutory maximum limits. Minister Bruins answered that the NVWA is investigating and companies must trace the contamination source, that EFSA cannot yet make a solid risk assessment, that recall and shelf removal are not warranted for now, and that Dutch efforts for EU maximum limits are ongoing.
In this case there are so many uncertainties about the reliability of the method and its conclusions that an order to recall products is not appropriate.
In dit geval zijn er zoveel onzekerheden over de betrouwbaarheid van de methode en de conclusies daaruit, dat een aanwijzing om producten terug te roepen niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Operatienormen: dat moet beter!’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care how to respond to a report that several hospitals narrowly missed surgical volume norms, and whether such norms reflect care quality, whether reimbursement or hospital comparisons need changing, and what role the Inspectorate and the minister have. The minister answered that volume norms are a valid quality measure, that norms are averaged over three years so hospitals are not penalised for short-term dips, that the existing reimbursement system does not block good care, and that the Inspectorate will address cooperation and training where care is at risk.
There is no question of hospitals not complying with the relevant norms.
Er is geen sprake van dat ziekenhuizen zich niet houden aan de betreffende normen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Dik-Faber en Van den Berg over het werkbezoek aan het Emma Kinderziekenhuis

MPs asked the minister about problems chronically ill young people face when transitioning to adult care, including loss of parental involvement, financial burdens and DBC billing limits, and about a transition unit and AVG care billing. The minister acknowledged transition challenges, said care providers and insurers should make tailored agreements and that NZa is handling AVG billing, but did not commit to a new transition unit pilot or funding.
I will make inquiries about this in the relevant consultations, such as the regular consultation with the Dutch Federation of University Medical Centres (NFU).
Ik zal hiernaar in de daarvoor in aanmerking komende overleggen, zoals in het reguliere overleg met de de Nederlandse Federatie van Universitair Medische Centra (NFU), navraag doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over borstvergrotingen pillen

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about food supplements sold as breast enlargement pills whose long-term health effects are unknown, and about why the NVWA has not acted despite reports to Lareb. The minister answers that the NVWA can only act if a product is shown to be harmful, that EFSA found no evidence of harm at the concentrations tested, and that a RIVM literature review has been commissioned with possible follow-up steps and a letter to parliament in spring.
Depending on the outcome of this, I will look at possible follow-up steps.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomst hiervan kijk ik naar mogelijke vervolgstappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de documentaire TURN!, 2Doc, 8 oktober 2019

MP Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the 2Doc documentary TURN! showing very young gymnasts pressured into intense training, and about safe-sport oversight, pedagogical training, parental information and complaint channels. The minister acknowledged concern, pointed to the Centrum Veilige Sport, KNGU reforms and the Sportakkoord, and committed to informing parliament on the centre's progress next year, while leaving most responsibility with sports bodies and clubs.
I will inform you next year, before the committee meeting, in more detail about the progress of the Centre for Safe Sport.
Ik zal u volgend jaar voorafgaand aan het AO nader informeren over de voortgang van het Centrum Veilige Sport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de brandbrief van werkgevers en vakbonden in de apothekersbranche

MP Van Gerven asks the Minister for Medical Care about a joint letter from pharmacy employers and unions on wages and market-based financing, including insurer claims on volume growth, vitamin D switching, and whether a subscription tariff should be introduced. The Minister says wage bargaining is for social partners and insurers, declines to compare insurer tariffs or assess tariff cuts, notes some vitamin D prescribing concerns and promises talks with parties, and sees no reason to change pharmacy funding.
However, I am not a party to the negotiations on tariffs between health insurers and (collectives of) pharmacies and do not wish to intervene in the private-law negotiations.
Ik ben echter geen partij in de onderhandelingen over tarieven tussen zorgverzekeraars en (collectieven van) apotheken en wil niet treden in de privaatrechtelijke onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over glucosesensoren

An MP asked the Minister whether he had seen a Kassa broadcast and an article on eligibility rules for continuous glucose monitoring, and whether he would ask the Zorginstituut to re-examine CGM reimbursement. The Minister answered that FGM and rt-CGM are already reimbursed for eligible patients, that he wanted to await the Ronde Tafel quality standard and the Zorginstituut's FGM assessment first, and that following two adopted motions he will now ask the Zorginstituut for a separate study on broader CGM reimbursement.
In accordance with the motions, I will put such a question to the Zorginstituut.
Conform de moties zal ik het Zorginstituut een dergelijke vraag voorleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Ruime meerderheid van Q-koortspatiënten ontevreden over zorg’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a report showing most Q-fever patients are dissatisfied with care, with large impacts on health and work. The minister acknowledges the suffering, points to existing research funding, screening, an updated QVS guideline and a single point of contact via Q-support, but offers no new binding measures beyond ongoing reviews.
To improve care for patients with chronic Q-fever, I have, in addition to stimulating more research, instructed the detection of patients with undiscovered chronic Q-fever.

Om de zorg voor patiënten met chronische Q-koorts te verbeteren heb ik, naast het stimuleren van meer onderzoek, opdracht gegeven om patiënten met een nog niet ontdekte chronische Q-koorts op te sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het stoppen met het herindicatie circus voor mensen met een chronische aandoening of een beperking

MPs Bergkamp, Raemakers and Slootweg asked whether the one-time diagnosis rule for chronically ill people (no repeated reassessments) would apply equally to Wmo and Jeugdwet support, and what would be done about repeated re-indication for blind people and people with disabilities. The minister answered that the Zvw change covers only health insurance, that Wmo and youth support require individual assessment, and that the VNG will survey municipal practice without a uniform legal change.
For young people with a disability, the need for help will change over time, and it is desirable to reassess the required help to best match their needs.
Voor jongeren met een beperking zal met het verstrijken van de tijd de hulpvraag veranderen en is het wenselijk de benodigde hulp opnieuw te inventariseren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de 500 banen die verloren raken bij drie ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the health minister about the loss of roughly 500 jobs at three Treant hospitals in Drenthe and Groningen, including whether forced dismissals are excluded and whether the sector's finances are to blame. The minister said forced dismissals are off the table, pointed to workforce and demand challenges beyond finance, declined state financial support for now, and described transition pools and voluntary departure schemes.
Treant has since spoken with the trade unions and forced dismissals are off the table.
Inmiddels heeft Treant met de vakbonden gesproken en zijn de gedwongen ontslagen van tafel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat antidepressiva vaak off-label wordt voorgeschreven

An SP MP asks the minister about reports that antidepressants are often prescribed off-label, about informed consent, under-reporting of side effects, effectiveness, tapering and advertising. The minister replies that off-label prescribing is permitted under guidelines and informed-consent duties, that the RIVM has documented the issues, and promises a round table on tapering and to raise prescribing and tapering with professional groups, but rejects a full advertising ban and an opiate-style action plan.
I will therefore ask the relevant professional groups to pay special attention to the need for responsible prescribing and tapering of antidepressants.
Ik zal daarom aan de betrokken beroepsgroepen speciale aandacht vragen voor de noodzaak van het verantwoord voorschrijven en afbouwen van antidepressiva.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de prijsverhoging van Fampyra

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why the price of Fampyra rose 64% from October 2019, whether the pricing process was flawed, and what counts as a reasonable price. The minister answered that the price is in line with earlier pricing, stays under the Wgp maximum, and that no further price measures are warranted, so the price rise does not affect patient access or co-payments.
Because I see no reason for further price regulation of Fampyra, I also see no reason to investigate production costs and profit margins.
Omdat ik geen aanleiding zie voor nadere prijsregulering van Fampyra (zie mijn antwoord op vraag 3 zie ik ook geen aanleiding om onderzoek te doen naar productiekosten en winstmarges.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Streep door gehate wet over rol verpleegkundigen’

An MP asked whether employers may unilaterally introduce functiedifferentiatie (differentiation of nursing roles) and whether the related research should proceed without nurses' involvement, and asked the minister to halt it. The minister answered that the statutory BIG-II regulation has been shelved for lack of support, that employers may develop their functiegebouw in consultation with works councils, and that the research involves nurses closely, so no halt is needed.
The statutory regulation has now definitively been taken off the table due to the lack of support for it.
Inmiddels is de wettelijke regeling definitief van tafel, wegens het ontbreken van draagvlaak hiervoor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over de patiëntenstop van Zilveren Kruis-verzekerden bij ziekenhuisgroep ZGT

MPs Ploumen and Kerstens asked the Minister for Medical Care about a patient stop imposed by hospital group ZGT on Zilveren Kruis insured patients, its consequences for access and quality, and what could be done for affected patients. The minister answered that referrals of Zilveren Kruis patients with new elective care needs are temporarily routed to insurer-brokered care, that this is a matter between the parties under the care duty which the NZa monitors, and that he is watchful but not directly worried about recurring patient stops.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Meerjarig onderzoek naar functiedifferentiatie verpleegkundigen van start’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a multi-year research project on functional differentiation of nurses, its timing relative to the stalled BIG-II bill and the ongoing Rinnooy Kan exploration, and nurses' trust and pay. The minister replied that the research stems from a 2018 hospital-sector agreement, is complementary to the bill, will involve nurses, and that pay is set by sector parties with additional funds and the Werken in de Zorg programme.
That such a study would take place was already reported in my letter to parliament of 4 June 2018.
Dat een dergelijk onderzoek zou plaats gaan vinden is reeds gemeld in mijn kamerbrief van 4 juni 2018
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het actief tegenwerken van het Zorginstituut Nederland, de NVvP en zorgverzekeraars van vergoedingen van taperingstrips

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about alleged obstruction by the Zorginstituut, the NVvP and health insurers regarding reimbursement of tapering strips for antidepressant withdrawal. The Minister answers that the Zorginstituut's internal remarks are not official positions, that insurers decide reimbursement under the rational pharmacotherapy criteria, and that he sees no reason to doubt the Zorginstituut's independence.
I have no reason to doubt the independence of the Zorginstituut.
Ik heb geen redenen om te twijfelen aan de onafhankelijkheid van het Zorginstituut.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het fiscaal aftrekken van de kosten voor het telen van eigen cannabis

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a Supreme Court ruling that home-grown medicinal cannabis costs are tax-deductible when prescribed, and what it means for home-cultivation policy, police enforcement and local triangle agreements. The minister answered that the ruling is a tax matter only, does not change criminal enforcement or pharmacy-based medicinal cannabis policy, and that local triangles set their own priorities, and gave an update on the research motions.
The Supreme Court ruling changes nothing about the fact that cultivating cannabis is prohibited under the Opium Act.
De uitspraak van de Hoge Raad verandert niets aan het feit dat het telen van cannabis op grond van de Opiumwet is verboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het manifest van Ieder(in) en de Vereniging Gehandicaptenzorg Nederland (VGN) over de toegang tot huisartsenzorg voor mensen met een beperking

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Health about a manifesto by Ieder(in) and VGN reporting that growing numbers of people with intellectual disabilities receiving Wlz care are being refused or dropped by GPs and GP posts, and about the LHV guideline excluding Wlz clients in institutions from basic GP care. The Minister acknowledged the signals, said he finds problems with access to medical-generalist care undesirable, commissioned an NZa study due early 2020, and reported a 15 October 2019 meeting with stakeholders agreeing short- and long-term actions, with a fuller approach promised by year-end.
I commissioned the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) at the end of August to research the signals about declining accessibility of medical-generalist care for this patient group.
Ik heb de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) eind augustus een opdracht gegeven om onderzoek te doen naar de signalen over afnemende toegankelijkheid van de medisch-generalistische zorg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over de rol die transferverpleegkundigen en transferbureaus spelen in persoonsgerichte zorg

Two D66 MPs asked about the role of transfer nurses and transfer agencies in person-centred care, including staff numbers, opening hours, and coordination with municipalities under the Wmo. The minister said there is no good overview of transfer nurse numbers, that the sector is mainly hospital-based, and that he will ask V&VN and VNG about local agreements with municipalities.
There is no good overview of the number of transfer nurses and the number of full-time equivalents.
Er is geen goed overzicht van het aantal transferverpleegkundigen en het aantal fte's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het inspectierapport over het onderzoek naar - en de toepassing van de cryoballon Arctic Front in het Erasmus Medisch Centrum in de periode 2005-2007

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why the inspectorate report gives a 2001 CE-marking date for the Arctic Front cryoballoon when press and a witness say July 2005, whether the device was used only at Erasmus MC, whether patients were informed, and whether the Manusama and German studies undermine the inspectorate's conclusions. The minister acknowledged the 2005 date (the 2001 date referred to an earlier device), said the inspectorate's conclusions are unaffected, and agreed that informed consent would have been preferable under the WMO for a study-like use.
I have no information on this other than what is stated in the inspectorate report.
Ik heb hierover geen andere informatie dan in het inspectierapport staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Driekwart ziekenhuispersoneel overweegt vertrek’

An MP asked the minister for health about a report that three quarters of hospital staff are considering leaving, and about pay, workload and work-life balance, the failure of the Werken in de Zorg action programme to reduce departures, and whether the minister will take concrete measures. The minister acknowledges the problems, points to regional exit research, sector-wide cao negotiations and existing funding, but gives no new concrete extra pay measures.
I hope that they, as in other care sectors such as the UMCs, GGZ, youth care and VVT, manage to reach good agreements that contribute to this.
Ik hoop dat ze net als in andere sectoren in de zorg, zoals de UMC’s, GGZ, Jeugdzorg en VVT, lukt om tot goede afspraken te komen, die hieraan bijdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de negatieve gebruikservaringen met Amfexa

MP Van Gerven asks the Minister of Medical Care about patients' negative experiences after being forced to switch from compounded dexamphetamine to Amfexa, whether medical necessity for compounding applies, and whether 2.5 mg doses should remain available. The Minister says switching between same-active-ingredient drugs is generally unproblematic, that individual cases must be judged by the prescriber or pharmacist, that compounding is allowed only for medical (not financial) reasons, and that reimbursement is for the insurer to assess.
I cannot do that. As mentioned above, it is for the prescribing physician or dispensing pharmacist to judge whether a registered medicine can be used in individual cases.

Ik kan dat niet doen. Zoals hierboven vermeld, is het aan de voorschrijvend arts of afleverende apotheker om te oordelen of al dan niet met een geregistreerd geneesmiddel kan worden uitgekomen in individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht dat transgenderzorg wordt belemmerd door een monopolie

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the minister about reports that a monopoly position of Amsterdam UMC hinders transgender care and about waiting times exceeding two years. The minister acknowledges the waiting times, points to a care coordinator's efforts to reduce them and expand capacity, and says he sees no evidence of deliberate discouragement by Amsterdam UMC.
I agree that everyone in the Netherlands is entitled, within the existing norms, to the care included in the basic package of the Health Insurance Act.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat iedereen in Nederland binnen de daarvoor bestaande normen recht heeft op de zorg die in het basispakket van de Zorgverzekeringswet zit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over voorwaardelijke toelating van Spinraza tot het basispakket

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care for a progress update on conditional reimbursement of Spinraza for SMA, a possible start date for treatment, whether financial negotiations are delaying it, and a message for affected patients. The minister says preparations continue, the target is starting the first patients by 1 January 2020, a covenant is expected in November, and he will inform parliament once Spinraza is formally proposed.
Once the covenant is completed and Spinraza is proposed as a definitive candidate for conditional admission, I will inform you further in line with the standard procedure.
Zodra het convenant is afgerond en Spinraza als definitieve kandidaat wordt aangedragen voor Voorwaardelijke Toelating zal ik u conform de standaardprocedure nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over de kwantificering van zorgkosten

PVV MPs asked the government to quantify health and care costs attributable to (non-Western) immigrants, premium arrears, and targeted programmes. The minister answered that no breakdown by migration background is available for most items, gave an estimate of about 2.2 million euros for medically necessary care to uninsured non-Western-background residents, and pointed to other sources for cost differences.
We have no insight into what share of care costs is spent on Dutch residents with a migration background.
We hebben geen inzicht in welk deel van de kosten van zorg wordt aangewend voor Nederlanders met een migratieachtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over misleidende reclame van e-sigaretten

The MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the state secretary about misleading advertising for e-cigarettes, online sales without age checks, flavours appealing to youth, and whether plain packaging and warnings should be introduced sooner. The state secretary answered that plain packaging for e-cigarettes is planned for 2022, that the NVWA supervises advertising and age verification, and that further studies and measures are underway.
That is why the prevention accord includes that plain packaging for e-cigarettes will be introduced in 2022.
Daarom is in het preventieakkoord opgenomen dat in 2022 neutrale verpakkingen voor e-sigaretten worden ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de reden van de vertraging bij de evaluatie van het Transparantieregister Zorg

Rep. Ploumen asked why the evaluation of the Transparantieregister Zorg (healthcare transparency register) was delayed beyond the promised summer 2019, its research questions and methodology, and whether it could be sent before the budget debate. Minister Bruins answered that the evaluation by IVM takes longer than planned, the results are expected before the Christmas recess, and he provided the research questions and design.
The evaluation unfortunately takes more time than was planned.
De evaluatie neemt helaas meer tijd in beslag dan gepland was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht dat medische hulp voor - en onderzoek naar mensen met niet-westerse achtergrond achterblijft

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Medical Care whether symptoms of conditions more common in non-Western populations are missed by doctors, whether funding and attention for non-white diseases is insufficient, and what the ministry is doing about it. The minister replied that the ministry does not distinguish between white and non-white conditions, points to existing rare-disease policy, European reference networks, research programmes and patient-organisation subsidies, and does not commit to new targeted measures.
The ministry has no insight into the time and attention devoted to non-white conditions, because policy does not distinguish between these conditions.
Het ministerie heeft geen zicht op de tijd en aandacht die naar niet-witte aandoeningen gaat, omdat er in het beleid geen onderscheid gemaakt wordt tussen deze aandoeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over anticonceptie in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about access to contraception, including whether it should be covered by the basic health insurance package, and about costs and usage figures. The minister answered that contraception is covered up to age 21, that cost is not a reason to restrict access, that no data exist on several requested figures, and that the cost of adding all methods to the package would run to tens of millions of euros.
There are no exact figures, but the report Sexual Health in the Netherlands 2017 gives percentages for the use of the various contraceptive methods.
Er zijn geen exacte cijfers, maar in het rapport Seksuele Gezondheid in Nederland 2017 worden wel percentages gegeven over gebruik van de diverse anticonceptie methoden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht 'Huisartsenposten zien toename agressie door patiënten'

An MP asked the Minister about reports of rising patient aggression against GP out-of-hours services, including aggression statistics, protocols, sanctions, and comparisons with other countries. The Minister answered that police do not record these incidents separately, that existing guidance and the Eenduidige Landelijke Afspraken apply, and that a joint sector review of aggression prevention will report by end 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Jaarlijks 220 doden door het slikken van zware pijnstillers’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that 220 people die yearly from strong painkillers such as oxycodone, and whether advertising bans, litigation risks, support for victims and enforcement against manufacturers are needed. The minister says the figure includes other substances, points to planned measures on information, prescribing guidelines, research and early detection, and holds that existing advertising rules are sufficient for now.
I therefore announced measures in February of this year to reduce problematic use of these medicines.
Ik heb dan ook in februari van dit jaar maatregelen aangekondigd om het problematisch gebruik van deze middelen terug te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het VGZ-contracteerbeleid 2020 en verder met betrekking tot de antistollingszorg door trombosediensten

An SP MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about insurer VGZ's plan to tender anticoagulation (trombosezorg) together with first-line diagnostics in combined regional lots, and about quality, safety and inspection concerns raised with the IGJ. The Minister confirms the facts, says regional cooperation is needed and that VGZ must meet quality criteria and its care duty, and says the IGJ is examining the report and the NZa oversees the insurer's duty of care, without committing to halting the tender.
The IGJ has taken this report up as a signal for review.
De IGJ heeft deze melding als signaal in behandeling genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Peters en Van den Berg over het gebruik van melatonine als slaapmiddel

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister about calls by about 500 scientists to make melatonin prescription-only, its sale and youth use, the rules under which it is sold, and whether labelling and enforcement are adequate. The Minister answered that melatonin products of 0.3 mg or more are treated as medicines by the IGJ, that jet-lag products sold without prescription are not approved for children, that enforcement is being intensified, but that he does not support making all melatonin prescription-only.
From September the IGJ is intensifying enforcement against unregistered medicines containing melatonin, based on a previously drawn-up enforcement plan that has recently been completed.
De IGJ intensiveert vanaf september de handhaving van niet-geregistreerde geneesmiddelen met melatonine, op basis van een eerder opgesteld handhavingsplan dat recent is afgerond.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat het Amsterdam UMC doorgaat met de invoering van functiedifferentiatie onder verpleegkundigen (wetsvoorstel BIG-II), ondanks de oproep een pas op de plaats te mak

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care how he views Amsterdam UMC continuing to introduce nursing function differentiation and the regieverpleegkundige role despite his call to pause, and whether he will act against employers who do not pause. The minister replies that the pause concerned the BIG-II bill, not employers' internal job structures, that he has appointed an explorer and will inform the House soon, but that he will not monitor or intervene with individual employers.
Creating positions is a matter for employers and must therefore be seen separately from the bill.
Het creëren van functies is een aangelegenheid van werkgevers en moet dan ook los worden gezien van het wetsvoorstel
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de minister de fabrikant Leadiant ter verantwoording heeft geroepen vanwege het 500 maal zo duur maken van het geneesmiddel CDCA

An SP MP asked whether the minister's open letter urging pharma companies to be transparent about drug pricing was aimed at Leadiant, which raised the price of the drug CDCA 500-fold, and what concrete steps would follow. The minister confirmed the talks concern Leadiant, asks it for a transparent price explanation, and says further steps are possible if it refuses, while pledging continued engagement with industry and international agenda-setting.
Should the company not be willing to do so, I will consider follow-up steps of various kinds.
Mocht het bedrijf hier niet toe bereid zijn dan zal ik mij beraden op vervolgstappen van diverse aard.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Omtzigt over de sluiting die dreigt voor de spoedpost van de huisartsendienst Twente-Oost

MPs Van den Berg and Omtzigt asked whether the Medisch Spectrum Twente hospital's rent increase, withdrawal of nurses and cooperation changes effectively force closure of the Oldenzaal out-of-hours GP post, and asked about catchment data, regional needs and stakeholder consultation. The minister answered that the post is not financially viable, that partial or full closure is under discussion with a final decision pending, that the RIVM accessibility norm remains met, and that SHT has been asked to hold an information meeting for residents before deciding.
In my view, SHT should organise an information meeting for residents so they can voice their concerns and suggestions before a final decision is taken.

Naar mijn mening zal de SHT een informatiebijeenkomst voor inwoners moeten organiseren om de inwoners de gelegenheid te geven hun zorgen en suggesties te uiten, voordat er een definitief besluit genomen wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over etikettering van producten afkomstig uit de Palestijnse gebieden

MPs Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked how the Netherlands enforces labelling of Israeli-occupied-territory products, whether the Ten Broeke motion and the Commission interpretive notice are being followed, and whether the 'Palestine' origin label implies recognition of a Palestinian state. The government answered that the NVWA follows the Commission notice, applies a warning policy, awaits a CJEU ruling, and that the footnote means the label does not imply recognition, which is unchanged.
The cabinet honours European agreements and the NVWA acts in line with the guidance in the Commission interpretive document mentioned above.
Het kabinet komt Europese afspraken na en de NVWA handelt conform de aanwijzingen uit het bovengenoemd interpretatiedocument van de Europese Commissie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de uitzending van De Monitor over ICT in de zorg

MP Hijink (SP) asks the Minister for Medical Care how the government will respond to a broadcast on ICT in healthcare, including the market power of EPD vendors Epic and Chipsoft, their profits, and poor data exchange between hospitals. The Minister says the government will help the sector bundle its negotiating power, relies on the ACM for competition oversight, opposes excessive vendor profits in principle, and commits to legislation mandating electronic data exchange and open systems in 2020.

In December 2018 I already announced that I would take the lead in accelerating the establishment of electronic data exchange in healthcare, including by making electronic data exchange legally mandatory.

In december 2018 heb ik daarom al aangekondigd regie te nemen op het versnellen van de totstandkoming van elektronische gegevensuitwisseling in de zorg, onder anderen door het wettelijke verplicht stellen van elektronische gegevensuitwisseling
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘ Verzekeraars mogen ouders wél informeren over tandartsbezoek kind‘

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care whether insurers may inform parents when children miss dental visits, how to raise the 600,000 children who never visit a dentist, and whether adult dental care should return to the basic package. The minister welcomes the Dutch data protection authority's clarification that such letters are permitted, commits to talks with insurers and a round table on children's oral health, but rejects restoring adult dental care to the basic package on cost grounds.
I am glad that the Dutch Data Protection Authority provided clarity in such a short time on whether health insurers may write to parents of children who do not go to the dentist.

Ik ben blij dat de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) op zo’n korte termijn duidelijkheid heeft gegeven op de vraag of zorgverzekeraars gericht ouders van kinderen mogen aanschrijven als deze niet naar de tandarts gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de huisartsenpost in Limburg die onder druk komt te staan

An MP asked the minister about shortages of GP assistants and practice support staff in Limburg, the impact on care quality, recognition of the profession and the limited number of training internships. The minister said insurers and regional actors are working on solutions, the inspectorate has received no reports on this, and the government is funding internships and a regional workforce programme.
Enquiries with the IGJ show that the inspectorate has so far received no signals in which a shortage of GP assistants is mentioned.
Navraag bij de IGJ leert dat bij de inspectie tot nu toe geen signalen zijn binnengekomen waarbij een tekort aan doktersassistenten wordt genoemd.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat mensen onvoldoende op de hoogte zijn om een passende zorgverzekering te kiezen

Ploumen asked the health minister how to ensure people are properly informed about the 2020 cut in the maximum collective discount for health insurance and whether they are overinsured with collective policies. Minister Bruins answered that insurers and comparison sites bear primary responsibility, that the government provides general information and campaigns, and that the NZa supervises compliance.
I have called on health insurers to inform their policyholders about the reduction of the maximum collective discount from 10% to 5%.
Ik heb zorgverzekeraars opgeroepen om hun verzekerden te informeren over de verlaging van de maximale collectiviteitskorting van 10% naar 5%.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Wachtlijsten dreigen in ziekenhuiszorg’

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about reports of waiting lists and overcrowding in hospital care, the financing of hospital transformation, flu-season preparedness and whether performance-based funding hinders 'the right care in the right place'. The minister acknowledges waiting times as a recurring concern, points to supervisory monitoring, the transformation fund and regional flu plans, and rejects the claim that performance-based funding is an obstacle, while promising further analysis of insurer contracts and a later NZa update.
The supervisory authorities closely monitor the quality and accessibility of care.
De toezichthouders houden de kwaliteit en toegankelijkheid van zorg nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het Kamerlid Ellemeet over de BIG-II

An MP asks the health minister about a union survey rejecting functiedifferentiatie in law, vacancies for regieverpleegkundige excluding mbo-trained nurses, staff turnover, and whether the transitional scheme of the BIG-II bill should be withdrawn. The minister answers that the survey is not representative, that employers decide vacancy requirements, that the transitional scheme's effect on turnover is being studied, and that Rinnooy Kan's advice on the bill is awaited in October 2019.
I will await the results of this exploration and will then consider how to deal with the draft bill BIG II
Ik wacht de resultaten van deze verkenning af en zal dan bezien hoe om te gaan met het concept wetsvoorstel BIG II

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het toenemende aantal signalen dat werkgevers in de zorg vooruitlopen op het (nog niet ingediende en mogelijk nooit ingediend wordende) wetsvoorstel BIG-II

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that employers in healthcare are acting as if the draft BIG-II bill is already law, reassigning nurse tasks and lowering grading, and whether a ban on staff commenting on the transition scheme is acceptable. The Minister said the examples are not always directly caused by the draft bill, that opining on the scheme cannot be forbidden, and that he will await an advisory report from Rinnooy Kan in early October 2019 before deciding how to proceed with the bill.
As I have previously announced, I do not see the bill on the nurse practitioner in its current form getting off the ground.
Zoals ik al eerder heb aangekondigd zie ik het wetsvoorstel rondom de regieverpleegkundige in de huidige vorm niet vliegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over slechte nazorg bij letselschade

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a patient harmed in hospital Isala who was not allowed to speak with the treating doctor or learn that doctor's identity after medical injury. The minister said openness and conversation are essential, the hospital board acknowledged liability and invited the patient again, and the minister considers existing rules (Wkkgz, GOMA, WGBO) sufficient so no new legislation is needed.
This patient too was reportedly invited several times to a conversation with Isala and the treating doctor, but would have declined every personal contact.
Ook deze patiënt zou volgens het bestuur meerdere keren zijn uitgenodigd voor een gesprek met Isala en de behandelend arts, maar zou elk persoonlijk contact af hebben gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de verwijdering van twee wietplanten uit de tuin van een ouder echtpaar door de politie

An MP asked the ministers about police removal of two cannabis plants from an elderly couple's garden, the proportionality of medicinal cannabis policy, the availability and cost of medicinal cannabis oil, and whether individual exemptions could be granted. The minister answered that policy is set within international and national frameworks, that five plants or fewer are generally not prosecuted but are seized, that no individual exemptions will be granted beyond legal needs, and that the BMC will discuss further steps with patients and analyse samples.
We cannot go into the content of an individual report to Meld Misdaad Anoniem.
Wij kunnen niet ingaan op de inhoud van een individuele melding bij Meld Misdaad Anoniem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Hermans over het bericht 'Vrouwen hebben genoeg aan veel lagere dosis medicijn tegen hartfalen'

MPs Rutte and Hermans asked the minister about a report that women may need a much lower dose of a heart failure drug, and whether guidelines, personalised medicine, clinical trials and the Gender and Health knowledge agenda will address sex differences. The minister replied that guidelines are the responsibility of professional groups, outlined how sex differences matter in drug development, and gave a progress update on the ZonMw programme with no new binding commitments.
Drawing up and observing treatment guidelines is the responsibility of the relevant professional groups.
Het opstellen en naleven van behandelrichtlijnen behoort tot de verantwoordelijkheid van de betreffende beroepsgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de verwachte toename van het aantal geneesmiddelentekorten in 2019

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about the reported increase in drug shortages in 2019, the status of the IGJ and KNMP study on pharmacists breaking rules due to shortages, EU measures and French proposals, and the KNMP call for longer tender periods. The minister confirms notifications nearly doubled, says the inspectorate sees no large-scale re-dispensing so no study is planned now, promises to inform parliament this autumn on stock policy, and notes preferential-tendering periods have already been lengthened.
Given the very small scale of re-dispensing expected by the IGJ and KNMP, it is not advisable to conduct research into the extent of this problem at this time.
Vanwege de door de IGJ en KNMP verwachte zeer kleine schaal waarop heruitgifte plaatsvindt, is het niet aangewezen om thans onderzoek te doen naar de omvang van deze problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het verslag van een schriftelijk overleg over het chronisch vermoeidheidssyndroom (ME/CVS)

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the Health Council's advice on ME/CVS, including graded exercise therapy, research funding, ICD classification, UWV registration, municipal awareness and specialist care. The Minister largely deferred to professionals and ongoing research, while committing to a ZonMw action plan, informing municipalities, and talking with the NFU.
