In line with this, I will ensure that municipalities are also pointed to the advice under the Social Support Act and asked to take it into account when carrying out their tasks.

Ik zal er in aansluiting hierop voor zorgen dat de gemeenten ook in het kader van de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning wordt gewezen op het advies en gevraagd worden hiermee rekening te houden bij het uitvoeren van hun taken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over Cordaan die verstandelijk beperkte cliënten een zwijgcontract liet tekenen

An MP asked the ministers why care organisation Cordaan had intellectually disabled clients sign silence contracts about abuse, when the abuse was reported late to the Inspectorate and perpetrators left with payments. The minister called silence clauses unacceptable, said the Inspectorate was not aware of the contracts until recently, and announced a law banning such clauses to go to consultation by end of year.
I find concluding such a contract between victims and a care organisation completely unacceptable.
Ik vind het afsluiten van een dergelijk contract tussen slachtoffers en een zorgorganisatie volstrekt onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Gemeentepolis minima staat onder druk’

Labour MP Kerstens asked the Health Minister and State Secretary of Social Affairs about a CPB report on municipal health insurance collectives (gemeentepolis) for low-income people and whether improvement options such as better risk-equalisation compensation, choice aids and a no-claim alternative to the deductible will be pursued. The government says the polis can help but depends on design, points to the voorzieningenwijzer and ongoing risk-equalisation improvements, stresses municipalities and insurers are free to offer collectives, and commits to further review of chronic-illness compensation without a full policy overhaul.
Municipalities and insurers are free to decide whether or not to conclude collectives.
Gemeenten en verzekeraars zijn vrij om wel of geen collectiviteiten af te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kerstens over het gebrekkige toezicht op de data van patiënten

MPs Ploumen and Kerstens asked how patient data is protected, whether a US company had access to anonymised data, whether patients are informed about research use, and about monopoly risks in digital care. The minister answered that responsibility lies mainly with care providers, that the software in question is not used in the Netherlands, that anonymised or consented research is the rule, and promised further letters and debate.
Hospitals themselves bear responsibility for their patient management software and what they agree with suppliers in their contracts.
Ziekenhuizen dragen zelf de verantwoordelijkheid voor hun software voor patiëntenbeheer en hetgeen ze afspreken met de leveranciers in hun contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de patiëntenstop voor VGZ verzekerden vanaf 1 juli bij het Ikazia Ziekenhuis

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the July 2019 patient stop at Ikazia Hospital for VGZ-insured patients with a budget ceiling, and whether this undermines patient choice and the health system. The minister answered that it follows an agreement between hospital and insurer, that communication to patients must be clear, that the NZa monitors VGZ's duty of care, and that he will not intervene but follows the situation.
I will not go further into the reasoning of the hospital and the health insurer.
Ik ga verder niet in op de redenering van het ziekenhuis en zorgverzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat ruim 200 gemeenten drugsgebruik op straat verbieden terwijl het van de wet mag

An MP asked whether municipal bans on drug use in public spaces conflict with the Opium Act, which does not criminalise use, and whether a general ban is preferable to area-specific bans. The minister replied that municipalities may ban public drug use under their local ordinances without conflicting with the Opium Act, and that the choice of approach is for local authorities to make.
Municipalities are competent under articles 121 and 149 of the Municipalities Act to make (supplementary) ordinances, insofar as these do not conflict with higher regulations.
Gemeenten zijn op grond van artikel 121 en 149 van de Gemeentewet bevoegd tot het maken van (aanvullende) verordeningen, voor zover deze niet in strijd zijn met hogere regelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Verpleegkundigen zien komst superverpleegkundige als degradatie.’

MP Kerstens asks whether the minister's willingness to pursue a sector-agreed arrangement covers the introduction of the regieverpleegkundige role itself, including dropping the MBO/HBO distinction, given nurses' unrest. The minister replies that the bill is being reconsidered, that alternatives such as CAO or quality standards are open, and that Rinnooy Kan will explore support and talk with the action committee.
As I have previously made known, the bill came about at the request of, and after extensive consultation with, among others, representatives of the profession, employers and employees.
Zoals ik eerder kenbaar heb gemaakt is het wetsvoorstel op verzoek van en na veel overleg met onder andere vertegenwoordigers van de beroepsgroep, werkgevers en werknemers tot stand gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Hijink over de podcast 'Met 30 jaar zorg-ervaring terug naar school door de wet BIG 2'

SP MPs Van Gerven and Hijink asked the Minister of Medical Care about a podcast claiming the BIG-II bill would strip nurses of tasks and pay, and whether it is a cost-saving measure. The minister denies that the bill removes any nurse tasks or powers, calls the transitional arrangement a quality measure, and says the bill will not be pursued in its current form while Rinnooy Kan explores alternatives.
In view of all recent developments, I do not see the current bill on the nurse-practitioner role working in this form.
Gelet op alle recente ontwikkelingen zie ik het huidige wetsvoorstel rondom de regieverpleegkundige in deze vorm niet vliegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de extra wachttijd voor VGZ- verzekerden bij Zuyderland

An MP asks whether the extra 8-week waiting time for VGZ-insured patients at Zuyderland hospital is acceptable and what the government will do for affected patients. The minister answers that the waiting time follows agreed budget caps between insurer and hospital, that VGZ offers referral support, that the NZa oversees the insurer's duty of care, and that no specific measures will be taken.
I am not worried about patients insured with VGZ.
Ik maak mij geen zorgen over patiënten die bij VGZ verzekerd zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het overleg met betrekking tot de overgangsregeling BIG II

MPs Hijink and Van Gerven asked whether a consultation on the BIG II transitional regulation for nurses would take place on 10 September 2019, whether the action committee of nurses was excluded, and whether it would be invited. The minister replied that the meeting was postponed on parties' request while an explorer, Rinnooy Kan, talks with stakeholders, including the action committee.
He will also enter into discussion with the BIG II action committee.
Hij zal ook met het actiecomité BIG II in gesprek gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de bijeenkomst op het ministerie met de 'regiegroep Wet BIG II'

An MP asked why the action committee of nurses opposing the BIG-II law was not invited to the planned 10 September 2019 meeting of the BIG-II steering group, and whether the minister would invite them and broaden support for the nurse-splitting law. The minister listed the invited organisations, said the meeting was postponed after some parties asked for that, and that a facilitator would talk with the action committee, while stating that broad support is the priority.
Some parties have since indicated that, given all recent developments, it is wiser to postpone this consultation until further notice.
Inmiddels hebben enkele partijen aangegeven dat het, gelet op alle recente ontwikkelingen, verstandiger is dit overleg tot nader order aan te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het deels instorten van het dak van het stadion van AZ in Alkmaar

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked the government about the partial collapse of the AZ stadium roof in Alkmaar, including whether budget cuts, municipal oversight, pressure on the municipality, and solar panels contributed. Minister Ollongren answered that the municipality found no evidence the roof was underbuilt, that investigations by Haskoning and the Onderzoeksraad are pending, and that she will inform parliament once outcomes are known.
The municipality of Alkmaar will inform me of the outcomes of this investigation. Once that has happened, I am willing to inform your House.
Over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek zal de gemeente Alkmaar mij informeren. Nadat dit is gebeurd, ben ik bereid uw Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de ambulancezorg in Woerdense Verlaat

An MP from the CDA asks the minister about ambulance response times in Woerdense Verlaat, where ambulances often exceed the 15-minute norm, and whether burden-sharing with neighbouring services was used. The minister answers that in 2018 ten of fourteen urgent calls exceeded 15 minutes, that the 95% legal norm reflects practical limits, and that regional steering and a forthcoming quality framework will address the issue.
It is questionable whether patient safety and quality of care would be served by this.
Het is de vraag of de patiëntveiligheid en de kwaliteit van zorg hiermee zijn gediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het vergoeden van stamceltherapie bij MS-patiënten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care whether stem cell therapy (aHSCT) for MS patients should be made conditionally accessible while research runs, and whether aftercare for patients treated abroad is reimbursed. The Minister said the neurologists' research proposal is reasonable, pointed to existing research funding schemes instead of conditional access, and explained that aHSCT and its integral aftercare are not reimbursed from the basic package because effectiveness is not yet established.
At present the researchers have not yet been able to establish whether the aHSCT treatment is effective care, and for that reason the treatment is currently not reimbursed from the basic package.
Op dit moment hebben de onderzoekers nog niet kunnen vaststellen of de behandeling aHSCT effectieve zorg is en om die reden wordt deze behandeling op dit moment niet vergoed uit het basispakket.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat Novartis gemanipuleerde data gebruikte

MPs asked the minister how the government views reports that Novartis subsidiary AveXis submitted manipulated data for Zolgensma, whether this should affect approval or pricing, and whether Europe should impose sanctions. The minister called such non-transparency very serious, noted the EMA review is still ongoing and can take the signals into account, and said he would scrutinise the price if the Zorginstituut advises negotiation.
I cannot anticipate possible consequences and/or measures from the European Union towards AveXis.
Ik kan niet vooruitlopen op eventuele gevolgen en/of maatregelen vanuit de Europese Unie richting AveXis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de uitspraak van de voorzitter van de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit dat een 0% groei van de ziekenhuiszorg in 2022 onrealistisch is

An SP MP asks the health minister whether the 0% growth target for hospital care in 2022, which the NZa chair called unrealistic, will cause waiting lists and quality problems, and whether a realistic budget will be proposed. The minister replies that the growth target is necessary, that the agreements with the sector are binding, that quality is monitored by supervisors, and that no concrete budget change or guarantee is given.
It is therefore not a noble but a necessary aim.
Het is daarmee niet een nobel, maar een noodzakelijk streven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de prijsverhoging van Priadel

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the sharp price increase of Priadel (lithium), its co-payment burden on bipolar patients, and whether Essential Pharma's monopolising practices can be stopped. The Minister says the increase is lawful under the Wgp but undesirable, is in talks with the company which must provide a cost justification by September 2019, and sees no further legal options beyond existing price and competition rules.
I have indicated that I would like to see a cost justification of the price of Priadel.
Ik heb aangegeven graag een kostenonderbouwing te zien van de prijs van Priadel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Graus over het bericht dat een zeer gevaarlijke reuzenteek aangetroffen is nabij Nederland

PVV MPs Agema and Graus asked the state secretary and ministers about reports of the dangerous Hyalomma tick near the Dutch border, its Crimean-Congo virus risk, public information, monitoring and vaccines. The minister answered at length that the risk to Nederland is currently very low, that monitoring and public information are being expanded, and that a separate tick hotline is of limited added value.
Because of the recent findings in Germany, the RIVM and the CMV will expand monitoring together with partners.
Vanwege de recente bevindingen in Duitsland gaan het RIVM en het CMV met partijen de monitoring uitbreiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het groeiend tekort aan doktersassistenten

MP Ploumen asked the Minister of Medical Care about the growing shortage of doctor's assistants, their role as gatekeepers, and whether they should be legally recognised under the Wet BIG. The minister answered that insurers and regional parties are addressing access problems, no IGJ signals about the shortage have been received, and the shortage is being tackled via the Werken in de Zorg action programme.
Nivel conducted surveys among GP practices in all labour market regions as part of a study I commissioned with the LHV last year.

Het Nivel heeft in alle arbeidsmarktregio's enquêtes uitgezet onder huisartsenpraktijken in het kader van een onderzoek waarvoor ik samen met de Landelijke Huisartsen Vereniging (LHV) vorig jaar opdracht heb gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het artikel ‘Zorg ontvangt tientallen miljoenen van de industrie’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care how to interpret reported rises in industry sponsorship of the medical sector, whether the transparency register should be mandatory and lower reporting thresholds introduced, and how to make doctors and institutions more careful about industry ties. The minister attributed the rise mainly to more companies registering, particularly medical device suppliers, said mandatory registration is not warranted now but that the evaluation may lead to changes, and said responsibility lies with doctors and institutions under existing codes and the legal ban on gift-giving, declining to implement a motion to remove exceptions to that ban.
If the results of the evaluation give cause for it, I will consider changes to the conditions for listing in the Transparency Register Healthcare or other measures.
Als de resultaten van de evaluatie daar aanleiding toe geven zal ik wijzigingen in de voorwaarden voor vermelding in het Transparantieregister Zorg of andere maatregelen overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het plaspillentekort

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the shortage of the 1 mg bumetanide tablet and whether low Dutch prices caused it, and what advice patients should get. The minister said the reports were incomplete: the shortage came from a packaging delay, not production or price, though a link to low prices cannot be fully excluded, and referred to a pending study on larger stockpiles due end September.
I expect the results of this study at the end of September.
Ik verwacht de resultaten van dit onderzoek eind september.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Geen gemeentepolis meer voor Heerder minima: we zijn teleurgesteld en kwaad’

An MP asks the health minister why Menzis is ending the municipal health insurance package for benefit recipients in Heerde and whether insurers and the government will ensure collective coverage. The minister replies that the municipal package is not an end in itself, points to alternatives, and declines to start talks with insurers or to compensate municipalities.
I see the municipal collectivity, however, as a means and not an end in itself.
Ik zie de gemeentelijke collectiviteit hiervoor echter als een middel en geen doel op zich.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Bijna één op drie ziekenhuisvacatures moeilijk te vervullen’

Kerstens and Ploumen (PvdA) asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that nearly a third of hospital vacancies are hard to fill, and about hospital staff turnover and collective labour agreement offers. Minister Bruins acknowledged hard-to-fill vacancies, provided turnover figures showing a net inflow of about 1,900 workers, and said that pay is a matter for social partners while the ministry provides extra funds for pay growth.
It is up to social partners to make good agreements on attractive collective labour agreements given this room.
Het is aan sociale partners om gegeven deze ruimte goede afspraken te maken over aantrekkelijke cao's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Dringend gezocht: nieuwe medicijnen’

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about reports that new antibiotics are urgently needed, whether the government shares the UN warnings, whether incentives for industry and mandatory contributions are warranted, and what the scale of resistance in the Netherlands is. The minister answers that the government shares the concern, cites the Noordwijk conference, a 4.5 million euro fund and 5 million euro for GARDP, states that new incentives are still under discussion, rejects mandatory industry contributions, and promises an update on the ABR programme in early 2020.
No, there are sufficient (European) initiatives in the field of antibiotic resistance research.
Nee, er zijn voldoende (Europese) initiatieven op het gebied van antibioticaresistentie-onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de tekortschietende registratie van borstimplantaten

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about news that only half of hospitals had their breast implant registration in order, and whether women's medical risks were adequately protected. The minister answered that registration is being phased in until 1 January 2020, that about half of hospitals have implemented the GDSN link, and that the IGJ and CIBG will monitor compliance and enforce where needed.
I will continue to closely monitor the connection of clinics and hospitals together with the IGJ and the CIBG.
De aansluiting van klinieken en ziekenhuizen blijf ik nauwlettend in de gaten houden samen met de IGJ en het CIBG.
Uitstel beantwoording vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het onderzoek waaruit het maatschappelijk rendement van sport en bewegen in Nederland blijkt

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care eight questions about a study showing a social return on sport and exercise of about 2.5 times the cost, covering school physical education, municipal use of sport, effects on care and crime costs, and business benefit. The minister only announces that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline and promises answers as soon as possible.
cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period
kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over de aanpak van de overlast door de eikenprocessierups

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers how the government will tackle the large-scale nuisance from the oak processionary caterpillar, including whether a national approach is needed. The minister acknowledges the increased nuisance, points to a new knowledge platform and RIVM/GGD information, and states that municipalities bear a duty of care, so the response is decentralised, with the ministry providing national coordination.

At national level I also take the lead, among other things through knowledge dissemination, research that is being set up and carried out, and sharing insights on controlling the oak processionary caterpillar.

Landelijk wordt ook regie genomen door mij, onder andere via kennisverspreiding, onderzoek dat wordt opgezet en uitgevoerd en het delen van inzichten ten aanzien van de bestrijding van de eikenprocessierups.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Nijboer en Van den Hul over Nederlandse verzekeraars die meer kunnen doen om medicijnen betaalbaar te maken

Three PvdA MPs asked whether Dutch insurers such as Aegon and Allianz, which invest heavily in pharmaceutical firms, should press those firms on medicine prices, tax payment and the Access to Medicine Index investor pledge. The minister answered that insurers are responsible for their own investment policy, pointed to existing IMVO covenant commitments and the OECD guidelines, encouraged signing the pledge, and saw no reason for further measures on transparency.
Institutional investors, including insurers, are responsible for their own investment policy and decide themselves in which companies to invest.
Institutionele beleggers, waaronder verzekeraars, zijn verantwoordelijk voor hun eigen beleggingsbeleid en bepalen zelf in welke bedrijven belegd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de voortgang van het behoud van de zorg in de regio

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister for Medical Care about the planned withdrawal of emergency care in Stadskanaal and Hoogeveen, the Isala plan for Meppel, consultation with regional stakeholders, temporary staffing costs at Treant and the procedure for changes to acute care. The Minister says the regional team is still developing plans in dialogue with the region, that Isala has no plan to change Meppel, and that an AMvB on acute care is not yet in force, so only informal guidance applies, with a handreiking promised for October.
As you know, the AMvB on acute care, in which communication with parties and residents in the region is an important component, has not yet entered into force.
Zoals u weet is de amvb acute zorg, waarin de communicatie met partijen en inwoners in de regio een belangrijk onderdeel is, nog niet in werking getreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het toegenomen aantal patiëntenstops als gevolg van drukte op spoedafdelingen

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the doubling of emergency-department patient stops in Noord-Holland and Flevoland, whether consultations with the NZa and LNAZ had produced time-out data, why Zeeland and Twente avoid emergency stops, and whether Amsterdam's stop rate rose after Slotervaart's bankruptcy. The minister said the NZa needs more time to analyse the data, promised a fuller reply by September, and described hospitals' internal measures and regional agreements.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over geneesmiddelentekorten

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about drug shortages in the Netherlands, referring to a press article and asking whether the government would adopt proposed measures and report on the status of each earlier recommendation. The minister declined to give a substantive view yet, pointing to ongoing studies (Gupta Strategists, IGJ evaluation, RIVM review) with results due later in 2019, and promised a status letter and further information once these are available.
I am aware of the article, but at this moment I find it premature to give my opinion on this and to go into the measures mentioned.
Ik ben op de hoogte van het artikel, maar ik vind het op dit moment prematuur om mijn mening hierover te geven en in te gaan op de genoemde maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ploumen over onrust onder BIG geregistreerde verpleegkundigen met een diploma van voor 2012

MPs Kerstens and Ploumen asked the Minister about unrest among experienced nurses with pre-2012 diplomas who must take a course or test to register as regieverpleegkundige under the Wet BIG II, and about attrition, competencies and recognition of prior learning. The Minister defends the 2012 cut-off and the transitional scheme as broadly supported, says the test or course is needed to show competencies, and says the EVC option will be examined.
The possibilities for this still need to be examined during the development of the training programme.
De mogelijkheden hiervan dienen nog te worden onderzocht tijdens de ontwikkeling van het scholingsprogramma.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rutte over de berichten ‘Waarom is bekostiging e-health zo complex, het kan zoveel simpeler’ en ‘Dankzij een app hebben hartpatiënten minder vaak spoedeisende hulp nodig’

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about the complexity of funding e-health and whether a heart-patient app reduces emergency visits, and about why effective smart home-care solutions are scaled up only sporadically. The minister acknowledges the complexity, outlines actions such as transformation funds, a request to insurers, and a uniform-financing ambition, while declining to make the equipment a basic-insurance benefit.

I will also enter into talks with health insurers, care providers, professionals, patients and informal carers in the coming period to sharpen what would further help make smart home care a regular part of care within a few years.

Ook ga ik de komende tijd in gesprek met zorgverzekeraars, zorgaanbieders, professionals en patiënten en mantelzorgers om scherp te krijgen wat hen nog meer kan helpen om over enkele jaren slimme zorg thuis regulier onderdeel van «zorg van nu» te laten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘St. Antonius stopt met bevallingen in Nieuwegein, moeders moeten uitwijken naar Utrecht’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about St. Antonius hospital's decision to permanently close acute obstetrics in Nieuwegein, questioning the staffing rationale, impact on pregnant women, travel times, and consultation. The minister answers that the status quo does not change for patients, the decision is driven by staffing and efficiency, the 45-minute norm is still met, and he has asked the hospital to follow proper consultation before closure.
The ROAZ, the NZa and the IGJ were not informed of the proposed decision to close permanently; I have told St Antonius that I do not consider this good practice.
Het ROAZ, de NZa en IGJ zijn niet geïnformeerd over het voorgenomen besluit om definitief te sluiten; ik heb het St Antonius laten weten dat ik dit geen goede gang van zaken vind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over een gevaarlijk dieet tegen kanker

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a Gerson-style anti-cancer diet, whether doctors prescribing it should be struck from the register, whether such providers exist, and whether the Inspectorate supervises them. The Minister says such diets are alternative therapies that are permitted if they cause no harm, that doctors can be sanctioned via disciplinary or criminal law, that the Inspectorate handles reports but takes no view on efficacy, and that existing enforcement tools are sufficient.
The legal enforcement instruments are therefore sufficient.
Het wettelijk handhavingsinstrumentarium is hiermee toereikend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over medische crowdfundingsacties

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the rapid growth of medical crowdfunding in the Netherlands, the need for better oversight and fee transparency, the effectiveness of treatments promoted, and ethical concerns about profiting from illness. The minister said he had no information on the growth comparison, that existing consumer protection rules by ACM and AFM are adequate, and that patients should discuss treatment effectiveness and risks with their doctor.
The State Secretary of EZK and I see no reason at this time to tighten supervision of crowdfunding, because we consider the existing regulatory framework adequate.
De Staatssecretaris van EZK en ik zien op dit moment geen aanleiding voor aanscherpingen van het toezicht op crowdfunding, omdat wij het bestaande regelgevend kader op dit moment toereikend achten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de patiëntenzorg die in gevaar is op de spoedeisende hulp van het LUMC

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about overcrowding and endangered patient care at the emergency department of the Leiden University Medical Centre, including reports of delayed care and a patient death. The minister answers by referring to a letter to parliament, stating the Inspectorate sees no current unacceptable risks, that the hospital board is taking measures and must monitor them, and that the Inspectorate and hospital have acted on the situation.
The Inspectorate has no reason to assume that there are currently unacceptable risks.
De Inspectie heeft geen aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat er op dit moment sprake is van onaanvaardbare risico’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de overbelasting van de spoedeisende hulp in het Leids Universitair Medisch Centrum (LUMC)

MP Van den Berg (CDA) asked the Minister for Medical Care about overcrowding at the emergency department of LUMC in Leiden, the regional distribution of acute care, RIVM regional data and consultations on closing the Bronovo emergency department. The Minister answered that no per-department patient figures are available yet (NZa asked), described the regional-picture approach and the draft AMvB notification and consultation procedure for closures, and listed the consultations held with HMC and with himself.
I do not have an overview per emergency department in the Leiden/The Hague region of the number of persons treated per year.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht met per spoedeisende hulppost in de regio Leiden/Den Haag het aantal personen dat per jaar wordt behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Personeel spoedeisende hulp LUMC: patiëntenzorg in gevaar’

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about staff warnings that emergency care at LUMC is endangered by overcrowding and staff shortages, and about the impact of closing the Bronovo emergency department. The minister refers to an earlier letter to parliament, states the Inspectorate sees no unacceptable risks for now, reports an external investigation commission at LUMC, and sees no reason to keep Bronovo open.
The Inspectorate has informed me that they have no reason to assume that there are currently unacceptable risks.
De Inspectie heeft mij laten weten dat zij geen aanleiding hebben om te veronderstellen dat er op dit moment sprake is van onaanvaardbare risico’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over hartinfarcten die voor vrouwen bijna dubbel zo vaak fataal zijn dan voor mannen

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the minister whether women's heart attacks and cardiac arrests are more often fatal than men's, and what measures are taken on reanimation, symptom recognition and research funding. The minister disputed the framing, attributed the poorer survival to cardiac-arrest rhythm differences, and listed existing campaigns, guidelines and research programmes, without committing to new measures.
A cardiac arrest in women is also less quickly recognised because the symptoms are less clear.
Ook wordt een hartstilstand bij vrouwen minder snel herkend omdat de symptomen minder duidelijk zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Lodders en Rutte Arno over het bericht ‘Bijkleuren van tonijn brengt risico voor de volksgezondheid met zich mee’ en de uitzending van het televisieprogramma Kassa

Two VVD MPs asked whether coloring of yellowfin tuna is banned, how it can be detected, and whether histamine risks are being controlled. The Minister of Medical Care confirmed that tuna coloring is prohibited under EU additive and food safety law, described NVWA inspections and sampling plans, and reported low histamine incident numbers.
The NVWA carries out checks on compliance with additives legislation through inspections.
De NVWA voert controles uit op de naleving van de additievenwetgeving door middel van inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Geluk-Poortvliet over het bericht 'Menzis eist 6 ton van zorgbureau Care Free Twente'

MPs Van den Berg and Geluk-Poortvliet asked the health minister about Menzis's fraud investigation into care agency Care Free Twente, including whether insurers and municipalities check that staff are qualified. The minister confirmed the investigation, described the findings (90 percent unqualified staff and incorrect declarations), explained the insurer's statutory controls, and noted that municipalities set their own contract conditions.
Supervision under the Wkkgz is assigned to the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate.
Het toezicht op de Wkkgz is belegd bij de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Analyse jaarverslagen: ziekenhuizen uit gevarenzone’

MP Ellemeet asked the health minister about a report that hospitals' finances improved in 2018, interest costs fell, and equity doubled since 2011, and whether that money should be invested in staff, ICT and innovation. The minister confirmed the improved average position, explained the WFZ's resilience criteria and the NZa early-warning system, and said investment choices rest with hospitals themselves.
I will inform your House further after the summer about the functioning of this improved early-warning system.
Ik zal uw Kamer na de zomer nader informeren over de werking van dit verbeterde systeem van vroegsignalering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het tekort aan doktersassistenten

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about a shortage of practice assistants (doktersassistenten) that could force GP practices to close this summer, including its effects on access, safety and regional care. The Minister says insurers and regional plans will address access, the inspectorate has received no reports of safety risks, and the government is pursuing a broad workforce action programme without committing to new specific measures.
In addition, there are opportunities in GP care to make better use of task shifting and job carving.
Daarnaast liggen er in de huisartsenzorg kansen om taakherschikking en job carving beter te benutten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Groothuizen over het bericht dat repressie niet meer voldoende is in drugsaanpak

MPs Bergkamp and Groothuizen (D66) asked the Justice and Health ministers how they view claims that repression alone is insufficient for drug policy, including criminal recruitment into the drug market, the normalisation of drug use, and calls for evaluation or an expert commission. Minister Grapperhaus answered that Dutch policy balances health and justice, points to prevention measures, the ondermijning funding and a closed cannabis chain experiment, and declined to set up a commission.
Setting up a committee is therefore not, in my view, opportune.
Het in het leven roepen van een commissie acht ik dan ook niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Geleijnse over de berichtgeving betreffende dry-misting-apparaten in supermarkten

Two 50PLUS MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about media reports on dry-misting devices in supermarkets, including legionella risks, the lack of independent control, and the lack of clear rules and responsibility. The minister answered that operators and suppliers are responsible for legionella management, that existing rules apply, that NVWA and ILT provide general oversight, and that he will consult departments and supervisors to clarify who is responsible for independent oversight.
I am consulting with the most relevant departments and supervisors to quickly create clarity on how independent supervision of the use of misting devices in supermarkets can best be organised.

Ik ga in overleg met de meest betrokken departementen en toezichthouders om snel duidelijkheid te scheppen over de vraag hoe onafhankelijk toezicht op het gebruik van mistapparaten in supermarkten het beste kan worden vormgegeven

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema, Van Aalst en Madlener over de acute zorg op Voorne-Putten met het oog op aankomende wegwerkzaamheden (en afsluitingen) en de wens in de regio om het Spijkenisse Medisch Centrum op t

PVV MPs asked the ministers about acute hospital care on Voorne-Putten, given road works and bridge closures, and about reopening the Spijkenisse Medisch Centrum as a full hospital with an emergency department, acute obstetrics and weekend stay. The minister replied that care should be provided in the right place, that the 45-minute norm is the relevant standard and is under study, that bridge disruptions are managed with contingency plans, and that the hospital is not a sensitive hospital and cannot be designated as a system hospital.
Before the summer I will inform you further about my vision on developments in the hospital landscape and my role in it.
Voor de zomer zal ik u nader informeren over mijn visie op de ontwikkelingen in het ziekenhuislandschap en mijn rol hierin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Van den Berg over de stijging van het aantal oxycodonverslaafden

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister about the rising number of oxycodone addicts, the lack of a clear treatment approach, prescribing practices, and patient information. The Minister acknowledged the trend, cited rising NVIC overdose notifications, and described a task force working on a national approach, prescribing guidance and patient information, with a progress letter promised for the second half of 2019.
Unfortunately I cannot give you national figures on the number of users in addiction care because these are not available.
Landelijke cijfers van het aantal gebruikers in de verslavingszorg kan ik u helaas niet geven omdat deze niet voorhanden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Snels over het bericht dat het kabinet €2 miljard per jaar kan besparen op diabeteszorg (voor type 2) door betere, meer duurzame en goedkopere diabeteszorg

Greens MPs Ellemeet and Snels asked whether the government would pursue lifestyle medicine and demedicalisation to cut type 2 diabetes costs, and how this fits budget rules and prevention commitments. The minister responded that lifestyle interventions can help but their savings are not yet proven, pointed to a ZonMw research programme of 1 million euro, said GLI is in the basic package and expects further steps via the Preventieakkoord, and promised an inventory with stakeholders by year end.
I want to work with relevant field parties to inventory why certain lifestyle interventions (e.g. interventions for diabetes) are not getting off the ground or are not being scaled up.
Ik wil samen met betrokken veldpartijen inventariseren waarom bepaalde leefstijlinterventies (bijv. interventies bij diabetes) niet van de grond komen of niet worden opgeschaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Geleijnse over hoge parkeertarieven bij ziekenhuizen

MPs Ploumen and Geleijnse asked the Minister whether hospitals profit from parking revenue, whether they inform patients about ways to limit parking costs, and whether insurers will act. The Minister said he keeps no overview of parking revenue, that parking policy is the responsibility of hospitals and municipalities, and that the issue was raised with hospitals in consultation without any firm commitment to further investigation.
I do not keep an overview of the revenues from parking fees at hospitals or whether hospitals keep money from them.
Ik houd geen overzicht bij van de opbrengsten van parkeertarieven bij ziekenhuizen en of ziekenhuizen daar geld aan overhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de petitie ‘De glucosesensor is geen gadget, maar bittere noodzaak’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a petition for reimbursement of the Freestyle Libre glucose sensor, including claimed cost savings, quality-of-life effects, and the Zorginstituut's distinction between flash and real-time monitoring. The minister said he sympathises with the initiative, declined to confirm the cost figures, referred to the Zorginstituut's assessments, and expects a Zorginstituut position on wider reimbursement by end 2019.
I therefore cannot confirm your assumptions.
Ik kan uw aannames daarom niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over voorwaardelijke toelating van Spinraza tot het basispakket

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care how his June 2019 pledge to start Spinraza treatment for SMA patients as soon as possible fits with the first treatments possibly not starting until 1 January 2020, and what he would do to start treatment within the month. The Minister says preparations are on a gradual timetable with the UMC Utrecht treatment capacity as the critical path, and that starting this month is not feasible.
After the summer recess I will send the House of Representatives a progress letter on the state of preparations for the conditional admission pathway for Spinraza.
Na het zomerreces zal ik de Tweede Kamer een voortgangsbrief toesturen over de stand van zaken van de voorbereiding van het voorwaardelijke toelatingstraject Spinraza.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Tandarts onbetaalbaar voor ruim half miljoen mensen in Nederland’

MPs Van Gerven (SP) asked about reports that dental care is unaffordable for over half a million people, and about access for adults and undocumented migrants. The Minister rejects restoring adult dental care to the basic insurance package, cites personal responsibility, and declines to change the reimbursement scheme for undocumented migrants.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de vergoeding van vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen

An MP asks whether IVF for egg donors and women unable to produce good eggs due to cancer or early menopause should be reimbursed, and why this differs from organ donation coverage. The minister says donor treatment is not covered because donors lack their own medical indication, and commits to asking the Zorginstituut for advice on this question.
I will ask the Zorginstituut to advise me on reimbursement under the basic package in the situation where the insured has a medical fertility problem.
Ik zal het Zorginstituut vragen mij te adviseren over vergoeding ten laste van het basispakket in de situatie dat er sprake is van een medisch vruchtbaarheidsprobleem bij de verzekerde
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht ‘Nederland gidsland bij doneren organen: unieke regeling na euthanasie gaat de wereld over’

MP Tellegen asked the minister about the Dutch euthanasia-organ donation guideline, its delayed delivery to parliament, how it will reach doctors and patients, the share of euthanasia patients who could donate, and a home-sedation-then-hospital procedure. The minister answered that the guideline is delayed to Q4 2019, will be distributed via professional networks and a foundation leaflet, estimates about 10% of euthanasia patients could be potential donors, and says the donation procedure must not compromise euthanasia care standards.
Therefore I cannot send the guideline to your House earlier than the fourth quarter.
Daarom kan ik niet eerder dan het vierde kwartaal de richtlijn aan uw Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het ontbreken van vergoeding voor het Freestyle Libre systeem dat grote voordelen heeft voor diabetespatiënten

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why the FreeStyle Libre glucose monitor is not reimbursed for all type 1 diabetes patients, citing benefits and cost savings and comparing Dutch coverage with other countries. The Minister said the Zorginstituut will issue a position on wider eligibility by end 2019, that cost considerations are not part of its clinical assessment, and that Dutch diabetes care is already effective and accessible.
It is expected that Zorginstituut Nederland can issue a ruling on reimbursement of FGM for all people with type 1 diabetes by the end of 2019.
Het is de verwachting dat Zorginstituut Nederland voor einde 2019 een uitspraak kan doen over vergoeding van FGM voor alle mensen met diabetes type 1.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het feit dat Nederland tegen openheid over ontwikkelkosten van geneesmiddelen heeft gestemd

An MP asks why the Netherlands supported transparency on drug prices and trial outcomes but opposed transparency on trial and R&D costs at the WHA, and why the resolution text was weakened. The minister denies the Netherlands opposed R&D cost transparency, says the resolution was adopted by consensus, and defends confidential price deals as necessary for access while calling for future price transparency.
During the negotiations on the resolution, the Netherlands made no statements contrary to transparency of trial costs and development costs.
Nederland heeft tijdens de onderhandelingen over de resolutie geen uitspraken gedaan die indruisen tegen transparantie van kosten van trials en ontwikkelingskosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van Toorenburg over het doorbreken van het medisch beroepsgeheim bij verdenking van een misdaad

MPs Van den Berg and Van Toorenburg asked whether staff at the Mondriaan clinic should have breached medical confidentiality when they suspected a patient was involved in a double murder, and for examples of when a breach is permitted. Staatssecretaris Blokhuis answered that breaching confidentiality requires a careful case-by-case weighing under the conflict-of-duties rules, declined to judge the case while the investigation is ongoing, and gave general examples.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het artikel 'Onbegrip bij ouders: stelselmatig wangedrag bij topturnclub'

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports of excessive performance pressure and boundary-crossing behaviour at a top gymnastics club, SV Pax. The minister answered that the Instituut voor Sportrechtspraak found some unwanted behaviour but no structural misconduct, that the KNGU and club agreed measures, and that broader safety and pedagogical improvements are being pursued through existing sports policy without a new investigation.
No, I do not consider this necessary since the ISR has recently investigated this.
Nee, ik acht dit niet nodig aangezien het ISR dit recent heeft onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de keuze van Bravis voor Roosendaal als locatie voor het nieuwe ziekenhuis

Mr Van den Berg (CDA) asked the Minister of Medical Care about the RIVM study on ambulance travel times for the Bravis hospital location, consultation with regional stakeholders, and hospital adherence figures. The Minister answered that the RIVM analysis was shared with municipalities and attached, that the hospital consulted stakeholders while the final decision rests with Bravis and its supervisory board, and that the ministry does not hold the adherence figures.
Hospitals hold these data themselves and can use them in decision-making.
Ziekenhuizen beschikken zelf over deze gegevens en kunnen deze gebruiken bij besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Westerveld en Özütok over de problemen in de transgenderzorg

Three GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about long waiting times in transgender care, the suicide risk for transgender youth, referrals to a third expert centre, self-medication, and insurers' contracting. The minister acknowledged the long waits, pointed to a care coordinator appointed by insurers and the ministry, said priority for young people was considered but left to insurers and providers, and gave partial information on capacity, timing and insurer contracting.
It is up to the health insurers and care providers, with the coordinator's advice in hand, to reduce the waiting lists for transgender care and, where necessary, set priorities.
Het is aan de zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders om, met het advies van de kwartiermaker in de hand, de wachtlijsten voor transgenderzorg terug te dringen en daarbij zo nodig prioriteiten te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het debat inzake het rapport van de commissie-Sorgdrager over de fipronilcrisis

MP De Groot asks the minister to confirm past statements that contaminated egg products could not be diluted and that processors had to recall products above the MRL, and questions whether the NVWA took effective measures in the fipronil crisis. The minister confirms the statements are based on existing law, states the NVWA intervened when companies failed to comply, and denies that contaminated eggs were knowingly processed with government consent.
I cannot give you the names of the Big8; in this I am bound by privacy legislation.
Ik kan u niet de namen van de Big8 geven, hierbij ben ik gebonden aan gebonden aan privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Ellemeet over het rapport ‘Overpriced: Drugs developed with Dutch Public Funding’

MPs Van Gerven (SP) and Ellemeet (GroenLinks) asked the ministers whether taxpayers pay twice for drugs developed with public funding, given the SOMO report 'Overpriced', and asked about ROM investments, transparency, conditions on public funding, and alternative models such as a national drug research fund. The government acknowledged the report, said R&D is only one element of drug prices, argued that its own funding overview cannot be meaningfully summed, and said it will review conditions on revolving funds while ruling out a national drug research fund.
The report 'Overpriced: Drugs developed with Dutch Public Funding' focuses in particular on revolving funds that impose no concrete conditions.
Het rapport «Overpriced: Drugs developed with Dutch Public Funding» zoomt met name in op revolverende fondsen die geen concrete voorwaarden stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over mogelijke beïnvloeding bij het opstellen van richtlijnen

MP Ploumen asks the Minister of Medical Care about the lowered LDL target of 1.8 in the new cardiovascular risk guideline, possible industry influence on its drafting, and the financial ties of committee members to drug makers. The minister replies that the 1.8 target applies only to very high-risk patients, that the guideline's drafters say they worked independently, that expected cost increases are limited, and that disclosure rules and the Health Inspectorate govern conflicts of interest, with the Transparency Register evaluation pending.
Professional groups are themselves responsible for the quality of their care and the guidelines for it.
Beroepsgroepen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van hun zorg en de richtlijnen daarvoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de nieuwe LDL-cholesterol-richtlijn

MP Van Gerven (SP) asks the minister about the new LDL-cholesterol guideline, its scientific basis, alleged pharmaceutical industry influence on guideline committees, and how such guidelines are produced. Minister Bruins largely refers to earlier answers, says medical treatment should rest on transparent medical grounds, states that existing rules on gifts and transparency apply, and commits only to inviting the NHG to give its view.
I do not have additional instruments to guarantee that there is no contact at all between the pharmaceutical industry and members of guideline committees.
Ik beschik niet over aanvullende instrumenten om te garanderen dat er in het geheel geen contact is tussen de farmaceutische industrie en leden van richtlijncommissies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het kweken van medicinale wiet in het Westland

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked about cannabis cultivation for medical use in Westland and why growers cannot export more freely, including whether the government would allow multiple producers. The minister replied that the single-buyer bureau (BMC) model follows the 1961 UN convention, export is capped at 100 kg per country per year, and a second grower may be contracted via European tender.
With the Bureau medicinale cannabis (BMC), the Netherlands complies with this convention.
Met het Bureau medicinale cannabis (BMC) houdt Nederland zich aan dit verdrag.
Àntwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Van Eijs en Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘800.000 Nederlanders kregen kanker, na ‘genezing’ houden zij problemen’

Three D66 MPs asked the health, finance and social affairs ministers about reports that many cancer survivors face lasting problems, including ongoing fatigue, lack of aftercare and advice, difficulties returning to work, and problems obtaining mortgages and insurance. The ministers answered that care providers should be doing more, that existing initiatives such as a no-risk insurance pilot and a Taskforce Cancer Survivorship are underway, and that the government sees little need for its own intervention, while promising to review mortgage and insurance issues with the sector.

In preparation for the next Platform meeting in 2020, I will ask how lenders handle the life insurance requirement and whether parties experience other bottlenecks in mortgage provision to (ex-)cancer patients.

Ik zal in voorbereiding op de volgende Platform bijeenkomst in 2020 uitvragen hoe kredietverstrekkers omgaan met de overlijdensrisicoverzekering en of partijen andere knelpunten ervaren op het gebied van hypotheekverstrekking aan (ex)kankerpatiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Bruins Slot over het vervoer tijdens de Formule 1 in Zandvoort

MPs Amhaouch and Bruins Slot asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about transport capacity to Zandvoort for the Formula 1 Grand Prix, including visitor numbers, the mobility plan, and rail upgrades. The State Secretary answered that the organiser and municipality are responsible for the mobility plan, that the line can run about six trains per hour with extra measures, and that ProRail is studying the cost and timeline for further upgrades.
Ensuring a mobility plan and good accessibility for the event is the responsibility of the organiser in cooperation with the municipality of Zandvoort.
Het zorgdragen voor een mobiliteitsplan en een goede bereikbaarheid van het evenement is de verantwoordelijkheid van de organisatie in samenwerking met de gemeente Zandvoort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over problemen met de indicatie voor ernstig zieke kinderen

MP Hijink asked the ministers whether health insurers frustrate indication and re-indication for seriously ill children, shorten indication periods, push children toward Wlz or municipalities, pressure nurses to reduce hours, and why the denktank on children with intensive care needs was dissolved. Minister De Jonge stated that the child nurse decides indication, insurers have a legal role to check lawfulness, individual cases are not commented on, and he will discuss indication issues with care parties under the 2019-2022 agreement.
In answering parliamentary questions I do not go into individual case details.
In beantwoording van Kamervragen ga ik niet in op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Pia Dijkstra over de (ongelijke) behandeling van homoseksuele weefseldonoren

MP Pia Dijkstra asked about a reported case in which a gay tissue donor was allegedly refused because of his sexual orientation, and about the planned shortening of the MSM deferral period for blood donation and alternatives to group-based donor selection. The minister regrets the distress, states sexual orientation is not an exclusion ground for organ donation, explains that tissue donation rules use population risk because donor information is often incomplete, and says the NTS is examining whether the 12-month period can be shortened.
Homosexual orientation is not a ground for exclusion in organ donation.
Homoseksuele geaardheid is geen uitsluitingsgrond bij orgaandonatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Özütok over het bericht ‘Gemeente Enschede voorkomt faillissement BVO FC Twente met miljoenensteun’

MPs Westerveld and Özütok asked whether Enschede's multi-million euro rescue of FC Twente, a commercial football club, complies with state aid rules, whether it fits the austerity in the social domain, and whether such clubs should receive aid when paying staff above WNT pay norms. The minister answered that municipal autonomy governs the choice, that the municipality itself judges no state aid is involved, that WNT does not apply to FC Twente, and pointed to a national reference framework and factsheet on football state aid.
In this case, the municipality takes the position that there is no state aid involved.
In dit geval stelt de gemeente zich op het standpunt dat er geen sprake is van staatssteun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat een niet-bewezen effectieve therapie bij ADHD wel door zorgverzekeraars vergoed wordt

MPs Raemakers and Van Weyenberg asked the ministers whether insurers, municipalities and UWV fund horse therapy for ADHD and other treatments not proven effective. The minister replied that such therapy is outside the basic package, that insurers set their own supplementary coverage, that UWV buys horse-coaching as Werk-Fit activation with success monitoring, and that the Jeugdwet and PGB rules apply to municipalities without a full list of funded treatments.
We therefore do not have a (complete) overview of which treatments or therapies are reimbursed from the supplementary package.
Wij beschikken dan ook niet over een (totaal)overzicht van welke behandelingen of therapieën uit het aanvullende pakket vergoed worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het bericht ‘20 jaar terug in de tijd’

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked the Minister for Medical Care why the government now departs from a 2001 policy that a missing male partner can be a sufficient indication for artificial insemination, and whether non-reimbursement of insemination for single women and lesbian couples conflicts with equal treatment. The Minister replied that the 2001 position concerned admission to treatment, not reimbursement under the Zvw, which requires a medical indication, and that the government will decide around summer 2019 on the role of government in funding such treatment, with insurers asked to keep reimbursing in 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Ruim 200 slachtoffers van Q-koorts krijgen nog geen geld’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care why over 200 Q-fever victims have not yet received the financial allowance, including the grounds for rejection and the objections filed, and whether the scheme will be applied generously and extended as the Chamber requested. The Minister confirmed the rejections (mostly failing diagnostic or 2007–2011 exposure criteria), said the policy rule is being revised following adopted motions with details to follow, and deferred the extension question to that forthcoming letter.
I will inform the Chamber about this soon.
Binnenkort zal ik de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van  het lid Van Gerven over het overschrijden van de 15-minutennorm bij ambulancespoedritten naar Woerdense Verlaat

An SP MP asked whether A1 ambulance emergency response times to Woerdense Verlaat stably exceed the 15-minute norm, and why the neighbouring RAV Utrecht does not help improve them. The minister answered that the norm applies regionally, reported average response times of about 18 minutes in 2018, admitted an incorrect government information page, and pointed to existing burenhulp agreements and municipal civil-aid initiatives.
This does not mean that A1 trips to Woerdense Verlaat systematically exceed the 15-minute norm.
Dit betekent niet dat bij A1-ritten naar Woerdense Verlaat stelselmatig de 15-minutennorm wordt overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat drogisten en huisartsen gaan samenwerken om mensen met kleine kwalen beter te helpen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a pilot in which drugstores and GPs cooperate on minor ailments, raising concerns about financial conflicts of interest and increased self-medication. The minister defended the pilot as jointly run by the drugstore association and an insurer with monitoring by NIVEL, denied conflicts of interest, and said no increase in self-care medicine use is expected.

I am of the view that, given the expertise in the advisory group and the monitoring by NIVEL, sound research can be carried out into the cooperation between GP, drugstore and pharmacist regarding minor ailments.

Ik ben van mening dat door de expertise in de klankbordgroep en de monitoring van het NIVEL, er gedegen onderzoek kan worden gedaan naar de samenwerking tussen huisarts, drogist en apotheker op het gebied van kleine kwalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het verband tussen wietgebruik en psychoses

An MP asked the government about a Lancet Psychiatry study linking strong cannabis use to psychosis, and whether this should end the closed coffeeshop cannabis experiment, cap THC levels, and cost implications. The minister answered that causality is scientifically uncertain, that further research is needed, that the experiment will continue, and that cost estimates cannot be given.
I do not share that view.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het verlagen van R&D en het beschikbaar maken van nieuwe geneesmiddelen voor patiënten voor wie geen behandeling bestaat

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about lowering R&D costs and making new drugs available to patients without alternatives, including post-phase-2 reimbursement and real-world evidence. The Minister answers that R&D costs do not directly determine drug prices, that reimbursement is limited to registered drugs meeting the 'state of science and practice' criterion, that named-patient and compassionate-use routes exist, and that a separate regime for orphan drugs and conditionals is being developed.
In addition, I am continuing to work on the scheme for orphan drugs and conditionals.
Daarnaast werk ik verder aan de regeling voor weesgeneesmiddelen en conditionals.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens, Bergkamp en Raemakers over het niet van de grond komen van projecten die over schotten heen werken

MPs Diertens, Bergkamp and Raemakers asked about the Nova Me care initiative that collapsed over funding divides between care domains, and about budgets and the Wlz experiment article. The minister answered that no funding is earmarked for the experiment article, that VGZ found the care not suitable, and declined to convene a dedicated meeting on lessons learned.
I have no insight into the amount of money that parties in daily practice invest in realising appropriate cross-domain care for clients.
Ik heb geen zicht op de hoeveelheid geld die er in de dagelijkse praktijk wordt geïnvesteerd door partijen om passend aanbod over domeinen heen voor cliënten te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de vergoeding van glucosemeter die de kwaliteit van leven aanzienlijk verbeterd

An MP asks the minister why research showing wider benefit of the FreeStyle Libre glucose sensor has not led to reimbursement, what it would cost, and whether the Zorginstituut will be asked to advise quickly. The minister replies that the Zorginstituut is developing a standpoint with the Ronde Tafel Diabeteszorg, cost estimates are given, and a decision on type 1 patients is expected by end 2019, so no new advice is requested.
I therefore see no reason at this time to ask the Zorginstituut for additional advice, since the Zorginstituut is already working on a standpoint
Ik zie daarom nu geen aanleiding het Zorginstituut om een aanvullend advies te vragen, aangezien het Zorginstituut reeds werkt aan een standpunt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Moorlag over het bericht dat vaginaal douchen schade oplevert bij vrouwen

MPs Ploumen and Moorlag asked whether vaginal douching products that claim health benefits, and that can cause harm, should be acted upon and whether more public information is needed. The minister says existing guidance already advises against douching, that the IGJ and NVWA have received almost no complaints, and that no further measures are currently warranted.
I currently see no reason to take further measures.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om nadere maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de miljoenenschikking van farmaceuten Bayer en Johnson & Johnson van Amerikaanse claims over het bloedverdunningsmiddel rivaroxaban (Xarelto)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the US settlement by Bayer and Johnson & Johnson over bleeding claims for rivaroxaban (Xarelto), and about Dutch use, risks, cost and evidence on DOACs. The minister answered that the Dutch situation differs from the US, that extra risk measures and monitoring are in place, that no new research is needed, and that a reversal agent has been recommended for EU approval.
This claim is entirely the responsibility of Bayer and Johnson & Johnson.
Deze stelling is geheel voor rekening van Bayer en Johnson & Johnson.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over gevaarlijke typen Ferroli-cv- ketels

An SP MP asked the ministers about dangerous Ferroli central heating boilers, including conflicting maintenance advice, complaints received, corporation Vestia's handling, and whether the boilers should be replaced. The minister answered that an NVWA investigation is ongoing, that no outcome can be anticipated, that Vestia is taking interim measures such as biennial maintenance, and that the government is working on a certification system for gas installation work.

I cannot anticipate the outcome of this investigation. As promised in the General Consultation on the NVWA of 23 April 2019, I will inform the House before summer about the progress of the investigation.

Op de uitkomst van dit onderzoek kan ik niet vooruitlopen. Zoals toegezegd in het Algemeen Overleg NVWA d.d. 23 april 2019 zal ik de Kamer voor de zomer informeren over de voortgang van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Krol over drugsdumpingen in de natuur

MPs Bergkamp and Krol asked about drug-waste dumping in nature and residential areas, its costs, health and environmental effects, and whether a legal drop-off point should be allowed. Minister Grapperhaus answered that dumping cannot be broken down by location, costs fall largely on regional and local authorities supported by national funds, and he rejects a 'drugsluikje' as facilitating crime.
It is not possible to break these registrations down by location; on the basis of the registrations it cannot be stated how often it concerned a residential area or nature area.
Het is niet mogelijk om deze registraties uit te splitsen naar locatie; het valt op basis van de registraties niet aan te geven hoe vaak het een woonwijk of natuurgebied betrof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat het ministerie van VWS de grootste stijging aan communicatiemedewerkers van alle ministeries heeft

An MP asked the Minister of VWS about the growth in communications staff at the ministry, its costs, campaigns on healthcare, and whether staff are used for party-political election activities. The government answered that staff work on policy communication, the growth was driven by public engagement needs, and election-campaign use is ruled out, while providing figures and campaign overviews.
No. The communications staff of VWS work on communication about policy, not on election activities.
Antwoord 18 De communicatiemedewerkers van VWS werken aan communicatie over beleid, niet aan verkiezingsactiviteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat in nieuwe spotjes zwijgen over dat het niet-registreren van een keuze wordt vastgelegd als ‘geen bezwaar’

An MP asked why the government's new organ donation campaign does not explicitly state that not registering a choice will count as no objection from 1 July 2020, and why it does not urge people to register actively now. The minister defended a phased communication plan that avoids stressing the consequence of non-registration, arguing this would only motivate 'no' voters, and said the campaign will later reinforce the 'no objection' message.
The aim of the campaign is in principle to motivate all citizens in the Netherlands to make and register their choice, whatever that choice may be.
Het doel van de campagne is om in principe alle burgers in Nederlander te motiveren hun keuze te maken en te registreren, welke keuze dan ook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de richtlijn nevenbevindingen bij het bevolkingsonderzoek borstkanker

An MP asked whether the RIVM guideline on incidental findings in breast cancer screening should be revised, given reports linking breast implants to ALCL, and whether implant leakage or wear should be reported to GPs. The state secretary said responsibility for implant maintenance lies with the care provider and patient, that the guideline is under review, and that the professional groups will be asked to act with care and inform parliament before summer.
I will inform the House before the summer about the professional groups' judgment and how incidental findings will be handled in future.
Ik zal de Kamer voor de zomer nader informeren over het oordeel van de beroepsgroepen en hoe in de toekomst om wordt gegaan met nevenbevindingen.
Nader antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat er weer een farmaceut is die de prijs van een weesgeneesmiddel maar liefst zes keer verhoogd

MP Ploumen asked which countries have assessed Lutathera as cost-effective and reimburse it, and why they pay such a high price. The minister reports, based on a PPRI survey of fifteen countries, that five reimburse the drug mostly through confidential price agreements, while the rest do not reimburse it, and that he has no insight into those confidential agreements.
I have no insight into the confidential price agreements that the various countries have made with Novartis, the manufacturer of Lutathera.
Ik heb geen zicht op de vertrouwelijke prijsafspraken die de verschillende landen hebben gemaakt met Novartis, de fabrikant van Lutathera.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Raemakers over het bericht ‘Medische gegevens duizenden Nederlanders verplaatst naar Google: 'Riskant'’

MPs Verhoeven and Raemakers asked whether patient medical data moved to Google Cloud by Medical Research Data Management was safe, whether patients and the Dutch Data Protection Authority were informed, and whether privacy-friendlier alternatives exist. The minister said hospitals bear responsibility for informing patients, that data stays in Dutch datacentres under double encryption with Google barred from access, and that he will commission independent research on non-European cloud platforms.
I will have independent research carried out into the desirability of using non-European cloud platforms to store healthcare data.
Ik zal onafhankelijk onderzoek laten doen naar de wenselijkheid van het gebruik van niet-Europese Cloud platforms voor het opslaan van zorgdata.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Ook jouw medische data liggen nu bij Google’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that medical data of hospital patients, processed by MRDM, is stored in Google's cloud, and raised concerns about privacy, pseudonymisation, US access under the Cloud Act and oversight. The minister answered that hospitals are the controllers, that pseudonymisation plus double encryption and Dutch/EU storage are safeguards, that the Data Protection Authority has started an investigation, and that an independent study on non-European cloud platforms will be commissioned.
I will have independent research carried out into the desirability of using non-European cloud platforms to store care data.
Ik zal onafhankelijk onderzoek laten doen naar de wenselijkheid van het gebruik van niet-Europese Cloud platforms voor het opslaan van zorgdata.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Patiëntdossiers in te zien door lek bij ziekenhuis OLVG’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a reported data breach at hospital OLVG that exposed patient records, including whether the breach was reported, whether other hospitals are affected, and whether the response was adequate. The minister said hospitals are responsible for data security, the AP is investigating, OLVG reported the breach and took measures, and the IGJ and OVV are reviewing hospital digital safety with results expected in Q3 2019.
I am not aware of which hospitals have experienced similar situations.
Het is mij niet bekend bij welke ziekenhuizen sprake is van soortgelijke situaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag, Ploumen en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Westerveld hoopt op snelle publicatie van RIVM rapport’

MPs Moorlag, Ploumen and Nijboer asked about a news report on Westerveld hoping for quick publication of a RIVM report on pesticide exposure, when it was completed, and what legal tools municipalities have to protect residents from pesticide exposure via zoning. The minister answered that the RIVM reports were sent to the House on 10 April, and that municipalities can use zoning plans and the precautionary principle to set buffer zones, with about 50 metres a commonly accepted rule of thumb, while the exposure study shows no unacceptable risk at that distance.
Yes, this is possible and is already happening.
Ja, dit kan en vindt ook al plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ploumen over de uitzending van het tv-programma Kassa over de hoge afhandelingskosten van medicijnrollen

MPs Kerstens and Ploumen asked the minister about a Kassa broadcast on high fees for weekly medication packaging and whether prices could be justified and made transparent. The minister said weekly dispensing fees average about €3.50 and vary by pharmacy, that the NZa is reviewing a possible flat-fee model, and that a decision is expected before summer.
The NZa is reviewing this with all parties involved. I am awaiting this exercise.
De NZa bekijkt dit met alle betrokken partijen. Ik wacht deze exercitie af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het besluit van het Openbaar Ministerie om abortusklinieken CASA en medisch diagnostisch centrum STAR niet strafrechtelijk te vervolgen

Parliamentary questions from MP Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the Minister about the Public Prosecution Service's decision not to prosecute abortion clinics CASA and STAR, and whether commercial incentives and unclear rules were at play. The Minister said he would tell clinics how to handle repeated consultations, commissioned an audit and revision of the subsidy scheme, and that the NZa will decide on further measures after receiving OM findings, while declining further action on the fraud investigation itself.
Regarding the OM's investigation into declaration fraud, the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) will have the OM further inform it about the nature, scope and content of the findings.

Ten aanzien van het onderzoek van het OM naar de declaratiefraude zal de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) zich door het OM verder laten informeren over de aard, omvang en inhoud van de gedane bevindingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het laten aansluiten van het aanbod van BMC bij de wensen en behoeften van gebruikers van medicinale cannabis

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care whether BMC's medicinal cannabis supply, expanding under a tender, could better match patient needs and whether BMC should analyse samples from dissatisfied patients. The minister confirmed the tender expansion, said only a single patient (not a group) has complained, and agreed BMC will analyse samples from patients holding self-cultivation permits and engage with patient organisations, but BMC lacks capacity for large-scale analysis.
BMC has indicated to me that it is willing to have analyses of cannabis varieties carried out on samples supplied by patients
BMC heeft bij mij aangegeven dat zij bereid is om analyses van cannabis variëteiten te laten uitvoeren met samples aangeleverd door patiënten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de aanbevelingen van het VN-Comité tegen Foltering (CAT) voor betere bescherming van intersekse kinderen

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care whether intersex children in the Netherlands undergo non-medically necessary procedures without informed consent, and related questions on the UN torture committee's recommendations, the WGBO, a broad quality standard, and whether the law should ban such procedures. The minister said no such reports are known to the IGJ, referred to existing legal remedies, stated the existing legal framework already prohibits procedures without consent and that no legal change is needed, and said a broad quality standard covering children and adults is being developed.
As I indicated in the answer to earlier parliamentary questions, no reports are known to the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ).
1 2 Antwoord 1 Zoals ik in het antwoord op eerdere Kamervragen 3 heb aangegeven zijn er geen meldingen bekend bij de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘UMC overtrad wet bij onderzoek galwegkanker’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that Amsterdam UMC broke the law in a gallbladder cancer study and mishandled other trials, including whether the IGJ should investigate further and why inspection results on the Strider study were not published. The Minister regretted late patient notification, said no new IGJ investigation is needed as improvements are underway, and explained that Article 29 of the WMO legally prevents publication of the inspection report, to change under the EU Clinical Trial Regulation expected in 2020.
This is legally not possible under Article 29 of the Medical Research Involving Human Subjects Act (WMO).
Dit is wettelijk niet mogelijk op grond van artikel 29 van de Wet medisch-wetenschappelijk onderzoek met mensen (WMO)
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Kerstens en Gijs van Dijk over zich ADO-supporters noemende personen die onder ander het monument De Dokwerker in Amsterdam hebben beklad

MPs Kuiken, Kerstens and Gijs van Dijk asked the ministers about ADO Den Haag supporters who defaced the De Dokwerker monument in Amsterdam, including criminal investigation, camera footage, administrative measures, stadium bans and antisemitism in sport. The government answered that a report was filed and is with the Public Prosecution Service, declined to discuss the investigation or evidence, pointed to the mayor's powers and the KNVB's private-law stadium bans, and described existing anti-discrimination policy in football.
