In the interest of the investigation, I cannot make further statements about the investigation.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Ploumen over onvoldoende toegang tot seksuele en reproductieve zorg voor ongedocumenteerde vrouwen

MPs Ellemeet and Ploumen asked whether undocumented women face barriers to sexual and reproductive care, including unaffordable abortion care despite the maximum tariff, and whether the government will act. Minister De Jonge replied that the maximum tariff gives clinics flexibility and financial buffers, that existing prevention programmes reach high-risk groups, and that he sees no need for additional measures.
I see no reason to take additional measures.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om aanvullende maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat het aantal vrouwen met een borstimplantaat dat lymfeklierkanker heeft gekregen explosief is gestegen

MP Ploumen asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports of rising breast implant-associated ALCL cases, whether women are adequately informed, whether incidents are reported to the IGJ and made public, and what measures will be taken. The Minister answered that ALCL reporting increased partly due to awareness and more implantations, that research and a RIVM assessment of the French ban are underway, that incidents will be reported directly to the IGJ after a likely law change, and that stopping implant use is not legally possible.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over de vergoeding van vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen van lesbische en alleenstaande vrouwen

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked the Minister of Medical Care about unclear reimbursement of fertility treatment (donor insemination) for lesbian and single women, and about the Zorginstituut's position. The minister replied that without a medical indication such treatment is not covered by the basic insurance, that a decision on government financing will come around summer 2019, and that insurers will keep reimbursing ongoing cases during 2019.
Your House will receive a cabinet position around the summer on the financing of fertility treatments without a medical indication, so that clarity arises for everyone before 2020.
Uw Kamer ontvangt rond de zomer een standpunt van het kabinet over de financiering van vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen zonder medische indicatie, zodat vóór 2020 voor iedereen duidelijkheid ontstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bergkamp en Buitenweg over het kweken van wiet als medicijn

MPs Van Nispen, Bergkamp and Buitenweg asked why home cultivation of medicinal cannabis should remain illegal for patients who cannot get adequate relief from the five pharmacy-available varieties, and about the Tilburg case and the court ruling in Jeffrey's favour. The minister answered that the five varieties largely meet need, that home-grown cannabis cannot guarantee consistent quality and dosage, that the appeal against the ruling prevents comment, and that no talks with Tilburg are planned.
An urgent appeal has been lodged against this ruling. I therefore cannot respond to it.
Tegen deze uitspraak is spoedappèl ingesteld. Ik kan hier derhalve geen reactie op geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de vergoeding van kunstmatige inseminatie

MP Ploumen asked the Minister of Medical Care why single women and lesbian couples are denied reimbursement for donor insemination while women with a male partner without semen are covered, and whether this constitutes discrimination. The Minister answered that reimbursement requires a medical indication under the Zorgverzekeringswet, which single women and lesbian couples lack, and that a decision on government funding for such treatments is expected around summer.
That is not the case when a male partner is absent.
Dat is niet het geval bij het ontbreken van een mannelijke partner.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de petitie ‘Vergoeding vruchtbaarheidsbehandeling voor elke vrouw’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a petition to reimburse fertility treatment for all women, and about the sudden end of insurance coverage for donor insemination for single and lesbian women without a medical indication. The minister answered that insurers will keep covering treatments already started in 2019 and that a decision on public financing from 2020 will follow, while defending the medical-indication criterion as non-discriminatory.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Ellemeet over het bericht waarin minister Bruins aangeeft dat vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen voor alleenstaanden en lesbische vrouwen tijdelijk toch vergoed wordt

MPs Ploumen and Ellemeet asked why the minister does not immediately decide to structurally reimburse insemination for single and lesbian women, and about the timing and handling of reimbursement decisions. The minister replies that reimbursement without a medical indication cannot be funded under the Zvw, that a decision on the government's role will be taken around the summer after further analysis, and that Parliament will be informed then.
The House of Representatives will be informed around the summer about the cabinet's intentions regarding the government's role in financing fertility treatments.
De Tweede Kamer wordt rond de zomer geïnformeerd over de voornemens van het kabinet omtrent de rol van de overheid in de financiering van vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het bericht dat tientallen bedrijven illegaal lipfillers zetten

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports of dozens of companies illegally injecting lip fillers, the status of the cosmetic procedures awareness campaign, website visibility, ZonMW-funded research, and the Inspectorate's enforcement powers. The minister answered that a reclame code is in force, the website was updated, research is nearly finished without a publication date, the Inspectorate acts on risk-based supervision and on signals, and no separate data exist on costs of corrective care.
When there are situations where the patient has suffered harm from a treatment and rules are not followed, the inspectorate will intervene.
Wanneer sprake is van situaties waar de patiënt schade heeft ondervonden van een behandeling en waar niet volgens de regels wordt gehandeld zal de inspectie optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Ziengs over het bericht ‘Sportclubs moeten verduurzaming aantonen’

MPs of the VVD asked the ministers about a requirement that large sports clubs report energy-saving measures by 1 July 2019, with possible fines, and whether clubs run by volunteers should be exempted to avoid higher membership fees. The minister confirmed the reporting duty and its enforcement by municipalities, pointed to support from sports federations and De Groene Club, and said municipalities decide on fines and usually give time to comply.
Sports clubs with questions about the reporting duty can turn to their own sports federation or to De Groene Club.
Sportverenigingen met vragen over de informatieplicht kunnen terecht bij de eigen sportbond of bij De Groene Club.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat kraamverzorgenden achter blijven in salaris

Ploumen asked the minister about reports that kraamverzorgenden earn below the minimum wage when standby hours are counted, and about shortages and working conditions. The minister said pay for standby shifts is a matter for social partners in the cao, that the NZa will start a cost study, and that he passed the petition's findings to the NZa.
It is up to the social partners to make agreements in the cao on the conditions of these shifts.
Het is aan de sociale partners om via de cao afspraken te maken over de voorwaarden van deze diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over Treant en de toekomst van de ziekenhuiszorg in Drenthe en Zuidoost Groningen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about Treant hospital group's financial position, an alleged 10-year survival guarantee, the closure of ER and acute maternity services in Hoogeveen and Stadskanaal, and the plan's broad support. The Minister replied that the kernteam plan is not a decision, that no survival guarantee was given, Treant remains responsible for its finances, and consultation with stakeholders will follow.
No survival guarantee has been given. The Treant Zorggroep remains itself responsible for its (financial) business operations.
Er is geen bestaansgarantie afgegeven. De Treant Zorggroep blijft zelf verantwoordelijk voor haar (financiële) bedrijfsvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Samenstelling verzekerdenpopulatie bepaalt resultaat zorgverzekeraars’

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister for Medical Care about reports that insurer results depend on the composition of their insured population, the size of voluntary deductible rewards, collective discounts that attract healthy members, and risk equalisation shortcomings for chronically ill people. The Minister answers that insurers should differentiate through procurement, that the voluntary deductible effect is small, that the collective discount will be cut from 10% to 5% from 2020 and monitored, and that ex-post equalisation is not preferred.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over de bizarre ontwikkelingen in de strijd om patiënten na het faillissement van het MC Zuiderzee in Lelystad

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about curators' conduct after the bankruptcy of MC Zuiderzee, including the removal of specialists, patient records handling, and whether the Inspectorate should investigate. The minister declined to intervene in the dispute between curators and specialists, said the Inspectorate saw no safety indication, and described safeguards for patient records and free choice of doctor.
I do not interfere in a matter between curators and two individual medical specialists.
Ik meng mij niet in een zaak tussen curatoren en twee individuele medisch specialisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het tekort aan bedden bij de kinderafdeling van het AmsterdamUMC

SP MPs asked the health minister about a shortage of paediatric intensive care beds at AmsterdamUMC after the VUmc child ICU closed, and whether the merger reduced capacity. The minister replied that concentration at AMC was planned, bed numbers rose to 10 operational with a target of 16, and staffing shortages and sick leave persist while the IGJ maintains its usual oversight.
The Amsterdam UMC has informed me that, like many hospitals in the Netherlands, it faces a staffing shortage in the paediatric ICU.
Het Amsterdam UMC heeft mij laten weten dat het, net als veel ziekenhuizen in Nederland, kampt met een personeelstekort op de kinder-IC.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de voorgenomen verplaatsing van OK-dagbehandelingen van Woerden naar Utrecht en Nieuwegein

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the planned move of about 3,000 day-surgery patients from Woerden to Utrecht and Nieuwegein, and whether the regional care picture was mapped before the decision. The minister answered that the hospital made the decision, that no complete regional care picture exists yet but an insurer is working on it, and that the Woerden site will be kept and strengthened, while declining to provide detailed adherence figures.
I do not have this detailed information.
Over deze gedetailleerde informatie beschik ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over een ziekenhuis in Amsterdam dat statushouders wil inzetten bij de verpleging

An MP asked the minister about a recruitment agency seeking refugees (statushouders) for an Amsterdam hospital, whether hospitals should train them, who pays for language training, whether Dutch candidates get trial placements, and whether priority schemes for refugees should end. The minister answered that hospitals choose their own recruitment, that candidates bear their own training and language costs, that Dutch candidates also qualify for trial placements, and that there is no priority scheme, while promising to draw employers' attention to underrepresented groups.
There is therefore no question of a priority scheme.
Van een voorrangsregeling is dan ook geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Hoe China de WHO misbruikt voor zijn eigen agenda’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about WHO's inclusion of a traditional medicine chapter in ICD-11 and whether it benefits China's commercial or political agenda. The minister replied that the chapter is an optional registration tool with no diagnostic role, that the Netherlands took no independent position, and that adoption will be decided at the 2019 World Health Assembly.
I have no overview of the input of the individual countries.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de inbreng van de individuele landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat patiënten kankermedicijnen kregen uit een afgekeurde Chinese fabriek

MP Ploumen asked whether cancer patients received medicines made from ingredients from a rejected Chinese factory, why the IGJ allowed two such ingredients to stay on the market, and why it did not name the manufacturers or inform patients and doctors. Minister Bruins answered that the IGJ judged the two critical medicines necessary and found no contamination, withheld manufacturer names under confidentiality law before the registration holders agreed to disclosure, and said the IGJ will talk with patient and professional groups about communication.

Under article 10(1)(c) of the Government Information (Public Access) Act, information is withheld where it concerns business and manufacturing data confidentially provided to the government by natural or legal persons.

Op grond van artikel 10, lid 1, aanhef en onder c van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (Wob) blijft het verstrekken van informatie achterwege indien dit bedrijfs- en fabricagegegevens betreft die door natuurlijke personen of rechtspersonen vertrouwelijk aan de overheid zijn meegedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Aantal buitenlandse tandartsen in Nederland neemt fors toe’

An SP MP asked the Health and Education ministers about reports that foreign dentists are increasingly working in the Netherlands, and whether enough Dutch dentists are being trained. The minister answered that about 14% of registered dentists have a non-Dutch nationality, roughly doubling since 2009, that the government does not actively recruit abroad, and that the cost of expanding training places will be reported in the Voorjaarsnota.

The Minister of OCW and I will inform the House with the Voorjaarsnota about the costs of following the advice of the Capacity Body on the required number of training places in Dentistry and Oral Health Sciences.

De Minister van OCW en ik zullen de Kamer bij Voorjaarsnota informeren over wat de kosten zijn van het opvolgen van het advies van het Capaciteitsorgaan over het benodigde aantal opleidingsplaatsen Tandheelkunde en Mondzorgkunde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het recht krijgen na een medische misser

An SP MP asks the health minister whether large financial disputes after medical errors, exceeding the 25,000 euro limit, cause serious problems, whether outdated cases show where the system fails, how many care providers use foreign insurers, and whether litigation costs deter victims from pursuing claims. The minister replies that the 25,000 euro threshold is intended for simpler cases, that the GOMA code and the Wkkgz have improved patient positions with an evaluation planned, that about 95% of liability is insured domestically with the rest abroad for unknown reasons, and that instead of compensating legal costs the answer lies in better patient handling by providers.
The Wkkgz will be evaluated next year.
Het komende jaar zal de Wkkgz worden geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Geen plek voor nieuwe poli in Arnhem-Zuid’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about Rijnstate hospital's plan to move the Arnhem-Zuid outpatient clinic to Elst, its reasons, whether the municipality and residents were consulted, and whether competition played a role. The minister answered that the plans are not yet decided, that the hospital and insurers bear first responsibility for such choices, that the hospital consults stakeholders and will decide by year end, and that the municipality is responsible for informing its council.
When making choices about the internal organisation of care and its location, the hospital's Executive Board and the health insurers are primarily responsible.
Bij het maken van keuzes rondom de (interne) organisatie van zorgaanbod en de locatie daarvan zijn de Raad van Bestuur van het ziekenhuis en de zorgverzekeraars als eerste verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Kuik en Agnes Mulder over het verdwijnen van de spoedeisende zorg in Hoogeveen en Stadskanaal

Three CDA MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about the planned closure of the emergency departments in Hoogeveen and Stadskanaal, including ambulance response times, the role of the ambulance services and regional administrators, and the RIVM accessibility analysis. The Minister replied that the regional core team's plan is not yet a decision, that the RIVM analysis shows the 45-minute norm would still be met, and that the ambulance services are involved in a regional steering group with IGJ and NZa monitoring continuity and quality.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Parkeren bij ziekenhuizen weer duurder’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about rising hospital parking fees, whether parking should be free or at most cost-covering for patients, and whether the government will negotiate with VNG and hospital associations. The minister replied that parking policy is the responsibility of hospitals and municipalities, pointed to the expanded patient transport scheme, and said he will urge hospitals to inform patients about discounts and remind VNG and hospital associations of the recurring questions, but will not steer national parking tariffs.
Parking policy and tariffs are the responsibility of hospitals and municipalities themselves.
Het parkeerbeleid en de tarieven zijn een verantwoordelijkheid van ziekenhuizen en gemeenten zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het advies over protonentherapie bij kinderen

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the Health Council's advice on proton therapy for children, including the composition of the advisory committee, its ties to the Prinses Máxima Centrum, the hospital-based requirement and whether the Delft centre can be used. The Minister answered that the committee was carefully composed, that the chair is independent, that the hospital criterion is maintained for safety and care quality, and that the Delft centre's capacity can be used without child patients.
The Health Council proceeded carefully to ensure sufficient expertise was present on the committee while preventing conflicts of interest from playing a role in formulating the advice.

De Gezondheidsraad is zorgvuldig te werk gegaan, om te waarborgen dat er voldoende deskundigheid in de commissie aanwezig was en tegelijkertijd te voorkomen dat belangenverstrengeling een rol zou spelen bij het formuleren van het advies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat het testen van pillen op festivals levens redt

Ms Bergkamp (D66) asked whether a UK study showing drug testing at festivals saves lives should lead to festival testing in the Netherlands. State Secretary Blokhuis answered that the Netherlands already has the DIMS monitoring and testing network with about 30 locations, that festival testing raises legal, practical, technical and financial problems and would send the wrong signal under the zero-tolerance policy, and that more test locations are expected.
In the Netherlands drugs can be tested, namely through the Drugs Information and Monitoring System (DIMS).
In Nederland kunnen drugs wel getest worden, namelijk via het Drugs Informatie en Monitoring Systeem (DIMS).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Machtsmisbruik dreigt door datamonopolie van farmaceuten’

An MP asks the Minister for Medical Care whether the EU Falsified Medicines Directive's verification database gives pharmaceutical firms a data monopoly and whether it hinders transparency, cost and access for small suppliers. The minister denies that industry can access the database, explains the cost structure and transition rules, and says the data are pseudonymised and supervised by the IGJ.
A monopoly of the pharmaceutical industry on access to the European database is therefore not an issue.
Een monopolie van de farmaceutische industrie op toegang tot de Europese database is derhalve niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het data-lek bij het ziekenhuis OLVG waardoor onbevoegde studenten medische dossiers hebben ingezien

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a data leak at hospital OLVG that let unauthorised student workers view patient records, whether patients were informed, whether access was closed, and whether a plan exists to address such leaks and to limit sharing to a basic patient-controlled dataset. The minister said the hospital reported the breach to the data protection authority, tightened access and privacy training, and is investigating; sector-wide, he cited existing rules, Z-CERT, a planned obligation to join it and a broader action plan, while rejecting a single basic dataset as impractical.
The OLVG is investigating the records that were unlawfully viewed by unauthorised student workers.
Het OLVG doet onderzoek naar de dossiers die onrechtmatig zijn ingezien door onbevoegde werkstudenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht antidepressiva onder vuur

An SP MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about reports linking SSRI antidepressants (notably Seroxat) to aggression and suicide risk, the GSK collective claim, prescription levels including for children, and a total advertising ban. The minister acknowledges documented side effects, points to ongoing EMA pharmacovigilance monitoring, defends prescribing under guidelines, and says advertising to professionals is adequately regulated.
Given the attention the professional groups pay to carefully handling antidepressants, I currently see no task for me in this.
Gezien de aandacht die de beroepsgroepen besteden aan het zorgvuldig omgaan met antidepressiva, acht ik vooralsnog hierbij geen taak voor mij weggelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de Pacemaker Protector (Pace-Pro)

An MP asks whether the Pacemaker Protector (Pace-Pro), which protects a pacemaker during sport, should be reimbursed under the basic insurance package, especially for children, and questions why insurers do not cover it while replacement pacemakers are covered. The minister replies that a protector can be supplied within the hospital DBC if the treating doctor deems it necessary, that insurers have no duty to reimburse it directly, and that no further action is needed.
It is already possible for a medical aid protecting a heart implant to be reimbursed from the basic package.
Het is nu al mogelijk dat een medisch hulpmiddel ter bescherming van een hartimplantaat uit het basispakket wordt vergoed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Jacques werd 2 jaar lang opgesloten om te 'genezen' van zijn homoseksualiteit’

MP Bergkamp asked whether exposing people to conversion therapy to remove homosexual feelings violates current law, whether the IGJ can supervise such providers, and whether a ban for minors is advisable. Minister Bruins answered that homosexuality is not an illness so healthcare cannot aim at curing it, that IGJ does not supervise non-medical therapies but can refer abuse to the Public Prosecution Service, and that he has no data on the scale of the practice.
IGJ therefore does not exercise supervision in situations of this kind.
IGJ houdt op dit soort situaties dan ook geen toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de vergoeding van kunstmatige inseminatie

MP Ploumen asked whether insemination for single women and lesbian couples had been reimbursed for social reasons, how many used it, and whether the basic insurance would be amended to cover such cases. The minister replied that absence of a male partner is not a medical indication, insurers are tightening checks, and he will not amend the Zorgverzekeringswet because it would fundamentally change the insured package and undermine solidarity.
I therefore do not intend to amend the Health Insurance Act to this effect.
Ik ben dan ook niet van plan de Zorgverzekeringswet hierop aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Van Gerven en Ploumen over de ambulancezorg in de gemeente Gennep

MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about the closure of the Gennep ambulance post, response times against the 15-minute norm, the role of insurers VGZ and CZ, cross-border mutual aid, and whether regional mayors must be consulted before closures. The Minister said the norm applies regionally, insurers did not fund the Gennep post directly, mutual-aid arrangements were tightened, and a national action plan and an AMvB on acute care availability are in progress, but no binding consultation duty for ambulance post closures.
This norm relates to the level of the (safety) region and not to the level of individual municipalities.
Deze norm heeft betrekking op het niveau van de (veiligheids)regio en niet op het niveau van individuele gemeenten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘ZiN-Rapport over de mondgezondheid van kinderen biedt onvoldoende basis voor beleidskeuzen’

An MP asks the Minister for Medical Care whether a TNO oral-health study of children is representative and whether the Zorginstituut may rely on it, given claims by the Ivoren Kruis dental association that it is not. The minister rejects the criticism, saying the study was representative, that children without dental visits were included, and that monitoring is under discussion with stakeholders.

I therefore am of the view, together with TNO and the Zorginstituut, that the report is sufficiently representative to draw conclusions about the oral health of young people in the Netherlands in general.

Ik ben dan ook van oordeel, met TNO en het Zorginstituut, dat het rapport voldoende representatief is om conclusies te trekken ten aanzien van de mondgezondheid van jeugdigen in Nederland in het algemeen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het ‘Voorlopig advies Capaciteitsorgaan tandartsen en mondhygiënisten’

An MP asks the ministers how they respond to the Capacity Body's provisional advice to raise annual dentist training intake to 311 students, and whether they will adopt it. The minister replies that the full analysis is still pending later in 2019 and that the costs of implementing the advice will be reported in the spring budget memorandum, without yet committing to the increase.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de brandbrief inzake een dichte dienstapotheek

An MP asked the health minister about a letter from pharmacists in the Hoeksche Waard concerning the night closure of the on-call pharmacy, the use of doctors' medicine bags, and reported calamities. The minister said falling prescriptions do not imply doctors dispensing widely, that doctors may dispense from their bags without notifying pharmacies, and that the inspectorate treats the three reports through its regular procedure.
The report is assessed by the inspectorate under the regular procedure and taken up where necessary.
De melding wordt volgens de reguliere werkwijze door de inspectie beoordeeld en zo nodig in behandeling genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Dik-Faber en Remco Dijkstra over de doorlooptijden bij het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

MPs asked why driving licence renewals at the CBR take so long, leaving people without valid licences and at risk of losing their jobs, and about poor communication and the four-week response standard. The minister acknowledged the delays, described CBR capacity expansion, priority handling for expiring licences and professional drivers, and extra information measures, but did not discuss specific cases.
The CBR must provide clarity on the renewal of the driving licence within four months. Unfortunately, this is currently not achieved in all cases by the CBR.
Het CBR dient binnen vier maanden duidelijkheid te geven over de vernieuwing van het rijbewijs. Dit wordt op dit moment helaas niet in alle gevallen gehaald door het CBR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het niet vergoeden van een uitname van siliconenprotheses op basis van siliconenincompatibiliteit door zorgverzekeraar Zilveren Kruis Achmea

MP Van Gerven asked the minister why insurer Zilveren Kruis Achmea refused to reimburse removal of a silicone breast implant for a patient whose specialist considered it indicated, and whether the Zorginstituut standpoint entitles such patients to reimbursement. The minister answered that the insurer's refusal was consistent with the Zorginstituut conditions, since no prior treatments were documented, and that the patient can turn to the SKGZ dispute body.
Zorginstituut Nederland stated in its standpoint of 31 May 2018 in which situations there is a medical necessity for removing (explantation) a breast implant
Zorginstituut Nederland heeft in zijn standpunt van 31 mei 2018 uitgesproken in welke situaties sprake is van een medische noodzaak voor het verwijderen (explantatie) van een borstimplantaat
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kuiken en Ellemeet over demonstranten die vrouwen intimideren voor abortusklinieken

Three MPs asked whether anti-abortion demonstrators intimidating women outside clinics is acceptable, how far demonstration rights extend, whether such conduct is criminal, and whether the government will meet clinics and municipalities. The minister said such intimidation is undesirable, that demonstrations are widespread but usually not intimidating, that municipalities can impose conditions and APV rules may cover the conduct, and that a joint meeting with clinics and municipalities will be held before the summer recess.
With due regard to the substantive responsibilities of local government, I will invite the municipalities concerned and the abortion clinics to a joint consultation before the summer recess.
Met inachtneming van de inhoudelijke verantwoordelijkheden van het lokale gezag, zal ik voor het zomerreces de betrokken gemeenten en de abortusklinieken uitnodigen voor een gezamenlijk overleg
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de last van het lijden en het krijgen van je recht na een medische misser

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a 2005 birth injury case, the Inspectorate's handling of it, the slow court procedures, and whether a no-fault compensation fund or a central liability body should replace the current insurer-driven system. The minister said the case was not reported as a calamity, declined to re-examine or meet the families, defended the existing complaint and arbitration routes, and rejected a no-fault system and a central body.
The Dijklanderziekenhuis has stated that it has not yet received information that a procedure has been brought before the European Court.
Het Dijklanderziekenhuis heeft laten weten nog geen informatie ontvangen te hebben dat er een procedure bij het Europese Hof aanhangig is gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Peters over de zorg voor en begeleiding van (oud-)topsporters

MPs Bruins Slot and Peters asked about mental health and career-end support for current and former top athletes, including a symposium, prevalence research, whether TeamNL offers structural post-career support, and whether a dedicated programme for former athletes is needed. The minister answered that research shows mental problems comparable to the general population, that TeamNL@Work provides tailored post-career support, and that NOC*NSF will explore enriching it with input from former athletes.
The project is still under development and NOC*NSF will in the coming period look at how current support can be further enriched, with input from former top athletes.
Het project is nog volop in ontwikkeling en NOC*NSF zal de komende tijd dan ook kijken naar hoe de huidige ondersteuning verder verrijkt kan worden, met de inbreng van oud-topsporters.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Apothekers doen aan verborgen export van pillen’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that pharmacists export medicines abroad while shortages exist in the Netherlands, and about pharmacist income and a possible national purchasing body. The minister said export of shortage drugs is undesirable and prohibited under agreements, that no hard evidence yet shows it, that the IGJ is investigating a report and is examining oddities, and declined a separate independent study, a national purchasing organisation and gave partial answers on income and a supply obligation.
If there is concrete information showing that this does happen, the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) would like to receive it so that it can investigate.
Als er concrete informatie is waaruit blijkt dat dit wel gebeurt, dan ontvangt de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) deze informatie graag zodat zij dit kan onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat apothekers schaarse medicijnen doorsluizen naar het buitenland

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care whether pharmacies are exporting scarce medicines abroad, how many patients were affected, and what measures will stop it. The minister said such export during shortages is undesirable, that the Inspectorate (IGJ) is investigating supply problems including the contraceptive pill, and that further measures will depend on those findings.
The scale on which medicines are exported abroad is unknown.
Het is onbekend op welke schaal geneesmiddelen naar het buitenland worden geëxporteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de mogelijkheid om gentherapie toegankelijk en betaalbaar te houden voor wie dat nodig heeft

An MP asks the health minister whether gene therapies could be paid in instalments tied to patient survival and quality of life to keep them affordable. The minister says pricing is for the Zorginstituut to advise on, that Kymriah has no price agreement for its approved indication, and that the instalment model will be considered only once a concrete case arises, with no commitment on the calculation requested.
I am willing to look into this further if a case arises in which this is possible.
Ik ben bereid om hier verder naar te kijken indien er zich een casus voordoet waarbij dit mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Politie zoekt getuigen van levensgevaarlijke rit over wielerparcours’

MPs Dijkstra and Heerema asked about police escort of cycling races, the legality of volunteer 'motards' directing traffic, and whether organisers should fund police presence. The minister answered that motards may not direct traffic while riding, that the police role is supervisory, and that the government will consult the KNWU and other parties on possible problems if police involvement is reduced.
Yes. I consider it important to get the possible problems clearly in view and to jointly explore possible solutions, including regarding the deployment of motards.
Ja. Ik vind het belangrijk om de mogelijke problemen goed in beeld te krijgen en gezamenlijk mogelijke oplossingen te verkennen, ook waar het gaat om de inzet van motards.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Van Eijs over het bericht omtrent schadelijke stoffen in lippenbalsem

MPs De Groot and Van Eijs asked the health minister about a Belgian study finding possibly carcinogenic mineral oil fractions (MOSH/MOAH) in children's lip balms sold in the Netherlands, and whether Dutch regulation and NVWA inspection were adequate. The minister replied that the Cosmetics Regulation prohibits carcinogenic mineral oils, that the NVWA had requested the study data and saw no reason for additional research or inspection, and that the ingredients are labelled as paraffinum liquidum and similar terms.
The NVWA therefore sees no reason to carry out additional research.
De NVWA ziet dan ook geen aanleiding om aanvullend onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het bericht ‘Meldingen seksueel overschrijdend gedrag in sport vorig jaar verdubbeld’

An MP asked whether the doubling of reported sexual misconduct in sport reflects more abuse or greater awareness, what steps are needed, how sports bodies, police and prosecutors share information, and progress on the De Vries commission recommendations. The minister says rising reports mainly reflect greater attention, outlines a mandatory reporting duty for sports club leaders due by 2020, a convenant and work document with police and prosecutors, and annual progress reports to parliament.
In addition, the Minister of Medical Care and Sport will inform you annually, prior to the WGO sport, about the progress of implementing the De Vries commission recommendations.
Daarnaast zal de Minister van Medische Zorg en Sport u jaarlijks, voorafgaand aan het WGO sport, informeren over de voortgang van de implementatie van de aanbevelingen Commissie de Vries.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ploumen over het bericht 'Ziekenhuis Bronovo dicht door tekort aan personeel'

MPs Kerstens and Ploumen asked about the closure of Bronovo hospital due to staff shortages, requesting an overview of hospitals with staff-related service cuts, vacancy and self-employed figures, and measures to address shortages. The minister said staffing is one cause among several in HMC's consolidation to two sites, cited national capacity data without a list of affected hospitals, and pointed to funding and the Werken in de Zorg programme as measures.
There is no overview of hospitals that must postpone or relocate care due to a staff shortage.
Er is geen overzicht van ziekenhuizen die zorg moeten uitstellen of verplaatsen vanwege een tekort aan personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Ploumen over beperking van de geitenhouderij

MPs Moorlag and Ploumen asked whether provinces restricting goat farming, which may push farms into other provinces, call for national policy such as a national settlement ban or herd cap, given the health risks. The minister answered that eight provinces have temporary bans on new or expanded stables under the precautionary principle, that municipalities and provinces may set their own conditions, and that no national ban or cap is being considered until the cause of the elevated pneumonia risk is found, with follow-up research due in 2020.
A national settlement ban or a national maximum on the number of goats is not being considered at this time for that reason.
Een nationaal vestigingsverbod of een nationaal maximum aan het aantal geiten wordt om die reden op dit moment niet overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Grote ICT-storing treft ziekenhuis, maar Luus (hier 10 uur oud) komt gewoon’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a major IT outage at hospitals in Alkmaar and Den Helder, whether backup emergency plans exist in all hospitals, and whether the OVV investigation covers this. The minister answered that hospitals are themselves responsible for emergency scenarios, that the Noordwest group has one in place, that the IGJ inspects continuity, and that OVV findings expected in Q3 will determine further action.
I am not aware of which hospitals do or do not have emergency scenarios for IT outages.
Het is mij niet bekend welke ziekenhuizen wel of geen noodscenario’s hebben voor ICT-storingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Vrouwen zoeken vaker én eerder hulp na verkrachting’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Bergkamp asked whether forensic evidence collection at Centres for Sexual Violence costs victims their own-risk payment, and how to exempt such care from it. The government answered that forensic costs are borne by the justice chain, medical care falls under the deductible, and it is piloting a one-year temporary scheme to reimburse the deductible for acute-phase victims while pointing victims to the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven.

We are working towards a temporary one-year arrangement under which victims of sexual violence seeking help at the CSG in the acute phase receive reimbursement of the costs incurred for the deductible.

Zo zetten wij erop in om een tijdelijke voorziening voor één jaar in te richten waarbij slachtoffers van seksueel geweld die in de acute fase hulp zoeken bij het CSG, een vergoeding krijgen van de gemaakte kosten voor het eigen risico.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Nijmeegse huisarts Hanneke: zorg te duur voor minima, levensgevaarlijk’

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that people with low incomes skip necessary care, such as check-ups and physiotherapy, because of the deductible and limited basic package, and asked for a response to calls for more income-dependent care. The minister acknowledges the problem is undesirable, points to existing compensation measures (zorgtoeslag, exemptions, gemeentepolissen, information campaigns) and says the Zvw is already partly income-dependent, without committing to new measures.
It is undesirable if people avoid necessary care because of the deductible.
Het is ongewenst als mensen vanwege het eigen risico noodzakelijke zorg mijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over korte termijn gevolgen van het faillissement van het MC IJsselmeerziekenhuizen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Medical Care about short-term consequences of the bankruptcy of MC IJsselmeerziekenhuizen, including whether Sint Jansdal hospital refuses talks with the local action group, when care arrangements for the region would be known, and whether Antonius hospital in Sneek has had a rheumatology patient stop since July 2018. The Minister answered that Sint Jansdal is engaging with stakeholders, referred to a separate letter on the status of the hospitals for incidents and arrangements, and described alternative rheumatology care options and a pending insurer decision.
For the answer to these questions I refer you to my letter to the House today on the state of affairs regarding MC Slotervaart and the MC IJsselmeerziekenhuizen.
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik graag naar mijn brief van heden aan de Kamer met betrekking tot de stand van zaken van MC Slotervaart en de MC IJsselmeerziekenhuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht ‘Oproep minister aan 18-jarige zegt niets over automatisch donorschap’

An MP asked why a letter to 18-year-olds about organ donation did not mention that from 1 July 2020 non-registration means automatic donor status, and why it was not linked to the ongoing campaign on the new donor law. The minister answered that the letter was tested before the campaign message was finalised, that neutral information on the new law is the policy, and that non-registered people will be contacted personally before 1 July 2020.

Everyone who is still not registered in the Donor Register on 1 July 2020 will then be personally written to with a request to register and informed of the consequence of not registering one's own choice.

Daarnaast wordt iedereen die op 1 juli 2020 nog niet geregistreerd staat in het Donorregister daarna persoonlijke aangeschreven met het verzoek zich te registreren en geïnformeerd wat de consequentie is van het niet registreren van een eigen keuze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het nieuws dat een farmaceut een diagnosemiddel voor prostaatkanker plots driemaal zo duur maakt

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a sudden threefold price rise for gallium, a prostate cancer diagnostic agent, and related questions on hospital budgets, supplier dependence, radiopharmaceuticals and the Pallas reactor. The minister called the price rise remarkable and in need of explanation from the supplier, saw no signs of hospital financial problems, and largely pointed to hospitals, insurers and the existing pricing framework rather than committing to new state measures.
Hospitals make agreements with health insurers about budgets and volumes.
Ziekenhuizen maken met zorgverzekeraars afspraken over budget en volumes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de sluiting van de nachtapotheken in Goes en Terneuzen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Medical Care whether the closure of night pharmacies in Goes and Terneuzen was caused by EU state-aid rules, how the decision was reached, whether the robot pharmacy in Oostburg is adequate, and what patients will pay for courier delivery. The minister denied the state-aid link, said the subsidy was withdrawn for lack of efficiency, defended the local decision-making, and gave the other answers mostly by referring to local arrangements and existing practice.
However, the organisation of out-of-hours pharmaceutical care locally is a local matter, for the health insurer and care providers.
De inrichting van de ANZ-zorg ter plaatse is echter een lokale aangelegenheid, van zorgverzekeraar en zorgverleners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de sluiting van nachtapotheken in Zeeland

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about closing night pharmacies in Goes and Terneuzen, leaving Vlissingen as the only one for Zeeland, and the effects on patients' access, prices and the end of the state subsidy. The Minister answered that the arrangement was agreed regionally, that prices will fall and that no patient will be left without necessary medication, without committing to a new national measure.
For Zeeland residents and tourists it no longer matters at which location they collect their medication; after 1 April 2019 the out-of-hours surcharge is identical everywhere.
Het maakt voor Zeeuwen en toeristen niet meer uit op welke locatie zij hun medicatie op halen, na 1 april 2019 is overal de ANZ toeslag identiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de behandeling met gesuperviseerde oefentherapie bij COPD/emfyseempatiënten

An SP MP asked the Minister whether new limits on supervised exercise therapy for COPD, which penalise patients without exacerbations and add bureaucracy, should be changed. The Minister defended the new GOLD-based caps as evidence-based on Zorginstituut advice, pointed to a KNGF guide and talks with professional bodies, and declined to change the benefit.
I therefore do not intend to change anything about the benefit.
Ik ben daarom niet voornemens iets aan de aanspraak te veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de aanbevelingen van het VN Comité tegen Foltering voor betere bescherming van intersekse kinderen

An MP asked the health minister about UN Committee against Torture recommendations on protecting intersex children and whether medically unnecessary surgery should be postponed until consent is possible. The minister acknowledged the need for better collaboration and a quality standard, but declined to commission new research or a protocol, stating that protocols are for professionals and existing guidelines and parental consent rules apply.
I do not have exact figures on how many newborns do not have an immediately clear sex, how often these children are operated on
Ik beschik niet over exacte cijfers bij hoeveel pasgeborenen het geslacht niet meteen eenduidig kan worden vastgesteld, hoe vaak deze kinderen worden geopereerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de zesvoudige prijsstijging van kankermedicijn veroorzaakt door Novartis

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the sixfold price increase of the cancer drug Lutathera by Novartis, including the company's acquisition of the raw-material supplier and the conduct of a Erasmus MC researcher. The minister condemned the price as excessive and unjustified, said Novartis must offer a reasonable price, and noted competition-law routes while giving no guarantees and committing only to further talks with Novartis.
I have therefore held discussions with delegations of Novartis.
Ik heb daarom gesprekken gevoerd met delegaties van Novartis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat er weer een farmaceut is die de prijs van een weesgeneesmiddel maar liefst zes keer verhoogd

An MP asked whether the government will act against Novartis raising the price of the orphan drug Lutathera from about 16,000 euro per course (hospital-made) to over 90,000 euro, and what steps will prevent such pricing. The minister condemned the price rise, said he met Novartis which could not justify it, said existing rules allow hospital compounding, and promised a NFU-led commission report on responsible licensing and further information on reimbursement abroad.
I have made clear that I disapprove of this conduct and will not accept it.
Ik heb laten weten dat ik deze handelwijze afkeur en niet wil accepteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de onjuiste informatie die door apothekers verspreid wordt over geneesmiddelentekorten

Ploumen (PvdA) asked the minister whether apothecaries are wrong to blame low Dutch drug prices for shortages, including the KNMP's claim and questions on the 2018 oral contraceptive shortage, stockpiling duties, and whether agreements with industry would be put to parliament first. Minister Bruins answers that shortages are a global supply-chain problem, that low prices are not proven as the cause, that stockpile arrangements are still under discussion with stakeholders, and that he will not commit to submitting binding agreements to parliament in advance.
Are you willing to commit to making no binding agreement or arrangement with pharmacists, wholesalers and pharmaceutical manufacturers without first submitting it to the House? If not, why not?

Bent u bereid toe te zeggen dat u geen bindende overeenkomst of afspraak met apothekers, groothandels en farmaceutische fabrikanten maakt zonder deze eerst aan de Kamer voor te leggen? Zo nee, waarom niet?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Oproep ‘noodregeling’ voor pil die hiv kan voorkomen’

MPs Ellemeet and Dijkstra asked the Minister of Medical Care whether PrEP reimbursement could start in early 2019 after advocacy groups urged an emergency arrangement, and about the pros and cons of national purchasing versus purchasing by pharmacists. The Minister said the RIVM advice was received on 18 December and is under consideration, that implementation is aimed for mid-2019, and that a decision on purchasing will be sent to the House soon.
Soon I will inform the House of my decision on how the reimbursement of PrEP will be implemented.
Binnenkort zal ik uw Kamer informeren over mijn besluit hoe de vergoeding van PrEP zal worden geïmplementeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat weer meer medicijnen niet leverbaar zijn

The MP Pia Dijkstra (D66) asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports of rising medicine shortages in 2018, their causes, comparison with other EU states, the KNMP claim that low prices contribute, progress on the promised sector talks, stockpiling obligations, and EU cooperation. The minister answered that shortages are a Europe-wide problem, that low prices are not shown to cause shortages, that a stock-building agreement and a report from the Meldpunt will follow, and that EU-level cooperation is being pursued.
I will inform your House about this in the second half of 2019.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover in de tweede helft van 2019 informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het artikel ‘Zo had ze beter kunnen sterven’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a newspaper article on care for patients with prolonged disorders of consciousness after coma, and about the status of conditional reimbursement for early intensive neurorehabilitation (VIN). The minister answered that conditional admission was not pursued, that a clarified standard of usual care now allows insurers to reimburse VIN, and that further bottlenecks and a prospective study are being addressed.
Ultimately, no choice was made for a Conditional Admission.
Uiteindelijk is er niet gekozen voor een Voorwaardelijke Toelating.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Van Gent over het bericht ‘Wantrouwen: het verkeerde uitgangspunt’

Two VVD MPs asked why patients must give separate consent forms before treating doctors can share medical records, and whether opt-out or broader one-time consent is possible. The minister replied that the GDPR requires explicit consent, ruling out opt-out and blanket consent, and that the GTS programme is exploring a registered-consent scenario, to be discussed with parliament.

The medical professional confidentiality (laid down in the WGBO) guarantees that everyone can freely seek help from a healthcare provider and that patients can be fully open with their treating physician.
Het medisch beroepsgeheim (vastgelegd in de WGBO) garandeert dat iedereen vrijelijk voor hulp bij een zorgverlener kan aankloppen en dat patiënten volledig open naar hun behandelaar kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Von Martels over regels en procedures die mogelijk onderzoek van gentherapie hinderen

MPs Van den Berg and Von Martels asked whether outdated EU and Dutch environmental-risk rules (GGO directives, implemented in the Besluit GGO 2013) hinder gene therapy research, and whether the Netherlands interprets EU rules more strictly than Belgium. The minister explained the permit procedure, denied stricter interpretation, defended the environmental risk framework as necessary, and said the government pushed the Commission for harmonisation and reduced burdens, though the Commission ruled out amending the GGO directives.
The Netherlands does not apply a stricter interpretation of the EU regulations.
Nederland hanteert geen striktere interpretatie van de EU-regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Eijs over het bericht dat Nederland investeringen in gentherapie misloopt

MPs Dijkstra and Van Eijs asked whether the Netherlands applies an extra environmental procedure and stricter interpretation to gene therapy, whether Dutch patients treated abroad need an import permit, and whether Dutch procedures are slower and could be streamlined. The minister replied that gene therapy falls under the GMO environmental release directive as in other states, that no import permit is needed, that procedural differences stem from EU rules, and that two rounds of streamlining already removed national bottlenecks, with an evaluation due in 2019.
The Netherlands has no extra environmental procedure for gene therapy and likewise does not choose to interpret the European rules for gene therapy more strictly than other member states.
Nederland kent voor gentherapie geen extra milieuprocedure en maakt evenmin voor gentherapie de keuze om Europese regels voor gentherapie strenger te interpreteren dan andere lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de noodzaak van nationale regie om de zorg betaalbaar te houden

Opposition MP Ploumen asked the Minister for Medical Care whether national steering is needed to improve cooperation between hospitals and primary care and spread best practices to keep care affordable, and how cooperation fits with competition under the current system. The Minister replied that regional and local cooperation is preferred, that hoofdlijnenakkoorden with sector parties set joint targets, that national steering is not seen as necessary, and that he will facilitate a best-practice website and monitor substitution, committing to ongoing support but not to a national plan.
A national approach does insufficient justice to this fact; there must be room for regional or local tailoring.
Een landelijke aanpak doet aan dit gegeven onvoldoende recht, er moet ruimte zijn voor regionaal of lokaal maatwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van Toorenburg over de rol van instanties rond het langdurig misbruikschandaal in de atletiekwereld

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Toorenburg asked why police and the OM only started an investigation after publication, whether a Rotterdam athletics coach is in the sports misconduct register, and how registers, information-sharing agreements and public disclosure of disciplinary rulings are being developed. The minister answered that ongoing criminal investigations cannot be discussed, that the coach is listed in the register, that a separate sex-offence register is undesirable under the GDPR, and that a joint register and a cooperation document with police and the OM are in preparation.
I do not make statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het gebrek aan landelijke regels voor zwemlessen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why there are few national rules for swimming lessons (instruction, group size, diplomas, supervision) and whether the government will regulate them. The minister answered that safety is primarily self-regulated by the swimming industry under existing rules, that group size is left to providers, and that a role for government will be considered after a national swimming safety plan is delivered in autumn.
That is why I consider it important that swimming lesson providers are adequately equipped for this task and that children become familiar with swimming water and continuously improve their skills.
Daarom vind ik het van belang dat zwemlesaanbieders adequaat toegerust zijn voor deze taak en dat kinderen vertrouwd raken met zwemwater en hun vaardigheden continu verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP asks the government to respond to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, including whether the Netherlands' climate policy is adequate and whether ministers will take further action, and asks about plant-based catering in ministries. The government answers that the questions were answered in a separate Aanhangsel document, so the substance is not stated in this item.
The written questions from MP Akerboom (PvdD), question number 2018Z24294, have been answered by way of Aanhangsel Handelingen, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1305.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Akerboom (PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24294 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1305 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de mogelijke sluiting van het Bronovo ziekenhuis

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether he accepts the Haaglanden Medisch Centrum board's possible closure of the Bronovo and Antoniushove hospitals, and how patient interests, IGJ/NZa oversight, public participation, staffing and the board's motives are addressed. The minister answers that the board and insurers are primarily responsible for the process, that the IGJ and NZa are involved, that a draft ROAZ decree would require broad consultation, and that no decision has yet been taken.
In the process, the hospital board and the health insurers play an important role, but they are not the only ones.
In het proces spelen het bestuur van het ziekenhuis en de zorgverzekeraars weliswaar een belangrijke rol, maar zij zijn niet de enige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de gang van zaken rond de mogelijke sluiting van het Bronovo ziekenhuis

Labour MP Ploumen asks the Minister of Medical Care about the possible closure of Bronovo hospital in The Hague, including the reported confidential restructuring plan, the timing of information to residents, staff, insurers and the municipality, and when the ministry was informed. The Minister answers that no decision has been taken, that the board will publish a preferred scenario on 24 January before consulting stakeholders, and that the ministry was informed by phone in December 2018 and January 2019, while declining to confirm the existence of a restructuring plan.
I do not have a restructuring plan.
Ik beschik niet over een herstructureringsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het tandartsentekort in Limburg

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the warned shortage of dentists in Limburg, including its causes, regional comparisons, waiting lists and the timing of a Capaciteitsorgaan study. The minister said signals are concerning, attributed the shortage to an aging dentist population and unattractiveness of peripheral areas, reported no current access complaints, pointed to task redistribution and the pending study, and promised to inform parliament.
The Capaciteitsorgaan will present the first interim results at the end of January 2019.
Het Capaciteitsorgaan komt eind januari 2019 met de eerste tussentijdse resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Meer patiënten gaan eigen bijdrage medicijnen betalen’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that more patients will pay the medicine co-payment, the risk that manufacturers stop compensation schemes after the 250 euro cap, the number of patients affected, ADHD medicines in the same cost cluster, and whether manufacturers may raise prices. The Minister acknowledges the risks, says the effects will be monitored by the SFK with a first report in early 2020, gives the estimate of about 40,000 beneficiaries, and says the cap keeps price and prescribing incentives in place.
For this, the Stichting Farmaceutische Kengetallen (SFK) will look at the effect on medicine prices, the amount and height of co-payments and the reimbursement schemes.
Daarvoor zal de Stichting Farmaceutische Kengetallen (SFK) kijken naar het effect op de geneesmiddelenprijzen, de hoeveelheid en hoogte van de bijbetalingen en de terugbetaalregelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over verborgen deals van topartsen met de hulpmiddelenindustrie

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about undisclosed consultancy deals between senior doctors and the medical device industry, including whether such contracts should be banned and whether the Transparency Register and the Code of Conduct work. The Minister replies that the gift ban exceptions should be kept, that the Code's secrecy-clause rule would be breached if such clauses exist, and points to EU regulation tightening notified bodies.
I do not believe the statutory exceptions to the gift ban should be abolished.
Ik ben niet van mening de wettelijke uitzonderingen op het verbod op gunstbetoon afgeschaft moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over tekortschietend ziekenvervoer

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care how she judges reports of late and overlong patient transport by taxi, whether clear rules exist under the Zorgverzekeringswet, whether solo transport is available, and whether a minimum per-kilometre rate should be set. The Minister agrees punctual transport matters, says the Bzv contains no timeliness rules and insurers set terms in contracts, notes Menzis's commitments and the pending Zorginstituut analysis, and refuses a minimum rate, pointing to insurers' duty of care and the NZa complaints desk.
The Besluit zorgverzekering (Bzv) provides that insured persons may have transport reimbursed if they fall within one of five listed groups.
In het Besluit zorgverzekering (hierna: Bzv) is opgenomen dat verzekerden vervoer vergoed kunnen krijgen als zij onder een van de vijf genoemde groepen vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Geleijnse over taperingstrips en blunder met niet bestaand onderzoek

MPs Van Gerven and Geleijnse asked the health minister about tapering strips for psychiatric drug withdrawal, a Follow the Money report alleging misleading information from Zilveren Kruis Achmea, and insurer coverage rules. The minister denied being misinformed, said the insurer's conduct is its own responsibility, and stated that insurers may reimburse only rational pharmacotherapy under the basic package.
It is up to the health insurer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het bericht dat veel kankerpatiënten weinig informatie krijgen over het leven na hun behandeling

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that many cancer patients receive little information about life after treatment, including unaddressed late effects, future plans, and differences between hospital types and between men and women. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to outcome information development, shared decision-making campaigns, training, and cooperation with hospitals and insurers, while declining to measure and compare hospitals' shared decision-making practice.
Now measuring and comparing the extent to which care providers apply shared decision-making would partly deprive care providers of the room to learn from each other and innovate on this point.
Nu gaan «meten» en vergelijken in hoeverre zorgaanbieders samen beslissen toepassen, zou zorgaanbieders de ruimte om te leren van elkaar en te innoveren op dit punt deels ontnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de tegemoetkoming Q-koortspatiënten en screening

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the implementation of the Q-fever compensation scheme, whether applications exceeded expectations and reduced per-person amounts, the administrative cost of about 1 million euro, the status of screening for vulnerable people in affected areas, and additional research funding. The minister answered that implementation was not delayed, over 1,550 applications had been received, the 15,000 euro maximum was a cautious gesture rather than damages, 1 million euro covers administration, screening details are in a separate letter with procedures still under discussion, and research funding will run through ZonMw.
As already indicated in the answers to the supplementary budget, there is no delay in setting up the implementation of the compensation scheme.
Zoals reeds aangegeven in de antwoorden bij de suppletoire begroting, is er geen sprake van vertraging bij de inrichting van de uitvoering van de tegemoetkoming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Omtzigt en Van den Berg over voorbereidingen om mogelijke medicijntekorten te voorkomen door een harde Brexit

MPs Slootweg, Omtzigt and Van den Berg asked how medicine shortages from a hard Brexit would be prevented, including supply continuity, registration, stockpiling, patient coverage and Dutch doctors' diploma recognition. The minister answered that the CBG is mapping critical medicines dependent on the UK, IGJ exemptions and alternatives are planned, and the rules for approval and healthcare coverage would be adjusted in a no-deal scenario.
To secure the supply reliability of the critical medicines on the list, several steps will be taken.
Om de leveringszekerheid van de kritieke geneesmiddelen op de lijst te borgen, zullen verschillende stappen worden doorlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over betere communicatie rondom de experimenten gesloten coffeeshopketen

An MP asked the ministers whether misunderstandings about the closed coffeeshop experiment, such as the belief that it automatically ends after four years, were causing declining municipal interest, and how these would be corrected. The minister denied direct signals of declining interest, acknowledged differing municipal preferences, and promised information meetings, written information to all municipalities and a registration procedure with the VNG.
We assume that municipalities will have sufficient clarity about the design and framework of the experiment once the bill has been adopted by the House of Representatives.
Wij gaan ervan uit dat voor gemeenten voldoende duidelijkheid bestaat over de invulling en kaders van het experiment als het wetsvoorstel eenmaal door de Tweede Kamer is aangenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht 'Dit zijn de beste ziekenhuizen van Nederland, ziekenhuis top 100'

An SP MP asked the minister to explain the 36 indicators behind a newspaper ranking of the best hospitals, including how they were selected, whether they measure care quality representatively, and whether complication scores ignore patient complexity. The minister replied that the AD, not the ministry or IGJ, chose and weighted the indicators, that the ministry cannot judge whether the ranking represents care quality or explain the scoring method, and that he sees no evidence hospitals select patients to improve their ranking.
I want to emphasise that the selection of factors and their weighting were carried out by the AD and not by the ministry or the IGJ.
Ik wil benadrukken dat de selectie van factoren en de weging ervan door het AD heeft plaatsgevonden en niet door het ministerie of de IGJ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over gebrekkig toezicht op medische implantaten

An MP asked the health minister about weak oversight of medical implants, including patient access to implant safety information, reporting of incidents and calamities, and a European reporting policy for breast implants. The minister answered that the Implant Register and reporting centre are being strengthened, that manufacturers must report incidents, that a campaign for care providers and a working group on post-market surveillance will follow, and that barcoding agreements are in progress but not fully implemented.
In 2019 I will start a campaign on implants for care providers.
In 2019 start ik een campagne implantaten voor zorgverleners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het advies van het Zorginstituut Nederland omtrent financiering hoogtechnologisch draagmoederschap

An MP asked whether the Zorginstituut advice shows that covering high-tech surrogacy from the basic insurance is a political choice and why the advice request was only submitted on 24 August 2018, 156 days after it was announced. The government answered that the institute sees a precedent only where the intended parents have a medical indication, that coverage without one would conflict with the Zvw, and that the timing followed the wider Staatscommissie process, with a cabinet response to follow later.

As indicated in the answer to your earlier parliamentary questions of 3 December, a cabinet response to the Zorginstituut advice will follow together with the cabinet response to the entire advice of the Staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap.

Zoals aangegeven in de beantwoording van uw eerdere Kamervragen op 3 december 3 volgt een kabinetsreactie op het advies van het Zorginstituut samen met de kabinetsreactie op het gehele advies van de Staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het Signalement Mondzorg 2018

An SP MP asked the minister to respond to the 2018 Dental Care Signal, which found stagnation or deterioration in oral health among young people and rising erosive tooth wear, and asked about social inequalities, evaluation of initiatives and why this monitor is being discontinued. The minister acknowledged the findings, said talks with the field will be organised by the Zorginstituut, and argued the monitor is no longer needed since the 1995 benefit change has been sufficiently evaluated.
The Zorginstituut therefore sees no reason to continue this specific monitor.
Het Zorginstituut ziet daarom geen reden meer om deze specifieke monitor voort te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de prijs van Orkambi

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether the government would compel Vertex to disclose the price of Orkambi, and about the consequences of disclosure, cooperation with other countries, the link between drug prices and premiums, and whether transparency would lower costs. The Minister said the original list price is public but a confidential financial arrangement covers the actual price, that transparency is preferred but manufacturers insist on confidentiality, and that expensive drugs are a driver of rising care costs.
Although the supplier is free to be transparent about these agreements, given the confidentiality agreements I cannot force the manufacturer to make the agreements public.
Hoewel het de leverancier vrij staat transparant te zijn over deze afspraken kan ik, gegeven de afspraken over vertrouwelijkheid, de fabrikant niet dwingen de afspraken openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Is digitale overdracht van zorgdata bij failliete ziekenhuizen wel gegarandeerd? Neen!’

An SP MP asked the health minister how patient data from bankrupt hospitals is transferred, who owns and controls the systems and data, and how the Slotervaart discharge letters were handled. The minister answered that medical records must remain available, that the curator and the treating provider bear responsibility, that IGJ and NZa are supervising the transfer, and that open standards are being developed.
It is the responsibility of the care provider to transfer the records carefully in such cases.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de hulpverlener om in die gevallen de dossiers zorgvuldig over te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Ellemeet over de problematiek rondom (chronische) Lyme

MPs Renkema and Ellemeet asked the minister about Lyme disease: patient concerns, prevention, recognition and diagnosis, co-infections, treatment of chronic patients, and whether the Health Council should be asked for new advice. The minister answers that research and patient involvement are ongoing, that prevention and GP training exist, and that a new Health Council advice will await results of the NLe research expected in a few years.
On the basis of the outcomes I want to formulate a new request for advice.
Op basis van de uitkomsten wil ik een nieuwe adviesvraag formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat verzekerden in Deventer niet meer terecht kunnen bij het ziekenhuis omdat de verzekeraar te weinig zorg heeft ingekocht

An MP asks whether it is acceptable that insured patients in Deventer face waiting lists because Zilveren Kruis bought too little hospital care, and whether the insurer is meeting its duty of care. The minister says patients will be offered the choice between accepting the longer wait at Deventer Hospital or referral to another provider in the region, that the insurer is responsible for ensuring this, and that he has contacted the insurer and hospital.
In this case it is for Zilveren Kruis to ensure this, given the duty of care the insurer has towards its insured.
Het is in deze casus aan Zilveren Kruis om dat zeker te stellen, gezien de zorgplicht die de verzekeraar heeft richting zijn verzekerden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat de contracten tussen zorgverzekeraars en ziekenhuizen weer niet op tijd zijn afgesloten

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why hospital-insurer contracts were again not concluded on time, what this means for insured people, and whether the market model is failing. The minister acknowledged slower contracting, pointed to existing insurer information duties and NZa enforcement, and said the government expects more contracts soon while promising better information for insured persons.
For that reason, any uncertainty about additional payments for non-contracted providers must be kept as limited as possible and will be reduced in the coming weeks.
Om die reden moet een eventuele onduidelijkheid over bijbetalingen bij nog niet-gecontracteerde partijen zo beperkt mogelijk zijn en de komende weken worden verminderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Ellemeet over het anticonceptiepil-tekort en het feit dat KNMP en Bogin het niet nodig vinden de geneesmiddelenprijzen zo laag mogelijk te houden

MPs Ploumen and Ellemeet asked the Minister for Medical Care about the contraceptive pill shortage and whether pharmacist and generics bodies KNMP and Bogin contribute to the problem by resisting low drug prices. The Minister answered that supply is recovering, plans a mandatory four-month stock obligation, will report on shortage causes and inspection of late reporting, and rejected the claim that low prices cause shortages.
As I indicated in my letter of 30 November, I will also evaluate this specific case of supply problems with the contraceptive pill and inform the House of the outcome.

Zoals ik heb aangegeven in mijn Kamerbrief van 30 november jongstleden zal ik ook deze specifieke casus van de leveringsproblemen met de anticonceptiepil evalueren en uw Kamer over de uitkomst informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de resultaten van prijsonderhandelingen met farmaceuten

MP Ploumen asked the Minister of Medical Care about the savings from drug price negotiations with pharmaceutical firms, the basis for claiming they reached the maximum achievable result, and transparency over drug pricing. The Minister explained the EUR 130 million saving calculation, said he cannot disclose which drugs or savings due to confidentiality agreements, and committed to pressing industry for transparency via dialogue and international cooperation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat zware pijnstillers nog steeds met een vervalst recept te verkrijgen zijn

Dijkstra (D66) asked the minister about a broadcast showing strong painkillers still obtainable with forged prescriptions, and what has been done since 2017 to improve controls. Minister Bruins answered that forgery is fraud, pointed to pharmacist alerting, IGJ inspections and a planned December meeting with pharmacists and KNMP, and urged electronic prescribing for the remaining paper prescriptions.
In December I will hold a discussion with the pharmacists involved in the report and with the KNMP.
In december ga ik in gesprek met de betrokken apothekers uit de reportage en de KNMP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat het kapitaalrecord voor medische bedrijven alweer gebroken is

An MP asked the Minister about reports that a record amount of capital was raised for medical companies, the trend of large pharma firms acquiring small biotech firms, and the regulatory barriers young firms face, including follow-up on an Actal advisory report. The minister said no data is kept on acquisitions or self-marketing by young firms, framed acquisitions as a success, and described steps taken to reduce regulatory burden on the reimbursement procedure.
Within the ministries of VWS and EZK, no information is kept on the exact number of acquired (young) medical companies in recent years.
Binnen de ministeries van VWS en EZK wordt er geen informatie bijgehouden over het exact aantal opgekochte (jonge) medische bedrijven in de afgelopen jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het nut van marktwerking in de ziekenhuiszorg
