Ploumen (PvdA) asks whether the price and quality of hospital care can be overseen when prices are not transparent, why hospitals get different tariffs for the same treatment, and whether the market label fits hospital care. Minister Bruins defends negotiated contracting by insurers as cost-restraining and consumer-choice enhancing, rejects full NZa price setting, and points to incremental price-transparency measures with possible obligations if progress lags in 2019.
I do not agree with that statement.
Ik ben het niet eens met die uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat VGZ-verzekerden niet meer terecht kunnen bij het Zuyderland ziekenhuis

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care for his reaction to reports that VGZ-insured patients could no longer be treated at Zuyderland hospital, whether patient stops are unacceptable, what measures prevent budget disputes being passed on to patients, and whether the stop will be ended. The Minister answered that insurers and providers share responsibility, insurers must ensure alternative care within Treeknorm waiting times, the NZa supervises the duty of care and can intervene, and that the NZa reports VGZ has contracted enough elective care elsewhere.
The NZa supervises that health insurers comply with their duty of care and intervenes where necessary.
De NZa ziet erop toe dat zorgverzekeraars de zorgplicht naleven en grijpt indien nodig in
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘St Jansdal: pas op met budgetpolis Zilveren Kruis’

MP Van Gerven asked why Zilveren Kruis excluded St Jansdal hospital for budget-policy holders in Lelystad and Harderwijk after the IJsselmeer hospitals went bankrupt, and whether affected patients can be helped. The minister replied that Zilveren Kruis has agreed to fully reimburse care at St Jansdal for 2018 and has added St Jansdal to its 2019 selected hospitals, so no one is affected.
Zilveren Kruis will inform insured persons in Lelystad with a Basis Budget policy about this by letter.
Zilveren Kruis zal verzekerden in Lelystad met een Basis Budget polis hierover per brief informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arno Rutte over het bericht 'Doktersdienst zet mes in huisartsenposten'

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care how the duty of care for GP out-of-hours services is ensured after Groningen GPs proposed closing the Hoogezand post and reducing others, and whether the ACM should review this. The minister answered that GPs organise out-of-hours care themselves, that the NZa supervises the duty of care and sees no current signals of risk, and that the plan is pending in regional consultation.
The Netherlands Competition and Healthcare Authority (NZa) supervises compliance with the duty of care.
De Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) ziet toe op naleving van de zorgplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Beertema over MRI-onderzoek door het Spinoza Centre

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether a Spinoza Centre MRI study recruiting people with strong views on refugees, paid 25 euros, was acceptable, whether studying brain activity via political topics was bizarre, what its purpose and subsidy were, and whether such practices should end. The minister defended the recruitment as standard for attitude research, said the study was ethically approved and fundamental rather than medical, and that the equipment is not available for medical use.

The recruitment method, alongside the research methods themselves, was approved by the Standing Committee for Science and Ethics of the Faculty of Behavioural and Movement Sciences of the Vrije Universiteit.

De methode van werving is, naast de onderzoeksmethodes zelf, goedgekeurd door de Vaste Commissie voor Wetenschap en Ethiek van de Faculteit der Gedrags- en Bewegingswetenschappen van de Vrije Universiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens over het bericht 'Voetbal is voor iedereen!'

Two D66 MPs asked the health and education ministers about an open letter from LGBT+ supporters calling for more acceptance in football, and what the government will do to promote inclusion and tackle discriminatory chants. The minister agreed more action is needed, pointed to the Alliantie Gelijkspelen and the Sportakkoord, and said the KNVB shares the ambition, while committing only to ongoing consultation with supporters.
Yes. Question 3: In what way are you currently promoting inclusion and acceptance of LGBT+ people in sport and especially in football?
Ja. Vraag 3 Op welke manier stimuleert u op dit moment inclusie en acceptatie van LHBT+ in de sport en bij het voetbal in het bijzonder?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht over gemaakte zorgkosten in 2018 die betaald moeten worden in 2017

MP Ellemeet asked whether patients postponing care to shift deductible costs to a later year, and the opacity of DBC billing timing, call for changing the system so the deductible applies only in the year of the hospital visit. Minister Bruins answered that compensation measures exist, that Nivel data show no rise in care avoidance, and that insurers must inform patients, but declined to commit to changing the DBC system now.
Question 5: Are you willing to change the system so that the deductible is only claimed in the year the hospital visit took place?
Vraag 5 Bent u bereid om het systeem zo aan te passen dat er alleen aanspraak gemaakt wordt op het eigen risico in het jaar dat het ziekenhuisbezoek plaatsvond?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'MST dreigt budget te overschrijden en zet deel verzekerden in de wacht'

An SP MP asks the health minister how a hospital (MST) placing some insured patients on a waiting list after exceeding its budget ceiling affects patient safety, referrals, and whether the government will investigate budget caps. The minister answers that the insurer and hospital share responsibility, urgent and oncology care continue, the IGJ sees no safety signals, and no separate investigation is planned.
No. In recent years insurers and care providers have more often disagreed about reaching a budget ceiling.
Nee. In de afgelopen jaren hebben zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders vaker meningsverschillen gehad rondom het bereiken van een budgetplafond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het mogelijk maken van hoogtechnologisch draagmoederschap voor paren van gelijke geslacht

An MP asked the government about allowing high-tech surrogacy for same-sex couples, citing clinic plans and a new professional guideline, and about the timing of a legal framework and Zorginstituut funding review. The minister answered that clinics may offer it within existing rules, that a legal framework awaits research due early 2019, and that the Zorginstituut was asked to assess funding.
The cabinet is considering a legal framework for surrogacy as part of its response to the advisory report of the State Committee on Parenthood.
Het kabinet beraadt zich over een juridische regeling voor draagmoederschap in het kader van de kabinetsreactie op het advies van de Staatscommissie Herijking ouderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over het nieuws dat Nederland genetische gegevens gaat delen met andere EU-landen

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about Dutch participation in the Million European Genomes project, which shares genetic data with other EU member states, including what data, governance, safeguards and consent apply. The minister answered that the project is in its start-up phase, that governance is still being developed within the GDPR framework, and that only pseudonymised data from consenting individuals will be used, but gave no firm answers on access restrictions or who decides sharing.
A governance model for the collaboration is currently being developed.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan een governancemodel van de samenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Verloskundigen: er is vaak geen plek in ziekenhuis’

An SP MP asks the minister whether midwives' reports of frequently having no hospital bed for births are a concern, how many hospital maternity units closed or stopped offering 24/7 care, and how the problem will be solved. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the regional acute care bodies should improve coordination, cites staffing investments and states no concrete new national measure beyond existing programmes.
I have no insight into which hospitals have recently announced an admission stop.
Ik heb geen inzicht in welke ziekenhuizen de afgelopen tijd een opnamestop hebben afgekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Arno Rutte over een levensgevaarlijk chloormiddel dat nog steeds te koop is

MPs Lodders and Rutte asked why the NVWA did not intervene against MMS chlorine products between 2010 and 2016, why warnings from the US and Canada were not reflected, and about the pace of the risk assessment, enforcement and inspection. Minister Bruins answered that enforcement was risk-prioritised and carried out under successive laws, explained the timeline of the risk assessment and inspections, and declined to commit to half-yearly reporting on inspection trajectories.
I am therefore not in favour of informing your House about this every half year.
Ik ben er daarom geen voorstander van om uw Kamer halfjaarlijks hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over omkoping van artsen door een bedrijf voor medische hulpmiddelen

An MP asked the minister whether the FIOD suspects a medical device company of bribing doctors, which company it is, the scale of the bribery, whether the FIU looked at other transactions, and whether self-regulation through the Transparency Register is sufficient. The minister confirmed the investigation but declined to name the company or give details because the criminal investigation is ongoing and the FIU findings are state-confidential, and rejected the view that self-regulation is insufficient, pointing to a pending evaluation of the register.
Because of the ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot give you further information about this case, and therefore also not about the scale and possible involvement of persons and care institutions.
In verband met het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik u geen nadere informatie geven over deze zaak en dus ook niet over de omvang en eventuele betrokkenheid van personen en zorginstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Buitenweg over lessen uit het Belgisch voetbalschandaal

MPs Westerveld and Buitenweg asked the ministers about lessons from the Belgian match-fixing scandal, including Dutch measures, links to other crime, the role of agents and international cooperation. The minister answered that a national match-fixing platform exists, an information coordinator will be appointed for a two-year pilot, there are no concrete signals of spread to the Netherlands, and an in-depth study of agents is not planned though international cooperation continues.
To improve this, an information coordinator will be appointed for a two-year pilot period.
Om hierin verbetering aan te brengen, wordt voor een pilotperiode van twee jaar een informatiecoördinator benoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Weer ongeluk met gevaarlijk Multiplay-springkussen’

An MP from the VVD asks the Ministers of Medical Care and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a reported accident with a Multiplay bouncy castle and about NVWA oversight of suppliers, certification bodies (AKI) and sales information. The minister answers that the NVWA sent letters to suppliers, inspected and tested certificates, withdrew the Piraat model, reviewed AKI audits and is handling further incidents, while declining some data requests and saying no additional warning labels are needed.
I cannot provide your House with the data you requested.
De door u gevraagde gegevens kan ik uw Kamer niet leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de situatie in Amsterdam na het faillissement van het MC Slotervaart

MP Kuzu (DENK) asked the Minister for Medical Care fifteen questions on the Amsterdam healthcare situation after the bankruptcy of MC Slotervaart, including why ministry signals on finances were not shared earlier, whether specialist care stays available, and whether laws must change for patient transfers. The minister answered that sufficient specialist capacity remains in the Amsterdam region, that an independent investigation into the bankruptcies will be launched, and that he will not anticipate its outcome on legislative changes.
For that reason I have promised your House that I will launch an external and independent investigation into the course of events leading up to the bankruptcies and afterwards.
Om die reden heb ik uw Kamer toegezegd dat ik een extern en onafhankelijk onderzoek zal starten naar de gang van zaken in aanloop naar de faillissementen en daarna.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de rol van de Raad van Europa en het uitvoerend WADA-comité bij het opheffen van de schorsing van de Russian Anti-Doping Agency

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the Council of Europe's role and WADA's executive committee in lifting RUSADA's suspension, including the procedural flaw that left the Council's representative without a mandate. The minister confirmed the concern, said the Netherlands raised objections via CAHAMA and with WADA, but acknowledged the decision was made by majority and is unlikely to be reversed.
I have urged WADA that decision-making on this subject requires a higher degree of care going forward.
Ik heb er bij WADA op aangedrongen dat in het vervolg besluitvorming op dit onderwerp een hogere mate van zorgvuldigheid vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat het rapport Integraal Appel over de wietteelt in Tilburg is gebaseerd op drijfzand

An MP asks the Justice and Health ministers whether the report 'Integraal Appel' on cannabis cultivation in Tilburg, reportedly based on a dubious single criminal-circuit source, is scientifically sound and whether its figures still shape policy. The Minister declines to judge the report's scientific quality, says it was commissioned regionally and not by the ministries, and states that the broader picture of drug crime rests on multiple sources and that policy does not depend on this specific calculation.
This concerns a confidential report that was not drawn up by or commissioned by the Ministries of Justice and Security or of Health, Welfare and Sport.
Het betreft hier een vertrouwelijk rapport dat niet door of in opdracht van de ministeries van Justitie en Veiligheid of Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport is opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over medicijnmisbruik in de sport

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about thyroid hormone misuse by Dutch top athletes, including whether NOC*NSF had reported internal findings from Pyeongchang and whether thyroid medication should be placed on the WADA prohibited list. The minister said a general signal was passed to the Dopingautoriteit, that the ministry supported a WADA submission requesting listing, that WADA has asked for further research, and that no complaints had been filed with the Medisch Tuchtcollege.
I will keep bringing the importance of this research to attention so that it may be placed on the prohibited list.
Ik zal het belang van dit onderzoek onder de aandacht blijven brengen zodat het mogelijk op de prohibited list wordt geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Von Martels over het feit dat ASML in België medische isotopen gaat ontwikkelen

MPs from the CDA asked why the Lighthouse medical isotope project, named a Dutch National Icon, is being developed in Belgium instead of the Netherlands, and what financing was tried. The government answered that Lighthouse keeps its icon status, that Dutch private investors judged the risk too high, and that the Belgian IRE is now the partner, with the state-aid compliance left to Belgium.
It is up to the Belgian government to ensure that the agreements comply with the European state aid rules.
Het is aan de Belgische overheid om te zorgen dat de afspraken voldoen aan de Europese staatssteunregels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het rapport ‘Waar een klein land groot in kan zijn. Nederland en synthetische drugs in de afgelopen 50 jaar’ van de Politieacademie

MP Bergkamp asked whether the Politieacademie report placing the Netherlands at the top of synthetic drug production rests on sound data, given that its volume and consumption figures seem implausibly high, and whether the 18.9 billion euro estimate is credible. The ministers reply that several European reports reach similar conclusions, that the authors are responsible for their own method, that a new advisory body (SBO) will advise by year-end, and that enforcement is being strengthened while the government keeps a balanced drug policy.
The report by Mr Tops and colleagues is not the first or only report pointing to the Netherlands' prominent position regarding the production of and trade in synthetic drugs.
Het rapport van de heer Tops en collegae is niet het eerste noch het enige rapport dat wijst op de prominente plek van Nederland waar het de productie van en handel in synthetische drugs betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat de farmaceutische industrie werkt aan een vrijwillige gedragscode

MP Ploumen asked the health minister about 44 pharmaceutical firms developing a voluntary code of conduct on drug pricing, whether it is credible, whether a convenant is being negotiated, and whether the Chamber will see it first. The minister welcomed the self-regulation initiative but rejected binding industry codes, said talks on a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding are ongoing, and declined to pre-submit it to Parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat het betalen van artsen/onderzoekers door de farmaceutische industrie kennelijk een lucratief marketinginstrument is

Ploumen asked the minister about reports that GSK resumed paying doctors and researchers for marketing, whether such payments are effective and lucrative, and whether all payments are transparently recorded in the Transparantieregister Zorg, including whether it can be circumvented and whether statutory regulation is needed. The minister said pharma-doctor cooperation can be legitimate, pointed to existing gift-ban rules and the IGJ's supervisory role, acknowledged that clinical drug research is not in the register, and referred to earlier letters for the absence of a statutory basis for the register.
Nevertheless, the qualifications she gives, by which she lumps the entire pharmaceutical industry together, must remain at Ms Godlee's own account.
Niettemin dienen de kwalificaties die zij geeft – en waarmee zij de gehele farmaceutische industrie over één kam scheert – voor rekening van mevrouw Godlee te blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten over het bericht dat farmaceuten belasting ontwijken via Nederland

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked whether pharmaceutical firms such as Abbott, Johnson & Johnson, Merck and Pfizer use the Netherlands to avoid tax and whether the government will investigate this. The State Secretary of Finance answered that he cannot discuss individual companies' tax affairs, pointed to the government's anti-avoidance measures (CFC rule, conditional withholding tax, EU directives) and said no separate investigation into pharmaceutical firms is planned, though the effects of the policy will be monitored.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act I cannot discuss the tax affairs of individual companies.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op fiscale aangelegenheden van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Ploumen over het bericht dat Nederland farmaceuten helpt om belasting te ontwijken

MPs Nijboer and Ploumen asked the government about reports that the Netherlands helps pharmaceutical companies avoid tax, including undisclosed arrangements, transparency, and effects on developing countries. The State Secretary of Finance answered that individual tax affairs cannot be discussed under article 67 AWR, and listed general anti-avoidance measures, the position on country-by-country reporting, and EU work on pharmaceutical patent protection.
Under article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot discuss the tax affairs of individual companies.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op fiscale aangelegenheden van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het feit dat de het dreigende faillissement van de IJsselmeerziekenhuizen en het Slotervaartziekenhuis mogelijk al eerder bekend was

An MP asked whether two meetings organised by Achmea about the financial distress of two hospitals were attended by ministry officials, what was discussed, and whether the minister was informed. The minister answered that ministry officials were not present, that he was unaware of the meetings, and that the ministry has no minutes, while referring to an earlier letter on when VWS and supervisors were informed.
I was not aware that these meetings took place.
Het was mij niet bekend dat deze bijeenkomsten hebben plaats gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de registratie van AED’s

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister for Medical Care about the low registration of automated external defibrillators (AEDs), regional gaps in the 6-minute zones, actions to raise registrations, awareness among civilian responders, merging of alarm networks, and talks on registering AEDs at (semi-)government buildings. The minister answered that roughly 16,000 AEDs are registered against at least 30,000 needed, outlined a range of campaigns and the completed merger into HartslagNu, and said the talks with other ministries and bodies would conclude early next year.
I consider it important that as many available AEDs as possible are registered.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat zoveel mogelijk beschikbare AED’s worden geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat volgens de artsen van het Slotervaart de patiënt wel in levensgevaar was

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care to respond to a doctor's claim that two patients at MC Slotervaart were in life-threatening danger, and why the minister had not disclosed this during the suspension. The minister replied that the hospital and inspectorate found no life-threatening situation, that a risky but not life-threatening situation occurred, and that the inspectorate visited the hospital promptly after the signals reached him.
These reports reached me during my first round in the parliamentary debate.
Deze berichten zijn mij tijdens mijn eerste termijn van het Kamerdebat ter ore gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het dreigende faillissement van het MC Slotervaart en de IJsselmeerziekenhuizen in Lelystad, Emmeloord en Dronten

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about the imminent bankruptcy of MC Slotervaart and the IJsselmeer hospitals, including whether owners drained funds and whether the state should intervene. The minister answered that curators will investigate causes and any unlawful withdrawals, that the government is working for accessible care and a possible restart, and that bankruptcy is not a duty for insurers to prevent, while committing to a legal notification requirement for acute care closures.
It is up to the curators of both hospitals to investigate the causes behind the bankruptcy.
Het is aan de curatoren van beide ziekenhuizen om de oorzaken achter het faillissement te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Verliest Delfzijl na ziekenhuis ook huisartsenpost? Stemming onder huisartsen geeft de doorslag.’

MP Van Gerven asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that the Delfzijl GP out-of-hours post might close after the hospital, and whether residents should have a say in such decisions. The minister answered that the revised plan keeps the Delfzijl post open, that acute care provision is for providers and insurers to arrange, that a national study on GP shortages is underway, and that a draft AMvB on informing regional stakeholders is being prepared.
I consider it important that residents are well informed about changes in the care provision in the region.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat inwoners goed worden geïnformeerd over de wijzigingen in het zorgaanbod in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de dreigende sluiting van de huisartsenpost in Delfzijl

An MP asked the minister about fears that the Delfzijl out-of-hours GP post would close, the commitments made when the hospital closed, and how municipalities are involved. The minister said the post will stay open under the current proposal, that the organisation of care is primarily the responsibility of providers and insurers, and that a consultation duty for regional care is not yet settled.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat ziekenhuispersoneel inschrijft op obligaties van het Bernhoven ziekenhuis

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about hospital staff buying bonds issued by Bernhoven hospital, including whether hospitals should be financed this way, the risks, the 4% interest paid out of care, and whether the ban on profit distribution should be lifted. The minister replied that financing hospitals is not the government's role, that staff participation is voluntary and unobjectionable, and that a study on profit distribution will be sent to parliament in early 2019.
I do not have the precise figures that are requested.
Ik beschik niet over de precieze cijfers waarnaar gevraagd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de apotheker de keuze van de arts voor een bepaald medicijn negeert

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether pharmacists overriding doctors' prescriptions marked 'medical necessity' is acceptable, how this relates to a 2013 motion, whether insurers misuse preferential policy, and what will ensure doctors decide on medication. The minister acknowledged no shared understanding of 'medical necessity', announced consultation and further research, rejected the misuse claim, and promised a stakeholder meeting on 31 October.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over apothekers die een voorschrift van een arts negeren

An MP asks about pharmacists dispensing a different, cheaper medicine than the one prescribed by the doctor, and whether cost considerations justify it. The minister says a prescription cannot simply be ignored, that the criterion is medical responsibility, and that a bestuurlijk overleg with all parties will set principles for switching medicines.
A prescription cannot simply be ignored.
Een recept kan niet zomaar worden genegeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Raemakers over het vergoeden van de hersteloperatie na vrouwelijke genitale mutilatie

MPs Sjoerdsma and Raemakers asked the Minister of Medical Care whether female genital mutilation reconstructive surgery should be covered by the basic health insurance, given earlier promises of a working group and a draft guideline. The minister answered that evidence on effectiveness is too uncertain to include reconstruction in the basic package, that the new guideline does not address reimbursement, and that the health institute will advise once the guideline is authorised.
I will ask the Zorginstituut to carry out the necessary procedure quickly.
Ik zal het Zorginstituut verzoeken om de hiervoor noodzakelijke procedure snel uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht dat veel amateurtrainers niet weten hoe ze met een groep moeten omgaan en het tekort aan vrijwilligers bij sportverenigingen

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about amateur coaches lacking training and the shortage of volunteers in sports clubs, and about support for trainers. The minister answered that trainers should be supported through the Sportakkoord, with courses, individual coaching and buurtsportcoaches, and that volunteer shortages are uneven across clubs.
I consider strengthening trainers and coaches important and am actively working on this in the Sports Agreement (sub-agreement on vital sports providers).
Ik vind het versterken van trainers en coaches belangrijk en zet daar in het Sportakkoord (deelakkoord vitale sportaanbieders) actief op in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat een verwoestende nieuwe drug in webshops te koop is

Two PvdA MPs asked whether phenibut, a highly addictive substance sold as a food supplement in webshops, could be bought by minors and why it is not banned under the Opium Act. The State Secretary for Health answered that minors cannot be excluded from access, that a CAM risk study is underway with results expected this year, and that measures including a possible ban will be considered afterwards.
Based on the research results and the CAM advice, I will consider measures to take, such as a possible ban.
Op basis van de onderzoeksresultaten en het advies van het CAM zal ik mij beraden op te treffen maatregelen, zoals een eventueel verbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over twee zwaargewonden kinderen na val onveilig speeltoestel

An MP asked the Ministers of Agriculture and of Medical Care about dangerous Multiplay bouncy castles after two children were seriously injured, including whether the NVWA should have acted sooner and why certificates were not checked. The minister acknowledged a non-valid certificate led to one model being taken out of use, stated the NVWA inspects only a small share of locations, and promised further steps on the procedure for placing bouncy castles on the market.
The NVWA has no information that shows whether the correct certificates and logbooks are present for all play equipment.
De NVWA heeft geen informatie waarbij inzichtelijk gemaakt kan worden of bij alle speeltoestellen de correcte certificaten en logboeken aanwezig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over gebrek aan handhaving door de NVWA

An SP MP asked ministers about lax NVWA enforcement against a dangerous product sold as medicine (MMS) and an unsafe inflatable play structure. The minister defended the NVWA's procedures, said enforcement against MMS is now being applied, and said the play structure was only partly unsafe and enforcement was adequate.
I see no reason to change the procedures.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de procedures aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over de vrijwilligers- en bestuurdersproblematiek binnen de breedtesport

An MP asks the Minister whether declining membership and volunteer shortages in sports clubs are a concern and how the EUR 9 million for vital sports providers will be allocated. The Minister says the decline is overstated, attributes the split between thriving and shrinking clubs to capable boards, and says the allocation plan will be sent to parliament before the Christmas recess.
I will inform the House about this before the Christmas recess.
Ik zal de Kamer voor het kerstreces hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de NVWA en vervolgonderzoeken naar onveilige cv-ketels

An MP asks how the NVWA handled the safety of Nefit gas boilers (B3L and B3M) from 2009 to 2018, including the handling of heat exchanger problems, oversight design, certification plans, registration of appliances and periodic inspection. The government answers that the NVWA acted in line with its powers, that a certification regime and related bill are being prepared, and it declines to introduce central serial-number registration or mandatory periodic inspection of home installations.
The NVWA was informed about this by the German authorities.
De NVWA is daarover door de Duitse autoriteiten geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het gebrek aan toezicht op legionella afkomstig van afvalwaterzuiveringsinstallaties

An MP asks ministers why wastewater treatment plants linked to legionella outbreaks at Vion and Rendac face no legionella controls, whether oversight is adequate and what will be done. The minister answers that the link was previously unknown, that local authorities acted correctly and that temporary measures are in place while permanent rules and further research are being prepared.
In addition, I will have the possibilities examined for including requirements on legionella for wastewater treatment as well.
Daarnaast laat ik in kaart brengen welke mogelijkheden er zijn om ook voor afvalwaterzuivering eisen op te nemen met betrekking tot Legionella.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het advies om de Mammaprint niet te vergoeden vanuit de basisverzekering

An MP asked why the Health Care Institute advised against reimbursing the MammaPrint breast cancer test from basic insurance, whether cost played a role, and whether the method should be independently reviewed. The minister replied that the Institute judged MammaPrint lacks proven added clinical value over the standard test, that cost played no role, and that the Institute's own scientific advisory council and joint European assessment provide sufficient safeguards, so no independent review is planned.
The Health Care Institute reassessed whether adding the MammaPrint test to the standard Adjuvant! Online (AO!) test in women with early-stage breast cancer leads to health gain.
Het Zorginstituut heeft opnieuw beoordeeld of het toevoegen van de test MammaPrint aan de standaardtest Adjuvant! Online (AO!) bij vrouwen met een vroeg stadium borstkanker leidt tot gezondheidswinst
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat de MammaPrint niet vergoed wordt

MP Ploumen asked the Minister of Medical Care about the decision not to reimburse the MammaPrint breast cancer test, including the reasons for the Zorginstituut's negative advice, the stance of professionals, foreign reimbursement practice, and whether it could still be reimbursed. The Minister answered that the Zorginstituut found no proven clinical benefit, that he is bound by the statutory test of proven effectiveness and by the Van den Berg motion, and that patients should discuss concerns with their doctor.
The Zorginstituut has the statutory task of judging whether care is effective and reimbursed from the basic package.
Het Zorginstituut heeft de wettelijke taak om te oordelen of zorg effectief is en vergoed wordt uit het basispakket.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het kankergeneesmiddel nivolumab niet langer vergoed wordt na negatief advies

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why insurers no longer reimburse nivolumab after a negative BOM oncology committee verdict for a new melanoma indication, and whether patients remain covered until end 2019. The Minister answered that nivolumab stays reimbursed for proven-effective indications, that the new melanoma indication is not proven effective and is therefore not covered, that insurers and the profession judge effectiveness, and that the Zorginstituut advises in sluis procedures.
For medicines within medical care, it is up to health insurers to determine whether care meets the state of science and practice and is therefore part of the basic package.
Voor geneesmiddelen binnen de geneeskundige zorg is het aan de zorgverzekeraars om te bepalen of zorg voldoet aan de stand van de wetenschap en praktijk en daarmee onderdeel is van het basispakket.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Reddend kankermiddel niet vergoed, patiënten in paniek’

An SGP MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about the background of the NVMO's negative advice on the cancer drug nivolumab, the reaction to specialists who call it effective, and whether the advice rests mainly on the technical requirement of five years versus two years of experience. The Minister answers by referring to answers already given to earlier parliamentary questions from other MPs, without substantive answers in this document.
For the answer to these questions I refer you to the answers to questions 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 from MP Van Gerven (SP).
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik u naar de antwoorden op de vragen 1, 2, 3, 4 en 6 van het lid van Gerven (SP)
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agema over het bericht dat kankermedicijn nivolumab niet meer vergoed wordt

An MP asked why the cancer drug nivolumab is no longer reimbursed after a medical society judged its newer melanoma indication not proven effective, and how the government squares this with patients and the drug's recognition. The minister replied that reimbursement requires proven effectiveness under the law, that the government will not second-guess the scientific judgement of the professional body, and that existing melanoma indications remain covered.
The law states that care is only reimbursed if it is proven effective.
In de wet is aangegeven dat zorg alleen vergoed wordt als deze bewezen effectief is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘MammaPrint niet in basispakket’

MPs Van Gerven asked the Minister for Medical Care why the Zorginstituut concluded that the MammaPrint test does not qualify for the basic health insurance package, despite a 2016 MINDACT trial that the questioners say shows a good survival chance for patients spared chemotherapy, and why this conclusion diverges from clinical guidelines worldwide. The Minister answered that the Zorginstituut judged the trial's randomised comparison with the standard test, found a clinically relevant chemotherapy benefit cannot be excluded, and that the Dutch standard test remains decisive, so the MammaPrint will not be reimbursed.
The Zorginstituut's position that the MammaPrint has no proven added value over the standard test is decisive, and therefore the MammaPrint does not belong in the basic package.
Het standpunt van het Zorginstituut dat de MammaPrint geen bewezen meerwaarde heeft op de standaardtest, is doorslaggevend en daarom behoort de MammaPrint niet tot basispakket.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de grote stijging in burn-outs onder artsen in opleiding

An MP asks about the rise in burnout among medical residents (artsen in opleiding) and whether the health inspectorate can help reduce it. The minister confirms the concern, says the workplace and workload issues are mainly for hospitals and social partners, cites staffing shortages and planned measures, and says the inspectorate will be asked to look at working conditions.
I will bring these parliamentary questions to the attention of the IGJ.
Ik zal deze Kamervragen bij de IGJ onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het alarm over risico’s van ‘mooimakende’ semipermanente fillers

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister for Medical Care about alarm over risks of semi-permanent cosmetic fillers, the timeline and results of the RIVM/Maastricht and VUmc/Erasmus MC research, the Inspectorate's complaint data, the new EU device rules, and the status of the cosmetic care quality framework. The minister answers that research results are expected in early 2019, preliminary findings show few complications from semi-permanent fillers, the Inspectorate has received 101 reports over five years, and a quality framework and competence requirements are being developed.
With the overview of the number of reports, I am keeping my commitment.
Met onderstaand overzicht van het aantal meldingen geef ik de toezegging gestand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de kosten voor bijzondere tandheelkunde vaak niet vergoed worden door de zorgverzekeraar

MP Hijink (SP) asked the minister about a Radar report that dental care costs after cancer treatment are often not reimbursed by health insurers, and about NFK research showing few patients received reimbursement. The minister disputes the 6% figure (75% received full or partial reimbursement), explains insurers apply the same assessment rules via adviserend tandarts guidelines, notes the Zorginstituut sent letters to professional groups, and rejects restoring adult dental care to the basic package due to cost.
Following the signals from the NFK and the Radar broadcast, the Zorginstituut Nederland immediately sent a letter to all parties involved.
Naar aanleiding van de signalen van het NFK en de Radar uitzending heeft het Zorginstituut Nederland direct een brief gestuurd aan alle betrokken partijen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Slootweg over de wenselijkheid van initiatieven als het ‘Kindergasthuis de Boeg’

Two MPs asked the government whether initiatives like Kindergasthuis De Boeg, a family guest house near hospitals, are desirable, how many exist, their costs compared with hospital stays, and how they could be supported. The minister answered that the houses are valuable for families but not a government responsibility, offered no overview or budget, and said hospitals remain primarily responsible for medical aspects.
I have no overview of the number of initiatives.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de aantallen initiatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Hermans over het bericht 'Haperende ICT in de Zorg: verkeerde medicatie, foute beslissingen'

MPs Rutte and Hermans asked the health minister about NOS reports of faulty ICT in healthcare causing dangerous medication errors, asking who is responsible and whether the Inspectorate can oversee it. The minister said information exchange agreements are a shared responsibility of care providers coordinated through the Informatieberaad, that the Inspectorate has carried out exploratory inspections and publishes findings, and that the VIPP programme deadlines are being pursued with a possible deadline extension for some clinics.
On the question of whether government should take more control on this point, I will return to it in the letter you receive at the end of this year on electronic data exchange.
Over de vraag of de overheid op dit punt meer regie zou moeten voeren kom ik terug in de brief die u aan het eind van dit jaar ontvangt over elektronische gegevensuitwisseling
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over informatiereizen in de zorg

An SP MP asked why the ministry commissioned a handbook on 'information journeys' in healthcare using personas, questioning whether it insults care workers and why it uses jargon like 'klant'. The minister answered that it aims to keep information provision patient-centred, that the wording is not objectionable, and that the handbook cost EUR 7,529.
Het realiseren van de handreiking heeft € 7.529 euro gekost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht dat een groeiend aantal geneesmiddelen tijdelijk niet leverbaar is

MP Ploumen asked the health minister about reports that a growing number of medicines are temporarily unavailable, including whether shortages are increasing and what legal tools exist to prevent them. The minister replied that shortages are mostly supply delays usually covered by alternatives, that reports rose in 2017 and 2018, and that existing instruments such as higher fines and temporary import of foreign medicines will be evaluated.
I will evaluate the measures taken in the Medicine Shortages Working Group based on the 2017 and 2018 data, to assess whether the existing measures suffice or whether stricter measures are needed.

Ik zal de genomen maatregelen evalueren in de Werkgroep Geneesmiddelentekorten op basis van de gegevens van 2017 en 2018 ten einde te beoordelen of de bestaande maatregelen volstaan of dat het verzwaren van maatregelen nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Sluiting kinder- en kraamafdeling Hoogeveen en Stadskanaal is definitief’

An SP MP asks the health minister how the definitive closure of the children's and maternity wards in Hoogeveen and Stadskanaal was decided, questioning the roles of the minister, insurers, municipalities, midwives and the inspectorate, and whether access, choice and safety are at stake. The minister replies that the decision was made by hospital group Treant after assessing options, that insurers and the NZa see no breach of the duty of care, and that the IGJ is satisfied with the stakeholders' commitments, so no intervention is planned.
For me, the quality and safety of care and the duty of care must be guaranteed above all.
Voor mij staat voorop dat de kwaliteit en veiligheid van de zorg en de zorgplicht moeten zijn geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Tarieven zorg nog altijd geheim’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van den Berg asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that healthcare tariffs remain secret, arguing patients should be able to choose providers on price, especially where the own risk applies. The minister answered that patients should have insight into costs, outlined existing disclosure obligations enforced by the NZa, and said the NZa is working with the sector on greater price transparency, initially in medical-specialist care, while declining for now to impose a statutory obligation.
I have called on the parties to take this seriously and asked the NZa to report on this point and to consider obligations if progress lags in 2019.
Ik heb partijen opgeroepen dit serieus op te pakken en heb de NZa gevraagd op dit punt te rapporteren en verplichtingen te overwegen indien de voortgang in 2019 achterblijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de vergoeding van het medicijn Translarna

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why the drug Translarna for Duchenne patients is not reimbursed, why the manufacturer stopped free supply, and whether the government will negotiate or create a faster access scheme. The minister answered that the drug was rejected for reimbursement for insufficient evidence of clinical benefit, that a new access scheme for orphan drugs is being developed with an update promised before year end, and that the government will not urge the manufacturer to continue free supply.
I will therefore not urge the manufacturer to continue providing the rejected drug free of charge.
Ik zal de fabrikant daarom ook niet aansporen om door te gaan met het gratis verstrekken van het afgewezen medicijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Nieuwe ouders moeten vaak kraamverzorgende delen door fors personeelstekort’

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about reports that new parents must often share a midwife-care nurse (kraamverzorgende) due to staff shortages, and whether the minimum 24 hours of postnatal care is being met. The Minister replies that no signals show the minimum is missed, that a shortage is a seasonal summer issue, and that a personnel planning study and a new collective agreement are being pursued.
There are no signals that young families are not receiving the minimum number of hours of postnatal care described in the national indication protocol.
Er zijn geen signalen dat jonge gezinnen niet het minimum aantal uren kraamzorg krijgen zoals omschreven in het Landelijk indicatieprotocol Kraamzorg
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over Flash Glucose Monitoring

An SP MP asks the Minister of Medical Care why Flash Glucose Monitoring is not reimbursed for all diabetes patients, including those with HbA1c below 64 mmol, children aged 4 to 18 only, and the cost and scope of extending coverage. The minister refers to the Zorginstituut's standpoint, states that insured care must meet package criteria, notes that a Rondetafel working group's results are not yet available, and gives only rough cost estimates.
As the legally designated package manager, the Zorginstituut assesses where necessary whether care forms meet the package criteria.
Als wettelijk toegewezen pakketbeheerder toetst het Zorginstituut indien nodig of zorgvormen aan de pakketcriteria voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over studenten met een hiv-besmetting die niet worden behandeld

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the ministers whether they knew of international students with untreated HIV, how large the problem was, and whether they would help find a solution with insurers and universities. The minister said there is no registration of the group, that he will commission research into its size and nature, that private insurers' exclusions are their and the universities' responsibility, and that he will participate in talks if that helps.
I will therefore have research carried out into the scope and nature of the problem in order to gain insight into the risk to public health.
Ik zal daarom onderzoek laten doen naar de omvang en aard van de problematiek om zicht te krijgen op het risico voor de volksgezondheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat een gevaarlijk product nog steeds op de markt verkrijgbaar is als medicijn

An SP MP asked the ministers whether a dangerous chlorine-based product (MMS) still sold as a medicine is acceptable, why NVWA enforcement came late despite a 2017 RIVM report, and what legislation governs it. The minister acknowledged the concern, explained the NVWA's warnings since 2010, the risk assessment process and the applicable food and medicines law, and said the existing information on warnings was sufficient.
As early as 2010 the NVWA warned consumers about MMS products because the safety of these products could not be guaranteed.
Al in 2010 heeft de NVWA consumenten gewaarschuwd voor MMS-producten omdat de veiligheid van deze producten niet kon worden gegarandeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Levensgevaarlijk chloormiddel nog steeds te koop als ‘medicijn’’

MPs Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked why the NVWA took years to act against Miracle Mineral Solution, a chlorine-based product sold as a medicine, despite early warnings and health reports. The minister explained the NVWA needed an independent risk assessment, enforcement began in 2018 after the March report, and it had issued warnings and fines in earlier years.
The bureau can ask the Front Office Food and Product Safety of the RIVM and RIKILT to carry out a risk assessment.
Bureau kan het Front Office Voedsel- en Productveiligheid van het RIVM en het RIKILT vragen een risicobeoordeling uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Duizenden minima dreigen voordelige zorgverzekering kwijt te raken’

MPs Kerstens and Gijs van Dijk asked the minister whether Menzis's plan to end collective health insurance for low-income groups outside its core regions, and the resulting possible loss of cheaper cover, was acceptable and how it affects trust in insurers. The minister answered that it is primarily up to municipalities and insurers to shape cooperation, that Menzis extends some contracts to 2020, that alternatives exist, and that the matter will be discussed with insurers and municipalities without committing to concrete new measures.
It is primarily a responsibility of municipalities and insurers themselves to shape cooperation for specific target groups.
Het is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten en verzekeraars zelf om samenwerking voor specifieke doelgroepen vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht 'Duizenden minima dreigen voordelige zorgverzekering kwijt te raken'

SP MPs asked the minister about Menzis ending collective health insurance contracts for low-income residents in about 30 municipalities, affecting roughly 41,000 insured. The minister replied that municipalities and insurers are primarily responsible, that contracts are extended to 2020 in most municipalities, and that insured people remain covered and can use other arrangements.
Primarily it is the responsibility of municipalities and insurers themselves to shape cooperation for specific target groups.
Het is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten en verzekeraars zelf om samenwerking voor specifieke doelgroepen vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Bestuursvoorzitter Ton Ruikes weg bij ZGT’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that the chair of Ziekenhuisgroep Twente is leaving involuntarily, whether this relates to financial mismanagement (a EUR 9.5 million overstatement), the causes of the hospital group's financial trouble, and whether the departing chair receives a golden handshake. The minister answered that the board and supervisory council are responsible, that the hospital is in a recovery plan, and that the Wet normering topinkomens applies and is enforced by CIBG.
Deliberation and decision-making on whether to continue a board member's employment is for the Supervisory Board and the person concerned.
Afweging en besluitvorming over het al dan niet continueren van het dienstverband van een bestuurder is aan de Raad van Toezicht en betrokkene zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Renkema over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraar Menzis de behandeling van depressies voortaan vergoedt op basis van de resultaten

MPs Ellemeet and Renkema asked whether Menzis paying for depression treatment partly on outcomes risks undertreatment, patient selection and administrative burden, and whether the government would discourage it. The state secretary supports outcome-based payment in principle, says the patient group is limited to milder cases with no 'no cure, no pay', and rejects discouraging the contracts, while noting ROM measurement debates and promising monitoring with patient organisations.
I therefore do not intend to discourage this type of agreement.
Ik ben daarom niet van plan om dit type afspraken te ontmoedigen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat het Academisch Medisch Centrum (AMC) door de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) gedwongen wordt de magistrale bereiding van het middel CDCA (chenodeoxy

An SP MP asks the Minister how the inspectorate (IGJ) handled the halt of compounded CDCA at Amsterdam UMC, the Belgian price comparison, the manufacturer Leadiant's pricing, and whether CDCA should move into the basic package. The Minister explains that the inspectorate acted on a enforcement request from Leadiant after tests found unknown impurities, says the inspection investigation is not finished, condemns Leadiant's pricing as socially unacceptable and plans a meeting with the company, and states that CDCA reimbursement is expected to be advised on in autumn 2018.
After consultation with the inspectorate, Amsterdam UMC stopped the compounding and supply of CDCA.
Na overleg met de inspectie is het Amsterdam UMC daarop gestopt met de bereiding en terhandstelling van CDCA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over het stoppen van magistrale bereiding door het Amsterdam UMC

An MP asked the Minister whether the inspectorate's investigation of Amsterdam UMC followed a manufacturer's enforcement request, how quickly the inspectorate responds, and why the hospital was not allowed to continue compounding with a clean batch. The Minister confirmed the enforcement request came from Leadiant, explained the inspectorate found unknown impurities above the Pharmacopoeia limit, and said further regulation for compounding is not yet needed while promising an update by end of October.
Because of the parliamentary questions and publicity around this case, the inspectorate is examining whether it can actively make its decision public in due course.
Vanwege de gestelde Kamervragen en de publiciteit rondom deze casus onderzoekt de inspectie de mogelijkheid om haar besluit te zijner tijd actief openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de vele berichten dat kinderen en volwassenen verdrinken in de zomerperiode

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care, with the Minister of Education, about drownings linked to weak swimming skills, falling swimming ability among children, and supervision of recreational water sites. The minister said the statistics show drownings are stable and largely in line with past years, pointed to the national swimming safety plan and the NL Zwemveilig project, and said provinces enforce supervision rules under the Whvbz, with no obligation for every recreational site to appoint supervisors.
I trust that this plan will adequately address the various aspects you mention.
Ik vertrouw erop dat dit plan voldoende in gaat op de diverse aspecten die u hiervoor noemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de grootverdieners in de zorgsector

An MP asks the health minister about a report of very high profits in home-care provision funded by public money, the absence of follow-up checks on care delivery in Almelo, extending the Wet toelating zorginstellingen to Wmo services, options to curb profits in extramural care, and whether owners fall under the planned top-income legislation. The minister points to a forthcoming letter on profit distribution with results by early 2019, explains that municipalities are responsible for checking Wmo providers, rejects extending the WTZi to Wmo services, and says owners acting as top functionaries are already covered by the WNT.
In my view, bringing Wmo 2015 under the WTZi does not fit the decentralised system in which municipalities are responsible for implementing the Wmo 2015.
Naar mijn oordeel past het onder de WTZi brengen van de Wmo 2015 niet in het gedecentraliseerde stelsel waarin gemeenten verantwoordelijk zijn voor de uitvoering van de Wmo 2015.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Tielen en De Lange over het bericht 'Húsdokter yn oplieding wol graach nei Fryslân, mar mei net'('Huisarts in opleiding wil graag naar Fryslân, maar mag niet')

Three VVD MPs asked why medical faculties restrict GP trainees to stages within their own university region, despite shortages in regions like Friesland, and asked about criteria, overviews and possible talks with HON. Minister Bruins replied that the uniform national allocation procedure already considers shortage regions, that HON is evaluating allowing transfers to shortage areas by Q3 2018, that no study delays were found, and that a LHV-linked study on GP location motives is being set up.
One of the recommendations from that evaluation is to allow transfers to shortage areas under conditions.
Een van de aanbevelingen uit die evaluatie is om overplaatsing naar krimpgebieden onder voorwaarden toe te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sazias en Van Brenk over het bericht ‘Voeding krijgt plek in opleiding geneeskunde Amsterdam’

Two 50PLUS MPs asked the health minister about a report that medical students receive under 30 hours of nutrition education and whether nutrition should get a firmer place in medical training. The minister acknowledged nutrition's importance, said curricula already meet the Raamplan, noted the government cannot dictate curricula due to freedom of education, and committed to raising nutrition in the planned Raamplan revision and ongoing talks with stakeholders.
The Raamplan mentions nutrition under prevention and nutrition and health under nutrition-related diseases.
In het raamplan wordt onder preventie «voeding» en onder voedingsgerelateerde ziekten «voeding en gezondheid» genoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de brandbrief van de FNV over de ambulancezorg

An SP MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about a FNV union letter on staff shortages in ambulance care, whether talks with regional acute care boards included unions, and why unions were not involved in a medium-care ambulance pilot. The minister answers that the pilot was not a sector-wide application, that regional ambulance services consulted their works councils, and refers to a separate letter sent to the FNV for the remaining questions.
Because it concerns a pilot and not a sector-wide application, the trade unions were not involved in carrying out this pilot.
Omdat het een pilot betreft én het niet om een sectorbrede aanvraag gaat, zijn de vakbonden niet betrokken bij de uitvoer van deze pilot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht Veel onduidelijkheden rond halen VIPP-deadlines

An MP asks the health minister whether hospitals will meet the VIPP digitisation deadlines and what the consequences of missing them are for data exchange. The minister says the module-B1 deadline was postponed from 1 July to 1 December 2018 after hospitals reported difficulty, that the NVZ has signalled no missed A1 deadlines, and that VWS will help where obstacles lie outside hospitals' control.
Following this, consultation was held and it was decided to amend the deadline in the regulation from 1 July 2018 to 1 December 2018.
Naar aanleiding hiervan is overleg gevoerd en besloten om de deadline in de regeling aan te passen van 1 juli 2018 naar 1 december 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de capaciteit in de mondzorg

An MP asked why the Capacity Body is being asked to study dental-care capacity again, when earlier reports already showed training capacity must rise, and whether the delay is a stalling tactic. The minister answered that the new study addresses quality doubts and the need to model task reallocation, starts in September 2018, and that the ministers will decide afterward, while declining to raise training places now.
There is no question of a 'delaying tactic' in the further study by the Capacity Body.
Er is bij het nader onderzoek door het Capaciteitsorgaan geen sprake van «vertragingstechniek».
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden De Lange en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Ramp voor de patiëntjes'

MPs De Lange and Aukje de Vries asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports of a shortage of paediatric staff at VUmc, and whether shortages elsewhere and the Werken in de Zorg programme would address them. The minister replied that there is no national shortage of paediatricians, that the shortage concerns paediatric IC nurses, that patients are still treated and planned operations are rerouted to other hospitals, and that longer-term measures and a study on regional imbalances are underway.
To clarify to what extent there are national, regional and local imbalances in the need for and availability of medical specialist functions and their causes, I will commission a study.

Om inzichtelijk te maken in hoeverre er landelijk, regionaal en lokaal sprake is van onevenwichtigheden in de behoefte aan en de beschikbaarheid van medisch specialistische functies en wat daarvan oorzaken zijn, laat ik een onderzoek uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de opleiding sportgeneeskunde

MP Hijink asked the minister why the SBOS, the training foundation for sports physicians, got into financial trouble, why its per-place funding is a third lower than for other specialties, and whether the ministry handled the financial problems properly. The minister denied any broken ministry commitments, defended the cost-covering funding as in line with EU state-aid rules, said the NZa will study training costs in 2019, and reported that the threatened bankruptcy was averted by a loan from SBOH with conditions attached.
The Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) plans to conduct research into the costs of training in medical specialist care in 2019.
De Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit is van plan in 2019 onderzoek te doen naar de kosten van opleidingen in de medisch specialistische zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over de juiste behandeling bij niet aangeboren hersenletsel

Two D66 MPs asked about the correct diagnosis and treatment of acquired brain injury, including waiting times for rehabilitation and support from municipalities. The minister answered that diagnosis is difficult, that a care standard for traumatic brain injury exists and is being implemented, that waiting times for outpatient consultations average about five weeks, and that existing initiatives to improve chain cooperation are underway.
No figures are known on this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de brief ‘Voortgang onderzoek asbest in cosmetica’ en het bericht ‘Johnson & Johnson moet schadevergoeding van 4 miljard euro betalen’

Lid Laçin (SP) asked whether the 296 talc-containing cosmetics tested for asbest should be retested with a more sensitive method (Fitzgerald method) and whether Johnson & Johnson products should be further investigated after a US damages ruling. The government declined to retest, saying the prescribed NEN 5896 method is adequate and it awaits an ISO decision, and said no further investigation of Johnson & Johnson products is warranted.
No, I am not willing to have the 296 products retested.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid de 296 producten opnieuw te laten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat in Nederland steeds vaker zware pijnstillers worden voorgeschreven

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports of rising prescribing of strong painkillers such as oxycodone, the possible link to ziekenhuis pain scores, hospital information on opioid addiction, and patient deaths. The minister acknowledged increased use, pointed to professional guidelines and monitoring, denied that hospital pain scores create an incentive, and gave partial figures on overdoses while noting addiction data is not available.
It is important to continue monitoring developments regarding opioid use.
Het is van belang om de ontwikkelingen met betrekking tot gebruik van opioïden te blijven monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het niet langer beschikbaar zijn van implanteerbare insulinepompen

MP Ploumen asks the minister whether the manufacturer Medtronic's discontinuation of implantable insulin pumps, with no reliable alternative in sight, is acceptable and what the government is doing about patients left without pumps. The minister confirms the discontinuation, says he has urged Medtronic to continue production and supported an alternative-pump initiative, but states he cannot legally compel manufacturers to produce or supply medical devices.
I cannot legally force manufacturers of medical devices to produce or supply medical devices.
Ik kan fabrikanten van medische hulpmiddelen bij wet niet dwingen tot productie of leveren van medische hulpmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht ‘ZGT hangt aan het infuus bij de bank

Two SP MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about ZiekenhuisGroep Twente's financial trouble, insurers' 20 million euro reclaim, the Supervisory Board approving accounts the auditor did not fully endorse, and whether accountability or further investigation is warranted. The Minister answered that the hospital bears responsibility for its finances, insurers' claims reflect agreed prepayment arrangements, the Supervisory Board assessed the matter and found no further steps needed, and he sees no reason for a further investigation.
I do not have an overview of the hospitals that exceeded their agreed budget or turnover ceilings in 2017 and as a result must repay amounts to health insurers.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de ziekenhuizen die over 2017 hun afgesproken budget- of omzetplafonds hebben overschreden en als gevolg hiervan een bedrag moeten terugbetalen aan de zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Kröger over het rapport 'Hoogspanningslijnen en gezondheid deel I: kanker bij kinderen'

MPs Ellemeet and Kröger asked whether the Health Council report linking long-term exposure to magnetic fields with childhood leukaemia and brain tumours should prompt precautionary measures extended to underground cables and existing housing. The State Secretary acknowledged the report, said magnetic fields cannot be shielded, and committed to an evaluation of the current precautionary policy and an exploration of extending it, without prejudging outcomes.
It will be evaluated how the precautionary policy for overhead lines has been implemented so far and what its societal effects are.
Er zal worden geëvalueerd hoe het voorzorgbeleid voor bovengrondse lijnen tot nu toe is uitgevoerd en wat hiervan de maatschappelijke effecten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht '#MeToo: artsen gaan niet vrijuit'

An MP asked the ministers about reports that many doctors and junior doctors have experienced sexual intimidation and that few victims report it, and about the lack of change since 2006. The government acknowledges the problem, points to employer responsibility under the Working Conditions Act, existing tools and the Werken in de zorg programme, and promises to talk with the sector about additional measures.
I, like the State Secretary of SZW, am working to ensure that employers in healthcare have an eye for this and act on it, as explained in the answer to questions 4 and 5.
Ik draag er, net als de Staatssecretaris van SZW, zoals toegelicht in het antwoord op vragen 4 en 5, aan bij dat werkgevers in de zorg hier oog voor hebben en werk van maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de overlast ten gevolge van lachgas

Labour MP Ploumen asked the ministers about nitrous oxide (lachgas) nuisance, including the status of voluntary sales restrictions, prevention materials, possible repressive measures, municipal powers and reported nuisance. State Secretary Blokhuis answered that voluntary measures are being agreed with retailers, Trimbos is developing prevention materials, monitoring continues and further measures will be considered if voluntary steps fail.
If it turns out that the voluntary restrictive measures and additional prevention efforts do not have the desired effect, I will consider possible additional measures.
Wanneer blijkt dat de vrijwillige beperkende maatregelen en extra inzet op preventie niet het gewenste effect heeft, zal ik mij beraden op mogelijke extra maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de privatisering van het patiëntencontact door bedrijven die geld verdienen aan het informeren van kankerpatiënten

An SP MP asked the Minister whether paid private services that advise cancer patients before oncologist consultations, and the resulting privatisation of patient contact, are acceptable and whether legal steps could stop them. The Minister replied that information from one's own care provider is part of regular care, that patients may freely buy extra advice, that no legal change is planned, and that the government will support shared decision-making through the 'Uitkomstgerichte Zorg 2018–2022' programme.
I see no reason to amend a law to restrict patients in this regard.
Ik zie geen aanleiding een wet aan te passen om patiënten hierin te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van den Berg over het bericht dat Noord-Holland opheldering eist over uitspraken Wiebes over Pallas-reactor

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government will act quickly so that Noord-Holland's final 40 million euro loan tranche to the Pallas reactor foundation is released and isotope supply delays are avoided. Minister Bruins answered that a go/no-go decision is expected soon, that the province is responsible for the loan decision, and that intensive contact with Noord-Holland is ongoing, without committing to a specific new step.
I am not responsible for the decision-making of the province of Noord-Holland.
Ik ben niet verantwoordelijk voor de besluitvorming van de provincie Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het afschaffen van het vrijwillig eigen risico

MP Hijink (SP) asked whether abolishing the voluntary deductible (vrijwillig eigen risico) would allow the mandatory deductible to be lowered, and whether the voluntary deductible undermines solidarity. The minister rejected the claim that abolition would free budget for a lower mandatory deductible, rejected the solidarity concern citing CPB research, and declined to propose abolition.
At this moment I see no reason to abolish the voluntary deductible.
Ik zie op dit moment geen reden om het vrijwillig eigen risico af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het artikel ‘Zorgtop verdient aanzienlijk minder dan vijf jaar geleden’

An MP asked whether the government will ensure the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT) is applied in spirit, not just letter, after hospital Nij Smellinghe reportedly gave two directors large severance payments without disclosure because they were not formally 'topfunctionarissen'. The minister replied that WNT compliance is good, that the disclosure duty for non-top-officials' severance was removed in 2017, and that institutions decide what transparency is appropriate, without committing to new action.
Within the limits the law sets, it is up to the institutions themselves to determine what an appropriate degree of disclosure is.
Binnen de grenzen die de wet stelt, is het aan de instellingen zelf om te bepalen wat een passende mate van openbaarmaking is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Pia Dijkstra over het uitblijven van een besluit over de overgangsregeling voor mbo- en inservice verpleegkundigen

MPs Bergkamp and Pia Dijkstra asked why no decision has been taken on the transitional arrangement for mbo-trained and in-service nurses, and about the planned expert committee. The minister answers that no existing body can assess these training programmes on both content and level, so an independent expert committee will be set up, with results expected in Q4 2018 and the BIG II bill to follow by end 2018.
To take a careful decision on the transitional arrangement, an independent party is needed that can assess these follow-up training programmes on both content and level.
Om een zorgvuldig besluit te nemen over de invulling van de overgangsregeling is een onafhankelijke partij nodig die deze vervolgopleidingen op zowel inhoud als niveau kan beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Beroerde arbeidsomstandigheden in kraamzorg’

Two MPs from the Labour party asked the minister about reports of poor working conditions in midwifery care, including structural overtime and inability to take holidays or sick leave. The minister said the monitor's findings are important signals if representative, that employers must follow existing rules, and that the sector is working on workload reduction, workforce planning, and an academy, with a subsidy for workforce planning.
There are no detailed projections known about the expected shortages of midwifery care staff.
Er zijn geen gedetailleerde ramingen bekend over de (te verwachten) tekorten aan kraamverzorgenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Dodelijke bacterie rukt op in Nederland’

MPs Diertens and Pia Dijkstra asked about the meningococcal vaccine shortage after the national programme was changed, the later vaccination of 14-year-olds, and why scarce vaccines were kept for travellers. The state secretary explained the tender shortfall, said the risk remains very small, and that free-market travel vaccines are outside government control.
Therefore, from 1 May 2018 children aged 14 months will be vaccinated, and teenagers born between 1 May 2004 and 31 December 2004 from 1 October 2018.
Daarom worden vanaf 1 mei 2018 kinderen van 14 maanden gevaccineerd en tieners geboren tussen 1 mei 2004 en 31 december 2004 vanaf 1 oktober 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het registreren van AED’s in overheidsgebouwen

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the low registration rate of AEDs, including those in government buildings, and whether government would coordinate with ministries and municipalities to register them. The minister acknowledged low registration, cited reasons such as non-public placement, and agreed to consult the Interior Minister, VNG and others.
Are you willing to consult with the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations so that all AEDs in or on (semi-)government buildings are registered?
Bent u bereid met de Minister van Binnenlands Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties in overleg te treden zodat alle AED’s in/aan (semi-)overheidsgebouwen geregistreerd worden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Transgenders ten einde raad: transitie stopt na faillissement instelling’

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the Minister of Medical Care about the bankruptcy of Psycho Informa Instellingen, which forced around 130 transgender patients to halt gender transition treatment, and asked about continuity of care, insurers' duty and protection of patient records. The Minister regrets the bankruptcy, says the matter was discussed in a VWS transgender care consultation where insurers advised patients to seek bemiddeling, confirms insurers have a duty of care, and points to professional record-keeping rules and curator obligations for patient files.
I regret that an institution has been declared bankrupt, as a result of which dozens of clients, including transgender people, cannot continue their treatment at this mental health institution.
Ik vind het te betreuren dat een instelling failliet is verklaard als gevolg waarvan tientallen cliënten, waaronder transgenders hun behandeling bij deze GGZ-instelling niet kunnen vervolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat een verslaggever van Zembla wordt aangehouden bij een lezing over een fout van het UMC Utrecht

An SP MP asked the minister whether a Zembla journalist's exclusion and arrest at a UMC Utrecht lecture on a medical error, and the hospital's earlier attempt to have a patient sign a silence agreement, were acceptable, and asked about the handling of the case and the hospital's progress on openness. The minister declined to comment on the journalist dispute, said the hospital's exclusion of one journalist is not structural, opposed silence agreements, and described the hospital's improvement measures as positive.
I refrain from commenting on both the journalist's statements and the hospital's statements.
Ik onthoud me van commentaar op zowel de verklaringen van de journalist als de verklaringen van het ziekenhuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Twintigers en dertigers trouwen minder”

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the decline in marriage among people in their twenties and thirties, and about the purpose, access and categories of the civil registry, including whether divorce status can be avoided and whether the registry should be modernised. The Minister explained the registry's evidentiary and legal purpose, denied a separate divorce register, said civil status cannot be freely chosen because of legal consequences for others, and promised to await the Staatscommissie Herijking Ouderschap results in early 2019 before deciding on follow-up.
Entering into a marriage is one of the possibilities.
Het aangaan van een huwelijk is daarbij een van de mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Veel huisartsen nog onbekend met declaratiemogelijkheden e-mailconsult'

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about awareness among GPs of how to declare e-mail consultations, and about how to promote them and other remote care.
