The minister answered that many GPs lack knowledge, that 62 percent offer e-mail consultations, that a handbook and NZa guidance are being issued, and that remote care will be promoted, but no parliamentary oversight of the executive is at stake.
I certainly see the e-mail consultation as an added value, for both the GP and the care user, in daily practice.
Ik zie het e-mailconsult zeker als een meerwaarde, voor zowel huisarts als zorggebruiker, in de dagelijkse praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat Sanquin een koper zoekt voor Sanquin Plasma Products (SPP)

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the minister about reports that Sanquin is seeking a buyer for its loss-making subsidiary Sanquin Plasma Products, asking about production problems, finances, the risk of bankruptcy, safeguards for the public plasma supply, and interested parties. Minister Bruins answered that production issues are being handled under CBG risk-limiting measures, SPP closed 2017 positively, a strategic partner is sought for market consolidation, the supply is secured in a convenant, and talks with interested parties are confidential.
Since this involves a dialogue between market parties, I want to respect the confidentiality of the talks.
Aangezien het hier een dialoog tussen marktpartijen betreft wil ik de vertrouwelijkheid van de gesprekken respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel ‘Kweekvlees is er! Maar we mogen het niet proeven’

An MP asks the ministers of Agriculture and Medical Care about the status of approval of cultured meat under EU novel food rules, EU efforts to speed approval, remaining legal barriers, and the NVWA's sealing of cultured meat packages. The government replies that cultured meat is not yet approved or in the EU list, no application has been filed, speeding up is very limited, no other legal barrier exists, and it supports the NVWA's enforcement action.
I support the NVWA's actions in this matter.
Ik ondersteun het optreden van de NVWA in deze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat de Franse investeerder Orpea een Nederlands zorgbedrijf met omstreden managementteam koopt

An MP asks the Health Minister about the acquisition of Dagelijks Leven, a Dutch elderly care provider, by French investor Orpea, including the role of its management, government funding, and whether foreign ownership should be curbed. The minister answers that the takeover was cleared by the NZa under competition rules, that no financial problems or Waardigheid en Trots funds were involved, that foreign and domestic owners are treated alike under existing regulation, and that the IGJ monitors governance.
Care institutions are private institutions and are responsible for decisions on the organisation of care provision, governance and ownership relations.
Zorginstellingen zijn private instellingen en zijn verantwoordelijk voor beslissingen omtrent de organisatie van de zorgverlening, het bestuur en de eigendomsrelatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de voorgenomen sluiting van de dienstapotheek in de Hoeksche Waard

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about CZ's plan to close the out-of-hours pharmacy in the Hoeksche Waard, including a target date of 1 September and whether subsidy and doctor's-bag alternatives are permissible. The Minister answered that talks are ongoing with no final decision, that closure would only proceed once local criteria are met, and that the government is concerned with efficient arrangements rather than keeping one pharmacy open.
What matters to me is that the pharmaceutical acute care is organised efficiently, with patients having access at all times to emergency medication and the necessary pharmaceutical care.
Het gaat mij erom dat de farmaceutische ANZ-zorg doelmatig is ingericht, waarbij patiënten te allen tijde toegang hebben tot spoedmedicatie en de noodzakelijke farmaceutische zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Graaf over het sluiten van kinderafdelingen in de ziekenhuizen in Hoogeveen en Stadskanaal

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Graaf asked the Minister of Medical Care about Treant's plan to close children's wards and acute obstetrics at Hoogeveen and Stadskanaal, and its consequences for care, travel times, finances and the regional decision process. The minister answered that the impact on care quality and safety is being examined by the IGJ, that 45-minute access for acute obstetrics is ensured, and that the regional body ROAZ is involved, but gave no details on financial consequences and deferred several points to a separate letter to parliament.
Together with my answers to these parliamentary questions I am also sending a letter to the House of Representatives regarding this proposed Treant decision.
Tegelijk met mijn antwoorden op deze Kamervragen stuur ik ook een brief aan de Tweede Kamer met betrekking tot dit voorgenomen besluit van Treant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijksma over kindergeneeskunde in Drenthe

An MP asked the minister about the planned closure of obstetrics and paediatric wards at Treant hospital in Drenthe, including midwives' concerns, IGJ contact, and shortages of doctors. The minister answered that the matter is primarily the responsibility of the provider and insurers, referred to a separate letter, and announced further study of regional doctor shortages.
The organisation of care in the region is, as you know, primarily the responsibility of care providers and health insurers.
De organisatie van de zorg in de regio is, zoals u weet, primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Agnes Mulder over de voorgenomen sluiting van de acute verloskunde in Stadskanaal en Hoogeveen

MPs Van den Berg and Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked the minister about Treant's plan to concentrate acute obstetrics and paediatrics in Emmen, closing Stadskanaal and Hoogeveen, including the insurer's objections, paediatrician recruitment, regional impact and consultation. The minister declined to take sides between insurer and provider, described recruitment efforts, said the decision is not yet final, and referred the remaining questions to a separate letter to parliament.
I do not wish to interfere in a discussion between the health insurer and the care provider.
Ik wil mij niet mengen in een discussie tussen de zorgverzekeraar en zorgaanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de voorgenomen sluiting van de dienstapotheek in onder andere de Hoeksche Waard

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Medical Care about CZ's plan to close on-call pharmacies during unprofitable hours, notably in the Hoeksche Waard, and about the end of the state subsidy capping emergency drug prices. The minister said the subsidy will end on 1 January 2019, that closing pharmacies is not an adequate solution and alternatives such as vending machines and delivery should be explored, and that talks with insurers are ongoing with nothing decided.
Simply closing on-call pharmacies is not an adequate solution; alternatives will have to be sought for obtaining medicines and pharmaceutical care.
Het simpelweg sluiten van dienstapotheken is geen adequate oplossing, er zal naar alternatieven moeten worden gezocht voor het verkrijgen van geneesmiddelen en farmaceutische zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de toekomst van de klinische verloskunde en klinische kindergeneeskunde

MP Ellemeet (GroenLinks) asked the Minister for Medical Care about Treant hospital group's plan to close the clinical obstetrics and paediatrics departments at Bethesda Hoogeveen and Refaja Stadskanaal, and about its consultation of partners, shortages of paediatricians, ambulance response times and staff anxiety. The Minister answered that the plan is a non-final proposal, that responsibilities of the parties are set out in a separate letter, that nationally there is no paediatrician shortage, and that further research will be done.
Furthermore, there are concerns, among other things, about the freedom of choice of pregnant women, for example to give birth at home.
Verder zijn er onder meer zorgen over de keuzevrijheid van zwangeren om bijvoorbeeld thuis te bevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de verspilling van medicijnen

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about wasted medicines, GP re-dispensing of leftover drugs, and whether re-dispensing should be allowed, including a thermometer-sealed bag and chip technology. The Minister rejects loosening the rules, citing quality and safety risks, and states that re-dispensing is only cost-effective for expensive drugs, while promoting measures to reduce waste.
I do not have exact figures on the extent of the waste.
Ik heb geen exacte cijfers over de omvang van de verspilling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Binnen vijf jaar nieuw ziekenhuis’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about Treant's draft regional plan to concentrate acute and complex care in a new intervention centre, the 93 job losses and whether emergency, maternity and paediatric services will stay in all three hospitals. The Minister answers that hospital care organisation is primarily the responsibility of providers and insurers, that the draft is not yet decided, and that a decision on maternity and paediatrics has been published with a separate letter to parliament.
As you know, the organisation of care in the region is primarily the responsibility of care providers and health insurers.
Zoals u weet is de organisatie van de zorg in de regio primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de dreigende verdwijning van de klinische verloskunde uit het Bethesda Ziekenhuis Hoogeveen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about Treant's plan to close the clinical obstetrics department at Bethesda Hospital Hoogeveen due to a shortage of paediatricians, and whether the Minister would intervene. The Minister answered that the decision is a proposal referred to in a separate letter, that the responsibilities of parties are set out there, and that nationally there is no paediatrician shortage, with a regional study agreed.
Treant's intended decision has triggered many reactions.
Het voorgenomen besluit van Treant heeft veel reacties opgeroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Tandartsentekort dreigt door wegblijven buitenlandse tandartsen’

An SP MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about reports that a language test for foreign-trained dentists is worsening a dentist shortage, whether the government will expand training places, and why a Panteia capacity report was not sent to parliament. The minister says the language requirement is justified, that no shortage signals exist from the inspectorate or regulator, that the final report will be sent before the summer recess, and that no additional study was started.
It is customary to send only the final report to the House.
Het is gebruikelijk slechts het eindrapport aan de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht ‘Statement Transvisie: Zorg voor transgender kinderen komt veel te laat'

An MP asked the Minister whether waiting times of up to 62 weeks in transgender care, especially for children and adolescents, are acceptable, and what action will be taken to reduce them. The Minister acknowledged the waits are too long, pointed to a quality standard due this year, expert-centre expansion talks, and stated that municipalities and insurers are responsible for their own provision, while the Minister does not hold data on municipal caps.
I do not have this information.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over vieze endoscopen in ziekenhuizen

An MP asked the minister about contaminated endoscopes in hospitals, following a report that Erasmus MC found duodenoscopes often dirty, and whether patients were informed and inspectorates involved. The minister answered that only duodenoscopes were studied, patients could not be individually informed due to batch cultures, the IGJ was informed and keeps monitoring, and the WIP guideline lapsed with a successor expected in 2018.
The inspectorate is not taking additional measures following the study results, closely monitors signals and draws attention to this on its website.
De inspectie neemt geen extra maatregelen naar aanleiding van de resultaten van het onderzoek, volgt nauwlettend signalen en vraagt aandacht hiervoor op haar site.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Sneller over het bericht dat miljoenen te besparen valt op dure medicijnen

D66 MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care whether doctors prescribe cheaper, equally effective biosimilars less often, whether this could save hundreds of millions a year, and what is being done to improve their reputation. The minister acknowledged rising biosimilar use, said the savings potential is uncertain, and pointed to a subsidised implementation programme and ongoing stakeholder engagement, without any structural change to oversight.
Prescribing biosimilars, however, is not a goal in itself.
Het voorschrijven van biosimilars is echter geen doel op zich.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de uitspraken van korpschef Akerboom over partydrugs

An MP asked the ministers about police chief Akerboom's claims that drug-related deaths rose sharply and that drug use sustains extreme violence, and whether harder sentences raise drug prices. The government answered that the death figures are not yet reliable due to registration changes, that it knows of no evidence that harsher penalties make the market more lucrative, and that its drug policy distinguishes soft from hard drugs to protect public health.
At this moment, therefore, a reliable picture is lacking.
Op dit moment ontbreekt dus een betrouwbaar beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Omtzigt over het onderzoek naar paasvuren

MPs Von Martels and Omtzigt asked why RIVM is studying Easter bonfire emissions, who commissioned it, its cost, and whether Easter fires are intangible heritage. The government answered that RIVM is updating the national emissions register under international obligations, estimated Easter fire PM10 emissions at about 10% of stove emissions, and budgeted 6,800 euro for a sizing study before any decision on inclusion.
Therefore it was decided to further determine the size of the source in 2018.
Daarom is besloten om in 2018 de grootte van de bron nader te gaan bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de mogelijkheden van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt om in te grijpen bij excessieve prijzen voor medicijnen

An MP asked the minister whether the competition authority ACM could use abuse-of-dominance rules against excessive medicine prices, and why it had not done so, and asked about cooperation with foreign regulators and the status of a European Commission investigation. The minister answered that such rules have never been applied to patented medicines, that the ACM is only beginning to examine the issue, that cooperation runs through the European competition network and bilateral contacts, and that the Commission's Aspen investigation is still ongoing.
However, the prohibition on abuse of a dominant position has in practice never been applied to patented medicines.
Het verbod op misbruik van een economische machtspositie is echter in de praktijk nog nooit toegepast voor geoctrooieerde geneesmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijksma over het grote aantal patiënten dat klachten ervaart na de door de zorgverzekering afgedwongen overstap van medicijn

MP Dijksma asked the minister about patients experiencing complaints after insurer-enforced switches between medicine brands, and about binding rules, monitoring, insurer compliance with medical-necessity notes, and research. The minister acknowledged the report, said prescribers and pharmacists should inform and guide patients, rejected a general cap on switches and stricter enforcement for now, and promised a study of switching reasons and a letter on planned savings.
I will carry out research into the reasons for switching medication so that I can better determine which measures are needed to prevent the disadvantages of (frequent) switching.
Ik zal onderzoek uitvoeren naar de redenen voor het wisselen van medicatie om zo beter te kunnen bepalen welke maatregelen nodig zijn om nadelen van (veelvuldig) wisselen te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Bruins Slot over het gebruik van levensgevaarlijke doping door amateursporters

Two MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about the dangerous slimming agent DNP used by amateur athletes, including prevalence, government warnings, a planned doping action plan and customs and enforcement findings. The minister said prevalence of DNP use is unknown, described existing warnings and education programmes, noted a RIVM study showing 0.5% of adults used performance-enhancing substances in the past year, and reported that the NVWA investigation into seized DNP shipments is complete with prosecutions ongoing.
Figures on the use of DNP in the Netherlands are not known.
Cijfers over het gebruik van DNP in Nederland zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Arissen over de gevoeligheid van de eendenhouderij voor vogelpest

MPs Ouwehand and Arissen asked the government about the susceptibility of duck farming to avian influenza, outbreak frequency, hygiene, welfare links and whether duck farming should be closed. Minister Schouten answered that ducks are more easily infected, that housing and biosecurity measures reduce but cannot eliminate risk, and that she does not intend to ban duck farming, instead pursuing a future-vision trajectory with the sector and animal welfare groups.
I do not intend to ban duck farming in the Netherlands.
Ik ben niet van plan de eendenhouderij te verbieden in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over zwemvaardigheden

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether it is undesirable that children with a migrant background and low socioeconomic status less often hold swimming diplomas, who is responsible for helping them, and whether the national swimming safety plan will address this. The minister replied that parents bear primary responsibility, that the Nationale Raad Zwemveiligheid is drafting a plan, and that he will decide on government measures after its advice, with research results due in 2018 and 2019.
The primary responsibility for learning to swim and obtaining the complete Zwem ABC diploma lies with the parents.
De primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor het leren zwemmen en het behalen van het complete Zwem ABC diploma, ligt bij de ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Thuismedicatie in ziekenhuis scheelt kosten en fouten’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a report on continuing patients' home medication in hospitals, its cost savings, implementation barriers, IT and financing obstacles, and extension to other care sectors. The Minister agreed waste should be curbed, pointed to a forthcoming consultation with stakeholders and NZa clarification of financing rules, and said the 15 million euro savings figure is only a rough extrapolation.
I will soon be meeting with, among others, pharmacists, prescribers and health insurers.
Ik ga binnenkort in gesprek met onder andere apothekers, voorschrijvers en zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijksma over het bericht ‘Zorgverzekeraars beleggen zelf in peperdure medicijnen’

An MP asked the Minister whether health insurers investing in pharmaceutical firms accused of raising drug costs is a wrong signal and whether the ministry would press insurers to stop. The Minister replied that insurers are private parties responsible for their own investment policy, that only up to 1% of assets is in pharma as a shareholder engagement tool, and that no reason exists to ask them to stop.
The investment policy of insurers is not for me, but for the health insurers themselves.
Het beleggingsbeleid van verzekeraars is niet aan mij, maar aan de zorgverzekeraars zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars voor miljoenen euro's beleggen in farmaceutische bedrijven

An MP asks the Minister for Medical Care whether health insurers' investments in pharmaceutical companies, and the buffer requirements behind them, are acceptable given their duty to keep care costs down. The Minister replies that insurers set their own investment policy under DNB supervision, that exposure is small, and that he will not force them to stop investing.
The investment policy of health insurers is up to them.
Het beleggingsbeleid van zorgverzekeraars is aan henzelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Pia Dijkstra over zorgverzekeraars die beleggen in farmaceutische bedrijven

Two MPs asked the Minister whether health insurers investing in pharmaceutical firms charging very high drug prices creates a perverse incentive, and about insurers' invested capital and reserves. The Minister replied that exposure is small (under 0.1% in named firms), that ESG exclusion and engagement policies apply, and gave invested capital of 13.2 billion euros and equity of about 11 billion euros at end-2016.
I do not fear a perverse effect.
Ik vrees niet voor een pervers effect.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Gerven over het bericht dat Menzis ziekenhuizen financiert op basis van prestatiebekostiging

SP MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about Menzis paying ten hospitals for cardiac procedures based on outcomes, and whether this risks patient selection, cutting complex care, and undermining collaboration. The minister defends the outcome-based contracts as rewarding quality, says safeguards against risk selection exist with monitoring by the Dutch Heart Registry, and gives no commitments beyond periodic information and monitoring.
For this reason I am making additional agreements with the NHR on how it can inform me periodically.
Daarom maak ik met de NHR aanvullende afspraken over de wijze waarop zij mij periodiek kan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht 'US body brokers supply world with torsos, limbs and heads'

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about Reuters reports on US body brokers, an FBI raid on a company with a Dutch branch, and infected body parts, asking about Dutch import rules and inspection. The minister answered that the FBI had not contacted the Netherlands, the Dutch branch appears to be administrative, existing rules do not target body-part trade, and the Dutch customs do not inspect for disease, leaving responsibility with the user.
There is no legislation providing for checks on disease in the import or export of body parts.
Er is geen wetgeving die voorziet in controles op het terrein van ziektes bij de import of export van lichaamsdelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over bericht 'Medische gegevens in eigen beheer op je computer of telefoon: vanaf volgend jaar is het mogelijk'

An SP MP asked the health minister about a newspaper report on a patient-controlled electronic health record programme (MedMij) run by the Patient Federation, including its scope, funding, privacy safeguards, timing and the role of the Data Protection Authority. The minister answered that MedMij sets a certification framework for existing personal health environments rather than building a new one, that privacy and security rules apply, and that the Data Protection Authority supervises but is not formally involved in the pilot.
It is up to the AP itself to decide which initiatives it actively investigates.
Het is aan de AP zelf om te bepalen naar welke initiatieven zij actief een onderzoek instelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijksma over het bericht ‘Tientallen snuffelden ongeoorloofd in medisch dossier Barbie’

MP Dijksma asks the Minister for Medical Care how the government views reports that dozens of unauthorised people viewed a patient's medical file at HagaZiekenhuizen, whether the Inspectorate's role is clear, and whether other hospitals and the rules should be checked or tightened. The Minister says such access is unwanted and prohibited, that the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) is primarily responsible for supervision with the Inspectorate handling care quality, that hospitals are responsible for data security, and that the rules are strict, so no tightening is planned.
The security of medical data falls under the responsibility of the hospitals themselves and the rules are strict and clear.
De beveiliging van medische gegevens valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de ziekenhuizen zelf en de regels zijn streng en duidelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat tientallen medewerkers van het HagaZiekenhuis ongeoorloofd een medisch dossier hebben ingekeken

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that dozens of HagaZiekenhuis staff unlawfully viewed a patient's medical record, and whether this shows the EPD/LSP system is unsafe. The minister said the LSP is not involved, the hospital's own records are access-controlled and under investigation, unlawful access would bring warnings or dismissal, and whether a breach occurred is for the Data Protection Authority to judge.
Whether there is a violation and whether measures must be taken is for the assessment of the Data Protection Authority.
Of sprake is van een overtreding en of er maatregelen moeten worden getroffen is ter beoordeling van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het artikel ‘Experts luiden de noodklok over falende aanpak tijgermug’

An MP asks the health minister whether invasive mosquito species should be prevented entirely, whether imports of used tyres and Lucky bamboo should be banned, and who is liable for a local epidemic. The minister answers that complete prevention cannot be promised, that NVWA will impose technical-hygienic rules on tyre importers but will not publish company names, and that liability cannot be determined in advance.
The names of the companies where exotic mosquitoes are found, I will not make public.
De namen van de bedrijven waar exotische muggen gevonden worden, zal ik niet bekend maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht 'By 2019, the first bionic kidney wil discard the need for dialysis'

An MP asked the health minister about a report on a bionic kidney that could replace dialysis and what the Netherlands is doing on artificial organs, including whether they could shorten transplant waiting lists and reduce organ trafficking. The minister described Dutch initiatives (portable artificial kidney, artificial pancreas), said such devices would not replace transplants soon, and said research funding is a matter for other ministers.
Stimulating research and innovation falls under the responsibility of the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate (EZK) and of Education, Culture and Science (OCW).
Het stimuleren van onderzoek en innovatie valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de Ministers van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (EZK) en Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijksma over het bericht 'Betaalbare medicijnen: waarom kan het in India wél?'

Dutch MP Dijksma asked the Minister for Medical Care about drug prices in India versus the Netherlands, maximum price setting, cooperation in the WTO and EU on pharmaceutical prices, compulsory licensing, and contact with India. The Minister acknowledged the price gap, described the Dutch reference-pricing system, said the government will pursue EU-level discussion and will inform parliament on compulsory licensing, and declined to contact the Indian counterpart for now.
Soon I will inform you in more detail on the subject of compulsory licensing in relation to medicines.
Binnenkort informeer ik u uitgebreider op het onderwerp dwanglicentie in relatie tot geneesmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over kwaliteitsregistraties in de zorg

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about hospitals' complaints that quality registrations are too burdensome, including the NVZ's call for a systemic overhaul, the difficulty of cutting indicators, comparison with OECD countries and the cost per hospital of accreditation and registration. The minister said he is in talks with the NVZ and tripartite parties, will send a plan of action to the House before summer that aims to reduce burden and add patient-reported outcome data, and cited a reduction in preoperative radiotherapy as evidence of benefit.
As I have previously promised, I will send my plan of action to the House before the summer, in which I combine both elements.
Ik stuur – zoals ik eerder heb toegezegd – voor de zomer mijn plan van aanpak naar de Tweede Kamer, waarin ik deze beide elementen verenig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Hijink inzake de brandbrief van de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Logopedie en Foniatrie

MPs Kooiman and Hijink (SP) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the NVLF's warning letter that first-line speech therapy tariffs are about 25% below NZa-set levels, threatening access and the insurers' duty of care, and about bargaining power, tariffs and vacancies. The Minister answered that the NZa is investigating the tariff developments and results are expected in early 2019, that insurers must meet their duty of care under NZa supervision, and that he sees no need for separate intervention.
I do not intend to conduct additional research on top of the investigation the NZa has already started.
Ik ben niet voornemens aanvullend onderzoek te gaan op het onderzoek dat de NZa al is begonnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg-Jansen over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek, uitgevoerd in opdracht van de LHV: werkdruk huisarts bedreigt kwaliteit van zorg

An MP asked the minister about an LHV-commissioned study finding that rising GP workload threatens care quality, linked to more elderly people living at home, and about solutions for shortages and insurer responses. The minister acknowledged the signal, pointed to a planned study with the LHV on GP location motives, existing measures such as practice managers and task transfer, and said insurers pursue varied regional approaches.
The LHV study shows that this is at stake for a part of the GPs.
Het onderzoek van de LHV laat zien dat dit bij een deel van de huisartsen in het geding is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over zwemvaardigheden

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about swimming skills, including whether children with migrant or low-SES backgrounds get swimming diplomas less often and whether the government will act. The minister points to an ongoing national plan (NL Zwemveilig) and says the government will await further research and inform parliament later.
I am awaiting these results and will consult with the National Water Safety Council on which measures the sector itself will take and what role the government can play in this.
Ik wacht deze resultaten af en ga met de Nationale Raad Zwemveiligheid overleggen welke maatregelen de sector zelf gaat nemen en welke rol de overheid daarin kan spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over bacteriofagen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care what steps are needed to allow magistral preparation of bacteriophages in hospitals, whether the Belgian model is applicable in the Netherlands, and whether the minister will consult the Belgian counterpart. The minister replied that individual use is in principle possible but clinical research is the preferred route, that applicability in the Netherlands cannot yet be judged, and that contact with Belgian colleagues has been made.
I therefore cannot yet make definitive statements about the applicability of this approach in the Netherlands.
Ik kan daarom nu geen definitieve uitspraken doen over de toepasbaarheid van deze werkwijze in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Futselaar over het bericht dat Brussel een kenniscentrum opricht voor bestrijding van voedselfraude en het bevorderen van voedselkwaliteit

MPs De Groot and Futselaar asked about the European Commission's planned knowledge centre on food fraud and food quality, including its tasks, staffing, budget, effect on national food authorities such as the NVWA, and legal basis. The minister answered that the centre supports the EU Food Fraud Network without changing national enforcement roles, that FTE and budget are unknown, and that the Commission alone decided on it without Dutch involvement.
I do not know how many FTE will be deployed for the knowledge centre and how many of these will be found within the existing staff of the Joint Research Centre of the European Commission.
Het is mij onbekend hoeveel fte zullen worden ingezet voor het kenniscentrum en hoeveel daarvan binnen de bestaande formatie van het Joint Research Centre van de Europese Commissie worden gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de forse toename van cosmetische ingrepen zoals behandelingen met botox en fillers

An MP asked the minister about the rise in cosmetic botox and filler treatments, including reports of unsafe practices at hairdressers and tanning salons, and whether there should be a total overview and an information campaign. The minister said the Inspectorate sees few such reports, that non-registered providers are only overseen reactively, that a legal amendment will clarify cosmetic injections are reserved acts, and that a quality framework and a consumer information tool are in progress.
I have asked the Inspectorate to draw up the overview you requested and will send it to you as soon as possible.
Ik heb de Inspectie verzocht om het door u gevraagde overzicht op te stellen en zal dit op zo kort mogelijke termijn aan u doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over een stopgezet medisch onderzoek in het AMC

An MP asked why a medical study on bile duct cancer patients was stopped after 14 of 54 participants died, whether it should have been reported to the inspectorate, how patients were informed, and why results were communicated late. The minister answered that serious events were reported to the METC, that the inspectorate lacks enough information to judge whether a calamity occurred, and that the CCMO is analysing the file with results expected in May.

At this moment the inspectorate has insufficient information to establish whether there was a calamity or irregularities during the conduct of the study, and whether this should have been reported to the inspectorate.

Op dit moment heeft de inspectie onvoldoende informatie om vast te stellen of hier sprake was van een calamiteit of van onregelmatigheden tijdens de uitvoering van de studie en of dit bij de inspectie gemeld had moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Veertien patiënten overleden bij medisch onderzoek AMC’

Dijkstra (D66) asked why the AMC study in which fourteen patients died was stopped and only now made public, why no report was made to the IGJ, and whether the two existing procedures' differing risks warrant further research. Minister De Jonge confirmed the figures and timing, said the CCMO is analysing the file and the IGJ will decide on further inquiry after the CCMO results, and held that no report was obviously required yet.
The CCMO has requested the research file from the METC and will subject it to further analysis.
De CCMO heeft het onderzoeksdossier opgevraagd bij de METC en zal dit aan een nadere analyse onderwerpen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Ellemeet over het bericht 'Zevende rechtszaak van Stichting GGZ Momentum tegen verzekeraar om vrije artsenkeuze: Achmea schendt artikel 13 Zorgverzekeringswet'

MPs Voortman and Ellemeet asked the minister about GGZ Momentum's lawsuits against insurer Achmea over low reimbursement for non-contracted mental health care, which may breach the free choice of provider under article 13 Zvw and shift costs to patients. The minister answered that the 75-80% reimbursement benchmark has held up in court, that NZa supervises article 13 and is investigating insurers' reimbursement, and that the government will examine contracting issues and report to parliament.
Health insurers have their own responsibility when it comes to following case law on care procurement.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben een eigen verantwoordelijkheid waar het gaat om het volgen van jurisprudentie met betrekking tot de zorginkoop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Volleybalbond denkt aan organisatie WK 2022’

An MP asked the minister whether the event framework's subsidy ceilings are adequate to bring a 2022 volleyball World Championship to the Netherlands and whether the framework would be revisited. The minister answered that the bid is the sports federation's initiative, that the government will explore its role within existing frameworks, and that the sports event framework is being evaluated this year with a decision expected in autumn.
I am willing to look at whether the central government, within the existing policy frameworks, can play a role in that.
Ik ben bereid om mee te kijken of de rijksoverheid, binnen de bestaande beleidskaders, daarbij een rol kan spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijksma over het bericht ‘Mogelijk één kraamafdeling voor drie Treant-ziekenhuizen’

An MP asked whether the temporary closure of obstetrics at Treant's Emmen hospital, which may lead to concentration of acute obstetrics in one or two Drenthe hospitals, is acceptable and what the minister will do about regional doctor shortages. The minister replied that Treant is still examining scenarios, that RIVM found concentration would not breach the 45-minute norm, and that regional care organisation is primarily the responsibility of providers and insurers.
The organisation of care in a region is primarily the responsibility of care providers and health insurers.
De organisatie van de zorg in een regio is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijksma en Van den Hul over de kwaliteit van zorg bij en de kennis over hart- en vaatziekten bij vrouwen

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about the quality of care for women with heart and vascular disease, gender-sensitive knowledge, and whether women are dying unnecessarily from missed diagnoses, and asked about the Dutch Heart Registry. The minister replied that scientific societies, not government, translate registry data into care, that a ZonMw gender-and-health programme will report on knowledge gaps, and that the government supports gender-sensitive care and women's presence in academic top positions.
Whether women are unnecessarily dying of heart and vascular disease due to missed diagnoses, I cannot assess.
Of vrouwen door gemiste diagnoses onnodig overlijden aan hart- en vaatziekten kan ik niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijksma en Nijboer over het bericht ‘Dreigend huisartsentekort in Oost-Groningen: Reden om je zorgen te maken’

MPs Dijksma and Nijboer asked the Minister about reports of a looming GP shortage in East Groningen, including ways to make setting up a practice more attractive, reducing administrative burden, contact with insurer Menzis and local partners, and other regions at risk. The Minister said the problem is regional and complex, pointed to a planned study with the LHV, administrative burden measures and a planned programme, and offered continued contact with local parties.
I am willing to stay in continuous contact with these parties about the bottlenecks they experience and the solutions they apply in practice.
Ik ben bereid doorlopend contact te houden met deze partijen over de ervaren knelpunten en de oplossingen hiervoor die zij in de praktijk toepassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Versnelde toelating medicijnen nauwelijks beter'

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a report that expedited drug approval yields little time gain, and about EU and Dutch options to speed access, the conditional marketing authorisation's use and results, US-EU differences, and member-state procedures. The Minister says initiatives like PRIME and joint scientific advice are being used, that the time gain is modest but real, and that new system changes will be considered only if current options prove insufficient.
I want the current possibilities for accelerated approval within the legal frameworks to be fully used first.
Ik wil dat de huidige mogelijkheden voor versnelde toelating binnen de wettelijke kaders eerst maximaal worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de opkomst van privéklinieken in Twente en de bezuinigingen in de Twentse ziekenhuizen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a private clinic opening near the Hengelo hospital, budget cuts at ZGT and MST in Twente, insurer Menzis and the NZa welcoming private clinics, and planned job cuts at MST. The Minister answered that the private clinic is a private matter, that he was not informed in advance, that he leaves insurer and hospital decisions to the parties concerned, and that the IGJ will monitor patient safety risks during the reorganisation.
However, I am not responsible for this either; this is a private matter.
Ik ga hier echter ook niet over; dit is een private aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Toename van spoedposten voor ouderen in ziekenhuizen'

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about a press report on growing numbers of geriatric outpatient clinics and trauma units in hospitals, asking about their working method, volumes, regional distribution and effect on emergency departments. The minister said there is no fixed model, the clinics are not separately registered, their effect on emergency room pressure is expected but not measured, and regional partnerships (ROAZ) are the main vehicle for tackling acute care pressure.
This concerns acute care; treatments at geriatric outpatient clinics or geriatric trauma units are not registered separately.
Het gaat hier om acute zorg, de behandelingen op ouderenpoli’s of geriatrische trauma units worden niet apart geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijksma over het bericht ‘Is er eindelijk een medicijn tegen een zeldzame ziekte, gaat het van de markt’

An MP asked whether the government would act after the withdrawal of etidronate, which may help patients with pseudoxanthoma elasticum, and whether it would contact the manufacturer about re-registration. The minister regretted that off-label use was not considered, pointed to import via physician statement and possible re-registration, and said no direct talks with manufacturers were needed for now.
The CBG was unable to include off-label use in patients with PXE in its weighing of patient interests.
Het CBG heeft het off-label gebruik in patiënten met PXE niet kunnen meenemen in de afweging van het patiëntenbelang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat medicatie voor botontkalking van de markt is gehaald terwijl het PXE-patiënten nieuwe hoop geeft

An SP MP asks why the bone-softening drug etidronate, which reportedly helped patients with PXE, was withdrawn from the Dutch market and whether it can be made available again quickly. The Minister explains that the CBG did not know of the off-label PXE use when withdrawing the licences, that doctors can still prescribe it via import, and that a faster registration route is possible but timing and feasibility cannot be estimated.
The CBG was unable to include the off-label use in patients with PXE in its weighing of patient interests.
Het CBG heeft het off-label gebruik in patiënten met PXE niet kunnen meenemen in de afweging van het patiëntenbelang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijksma over het stopzetten van de vergoeding van het medicijn Fampyra

An MP from the PvdA asks the Minister of Medical Care why Fampyra is no longer reimbursed, how this fits with neurologists' views and the EMA's favourable opinion, what other countries do, and whether the decision will be reconsidered. The Minister answers that the Zorginstituut found after a second assessment that Fampyra is not proven more effective than best supported care and does not show a meaningful quality-of-life effect, so the temporary reimbursement ends on 1 April 2018, and that the manufacturer can resubmit new evidence.
The Zorginstituut has now concluded that the manufacturer's research did not meet these pre-established effectiveness criteria.
Het Zorginstituut is nu tot de conclusie gekomen dat het onderzoek van de fabrikant deze vooraf vastgestelde effectiviteitscriteria niet heeft behaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Omtzigt en Rudmer Heerema over de btw-vrijstelling voor denksporten

MPs Bruins Slot, Omtzigt and Rudmer Heerema asked about the VAT exemption for mind sports (bridge, chess, draughts) after the 2017 CJEU ruling that such activities are not 'sport'. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling removes the sports exemption, estimates about EUR 1 million extra VAT revenue, and says talks are underway on possibly listing mind sports under the cultural services exemption, with a letter to the House promised before the summer recess.
However, I aim to inform the House in more detail about this before the summer recess.
Ik streef er echter wel naar uw kamer voor het zomerreces hierover nader te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijksma over het bericht ‘Farmabedrijven moeten open zijn over prijsvorming’

An MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about pharmaceutical price transparency, the Zorginstituut's claim that government is being blackmailed by drug makers, and the Spinraza price negotiations with Biogen. The Minister agrees the situation is untenable, promises to press manufacturers and pursue transparency initiatives, but declines to disclose confidential negotiation outcomes and defers further measures to a forthcoming letter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat ziekenhuisapothekers kampen met een chronisch tekort aan geneesmiddelen

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the minister about reports of chronic drug shortages in hospital pharmacies, their causes, and whether the preferential reimbursement policy is harming supply. The minister acknowledged the problems, described the Werkgroep Geneesmiddelentekorten's 20 measures and the reporting point, and argued that 2017 figures show fewer shortages for preferred drugs and that the policy cannot be evaluated in isolation yet.
I endorse the intention of the Drug Shortage and Defect Reporting Point to publish figures on reports periodically, so that comparisons will be possible in the future.
Ik onderschrijf het voornemen van het Meldpunt Geneesmiddeltekorten en -defecten om periodiek cijfers over de meldingen te publiceren, zodat in de toekomst vergelijkingen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat experts stellen dat de aanpak van topsalarissen in zorg symboolpolitiek is

An SP MP asks whether the government's plan to extend the WNT pay cap to subcontractors in healthcare closes loopholes such as director-shareholders taking dividends from BV structures, and whether an anti-abuse clause should be added. The minister replies that dividends fall outside the WNT's employment-based pay norm and under separate WTZi rules enforced by the IGJ, that the Council of State advised against an anti-abuse clause, and that no clause is planned for now.
I see no reason to conduct further investigation myself.
Ik zie geen aanleiding zelf verder onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht dat wietolie zo populair is dat gemeenten soepelere regels overwegen

An MP asked whether rising demand for medicinal cannabis oil and a Tilburg initiative easing enforcement for home growers warrant looser rules, and whether the government would consult the VNG. The minister answered that home cultivation remains illegal under the Opiumwet, that only the VWS minister can grant exemptions, and that no consultation with the VNG is planned because the regime is already well regulated.
Only the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS) can grant an exemption from this (Article 8 Opiumwet).
Alleen de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS) kan hiervan ontheffing verlenen (artikel 8 Opiumwet).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over een brede open studie naar het zorgstelsel en de zorgkosten

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked whether the government and the WRR would carry out a broad open study of the healthcare system and rising healthcare costs, as promised in the budget debate. The minister replied that the government supports the request, is consulting the WRR, and that the WRR will decide on its work programme this spring.
Yes, we have discussed your request and wholeheartedly support it.
Ja, wij hebben uw verzoek besproken en steunen het verzoek van harte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het onderzoek van de commissie-Sorgdrager naar het fipronilschandaal

An MP asked whether the Sorgdrager commission's investigation into the fipronil egg scandal covers all actors in the egg chain, why private-sector representatives sit on its advisory group, and whether civil society groups such as foodwatch are heard. The ministers answer that the commission is independent and broad in scope, that no representatives of investigated organisations sit on the advisory group, and that the government will not steer the commission's findings.
No representatives of organisations that are the subject of the investigation take part in the expert advisory group.
In de klankbordgroep van deskundigen nemen geen vertegenwoordigers deel van organisaties die onderwerp van onderzoek zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Hijink over de brandbrief van de KNGF aan zorgverzekeraars

MPs Kooiman and Hijink (SP) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the KNGF's open letter to health insurers complaining of unequal power, stalled negotiations, unprofitable physiotherapy tariffs, rising non-contracted practice and administrative burden. The Minister answered that the Hoofdlijnenakkoord Paramedische Zorg is making progress, that tariffs are a matter for individual negotiations with the NZa planning a study, that the cabinet favours multi-year contracts and will report in April 2018, and that power balances vary by sector and are monitored by the NZa and ACM.
I am not aware of any recent NZa study on physiotherapy tariffs. As for the KPMG study, I do not have it at my disposal.
Mij is geen recent uitgevoerd onderzoek van de NZa naar tarieven binnen de fysiotherapie bekend. Wat betreft het KPMG-onderzoek; dit heb ik niet tot mijn beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arissen over het niet publiceren van de Donorwet

An MP asked why the Donor Act, adopted by the Senate in February 2018, had not yet been published in the Staatsblad, and whether the delay hindered a citizens' referendum. The minister explained that a members' initiative bill must first be discussed in cabinet and that financing will be considered in spring budget decisions, citing a typical 30-day publication gap, while rejecting the claim of deliberate delay and promising to place the bill on the cabinet agenda as soon as possible.
That said, the proposal will be placed on the cabinet agenda as soon as possible.
Dit gezegd hebbende, zal het voorstel zo snel mogelijk geagendeerd worden in de ministerraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Sazias over de inzet van magistrale apotheekbereidingen in taperingstrips als middel om medicatie op verantwoorde wijze af te bouwen

MPs Kooiman and Sazias ask the minister why insurers refuse to reimburse magistral taper strips for withdrawing psychiatric medication, and how the Zorginstituut and insurers reached their positions. The minister replies that insurers and the Zorginstituut decide reimbursement under the rational pharmacotherapy criterion, that the minister has no formal role, and that a consensus document on antidepressant tapering is being prepared by the professional bodies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat EU-landen elkaar niet voldoende waarschuwen voor omstreden artsen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why EU states do not adequately warn each other about disciplined doctors, including a German dentist who practised in Nederland after restrictions elsewhere. The minister answered that no figures exist on how many such professionals work in the Netherlands, that Nederland takes over foreign restrictions in principle, and that refusing EU professionals for non-reporting would be unlawful, while promising to raise the warning mechanism with the European Commission.
No figures are available on the number of healthcare professionals from another Member State who received a restriction on their practice there and nonetheless went on to work in the Netherlands.

Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar van het aantal zorgverleners afkomstig uit een andere lidstaat die een bevoegdheidsbeperking in de lidstaat opgelegd hebben gekregen en desondanks in Nederland zijn gaan werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over vroege selectie en prestatiedruk bij jonge sporters

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about early selection and performance pressure among young athletes, including whether half of children quitting sport for lack of fun is linked to pressure, and whether the sports accord and youth football scouting should address this. The minister answered that fun should be central, that sports bodies are responsible for pedagogical safeguards, that the KNVB youth programme controls academies, and that no general data exist on outcomes for scouted players who do not reach professional football.
It is up to the sport itself to monitor and improve these processes.
Het is aan de sport zelf om deze processen te bewaken en te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de uitzending van Hart van Nederland over bacteriofagen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a Hart van Nederland broadcast on bacteriophage therapy in Georgia, whether it is acceptable that only the wealthy can access it, whether Dutch doctors should encourage it without evidence, when Dutch patients could be treated, what research is planned, and how subsidies could be directed to phage research. The minister answered that doctors must inform patients of risks and alternatives, that no Dutch timeline can yet be given because phages may require registration as medicines, that more clinical research is needed by researchers and companies, that ZonMw and NWO funding exists but no phage proposals were submitted, and that the RIVM literature study is expected in the second quarter of 2018.
I expect to receive the outcome of the literature study, which will also include the findings of the visit to Georgia, in the second quarter of this year.
Ik verwacht de uitkomst van de literatuurstudie, waarin ook de bevindingen van het bezoek aan Georgië opgenomen worden, in het tweede kwartaal van dit jaar te ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijksma over het bericht ‘Schaatscoach Jillert Anema ondernam poging tot matchfixing op Winterspelen Sotsji’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports that a Dutch speed-skating coach attempted matchfixing at the 2014 Sochi Olympics, and why NOC*NSF did not disclose it until four years later. The minister said he disapproves of matchfixing, that NOC*NSF informed him only during a visit to Korea and acted within IOC rules at the time, and that he stays in regular dialogue with NOC*NSF on sports integrity.
In this specific case, NOC*NSF chose not to make this incident public.
In deze specifieke casus heeft NOC*NSF ervoor gekozen om dit voorval niet naar buiten te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het tegengaan van matchfixing

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about match-fixing rules in sports, including whether suspected match-fixing must be reported to sports disciplinary committees and whether a formal disciplinary procedure should be a condition for state subsidies. The minister replied that sports federations adopted disciplinary rules in 2014-2016, that the 2014 Anema case predates the reporting duty and was therefore not reported, and that athletes bound by these rules lose state subsidies if sanctioned.
No, in the Anema case no report was made to a disciplinary committee.
Nee, in het geval van de zaak Anema is geen melding gedaan bij een tuchtcommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Willekeur bij publicatie voedselveiligheidswaarschuwingen”

MPs Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked the ministers why food safety warnings were published late or not at all by the NVWA, and how consumers could find them in one place. The minister replied that companies must issue public warnings themselves, that the NVWA can only require companies to publish, not to report to it, and that the NVWA will tighten its internal procedures and urge companies to notify faster.
In the TV broadcast the NVWA promised it would tighten its internal procedures so that public warnings are published faster.
In de Tv-uitzending heeft de NVWA toegezegd dat ze haar interne werkwijze gaat aanscherpen zodat publiekswaarschuwingen sneller worden gepubliceerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de belangen tussen zorgverzekeraars en kwaliteitsinstituten

An MP asked the health minister about the financial dependence of quality-registration bodies such as DICA on health insurers, the number and cost of accreditation institutes, and whether the registries are independent. The minister answered that DICA is independent with a board of professional associations, that insurers have no say over content, that costs fall under hospitals' own operations, and that no further investigation of other insurer-funded bodies is planned.
Health insurers have no governance involvement in quality registries such as DICA, nor any influence over the content of the registrations.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben geen bestuurlijke betrokkenheid bij kwaliteitsregistraties zoals DICA of invloed op de inhoud van de registraties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg-Jansen over het bericht dat de bloedvoorziening mogelijk in problemen komt

Members of parliament asked whether blood supply continuity is threatened by possible financial losses at Sanquin Plasma Products, and about pricing and monopoly concerns. The minister denied imminent financial trouble, said continuity is safeguarded by agreements and a pending bill, and defended the Dutch price level by citing lower usage and fixed costs.
My predecessor already asked Sanquin in 2012 to place the most risky non-statutory activities outside the foundation.
Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft in 2012 Sanquin reeds verzocht de meest risicovolle niet-wettelijke activiteiten buiten de stichting te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat het Erasmus MC buitenlandse patiënten naar Nederland wil halen

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister whether Erasmus MC's plan to attract more foreign patients reflects temporary or structural overcapacity in highly complex care, whether it displaces Dutch patients, and whether specialised equipment should be reserved for Dutch insured patients. The minister replied that there is no overcapacity, that the hospital already treats foreign patients and focuses on tertiary care, that waiting-list oversight lies with insurers and the NZa, and that foreign patients pay passant tariffs.
No, I am not responsible for this.
Nee, hier ga ik niet over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Leijten over het aandeel van banken in de financiering van de zorg

MPs Hijink and Leijten (SP) asked the Minister for Medical Care about banks' large lending to care institutions, whether premium funds pay bank interest, and whether banks pressure hospitals toward profitable specialisation. The minister answered that bank debt is normal for investment, the sector's solvency meets the norm, banks' scrutiny is legitimate, no evidence shows banks forcing specialisation, and the government will keep the current system.
It is not known what part of this amount was specifically spent on paying interest to banks on outstanding loans.
Het is niet bekend welk deel van dit bedrag specifiek is besteed aan het betalen van rentes aan banken over uitstaande leningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Ziekenhuizen behandelen intensief door bij levenseinde’

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister how the government views conflicting findings from a university consortium and the Zorginstituut on whether hospitals overtreat patients at the end of life, and why hospital-level practice variation was not studied. The minister answered that the Zorginstituut commissioned and published the studies, that its own analysis nuanced the consortium's findings, and that practice variation at hospital level was not requested because of legal limits on identifiable data, while saying further hospital-level research is possible only if institutions share data and declining to commission it now.
The Zorginstituut awarded the assignment on the basis of this offer, and informed the researchers that it has no legal possibility to publish information traceable to individual institutions.

Het Zorginstituut heeft de opdracht toegekend op basis van deze offerte, en heeft de onderzoekers laten weten dat het Zorginstituut juridisch geen mogelijkheden heeft om tot instellingen herleidbare informatie te publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat Rotterdam van plan is het tekort aan verpleegkundig ambulancezorg op te vangen door verpleegkundigen uit het buitenland te halen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about Rotterdam's plan to recruit foreign ambulance nurses to fill shortages, and about rising emergency calls and related staffing and triage problems. The Minister acknowledged the concerns, explained the recognition rules for foreign-trained nurses, and pointed to ongoing NZa and IGJ monitoring, triage studies and planned measures, while declining to intervene in pay negotiations.
I call on the sector to take action on this.
Ik roep het veld op hier werk van te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat een demente vrouw 250 euro moest betalen voor een consult waarbij zij niet betrokken is geweest

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a report that a woman with dementia was billed 250 euros for a consultation between doctors she was not part of, and how such billing via the deductible is possible. The minister answered that the claim was unlawful, the hospital and insurer Menzis are reversing it, telephone consults between specialists are not a billable basis, and that complaints can go to the NZa, while not knowing how often such cases occur.
I think it is positive that the son in this case critically examined the bill his mother (the patient) received.
Ik vind het positief dat de zoon in deze casus kritisch keek naar de door zijn moeder (de patiënt) ontvangen rekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over onveilige cv-ketels

An SP MP asked why the government's answers on faulty Nefit cv-boilers (types B3L and B3M) did not address heat-exchanger problems, when NVWA was informed, and whether boilers meet safety rules, among other questions about a carbon monoxide study and OvV recommendations. The minister answered that the NVWA was informed of B3L heat-exchanger problems from 2012 and of B3M issues in 2016, issued a formal order to Nefit to report all incidents, and that the independent CO study and RTL-commissioned research will be shared before summer, but gave evasive or referral answers on legislation, installer training and the OvV recommendations.
The NVWA then decided to demand all information about incidents involving the B3M type.
Daarop besloot de NVWA alle informatie over incidenten met het type B3M te vorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een voor aanranding veroordeelde trainer die toch coach kon blijven

An SP MP asked the Justice and Health ministers how a trainer convicted in absentia of indecent assault was able to keep coaching, what should change, and how cross-border screening of such coaches can be improved. The minister declined to go into the case because it is pending in cassation, but pointed to the KNVB's actions, the VOG screening policy for youth coaches, the ECRIS information exchange, and a forthcoming policy response to the De Vries report.
Because the person concerned has lodged an appeal in cassation and the case is therefore still before the courts, I cannot go into the details of this case.
Omdat betrokkene in cassatie is gegaan en de zaak dus nog onder de rechter is, kan ik niet in detail ingaan op deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijksma,  Ellemeet en Kooiman over het bericht ‘Megawinst farmaceut zet medicijndebat op scherp’

Three MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports of high profits by pharmaceutical firms, whether profits factor into drug price negotiations, how firms fulfil their social responsibility, and whether EU joint procurement could be expanded. The minister said firms should justify high prices and be transparent, called their social responsibility insufficient, declined to comment on negotiations, and pointed to ongoing BeNeLux and EU cooperation.
I do not make substantive statements about the negotiation process.
Ik doe geen inhoudelijke uitspraken over het onderhandelingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de herregistratie in het BIG-register voor profielartsen

An MP asked why profile physicians must separately re-register in the BIG register and provide an extra certified proof from the Medical Specialists Register, unlike other specialists, and whether this automatic link can be created. The minister confirms the separate procedure, says eleven of twelve profiles can use a lighter KNMG profile-register proof, is discussing digital delivery with CIBG and KNMG, and states that automatic linking applies only to legally recognised specialisms.
I am already in discussion with the CIBG, the executor of the BIG register, and the KNMG to examine whether and how these proofs can be delivered digitally.
Ik ben met het CIBG, uitvoerder van het BIG-register, en de KNMG reeds in gesprek om te bezien of en hoe deze bewijzen digitaal kunnen worden aangeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat kortingsacties voor cosmetische ingrepen op grote schaal worden ingezet om mensen over te halen een cosmetische ingreep te ondergaan

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about time-limited discount campaigns for cosmetic procedures and whether these should be banned. The minister said misleading or time-pressured advertising is prohibited under a self-regulatory advertising norm being implemented via the advertising code body, but declined to introduce a statutory advertising ban.
I do not intend to legally regulate an advertising ban.
Ik ben niet voornemens een reclameverbod wettelijk te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over nieuwe bezuinigingen die bestuurders van Ziekenhuisgroep Twente (ZGT) doorvoeren

An MP asked the minister about ZGT hospital board cuts, including closing outpatient clinics in Nijverdal and Goor, raising parking tariffs, and possible closure of the Hengelo emergency department, and asked about insurers' role and cost savings. The minister said the closure decisions lie with the hospital board, declined to disclose savings figures as commercially sensitive, said the inspectorate sees no patient safety risk, and referred to a forthcoming letter on the emergency department and location profiles.
This is commercially sensitive information that I do not have.
Dit is bedrijfsgevoelige informatie waar ik niet over beschik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over te weinig kennis over het vrouwenhart

An MP asked the health minister about waiting times and cardiologists' limited knowledge of women's heart conditions, and whether awareness campaigns, training, women's clinics and medical research on gender differences should be stepped up. The minister acknowledged that waits are undesirable, pointed to existing gender content in cardiology training, guidelines and a ZonMw gender programme, and declined to start new awareness campaigns or assess women's clinics, leaving that to insurers.
I do not see a role for me in starting additional information campaigns.
Ik zie geen rol voor mij weggelegd om aanvullende voorlichtingcampagnes te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Hermans over de berichten 'Honderdduizenden ouderen houden dure ziekenhuisbedden bezet' en 'Veel 65-plussers liggen onnodig in ziekenhuis'

VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that hundreds of thousands of elderly patients occupy costly hospital beds without medical need and that about 1.4 billion euro is spent on unnecessary care. The ministers acknowledge the problem, describe alternative options such as short-stay facilities and regional coordination points, but say most figures from the ActiZ-commissioned study cannot be verified.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Dijksma over hoge parkeertarieven bij ziekenhuizen

MPs Kooiman and Dijksma asked the minister whether high hospital parking charges, and the lack of local say over them, were acceptable and what was being done about transparency and patient support. The minister answered that he has no role or competence over parking tariffs, which lie with hospitals and municipalities, and declined to add parking costs to transport schemes or require a specific accounting duty.
I have no role or competence regarding parking tariffs and consider this the responsibility of hospitals and municipalities.
Ik heb geen rol of bevoegdheid ten aanzien van parkeertarieven en vind ik dit de verantwoordelijkheid van ziekenhuizen en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de uitzending van Radar over Sint-janskruid

MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Medical Care about a Radar broadcast showing St John's wort sold freely in drugstores without warnings about interactions with medicines, and pressed for stricter rules such as sales only via pharmacies and questioned why action had not been taken earlier. The minister acknowledged the interaction risk, announced a legally mandatory warning text on all St John's wort products by year-end, and rejected restricting sales to pharmacies as going too far, while pointing to a pilot and to monitoring by Lareb and the NVWA.
I therefore want to make a warning text on all products with St John's wort legally mandatory.
Ik wil daarom een waarschuwingstekst op alle producten met Sint-janskruid wettelijk verplicht stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijksma en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Te weinig cardiologen hebben verstand van het vrouwenhart’

MPs Dijksma and Van den Hul asked the minister about a report that too few cardiologists understand women's heart disease and about claims that women die weekly from missed diagnoses. The minister disputed the mortality claim, agreed knowledge of women's hearts is needed and is being built into training, but declined any new public awareness campaign and pointed to existing ZonMw programmes.
I do not see a role for me in starting additional public information campaigns.
Ik zie geen rol voor mij weggelegd om aanvullende voorlichtingcampagnes te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘E-healthweek 2018: ‘Opschaling is altijd gedoe’’

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about the slow scaling of e-health innovations, the potential of blockchain in healthcare, its obstacles, and the status of the Mijn Zorg Log prototype including its possible use for personal budgets. The minister answered that scaling is a challenge involving organisational change, listed existing support instruments, said blockchain is still early-stage with research ongoing by Zorginstituut Nederland, and described a small practice trial and the need for further study before wider use.
To deploy Mijn Zorg Log more broadly, including for personal budgets, further research is needed.
Om Mijn Zorg Log breder in te zetten, waaronder voor PGB, is nader onderzoek nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Hermans en De Lange over het bericht 'Wachttijden onacceptabel'

MPs from the VVD asked the government about the causes of waiting times across healthcare sectors, whether insurers and providers have agreed to reduce them, and what the NZa can enforce. The minister answered that the NZa has an action plan, that insurers can be sanctioned under their duty of care, and that concrete follow-up such as reports to the House is planned.
Health insurers must make efforts to ensure that their insured persons receive good quality, accessible and timely care.
Zorgverzekeraars moeten zich inspannen om ervoor te zorgen dat hun verzekerden kwalitatief goede, bereikbare en tijdige zorg ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Ambulance laat Lies (91) uren lijden”

MP Aukje de Vries asked the Minister for Medical Care how a 91-year-old woman with a broken hip could wait five hours for non-urgent ambulance transport, whether the situation could have been prevented, how often such cases occur, and whether the same wait would have applied after a fall in public space. The minister expressed regret, explained the case was classed as B-urgency due to ambulance staff shortages, said such delays are not systematically tracked, and committed to discussing response times with the regional acute care chairs.
No nationally binding time standards apply to B-transport.
Voor B-vervoer gelden geen landelijk bindende tijdsnormen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat farmaceut Pfizer stopt met onderzoek naar medicatie voor Parkinson en Alzheimer

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about Pfizer ending its neuroscience research on Parkinson's and Alzheimer's drugs, its reasons, consequences, and whether the Netherlands should fund an independent national drug research fund. The Minister says Pfizer decides its own portfolio, other firms and research groups remain active, and he will not create a national fund, though he will address alternative development models in a later response.
As I indicated above, I do not share your view that priorities for drug development are set solely by industry.
Zoals ik hierboven heb aangegeven deel ik uw mening niet dat de prioriteiten voor medicijnontwikkeling uitsluitend door de industrie worden vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de vergunningsaanvraag voor het openen van een nieuwe abortuskliniek in ‘s Hertogenbosch

An MP asked whether a new abortion clinic in 's-Hertogenbosch was being licensed, whether capacity or spread can be considered, and whether investor returns create incentives. The minister replied that no application has been received yet, that licensing law contains no capacity or spread conditions, that he is reviewing whether regulation needs changing, and that the clinic may not pursue profit.
As reported to the House of Representatives on 27 September 2017, I am looking at the current regulations in this area to see whether adjustment is needed.
Zoals aan de Tweede Kamer gemeld op 27 september 2017 4 kijk ik naar de huidige regelgeving op dit gebied om te bezien of aanpassing nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Paternotte over het monopolie van sportbonden

D66 MPs asked whether the European Commission's ruling against the ISU's eligibility rules for skaters racing outside federation structures affects Dutch athletes, whether pro football clubs could play outside the Dutch pyramid, whether other federations sanction athletes similarly, and whether Dutch law should change. The minister replied that the ruling concerns the ISU alone, that FIFA rules allow pro clubs to play outside the calendar with federation permission, that no comparable federation sanctions are known, and that no change to Dutch law is needed.
In light of the above, I see no reason to amend laws and regulations.
In het licht van bovenstaande zie ik geen aanleiding om wet- en regelgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over het bericht “Experts luiden noodklok over falende aanpak tijgermug”

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Health and Agriculture about expert warnings that the approach to the tiger mosquito is failing, and whether the NVWA can monitor and control invasive exotic mosquitoes and their introduction via products such as used tyres and Lucky Bamboo. The minister says the NVWA monitors risk locations and businesses with traps, that the ministries fund monitoring and control, and that existing preventive measures are sufficient, while acknowledging that the imported products cannot be checked directly at borders given free movement in the EU.
I consider the monitoring of and supervision over businesses and the monitoring at risk locations (see also the answer to question 2) sufficient.
Ik acht de monitoring van en het toezicht op bedrijven en de monitoring op de risicolocaties (zie ook het antwoord op vraag 2) voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijksma over het bericht dat huisartsen in achterstandswijken structureel overbelast zijn

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about funding for health-care disadvantaged neighbourhood funds, the number of residents in NZa-designated areas, the methodology for the postcode lists and whether regulatory measures will be taken, and whether insurers made extra investment agreements for 2018. The minister gave figures on fund income, said the postcode lists are under review with intent to change by 2019, declined to take regulatory measures as this is for LHV and ZN, and said he has no insight into extra insurer agreements for 2018 though a general investment commitment exists.
I do not intend to take regulatory measures myself.
Ik ben niet voornemens zelf regulerende maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat Achmea met een fusie van dochtermaatschappijen orde op zake probeert te stellen

An SP MP asked the health minister about Achmea's merger of Zilveren Kruis and De Friesland amid financial strain at subsidiary FBTO, including whether DNB supervision and capital transfers within the group protect premium payers. The minister answered that DNB was informed and approved FBTO's recovery plan, that intra-group capital transfers are permitted and sound, and that the merger is a commercial decision whose legality is pending before the Ondernemingskamer.
I am awaiting the judgment of the Enterprise Chamber.
Ik wacht het oordeel van de Ondernemingskamer af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Lange over tekorten aan huisartsen in de regio

MPs Aukje de Vries and De Lange asked the minister about shortages of GPs in regions such as Friesland and Zeeland, monitoring of supply, and measures to address them.
