The minister replied that there is no national GP shortage, that regions must solve local problems with insurers' help, and that the government will send an action plan in spring 2018.
At present I am not holding consultations with the Landelijke Huisartsenvereniging (LHV) and health insurers specifically to solve the GP shortages in the regions.
Op dit moment voer ik geen overleg met de Landelijke Huisartsenvereniging (LHV) en zorgverzekeraars om specifiek het tekort aan huisartsen in de regio’s op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘De tropenarts dreigt te verdwijnen’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the risk of the tropical medicine specialist (arts IGT) training disappearing as five of 24 hospitals have stopped offering it, and whether talks with stakeholders would be held. The minister answered that these doctors serve abroad, that Dutch care does not depend on them, and saw no reason for consultation on training places.
From my responsibility for care in the Netherlands I see no reason to consult on maintaining the number of training places.
Ik zie vanuit mijn verantwoordelijkheid voor de zorg in Nederland geen aanleiding voor overleg over behoud van het aantal opleidingsplekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de normalisering van gebruik van lachgas voor recreatieve doeleinden

MP Kuik (CDA) asks the government about the normalisation of recreational nitrous oxide use among young people, its benign image, online and retail sales, and enforcement against hospitality businesses supplying it. Minister Bruins answers that a Trimbos study shows concentrated but mostly incidental use, that Trimbos will add prevention on nitrous oxide, and that talks with retailers on voluntary restrictions are ongoing, with stronger measures to be considered if these fail.
I have asked the Trimbos Institute to include nitrous oxide as a specific theme in their current prevention offer to schools, parents and nightlife visitors.
Ik heb het Trimbos-instituut gevraagd lachgas als specifiek thema mee te nemen in hun huidige preventie-aanbod aan scholen, ouders en uitgaanders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht 'De overheid is de regie kwijt in het bestrijden van overlast van ratten'

An MP from the CDA asked ministers about reports that government has lost control of rat control, including the health risks, the RIVM rat monitoring, WHO advice, the status of an initiative group, the effectiveness of integrated pest management and public information for households. The ministers answered that three ministries share responsibility, that no national plague or clear rise in rat-related disease is visible, that existing legal frameworks cover prevention, and that monitoring, a planned effectiveness study and consumer information are under way.
Three ministries jointly lead the control of rat nuisance.
Er zijn drie ministeries die gezamenlijk regie voeren op het bestrijden van overlast van ratten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat er een einde dreigt te komen aan döner kebab

An MP asked whether EU phosphate rules could effectively ban döner kebab in the Netherlands, and whether the government would lobby for an exemption and assess job and revenue losses. The minister replied that the EU parliament had approved phosphate use in döner kebab, that no ban is at issue, that additives are EU-regulated and no exemption or loss study is needed, and that the government will communicate with the sector.
Yes, I can understand that. Meanwhile it has become clear that phosphates in döner kebab will not be banned.
Ja, dat kan ik begrijpen. Intussen is duidelijk geworden dat fosfaten in döner kebab niet worden verboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Nispen over de strafrechtelijke aanpak van matchfixing

MPs Kuiken and Van Nispen asked whether matchfixing should be made explicitly criminal, given evidence problems reported by prosecutors. Minister Grapperhaus replied that prosecutors have managed with existing law, that the Openbaar Ministerie will explore whether a separate offence adds value, and that a reporting duty and any sanction will be studied before further steps are taken.
The Public Prosecution Service will examine whether a separate criminal offence of matchfixing adds value to the current legal instruments for acting against fraud in sport.
Het Openbaar Ministerie gaat bekijken of zelfstandige strafbaarstelling van matchfixing meerwaarde heeft ten aanzien van het huidig wettelijk instrumentarium om op te treden tegen fraude in de sport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Sjoerdsma over homofobie in de voetbalwereld

MPs Diertens and Sjoerdsma asked the ministers about a news report on homophobia in football, whether homosexuality remains a taboo among professional players, and how acceptance of LHBTI athletes in sport will be promoted. The minister condemned intolerance, cited a 2014 survey of players, and pointed to KNVB workshops, the Alliantie Gelijkspelen and the sports agreement as measures.
To further promote diversity in sport and the acceptance of LHBTI athletes, I will include this theme as a focus area in future sports policy.
Om diversiteit in de sport en de acceptatie van LHBTI-sporters verder te bevorderen, zal ik dit thema meenemen als aandachtsgebied in het toekomstig sportbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat bevallen in Emmen niet mogelijk is

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Medical Care about the reported temporary closure of obstetric and children's wards at Scheper Hospital in Emmen, including causes, financial mismanagement, the 2008 merger and plans to reopen. The minister answered that the wards stay open a week longer, that the Inspectorate saw no unsafe care beforehand but staffing shortages posed a risk, and that the hospital and insurers are primarily responsible, declining to give internal financial details.
Treant has informed me that it cannot provide information on this, because it is internal business information.
Treant heeft mij laten weten hier geen informatie over te kunnen geven, omdat dit interne bedrijfsinformatie is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de kindergeneeskunde afdeling en verloskunde afdeling van het Scheper ziekenhuis tijdelijk sluiten

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the temporary closure of paediatrics and acute obstetrics at Scheper hospital in Emmen due to a shortage of paediatricians, including ambulance travel times, staff complaints, board decisions, inspectorate involvement and measures to reopen. The Minister answered that the wards could stay open until 18 December, that responsibility for regional care lies with providers and insurers, and that the NZa and Inspectorate are monitoring, while noting ambulance impacts will be analysed and no commitment beyond monitoring was given.
The organisation of care in the region is primarily the responsibility of care providers and health insurers.
De organisatie van de zorg in de regio is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Keuzevrijheid is in het geding’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Arno Rutte asked whether limited competition and entry barriers in the health insurance market threaten consumer choice, and whether the government will commission further study or reconsider regulation and a proposed profit ban. The minister agrees competition matters, cites the ACM report on entry barriers, finds current regulation proportionate, and declines additional research as the ACM study already covers the issue.
Additional research therefore currently has no added value.
Aanvullend onderzoek heeft daarom op dit moment geen meerwaarde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berg over de uitzending van Kassa ‘Nabestaanden dupe van niet-transparante uitvaartondernemers’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care and the State Secretary about a Kassa broadcast on funeral undertakers and mortuary costs imposed on bereaved families without prior agreement. The Minister acknowledged communication failures, said the sector will tighten working agreements and transparency, and pointed bereaved families to the funeral provider and the Stichting Klachteninstituut Uitvaartwezen for complaints.
Once bereaved families have been informed by the funeral undertaker, they must receive full openness and have freedom of choice regarding the further care of the deceased.

Op het moment dat nabestaanden geïnformeerd zijn door de uitvaartondernemer, dienen zij volledige openheid van zaken te krijgen en hebben zij keuzevrijheid ten aanzien van de invulling van de verdere zorg voor de overledene.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de CASA-klinieken

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked the Minister about signals that care quality at CASA clinics was not guaranteed, including workload, use of temporary nurses, and the protection of counselling and information rights for women seeking abortion. The Minister answered that the inspectorate placed CASA Klinieken under intensified supervision, that responsibility for care quality lies with the board, and that a licence procedure will apply to any takeover.
After completion of the intensified supervision process, the inspectorate will prepare a report and publish it as usual.
Na afronding van het traject van verscherpt toezicht zal de inspectie een rapportage opstellen en zoals gebruikelijk openbaarmaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het vergoeden en/of verlagen van de prijs van medicinale cannabis

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Medical Care whether medicinal cannabis could be reimbursed or made cheaper, and when placebo-controlled studies and the price study would be ready. The minister answered that Leiden University Medical Center's placebo-controlled study should finish around July 2018 with results in autumn 2018, and that the price will fall from EUR 6.20 to EUR 5.80 from 1 January 2018.
The study on lowering the price of medicinal cannabis has just been completed.
Het onderzoek ter verlaging van de prijs van medicinale cannabis is net afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Consumentenbond bezorgd over groot aantal ‘kloonpolissen’’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the Consumentenbond's concern over many near-identical 'clone policies' sold within the same insurance groups, and whether transparency and NZa enforcement are adequate. The minister acknowledged the importance of transparency, described new NZa rules from November 2017 requiring clear disclosure, said the NZa is monitoring the 2018 switching season and will report in early 2018, and agreed to talk with the NZa about holding insurers to their transparency duties.
The NZa maintains supervision of the regulation throughout the entire switching season.
De NZa houdt gedurende het gehele overstapseizoen toezicht op de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gerbrands over het bericht dat een ziekenhuis professionele tolken in gaat zetten

An MP from the PVV asked the health minister about a hospital's decision to use professional interpreters after a wrongful hysterectomy, including who pays and whether patients should bear responsibility for their Dutch language skills. The minister called the hospital's measures good, said the hospital bears the interpreter costs itself, and stated that communication is essential to good care and that patients are responsible for managing language barriers.
These costs are not reimbursed by central government.
Deze kosten worden niet van rijkswege vergoed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over gedragsinterventie voor jongeren die zich misdragen hebben op het voetbalveld

Mr Van Nispen (SP) asked the ministers whether the 'Sport en Gedrag' training for youths who misbehaved on the football pitch will be discontinued for lack of funds and asked for support to keep it. Minister Bruins answered that the government funds the training through end-2018, that it is anchored in Halt's offer, and that talks with the KNVB and Halt on adapting it for other sports are ongoing.
Until the end of 2018 I support the Sport en Gedrag training, as part of the action plan 'Towards a Safe Sports Climate'.
Tot en met eind 2018 ondersteun ik de trainingen Sport en Gedrag, als onderdeel van het actieplan «Naar een Veilig Sportklimaat».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Aardbeien zes keer giftiger dan ander fruit door cocktaileffect’

MP De Groot asked whether the NVWA assesses combination effects of pesticide residues on strawberries, whether standards exist, and why the EFSA cumulative assessment method, required since 2005, is still not in place. The minister answered that MRLs cover single substances only, that a cumulative method is under development with EFSA and RIVM, and committed to urging EFSA to speed up the process and requesting a timetable.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over wijkverpleging

An MP asks whether the minister is aware of Zilveren Kruis's plan to require prior authorisation for uncontracted home nursing, and argues this adds bureaucracy, burdens patients who must pay upfront, and harms uncontracted providers. The minister acknowledges the letter, says the measure aims to curb cost growth and fraud and reduce pressure on the budget, notes patients can avoid it by choosing contracted providers, and says he understands the insurer's measures without committing to ask it to withdraw them.
I support Zilveren Kruis in promoting contracted care and understand that insurers introduce additional safeguards for uncontracted providers.
Ik steun Zilveren Kruis in het bevorderen van gecontracteerde zorg en heb er begrip voor dat de verzekeraars extra waarborgen inricht ten aanzien van ongecontracteerde aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de beschikbaarheid van bacteriofagen als alternatief voor antibiotica

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the unavailability of bacteriophage therapy in the Netherlands, commercial trips to Georgia, and research funding. The minister said clinical evidence is limited, outlined ongoing Dutch phage research and funding programmes, and promised a RIVM literature study and a visit to the Eliava institute.
I also indicate that treatment with bacteriophages or products based on them is possible under conditions and has also been practically used in the Netherlands.
Ook geef ik aan dat een behandeling met bacteriofagen of producten die daarop gebaseerd zijn onder voorwaarden mogelijk en ook praktisch gebruikt is in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het voornemen van Zilveren Kruis om geneesmiddelen voor een jaar te verstrekken in plaats van maximaal drie maanden

An MP asked the Minister whether Zilveren Kruis's policy of dispensing cheap chronic medicines for up to a year, instead of three months, breaches the national prescription agreement and what the effects would be. The Minister answered that the insurer's policy does not breach the agreement, which covers only new, expensive and palliative medicines, and that prescribers and patients will set appropriate durations, with the government deferring the details to contract negotiations.
Zilveren Kruis does not deviate from the prescription arrangement with its purchasing policy.
Zilveren Kruis wijkt met haar inkoopbeleid niet af van de prescriptieregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars hun afspraken met huisartsen niet nakomen

An SP MP asked the minister whether health insurers are failing to honour the 2018 GP agreement on investment in vulnerable groups, and what safeguards will prevent this. The minister acknowledged the reports, said the parties must resolve it locally and regionally, and noted a shared commitment to the agreement without committing to a concrete step.
I expect the parties to keep talking with each other and to reach agreement.
Ik ga er van uit dat de partijen goed met elkaar in gesprek blijven en dat ze er uit komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijksma over het bericht dat huisartsen in achterstandswijken structureel overbelast zijn

MP Dijksma asks the health minister how he responds to reports that GPs in deprived neighbourhoods are structurally overloaded, whether he will meet the GP and insurer bodies, whether he will provide more than the planned 10 million euros, and whether the allocation criteria will be revisited. The minister points to existing supplements and deprivation funds, says the NZa is already convening the parties, declines extra funding for now, and says the criteria are on the NZa-chaired agenda.
I will not make additional funds available at this moment.
Ik zal op dit moment geen extra middelen beschikbaar stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özdil en Ellemeet over de numerus fixus in (tand)artsenopleidingen

MPs Özdil and Ellemeet asked whether the numerus fixus in dentist and doctor training causes the dentist shortage, raises specialist salaries and collective care costs, and whether more training places should be funded. The minister answered that the latest capacity study is under way with results expected end 2017 or early 2018, that the numerus fixus is considered sufficiently generous, and that integrated tariffs were introduced in 2015 to address costs, without committing to a new estimate of places.
I would prefer to await the results of this study before making statements about the number of training places needed.
Graag wacht ik de resultaten van dit onderzoek af alvorens uitspraken te doen over het aantal benodigde opleidingsplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de financiële problemen van Ziekenhuis Groep Twente (ZGT)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about financial trouble at Ziekenhuis Groep Twente (ZGT), including the board's cost cuts, the loss of 9.7 million, and whether the hospital supervisory bodies and the IGJ had acted. The minister answered that hospitals are responsible for their own finances, that ZGT has been transparent, and that the IGJ monitors quality and safety rather than financial management, while stating he cannot judge the internal supervisor's conduct.
From my position I cannot judge the conduct of ZGT's internal supervisor.
Ik kan vanuit mijn positie niet oordelen over de handelwijze van de interne toezichthouder van ZGT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijksma over het bericht “Debat over duur medicijn door lobbyist ‘vervuild’“

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that drugmaker Vertex gave misleading profit information and lobbied through patient groups during negotiations over the drug Orkambi, and whether the ministry would disclose the negotiation details and payment. The minister condemned Vertex's conduct but refused to disclose the price and negotiation details citing contractual confidentiality, while promising greater transparency on the process and publication of the last offer after failed negotiations.
This information I cannot share because of the agreements on confidentiality that were made.
Deze informatie kan ik vanwege de gemaakte afspraken over vertrouwelijkheid niet delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het naar Nederland terughalen van de Formule 1

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether a feasibility study for returning Formula 1 to Zandvoort was known, whether the TT circuit in Assen was also studying it, and whether the Sports Council would be asked for advice. The minister confirmed the Zandvoort report but said it was only a first exploration with too many uncertainties, so no advice request would be made yet, though the Sports Council could be asked later.
There are too many uncertainties to arrive at a concrete request for advice to the Dutch Sports Council.
Er zijn te veel onzekerheden om tot een concrete adviesaanvraag aan de Nederlandse Sportraad te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de aangekondigde ontslagen bij Ziekenhuis Groep Twente

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about ZGT hospital's plan to cut 150 jobs, the reasons, union involvement, the role of banks, the future of the Hengelo emergency department, and whether the recovery plan would be shared. The minister said the cuts are needed, ZGT is negotiating a new social plan with unions, the Inspectorate monitors quality risks, and the banks are reviewing the plan, but declined to share the internal recovery plan and said it is not for the minister to intervene in hospital management.
ZGT has informed me that the recovery plan is an internal plan that is only shared with the banks and health insurers.
ZGT heeft mij laten weten dat het herstelplan een intern plan is dat alleen met de banken en zorgverzekeraars wordt gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de noodzakelijke toestemming voor het vergoed krijgen van langdurige psychoanalytische psychotherapie

An MP asks why insurer OHRA requires written prior consent for long-term psychoanalytic psychotherapy that the Zorginstituut has classified as insured care, and questions the legal basis and the administrative burden. The Minister answers that insurers may require procedural prior consent as an administrative condition, that this serves appropriate use of care, and that the Zorginstituut's standpoint does not remove each insurer's duty to verify indication, while stating that consent requirements for long-term psychotherapy are not common among other insurers.
Health insurers are jointly responsible for the correctness of claims charged to the Zvw.
Zorgverzekeraars zijn medeverantwoordelijk voor de juistheid van declaraties ten laste van de Zvw.

An SP MP asks the new Minister for Medical Care how she will credibly tackle top earners in healthcare, pointing to the minister's own earnings from UWV and NPO that exceed the Wet normering topinkomens limit. The minister replies that the premise is a misunderstanding because UWV complies with the Act, which applies to everyone, and that the CIBG supervises suspected violations in healthcare.
Where there is a (suspected) violation of the Wet normering topinkomens in healthcare, the CIBG acts as the independent supervisor.
Daar waar sprake is van een (vermoeden van een) overtreding van de Wet normering topinkomens in de zorg treedt het CIBG op als onafhankelijk toezichthouder.

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Defence about costly recruitment campaigns that yield few new soldiers, including campaign spending, applications versus appointments, performance indicators, bottlenecks, attrition, and whether conscription should be reintroduced. The State Secretary answered at length, disputing the press portrayal, providing spending and intake figures, explaining selection attrition and measures underway, and rejecting compulsory service for now while preparing a voluntary Defence survey and retaining the conscription option as a last resort.

MPs from several parties asked whether part of the 2026 military support budget for Ukraine was brought forward into 2025, leaving a gap in 2026, and how the government will prevent unwanted gaps. The Minister confirms that €3.1 billion for 2026 was partly accelerated into 2025, that planned 2026 cash outlays now stand at about €2.1 billion, and that support will continue with further burden-sharing efforts, without committing to a specific new safeguard.
Part of this support has been accelerated into cash expenditure in 2025.
Een deel van deze steun is versneld in 2025 tot kasuitgaven gekomen.
